name: Plot: Health stats reimagined
description:
Apple Health collects almost everything and explains almost nothing. Plot reads it and draws it: what changed, what it might connect to, and one gentle idea when you ask for it.

YOUR NORMAL, NOT THE AVERAGE
Every measure is read against your own normal, worked out from your recent weeks and drawn as a hatched band. A point above, within or below the band is enough to read a day.

48 PLATES, ONE LANGUAGE
Sleep, movement, heart and mind, each drawn with a ruler and a compass. Night Barcode, Resting Seismograph, Daylight Horizon, Body Clock and 44 more. Tap any plate for the full picture, then pull up for every reading and its source.

FOUR WAYS IN
• Today: the day as one edition, ranked by what moved, with its week, season and year.
• Atlas: every plate, by body system.
• Board: the plates you pin, in the order you set.
• Reflect: a Sunday edition for the week.

GENTLE BY DESIGN
Ideas come when you ask, or as one quiet line on a plate. No streaks, no badges, no red alarms. Patterns are shown with their evidence and labelled for what they are: a pattern, not proof.

PRIVATE BY ARCHITECTURE
Everything is computed on your iPhone. No account. No server. No analytics. Apple Health is only read, never written. If you share your place, it is rounded to about 10 km and stays on your iPhone.

Plot is a wellness reader, not a medical device. It does not diagnose. Cycle dates are estimates from the cycles you log, not a method of birth control. Clinical questions belong with a clinician.

name: Indian Compass: Hare Krishna
주차 도우미
description:
지하 3층이었나, 4층이었나? 주차 도우미는 차를 세우고 버튼 한 번만 누르면 주차한 곳을 기억해 두는 앱이에요. 유튜브 「너도 운전」 채널이 만들었어요.

■ 한 번 눌러 주차
· [지금 여기 주차했어요]를 누르면 위치와 시각을 저장해요
· 지하 B1~B5 층, 기둥 알파벳 A~G를 눌러서 고르고, 기둥 번호는 말로 적어도 돼요
· 기둥과 표지판 사진을 찍어 두면 GPS가 안 잡히는 지하에서도 찾기 쉬워요
· 집·회사처럼 늘 세우는 곳은 [자주 가는 곳]에 저장해 두면 홈에서 한 번에 주차

■ 걸어서 찾아가기
· 카카오맵, 네이버 지도, 애플 지도로 차까지 걷는 길을 바로 열어 줘요

■ 요금과 시간
· 주차장 입구의 요금표를 넣으면 지금까지 나온 요금을 계속 계산해요
· "몇 시간 세우면 얼마?"를 미리 계산해 볼 수 있어요
· 무료 시간이나 정한 시간이 끝나기 10분 전에 알림을 보내요

■ 주차 기록
· 언제 어디에 얼마나 세웠는지, 이번 달 주차 횟수와 요금을 모아 보여 줘요

■ 알아 두면 좋은 것
· 여기 세워도 될까? 주정차 금지 장소와 과태료
· 장애인 전용주차구역과 전기차 충전구역 규칙
· 주차장에서 긁었거나 긁혔을 때 할 일 (연락처 남기기, 신고, 보험)
· 문콕 피하기, 비탈길, 겨울·여름 주차 꿀팁
법·과태료 내용은 도로교통법 등 공식 자료로 확인했어요 (2026년 11월 기준).

■ 내 정보는 내 휴대폰에만
· 주차 위치, 사진, 기록은 모두 이 휴대폰에만 저장돼요. 회원가입도, 서버도 없어요.

한국어, English, 日本語, 中文을 지원해요.
문의: yourdriving@naver.com

name: 8¾ Ball
description:
Think of a yes-or-no question. Shake your iPhone — or tap the button — and watch as swirling smoke parts to reveal your magical answer.

8¾ Ball is a beautifully crafted fortune-telling experience, designed with cinematic animations, haptic feedback, and rich seasonal atmospheres.

FEATURES

• Shake, tap, or flip your phone to ask
• Cinematic reveal: swirling smoke, golden sparks, light flash, and haptics
• 40 original replies across two sets. Choose dry humor with Classic or a touch of prophecy with Fantasy.
• Seasonal worlds: snow in winter, fallen leaves in autumn, blossoms in spring, fireflies in summer — changes automatically with the real season and your hemisphere
• My Ball: create your own answer sets for any occasion
• English and Hebrew. Hebrew answers and instructions are written with niqqud.
• VoiceOver, Dynamic Type, and Reduce Motion support
• No ads, no tracking, no account, no internet required

CRAFTED WITH CARE

The golden frame catches light, the ball responds to your phone’s tilt, particles drift with the season, and the haptics pulse in sync with the reveal.

Your custom answer sets are stored on your phone only. No cloud, no sharing, no account needed.

name: Ababeel World
description:
Ababeel World: the bird and cat supplies store from Saudi Arabia, short lessons for pet birds and a nutrition guide, in one Arabic-first app.

Shop
• Cages, food, toys and supplements for your birds and cats.
• One cart and one account shared with ababeel-world.com.
• Secure payment by card or mada on the store's own payment page.
• Order tracking, one-tap reorder and order status notifications.

Learn
• Step-by-step lessons on taming budgies, cockatiels, African greys, ringnecks and lovebirds.
• Questions, hands-on tasks and a daily plan that fits your bird's stage, with a day streak and an optional reminder.
• Play Yard: "Who am I?", "True or false" and "Put the steps in order", short games from your lessons with a daily challenge.

Nutrition
• "Is this safe for my bird?": search more than 300 foods, with a clear alert for toxic foods and the source of every entry.
• Scan a product: scan the barcode to see the ingredients and bird-safety warnings.
• A food diary and weight log for every bird.

Ababeel Studio
• Make a card from your pet's photo: Ababeel World frames, stickers and text.
• Save it to Photos or share it. Your photos stay on your phone; nothing is uploaded.

Your pets
• A profile for every bird or cat with photos, stage, housing and an ID card.
• A weight log with a drop alert.
• Pet data stays on your device and is never uploaded.

Every lesson and tool in this version is free for everyone, and an account is optional. Fully in Arabic with English support, light and dark modes.

name: Abuelo OK
description:
Abuelo OK gives peace of mind to families looking after a grandparent who lives alone.

A phone stays at their home with Abuelo OK in "home phone" mode. From your iPhone you see how the home is doing and get an alert when it matters:

• Help request: if your grandparent presses the help button you are alerted right away, and with "I'm on my way" they know someone is coming.
• No activity: if the hours you choose go by with no movement at home, you get an alert (quiet hours respected).
• Power and internet: you are alerted when the power goes out or the home phone stops responding.
• "I'm fine": your grandparent can let you know with one tap that all is well.

On your iPhone:
• Each home's status at a glance: power, internet and activity.
• Today's timeline and the power outage history.
• Invite other relatives with a code and choose who gets each alert.
• Works in Spanish and English.

Privacy: Abuelo OK never records audio or video. The home phone only reports whether there was activity, the power state, battery and connection. You can delete your account and data in the app.

Important: Abuelo OK does not call 911 and is not an emergency service. Alerts depend on power, internet and signal and may be late or never arrive. In an emergency, call 911.

Abuelo OK is free.

name: Acaib: Minyatür Yapboz
description:
Müze koleksiyonlarından 24 minyatürle yapboz. Parça sayısını sen seçersin: 12, 24, 48 ya da 96.

Parçaları alttaki tepsiden çekip çerçeveye bırakırsın. Yerine yaklaşan parça oturur. Parçaları çerçevenin dışında da birbirine tutturabilir, tutunanları birlikte taşıyabilirsin. Tepside yalnız kenar parçalarını gösterebilir, bitmiş resme bakabilir, iki parmakla yakınlaştırabilirsin.

Yaprağı bitirince hikâyesi açılır: sahnede ne oluyor, hangi kitaptan, hangi müzede. Leylâ ile Mecnûn çölde buluşuyor, İskender cam bir çanla denize iniyor.

Her gün bir yaprak günün yaprağı olur. Yarım bıraktığın yapboz kaydedilir, kaldığın yerden sürdürürsün.

Görsellerin hepsi müzelerin kendi taraması. Yapay zekâyla üretilmiş görsel yok. Kurumlar bu taramaları açık lisansla yayımlıyor, her yaprağın künyesi hikâyesinin altında.

Reklam yok, hesap gerekmez, internet olmadan çalışır.

name: Accountancy Hub
description:
Accountancy Hub is the study app for students of Accountancy Hub's ACCA courses. Sign in with your account and continue learning on your phone or tablet.

STUDY YOUR WAY
• Watch your recorded video lectures anytime
• Lessons taught in Urdu/Hindi and English
• Pick up exactly where you left off

PRACTISE AND TEST YOURSELF
• Topic-wise tests for each paper
• Full mock exams to build exam confidence
• Instant quiz results so you can see where to improve

TRACK YOUR PROGRESS
• See all your enrolled courses in one place
• Follow your lesson progress and completed lessons
• Review your quiz attempts and results

MORE FROM ACCOUNTANCY HUB
• Meet your instructors and read their profiles
• Keep your profile up to date, including your photo
• Contact the team from inside the app

SIMPLE AND SECURE
• Create an account with your email and verify it with a one-time code
• Your courses appear in the app after you sign in
• You can delete your account and data at any time from the Profile screen

Need help? Email contact@accountancyhub.net or call/WhatsApp +92 336 0496752.

Accountancy Hub is an independent education provider and is not affiliated with or endorsed by ACCA.

name: AcrossNow
description:
A clearer way across. AcrossNow brings your closest Canada–USA land crossings, official border wait reports and everyday destinations into one simple iPhone app.

See the three crossings closest to your location, explore the wider border on the map and check standard or NEXUS reports where agencies publish them. Each report shows its original source age. Missing reports are shown clearly rather than treated as no delay.

Save your usual destinations, return to recent searches and open your selected destination in Apple Maps. Supported Windsor–Detroit crossings can show approximate trip breakdowns alongside border waits. Apple Maps chooses its own navigation route; verify your intended crossing before driving.

Optional quick reports let you log a wait range and the time you crossed. An optional local crossing log records reviewed queue-to-primary-inspection measurements. Reports, destinations and learning records stay on your iPhone in this release. They are not a shared crowd feed, and learning results do not change route recommendations.

The catalog includes 118 Canada–USA land offices, including Alaska. Live reports cover a subset. Check official hours, eligibility, closures and documents before travelling. Passenger vehicles only. Independent of CBP, CBSA and crossing operators. Waits are estimates and can change.

name: AeeskLoa
description:
Your private workout log—on your iPhone only.

AeeskLoa helps you record what you did, how long, and how it felt, without social feeds, accounts, or cloud sync. Built for quick taps after a session, with streaks and simple insights to keep you moving.

name: Aerventhora Play
description:
Λίγος αέρας. Μια ασφαλής άφιξη.

Ανάλαβε μια ήσυχη βάρδια σε έναν τροχιακό σταθμό φορτίου. Απασφάλισε ένα κιβώτιο, δες τη διαδρομή του και στείλε έναν παλμό αέρα. Οδήγησε κάθε αριθμημένο κιβώτιο στον αντίστοιχο θάλαμο και ασφάλισέ το για την παράδοση.

Ο αέρας είναι κοινός πόρος. Κάθε παλμός αλλάζει την πίεση που απομένει για την επόμενη κίνηση. Μερικές φορές η έξυπνη επιλογή είναι να κρατήσεις ένα κιβώτιο σταθερό όσο περνά ο αέρας. Οι διακεκομμένες διαδρομές μεταφέρουν μόνο αέρα.

24 ΧΕΙΡΟΠΟΙΗΤΕΣ ΠΑΡΑΔΟΣΕΙΣ
Εξερεύνησε τέσσερις τομείς με κοινά αποθέματα, πολλά κιβώτια και τελικές ενδείξεις ασφαλείας. Η πρώτη παράδοση περιλαμβάνει πρακτική καθοδήγηση που μπορείς να παραλείψεις.

ΔΕΣ ΤΗΝ ΚΙΝΗΣΗ ΠΡΙΝ ΤΗΝ ΕΠΙΒΕΒΑΙΩΣΕΙΣ
Η προεπισκόπηση δείχνει πού θα κινηθούν ο αέρας και το φορτίο. Ακύρωσε την προεπισκόπηση, αναίρεσε επιβεβαιωμένες κινήσεις ή ζήτησε υπόδειξη για την τρέχουσα κατάσταση.

ΒΡΕΣ ΤΗ ΔΙΚΗ ΣΟΥ ΚΑΛΥΤΕΡΗ ΔΙΑΔΡΟΜΗ
Κάθε ασφαλής παράδοση μετράει. Οι προαιρετικοί στόχοι αποδοτικότητας δίνουν λόγο να επιστρέψεις, χωρίς να εμποδίζουν την πρόοδο. Ολοκλήρωσε και τις 24 βάρδιες για να ετοιμάσεις τον σταθμό για το επόμενο πλήρωμα.

ΚΡΑΤΗΣΕ ΤΟ ΙΣΤΟΡΙΚΟ ΤΩΝ ΠΑΡΑΔΟΣΕΩΝ ΣΟΥ
Συνέχισε μια ημιτελή βάρδια. Δες τις καλύτερες διαδρομές στο ημερολόγιο, παρακολούθησέ τες βήμα προς βήμα ή μοιράσου μια εικόνα παράδοσης μέσω του μενού κοινής χρήσης του iOS.

ΠΑΙΞΕ ΜΕ ΤΟΝ ΡΥΘΜΟ ΣΟΥ
Δεν υπάρχει αντίστροφη μέτρηση. Η μουσική είναι αρχικά κλειστή. Η μουσική, τα ηχητικά εφέ, οι απτικές αποκρίσεις και η μειωμένη κίνηση έχουν ξεχωριστές ρυθμίσεις. Η πρόοδος και οι προτιμήσεις ήχου αποθηκεύονται στη συσκευή σου.

Το περιβάλλον του παιχνιδιού είναι προς το παρόν στα αγγλικά. Το κείμενο του καταστήματος μπορεί να διατίθεται σε άλλες γλώσσες. Οι τοπικοί γρίφοι δεν απαιτούν λογαριασμό. 

Η εφαρμογή περιλαμβάνει απόδοση διαφημιστικών εγκαταστάσεων μέσω AppsFlyer. Όπου επιτρέπεται, το iOS ζητά άδεια παρακολούθησης πριν συνεχιστεί η ροή εκκίνησης του SDK. Η επιλογή σου δεν αλλάζει τους κανόνες των τοπικών γρίφων ή την αποθηκευμένη πρόοδο.

name: AfterDev - 현상후
description:
현상은 끝났어요.
간직하고, 보여 줄 차례예요.

현상소에서 받은 사진, 이제 휴대폰 사진 앱에서 편하게 꺼내 보세요. 현상후(AfterDev)는 필름 사진을 정리하고, 저장하고, 공유하는 앱이에요. 한 롤을 통째로 정리할 수도 있고, 바로 SNS에 올리고 싶은 한 컷은 '사진 한 장 가져오기'로 사진첩이나 파일에서 바로 불러올 수도 있어요. 남겨 둔 촬영 정보가 있다면 사진과 함께 보여줄 수도 있어요.

스캔 받은 필름 사진을 정리해요
현상소에서 받은 ZIP 파일을 가져오세요. 컷 번호와 순서를 정리할 수도 있고, 수평이나 방향이 맞지 않는 사진은 조정할 수 있어요.

저장하고, 보여 주세요
정리한 사진을 사진 앱에 저장하거나 다른 앱으로 공유해 보세요. JPEG, PNG, WebP로 저장할 수 있어요. 한 롤을 한눈에 보고 싶을 때는 여러 사진을 한 장에 모아 볼 수도 있어요.

촬영 정보도 함께 남겨요
카메라, 렌즈, 필름과 노출 정보를 사진과 함께 프레임에 담아 보세요. 한 롤에 공통으로 쓰는 정보는 한 번만 입력하고, 달라진 컷만 따로 바꿀 수 있어요. 사진만 원한다면 프레임 없이 내보내면 돼요.

사진은 내 기기에서 처리해요
회원가입 없이 사용할 수 있고, 가져온 사진과 기록은 기기 안에서 처리해요. 사진을 개발자 서버로 자동 전송하지 않아요.

name: AI Data Center Empire
description:
The AI boom needs computers, and computers need a home. Start with $100 million and one converted warehouse, and grow it into the biggest AI data center campus in town.

Data Center Empire is a turn-based business strategy game. Each month you decide what to build, what to buy and who to sign, then press Next month and watch your campus run. Five years, sixty turns, one city.

RUN THE WHOLE BUSINESS
• Build halls and buildings on your plot: small, medium or large, each with trade-offs
• Pick cooling for every hall: air, rear-door, liquid or immersion. Newer chips run hotter
• Buy power on the spot market or lock in long-term prices. Wait a year or more for the grid, or run gas turbines
• Order GPUs from three rival chip makers. Newer, faster chips are announced with long waits. Order now or wait?
• Hire the team the site needs, from part-time managers to senior leaders
• Borrow, sell shares or sell and lease back halls. Lenders watch your debt cover

WIN THE CUSTOMERS
• Sign long contracts with AI labs, cloud giants, universities and trading firms, or rent by the hour for higher prices and more risk
• Deliver what you promised: outages and late halls cost refunds and reputation
• Bid against rivals in sealed mega-contract auctions
• Customers remember how you treated them and come back with new projects

SURVIVE THE CYCLE
• Booms, slumps, chip shortages, heat waves, winter storms and grid emergencies
• Decision cards force tough calls: poached staff, buyout offers, emergency power deals
• Four rival operators race you for the top of the city ranking

SEE IT GROW
• A 3D campus that grows with you: trucks at the dock, cranes on new buildings, power and cooling flowing through every hall
• Step inside any hall to see its racks, cooling and power gear

PLAY YOUR WAY
• 3 cities, 5 founders with their own perks, 6 scenarios and 3 difficulty levels
• Earn up to 3 stars and an end-of-game grade; beat your records
• A weekly challenge with the same start for everyone, and codes to share a setup with friends
• 3 save slots. Plays offline, no account, no ads, no data collected

Built on real 2025–2026 data center economics, simplified into a game. All companies, chips, customers and cities are fictional. Not financial or investment advice.

name: AI The Right Way®
description:
AI the Right Way® is the learning app from The AI Assembly for people working towards their Responsible AI Citizen™ and Responsible AI Leader™ certifications.

Sign in with the account you already use on the AI the Right Way® portal and pick up exactly where you left off. Your progress, answers and certificates are the same on your phone and on your computer.

What's inside
• The eight pillars of responsible AI: chapters to read, with audio and video where a chapter has them, and the short checks along the way
• Real-world AI challenges: a little to read, something to try, a question, then the points
• Your points and weekly streak
• Your certificates and how long each one is valid

New to AI the Right Way®? Create your account on the portal first, at certification.theaiassembly.com.

name: Airport Notebook
description:
HND is Haneda. What about RJTT? Practice airport codes from around the world and keep a personal record of the airports you visit.

LEARN AIRPORT CODES
Switch between three-letter IATA and four-letter ICAO codes. See each airport on the map after you answer. Five questions a day and retries for missed airports are free. Bookmark airports from the quiz or directory.

KEEP AN AIRPORT JOURNAL
Save photos, aircraft sightings, and notes from your visits. Find nearby airports when you want to make an entry, and browse past visits by airport or on the map. No account is needed. Entries stay on your device, and backup and restore are free.

AIRPORT NOTEBOOK PASS
With a one-time purchase, practice without a daily limit and quiz yourself by country, region, or your own bookmarks. Build aircraft books with your photos, see past and present photos of the same aircraft side by side when the registrations match, and export PDF albums.

name: ALA-Hub
description:
ALA-Hub ist die interne Mitarbeiter-App für Teams der AUTOLACKAFFEN GmbH.

Funktionen für Mitarbeiter:
• Digitale Zeiterfassung & Stempeluhr mit GPS-Standortprüfung und Stundenkonto
• Urlaubsplaner & direkte Antragsverwaltung
• Digitales Serviceheft für Fahrzeuge, Services und Intervalle
• Auslagen-Tool & Bestellungen direkt vom iPhone
• Dienstanweisungen, Sicherheitsdatenblätter und interne Informationen
• Push-Mitteilungen auf den Sperrbildschirm bei wichtigen Team-Updates
• Bluetooth-Unterstützung für NexPTG-Lackschichtmessgeräte

Hinweis: Diese App richtet sich ausschließlich an interne Mitarbeiter und erfordert ein vom Arbeitgeber bereitgestelltes Mitarbeiterkonto. Eine öffentliche Registrierung in der App ist nicht vorgesehen.

name: Alabaster HQ
description:
Alabaster HQ brings field work and company operations together for Alabaster Contracting Solutions LLC. Sign in with your company account to see your assigned jobs, share job photos and videos, and message the people working with you.

Record your work hours and breaks, review your time history, and request corrections. If you lose your connection, the timeclock saves your punches and syncs them when you reconnect. Location is optional.

Managers can coordinate their crews and review hours for the jobs they manage. Team members can also find company documents and request uniforms or protective equipment.

name: Almanacka
description:
Rivalmanackan från väggen, direkt på hemskärmen och låsskärmen. Almanackas widgetar byter blad vid midnatt av sig själva: dagens datum, veckonummer och namnsdag på låsskärmen, och dagens blad på årstidens bild på hemskärmen – utan att du öppnar appen.

WIDGETAR
• Låsskärmen – en cirkel med dagens datum, en rektangel med veckodag, datum, namnsdag och vecka, och raden under klockan med veckonummer och namn.
• Almanacka – dagens blad på årstidens bild, med röda dagar i rött och flaggan på flaggdagar.
• Almanacka enkel – samma blad på en lugn bakgrund.
• Minimal – veckodag, stort datum och dagens namn.
• Veckan – den här veckan med röda dagar och dagens datum markerat.

BLADET
Ett blad per dag: veckonummer, veckodag, datum, månad, dagens namn, röda dagar och aftnar, flaggdagar och månens faser. Svep uppåt för morgondagen, nedåt för gårdagen. Papperet böjer sig runt ringarna och landar med ett litet tick. Årstidens bild bakom blocket: varje månad har sin, och nyår, påsk, valborg, nationaldagen, midsommar, halloween, lucia och jul har sina egna.

UNDER BLADET
Fyra kort att svepa mellan:
• Solen – soluppgång och solnedgång, och var solen står just nu. Tryck för hela årets soltider.
• Månen – upp- och nedgång, fasen, hur mycket som lyser och nästa huvudfas. Tryck för årets måne.
• Dagen – helgdag, afton, flaggdag, märkesdag eller temadag, och vad det är för något.
• Namnen – varifrån dagens namn kommer och vad de betyder.

NAMNEN
Alla namn i almanackan med sökning. Tryck på ett namn så vänder bladet till dess dag. Namnsdagarna följer Svenska Akademiens namnlängd med ändringarna till och med 2022 och de nya namnen från 2027.

PLATS
Sol- och måntider räknas för Stockholm från start. Välj en annan av 90 svenska orter, eller Automatiskt så följer tiderna din position. Platsen används bara på enheten.

KÄLLOR
Röda dagar enligt lagen om allmänna helgdagar och flaggdagar enligt förordningen om allmänna flaggdagar. Solens tider med NOAA:s metod, månens bana efter Paul Schlyter, månfaserna efter Jean Meeus.

Inget konto, ingen server, ingen reklam och ingen spårning. Allt räknas ut på enheten.

name: Alpenglow Run
description:
Drop into the mountains on Apple Vision Pro. Ski or snowboard downhill, shift your weight to carve, and pick your line when the trail splits. Each resort's runs are built from mapped trails and elevation data.

Learn turns, braking and jumps in guided lessons. On a snowboard, practice riding switch and turning in the air. Ride in first person to look down at your equipment, or watch the rider in third person. Come back for a morning, daytime or nighttime run and try to beat your best time.

The practice slope and Zermatt are free. Whistler, Niseko, Cardrona and Hemu are available as one-time purchases, individually or together. Unlocking a resort opens every playable branch in its trail network.

name: Amiruno Knit - Stitch Planner
description:
Turn your desired knitting dimensions into a practical stitch and row plan. Use your gauge swatch and finished measurements to calculate the required stitch and row counts, check planned increases and decreases, and track the rows you have completed. Keep projects in progress and finished pieces organized together with their notes.

Calculate Stitch Counts from Your Gauge

Enter the number of stitches and rows per 10 centimeters, along with the starting width, ending width, and overall length of your project. Calculate the required stitch count and total number of rows to create a knitting plan that matches your intended dimensions.

Check Increase and Decrease Timing

See which rows require increases or decreases based on the stitch counts at the beginning and end of your project. Upcoming adjustments are also displayed in a list, making it easier to review your plans when working on several projects at once.

Count Rows and Track Your Progress

Keep track of the completed row count for each project and see your progress against the planned total. Even if you take a break midway through your work, you can resume easily using your previously recorded row count.

Organize Ongoing and Finished Projects

Save projects with a name and notes, then search for and reopen them whenever needed. Completed pieces can be revisited in your archive. You can also review the total number of projects and the combined number of rows completed.

Export Your Knitting Plan

Export your knitting plan as a PDF file. Use it as a reference while working on your project or keep a copy as a record of your finished work.

name: APOUL Music: Play WMA & FLAC
description:
Your old music, playable on iPhone with no conversion, and it stays with you when you get a new iPhone.

APOUL Music plays the audio files you already own, straight from the Files app — including Windows Media (WMA/WMC) files that iPhone can't play on its own. No converter needed. No streaming, no account, no internet needed.

FREE, WITH NO TIME LIMIT
• Play every format, pick any song, shuffle and repeat
• 5-band equalizer and playback speed
• Send songs from your computer's web browser over Wi-Fi
• Move your whole library to a new iPhone
• Playlists, widgets, Siri and sleep timer
• Put "Shuffle All" in Control Center or on the Action button to start music with one press
Only small banner ads, never in the middle of a song.

PLAY ALMOST ANY FORMAT
• MP3, AAC/M4A, FLAC, WAV, AIFF, ALAC
• WMA and WMC (Windows Media)
• OGG Vorbis and Opus
• APE (Monkey's Audio) and WavPack lossless rips
• Extract the audio from MP4 and MOV videos
• Indie releases, game soundtracks and old CDs that aren't on streaming services play fine from your own files

BUILT FOR YOUR OWN FILES
• Import from Files, iCloud Drive, Google Drive, Dropbox and more
• Send songs and folders from a computer on the same Wi-Fi using its web browser (no software to install)
• Import songs from the Music app, such as CDs you ripped and synced from a computer
• Getting a new iPhone? Move everything over Wi-Fi, free: songs, covers, lyrics and playlists
• Import single songs or entire folders, subfolders included. Artist and title are filled in from file names
• Browse by folder, album or artist, or search by title and artist
• Filter by format or favorites, and sort by title, artist or date added
• Picks up where you left off, song by song
• Deleting a song only removes the app's copy, never your original file

LISTEN YOUR WAY
• 5-band equalizer with presets, including one for older recordings
• Playback speed from 0.75x to 2x, without changing pitch
• Repeat one or all, shuffle, Play Next and Play Last
• Playlists, plus smart playlists such as Most Played and Recently Added
• Sleep timer, background playback, Lock Screen and headphone controls
• Home Screen widget and Siri

MAKE IT YOURS
• Set any photo or video as a song's artwork, then adjust its position
• 9 theme colors — the app icon changes to match
• Audio Mode: full-screen visualizers that react to your music, including a retro car-stereo style and flowing light
• Face ID / Touch ID lock
• Share an image of your most-played songs of the year

APOUL MUSIC PREMIUM
Try it free for 7 days, then $1.99/month or $14.99/year (save 37%). Cancel anytime.
• No ads on any screen
• Lyrics: paste or type lyrics for each song. Time-synced (LRC) lyrics scroll line by line, and tapping a line jumps to that moment. LRC files with the same name as a song are picked up automatically when you import
• Song transitions: gapless playback or crossfade (3, 6 or 10 seconds)
• Volume leveling across songs
• Practice tools: A-B repeat, key change and karaoke mode
• Extra Audio Mode designs (Neon and VU Meter) and your own photo as the background
• Edit song titles, artists and albums, and back up and restore your library

Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Cancel anytime in Settings > Apple Account > Subscriptions; if you cancel during the free trial, you won't be charged.

Note: DRM-protected WMA files can't be played.

APOUL Music uses FFmpeg under the LGPL v2.1. See Licenses in the app for details.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://apoul.jp/music/privacy/

name: Appareltechona
description: Appareltechona turns every garment style into a living production workspace. Capture the sketch, size range, fabric and trim usage, construction steps, finishing marks and cost assumptions in one connected record. Generate multi-size and multi-colour specification sheets, then export a polished tech pack or material bill in seconds.

name: Appreciate Appbuilder
description:
Appreciate Appbuilder is the companion app of the Appreciate app builder platform. Design an app in your browser, scan a QR code, and see it running on your own phone, live.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Open your app in the designer and choose "Preview on a phone".
2. Scan the QR code with this app.
3. Your app opens with its own theme, navigation and content.
4. Change something in the designer and it shows up on your phone within seconds.

WHAT YOU CAN CHECK
• Colors, fonts, icons and backgrounds
• Tabs, menus and screens, lists with search and filters, and detail screens
• Forms and sign-in screens
• Dutch, French and English
• Phone and tablet layouts

TRY IT WITHOUT AN ACCOUNT
Tap "Try a demo app" to explore Masterpieces, a sample guide to 43 painting highlights and 15 artists. It works without a network connection.

Designing your own app requires an Appreciate Appbuilder account for your organization. Get in touch at [support email] to get started.

Demo content: open data of the Art Institute of Chicago (CC0).

name: Arròs Brut: la recepta
description:
Arròs Brut: la recepta t'acompanya a fer s'arròs brut mallorquí de sempre, des de sa compra fins a sa taula.

QUANTS SEREU?
Digues quants sereu a taula i s'app te calcula ses quantitats de cada ingredient: carn, peix, verdures, arròs, espècies i aigua.

PAS A PAS
Vuit passes explicades amb fotos, consells i avisos perquè no se t'escapi res. Quan toca tirar s'arròs, un temporitzador te guia i t'avisa quan has d'afegir cada cosa, encara que tenguis es mòbil bloquejat.

SA SENALLA
Sa llista de sa compra ordenada per botigues: carnisseria, peixateria, verdures i rebost. Marca el que ja tens a sa senalla i comparteix-la amb qui hagi d'anar a comprar.

FET A MALLORCA
Sense anuncis, sense registres i sense recollir cap dada. Un preu simbòlic per qui vulgui recolzar es projecte.

Més informació a arrosbrut.cat

name: Artemida Messenger
description:
Artemida — быстрый и аккуратный мессенджер для iPhone.

ЛИЧНЫЕ ЧАТЫ
• Сообщения доставляются мгновенно, видно, когда собеседник прочитал и печатает
• Ответы на сообщения, реакции, редактирование и удаление у всех
• Закреплённые сообщения и «Избранное» для заметок и файлов

ГРУППЫ И КАНАЛЫ
• Группы, где пишут все участники, и каналы, где пишете вы, а остальные читают
• Администраторы, добавление и исключение участников
• Отключение уведомлений и закрепление чатов в списке

ФОТО, ВИДЕО И ФАЙЛЫ
• Несколько фото и видео отправляются одним альбомом с подписью
• Файлы любого типа, в том числе фото без сжатия
• Голосовые сообщения одним нажатием

БЕЗОПАСНОСТЬ
• Вход через Apple в одно касание
• Пожаловаться на сообщение или заблокировать человека можно в два нажатия
• Аккаунт удаляется прямо в настройках

Тёмная тема, никакой рекламы.

Условия использования: https://vitiukboss-sketch.github.io/artemida/terms
Политика конфиденциальности: https://vitiukboss-sketch.github.io/artemida/privacy

name: AstrArch
description:
The galaxy is waiting. In AstrArch, explore star systems, develop your empire, and decide how to deal with the civilizations you encounter.

Discover new worlds, manage your fleets, and choose your strategy: forge alliances, negotiate with leaders, or prepare for conflict. Every system offers new possibilities, and every encounter can change the future of the galaxy.

• Explore a galactic map and its star systems
• Develop your empire and manage its resources
• Command fleets and expeditions
• Meet leaders and rival civilizations
• Get advice to help guide your decisions

name: AyetFlow
description:
Fill the moments you would spend scrolling with the Qur'an. AyetFlow is a calm, beautiful Qur'an app with a verse feed, AI-assisted Heart, narrated stories, Stillness sessions and prayer times.

VERSE FEED
• Scroll like social media, but find verses instead.
• Arabic text with Turkish and English translations side by side; all 114 surahs.
• Listen with Mishary Alafasy, Abdul Basit and Mahmoud Al-Husary, all free.
• Set a daily goal, keep your streak and share verses as beautiful cards.

HEART: VERSES FOR HOW YOU FEEL
• Write a few sentences about what is on your mind; Heart brings fitting verses, a short reflection and a prayer.
• Spiritual Journal: your notes, week by week, with a short reflection on your heart, a verse for the week ahead and a prayer.

STILLNESS SESSIONS
• A few minutes of calm with breath, recitation and nature sounds: Tight Chest, Before Sleep, Begin the Day, Gratitude and Trust.
• Mix rain, night, wind, stream and waves, even under a recitation.
• A sleep timer fades the sound out; it keeps playing with the screen locked.

NARRATED STORIES
• Short, simple tellings of the prophets and the stories of the Qur'an, scene by scene with a calm narrator (Turkish).
• Every story comes with the recitation of its verse.

HIFZ AND VOICE CHECKING
• Memorise surahs verse by verse; the verses you stumble on come back for review.
• Recite the rest of a verse aloud; AyetFlow listens and shows any word you skipped or got wrong.

DHIKR AND THE 99 NAMES
• A dhikr counter and the tesbihat after prayer, step by step.
• Asma ul-Husna: the 99 Names of Allah with their meanings.

PRAYER TIMES, QIBLA AND CALENDAR
• Prayer times and reminders for your location or a city you choose.
• Qibla direction with the compass.
• Hijri calendar with holy nights, Eids and blessed days, each with related verses.

WIDGETS
• For the Home and Lock Screen: Verse of the Day, Name of the Day, Streak and Goal, Blessed Days and Prayer Times with a live countdown.

RESPECTS YOUR PRIVACY
• No account, no ads, no tracking. Your history and notes stay on your phone.

AYETFLOW PRO
Pro gives you unlimited Heart, the weekly spiritual reflection, every Stillness session and the ambience mixer, all 100 stories with narration, any surah in Hifz and unlimited voice checking. The Qur'an text, translations and every reciter are free for everyone. Pro is offered as yearly (with a free trial) and monthly auto-renewing subscriptions. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage it in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use: https://onenly.com/ayetflow/terms.html
Privacy Policy: https://onenly.com/ayetflow/privacy.html

name: Baby Sleep Tracker & Nap Timer
description:
Baby Sleep Tracker helps tired parents answer one question: when is the next nap?

TODAY AT A GLANCE
• See how long your baby has been awake and when the next nap window opens
• "Why this time?" explains every suggestion in plain words
• Last feed, next breast side and last diaper, right on the home screen

LOG IN ONE TAP — ALL FREE
• Naps and night sleep with a live timer
• Breastfeeding timer for each side, with pauses; fix any segment later
• Bottle, pump, solids and diapers
• Add or change past entries any time

GENTLE REMINDERS
• A check-in if a nap, night or feed timer is left running, with a one-tap "Woke up" or "Save feed" button, on iPhone and Apple Watch
• A wind-down nudge 30 minutes before bedtime, and an optional feed reminder
• Month-birthday notes and a Sunday recap; tips come in the daytime, at most one a day

MADE FOR 3 AM
• Night mode turns the screen black and red, with big buttons for night wakings and feeds
• It switches on by itself during night sleep

PRO
• A nap window tuned to your baby's last 7 days, plus a reminder 10 minutes before it opens
• Month and 6-month stats for sleep, feeds and diapers
• A one-page weekly summary PDF to keep, print or share
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets, Live Activity and Apple Watch
• 7 days free with the yearly plan

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your logs stay on your iPhone. No ads, no tracking.

Wake windows are general guidance from common parenting resources, not medical advice. Talk to your pediatrician about your baby's sleep.

Subscriptions: Pro Yearly ($29.99/year, 7-day free trial) or Pro Monthly ($4.99/month). Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period; manage them in Settings > Apple Account > Subscriptions.
Terms of Use: https://odyraai.com/apps/baby-sleep-tracker/terms
Privacy Policy: https://odyraai.com/apps/baby-sleep-tracker/privacy

name: BamDico – Bamboutos languages
description:
BamDico is the community dictionary of the languages of the Bamboutos: Ngiemboon, Mungaaka, Ngombale and other varieties spoken in Mbouda, Babadjou, Batcham, Balatchi, Bangang, Bamessingue…

Every word is written with its tones, translated into French and English, and above all pronounced by native speakers. Listen, repeat, remember.

LOOK UP A WORD
• Search in Ngiemboon, Mungaaka, Ngombale, French or English – with or without accents and tones
• Filter by language and by category (family, food, body, greetings…)
• More than 600 words, with example sentences

HEAR THE RIGHT PRONUNCIATION
• Every word and every example sentence has its recording
• Tones are written the way they are spoken

LEARN WHILE PLAYING
• A 10-question quiz per language, new every round
• "How do you say…?" and "What does … mean?"
• Hear the right answer when you get one wrong

ADD YOUR WORDS
• Do you speak a Bamboutos language? Add words and sentences and record your voice
• The team checks every word before it appears in the dictionary
• Contributors who wish to are rewarded for approved words (Mobile Money)

A COMMUNITY
• Comment on words, rate them, suggest corrections
• Write to a word's author; send messages, photos and voice messages
• A question? Write directly to the BamDico team

Our languages live when we speak them and pass them on. With BamDico, keep them alive for our children.

Available in French and English. Light and dark mode.

name: Battery Clock
description:
Pil azaldığında iPhone’unu şarja takmayı Battery Clock hatırlatır. İlk alarm için %20, %15, %10 veya %5’i seç.

Alarmı durdurduğunda, pil bir sonraki 5 puanlık eşiğin altına inerse yeniden çalar. Örneğin %20 uyarısını durdurursan bir sonraki uyarıyı %15’in altında duyarsın. iPhone’u şarja bağladığında alarm susar.

Kilit ekranında da uyarı almak için uygulamadaki kurulum rehberini izle. Alarm iznini verip Kestirmeler’de dört pil düzeyi ve bir şarj bağlantısı otomasyonunu bir kez oluştur. Daha sonra ilk alarm eşiğini ana ekrandan değiştirebilirsin.

Ana ekranda pil seviyeni ve şarj durumunu gör. Pilin azalmasını beklemeden alarm sesini kurulum rehberinden dene.

name: Bead Atelier
description:
PICK. STRING. CREATE.

Step into a quiet jewelry studio and craft bracelets bead by bead. Study each target design, then drag pearls, glass, crystal, wood, and metal beads onto the string in the right order. Tap CONNECT to lock your piece—match perfectly and watch the clasp close; miss the order and try again without the game fixing it for you.

With 120 commissions across six chapters, Bead Atelier turns careful observation and gentle hand-stringing into a calm, elegant puzzle experience.

Short (App Store subtitle style)
A calm jewelry studio puzzle — observe, string, and connect.

One-liner
Drag beads onto the string, match the target design, and create your own little atelier masterpiece.

name: Beak & Bungee
description:
Mabel and Gus have one elastic sling, two very important postal uniforms, and a bowl of soup that absolutely must arrive upright.

Work both ends of the sling as your pigeon couriers cross Brinewick Wharf. Tilt a parcel through an inspection, toss it through a brass hoop, then catch it before the customer notices. A clean delivery earns postage and stamps for your scorecard.

Play 200 routes in ten districts. Lunar Post puts the birds in pressure suits and changes the gravity of every throw. Master Shift demands late catches and ends a clean run on the first mistake. Sunday Assist slows the action and keeps a separate scoreboard.

Add couriers to the on-device Rogues’ Gallery, compare personal bests, and replay a favorite delivery. Routes 1–10 are free. One optional purchase permanently unlocks routes 11–200, including Lunar Post and Master Shift.

name: Beat Alarm: Wake-Up Games
description:
Make getting up your first win. Beat Alarm is a wake-up alarm clock that pairs your morning alarm with a quick game. Set a time, pick a challenge, and open it from the system alarm screen when it rings.

WAKE UP WITH A GAME
Choose from quick puzzles and games using memory, rhythm, touch or movement. Slice fruit, match cards, tap to the beat, or try another challenge in the game library.

SET UP YOUR MORNING ROUTINE
Create one-time and weekly alarms. Choose a sound and an optional snooze interval for each alarm. When it rings, tap Start challenge to play. The system Stop control is also available.

BUILD A STREAK
See completed challenges and achievements. Beat Alarm Pro is a one-time purchase that unlocks all games, more alarms, and a seven-day wake report. Selected games can also be unlocked by choosing to watch a rewarded ad.

No account is required. System alarms use AlarmKit on iOS and iPadOS 26 or later and require the Alarms permission.

name: Beat Em Up: No Backing Down
description:
Four locals. One city. No backing down.

Beat Em Up is a 3D street brawler for one to four players. Fight your way from the docks at night, down into a deep metro station and onto a moving train, through an underpass and up to the roof of a tower high over London.

FIGHT
• Four fighters with their own styles: Kai the boxer, Nadia the kickboxer, Tono the strongman and Isla the taekwondo fighter
• Combos, running and jumping attacks, grabs, throws and a super move for each fighter
• Pick up bats, rods and crates, break the scenery, and knock enemies into the water or onto the live rail
• Six kinds of enemy and four bosses

TOGETHER
• Two to four players on one device, with game controllers or a split touch screen
• Online co-op through Game Center: invite friends, match up automatically, or play with people nearby
• No chat. Players see each other's Game Center nickname, and anyone can hide names in Settings

YOUR WAY
• Choose your route through the city
• Five soundtracks to choose from, or switch the music off
• Touch controls, game controllers and keyboards

GOOD TO KNOW
• Rated 18+ for realistic fighting. There is no blood or gore
• No advertising, no in-app purchases, no accounts, and no personal data collected
• The game asks Apple for your age range, because it is for adults
• Everything in the game is fictional: characters, gangs, companies, stations and signs

Support, privacy policy and terms: https://t-innovations.github.io/beat-em-up-support/

name: Bebe Duo
description:
Bebe Duo is a run-and-jump platformer with the look and sound of a 90s PC game: chunky pixels, bright colours and chiptune music.

It is bedtime, and the baby has other plans. Run through the nursery, the backyard and all the way to dreamland, and reach the crib at the end of each level.

RUN, SKATE, THROW
• Jump on mice, bouncing balls, bees and jack-in-the-boxes, or throw rattles at them.
• Skateboard levels: the board never stops. Brake, speed up and jump at the right time.
• Bottles of milk give a heart back. Teddy bears are checkpoints.
• Springs, toy blocks and shelves to climb.

SUPER POWERS
• D-U-O — collect the three letter coins and your twin appears, and takes one hit for you.
• STAR BIB — nothing can hurt you for a while.
• TRIPLE RATTLE — three rattles at once.
• BALLOON — one more jump in mid-air.

PAY ONCE, PLAY IT ALL
One price gets you the whole game: all 12 levels in three worlds, plus every level added later. No ads, no in-app purchases, no subscription.

THREE WORLDS
• NURSERY — first steps and the first skateboard.
• BACKYARD — green hills, bees and a long ride downhill.
• DREAMLAND — clouds, the moon and the last crib.

MADE FOR FOLDABLES, GOOD EVERYWHERE
On a foldable iPhone, stand the phone half-open like a laptop for console mode: the game on the top half, and on the bottom half the buttons and the baby monitor, a map of the level showing where the letters hide. Fold it just a little for lullaby mode, and everything runs in slow motion. On every other iPhone and on iPad it plays the same, in any orientation.

• Three stars per level: finish it, collect D-U-O, and beat the par time.
• WORLD RANKING — best total time (Game Center).

No ads. No sign-up. We collect no data.

name: Becoming: Goals & Journal
description:
A little more you, every day.

Becoming is a calm, values-led space for personal growth. Notice where your life is today, decide what matters to you, and move toward it through small, meaningful actions. Private by design, with no account and nothing to sign up for.

TODAY
• See today's practices, your active goals and today's reflection on one screen
• Check off a practice with a single tap
• Write a short reflection: what felt meaningful, what was hard, your next small step

LIFE COMPASS
• Rate your satisfaction and how important each area feels, across 12 life areas: partnership, physical and emotional well-being, family and friends, work, finances, learning, purpose, joy and creativity, home, community and balance
• Skip any area that does not fit your life
• A compass chart shows your shape at a glance and how it changes over time
• Suggested focus areas, which you are always free to ignore

GOALS AND MILESTONES
• Turn an intention into a goal with a reason, a value and a target you can track
• Break it into milestones and record your progress
• Start from an editable suggestion for each life area

DAILY PRACTICES
• Small, repeatable actions with a cue: "After dinner, put our phones away and ask about each other's day"
• Link practices to goals, choose how often, and see your last seven days

JOURNAL AND PROGRESS
• Daily and weekly reflections with mood and energy
• Completed goals, practice totals and your assessment history in one place

GENTLE REMINDERS (OPTIONAL)
• An evening nudge to reflect, a morning nudge for your practices and a weekly review, at times you choose
• A note a month after your life compass and when a goal reaches its date
• At most one in the morning and one in the evening, none for what you have already done, and never your own words on the lock screen

YOUR NORTH STAR
• Choose the values you want to live by, or add your own
• Describe the person you want to become, and what you don't want to optimise for

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no email, no sign-up
• No analytics, no ads, no tracking
• Works fully offline; your entries never leave your iPhone
• Export a backup to Files whenever you like, and restore it on a new phone

Try it first: start with sample entries to explore every screen, then remove them in Settings whenever you are ready. Your own entries stay.

GROUNDED IN RESEARCH
The 12 life areas draw on the SAMHSA eight dimensions of wellness and the OECD well-being framework; the focus on chosen goals and small, specific actions draws on self-determination theory and research on implementation intentions. The sources are in the app.

Becoming is a tool for personal reflection and planning. It is not a medical, clinical or therapeutic service.

Made by Godari Labs · godari.org

name: Beezifi MediaPro
description:
MediaPro is a pro camera for iPhone and iPad that keeps your library organized while you shoot.

SHOOT STRAIGHT INTO ALBUMS
• Pick a capture album and every photo and video lands in it automatically
• Create, rename and sort albums without leaving the camera
• Recents and an Unsorted view show what still needs a home

FULL MANUAL CONTROL
• Auto, Manual, Shutter- and ISO-priority exposure
• Manual focus with focus peaking and a magnifying loupe
• White balance in Kelvin with tint, presets and lock
• Histogram, waveform, false color, highlight and shadow zebras
• Split focus and exposure points, AE/AF lock, level and grids

PHOTO
• HEIF, JPEG, Natural (minimal processing), RAW, RAW+HEIF and Apple ProRAW
• Exposure bracketing (3 or 5 shots) for HDR, and hold-to-burst
• Aspect ratios from 1:1 to 65:24, self-timer
• Eleven built-in looks, including Mono, Noir, Sepia and Vintage, plus your own .cube LUTs, previewed live

VIDEO
• ProRes, HEVC 4:2:2, Apple Log and HDR on supported iPhones
• 1 to 240 fps, bitrate control, stabilization
• Record straight to a USB-C SSD, with a clean HDMI feed
• Stereo and external mics, polar patterns, headphone monitoring
• Looks recorded into your clips, or shown as a preview only for Log monitoring

FOR FILMMAKERS
• Shutter angle (180°, 172.8° and more) that stays put when you change frame rate
• Time-of-day or record-run timecode, written as a standard timecode track
• Digital slate: scene, shot, take and camera written into every clip
• Clips on a USB-C drive named by slate, such as A_S12_4B_T03.mov
• Mark good takes, add take notes and export a CSV camera report

CREATIVE
• Slow Shutter: motion blur and light trails, saved as Live Photos
• Time-lapse with interval, auto-stop and playback speed
• Anamorphic de-squeeze for photos and video

FAST
• Profiles: save a complete setup and recall it in one tap
• Home Screen widgets, Control Center, Lock Screen and Action Button
• Volume buttons and Camera Control as shutter

EDIT & SHARE
• Non-destructive light, color and look edits, revert any time
• Automatic perspective correction: straighten horizons, fix converging lines and square up documents
• Share originals straight from the viewer

In English, Spanish, French, German, Japanese and Chinese, with full VoiceOver support.

Private by design: no accounts, no tracking, no data collection. Your photos and videos never leave your device.

One-time purchase. No subscription, no in-app purchases.

name: Bibliagram: Bíblia Sagrada
description:
O Bibliagram é um aplicativo para ler a Bíblia em português, um versículo por tela, do Gênesis ao Apocalipse. A Bíblia inteira vem dentro do app e funciona sem internet. Não tem anúncios, e você não precisa de conta para ler.

LER
Deslize para cima e o próximo versículo aparece. O app guarda onde você parou. Dá para ir direto a um livro e capítulo, ou buscar por uma palavra ("pastor", "esperança") ou por uma referência ("Jo 3:16"). Dois toques curtem o versículo; o marcador salva. Tem tema claro e escuro.

VERSÍCULO DO DIA
No alto do feed, o anel abre o versículo do dia em formato de stories: o texto, o mesmo trecho em palavras mais simples, o contexto e outros versículos para ler depois. Leva menos de um minuto.

ESTUDOS
Muitos versículos têm um estudo curto com quatro partes: explicação, versão em palavras mais simples (uma paráfrase, marcada como tal), contexto (quem escreveu, para quem e quando) e versículos relacionados.

A BÍBLIA INTEIRA EM 2027
Um plano de 1º de janeiro a 31 de dezembro para ler a Bíblia toda, sem pular nada, com cerca de 14 minutos por dia. É grátis.
Há também planos curtos, com leitura, reflexão, uma pergunta e uma oração por dia: 7 dias de paz, 21 dias de oração e 40 dias com Jesus nos Evangelhos. Se quiser, ative um lembrete diário.

MAPAS
Um atlas bíblico com rotas e lugares: as viagens de Paulo, o Êxodo e outros caminhos, com o trecho da Bíblia de cada parada.

COMUNIDADE DE DEVOCIONAIS
Devocionais escritos por outros irmãos, com capa, título, autor e as primeiras linhas abertos a todos. Ler os devocionais inteiros, escrever e publicar fazem parte do Premium; para publicar, entre com a Apple ou com o Google. Antes de sair, cada texto passa por uma checagem automática das diretrizes da comunidade. Você pode denunciar um devocional, bloquear um autor e apagar a sua conta pelo próprio app.

PERFIL E COLEÇÕES
Veja seus dias seguidos de leitura, o calendário do mês e os versículos que curtiu e salvou. Organize os salvos em coleções ("Ansiedade", "Gratidão"). Essas coisas ficam guardadas no seu iPhone.

COMPARTILHAR
O app monta um cartão no tamanho dos stories com o versículo, a referência e o crédito da tradução. Você escolhe o estilo e pode escrever uma reflexão curta.

PREMIUM (OPCIONAL)
A Bíblia, o feed, a busca, o compartilhar e o plano de 2027 são grátis. O Premium libera estudos sem limite diário, todos os planos, o atlas completo, temas extras e a Comunidade. Assinatura mensal ou anual, com teste grátis para quem ainda não usou. O valor é cobrado na sua conta Apple ao confirmar a compra (ou ao fim do teste grátis). A assinatura renova automaticamente pelo mesmo valor e período, a menos que seja cancelada pelo menos 24 horas antes do fim do período atual. Gerencie ou cancele em Ajustes > seu nome > Assinaturas.

SOBRE OS ESTUDOS
Os estudos, as paráfrases, os contextos e as reflexões dos planos foram escritos com auxílio de inteligência artificial e são revisados de tempos em tempos. Podem ter erros e não substituem a leitura da Bíblia; o app avisa isso nas telas. O texto bíblico nunca é gerado por IA. Se encontrar um erro, avise pelos Ajustes.

TEXTO BÍBLICO
Bíblia Livre (BLIVRE), de Diego Santos, Mario Sérgio e Marco Teles, licença Creative Commons Atribuição 4.0 Brasil. É uma atualização da tradução de João Ferreira de Almeida. O crédito aparece no app e nos cartões.

O Bibliagram é um aplicativo independente, sem ligação com redes sociais.

name: Big Tile Mahjong: World Trip
description:
Relax, match tiles and travel the world!

Big Tile Mahjong: World Trip is a calm, classic tile-matching puzzle with extra-large tiles that are easy on the eyes. Every level you complete reveals a stunning photo from a new place on your trip around the world.

TRAVEL TO 8 AMAZING DESTINATIONS
Visit Kyoto, Paris, Cairo, London, Santorini, New York, Rio de Janeiro and the Northern Lights of Norway. Each destination has 6 levels and 6 beautiful photos to discover.

BIG, CLEAR TILES
Large tiles with bold numbers and letters, so you can play comfortably without straining your eyes. Blocked tiles are gently dimmed, so you always know which tiles you can use.

SIMPLE AND RELAXING
Tap a free tile to move it to the tray. When two matching tiles meet in the tray, they disappear. No timers, no pressure. Play at your own pace.

COLLECT POSTCARDS AND PHOTOS
Finish a destination to collect its postcard, and revisit every photo you have unlocked in your personal Photo Album.

CITY SOUVENIRS
Find special souvenir tiles in every city: the Eiffel Tower, a red London bus, a yellow New York taxi and many more.

A NEW PUZZLE EVERY DAY
Come back for the Daily Challenge, mark your calendar and build your streak.

HELPFUL TOOLS
Hint, Undo and Shuffle are always there when you need them, and every puzzle can be solved.

Perfect for mahjong lovers, puzzle fans and anyone who enjoys a peaceful moment and beautiful places. Start your journey today!

name: Bilge Çocuklar - 4. Sınıf
description:
Bilge Çocuklar: 4. Sınıf Tüm Dersler Soru Bankası ve Deneme

İlkokul 4. sınıf öğrencileri için ders çalışmayı sıkıcı bir görev olmaktan çıkarıp heyecan verici bir keşif yolculuğuna dönüştüren Bilge Çocuklar ile tanışın! %100 MEB 4. Sınıf öğretim programı kazanımlarına uyumlu olarak hazırlanan uygulamamızda Türkçe, Matematik, Fen Bilimleri ve Sosyal Bilgiler derslerinin tamamı tek çatı altında buluşuyor.

4 Ana Ders • 31 Fasikül • 465 Seviye • 4.650+ Özgün Soru:
• Türkçe (8 Fasikül): Sözcükte Anlam, Cümlede Anlam, Paragraf, Deyimler ve Atasözleri, Yazım Kuralları, Noktalama İşaretleri, Dil Bilgisi ve Görsel Okuma.
• Matematik (9 Fasikül): Doğal Sayılar, Toplama ve Çıkarma, Çarpma ve Bölme, Kesirler, Zaman Ölçme ve Veri, Geometri, Uzunluk-Sıvı-Tartma ve Çevre-Alan.
• Fen Bilimleri (7 Fasikül): Yer Kabuğu ve Dünya'mızın Hareketleri, Besinlerimiz, Kuvvetin Etkileri, Maddenin Özellikleri, Aydınlatma ve Ses, İnsan ve Çevre, Basit Elektrik Devreleri.
• Sosyal Bilgiler (7 Fasikül): Birey ve Toplum, Kültür ve Miras, İnsanlar Yerler ve Çevreler, Bilim Teknoloji ve Toplum, Üretim Dağıtım ve Tüketim, Etkin Vatandaşlık, Küresel Bağlantılar.
Her seviyede tekrar etmeyen 10'ar özgün soru ile sıkılmadan adım adım ilerle!

Tüm Derslerde Akıllı İşlem ve Not Defteri:
Soruları çözerken kağıt ve kalem aramana gerek yok! Ekranın sağ üstündeki "Defter" butonuna dokunarak gerçek kalem sesi eşliğinde Matematik ve Fen Bilimleri sorularında kareli işlem defterine, Türkçe ve Sosyal Bilgiler sorularında çizgili not defterine işlemlerini yazabilir, silgiyle düzeltebilir, defteri küçültüp soruya tekrar bakabilirsin.

3 Aşamalı Çarpım Tablosu ve Aritmetik Sayma Oyunları:
Ezberlemek yok, eğlenerek öğrenmek var!
• Eğitim Ekranı: Çarpanlara dokunarak sonuçları keşfet.
• 1. Aşama (Eşleştirme): Çarpım işlemleriyle doğru sonuçları eşleştir.
• 2. Aşama (İkiliyi Bul / Boşluğu Tamamla): Hedef sonucu veren çarpanları ve örüntüdeki sayıları yakala.
• 3. Aşama (10 Soruluk Hız Testi): Her seviyede değişen sayı kurgularıyla bilgini pekiştir ve kaç kez tekrar ettiğini takip et!

Beceri Temelli ve Süreç Odaklı Deneme Sınavları:
Gerçek sınav provası! Sütun grafiği ve tablo yorumlama soruları içeren deneme sınavlarında önce tüm soruları çöz, sınav sonunda açılan detaylı karne ekranında hatalı sorularını ve adım adım çözümlerini incele.

Kısa Konu Özetleri, Jokerler ve Haftalık Altın Ligi:
• Kısa Konu Özetleri: Testlere başlamadan önce hap bilgiler ve pratik ipuçlarıyla konuyu tekrar et.
• Akıllı Jokerler: Zorlandığın sorularda topladığın altınlarla her test serisinde "İpucu Gör (-15 Altın)" veya "2 Şıkkı Ele (-30 Altın)" jokerlerini kullan.
• Haftalık Altın Ligi: Doğru cevaplarla altınları topla, 3 yıldızlı karneleri biriktir ve liderlik tablosunda zirveye yerleş!

Çocuklar İçin %100 Güvenli ve Reklamsız Ortam:
Bilge Çocuklar, ilkokul öğrencilerinin güvenliği gözetilerek tasarlanmıştır. Dikkat dağıtıcı üçüncü taraf reklamlar içermez ve kişisel verileri üçüncü taraflarla paylaşmaz.

name: Bilsem Resim Sınavı Soruları
seller_name: KODRIKA YAZILIM ARGE BILISIM REKLAM EGITIM DANISMANLIK HIZMETLERI LIMITED SIRKETI
description:
1, 2 ve 3. sınıf öğrencilerinin BİLSEM resim (görsel sanatlar) yetenek sınavına hazırlığı için çizim görevleri, gerçek sınav gibi deneme oturumu ve ebeveyne gelişim raporu. Her gün yeni bir konu okunur, hayal edilir, kâğıda çizilir; düzenli çalışma sınav gününe alışkanlık kazandırır.

276 ÇİZİM GÖREVİ, ÜÇ KATEGORİ
• Hayal Et – İmgesel Resim: 175 görev (ör. "Boyunuzdan daha uzun dev bir kaleminiz olsa ne yapardınız?")
• Tasarla – Tasarım ve Kompozisyon: 56 görev (1 ve 2. sınıf)
• Gözlemle – Gözleme Dayalı Tasarım: 45 görev (3. sınıf)
Sınıf seçilir; uygulama yalnız o sınıfa uygun görevleri gösterir. Bu görevlerin hepsi ücretsizdir.

SINAVDAKİ GÖREV TÜRLERİYLE ÇALIŞMA
• Üç Kelime: birbiriyle ilgisiz üç kavram tek bir resimde birleştirilir
• Hikâyeyi Tamamla: sonu açık bir hikâye okunur, devamı resimle anlatılır
• Gözle ve Dönüştür: bir nesne gözlemlenir, dönüşmüş hâli bir sahnede çizilir
Görev kartında türü yazar; Görevler listesi sınav türüne göre filtrelenir. Hikâye tamamlama ve üç kelime görevleri ücretsiz görevlerde de var.

GERÇEK SINAV GİBİ DENEME OTURUMU
İki oturum, her biri 40 dakika, aralarında kısa mola. A3 kâğıt ve 2B kalem hazırlanır, süre tutulur. Uygulama arka plana geçse de süre doğru işler. Bitince iki çizimin fotoğrafı tek dokunuşla eklenir.

HER GÜN BİR ÇİZİM
• Ana ekranda günün görevi, tek dokunuşla rastgele görev
• Her hafta yeni bir tema (uzay, deniz, hayvanlar ve daha fazlası)
• 5 dakikalık ısınma çizimleri: el ve göz alışsın
• Dersler sekmesi: kalemle çizmenin püf noktaları kısa adımlarla, ardından 5 dakikalık deneme
• İsteğe bağlı ipuçları, süre tutma, favoriler, görev arama
• Dinle: görev metnini sesli okur, okumayı yeni öğrenenler için

SERGİM VE GELİŞİMİM
• Kâğıda yapılan çizimin fotoğrafı çekilir, Sergim'de çerçeveli bir duvarda durur
• Çizim büyütülerek ayrıntısıyla incelenir
• Her çizimden sonra kısa öz değerlendirme: Kâğıdın tamamını kullandım mı? Çizgilerim net mi?
• Haftalık hedef, çalışma serisi, 24 rozet; çizdikçe yeni çerçeveler ve maskot Piko için aksesuarlar
• Fotoğraflar yalnız cihazda kalır, hiçbir yere yüklenmez

EBEVEYNLER İÇİN
• Basit bir işlem sorusuyla açılan ebeveyn alanı
• Gelişim raporu: tamamlanan görevler, aktif günler, haftalık grafik, türlere göre dağılım, deneme süreleri
• Günlük hatırlatma (isteğe bağlı, saatini ebeveyn seçer)
• Sınav bilgisi: aşamalar, malzemeler, süre, değerlendirme ölçütleri ve hazırlık ipuçları
• Açık, koyu ya da cihaz teması; iPhone ve iPad

BİLSEM RESİM PLUS (isteğe bağlı)
Ebeveynlere yönelik ek içerik ve araçlar. Ücretsiz özellikler ücretsiz kalır.
• Teknik dersler: çizgi, oran, kompozisyon, perspektif, ışık-gölge ve ayrıntı (ilk ders herkese açık)
• 152 ek görev: üç kelime, hikâye tamamlama, gözle ve dönüştür, gözlem ve tasarım
• Değerlendirme rehberi: çizimleri sınav ölçütleriyle değerlendirme
• Sınav tarihine göre haftalık çalışma planı
• PDF gelişim raporu, en fazla 4 kardeş profili, çizim yedeği, reklamsız kullanım
Aylık abonelik (yeni abonelere ilk 3 gün ücretsiz, sonra aylık ücret) ya da tek seferlik ödeme. Abonelik otomatik yenilenir; Apple hesabınızdaki Abonelikler bölümünden istediğiniz zaman iptal edilebilir. Abonelik bitse de çizimler ve ilerleme silinmez. Satın alma ebeveyn onayının arkasındadır.

GÜVENLİ VE SADE
• Hesap ve giriş yok; görevler internetsiz çalışır
• Reklamlar kişiselleştirilmemiş ve yaşa uygundur; görev, deneme ve ders ekranlarında reklam yoktur
• Reklamlar Plus ya da ebeveyn alanındaki tek seferlik "Reklamları kaldır" ile kapanır

name: Bilye Evreni
description:
Bilye Evreni, klasik bilye oyunlarını telefonuna getirir. Üçgen, Tumba ve Çukur oyunlarında atışının yönünü ve gücünü ayarla. Bilgisayar rakiplerine karşı oyna veya aynı telefonu paylaşarak arkadaşlarınla sırayla atış yap.

Bilye keseni büyüt, farklı materyal ve efektlere sahip bilyeleri keşfet. Günlük hediyelerini al ve sonraki maçında kullanacağın bilyeyi seç.

name: Binairo: Takuzu Logic Puzzle
description:
Fill every cell with a black or a white circle, and keep everything in balance.

Binairo (also called Takuzu) is a classic logic puzzle with three simple rules. Each row and each column holds as many black circles as white ones. Never more than two circles of the same colour sit next to each other. And no two rows, no two columns, are ever the same. Some circles are given; the rest is pure deduction. Every level, daily and quick-play puzzle has exactly one solution, reachable by logic alone.

12 STAGES, 360 LEVELS
• From a small 6 × 6 domino to a 14 × 14 binary code
• Earn up to 3 stars on every level; each stage unlocks the next

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Daily puzzle: one 10 × 10 puzzle a day for everyone, with a streak and a month calendar
• Quick play: 6 × 6 to 14 × 14, four levels (Easy, Medium, Hard, Expert), endless new puzzles
• Enter a puzzle code to play a puzzle from a friend or a book, up to 20 × 20

HELPFUL, NOT INTRUSIVE
• Tap a cell for a black circle, tap again for white; drag to fill many cells at once
• Black / White switch for one-tap filling
• Counters at the end of every row and column show how many black and white circles it still needs
• Three in a row, a line with too many of one colour and two identical lines turn red
• Touch a cell to highlight its row and column
• Optional 0 / 1 style for the circles
• 3 hints per game (watch an ad for more when they run out); each hint names the technique and explains why
• "Check" points out wrong circles; stuck? Show the solution (that game gets no stars)
• Solving tips: six techniques with worked examples, plus an interactive tutorial
• Undo and redo without limit; pinch to zoom on big boards

STARS AND PROGRESS
• 3 stars: solved without hints and under the target time
• Statistics for every board size and level, 12 achievements

ON EVERY SCREEN
• Phones and tablets, with layouts made for each: tab bar on phones, sidebar and side panel on tablets and desktop
• Keyboard and right click on Mac
• Dark design, English and Vietnamese

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account needed
• Never an ad while you solve. Remove ads for good with a one-time purchase, no subscription (the Mac version has no ads)
• Works fully offline; your progress stays on your device

name: Bingo Caller & Cards Maker
description:
Host bingo night at home, in class or at the club. No cage, no balls, no printed number sheets: the iPhone does it.

THE CALLER
Tap to draw the next number, or let the app call by itself at the pace you choose. A clear voice says every number, the big ball shows it, and the board lights every number that is out. Repeat a call, take one back, start a new game.

CARDS TO PRINT
Choose how many cards you need and print them, or send the PDF. One, two or four cards to a page. Every card is different, and each carries its own number.

CHECK THE WINNER
Somebody shouts bingo? Enter the number printed on their card. The app shows the card with the called numbers marked and tells you whether the line, the four corners or the full house is complete, and which numbers are still missing.

75-BALL AND 90-BALL
Play 75-ball bingo with B-I-N-G-O cards. With Pro, play 90-ball bingo too, known as Tambola and Housie, with three-row tickets and the old hall calls: "Two little ducks, 22".

ON THE BIG SCREEN (PRO)
Mirror your iPhone to a television, turn it on its side and open the big screen: the ball and the board, nothing else. A tap calls the next number.

FREE
The 75-ball caller with voice and auto-calling, sets of up to four cards, and the winner check.

BINGO CALLER PRO
Sets of up to 300 different cards, 90-ball bingo, the big screen, a choice of voices and colour themes.

FOR FUN
A tool for games among family, friends, classes and clubs. The app takes no stakes and pays no prizes. No account; nothing is sent to us.

Bingo Caller Pro is optional. It is offered as a monthly subscription that renews automatically until cancelled, or as a one-time purchase. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; manage or cancel it in your Apple Account's subscriptions. A free trial is shown in the app only when the App Store offers one to you.
