name: Bird Shop Simulator
description:
Become the neighbourhood's bird keeper! In Bird Shop Simulator you start small: two cages of budgies, a little seed and a till. Look after your birds, bargain with your customers and grow the shop into a two-floor bird house. Play on your own or with up to three friends.

CARE FOR YOUR BIRDS
• Budgies, canaries, zebra finches, cockatiels, lovebirds, Gouldian finches, African greys, sulphur-crested cockatoos and scarlet macaws: 9 species, dozens of colours.
• Every species sings with its own voice, and every bird has a character: curious, shy, chatty or sleepy.
• Watch a cage up close, pet your birds and give them treats. Happy birds sing more and draw more customers.
• Neglected birds fall ill: treat them with vitamins or cuttlebone, or call the vet. Leave a bird neglected too long and animal welfare takes it away.

BARGAIN AND SELL
• Families, students, retired canary lovers, experts after rare colours and collectors…
• Every customer has their own patience and budget: take the offer, ask for more or say no. Push too hard and they walk out!
• Happy customers tip, your rating climbs and more people come in.
• Special requests on the tablet every morning: two budgies for a nursery, a cage of canaries… Get them ready in time for a bonus.

ORDER AND GROW
• Order birds, seed, treats, cuttlebones, toys and cages on the counter's tablet; carry the deliveries in, put the birds in their cages and stock the shelves.
• Thirty levels of new species, cage spots, shelves, a side room, flight cages, an upper floor up the stairs and parrot aviaries.
• Keep up with the rent and bills: if debts pile up the bailiff seals your newest expansion, and the seal comes off when you pay.

BREED AND COLLECT
• Put pairs in the breeding room's nests: eggs, chicks, fledglings.
• Rare colours like violet budgies and red-factor canaries only come from breeding.
• Fill the bird album and collect achievements.

THE MARKET SQUARE
• A lively square outside your door: the simit seller, old men at backgammon by the tea house, a fountain, a plane tree and pigeons.
• Sit on the stool by the door, buy everyone tea, feed the pigeons, wave, high-five a friend.
• Sit there too long and Boncuk the parrot tells on you!

DECORATE YOUR SHOP
• Pick the wall paint, the floor and the cage colour; plants, paintings, a fountain, an aquarium, chandeliers and statues make the shop more appealing.
• See before you buy: try the decor in your own shop first.
• Choose your outfit; your friends see it too.

PLAY WITH FRIENDS (1–4 PLAYERS)
• Share your shop with up to three friends: one at the till, one carrying boxes, one feeding the birds, one on the shelves.
• Play on the same Wi-Fi with no server, or join over the internet with a code.
• Help in a friend's shop and earn a helper's share; fun awards at the end of the day.

Drop by every day for your daily gift. The game is in English and Turkish and plays offline on your own. Contains optional in-app purchases and ads.

name: Bisa Cantonese by Miels
description:
Learn Hong Kong Cantonese the way Indonesian speakers need it — made for people who live and work in Hong Kong.

EVERYDAY SPOKEN CANTONESE
The words Hong Kong people actually say: at home, at work, at the market, on the MTR, at yum cha, shopping or at the doctor. Example sentences are written in spoken Cantonese (佢、喺、咗、唔、嘅), not Mandarin.

DAILY PRACTICE
• Daily quiz: 10 questions from the words you have learned (meaning, listening, hanzi). Missed words come back more often.
• Speaking practice: say the word and the iPhone checks it, on the device only.
• A streak counter keeps you going.

EVERY WORD
• Hong Kong traditional characters, jyutping coloured by the 6 Cantonese tones, an Indonesian-style pronunciation guide, the Indonesian meaning, an example sentence and recorded audio.
• 6000 words in 20 levels plus 1500 sentence cards. Levels 1–5 free; one purchase unlocks 6–20.
• Large, easy-to-read home screen and lock screen widgets.
• No account, no ads, works offline.

Bisa Cantonese is made by Miels, makers of natural handmade soap. Visit miels.id.

name: Bitttrack
description:
Bittrack is a calm, focused habit tracker. Add the habits you care about, check them off each day, and let your activity calendar show how far you've come.

ONE TAP A DAY
Your Today screen shows every habit with a round check button. Tap it and the habit fills with color, your daily progress updates, and you get a little celebration when everything is done.

STREAKS THAT FORGIVE
Streaks count consecutive completed days. An unfinished today never breaks your streak before the day is over, and you can suspend a day — sick, travelling, rest day — without losing your progress.

SEE YOUR WHOLE YEAR
The activity calendar shows six months and more at a glance: the darker the blue, the more of your habits you completed that day. Tap any day for a breakdown, or open a habit to see its own calendar and fix past days.

TAP AN NFC TAG TO LOG
Stick a cheap NFC tag where the habit happens — by your yoga mat, on your water bottle, next to your bed. Bittrack walks you through a Shortcuts automation so a single tap of your iPhone marks the habit done. Tapping again the same day never undoes it.

SIRI AND SHORTCUTS
Say "Log Reading in Bittrack" or use the Log Habit action in your own shortcuts and automations.

GENTLE REMINDERS
Set a daily reminder time for each habit. Habits that share a time share one notification, so your lock screen stays tidy.

MAKE IT YOURS
Pick from 24 symbols and 8 colors, or start from a suggestion like "Drink water", "Read 10 pages" or "Meditate".

YOUR DATA STAYS YOURS
No account, no ads, no tracking. Everything is stored on your iPhone, and you can export your full history as a CSV file for any spreadsheet app at any time.

BUILT FOR EVERYONE
Full VoiceOver support, Dynamic Type up to the largest accessibility sizes, Dark Mode, Reduce Motion, in English, French and Spanish.

name: Blackbox Lab: Drone Logs
description:
Understand your drone's flight logs on iPhone or iPad, with Arabic explanations and familiar engineering labels.

Choose Betaflight, INAV or ArduPilot, then import a recorded flight from Files. Blackbox Lab reads supported raw Blackbox recordings, ArduPilot DataFlash BIN/LOG files and CSV exports. Content-based import also recognizes supported logs without a filename extension.

Explore gyro motion, requested versus measured rates, motor commands, voltage and current when those channels are available. View Welch frequency spectra and a time-frequency map. When a recording includes both filtered and unfiltered gyro channels, compare their spectra separately. Select a time window to recalculate the readings from its original samples.

Evidence-based screening highlights patterns such as narrow vibration peaks, broadband noise, rate-tracking error, high motor output, voltage changes and recording gaps. Each finding explains the measured evidence and suggests what to inspect or review. Available ArduPilot VIBE and clipping channels receive their own interpretation.

Learn with synthetic examples and a beginner glossary, explore an illustrative low-pass filter response, and export HTML or JSON reports through the system share sheet.

Analysis runs on your device. There is no account, advertising, tracking or cloud-analysis service. The app does not connect to or change your flight controller. Reference, support and privacy links open in your system browser. You choose whether and where to share a report.

The interface and explanations are currently in Arabic. Logging formats, firmware versions and available channels vary. Imports are limited to 100 MB, with additional sample and memory limits; longer recordings may require a shorter log. Control interpretation is primarily intended for multirotors. Findings are explainable screening rules, not a model trained on real-flight data, guaranteed tuning values or certification that an aircraft is safe to fly.

The iOS application is open source under GNU GPLv3. Corresponding source: https://blackbox-lab-support.honedhumor2.chatgpt.site/source/

name: Bloomwake Rush
description:
A little gardener. A big adventure.

Meet Pip, a moon gardener with a growing crescent and a garden full of trouble. Stretch your reach, recall your crescent through the crowd, and ride its glowing wake into open space. Charge a wake with a hit and watch a trail of flowers bloom behind you.

ONE LOVELY COMBAT RHYTHM
Move freely with the joystick. Hold Orbit to extend your crescent, release to recall, then line up a Wake Ride. Mix quick dodges, sweeping attacks, and flowering escapes to find your own flow.

100 TRAILS TO EXPLORE
Travel through ten colorful chapters, from winding orchard paths and bubbling riverbanks to snowy passes and the Moonseed Citadel. Clear enemy groups, rescue Sproutlings, carry glowing lanterns, protect the Bloomcart, and face chapter guardians.

MAKE EACH RUN YOUR OWN
Collect three route badges on every trail. Complete optional mastery goals, earn stars, and return to improve your personal best. Your local leaderboard keeps real records from this device.

A LITTLE GIFT FOR COMING BACK
Claim daily cosmetic rewards and choose fresh leaf colors or a Petal Crest for Pip. Miss a day? Your next reward will wait. Every style plays the same.

PLAY AT YOUR PACE
Enjoy an invulnerable practice area, unlimited retries, separate music and sound controls, reduced motion, and mirrored controls for left-handed play.

An offline single-player adventure. No account, ads, in-app purchases, or subscriptions. Your progress and scores stay in local app storage, subject to your device backup settings.

Bring a little light back to the garden.

name: Bluebird Weddings
description:
Bluebird Weddings is the companion app for guests and organisers of weddings planned by Bluebird Events.

FOR GUESTS
• Join with your personal invite code, and see the wedding before you confirm.
• Check in one friendly step at a time: arrival, travel, who is coming, extra beds and ID for everyone in your group.
• Share your family's details once. Other adults join with their own code, without filling it all in again.
• See every function with its mood board, dress code, programme, venue and menu.
• A day-by-day schedule that always shows what is on now.
• Play the Jodi Cup, bride's side against groom's side, with Tap-of-War, quizzes and predictions.
• Get announcements, chat with the Bluebird help desk, find nearby places, and send blessings to the couple.

FOR ORGANISERS
• See who is arriving today, what rooms are needed and which IDs to check.
• Guests, arrivals and departures, help desk and announcements in one place.
• Make single-use invite codes for guests, families and helpers.
• Edit functions, mood boards and check-in questions without any technical knowledge.

Every invite code works once, for one person, so a forwarded code cannot be used by anyone else. ID photos are visible only to the wedding's organisers.

name: Body of Work: Muscle Tracker
description:
Turn your workout into a work of art. Log an exercise and watch the muscles it works light up on a classical sculpture.

TAP A MUSCLE, FIND A MOVEMENT
Explore exercises for the muscle you want to work. Choose your available equipment to narrow the results, from bodyweight movements to dumbbells and gym equipment.

SEARCH THE WAY YOU SPEAK
Search more than 900 exercises, with common alternate names, abbreviations, and typo matching. Tap + to type, or hold it to say an exercise using on-device English transcription when available.

SEE THE MOVEMENT
Swipe through exercise cards before logging. The first illustrated collection shows 14 dumbbell movements involving the quadriceps, with two poses for each movement. Other exercises show their muscle targets.

SAVE YOUR WEEK
Take a screenshot of the workout canvas when you finish. Your exercises and muscle coverage are saved together in a weekly calendar. Revisit a completed workout or share its artwork.

MAKE IT YOURS
Choose light or dark appearance, change paint colors, turn the sculpture to see its back, and pinch to explore.

No account, ads, subscriptions, or tracking. Your workout history stays on your device. Muscle colors summarize logged exercises; they do not measure muscle activation, fitness, or recovery.

name: Bodyday: Calorie Counter
description:
Bodyday is a food and weight log that shows the calories and protein you have left today, sized to your goal.

LOG A MEAL WITH A PHOTO OR A LINE OF TEXT
Snap your plate or type something like "half a bowl of rice and grilled salmon". AI estimates the foods, portions, calories, carbs, protein and fat. Add the oil or sauce a photo can't show in one line. Fix portions or grams before saving, and pick foods you fixed from Recent foods next time. You can also log by hand, without AI.

DAILY CALORIES AND PROTEIN FOR YOUR GOAL
Your height, weight, age, activity and goal weight and date set a daily calorie and protein target, with the formulas shown. See what you ate, what's left and your macro split on one screen.

AI MEAL COACH
Ask "What should I have for dinner?" The coach knows today's log, recent meals and your weight trend, and suggests meals that fit your remaining calories and protein, with estimates.

WEIGHT, BODY COMPOSITION AND PROGRESS PHOTOS
Follow your weight on a chart with a 7-day average. Snap a body composition printout and Bodyday reads the numbers into a table (the photo isn't kept). Progress photos stay on your phone and can be locked with Face ID.

AI WORKOUT PLAN AND WEEKLY REVIEW
Get a week of workouts that fits your experience, place and equipment, and check them off. The weekly review points out food groups you've been missing.

FREE AND PREMIUM
Manual logs, weight and progress photos are always free. Try 5 meal analyses, 3 AI coach replies, 1 body composition printout and 1 workout plan for free. Bodyday Premium (weekly, monthly or yearly) gives you more AI use within daily and monthly limits. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; manage or cancel them in your App Store account settings.

YOUR LOGS STAY ON YOUR PHONE
No sign-up needed. Your logs and photos are stored on your phone; photos, text and log summaries are sent for analysis only when you ask for AI analysis, and are not kept on our servers. Delete everything at any time in Settings.

Terms of Use: https://bodyday.web.app/en/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://bodyday.web.app/en/privacy/

Bodyday is not a medical device and does not diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any medical condition. Calories and nutrients are estimates. If you have a health condition or take medication, talk with your doctor.

name: Boo: Books, Briefly
description:
Someone recommended a book? Boo turns it into five minutes of illustrated cards and answers the real question: is it worth reading in full?

How it works
Type a title or an author, paste the message where a friend recommended it, or snap the cover in a shop. Boo finds the book and opens a short story in cards.

In every book
• The book in one line
• Five key ideas, each with its own drawing
• How the author thinks, and their style
• One line to take home
• The verdict: worth reading in full? Who should, when the summary is enough, and which chapter to taste

Honest by design
Each book is written once with AI, in our own words, and checked automatically. These are not quotes from the book and not a substitute for it. When the system doesn’t know a book well enough, it says so instead of making things up. You can request it, and we count the requests.

Hebrew and English
Every book comes in both languages. Switch with one tap.

Offline too
Books you’ve opened stay on your phone and open on a plane.

Share
Send a friend the key ideas and the verdict, straight from the share sheet.

No account, no ads, no tracking.

name: Book Builder Studio
description:
Turn your ideas into beautiful, professional e-books and PDFs, right on your iPhone or iPad.

Book Builder Studio is the all-in-one book maker for students, professionals and creators. Pick a template, write your chapters, design a stunning cover and export a polished PDF with a contents page, page numbers and bookmarks. No computer needed.

START FAST WITH TEMPLATES

Student notes, assignments and study guides
Employee portfolios, handbooks and resume books
Business and project reports
Lab reports with aim, procedure, observations and results
Data books full of charts
Or start from a blank book

WRITE WITHOUT DISTRACTIONS

Full-screen chapter editor with live word count and reading time
Add a photo and a chart to any chapter
Reorder chapters by dragging, and duplicate chapters or whole books
Everything saves automatically on your device

8 CHART TYPES Column, bar, line, area, step, scatter, pie and donut charts. Add a title, show values on the chart and choose from colour sets. Charts in your PDF look exactly like the preview.

DESIGN A COVER THAT STANDS OUT

Cover designer with your own image, colours, fonts and layout
14 ready-made cover designs and 7 designer layouts: Geometric, Stripes, Diagonal, Wave, Badge, Editorial and Spotlight
Themes, page colours, serif or sans typography
Page numbers in five styles, watermarks, page frames and your signature

ADD PAGES FROM ANYWHERE

Photos and image files (JPG, PNG, HEIC)
Free stock photos from Pixabay
PDF files, web pages, and Word or PowerPoint documents (Pro) Imported pages get your book's page numbers, watermark and signature.

EXPORT AND SHARE

Polished PDF with a contents page and chapter bookmarks
Protect PDFs with a password, or block editing and copying
NEW: Turn pages into a video. Choose page, story, square or widescreen format, HD or Full HD, timing and transitions. Save to Photos or Files, or share anywhere.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN

Books are stored on your device
Private Vault hides books behind Face ID, Touch ID or your passcode
Lock a book's editing so it stays read-only
Word, PowerPoint and web pages are converted on your device

BOOK BUILDER STUDIO PRO Upgrade for the full studio:

Unlimited books every day
All built-in cover designs and designer layouts
Import PDFs, web pages and Office documents
Unlimited stock images at a time
No ads, and instant PDF and video export

Pro is available as a weekly, monthly or yearly subscription, or a one-time lifetime purchase. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage and cancel subscriptions in your App Store account settings after purchase.

name: Bragsy: Score Keeper
description:
Bragsy keeps score for card games and board games, so the table can just play.

Pick a game, add your players, and start. Type each round's points on a big number pad, or use Quick Tally for games where you add points as they happen. Fix any cell later if someone counted wrong.

SET UP YOUR OWN RULES
Highest score wins or lowest score wins. Play to a target score, play a set number of rounds, or end whenever you like. Allow negative points, set your own quick-add buttons, and play in teams. Built-in starting points for Hearts, Spades, Rummy, Cribbage and dice games; every rule can be changed.

EVERYONE IN ONE PLACE
Players keep their color and avatar across every game. Save a crew, like Family or Friday Group, and start a new game with them in two taps. Spin to pick who goes first.

BRAGGING RIGHTS
When the game ends, Bragsy ranks everyone, shows the gap, and crowns the winner. History keeps every game: search it, filter by game or crew, resume a game you stopped, or play a rematch. Stats show wins, win rate, streaks, best games and who leads whom.

SHARE THE RESULT
Send a clean result card to the group chat.

PRIVATE AND SIMPLE
No account, no ads. Everything stays on your iPhone and in its iCloud backup. Export a backup file to move to a new phone.

FREE, WITH ONE OPTIONAL UPGRADE
Unlimited games, players, rules, history, leaderboard and backups are free. Bragsy Pro is a single purchase, no subscription, and adds full rivalries, charts of past games, top-5 scores per game, crew and date filters, a second share card style, CSV export and three more app themes. Family Sharing included.

Bragsy is not affiliated with any game publisher. Game names mentioned are common public-domain games.

name: Brainbreak: Calm Puzzle Games
description:
Brainbreak is a quiet place for a quick puzzle. Eleven games, 550 levels and no account. Play for three minutes or thirty.

ELEVEN GAMES, ONE APP

Logic
• Color Sort: pour until every tube is one colour
• Traffic Escape: clear the jam, one car at a time
• Crown Grid: one crown in every row, column and colour
• Rope Rescue: snip the bunnies free and keep the foxes tied

Numbers
• Number Path: draw one line through every tile
• Make 10: pair numbers that add up to ten
• Chain Merge: link matching tiles to build bigger ones

Words
• Word Wheel: swipe letters to fill the grid
• Word Groups: find the four words that belong together
• Top Answers: guess the most popular answers

Lateral
• Tricky Tap: riddles where the obvious answer is wrong

50 LEVELS IN EVERY GAME
Each game starts gentle and builds steadily. Earn up to three stars on every level, and use a hint when you're stuck.

MEET PIP
Pip is your small companion. Every star earns Sparks, and Sparks help Pip grow through twelve forms, from a seed to something much stranger.

A HABIT THAT STAYS SMALL
Hit a small daily goal, keep your streak going, and get one gentle reminder a day if you want it. Stats show your solve times and progress in every game.

CALM BY DESIGN
No account. No timers pushing you to pay. Light and dark mode, soft sounds and haptics you can switch off.

BRAINBREAK PLUS
Brainbreak is free with five new levels every day and occasional ads. Plus is optional and adds:
• Unlimited levels
• No ads
• Three free hints every day
• A streak freeze: one missed day forgiven each week

Plus is available as a monthly or yearly subscription, or as a one-time lifetime purchase. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel in your Apple Account settings.

Terms of Use: https://getbrainbreak.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://getbrainbreak.app/privacy

name: Breakaway Back
description:
Your running back takes off on his own. All you do is steer. Drag left and right to juke past linemen, linebackers and safeties, reach the end zone, then line up again against a faster, bigger defense.

One tackle ends the run. One more run is always a tap away.

QUICK TO PLAY
Runs last a minute or two, so Breakaway Back fits a coffee break, a bus ride or a few minutes before bed. Play with one thumb, and drag anywhere on the screen to steer. If you get interrupted, the game pauses itself and waits for your next touch.

JUKES AND COMBOS
Slip past a defender by a step and you score a juke bonus. Chain jukes close together for a combo worth up to five times the points.

COINS ON THE FIELD
Coins sit up the field, often right next to a defender. Grab them for points and coins, and watch for the rare golden helmet.

MISSIONS
Three goals at a time, like scoring a touchdown or juking five defenders in one run. Finish one to earn coins, and a slightly tougher one takes its place.

DAILY DRIVE
Everyone gets the same defense each day. Beat your own best for the day, and your first try pays a coin bonus.

DAILY STREAK
Your first run each day pays a bonus that grows for seven days. Miss a day and it simply starts over.

JERSEY LOCKER
Spend the coins you earn on seven jerseys, from Midnight to Gold Rush. Jerseys only change how you look. Coins are earned by playing and are never sold.

LEADERBOARD
Post your best score to the Game Center leaderboard and chase your friends.

ORIGINAL PIXEL ART AND CHIPTUNE SOUND
Every sprite, the field and the music are drawn and synthesized in the game itself.

FREE TO PLAY WITH ADS
Breakaway Back is free and shows ads. After a tackle you can choose to watch a reward video to keep running once per run, and short ads play between some runs. An optional one-time purchase, Remove Forced Ads, turns off the ads between runs. The optional reward video is still offered.

For players 13 and older.

Breakaway Back is made by Pudgefinds LLC.
Terms of Use: https://pudgefinds.com/breakaway-back/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://pudgefinds.com/breakaway-back/privacy/

name: Brickly: Color Puzzle
description:
Welcome to Brickly, a cozy color brick puzzle where every level is a cute pixel picture waiting to be restored!

Some parts of each picture are the wrong color, and others are empty. Tap a wrong-colored area to lift its bricks into your tray, then tap an empty area to fill it with the right color. Simple to learn, surprisingly clever to master!

HOW TO PLAY
• Tap a wrong-colored area: its bricks hop into the tray
• Tap an empty area: if your tray has enough of that color, it fills all at once
• Watch your tray! Its space is limited, so plan your moves before it gets full
• Finish in the fewest moves to earn 3 stars

150 PICTURES, 10 DREAMY WORLDS
Travel along a magical map through Cozy Village, Fruit Garden, Ocean Bay, Snowy Peak, Starlight City, Autumn Woods, Candy Castle, Jungle Safari, Toy Town and Cloud Kingdom. Each world is full of adorable pictures: hearts, mushrooms, kittens, fruit, frogs, cupcakes and more.

UNLOCK HIDDEN PICTURES
Every world hides a big secret picture. Restore all 15 pictures in a world to reveal it!

COLLECT EVERY STICKER
Each picture you restore becomes a sticker in your album. Fill every page and collect all the stars!

HELPFUL BOOSTERS
Stuck? Use Undo to take back a move, Hint to see a good next move, or Extra Row for more tray space.

WHY YOU'LL LOVE BRICKLY
• Calm, relaxing gameplay with no time pressure
• Bright, cheerful pixel art with chunky, easy-to-tap bricks
• Short levels, perfect for a quick break
• Satisfying sounds and gentle vibrations as pictures come to life
• A sweet story to follow along the way

Small puzzles, brighter days. Download Brickly and start restoring!

name: BrixBalls
description:
BrixBalls is a modern brick breaker you can play with one hand.

Drag anywhere to move the paddle, break the wall and catch the capsules that fall: extra balls, a bigger paddle, lasers, bombs, a sticky catch and the giant wrecking ball that clears the whole level.

EVERY LEVEL HAS ITS OWN MUSIC
Mozart, Beethoven, Bach, Grieg, Chopin, Debussy, Schubert, Joplin and more. Each level plays one complete piece, arranged for strings, harp and bass.

BUILD YOUR RUN
Spend the coins you earn on boosts that last one level: calmer ball, multiball, exploding bricks and more. You always earn coins by playing.

WRECK IT
Finish a level and watch the wrecking ball knock down houses, towers and whole planets, then follow your progress on the map.

WORLD RECORDS
Compete on Game Center: total score, a daily level that is the same wall for everyone, and the fastest time on each of the first ten levels.

MAKE IT YOURS
Unlock paddles shaped like spaceships, rockets, cars, instruments, animals and more, each with its own laser.

FOUR LANGUAGES
English, Spanish, Portuguese and French. The game picks your language and you can change it any time.

No ads. No account needed. Coin packs are available as optional in-app purchases.

name: Bullseye: Darts Scoreboard
description:
Keep score at the board without doing the maths. Enter each dart on a quick keypad or a tap-the-board pad, and Darts Scorekeeper handles the rest.

GAMES
• 301, 501 and 701, with Straight or Double In and Straight or Double Out
• Cricket: 15 to 20 and the bull, with marks and points
• Around the Clock practice: 1 to 20, then the bull
• Single games or matches, best of 3, 5 or 7 legs
• Up to 6 players, with handicap starting scores

FAST SCORING
• Type darts like T20, D16 or Bull, or just the number: 60 reads as treble 20
• Or tap the colour-coded dartboard pad
• Busts are caught for you, including leaving 1 on Double Out
• Checkout hints whenever you're on a finish, like "T20 + T20 + Bull"
• Undo any turn

THE FULL EXPERIENCE
• A caller reads out each score: "One hundred and eighty!"
• Celebrations for 180s, tons, checkouts and wins
• Show a big scoreboard on your TV with AirPlay screen mirroring
• Built for iPhone and iPad

STATS
• Every finished game is saved
• 3-dart average with a chart, 180s, tons and best checkout for each player
• Saved players, so stats build up over time

NO FUSS
• No account, no ads and no tracking
• Your game is saved after every turn, even if the app closes

name: Bulq! Water Color Sort
description:
Pour colored water until every full flask holds just one color. Tap a flask, then tap an empty flask or one with the same color on top and enough room. Start with simple layouts and work your way up to puzzles where each move matters.

• Play 180 levels in six worlds, with more colors and more intricate combinations as you go.
• Earn coins the first time you clear a level. Spend them on backgrounds and flask shapes.
• Undo a move or use a hint when you get stuck.
• Turn on patterns to help tell colors apart. Adjust sound and vibration in settings.
• Play offline at your own pace, with no timer or account. Your progress is saved on your device.

name: Buoywake: Stone Skip Puzzle
description:
Flick a skipping stone across a pocket harbor. The pebble keeps going until it reaches a breakwater or the shore. Bring it to rest on every numbered buoy, in order, with as few throws as possible.

Read 120 solvable harbor layouts, compare your route with the shortest possible passage, and try a daily chart. Use swipes or compass buttons. Undo and restart are always free. Your best routes stay on your iPhone.

In adult sessions, optional rewarded ads can reveal one bearing. The one-time Harbor Pass removes home-screen ads and includes one hint per passage. No subscription.

name: Buried Wonders: Fossil Dig
description:
Uncover fossils, piece together prehistoric skeletons and build a museum of your discoveries. Buried Wonders: Fossil Dig is a relaxing 3D excavation game where every careful dig brings you closer to your next exhibit.

DIG WITH CARE
Scan the ground with your detector, choose the right tool and reveal what lies beneath. Use a shovel to move soil, a pickaxe to break rock and a brush for delicate finds. A fossil's condition affects its reward, so a careful touch pays off.

BUILD YOUR COLLECTION
Collect bones and assemble skeletons from the dinosaur and Ice Age collections. Discover 20 prehistoric creatures, from T-Rex and Diplodocus to the mammoth, and watch your museum grow piece by piece.

EXPLORE FIVE DIG SITES
Excavate steppe, dunes, clay, rocky slopes and a dry riverbed. Different ground conditions give each expedition its own character, with bones, coins, pottery and gems waiting to be found.

UPGRADE YOUR TOOLS
Earn gold through discoveries and spend it in the workshop. Unlock tools and improve digging power, precision, energy and more. Your tools and upgrades carry over as you move between collections.

TAKE ON DIG CONTRACTS
Complete ongoing objectives for extra gold. Each claimed contract is replaced with a new one. Claim three contract rewards in a day to unlock an optional daily bonus.

PLAY OFFLINE
No internet connection or account is required. There are no ads or in-app purchases. Progress is saved on your device.

Play in English, Turkish, German or Spanish. A guided introduction helps you make your first discovery.

Pick up your brush. Your next discovery is just beneath the surface.

name: Burrow: Kids Music & Video
description:
Burrow is a small, quiet place for a young child. You choose what goes in; there is no way for anything else to get out of it.

Most apps for children are built to keep them watching. This one is built to stop. No recommendations, no infinite feed, no autoplay into something you have never seen.

HOW IT WORKS
- You make tiles: one tile is one playlist, music or video
- Fill them with audio and video files from your device, Apple Music songs, or YouTube links
- Your child sees big, calm tiles and nothing else — no search, no browsing, no way out
- A year-of-birth question guards everything on the parent's side

CALM BY DESIGN
- No scores, no timers, no streaks, nothing that ends play for good
- A YouTube link plays without recommendations or comments around it
- In a music tile, a YouTube item plays sound only and keeps its picture hidden

GAMES
Six games, all quiet: Matching Pairs, Odd One Out, Copy the Pattern, Tic Tac Toe, Four in a Row, and Hangman without the gallows. The opponent in Tic Tac Toe and Four in a Row blocks only some of the time, because a perfect opponent is one a four-year-old can never beat.

SCREEN TIME
Set a daily limit per child. When the time is up, playback stops and Burrow returns to the profile picker.

YOUR DATA STAYS YOURS
- No accounts, no analytics, no advertising, no tracking
- Profiles, tiles and playlists sync through your own private iCloud
- Nothing is ever sent to us — there is no server of ours to send it to
- Export a full backup whenever you like

BURROW FULL
One purchase, forever. No subscription:
- Unlimited child profiles (free: one)
- Unlimited tiles per profile (free: five)
- Up to 50 items per playlist (free: three)
- Every game (free: two)

Try everything free for 14 days. It costs nothing and there is nothing to cancel.

name: Buvell
description:
Buvell helps DIY flower lovers design bouquets with the stems they already have. Whether you’re arranging a market bunch or making a gift, you can decide where each flower belongs and check that you have enough stems before you start.
Add each flower’s name, color, and stem count, then choose a bouquet shape and palette. Drag, resize, and rotate flowers on the canvas to see how focal blooms, fillers, and greenery fit together. Buvell flags any shortage while there’s still time to adjust.
When you’re ready to arrange, follow your own stages. Each one highlights the stems you need and where to place them. If a bloom opens wider than expected, adjust its position or compare a replacement. Save a photo, notes, and the quantities you actually used. Next time, copy the design and try it with a different mix of flowers.

name: Byrr
description:
Byrr viser været time for time i én graf: temperatur, nedbør og vind, med symbolene over. Dra fingeren over grafen for å lese av hver time.

ET VARSEL SOM LÆRER AV MÅLINGENE
I Norge lager Byrr varselet selv. Vi tar værmodellene fra Meteorologisk institutt, ECMWF og NOAA, og retter dem mot det norske målestasjoner faktisk har målt, for stedets egen høyde. Hver gang lagrer vi også Meteorologisk institutts varsel for de samme stedene, og når været er målt, ser vi hvem som kom nærmest. Resultatet ser du i appen under «Hvor godt treffer varselet?».

NEDBØR SOM ET SPENN
Nedbøren vises som det mest sannsynlige, og som spennet den havner innenfor fire av fem ganger. Du ser også sjansen for nedbør hver sjette time, så du vet om regnet er sikkert eller bare mulig.

ALT DU TRENGER, PÅ ETT STED
• Neste 24 timer: temperatur, nedbør, vind og vindkast
• Ti dager fram, hver dag med sine timer og egen graf
• Lenger fram: temperatur og nedbørsjanse noen uker framover
• Farevarsler fra Meteorologisk institutt
• Sol opp og ned, solskinn, tåke og hvor kaldt det føles
• Kart med nedbør, temperatur, vind og skyer for hele Norge, time for time
• Varsel for hele verden, fra Meteorologisk institutts globale varsel

WIDGETS
Små, mellomstore og store widgets for hjemskjermen, og for låseskjermen på iPhone.

Lagre stedene du bryr deg om: hytta, fjellet og byen. Appen har lys og mørk visning, norsk og engelsk.

Ingen konto, ingen reklame og ingen sporing.

Data: Meteorologisk institutt, ECMWF, NOAA og Copernicus. Stedsnavn: Kartverket og OpenStreetMap.

name: ByteDrop: Video Compressor
description:
Many apps reject video attachments over 10 MB for chat, 25 MB for email, or 50 MB for messaging. Pick your target size and ByteDrop re-encodes your MP4 or MOV clip on your iPhone to fit, with no uploads.

HIT YOUR TARGET SIZE
• Pick Under 10 MB, Under 25 MB, Under 50 MB, or set a Custom Size from 0.5 MB to 100 MB in 0.5 MB steps.
• Checks file size and duration before encoding: clips that already fit share as-is without re-encoding, and clips too long for the 120 kbps minimum video bitrate floor show the smallest target they can reach upfront.
• Checks the finished file size and retries tighter up to three times if needed.
• Switch between Shrunk and Original in the player before sharing or saving to Photos.

H.264, HEVC, AND HDR TO SDR
• Uses Apple's hardware AVFoundation encoder with AAC audio: choose H.264 for wide playback or HEVC for sharper detail at the same file size (output caps at 1080p and steps resolution down for tight targets).
• Automatically tone-maps iPhone HLG and PQ HDR clips to standard Rec. 709 SDR so uploads do not look washed out in chat and web players.
• Preserves portrait, landscape, and rotated camera orientations without black bars.

PHOTOS, FILES, AND SHARE SHEET
• Open MP4 or MOV clips from Photos or Files.
• From another app, tap Shrink With ByteDrop in the Share Sheet, choose 10 MB or 25 MB, then open ByteDrop to shrink the clip.
• Open ByteDrop straight to a 10, 25, or 50 MB preset from Apple Shortcuts.

NO SUBSCRIPTIONS, NO SERVERS
• Includes 3 free video shrinks under target size, plus unlimited runs on the built-in sample clip.
• Unlock unlimited shrinking with one optional in-app purchase. No account, no ads, and no analytics.

name: Cali Tides
description:
Every other tide app has ads or costs money. Cali Tides doesn't. It's free, local to California, and beautiful.

WHY CALIFORNIA NEEDS ITS OWN TIDE APP
California's tides don't keep a steady beat. NOAA calls them "mixed semidiurnal": two highs and two lows a day, but of very different sizes, so one low tide can be 4 feet lower than the other and the timing keeps shifting. A store-bought tide clock assumes the steady 12-hour-25-minute rhythm of the Atlantic, and the makers themselves say Pacific tide clocks must be reset as often as every week.

We checked two years of NOAA forecasts at Mesa Lane in Santa Barbara. On more than half of all days, the two low tides differ by over 2 feet. Almost two times out of three, the gap between high tides falls outside the 12-to-13-hour window a tide clock counts on. So Cali Tides shows the actual forecast for your beach, every minute of every day.

Each beach is an oil painting that follows the real tide and the real sun. At low tide the reef and tide pools show. At high tide the waves reach the stairs. At sunset the sky turns gold, and at night the moon comes out.

TIDES YOU CAN TRUST
• Forecasts for every NOAA tide station in California, built in so they work offline
• Live water level from NOAA, so you can see a storm push the tide higher
• Highs, lows, sunrise and sunset for every day

SEE IT, DON'T READ IT
• Slide your finger along the tide line to move through the day
• Swipe for tomorrow, or see the whole week on one chart
• The week's lowest low and highest high, called out

LOW TIDE CROSSINGS
• Ocean Beach to Fort Funston, Baker Beach to China Beach
• See when each walk is open in daylight, all week

ALERTS FOR YOUR PLANS
• "Under 2 ft on weekends between 7 AM and 4 PM" — or sunrise to sunset
• A heads-up the night before and an hour before

INVITE YOUR PEOPLE
• Dog walk, surf, sunset walk, tide pools, bonfire and more
• Send a painted invite card in Messages with the best tide window
• Pick friends from your contacts once; alerts open a ready invite

WIDGETS FOR YOUR HOME SCREEN
• Add a Cali Tides widget to your home screen: your beach's painting, changing with the tide and sun all day
• Lock screen widgets too: small tide gauges that sit under the clock: the tide now, the day's tide curve, or the next high or low
• To add one: touch and hold your home screen, tap Edit, then Add Widget, and pick Cali Tides

No ads. No accounts. No subscriptions. Nothing you do leaves your phone.

Beaches today: all 193 NOAA tide stations in California, from Crescent City to San Diego. Mesa Lane, Ocean Beach and Baker Beach have their own paintings; every other station shows a painting of its region. Don't see your beach? Tap "Request a beach."

name: Candy Nuts: Sort Puzzle
description:
Unwind with Candy Nuts: Sort Puzzle — a sweet, tactile 3D color-sorting brain teaser designed for relaxing focus.

Tap to lift translucent jelly candy nuts and stack matching colors cleanly onto wooden bolts. Easy to pick up in seconds, deeply satisfying as every bolt clicks into place.

KEY FEATURES
• 500+ Handcrafted Levels: Progress from gentle warm-ups to clever multi-color challenges across 10 cozy candy worlds.
• Glossy 3D Jelly Aesthetics: Crisp translucent candy nuts, warm sunlit visuals, and gentle haptics tuned for pure satisfaction.
• Unlockable Cozy Themes: Earn stars as you clear stages to collect new candy boards and visual styles.
• Smart Puzzle Helpers: Stuck on a tricky board? Use Undo, +Bolt, or Hint anytime.
• Game Center Leaderboards: Compete on Weekly & Global star rankings and unlock 6 milestone achievements.
• Play Offline Anytime: Great for commutes or quick breaks; optional one-time Remove Ads purchase with full Restore Purchases support.

Support: https://candy-nuts.pages.dev/
Privacy Policy: https://candy-nuts.pages.dev/privacy.html

name: Capi Bubble
description:
Join our cozy capybara on a relaxing bubble-shooting journey !

Blast and match colorful bubbles along winding water tracks, trigger sparkly combos, and bring peace back to the magical hot spring. Aim carefully, pop groups of bubbles, and unlock fun boosters to beat tricky levels!

 Game Features
• Simple & satisfying bubble match gameplay for everyone
• Adorable capybara companion with a yuzu on its head
• Numbers of unique levels with fresh challenges
• Smooth zen-style atmosphere, perfect to unwind
• Free to play, new levels added regularly

Pop bubbles. Save the spring. Relax with Capi!

name: Car Warning Lights: Car Assist
description:
KNOW WHAT TO DO WHEN YOUR CAR ACTS UP.
Car Assist is built for drivers with no technical knowledge. Pick the symptom, answer a few quick questions, and see an estimated risk level with a safe next step.

KEEP DRIVING OR STOP NOW?
• 8 problem types: car won't start, warning light, noise or vibration, smoke or smell, performance drop, overheating, tire problem and more
• Plain questions with big options; "I'm not sure" is always a valid answer
• Low, medium, high or emergency: a clear risk level
• Possible causes and the safe steps to take, in order

QUESTIONS THAT FIT YOUR CAR
• Symptoms and questions adapt to gasoline, diesel, LPG, hybrid and electric vehicles
• Manual and automatic gearboxes are handled differently
• Pick your make and model and a photo of your car appears automatically

ROADSIDE HELP ON THE MAP
• See nearby tow trucks, tire shops, battery help, mobile repair and garages
• Estimated arrival time and distance
• Call with one tap and share your location

A REPORT READY FOR YOUR MECHANIC
• Symptoms, answers and the estimated assessment in one text
• Add a dashboard photo and an engine sound recording
• Send it by message or email so your mechanic knows what to expect

MAINTENANCE AND REMINDERS
• Keep a service and maintenance log per vehicle
• Get notified for dated reminders
• Add more than one vehicle

PRIVACY
No account. Your vehicle, report and maintenance data is stored only on your device.

IMPORTANT
Car Assist does not give a definitive diagnosis; results are an estimate based on your answers. In case of a crash, injury or fire, call your local emergency number first.

SUBSCRIPTION
A Pro subscription is required to use the app. New subscribers get a 3-day free trial; cancel before it ends and you are not charged. Yearly and monthly plans are available. Payment is charged to your Apple Account, and the subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage and cancel your subscription in Settings › Apple Account › Subscriptions.

Privacy: https://arac-asist.vercel.app/privacy
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: CardioVector 3D
description:
심전도 파형을 외우는 대신, 심장의 전기가 어떻게 흘러서 그 파형이 되는지 눈으로 확인하는 학습 앱입니다.

· 3D 심장과 12유도 심전도가 같은 시간축으로 함께 움직입니다.
· 질환별 심전도 49개: 허혈과 심근경색, 방실차단, 각차단, 빈맥, 전해질 이상 등을 범주별로 찾아봅니다.
· 기초 학습 23강: 전도계부터 판독 순서까지 차례로 익히고 강마다 확인 문제를 풉니다.
· 퀴즈: 12유도 기록지만 보고 진단을 고릅니다. 틀린 문제는 다시 나옵니다.
· 판독 순서, 감별 심전도, 보고 문구(SBAR)를 함께 제공합니다.
· 나란히 비교, 즐겨찾기, 다크 모드, 영어 지원. 인터넷 없이도 동작합니다.

의대생, 간호대생, 응급구조과 학생과 심전도를 다시 정리하려는 의료인을 위해 만들었습니다.

이 앱은 교육용 시뮬레이션입니다. 의료기기가 아니며 실제 환자의 진단, 치료, 모니터링에 사용할 수 없습니다. 파형은 모델로 합성한 것이어서 실제 심전도와 다를 수 있습니다.

name: Caribbean Keys
description:
Caribbean Keys brings the sound of Latin and Caribbean keyboards to your iPad: studio grands for salsa montunos and boleros, a Cuban upright, classic electric pianos, steel pan, vibraphone and lush string pads.

TWENTY SAMPLED INSTRUMENTS
• Pianos: Puerto Rico, Miami and NYC studio grands, Cubano upright, Piano Merenguero, M1 Salsa Piano, Reggae Piano and more
• Electric pianos: Suitcase EP, Romantic EP, 70s Salsa EP, Classic DX EP, 80s Electric Grand
• Caribbean Steel Pan and Latin Vibraphone
• String pads for ballads and modern Latin pop

74 READY-TO-PLAY PRESETS
Stage Ready, Studio and Character versions of each instrument, plus layered sounds such as Steel Pan & Vibes Duet, Montuno Grand + M1 Bite and Bolero Trio. Search, sort by category and style, and save your own presets.

LAYER UP TO FOUR SOUNDS
Stack up to four instruments, each with its own volume, pan and sound, and shape them all with the ADSR envelope.

STUDIO EFFECTS
3-band EQ, compressor, tremolo, chorus, tempo-synced ping-pong delay and reverb with room, hall, plate and large hall types. Every effect has its own power switch.

MADE FOR TOUCH
• Large 25-key keyboard with octave buttons, note names and multi-touch chords
• Pitch bend and mod wheels
• Big knobs you can drag from anywhere on their label

PLAY IT YOUR WAY
• Standalone app, or as an Audio Unit (AUv3) instrument inside GarageBand and other host apps
• Connect a USB or Bluetooth MIDI keyboard, sustain pedal and mod wheel
• Choose the MIDI channel, velocity curve and pitch-bend range

All sounds are included in the app: no account, no subscription, no extra downloads.

name: CarkThraung
description:
Tonight, you're softly held.

CarkThraung is a quiet companion for everyday feelings—not therapy, not a crisis line. Pick one mood word, add an optional note, listen to calm soundscapes, and read a daily line of warmth. Everything stays on your iPhone

name: Cashier Crew Manager
description:
Cashier Crew Manager is the remote control for your Cashier Crew self-checkout screen.

Your counter takes orders by voice and touch. This app lets you run it from your phone, wherever you are.

TODAY
See that your screen is online and the card reader is charged. Follow sales, average ticket, extra sales from suggestions and best sellers as the day goes.

MENU
Ran out of something? Switch it off with one tap. Guests see it as sold out, the cashier stops offering it, and it comes back tomorrow by itself.

CASHIER
Choose the face guests see. Turn voice ordering on or off. Write your own greeting or let it change every day. Decide what to offer and how insistent to be.

SCREEN
Tips, "for here or to go", regulars, brightness and button color.

BUILT FOR A TEAM
Give staff their own access: they can mark items sold out without seeing sales. See every phone with access and remove any of them instantly. Every change is logged with who made it and when.

SECURE
Face ID on every open. Your password is never stored on our servers in readable form.

Cashier Crew Manager works with a Cashier Crew screen installed at your venue. Your venue code comes with the installation. No screen yet? Tap "See the demo café" to look around, or visit cashiercrew.com.

name: Castle Workshop: Slide & Build
description:
Find the resource your castle needs next.
Slide stone, wood and iron blocks through the exits. Watch each delivery become part of a miniature wall, tower, roof or gate.

THINK AHEAD
Vertical blocks slide up and down. Horizontal blocks slide left and right. Work around fixed obstacles, choose between exits and make room in limited storage.

50 STAGES TO BUILD
Complete miniature watchtowers, keeps and bridge fortresses. Take your time with no countdown. Undo, retry and regular hints help you keep exploring.

CHOOSE WHAT TO COLLECT
Check the construction goals above the board. Unneeded resources use storage space, so knowing what to leave behind matters too.

Progress is saved on your device. The puzzle game works offline. Ads, purchases and purchase restoration require a connection.
Ads may appear between stages. The optional Remove Ads purchase disables between-stage ads. Optional hint videos remain available. Regular hints can be used without watching ads.

name: Cendregarde: Roguelite Dungeon
description:
Cendregarde is a dungeon action RPG made for your phone. One thumb to run, your hero strikes on their own: you choose where to go, what to pick up and when to head back.

A DESCENT
Every descent builds a new crypt, floor after floor. Shadows drop weapons, armour and jewellery with random affixes. Compare at a glance, equip, salvage what you no longer need. Each level you gain, pick one card out of several. Every five floors, a guardian seals the stairs.

AT THE REFUGE
Fallen or back of your own will, you bring back ash. It raises your relics, bonuses that stay from one descent to the next. The next descent goes further.

EVER DEEPER
Difficulty tiers open when you beat their guardians: tougher enemies, richer loot. Around twenty legendary items, each with its own power, and their mythic form. Eight heroes, including the Fool, who draws an omen at the start of every descent.

MADE FOR YOUR PHONE
• One hand, portrait mode.
• Short descents: play for five minutes or an hour.
• Offline, no account: your game stays on your device.

WHAT COSTS MONEY
The game is free and fully playable without buying anything. No ads, no tracking, no energy or timers, and nothing that sells power. The shop offers tips, a ceremonial cloak and instant unlocks of heroes you can also earn by playing.

Available in English, French, German, Spanish, Italian, Brazilian Portuguese, Japanese, Korean and Traditional Chinese.

Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy: https://apps.epacus.fr/en/cendregarde/privacy/

name: Chaos Arena: Push Party
description:
Chaos Arena is a fast, funny party brawler where the last one standing wins. Shove, dash and bump your rivals off a crumbling arena in quick knockout rounds for 2 to 8 players.

PLAY WITH FRIENDS OR ONLINE
- Online multiplayer: jump into a match in seconds.
- Private rooms: invite friends with a short room code and battle together.
- Offline mode: practise against bots anytime, no internet needed.

EASY TO PLAY, HARD TO MASTER
- Simple controls: move, push and dash. Time your shove to send rivals flying.
- A guided first match teaches you in under a minute.
- Every round is a new sumo-style showdown: push, dodge, survive.

FIVE CHAOTIC ARENAS
- A floor that crumbles from the edges
- Rooftop fans that blow you away
- Rafts that drift apart
- A kitchen with oil slicks and steam vents
- A market with runaway carts

ITEMS AND CHARACTERS
- Grab a glove for a stronger push, a shield that blocks one hit, or a banana peel to trip the others.
- Four funny characters, each with their own look and push animation.
- Earn XP, level up and complete daily challenges.

A party game for game night, a quick io-style brawl on the bus, or a battle royale of shoves with your friends: Chaos Arena is pure chaos in your pocket.

Ads appear between matches, never during one. A one-time Remove Ads purchase turns them off.

name: Choy Puli: QR Tips for Waiters
description:
Choy Puli is a free service for cashless tips by QR code for waiters, baristas, couriers and anyone who gets tips in Uzbekistan.

Show a guest your QR code: it opens your page, and they send a tip straight to your Uzcard or Humo card from their own banking app. No dictating card numbers, no hunting for change, no splitting a shared tip jar.

It suits cafes, restaurants, teahouses, bars and coffee shops, delivery and taxi drivers, beauty salons and hotels.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Sign in with Telegram or Apple.
2. Add your name, pick a photo or an avatar, add your card and your Click link.
3. Show the QR code on your phone, or print it and put it on the table.

WHY CHOY PULI
• Free, no commission. The money never passes through us: the guest sends it from their card to yours.
• Any guest's bank: Click, Payme, Uzum, Alif, Paynet and more. The card number is copied for them.
• Click in one tap. Add your Click link and the guest lands right in a transfer to you.
• Your own page with your name and photo, so the guest sees whom they thank. It opens in Uzbek, Russian and English.
• Your code at hand: the app opens on the QR screen and turns up the brightness so it scans easily.
• Stats: how many times guests opened your page today, this week and in total.
• A QR code to print: the @ChoyPuliBot bot sends you a picture of your code.

SAFETY
A card number only lets people send money to the card. We never ask for the expiry date, the CVV or SMS codes. Your card number is stored encrypted. You can delete your account in the app at any time.

The guest's bank may charge its usual transfer fee, depending on its rates.

Questions and ideas: @ChoyPuliBot on Telegram.

name: Christmas Goods Sorting Puzzle
description:
Welcome to the coziest Christmas shop in town! Sort the shelves, match three of a kind and clear every level before the clock runs out.

Christmas Goods Sorting Puzzle is a shelf-sorting match-3 puzzle. Every level fills a snowy wooden cabinet with mixed-up goods: candy canes, gingerbread cookies, nutcrackers, stockings, cupcakes, cocoa mugs, teddy bears, snow globes, sodas, milk and more. Drag an item to another shelf, line up three of the same kind and they clear away. More goods wait in the back row, so plan ahead!

HOW TO PLAY
• Drag an item onto a shelf with a free spot.
• Put three of the same item on one shelf to clear them.
• When a shelf's front row is empty, the goods behind it move forward.
• Clear the whole cabinet to win the level.

PUZZLES THAT KEEP CHANGING
• Falling shelves: empty a shelf and the shelves above drop down, with new ones sliding in from the top.
• Ribbon locks: clear matches anywhere to untie locked shelves.
• Gift stacks: take the top item and the next one pops up.
• Ice: frozen goods stay put until a match next to them melts the ice.
• Cabinets in fresh shapes, plus Hard levels for an extra challenge.
• Combos: clear matches quickly to build a combo and earn more stars.

HANDY BOOSTERS
• Hammer opens an extra shelf, Shuffle re-deals the goods, Magnet pulls three matching goods off the shelves, and Frost freezes the clock for 15 seconds.
• Before a level, pick Extra Time, Head Start or Double Stars.

FESTIVE EVENTS EVERY DAY
• Elf Race: race four elves to win 8 levels first.
• Weekly Ranking: climb the league with the stars you earn.
• Lucky Spin, a daily Free Gift and Daily Quests full of rewards.
• Star Chest and Level Chest: open them as you play.

Ready to tidy up the holiday shelves? Download Christmas Goods Sorting Puzzle and start matching!

name: Chrono Gear: Astrolabe Bastion
description:
Spin the concentric brass rings, refract projectiles through outer prisms, and cleave hordes with the Grand Gravity Pendulum!
Chrono Gear: Astrolabe Bastion blends tactile 3-ring rotational aiming, drag-to-merge turret synthesis, and roguelike perk card drafting into a crisp 2.5D tactical tower defense experience.

KEY FEATURES
- Tactile 3-Ring Rotational Defense & Optical Refraction: Mount elemental Guardians across Inner, Middle, and Outer concentric gear rings and spin any ring with your finger to line up shots. Projectiles passing through outer prism gears split and amplify in mid-air!
- 360-Degree Grand Gravity Pendulum & Bullet Parry: Command a massive physical pendulum sweeping across the stone courtyard, cleaving clockwork monsters on contact and parrying allied shots into crescent shockwaves.
- Drag-to-Merge & 6-Star Mythic Sovereign Awakening: Merge matching Guardians, smelt spare gears in the Furnace for Gold and Lucky Coils, and assemble 3-gear recipes to awaken 6-Star Mythic Sovereigns with signature Ultimates!
- 18 Perk Cards, 12 O'Clock Compound Interest & 6 Chapters: Draft synergistic Perk Cards, ride the 12-second clock hand for Gold interest, and conquer 20-wave runs across 6 chapters.
- Instant Offline-Friendly Play: No account sign-in required. Upgrade permanent Atelier Sanctuary talents with earned Aether Gems!

name: CIRCUIT'27
description:
CIRCUIT'27 is an arcade racer that goes round the world.

Ten worlds, ten circuits in each. Every race is three laps from a standing start, with eleven rivals on the grid beside you.

100 CIRCUITS IN TEN WORLDS
Neon City, Alpine Rush, Desert Dunes, Cairo, Sydney Harbour, Great Ocean Road, Great Barrier Reef, The Cotswolds, Vineyard Valley and Frozen Arctic. Each has its own roads, its own light and its own weather: wet streets under neon, a cliff road above the sea, lanes between stone walls, snow ploughed into banks.

TWELVE CARS, THREE LAPS
Start from the grid and pass who you can. Three stars for a win, two for second or third, one for finishing.

TWO THUMBS
A single pedal drives: hold to go, slide up to boost, down to brake. A glass slider steers, or tilt your iPhone instead.

AS EASY OR AS HARD AS YOU LIKE
Lane assist and brake assist make every circuit finishable. Switch them off to earn all three stars.

DAY, NIGHT AND WEATHER
Sunshine, rain, snow, mist, dust and storms. Night races are lit by neon and your own headlights.

WATCH IT AGAIN
Checkpoint times against your best run, and after every race a replay of the whole field from a circling drone, with your best run beside you as a ghost.

GAME CENTER AND iCLOUD
Leaderboards for stars and for best times, achievements, and progress that follows you from one iPhone to the next.

FAIR TO BUY
The World Tour is free: ten circuits, one from every world. Each of the ten worlds can be bought on its own, or all ten together for less. One-time purchases: no subscription, no ads, nothing to run out.

name: Citriroll
description: Citriroll is a cheerful fruit orchard game packed with juicy spins and quick challenges. Spin the Citri Wheel to collect citrus treasures, play Juice Rush for combo scores, craft fresh juice recipes, complete daily orchard quests, and unlock wheel themes in the grove shop. Sign in with Apple, Google, or play as a guest and grow your farm progress at your own pace.

name: Clay Town: Spot the Difference
description:
"Clay goes back where it belongs once someone notices."

Solnae is a small town by the sea. Grandpa ran its photo studio for forty years, and after he closed it, he used his old photos to build the whole town as a clay model. But every night, someone changes the model a little. Join his granddaughter Bori on her summer vacation: compare Grandpa's photos with today's model, find what's different, and put the town back. Who is the little prankster behind it all?

■ How to play
· On top is Grandpa's photo; below is the model as it is now. When you spot a difference, tap it in either picture.
· The piece you found crumbles away in a puff of clay dust, and the model goes back to match the photo. Find them all and the two pictures become the same.
· Tap areas are generous, so you don't need pinpoint taps.
· Pinch or tap the zoom buttons to see up to three times larger. Both pictures move together.
· Stuck? Take a hint and one spot you haven't found yet will sparkle. Each picture gives you one hint for free, and you can watch a rewarded ad for more.
· In Story and Relaxed, the spots you found are saved, so you can pick up where you left off.

■ Fair differences
· Only the changed spots are pasted onto the original picture, so everything else matches pixel for pixel. No accidental smudges or mismatches to chase.
· Every difference was checked: ones that were too small or too faint were left out, and we avoided ones that only show as a red or green color change.

■ Grandpa's Clay Town — a fully voiced story
· 8 chapters, 80 pictures: from Grandpa's workshop through the alley market, the seaside school, the little station, the fishing harbor, the autumn fields and the winter alley, all the way to the town festival.
· Every chapter has dialogue scenes, and every line is voiced in Korean, English and Japanese (following the app language).
· Meet the rice-cake granny, the teacher, the stationmaster, the old fisherman and more, and uncover the secret of the prankster who keeps changing the model.
· Story pictures have a time limit. When time runs out, try again, or watch a rewarded ad once per picture for 30 more seconds.

■ A seaside town in clay miniature
· A 1990s Korean seaside town in clay miniature art: the market, the school, the station, the harbor, the fields, a winter alley and a festival, all one town.

■ Daily Picture
· A new picture every day at 07:00 UTC, with the same differences for everyone.
· Find them all on your first try of the day without hints, and you can post your time to the leaderboard (optional).
· Past Daily Pictures can be played again from the Album the next day (personal records).

■ Relaxed
· Play pictures you've cleared again, with no time limit. You can choose it right from the title screen.

■ Showcase and Album
· Finish a picture to earn clay, then use it to collect 24 clay figures of townspeople, animals and things for your showcase.
· The Album keeps the pictures you've cleared and lets you watch story scenes again.

■ Ads and in-app purchases
· Ads are a banner below the play screen and optional rewarded ads (one more hint, more time) that play only when you choose them.
· Free play continues while the banner is shown, so it needs an internet connection.
· Remove Banner Ads removes the banner and gives you rewarded help without ads (the same number of times). With ads removed, you can play without internet for up to 7 days after the last check.
· Workshop Ledger (+50% clay) and the decoration sets Jogakbo Patchwork and Cherry Blossom (album frame, found-spot marks and background). All are one-time purchases, and every picture, story chapter and figure can be earned without buying. There are no random items.

■ Privacy
· Usage statistics and leaderboards are used only if you turn them on in Settings. They are never offered to players under 16.

Contact: help@moonzworks.com

name: CloudDrive Storage & Backup
description:
CloudDrive – Secure Cloud Storage, Photo Backup & File Sharing

Keep your photos, videos, and documents safe in the cloud and access them anytime, anywhere. CloudDrive makes it easy to back up your iPhone, free up storage space, organize your files, and share them securely with just a link.

- AUTOMATIC PHOTO BACKUP
Enable Auto Backup to automatically upload your camera roll to the cloud. Choose to back up over Wi-Fi only, select the albums you want to save, and keep your precious memories protected without lifting a finger.

- ALL YOUR FILES IN ONE PLACE
Store photos, videos, PDFs, documents, music, and more in one secure location. Create folders, organize your files, search quickly, and monitor your available storage at a glance.

- FAST UPLOADS AND DOWNLOADS
Upload large files and entire folders with ease. Background uploads let you continue using your device while transfers are in progress. Track everything from the Transfers screen, including ongoing uploads, completed files, and transfers that need to be retried.

- SECURE AND EASY FILE SHARING
Share files and folders using a public link with customizable expiration options: 1 hour, 1 day, 7 days, or 30 days.
For greater privacy, share files directly with selected people via email. Choose between view-only and edit permissions, and update or revoke access whenever you need.

- STARRED FILES
Keep your most important files within easy reach. Simply star your favorites and access them instantly from the Starred tab.

- ACCESS FILES OFFLINE
Make selected files available offline and access them without an internet connection. Whether you're traveling, flying, or away from a reliable connection, your important files are always within reach.

- MORE FEATURES TO EXPLORE
Preview photos, videos, PDFs, and documents directly in the app.
Restore deleted files from Trash within 30 days.
Receive notifications when someone shares a file or folder with you.
Sign in easily using Apple, Google, or email.
Every CloudDrive account includes 5 GB of free cloud storage.

- PURPOSE
CloudDrive is designed to provide users with a secure, convenient, and reliable solution for storing, backing up, organizing, accessing, and sharing their digital files. Its primary purpose is to protect important photos, videos, and documents while helping users free up device storage and manage their digital content efficiently.

With automatic photo backups, fast uploads and downloads, offline file access, flexible sharing options, and expandable cloud storage plans, CloudDrive offers an all-in-one solution for keeping important files accessible and organized anytime, anywhere.

Terms of Use : https://sites.google.com/view/cloud-storage-terms-of-use/home
