name: Clue Countdown
description:
Clue Countdown turns your family's Secret Santa draw into a guessing game that runs for days.

After the draw, every Santa posts one small clue about themselves each day, like "I always burn the first pancake." Everyone tries to work out who their own Santa is, and can change their guess as the clues pile up. On reveal day, put the reveal on the TV or share it on a video call. One person at a time, it shows their guesses day by day, then who their Santa really was.

HOW IT WORKS
• One person sets it up. Add everyone by first name or nickname, group people by the home they live in and pick the dates.
• The app makes the draw. Nobody picks names by hand, and nobody sees the full list of matches, the organizer included.
• Send each person their own private link. There are no accounts, emails, phone numbers or passwords.
• A new clue unlocks at the same time each day for the whole group. Choose 5, 7 or 10 days of clues.
• Make a guess each day. Your guess history becomes part of the reveal.

THE WHOLE FAMILY CAN PLAY
Everyone picks a picture tile, like a mitten or a kettle, so players who can't read yet can still find their name. Children under 13 play on a grown-up's phone. The grown-up writes the child's clues, then taps "Hand to" and the child's name. The child hears each clue read aloud by the phone itself and taps a big picture tile to make a guess. Children never type anything, and a press-and-hold button hands the phone back to the grown-up.

FAIR AND PRIVATE DRAWS
• Keep certain people apart, such as a couple, without anyone seeing the list.
• People in the same home won't draw each other unless you allow it.
• Someone drops out? Remove them and only their Santa's match changes.

KIND BY DESIGN
• Clues are short text only. Web links, email addresses and phone numbers are removed automatically, and a word filter catches unkind words.
• Anyone can report a clue. It disappears for everyone until the organizer shows it again or deletes it.
• There are no public profiles, no messages between players and no strangers. Everything stays inside your group.

ANY CELEBRATION
Use the Secret Santa theme, or switch to the plain theme for Hanukkah, Eid, Diwali, a birthday or a family reunion. For Hanukkah, seven nights of clues with the reveal on the eighth works well.

FREE, WITH NO ADS
There are no ads, in-app purchases, affiliate links or gift suggestions, and no tracking, analytics or cookies. Everything about a group is deleted 30 days after the reveal, or sooner if the organizer deletes it.

Relatives without an iPhone can join from the same private link in any web browser.

name: Cluestamp: Crossword Maker
description:
Turn the things only the two of you know into a small crossword, then send it as one link in any chat. The person you send it to solves it on their phone, in the browser. They don't need the app.

■ Write it
• Pick a New Year template: Family, Friends, Partner or Coworkers. Each one asks questions like "Where we went this summer" or "Who laughs loudest at the dinner table". Or start blank.
• Answer with words that mean something to both of you. You can change any question.
• Cluestamp fits the answers into a crossing grid as you type. If a word doesn't cross the others, it tells you, and you can shuffle, change the word or leave it out.
• Add your name and a message they see when they finish.

■ Send it
• Preview shows exactly what they will see, and you can solve it yourself.
• Share sends one link. The whole puzzle is packed inside the link, so nothing is uploaded and there is no account.
• A bar shows how long the link is, so it works in the chat app you use.

■ They solve it
• The link opens a crossword page on vyvflo.com in their browser, with their phone's keyboard and the current clue right above it.
• When they finish, a card shows their time, your message and a postmark with your name, and they can send the result back to you.

■ Free and Pro
Your first crossword is free, from start to finish. Cluestamp Pro is a one-time purchase, not a subscription: send as many crosswords as you like, and change a sent one to send it again.

■ Private
No account and no sign-in. Your puzzles are stored on your iPhone. No ads and no tracking.

Cluestamp is in English, German, French, Spanish, Italian and Portuguese. Answers use the letters A to Z, so accented letters become plain ones.

name: Cờ Tướng: Chinese Chess
description:
Cờ Tướng (Xiangqi, Chinese chess) for you and your family.

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Against the computer at Easy, Medium or Hard.
• Two players sharing one phone.
• Nearby: two phones close together.
• Online with a friend through Game Center.

THE REAL RULES
Check and checkmate, the "flying general" rule, stalemate counts as a loss, perpetual check is not allowed, and repeating a position three times or 60 moves without a capture is a draw. The rules are tested against published move-count numbers.

LEARN AS YOU PLAY
• Help in English and Vietnamese: every piece with pictures, check and checkmate, special rules, tips and quizzes.
• Tap Hint to see a strong move, with the reasons it is good in plain words.
• Take back your last move and try again (optional, and you can switch it off).
• The board marks the last move, the squares a piece can reach, and a General in check.

MAKE IT YOURS
• Optional timer: 30 or 60 seconds per move, or 5 or 10 minutes for the whole game.
• Quit any time and continue later. Games against the computer are saved automatically.
• Your pieces are always at the bottom of the screen, whichever side you play.
• Tokens and stats for friendly bragging rights. Tokens are virtual and have no cash value.
• Make a group of friends and family: see who has the most tokens, get notified when someone plays, and watch live games.

PRIVACY
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your name, tokens and stats stay on your device. If you make a group, they are shared through your own iCloud with the people you invite.

name: Coin Tub
description: Coin Tub keeps the name of a laundry machine and the coins you slide into it. Each full slide to the left adds 0.50, and the amount stops at 2.00. After the amount is above 0.00, pull the copper knob down to start that load. Loads lists the machine and the amount. The pages can be read in English, Arabic, Chinese, French, Russian, Spanish, German, or Japanese. The load stays on this iPhone.

name: Coinwerk: Crypto Idle Tycoon
description:
One old PC in a garage. That's how every coin empire starts – and yours ends on the Moon.

Coinwerk is an idle tycoon with brains: you don't just tap. You invent your own coin, run the company behind it and learn to read a living world.

DESIGN YOUR OWN COIN
Pick a name, a logo, a theme, a technology and a style. A pizza coin booms when delivery services break records. A solar coin loves sunny days. Every trait reacts to the world – no two coins behave the same.

READ THE WORLD
Season, time of day, weekday and moon phase are real. Weather, economy and headlines belong to the game world. Together they decide the demand for your coin, right now and in the hours ahead. Plan with the forecast instead of hoping for luck.

FARMS AROUND THE GLOBE
Upgrade from garage to basement, loft, office, data center and skyscraper. Open sites in Reykjavík, Dubai, Singapore, Sydney, Texas and Vancouver – then in orbit and on the Moon. Every site has its own clock, weather, climate, power price and market. The same coin can boom in one place and flop in another.

KEEP THE LIGHTS ON
Machines draw power and give off heat. Expand the power line and the cooling, build solar, wind, hydro and geothermal plants, store the surplus in batteries and sign fixed-price contracts before the evening peak. The control panel in every room shows load, cooling, own power and electricity costs at a glance.

SEVERAL COINS, SEVERAL SITES
Run different coins in parallel and give every machine type the coin that pays best right now. Site managers reinvest for you while you are away.

MAKE YOUR COIN FAMOUS
Run campaigns from flyers to stadium sponsoring, research permanent advantages and sell the whole company for fame that makes every new company grow faster.

ALWAYS SOMETHING TO DO
• 22 goals that guide you step by step, then long-term goals without end
• Missions, a daily bonus, 52 achievements and a coin album with 990 entries
• Market weeks with changing themes
• Duels and rankings with friends by friend code
• Whales, boosters and earnings while you are away

FAIR PLAY
No ads. No tracking. No location access. Playable offline. Coinwerk is a game: all coins, prices and money are made up, nothing is mined or traded for real and nothing has real-world value.

Coinwerk is free to play. Optional purchases: chip packs, a permanent income doubler and the Coinwerk Pro subscription (monthly or yearly) with an extra coin slot, a permanent auto-tapper, longer and doubled away earnings, a longer forecast, bonus chips and longer power contracts. Payment is charged to your Apple account. The subscription renews automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the period ends; you can manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings.

Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy policy: https://crorry-dev.github.io/coinwerk/datenschutz/

name: ColorMode for Safari
description:
Make Safari easier on your eyes and truly yours.

ColorMode for Safari is a Safari extension that transforms any website into Dark Mode or your favorite custom color theme with a single tap. Reduce screen glare during late-night browsing and enjoy a more comfortable web experience every day.

KEY FEATURES

• One-Tap Preset Themes
Instantly switch between Standard Dark Mode, calming Midnight, and warm Sepia for comfortable reading—tailored to any lighting or mood.

• Full Custom Color Control
Use the built-in color picker to freely customize background, text, and link colors. Create the exact contrast and palette you love.

• Image Brightness Adjustment
Bright photos and graphics can feel harsh against dark backgrounds. Gently dim images with a simple slider to keep the entire page balanced and easy on the eyes.

• Per-Site Toggle
Apply your theme across all websites, or disable it for the current domain with a single tap whenever you prefer a site's original design.

• Instant, Real-Time Updates
Changes to colors and brightness apply immediately without reloading the page. Your settings are saved automatically for every new tab and visit.

PERFECT FOR
• Late-night browsing in dark rooms
• Turning websites without native Dark Mode into dark pages
• Reading long articles and blogs without harsh white glare
• Personalizing Safari with your favorite color combinations

HOW TO GET STARTED
1. Open the Settings app > Apps > Safari > Extensions.
2. Turn on "ColorMode for Safari" and set All Websites to "Allow".
3. Open any website in Safari, tap the Extensions button in the address bar, and choose your theme or custom colors.

PRIVACY FIRST
All your color settings and excluded domains are stored locally on your device. ColorMode for Safari never collects, tracks, or sends your browsing history or personal data to any external server.

name: Column Tide
description:
Column Tide presents classic FreeCell solitaire with a crisp look and a rewarding focus on strategy.

Every card begins face up across eight tableau columns, giving you the information needed to plan ahead. Use four free cells to open new paths, rearrange available cards, and build each foundation from Ace to King by suit.

Study the full layout from the first move

Use open cells as temporary holding spaces

Organize the tableau one card at a time

Complete all four foundations by suit

Elegant, thoughtful, and easy to revisit, Column Tide turns a familiar deck into a satisfying test of logic and foresight.

name: CondomWise
description:
O CondomWise põe o seu condomínio no telemóvel. Saiba o que deve, o que se decidiu na última assembleia e em que ponto está a infiltração da garagem, sem papéis, sem telefonemas e sem esperar pela próxima reunião.

A app é para quem vive ou tem casa num prédio gerido com o CondomWise e para quem o administra.

PARA CONDÓMINOS

• Quotas e pagamentos — veja o mapa de quotas da sua fração, o que está pago e o que falta. Comunique um pagamento com o comprovativo e a administração confirma.
• Comunicados — receba os avisos da administração com notificação no telemóvel, no momento em que são publicados.
• Ocorrências — reporte um problema com fotografias e acompanhe o estado até ficar resolvido. As ocorrências das zonas comuns ficam visíveis para todo o prédio.
• Assembleias — consulte convocatórias, ordem de trabalhos e atas.
• Documentos — regulamento, apólices, atas e outros documentos do condomínio sempre à mão.
• Reservas — marque o salão de festas ou outro espaço comum e acompanhe a aprovação.
• Obras — conheça as obras em curso, os orçamentos e a sua parte em cada uma.
• Pedidos à administração — peça uma declaração de não dívida, um documento ou a atualização dos seus contactos.
• Seguros e manutenção — veja as apólices em vigor e as próximas manutenções dos equipamentos.
• Contas do condomínio — acompanhe o saldo e os movimentos de forma agregada e transparente.

PARA ADMINISTRADORES E GESTORES

• Painel com o estado de todos os condomínios que gere.
• Pagamentos, despesas e frações sempre acessíveis.
• Responda a ocorrências, pedidos e reservas onde quer que esteja.
• Publique comunicados e chegue a todos os condóminos de uma só vez.

PRIVACIDADE EM PRIMEIRO LUGAR

Cada condómino vê apenas o que lhe diz respeito: o mapa do prédio não mostra nomes nem valores de outras frações, e as contas aparecem apenas de forma agregada. Pode apagar a sua conta a qualquer momento a partir da app.

COMO ENTRAR

O acesso é feito por convite da administração do seu condomínio. Depois de receber o convite por email, entre com password, Google ou Apple. Se o seu prédio ainda não usa o CondomWise, fale com a sua administração ou visite condomwise.pt.

Disponível em português e inglês, com modo claro e escuro.

name: Confession Booth
description:
Turn your party into a reality show.

Set an iPad or iPhone on a stand, name your event, and let guests step into the Confession Booth. They tap Start, get a countdown, and spill it: birthday wishes, wedding toasts, embarrassing stories, hot takes. At the end of the night, Confession Booth stitches every clip into one movie you can share with everyone.

SWAP THE ROOM, LIVE
Drop your guests into a mansion, a penthouse, a nightclub, a library or a cozy cabin. The background is replaced live while they record, and it works with groups too. Browse beautiful indoor rooms or use your own photos. Only the host can change the background.

MADE FOR GUESTS
• Big, simple Start button with a countdown
• Clear on-screen steps, so nobody needs instructions
• Keep it or redo before it's saved
• A host passcode keeps guests in the booth and away from settings

ONE MOVIE AT THE END OF THE NIGHT
• Every clip joined in order with smooth crossfades
• A title card with your event name and date
• Add a song from your files with its name shown on screen
• Share to Messages, AirDrop, Instagram and more, or save to Photos

CAN'T MAKE IT? INVITE THEM ANYWAY
Send an invite link to friends who couldn't come. They record their confession in the app, and it lands in your event over iCloud.

EVERY PARTY, SAVED
Pick up where you left off, start a new event, or go back to an earlier one and remake its movie. Clips are kept in your own Photos library, never on our servers.

FREE TO TRY, ONE PRICE TO UNLOCK
Every event holds 3 clips for free, so you can try everything, including the final movie. Confession Booth Unlimited is a one-time purchase for unlimited clips and remote invites at every party. No subscription, and it works with Family Sharing. Remote guests always record for free.

Perfect for weddings, birthdays, bachelorette parties, reunions, holiday parties, graduations, office events and game nights.

name: ContaTudo
description:
Faça o seu trabalho. O ContaTudo faz as contas.

Trabalha em mais do que um sítio e recebe à percentagem, a valor fixo ou à hora? Registe cada consulta, sessão ou serviço em segundos e veja quanto faturou, quanto vai receber de cada local e quanto falta para o objetivo do mês.

Feito para profissionais de saúde, fitness, beleza, bem-estar, educação, veterinária e outras áreas: a app usa as palavras da sua área (consultas, sessões, aulas, serviços) e os nomes dos seus locais de trabalho.

REGISTO EM SEGUNDOS
• Escolha o local, o cliente e o preço; a app aplica a percentagem, o valor fixo ou a tabela de preços desse local.
• Custos extra e material descontados automaticamente.
• Salário base semanal, mensal ou anual somado aos totais.

OS SEUS NÚMEROS, CLAROS
• Painel com a faturação de hoje e do mês e a variação face ao mês anterior.
• Análise por local de trabalho: onde ganha mais e quanto vale a sua hora.
• Calendário com tudo o que registou e o histórico de cada cliente.

OBJETIVOS
• Defina metas de faturação ou de atendimentos e acompanhe o progresso a cada registo.

PLANOS
• Basic, grátis: até 2 locais de trabalho ativos, 50 registos por mês, 1 objetivo e análise por mês e ano.
• Pro, subscrição mensal ou anual: até 4 locais de trabalho ativos, 150 registos por mês, 3 objetivos, análise por dia, semana, mês e ano, métricas avançadas, assistente que responde a perguntas sobre os seus números (50 perguntas por mês), registo por foto (fotografe a agenda ou um recibo e reveja as marcações; 15 leituras por mês) e suporte prioritário.
• Max, subscrição mensal ou anual: locais de trabalho, registos e objetivos sem limite, períodos personalizados na análise e assistente com 500 perguntas e 150 leituras de fotos por mês, além de tudo o que o Pro tem.

SUBSCRIÇÕES
O pagamento é cobrado na sua conta Apple ao confirmar a compra. A subscrição renova-se automaticamente, a não ser que seja cancelada pelo menos 24 horas antes do fim do período em curso. Pode gerir e cancelar nas definições da conta Apple, em Subscrições. Pode mudar de plano na app.

PRIVACIDADE
Sem anúncios. Os seus dados são só seus: não os vendemos nem os usamos para publicidade. Pode apagar a conta e todos os dados a qualquer momento, na app.

Termos de utilização: https://contatudo.app/termos
Política de privacidade: https://contatudo.app/privacidade

Disponível em português, inglês, espanhol, francês, alemão e italiano.

name: Coro Fe y Alegría
description:
Coro Fe y Alegría es la app del coro de la Iglesia Católica del Sagrado Corazón en Hidalgo, Texas. Reúne en un solo lugar el cancionero del coro y las listas de cantos de cada Misa.

• Listas de cantos: la Misa de cada domingo y fiesta, momento por momento, con la versión y el tono de cada canto.
• Partituras y hojas de acordes: escaneos, hojas con acordes y partituras que se pueden cambiar de tono, con colores Boomwhacker.
• Sin internet: descargue las listas y lleve las partituras a la Misa aunque no haya señal.
• Dibuje sobre las partituras: marque respiraciones, entradas y notas con el dedo o con el Apple Pencil, y compártalas con el coro.
• Calendario litúrgico: los nombres y las fechas de los domingos y las fiestas para preparar cada lista.
• Sugerencias de cantos: ideas para cada momento de la Misa según las lecturas del día.
• Para quienes dirigen el coro: subir escaneos y grabaciones, escribir hojas, armar listas y manejar las cuentas.

La app es solo para los miembros del coro. Las cuentas las da la parroquia.

name: Corvel
description:
Corvel is a quiet, private place to write a cover letter. No sign-in, no ads, no internet connection required — just a simple tool that helps you turn a few facts about a role into a clean, readable first draft.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Choose one of four letter styles: Professional, Confident, Friendly or Concise.
2. Add the company, job title, your name and a short highlight or two.
3. Pick a tone and generate a full letter in seconds.
4. Read it, select and copy the text, and keep it in your local library.

WHAT YOU GET
- Four original templates with different openings, body paragraphs and closings
- Four tones that change the supporting sentences, not just the greeting
- A three-step editor that keeps every screen short and focused
- A personal profile so your name and contact details are reused automatically
- A letters library with search, re-editing and deletion
- 24 original phrases across Openings, Skills, Achievements and Closings
- Full text selection, so you can paste your letter into email or any document

name: Couch Weather
description:
The weather for the places you care about, on the biggest screen in the house. Couch Weather is made for Apple TV: large type you can read from across the room, calm colours, and everything a swipe of the remote away.

AT A GLANCE
• The temperature now, today's high and low, and what the sky is doing
• The next hours, hour by hour
• The days ahead with highs, lows and the chance of rain
• Humidity, wind and air pressure
• Where the sun is right now, with sunrise, sunset and the length of the day

CHARTS FOR THE COUCH
Open temperature, humidity, wind or pressure as a full-screen chart. Switch between the next 24 hours and the next days, and move along the curve with the remote to see each hour.

ALL YOUR PLACES
Add your home, your family's town, the ski resort or your next holiday, as many places as you like, and switch between them from the bar at the top. Each place shows its own local time.

GOOD FORECASTS, CHOSEN FOR YOU
Couch Weather picks the right source for every place by itself: the US National Weather Service in the United States, Bright Sky with data from the German Weather Service in Germany, and MET Norway everywhere else.

YOUR UNITS
Celsius or Fahrenheit, km/h or mph, hPa or inHg.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your places and settings stay on your Apple TV.

From the maker of Couch Control.

name: Court Damage
description:
Play a quick game of doubles on the waterfront at Mercer Yard. You control Trevor. Three opinionated rivals and teammates share the court, each with a different way to place the ball. Drop a soft shot just over the net or drive deep for the baseline.

Four legal returns charge a Spit Slick. Challenge a rival at the net, counter a scuffle, or slip out of reach. Your partner keeps playing while you are occupied. Every point comes from the rally, and the first team to five wins.

Play offline in landscape. Character voices have speaker-labelled captions, and you can mute speech while keeping the sounds of the court.

name: CourtMaster Club
description:
CourtMaster is the all-in-one platform for ball sports clubs – management, teams, tournaments and live scoring in one app.

CLUB
• Members and roles (admin, staff, coach, scorer)
• Venues, courts and court booking
• Sponsoring and season planning

TEAMS
• Rosters with positions and jersey numbers, import from CSV/Excel
• Plan trainings and matches, attendance and absences
• Attendance export, team fund, team emails
• Tactics board with lineups and rotations

TOURNAMENTS
• Groups, knockout, hybrid, Swiss, ladder and multi-stage formats
• Automatic schedule with courts, times and referees
• Live standings, bracket and public tournament page
• Team check-in and third-place match

LIVE SCORING
• 7 sports: volleyball, beach volleyball, tennis, padel, squash, badminton, table tennis
• Guest access via QR code, voice announcements, offline scoring

ATHLETICS
• Competitions with the Swiss Athletics points table, hand timing, rankings

5 languages: German, English, French, Italian, Spanish.
No ads, no tracking.

More at https://courtmaster.io

name: Crew Go
description:
Crew Go is the companion app for event crews whose company books work through a Crew Go crew website. Sign in with the website address, email and password your company gave you.

MY JOBS
- See your next job at a glance: dates, call time, venue and your position
- Answer job requests with one tap: Available or No, with an optional note
- Know where you stand: confirmed, on hold, standby or waiting on you
- Open the call sheet, maps and the other confirmed crew's contact details

OPEN JOBS
- Browse shifts that still need people, matched to your skills
- Claim a spot, ask the office a question, or share a job with a friend

DOCUMENTS, EVEN OFFLINE
- Stage plots, run sheets and other job files save to your phone automatically, so they open in a basement venue with no signal

REPORTS AND PHOTOS
- Send after-action notes and broken-gear reports straight from the job
- Take photos with the camera; each one is stamped with the upload time and stripped of location data before the office sees it

CALENDAR
- Your confirmed, pending and standby jobs on one calendar
- Mark the days you can't work so you aren't asked

NOTIFICATIONS
- Get a push notification when you're asked about a job, booked, or a call sheet changes

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
- No ads, no tracking. Your password can be kept in your iPhone's Keychain, and you can delete your account from the Me tab at any time.

Crew Go needs an account created by a company that uses the Crew Go crew website. There is no public sign-up.

name: Curioflow
description:
Curioflow is a reading app for iPhone and iPad that connects to your self-hosted Curioflow server. Save articles from Safari and other apps, follow RSS feeds and newsletters, and read synced articles offline.

• Organize saved articles in your Library and revisit them in Archive.
• Browse new posts and newsletter issues in Subscriptions, then save the ones you want to keep.
• Make the reader your own with adjustable text size and reading themes.
• Pick up where you left off with synced reading progress.

To get started, enter the URL of a compatible Curioflow server and sign in with your server account.

name: Daddy's Total - Dad Play Cards
description:
"What should we play today?"
Draw one card and get a game that fits your child's age.

Daddy's Total is a play-card app for dads. It has 119 games you can start right away with kids from newborn to 8 years old. Most need only things you already have at home, and each card tells you what to do in a few short steps.

[Great for dads who]
- want to play with their kids but don't know where to start
- are tired of playing the same game every time
- want to make the most of ten minutes after work or a free weekend

[Cards that fit your child]
- Enter your child's birthday and you'll only see games for their age in months.
- Pick what your child loves (dinosaurs, drawing, animals, cars, cooking, nature and more) and those games show up more often.
- Choose indoor or outdoor, and 10 minutes, 30 minutes or an hour.

[On every card]
- What you need and how to play
- How it helps your child grow (body, language, feelings, thinking, hands, creativity)
- A safety tip when it matters

[Your play calendar]
Tap "We did it" and the game's picture stays on that day in your calendar. See at a glance how much you played together this month, and save favorites to play again.

[Simple and private]
- No sign-up
- No ads
- Your child's details and play history stay on your phone
- Korean and English

[Price]
Try your first 5 games for free. If you like it, buy once to unlock every card. No subscription. Use "Restore purchase" to unlock it on your other devices with the same account.

Every game is matched to your child's age and stage of development. Always stay close and keep an eye on your child while playing.

name: DaGrande
description:
DaGrande è un gioco per imparare a gestire i soldi: sbagli lì, non nella vita vera.

Hai 22 anni, il primo stipendio e una vita da vivere a Cosenza, ricostruita in 3D: casa tua, Corso Mazzini, Piazza dei Bruzi. 
Per strada ti propongono delle spese, come succede davvero: il telefono nuovo a rate, l'aperitivo del venerdì con gli amici, il viaggio dell'estate.

Prima di rispondere apri la Lente: ti dice quanto paghi in tutto e quanto ti resta a fine mese. Poi i mesi passano in pochi secondi e vedi com'è andata.

E se avessi risposto in un altro modo? Con la Macchina del tempo torni alla scelta, ne provi un'altra con la stessa fortuna e confronti le due vite.

Non vince chi spende di meno: chi rinuncia a tutto ha i conti a posto ma è meno sereno, chi dice sì a tutto va in rosso. Sta meglio chi sceglie con misura.

Cosa trovi nel gioco: 
• Cosenza in 3D da esplorare, con gli occhi del protagonista o vedendolo da dietro 
• Tre proposte di spesa, con la Lente per fare i conti prima di scegliere 
• Vita lampo: tre mesi in pochi secondi, con stipendio, affitto e rate 
• La Macchina del tempo per confrontare due scelte 
• I conti di casa sul frigo e il salvadanaio sulla scrivania

Gratis, senza pubblicità, senza account e senza raccolta di dati. Funziona anche senza connessione.

Gioco educativo: i soldi sono inventati e non dà consigli di investimento.

name: Daily Hadith: Bukhari & Muslim
seller_name: AL TITI ESTABLISHMENT FOR SOFTWARE TECHNOLOGY
description:
One hadith a day, from Sahih al-Bukhari and Sahih Muslim.

The app opens straight onto the hadith of the day, and sends a single notification at a time you choose. No account, no ads, and no internet connection required.

■ What it does

• 10,044 hadith: 7,005 from Sahih al-Bukhari, 3,039 from Sahih Muslim
• Works entirely offline: the texts ship inside the app, so there is nothing to download on first launch
• One daily reminder, at the time you pick
• Classical commentary for more than three quarters of the collection
• The matn without the chain of narrators, so the daily reading stays short
• "Another hadith" for anyone who wants more on the same day
• A fully Arabic, right-to-left interface

■ Notifications are entirely local

The reminder is scheduled on your own device. There is no push service and no device token. Nothing needs a network connection at the moment the notification arrives.

■ Privacy

No accounts and no ads. Anonymous usage statistics help us improve the app, with no advertising ID and never the text of a hadith. Your chosen reminder time stays on your device.

■ Note

The app shows the matn without the isnad, to keep the daily reading brief. For the full chain of narrators, consult the source collections.

Source: Sahih al-Bukhari and Sahih Muslim, with their classical commentaries.

name: Daily Missal: Catholic
description:
Daily Missal follows the Catholic liturgical calendar, day by day.

• Today: the liturgical day, season and week, liturgical colour, Sunday and weekday cycles, and rank, with a short explanation for each.
• Mass readings: the reading references for every day of the year, with a link to read the full texts.
• Saint of the day: a short biography, patronage and a classic painting, shareable as an image.
• National feasts: choose your country to add its own feasts and saints.
• Calendar: browse any date and see what is coming up this week.
• Prayers: a library of traditional Catholic prayers and the Rosary.
• Reminders: gentle daily notifications, and a greeting on your birthday.

Works offline: the calendar is worked out on your phone. Available in English, French, Spanish, Filipino, Portuguese and Tamil. Light and dark themes.

No account, no ads and no tracking.

name: Date Stamp: Batch Photo Dates
description:
Just select them all. Each gets the date it was taken.

Pick the photos you've already taken, and every photo gets its own date taken stamped on it. Select the photos from a three-day trip and day one's photos get day one's date, day two's photos get day two's date. Send them to family or print them on paper, and anyone can see when each photo was taken.

GREAT FOR
• Printing photos from trips and events with the date on them
• Keeping the date on photos of your kids growing up
• Showing when a photo was taken before you send it to family or friends
• Adding a date stamp later to photos for albums and records

HOW TO USE
1. Tap "Select Photos" and choose your photos (up to 100 at once).
2. You'll see every photo with its date taken already on it. Tap a photo to zoom in and check the text and position.
3. Tap "Save to Photos" to save new copies with the date. You can also send them right away with "Share".

FEATURES
• The date is each photo's own date taken. Photos taken abroad or around midnight keep the date of the place where they were taken.
• If you corrected a photo's date and time in the Photos app, the corrected date is used (when you allow access to your photo library).
• Images with no recorded date taken never get today's date filled in. Use "Check date taken" to enter a date yourself or skip them.
• Change "Position", "Text size" or "Date format" once and it applies to all selected photos. Your settings are kept for next time.
• Text color and outline adjust automatically to each photo, so the date stays readable on bright skies and dark backgrounds.
• Under "Ratio", choose "Original", "3.5×5 in (L)" or "4×6 in". With a print ratio, you can check the area that will be kept, and the date is placed slightly inside it.
• Your original photos stay untouched. With "Original", copies are saved at the same pixel size as the original.
• Shared photos don't include location (GPS) data.
• Everything is processed on your device. Your photos are never sent anywhere.
• No ads and no in-app purchases.
• Lightweight: the app is about 3 MB and takes almost no space on your iPhone.

name: Dayguard: Schengen & Tax Days
description:
Dayguard counts your days abroad, so you always know where you stand.

SCHENGEN 90/180, DONE RIGHT
• Days used in the rolling 180-day window and days left today
• The exact last day you can stay, including your planned trips
• The next date you can enter again, and when all 90 days are back
• Arrival and departure days both count, a day in two countries counts once
• Up to date with the 29 Schengen countries (Bulgaria and Romania included; Cyprus and Ireland are not in Schengen)

TRIP PLANNER
Check a future trip before you book: Dayguard tells you if it fits, the day you would go over, and the earliest dates that work.

TAX RESIDENCY (183 DAYS)
• Days per country for your tax year: calendar year, UK (April 6), Australia (July 1) and more
• Choose how a day counts: any part of a day, or present at midnight (UK style)
• An alert before you reach 183 days, with the date you would reach it

SIMPLE AND RELIABLE
• You enter your stays: no guessing from photos or background location
• “I’m here today” in one tap, with an optional one-time location check
• Past, current and future trips, any year
• Reminders before you reach a limit
• Backup file you can keep in Files or iCloud Drive, and CSV export

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account. No ads. No analytics. Your data never leaves your iPhone.

FREE AND PRO
Free: Schengen tracking with up to 5 stays.
Dayguard Pro (monthly or yearly subscription): unlimited stays, tax residency, trip planner, reminders and CSV export. Prices are shown in the app before you enter any data.

Payment is charged to your Apple Account. The subscription renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://dravlogy.com/mobile/country-days/privacy

Dayguard is a tracking tool, not legal, immigration or tax advice. Rules differ by country and can change; border officers make the final decision.

name: De La Table
description:
De La Table is the pocket companion for restaurants that take their bookings with De La Table.

Open the app and you see tonight: who is coming, at what time, how many guests, and which tables are still free.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• See today's bookings, service by service
• Mark a guest as arrived with one tap
• Add a new table in four quick questions: how many, which day, what time, who
• Open a booking to call the guest, move it or cancel it
• See allergies and notes before the guest sits down
• Look up a guest in your guest book
• Keep an eye on the waitlist, the floor plan and your opening hours
• Get a notification for every new booking and cancellation
• Lock the app with Face ID so only your team sees your guests

WHO IT IS FOR
Restaurant owners, managers and hosts who already have a De La Table account. Accounts are created on delatable.com. The app is free and has no in-app purchases.

Questions? Write to us from the app (Everything else > Contact support) or at delatable.com/contact.

name: DiceRally
description:
# Dice Rally – Roll, Score, Win!

Roll the dice, build your score, and challenge your friends in Dice Rally! This fun and addictive five-dice game combines classic dice gameplay with exciting scoring options and local multiplayer competition.

Whether you're playing solo or competing against friends and family, every roll brings a new opportunity to score big!

### FEATURES

**Classic Five-Dice Gameplay**
Roll five dice, create winning combinations, and make strategic decisions to maximize your score. Easy to learn, but challenging to master!

**Two Ways to Play**
Choose Classic Mode for familiar five-dice scoring or Advanced Mode for additional scoring possibilities and a fresh challenge.

**Local Multiplayer**
Challenge up to 3 friends in nearby multiplayer matches! Compete with 2–4 players and see who can finish with the highest score.

**Solo Play**
Want to practice your strategy or beat your personal best? Enjoy Dice Rally on your own whenever you want.

**Designed for iPhone and iPad**
Enjoy a clean, intuitive interface designed to make rolling dice, selecting scores, and following the action simple and enjoyable.

### READY TO RALLY?

Every roll counts, every decision matters, and one great combination can change the game!

Download Dice Rally and see who can roll their way to victory!

name: Dieta Plus: Glykomenu
description:
Eating well with diabetes shouldn't mean counting everything on paper. Dieta Plus builds your meal plan for the whole week – keeping calories, protein, carbs and glycemic load in check – and then writes your shopping list.

A MEAL PLAN THAT FITS YOU
• Enter your age, weight, height, activity and goal (maintain, lose or gain weight)
• Takes type 1 and type 2 diabetes, prediabetes and your medications into account
• Four diet types: standard, meat-based (lunch and dinner always with meat or fish), vegetarian and vegan
• Calculates your needs (BMR, TDEE) and daily macro targets
• 5–6 meals a day at regular times; swap any dish with a long press

MADE FOR DIABETES
• Carbohydrate exchanges and protein-fat exchanges for every meal
• Glycemic index and glycemic load of each dish
• Keeps added sugars and fiber in check

373 RECIPES FROM 20 CUISINES
• Mediterranean, Italian, Greek, Spanish, Asian, Mexican, Middle Eastern, Polish and more
• 209 recipes with a Thermomix® version
• Breakfasts, lunches, dinners and snacks – vegetarian and dairy-free too
• Combinable filters: meal, dish type (meat & fish, vegetarian, vegan), cuisine and Thermomix®
• Save favorites with one tap

SHOPPING LIST WITH PRICES
• Every ingredient for 7 days, grouped by store aisle
• Estimated cost (US, UK, Germany, Italy, Spain, Poland)

YOUR PREFERENCES
• Exclude foods you don't eat – the planner skips them
• Dairy swaps (soy drink, soy yogurt)

CALORIE TABLE
• Nutrition facts and GI of common foods
• 200+ foods in a built-in database – works without internet

PRIVACY
• No account, no ads, no internet needed
• Your health data stays on your iPhone only

IMPORTANT: Dieta Plus is for educational purposes and is not a medical device. Nutrition values are estimates. Discuss any diet changes – especially with insulin or glucose-lowering medication – with your doctor or dietitian.

Available in English, Polish, German, Italian and Spanish.

name: DIMINSOAP
description:
When it comes to the formula, there are many details and it's easy to forget them.

This tool does one thing very simply: it calculates what needs to be calculated and records what needs to be recorded. Ratios, progress, materials, costs - all in one place, and they match up perfectly.

It doesn't push you or make decisions for you. You do it according to your own habits, and it is responsible for ensuring the consistency of the numbers and the continuous recording.

name: Dix FM
description:
Dix FM es tu radio en vivo, ahora en una app hecha para escucharla como se merece.

Abre la app, toca reproducir y listo. La música sigue sonando con la pantalla bloqueada o mientras usas otras apps.

LO QUE SUENA, SIEMPRE A LA VISTA
• Título, artista y carátula de la canción en directo.
• Historial con las últimas canciones que han sonado.

GUARDA LO QUE TE GUSTA
• Marca tus canciones favoritas con un toque.
• Ábrelas después en Apple Music.

ESCUCHA A TU MANERA
• Controles en la pantalla de bloqueo, los auriculares y el coche.
• AirPlay para enviar la radio a tus altavoces o a la tele.
• Widgets para la pantalla de inicio y la de bloqueo.
• Temporizador de apagado para dormirte con la radio.
• Diseño vertical y horizontal, en iPhone y iPad.

SIEMPRE EN DIRECTO
• Si se corta la señal, la app se reconecta sola.
• Al volver de una pausa, suena lo que está al aire en ese momento.

Comparte lo que estás escuchando con tus amigos y lleva Dix FM siempre contigo.

name: DoodleWhisper: AI Storybooks
description:
A scribble and a few spoken ideas become an illustrated storybook page, written in two languages. DoodleWhisper is made for a grown-up and a child to create side by side.

HOW IT WORKS
• Draw together on a big sheet of paper with nine crayons. Fingers and Apple Pencil both work.
• Type the idea, or tap Record voice and a grown-up says it aloud. The recording stays on your device until you ask for a page.
• Tap Generate page. AI looks at the drawing and your ideas, writes the words in both languages and paints a picture-book illustration.
• Flip between My drawing and Picture to see where the page came from.
• Draw on top of the picture and generate it again. Earlier versions are kept, and any page can be reported to us.

ONE STORY, TWO LANGUAGES
Every page keeps its words in two languages side by side: English and Russian by default, or choose Spanish, French, German, Italian or Portuguese. Read in one language, the other, or both, and edit any word yourself.

CHARACTERS WHO RETURN
Give recurring characters a name and a few details. Those details guide the following pages, so the little duck keeps the blue scarf.

READ AND KEEP
• A reading mode you swipe through together.
• Save the whole book as a PDF and share it with family.
• Save a backup file and restore it later.
• Check a square 8.5 × 8.5 in print layout. Ordering printed books is not available in the app yet.

BUILT FOR PARENTS
• An adult starts every AI action and gives permission before anything is sent.
• Your book is saved on your device. The drawing, your notes and your recording go to our AI provider, OpenAI, only when you tap Generate page.
• No account needed: AI works after a grown-up gives permission. An optional adult account adds a private cloud backup and can be deleted in the app at any time.
• For now AI is for the grown-up's own words: please leave out a child's name, photo and voice.
• No ads. No in-app purchases.

AI can make mistakes. Read each page before you share it.

name: Double Scoop: Couple Games
description:
Little games. Real dates. The app for couples.

Double Scoop is made for two: answer one little question and play one quick couple game together every day, then pick one real date a week by secret vote.

HOW IT WORKS

• A Scoop of the day. One question for both of you, every day. Your answers stay secret until you both play.

• A Game of the day. This or That, Guess my answer, Who's more likely, Would you rather: a couples quiz to see where you match and find your double scoops.

• Grow your cone. Every day you both answer, your cone grows. Miss a day and it starts to melt. A Refreeze can save it.

• One real date a week. Every Monday, vote yes, maybe or no on 5 date night ideas in secret. When you both like one, it's a date, with a little kit to make it special. Rate it together afterward.

• Keep your memories. Your games, dates and ratings end up in one shared timeline, with your photos.

• Never miss the big days. Add birthdays and anniversaries and get a reminder before they come.

Just started dating, living together, married or long distance: a few fun minutes a day and one real date a week keep you two playing together.

FREE TO PLAY

490+ cards and date ideas, free forever: 340+ game cards in 3 starter packs, 150 date ideas and all your memories.

DOUBLE SCOOP PREMIUM

1,260+ cards and ideas, 2.5× more. One subscription covers both of you.
• 890+ game cards in 14 packs, plus unlimited bonus rounds
• 220+ trips, weekends and movies: Vacation match, Weekend plan and Movie night
• Unlimited Date Match rounds and re-rolls
• Monthly recaps and Our Year Wrapped
• 3 Refreezes a month

Try Premium free for 7 days.

Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm your purchase. Your subscription renews automatically unless you turn off auto-renew at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account is charged for the renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription in your App Store account settings. Any unused part of a free trial ends when you buy a subscription.

Terms of Use: https://doublescoop.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://doublescoop.app/privacy

name: Drama Lens Lens
description:
Drama Lens is your private short-drama companion for overseas viewers.
Browse authentic-style drama posters, read episode-by-episode breakdowns, and write personal thoughts after every episode. This app is a reference library and journal — not a video player.
WHAT YOU GET
• Discover trending vertical short dramas across romance, revenge, mafia, fantasy, werewolf, family, and more
• Episode Recap, Key Twists & Clues, and Character Highlights for each episode
• Spoiler toggle so you control what you read
• Private journal with star ratings, tags, and long-form notes
• Want To Watch / Watched / Favorites lists stored on your device
WHAT WE NEVER DO
• No video playback, streaming, or watch links
• No ads and no in-app purchases
• No account login and no cloud sync
• No sharing, social feeds, comments, or chat
Slogan: Read the Drama, Write Your Thoughts
Poster images are for reference and introduction only and are not media playback resources. All notes stay on your device via local storage. Uninstalling the app clears your journal and lists.

name: DreamJar: Dream Journal
description:
Dreams slip away within minutes of waking. DreamJar helps you keep them.

SPEAK IT OR TYPE IT
Tap the moon and describe your dream out loud, and watch the words appear as you speak. Pause, fix a word, keep going. Prefer to write? Switch to typing at any time and your words come with you. Works in many languages.

A GENTLE READING
Each dream gets a short, kind reading: what it might be touching in your life, the symbols that stood out, and one small thing to try. Never a diagnosis, never a prediction. Just a quiet mirror.

A PICTURE OF YOUR NIGHT
DreamJar paints your dream as a soft illustration. Share it as a card, or keep it in your journal.

SEE YOUR PATTERNS
Themes that return, a calendar of your dreams, and search across everything you have kept.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account. No ads. No tracking. Your dreams stay on your device, with optional backup to your own private iCloud. Lock the journal with Face ID. You choose whether a dream is sent to cloud AI for its reading and picture, and you can turn that off at any time.

Privacy Policy: https://privacy.ulme.cn/echomind/en/

DreamJar offers gentle reflections for personal insight. It is not medical advice or a substitute for professional care.

name: DreamMatic: Dream Interpreter
description:
Capture the dreams you remember and explore what they may mean. Write each dream in your own words, notice its symbols, feelings, and themes, and use a thoughtful interpretation as a starting point for reflection. Keep your entries together in a dream journal and revisit past dreams to notice recurring themes over time. Dreams are personal experiences; interpretations are reflective prompts, not predictions or medical advice.

AI interpretations are created on the device on iPhones that support Apple Intelligence; your dream never leaves your phone. On other iPhones you get a free reading based on the dream dictionary, plus reflection questions.

DreamMatic Premium is an auto-renewing subscription (monthly or yearly). Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in Settings > Apple ID > Subscriptions.

Terms of Use: https://dreammatic-app.web.app/terms.html
Privacy Policy: https://dreammatic-app.web.app/privacy.html

name: Duo Doctor: Fold Counter
description:
Duo Doctor counts every time you unfold your Duo, and shows it in a beautiful widget that matches your Home Screen.

A lab robot has folded a Duo more than 451,000 times. How many have you done? Duo Doctor tells you today's opens, your lifetime total, and how long your Duo would take to reach the lab's number at your pace.

COUNTS ALL DAY
Duo Doctor counts every open while it's on screen, right away. To count all day, set up one Shortcuts automation in two guided steps, and Duo Doctor counts each open and close, even when the app is closed and your phone is locked. Add the opens you made before installing, or let the app estimate them from the day your Duo arrived.

WIDGETS THAT MATCH YOUR HOME SCREEN
Small, medium and large Home Screen widgets, plus Lock Screen widgets. Pick one of 14 themes: Paper, Midnight, Minimal, Glass, Titanium, Graphite, Sunrise, Mint, Mono, plus five retro themes (Aqua Gel, Neon Grid, Pocket LCD, Hologram and Boot Terminal). Or make your own: background, a colour taken from any photo (like your wallpaper), accent colour, number style and layout. Widgets also look right in tinted and clear Home Screen modes. The Ultra widget packs today's opens, battery, heat and more into one customizable tile.

PHONE HEALTH
See what unfolding really costs your battery each hour, your charging habits (charge cycles, time sitting at 100%), when your Duo runs warm and why, free storage and time in Low Power Mode. Watch the live hinge angle on a big dial that matches your theme, and celebrate fold milestones along the way.

DUO CARE REPORT
If your Duo ever needs a repair, make a printable PDF that shows how you've looked after it: opens, time unfolded, heat and charging history, and exactly how each number was recorded. Made on your phone, shared only by you. Duo Doctor is not affiliated with Apple; the report simply states the facts.

MADE FOR THE BIG SCREEN
Folded, Duo Doctor is one clean column. Unfolded, it uses both halves.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. Nothing leaves your phone.

DUO DOCTOR FULL
The counter, the lab comparison, the small widget, a Lock Screen widget and two themes (Paper and Midnight) are free. A one-time $2.99 purchase unlocks every theme (including the five retro themes) and the theme editor, the Ultra widget and every other widget, 7-day phone health history (battery cost of unfolding, charging habits, heat watch) and the Duo Care Report. No subscription.

Counting while the app is closed needs iOS 27.2 or later.

name: Durak: Location Reminder
description:
Walked right past the pharmacy and forgot the prescription? Durak ties reminders to places instead of times. Pick a place, write what to do, and Durak lets you know when you get there, even when the app is closed.

WHAT YOU CAN DO

• A specific place: Pick a spot on the map or search for it by name. Get notified when you arrive.
• Any pharmacy, store or ATM: No exact place needed. Choose a category and get reminded near any pharmacy, grocery store, supermarket, gas station, ATM, bank, hospital, restaurant, café, shopping mall, gym, mosque, school or airport.
• You set the radius: From 100 meters to 1 kilometer, choose how close you get before the alert.
• Notification or alarm: A quiet notification, or a loud, time-sensitive alarm notification for things you can't miss. Tap it to open a full-screen alarm that rings until you stop it.
• One-time reminders: They delete themselves after ringing once, so your list stays tidy.
• Pause with one tap: Turn any reminder off without deleting it.
• Light and dark theme, Turkish and English interface.

PRIVACY FIRST

Durak has no server. No account, no ads, no tracking. Your reminders are stored only on your phone, and Durak keeps no location history. When you search for a place, only the text you type is sent to Google Places; if you have an active category reminder, your current location is sent to find nearby places. Durak doesn't store them anywhere.

Location checks are handled by your iPhone's built-in region monitoring. Durak doesn't keep polling your location, so it won't drain your battery.

HOW IT WORKS

1. Tap "Add Reminder".
2. Pick a place on the map or choose a category.
3. Write what to remember, then set the radius and alert type.

Durak takes care of the rest.

name: Econo Camera
description: Econo Camera lets you take pictures, do video recordings, and panoramic shots at 60p, 120p, 240p, 480p or 720p,  without wasting valuable disk space. You can also save your files to a repository for future use. A built-in MP4 and MP3 converter lets you convert and save your files in one step, and an audio-to-text feature turns spoken audio into text for note taking. It's all in one app, and it's 100% ad-free.

name: EdT365 Music Theory & Ear
description:
EdT365 Music Theory & Ear helps beginners understand the basics of music and train their ear: read notes on the staff, recognize intervals and chords by ear, and tap rhythms in time. Designed by Edtech365 in Vietnam, with no ads and no account, and it works fully offline. The interface is in English and Vietnamese, with Do-Re-Mi or C-D-E note names.

23 LESSONS IN 5 CHAPTERS
- Pitch and the staff: note names, treble and bass clefs, the grand staff, the keyboard, tones and semitones, sharps, flats, naturals and enharmonics.
- Rhythm and meter: whole to sixteenth notes, rests, dots and ties, 2/4, 3/4, 4/4 and 6/8 time.
- Intervals: numbers, perfect, major, minor, augmented and diminished intervals, inversions.
- Scales and keys: major, natural, harmonic and melodic minor, key signatures, the circle of fifths, relative keys.
- Chords: major, minor, augmented and diminished triads, inversions, seventh chords, chord symbols (C, Am, G7), common progressions, modulation and transposition.
Every lesson has a staff and keyboard you can tap to hear, plus a quick check.

9 ADAPTIVE DRILLS
- Read Notes: treble and bass clef, ledger lines and accidentals, against the clock.
- Find the Key: see a note name, tap its key.
- Intervals, Chords and Scales by ear: from major and minor to seventh chords and inversions.
- Higher or Lower: compare pitches and follow the shape of a melody.
- Melody Dictation: hear 3 to 5 notes and play them back.
- Rhythm Tapping: tap the written rhythm and see how many milliseconds early or late each note was, with latency calibration for Bluetooth headphones.
- Key Signatures: name the major or minor key.
Each drill has 5 levels: do well to move up, or step back to build confidence.

A PIANO IN YOUR POCKET
- A 5-octave keyboard with multi-touch and glissando.
- See what you play on the grand staff, with the chord name (C, Am, G7, Cmaj7 and more).
- Highlight any scale on the keys. Piano, guitar or organ sound.

TRACK YOUR PROGRESS
- A daily goal, day streak, weekly chart, and the level and accuracy of every skill.

ACCURATE AND COMFORTABLE
- Every interval, scale, key signature and chord spelling is computed and automatically tested for all roots, including enharmonic ones.
- A Vietnamese-English glossary of music terms.
- Sound plays even when your iPhone is in silent mode.
- Light, dark or automatic appearance and a layout made for iPad.

No data collected. No ads. No in-app purchases. Your progress stays on your device.

With EdT365, you'll never learn & grow alone!

name: EinbürgerungPro · 310 BAMF
description:
Pass the German naturalization test (Einbürgerungstest / Leben in Deutschland) with confidence. Practice all 310 official BAMF questions with instant native-language translation in 30 languages.

KEY FEATURES:
• Complete 310-question catalog (300 general + 10 for your German federal state)
• One-tap translation into 30 languages alongside the original German text
• Realistic Exam Simulator: 33 questions in 60 minutes (17/33 required to pass)
• Smart Priority Mode & Mistakes Review to focus on weak areas
• Visual progress tracking & exam history
• Works 100% offline

SUPPORTED LANGUAGES (30):
Deutsch, English, Русский, Українська, Türkçe, العربية, فارسی, Polski, Română, Italiano, Español, Français, Português, Ελληνικά, Hrvatski, Српски, Bosanski, Shqip, Български, Magyar, Čeština, Slovenčina, Nederlands, Tiếng Việt, हिन्दी, اردو, پښتو, Soomaali, Tigrinya, 한국어.

DISCLAIMER (UNOFFICIAL APP):
This is an independent, unofficial study app and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the German government or BAMF. Source of public questions: BAMF (bamf.de).

name: Eizenshtot Zmanim
description:
The official app of Beis Medrash Kahal Pnei Meiros – Eizenshtot, 5717 12th Avenue, Boro Park.

The same zmanim board that hangs in the shul – now on your iPhone, always up to date:

• Davening times – Shacharis, Mincha & Maariv minyanim, Shabbos and Yom Tov schedules, updated live by the gabbaim.
• Daily zmanim – Alos, Netz, Sof Zman Krias Shema and Tefillah (Magen Avraham and Gra), Chatzos, Mincha Gedolah, Plag, Shkiah, Tzeis and Rabbeinu Tam – calculated for Boro Park 11219, matching the shul board.
• Shabbos – candle lighting and Motzei Shabbos from the Tomche Shabbos calendar, the parsha and Shabbos schedule.
• Zmanim reminders – pick any zman (e.g. Sof Zman Krias Shema, candle lighting, shkiah) and get a notification 5–60 minutes before. Reminders are calculated on your phone, work without internet, and are automatically silenced over Shabbos.
• Works offline – today's zmanim and the last copy of the board are saved on your phone.
• Home-screen and Lock Screen widget – the next zman at a glance.
• Hebrew date, Daf Yomi, weekly shiurim, announcements, Mazel Tovs and dedications – just like the screen in shul.

No account, no ads, no tracking.

name: Elevated COMMAND
description:
COMMAND is the internal app for the Elevated Integration team. It is for our employees and contractors; accounts are set up by Elevated Integration.

- Clock in and out, and switch between on site, driving, parts runs and the office.

name: EQCalc
description:
EQCalc is a high-speed Monte Carlo equity calculator for Texas Hold'em, built for players who want fast, reliable numbers—from quick heads-up checks to complex 5-way spots with weighted ranges.

name: Evolve: Habits & Focus
description:
Make room for what matters.

Evolve brings your habits, focus sessions and personal goals into one calm space. Choose a small action, find a rhythm that suits you, and notice what you do. Every feature is free. No account, ads or subscription.

HABITS THAT FIT YOUR LIFE
Read, walk, learn or take a little time for yourself. Set a target in minutes, steps, pages, lessons or other units. Choose specific days or a flexible number of sessions per week.

TRACK PROGRESS YOUR WAY

HISTORY, GOALS AND RITUALS

name: Executive Edge Studio
description:
Executive Edge Studio teaches structured problem solving by having you do it. Work down one page from a messy problem to a recommendation a senior leader can act on, then export it as a document and a slide deck.

WHO IT'S FOR
Managers, analysts, consultants, team leads and students who need to recommend something to decision-makers: a proposal, a business case, a project update or a case interview.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Frame the problem with SCQ. Write the Situation, the Complication and the Question, with built-in checks (no problem in the Situation, no solution in the Complication, a Question that mirrors the Complication).
2. Build a hypothesis tree. State a core hypothesis, then test it through six lenses: Impact, Cost, Time, Risk / Feasibility, 3rd-party approval and any other dealbreaker. Each sub-hypothesis gets the data you will use to verify it, plus an optional rival hypothesis and a prioritised workplan.
3. Write the executive summary in Pyramid order: Question, Recommendation, three reasons, quantified impact and the ask, plus a 30-second "say this" script.
4. Write the slide storyline. Six slides, each with a full-sentence action title and the bullets that prove it. A live preview shows whether the titles alone tell the story.
5. Export. Word (.doc), PDF document, PowerPoint (.pptx, 6 widescreen slides, your script in the speaker notes) or landscape PDF slides. In the app, exports open the iOS Share sheet so you can save to Files or send to Mail, PowerPoint or Word.

LEARN AS YOU GO
Four short Learn cards explain SCQ, hypothesis trees, the Pyramid principle and action titles, each with a small example. Tap "Load worked example" to see a complete case (a fictional resort booking problem) filled in, then tap "Clear all" and start your own.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no sign-in, no ads, no tracking and no in-app purchases. Your work is saved automatically on your device only and is never uploaded. "Copy executive summary text" puts the summary on your clipboard for email or speaker notes.

Made in Singapore by Eugene Seow, a former teacher. The worked examples are fictional teaching cases.

name: Falah: Prayer Times & Azan
description:
Falah is a free prayer app from AlQuranClasses™, the online Quran school teaching families since 2010. Every feature is free for everyone: no ads, no account, no subscription and nothing locked.

PRAYER TIMES YOU CAN TRUST
• Accurate Fajr, Sunrise, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib and Isha times for your city, with a live countdown to the next prayer
• The calculation method used by your country is set for you (ISNA, Muslim World League, Umm al-Qura, Karachi, Egyptian, Diyanet and more), or choose your own

THE AZAN IN OUR TEACHERS' VOICES

QIBLA, TASBIH AND MORE
• Qibla compass pointing to the Kaaba, with the distance to Makkah

• Share today's prayer times with family in one tap
• Search over 249 cities, or use your location

YOUR PRIVACY
Falah does not collect any data. There is no account and no tracking. Your location is used on your phone to work out prayer times and the Qibla, and is never sent anywhere.

PAY IT FORWARD
Falah is our gift to the Ummah. If it helps you pray on time, you can pass the gift on: sponsor Quran classes for a student whose family cannot afford them, or gift classes to someone you love. name: Fernhum Pets: Calming Sounds
description:
Calming sound for the moments your dog or cat finds hard.

Fireworks, thunder, an empty house, a long drive. Fernhum Pets plays slow, gentle music made for dogs and for cats, with soft backgrounds and extra masking noise when it's loud outside. Pick the moment, press play, and keep the volume low.

SOUND FOR THE MOMENT
• Fireworks & Storms: deep, steady sound that softens bangs and rumbles.
• Home Alone: calm music for the hours you're away, up to 8 hours.
• Settle for Sleep: a quiet wind-down for bedtime.

MUSIC FOR DOGS AND CATS
Dogs get slow piano in a low register. Cats get higher, gentle music with a live purr. Choose a background like rain or a fire, and set the mix yourself.

SOUND TRAINING
Help your pet get used to fireworks, thunder and the doorbell, a little at a time. Each sound has ten gentle levels. After every five-minute session, tell the app how your pet reacted: relaxed, a bit unsure, or stressed. The level moves up, stays, or steps back. Training never starts on its own, pauses when you leave the app, and has a "my pet is stressed, stop" button on screen the whole time.

EVERY PET IN YOUR HOME
Add a profile for each dog and cat. Each pet keeps its own training levels and history.

NO ACCOUNT NEEDED
Everything stays on your phone. Works offline.

Fernhum Pets is a paid app. Choose a yearly subscription with a 7-day free trial for new subscribers, a monthly subscription, or pay once for lifetime. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel in your Apple Account settings.

Fernhum Pets is for comfort and routine. It is not veterinary advice. If your pet shows strong or lasting fear, talk to your vet.

name: Find IT: Drawer organizer

name: Fretgrain: Guitar Voicing Pad
