name: GardenRegister
description:
Garden Register is a pocket companion to the historic parks and gardens of the British Isles, made for the moment you stand in one and ask who designed it. The records follow the shape of the national archive: a first layout date, the phases that followed, the features that survive on the ground, and the terms on which the place can be visited at all.

Each garden is introduced by a drawn plate rather than a photograph, so the register reads as one continuous archive. Open a record and you can follow its history in layers, see what remains of the terraces, rills and avenues, and read the planting season by season — including the question that matters in January, why a particular corner still holds colour.

The on site view sets the historic plan beside the garden as it is today and marks the main axis, so you can see where a line used to lead and what now closes it. Mark the gardens you mean to see, record what was in flower when you got there, and the year page turns those notes into a picture of your own gardening year.

Records are drawn from the Parks & Gardens UK archive. Many of these gardens are private or open on only a few days: the register states the access terms before you travel, and asks you to respect the ground that is closed.

name: Gastro Srdcom
description:
Gastro Srdcom nahradí zošit s uzávierkou, papierovú smenovku a skupinu na WhatsAppe. Appka vznikla v skutočnom bistre a je pre reštaurácie, bistrá, pizzerie, kaviarne a bary.

DENNÁ UZÁVIERKA
Tržba z eKasy, výdavky a výplaty z kasy, počítadlo bankoviek a 8 krížových kontrol. Appka ukáže, kde je chyba, a odoslanie potvrdí človek svojím PIN-om. PDF uzávierky a história každej opravy.

SKLAD A FOOD COST
Receptúry, food cost a marža pri každom jedle, inventúra naslepo, príjemky, dátumy spotreby a odpad s fotkou. Návrh objednávky podľa spotreby a upozornenie, keď surovina klesne pod minimum.

SMENY, DOCHÁDZKA A MZDY
Rozpis smien zo šablón, výmeny smien v appke, kontrola Zákonníka práce, príchod a odchod v mobile, na tablete aj na Apple Watch. Dovolenky, prepitné podľa vášho pravidla a mzdy z odpracovaných dní.

ČIARKOVANIE A DENNÉ MENU
Ťuk pri každom pripravenom kuse aj bez internetu. Obedové menu napíšete raz a appka z neho spraví tabuľu do okna, stojanček, obrazovku v prevádzke aj e-mail pre firmy.

HOSTIA
Rezervácie stolov, objednávka zo stola cez QR kód, kuchynský displej, vernostné pečiatky a catering.

TÍM A UPOZORNENIA
Chat a oznamy tímu, kontrolné zoznamy a upozornenia na nové smeny, výmeny, neodoslanú uzávierku či surovinu pod minimom. Každý vidí len to, čo potrebuje: majiteľ, manažér, zamestnanec aj účtovník.

APPLE WATCH
Príchod a odchod jedným ťuknutím na zápästí a dnešná smena.

BEZPEČNE
Údaje sú na serveri na Slovensku so šifrovanými zálohami každú noc. Prihlásenie heslom, cez Face ID alebo dvojstupňovým overením. Účet zmažete priamo v appke.

Appka je pre podniky, ktoré používajú Gastro Srdcom. Účet podniku sa zakladá na gastrosrdcom.sk.

name: Gaymocracy
description:
Gaymocracy is a safe space for LGBTQ+ adults and allies: a small city of our own, run on respect, where everyone is a citizen and nobody has to hide.

A PLACE TO BELONG
Become a citizen: choose your look, fill in your passport with your pronouns and a motto, and take the pledge in the Citizens' Hall. The community charter is simple: respect, privacy, no hate.

YOUR COMMUNITY
Say hello in the Central Square, take a table with friends at the Café, wave, dance and see who is around. Add friends and write to them in private.

GATHER TOGETHER
Quiz nights, talks, open circles and parties, hosted in the city. Say you are going, and join when it starts.

OUR HISTORY, OUR CULTURE
Walk through the Museum, from Stonewall to today. Read the news from LGBTQ+ publications around the world at the Café. Ask the Unicorn, the city's AI, about our history, rights and culture, or for a joke.

SAFE BY DESIGN
• Adults only: 18 and over.
• No real name needed. Your email is never shown to anyone.
• Mute, block or report anyone. A moderator looks at every report.
• Slurs are not sent.
• Notifications are discreet: they never say who wrote or what.

Gaymocracy is run by Calenzy Pte. Ltd. Community charter and privacy page: city.gaymocracy.com

name: GhostHawk
description:
Take the controls of a fighter jet and blast your way through hostile skies in Ghost Hawk: Under the Radar, a fast arcade shooter built for quick sessions and big explosions.

Dodge enemy fire, shoot down everything in your path and keep your fuel tank topped up. The further you fly, the tougher it gets, and every stage ends with a massive boss fight.

EPIC BOSS BATTLES
Face six unique bosses, each with its own attack patterns and weak spots: a Destroyer, a Heavy Bomber, a fortified Dam, a Submarine, a Gunship and a Sky Carrier. Knock out their guns first, then strike when the core is exposed.

UNLOCK DEVASTATING WEAPONS
Grab weapon crates to upgrade your firepower step by step:
• Twin Cannon and Spread Guns
• Homing Rockets
• Wingmen who fly and fight at your side
• Heavy Rounds
• Pulse Laser
• And even faster guns beyond that

STAY UNDER THE RADAR
Radar sites lock on and launch SAM missiles. Drop flares at the right moment to shake them off, or fire your own missiles to clear the way.

ENEMIES THAT KEEP COMING
Interceptor jets, flak guns, armored helicopters, missile boats, kamikaze drones and jet formations join the fight as you push deeper.

POWER-UPS
Collect fuel, health, missiles and flares to stay in the air, and grab stars for extra points.

THREE DIFFICULTY MODES
• EASY: a gentler start with slower missiles and fewer radars
• NORMAL: the classic challenge
• HARD: fly low through the canyon and refuel from barges, with radars everywhere

Each mode keeps its own best score. How far can you fly?

FEATURES
• Simple one-thumb movement with on-screen fire, missile and flare buttons
• Short, replayable runs that are easy to pick up
• Colorful low-poly graphics
• Energetic soundtrack, with music and sound effects you can adjust or turn off
• Play offline, no account needed

name: GlowUp Looksmax Jawline Mewing
description:
Looksmaxxing for men without the gimmicks: jawline exercises, mewing and face workouts, shown move by move by an animated statue and guided by a voice coach. About 10 minutes a day, no equipment.

No face scans. No AI ratings. Just a clear routine and your progress, day after day.

JAWLINE, MEWING AND FACE EXERCISES
• Jawline exercises and jaw muscle training
• Mewing and tongue posture practice
• Neck and under-chin routines
• Face yoga for cheeks, nose and eyes
• Face massage
Every move is demonstrated by the statue with clear arrows, and the voice coach reads each step and guides you through holds and rests.

FACE MECHANICS
Technical routines for how your face works: tongue posture, lip seal and nasal breathing, jaw (TMJ and masseter) control, facial symmetry, the angle between your neck and jaw, and expression control.

GROOMING AND HABITS
Skincare, hair and beard, sleep, voice, confidence and breathing routines, plus simple daily habits you can check off.

YOUR 30-DAY GLOW UP PLAN
Pick the area you want to work on, your training days and how many minutes you have. GlowUp builds a 30-day plan in four phases: Adapt, Build, Intensity and Peak. Reminders come only on the days you choose.

RANK, AURA AND THE MONTHLY LEAGUE
• Earn aura with every finished workout and climb the ranks
• Keep your daily streak going
• Join the monthly league with a display name and see where you stand
• A monthly tongue posture check to see how far you have come

BUILT ON SCIENTIFIC SOURCES
Moves are linked to the published study behind them, and you can open each source right in the app.

116 MOVES, 24 PROGRAMS, 18 LANGUAGES
Voice guidance is available in all 18 languages.

FREE AND PRO
Start free: your daily workouts are free for the first 7 days, and the free moves stay open after that. GlowUp PRO unlocks all 116 moves, 24 programs, Face Mechanics and every 30-day plan.

GlowUp PRO is an auto-renewable subscription, offered monthly or yearly, with a 3-day free trial on the yearly plan for eligible new subscribers. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it anytime in your Apple Account settings.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1KUy1_bNYa01xk60ZgZB2ESCMNWm0OKLfjB24Y8DW9wM/edit?usp=sharing

Results vary from person to person and depend on regular practice. GlowUp trains muscles, posture and habits; it does not change bone structure and is not a medical service.

name: GNSS Atlas
description:
Explore the GPS/GNSS accuracy reported by aircraft around the world. GNSS Atlas is an independent observatory combining interactive maps, published daily observations and transparent statistical analysis, with Arabic and English layouts for iPhone and iPad.

EXPLORE PUBLISHED OBSERVATIONS
• View source cells with their official color classifications, zoom the map and search for countries, cities or coordinates.
• Switch map styles and select published archive dates or aircraft altitude bands where available.
• Open area details to see the percentage of aircraft reporting reduced accuracy, observed and affected aircraft counts, and the indicator classification.

UNDERSTAND CHANGE OVER TIME
• Follow global trends and changes over 24 hours, 7 days, 30 days and 90 days when matching dates are available.
• Compare up to three countries from the supported watchlist, with charts and coverage statistics.
• Load seven sampled cell dates across 30 days, where compatible archives exist, and compare the latest value with the prior sampled mean.
• Review unusual increases and conditional statistical ranges, and share an explanatory report. These ranges are descriptive scenarios, not guaranteed or calibrated forecasts.

OPTIONAL MONITORING, FLEXIBLE DISPLAY
• Follow selected countries with local notifications evaluated when you open the app or refresh its published data.
• Choose dark or light appearance, Arabic right-to-left or English left-to-right layouts.
• No account or device location permission is required. An internet connection is needed for data, maps and place search.

COVERAGE AND UNCERTAINTY MATTER
Areas without published cells are No Data, not evidence of reliable GNSS. The source omits cells with fewer than three aircraft. Receiver coverage, traffic, equipment and sample size affect the estimates. Summed aircraft counts across cells are aircraft–cell observations, not a globally unique aircraft count.

Reduced GPS/GNSS accuracy does not prove jamming or spoofing, locate transmitters or identify responsible parties. Data is published daily, not measured live by this app. GNSS Atlas is for information and research, not navigation or aviation safety decisions. Consult NOTAM and official aviation sources.

Source: GPSInterference.com (https://gpsinterference.com/).
GNSS Atlas is independent and is not affiliated with or endorsed by GPSInterference.com. Original ADS-B data comes from adsb.lol under ODbL. Maps and imagery are supplied by Apple Maps, with attribution displayed on the map.

name: Golemoo
description:
Monsters are pouring out of the portal, and only Golo stands on the bridge!

Slide your finger and Golo follows. Choose the right spell: fire, water or wind. Every monster has one it fears and one that does nothing. Break rune rocks, grab powers from fruit walls, call your soldiers and shake the bridge.

• 100 levels across 10 regions, each with its own climate
• Three spells and fifteen skills: Lightning Orb, Meteor, Healing Water and more
• A Bridge Keeper every tenth level
• Fifteen outfits, each with its own power
• Daily rewards and quests
• Works offline, no ads

The game is free to play. Optional in-app purchases are available: gold packs, permanent packs and the Surprise Chest, which gives a randomized reward. The odds of every Surprise Chest reward are shown in the shop before purchase. The game can be played without purchases.

name: GOLLO SCORE SMART
description:
GOLLO SCORE SMART es el anotador de dominó pensado para clubes y campeonatos:

- Anotador mano a mano para 2, 3 o 4 jugadores, con números gigantes y límite hasta 250
- Dictado por voz: dicta los puntos y la app los anota
- Modo TV: muestra el marcador en la televisión con un código QR
- Celebración especial cuando un equipo gana 200 a 0
- Torneos completos: Suizo y Round-Robin, sorteo automático por ranking (los de arriba a la mesa 1), puntos por victoria y bono por chiva, hasta 80 jugadores, temporadas y vista de espectador
- Club con registro de jugadores por número de carnet, estadísticas y ranking
- Historial con exportación en PDF y compartir como imagen
- 4 idiomas: español, inglés, portugués y francés
- Funciona sin internet y sincroniza tus datos con tu cuenta

Primer mes gratis con todo desbloqueado. Después, Premium por $9.99/mes; el anotador básico sigue gratis.

name: GramCounter: Deli Slice Puzzle
description:
Step behind the deli counter. Swipe once to cut the smaller piece from a block of cheese, halva or brownie, then watch the scale reveal how close you came. Three customers order from the very same piece, so every cut changes your next move.

Play a fresh daily challenge, compare your lowest total error and share your receipt. In regular shifts an optional rewarded video lets you retry the final cut if an ad is available. The one-time Master Pack opens the cheesecake counter and includes the final retry without an ad. Play in English. Adult sessions may include home screen ads. The Master Pack removes all ads.

name: Grid Tintstorm Territory
description: ఒకే ఒక్క టైల్‌తో ప్రారంభించి, మొత్తం ప్రాంతం ఎలా మారుతుందో చూడండి. Grid Tintstorm Territoryలో 120 విభిన్న గ్రిడ్‌లలో చిన్న చిన్న రంగుల ఎంపికలు సంతృప్తికరమైన భూభాగ స్వాధీనాలుగా మారుతాయి. మీకు నచ్చిన ప్రారంభ స్థానాన్ని ఎంచుకోండి, పక్కనున్న రంగుల ద్వారా విస్తరించండి, ఊహించని ఖాళీలను దాటేందుకు తెలివైన మార్గాలను కనుగొనండి. అనుసంధానిత పోర్టల్‌లు దూర ప్రాంతాల్లో కొత్త అవకాశాలను తెరుస్తాయి, తాళాలు మూసివేసిన టైల్స్‌ను తెరుస్తాయి, మారుతున్న అలలు మీకు తెలిసిన వ్యూహాలను కూడా ఆసక్తికరంగా మారుస్తాయి. ఆశ్చర్యకరమైన షార్ట్‌కట్ కోసం మీ రిలేను దాచుకోండి, తప్పు దారిని వెనక్కి తీసుకోండి లేదా తక్కువ కదలికలతో మూడు నక్షత్రాలను సాధించడానికి ప్రయత్నించండి. ప్రతిరోజూ కొత్త డైలీ గ్రిడ్ మిమ్మల్ని మళ్లీ ఆడేందుకు ప్రేరేపిస్తుంది. ఆఫ్‌లైన్‌లో ఆడండి, మీ పురోగతిని భద్రపరచుకోండి, స్వేచ్ఛగా ప్రయోగాలు చేసుకునే అవకాశమున్న ప్రశాంతమైన పజిల్‌ను ఆస్వాదించండి.

name: Halal Scanner – Is It Halal?
description:
Is it halal? Scan the barcode and find out.

Halal Scanner checks packaged food for you. Point your camera at the barcode, type the number, or take a photo of the ingredient list. You get a clear answer and the reason behind it.

WHAT YOU SEE
• A simple result: nothing flagged, needs checking, or contains a flagged ingredient
• Why: each ingredient that matters, with a short explanation
• Where it came from: the product data source and date, and the version of our rules
• Your recent scans, saved on your phone

PHOTOGRAPH THE INGREDIENTS
No barcode, or a product we don't know yet? Take a photo of the ingredient list. We read the text and check every ingredient.

FOUND A MISTAKE?
Tap "Report a mistake". A person on our team reviews every report.

FREE, NO ACCOUNT
Unlimited scans. No sign-up, no ads.

PLEASE NOTE
Halal Scanner is not a halal certifier and gives no religious rulings. Results show what we found and where it came from. When in doubt, check the packet for a recognised certification and ask a scholar you trust.

Product data from Open Food Facts (ODbL).
Halal Scanner by AlQuranClasses™.

name: Hannim
description:
Learn Korean and pass TOPIK on one path — with Han, a teacher who plans your day.

Hannim takes you from the Korean alphabet to TOPIK level 6. Every explanation is written in English, Russian or Uzbek, so nothing gets lost in translation.

WHAT YOU GET
• A daily plan: today's lesson first, then reviews and practice sized to your minutes
• A full course from Hangul to level 6, step by step
• Real TOPIK-style reading and listening questions, with audio and a clear explanation for every answer
• Full mock papers for TOPIK I and TOPIK II — paper or IBT format, timed and scored like the real exam
• Writing questions 51–54 graded on the official criteria, with feedback on what to fix
• A predicted score and a countdown to your exam date
• 11,000 words and 500+ grammar patterns with hanja, collocations, look-alikes and real exam sentences
• Every mistake comes back in your reviews until it sticks
• Games for the words and grammar you're practising

FREE FOREVER
Hangul, all of level 1, the library, daily practice and the game room are free. No card needed.

HANNIM PRO
Levels 2–6 of the course, full mock papers and writing grading.
• Monthly — auto-renewing subscription, $7.99 per month
• Exam Pass · 3 months — $19.99, one-time, does not renew
• Exam Pass · 6 months — $34.99, one-time, does not renew
• Year Pass · 12 months — $59.99, one-time, does not renew
Prices are in USD and may differ by country.

The monthly subscription is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase and renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the period. You can manage or cancel the subscription in your App Store account settings after purchase.

Terms of Use: https://www.hannim.app/app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://www.hannim.app/app/privacy

name: Hanzala Cloud Tax
description:
Snap a receipt, pick a group and a category, done. Hanzala Cloud Tax files every receipt in a tidy iCloud Drive folder and builds a year-end report for your accountant.

• Document scanner with automatic edge cropping
• Reads the amount, date and store on the device, offline
• Groups and categories, with 70+ ready-made tax-friendly categories
• English folder names, ready to hand to your accountant
• Mileage log and yearly odometer
• PDF report, CSV tables and a ZIP of the whole year
• iPhone and iPad, synced through iCloud
• In English and Arabic

Completely free: unlimited receipts, groups and templates, reports and the mileage log. No ads, no subscription.

The app does not calculate tax or give tax advice; it keeps your receipts organised.

name: HariNuku: ハリネズミ飼育日記・保温チェック
description:
Note: the app is available in Japanese only.

HariNuku is a daily log for pet hedgehogs, built around the temperature of the cage.

- Record the cage temperature (and humidity) in one tap, starting from the last reading
- Urgent alert below 20 C (risk of hibernation attempt) and above 32 C (heat stroke); a caution outside your comfortable range (24-29 C by default)
- Warns when the cage got cold in the last 24 hours, even if it is fine now
- 7-day temperature chart with the comfortable band, and daily lows and highs
- Last night's log: food served and left, insects, wheel, droppings, wobbling, feeling cold, quilling
- Compares food eaten with the average of the previous 7 nights
- Weight trend with alerts for a 5% or 10% drop in a week
- Care schedule for nail trimming, bath, bedding, wheel cleaning and checkups
- Morning and evening reminders; any number of hedgehogs

Records and photos stay on your device. No account. All features are free (a banner ad is shown).

Alerts are guidelines, not a diagnosis. If your hedgehog feels cold, wobbles or stops eating, see an exotic-animal vet.

name: Hark: Listen Closer
description:
Hold up your phone and Hark tells you who's singing: birds, frogs, insects and mammals, live, as they call. Everything runs on the phone. It's free, with no subscription, no account and no ads.

ALL ON YOUR IPHONE
There's no server behind Hark. Two full-size AI models, Google DeepMind's Perch 2.0 and BirdNET+ 3.0, are built into the app and run on your iPhone's Neural Engine, the chip Apple makes for machine learning. Every second, Hark scores the last five seconds of sound against about fifteen thousand species with both models, in a fraction of a second. The species ranges and week-by-week seasons are in the app too. So it works just the same deep in a marsh with no signal or in Airplane Mode, and no recording ever leaves your phone. (The first launch after installing or updating takes a few extra seconds while iOS sets the models up for your phone's chip.)

LIVE
• A scrolling spectrogram and a list of what's calling right now, updated every second
• New species are logged as they're heard, with a clip of the call
• "New for you" when a species is a first

TWO MODELS AT ONCE
Google DeepMind's Perch 2.0 and the BirdNET team's BirdNET+ 3.0 listen together. An ID counts when they agree, or when one is very sure. In side-by-side tests that caught more calls than either model alone, with no more false alarms. Prefer one model? Pick it in Settings.

MISSED IT? TOUCH THE SPECTROGRAM
It pauses on the last minute of sound. Drag across a call and Hark identifies exactly that stretch, or tap to grab five seconds. Play it back, see its pitch and length, then log it. Prefer to choose every ID yourself? Manual mode only identifies what you pick out.

MORE THAN BIRDS
About fifteen thousand birds, frogs, toads, crickets, katydids, cicadas and mammals worldwide, plus everyday sounds like traffic, dogs and voices, so they don't get mistaken for wildlife. Switch any group off.

KNOWS WHERE AND WHEN
A Spring Peeper in November or a European bird in Wisconsin is flagged as unusual instead of logged, using the BirdNET geomodel's week-by-week ranges and records from GBIF. Add your own free eBird key and anything birders reported near you this month counts too. Species you've confirmed near a spot are never flagged there.

WALK MODE
Start listening, lock the phone and go. Hark keeps logging, shows on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island, and buzzes when something new turns up. It stops on its own after the time you set.

YOUR LOG
• A timeline of everything heard, with time, place, confidence and the clip
• Sessions, with your route on a map and when each species called
• A species list with your life list growing over time, time-of-day and seasonal charts
• Mark the ones you saw; search and filter by group
• Wrong ID? Swipe "Not it" and Hark drops it and ignores it for the rest of the walk (with Undo)
• Share a card of a find, with the place or without

ONE PRESS
Start listening from the Action Button, Control Center, a widget or Siri.

MAKE IT YOURS
Sensitive, Balanced or Strict, or fine-tune each group. Nine spectrogram color schemes, including an 8-bit one and an all-red one that saves your night vision on an owl prowl. Choose how many seconds the spectrogram shows, its contrast, your microphone and a rumble filter for wind and road noise.

PRIVATE
Audio is identified on the phone and never uploaded. No account, no analytics, no tracking. Your log stays on your phone.

Sound ID can be wrong, especially with distant, quiet or overlapping calls. Treat an ID as a suggestion, and confirm anything important by sight or with an expert.

name: Harubox: All-Day Recorder
description:
Tap record once and Harubox keeps recording with the screen off or while you use other apps. Meetings, lectures, calls, or a whole workday. When you stop, it transcribes on your iPhone.

ALL-DAY RECORDING
- No time limit. An overnight recording of more than 8 hours ran without a break on a real iPhone.
- If a call or an alarm interrupts, recording picks up again by itself afterward, and the gap is marked in the log.
- Add bookmarks and notes while you record.
- 9 hours of audio is about 130 MB. If storage runs low, the recording is saved and stops.

TRANSCRIPTION AND SPEAKERS
- Transcription runs on your iPhone: right after recording, or only while charging.
- Shows who said what. Rename speakers, merge them, edit sentence by sentence.
- Search across all recordings, tap a result to play from that spot, and fix the text as you listen.
- Find and replace fixes a misheard name everywhere at once.

SUMMARIES AND TO-DOS
- Each recording gets a summary, topics and next steps (on devices with Apple Intelligence).
- Send to-dos to Reminders and events to Calendar. You confirm each item before it is added.
- Say "Assistant, dentist appointment tomorrow at 3" while recording, and once it is transcribed you get a to-do card and a notification.
- Talk out loud and get a short breakdown into to-dos, events and notes.

APPLE WATCH
- Record with the watch alone. The recording moves to your iPhone for transcription.
- Start and stop an iPhone recording from the watch and add bookmarks.
- If the watch battery drops below 25%, the recording is saved and stops.

EXPORT AND STORAGE
- Share transcripts as text or PDF and recordings as audio files.
- Import recordings from Voice Memos or the Files app and transcribe them.
- Sync with your other devices through your own iCloud.
- Recordings move to Recently Deleted after 30 days and are erased 7 days later. You can change the period, and starred recordings stay.

PRICE
- Everything is free. No time limits and no in-app purchases.

name: HDH APP
description: HDH APP is the Hyundai Dealer Hub for the Netherlands. The central platform for news, model updates, marketing, training, documents, events and important announcements from Hyundai Motor Netherlands. Everything in one place, always up to date.

name: Hearthguard: Village Defense
description:
Hearthguard is a one-thumb fantasy action roguelite. Monsters march on your village wave after wave, and only your hero stands in their way.

STAND STILL TO STRIKE, MOVE TO DODGE
Drag to move. Let go and your hero attacks automatically. Easy to pick up, hard to put down, built for one hand.

A NEW BUILD EVERY RUN
After each wave, choose 1 of 3 blessings: multishot, ricochet, orbiting shields, bonfire nova and more. Stack them into a different hero every run.

BOSSES WORTH BRAGGING ABOUT
Every fifth wave a boss arrives. Beat it and the game saves a short vertical clip of the fight that you can share from the results screen.

FORGE YOUR ARSENAL
54 weapons in Frost, Ember, Storm, Blood and Gilded forgings, each with its own effect: Frost slows, Ember explodes, Storm's lightning jumps between foes and Blood heals you on kills. Add 12 armours, 23 relics, 6 familiars that fly beside you, and 6 auras.

8 HEROES
From Tom the Farmhand to Sir Valor the Paladin, every hero has a perk that changes how you play.

REBUILD YOUR VILLAGE
Spend gold on 14 buildings, from the Blacksmith and Inn to the Library and Trading Post. Each one makes you stronger. As the village levels up, new homes, market stalls and villagers appear.

5 MAPS, DAILY CHALLENGES AND ACHIEVEMENTS
Village Square, Market Road, Mill Fields, Night Siege and the Haunted Wood, plus a rotating Daily Challenge and achievements that pay out crystals.

PLAY ANYWHERE
No account, no ads and no internet needed. The game resizes to fill any screen.

Every hero, weapon, armour, relic, familiar and aura can be earned with crystals you collect by playing. Optional in-app purchases are available.

name: Hebrew Words
seller_name: AL TITI ESTABLISHMENT FOR SOFTWARE TECHNOLOGY
description:
Start speaking Hebrew with the words you use first: how to greet people, count, order food, get around and handle everyday moments.

Hebrew Words teaches 90 words and phrases in short lessons of a few minutes each, each with clear pronunciation you can listen to and repeat.

WHAT YOU LEARN
• Greetings and courtesy: shalom, boker tov, toda, bevakasha
• People and family: ish, isha, mishpacha, aba, ima
• Numbers one to a hundred, and days, weeks and months
• Food and drink: lechem, mayim, chalav, kafe, okhel
• Around town and travel: bayit, shuk, rakevet, kartis
• Everyday phrases: how much is it, I don't understand, help

MADE FOR ARABIC SPEAKERS
• Every word is also written in Arabic letters, so you can read it at a glance
• Words that Hebrew shares with Arabic are pointed out: shalom and salaam, echad and ahad, sheva and sab'a
• Explanations in Arabic or English

HOW IT WORKS
• Short lessons where you learn by doing, with instant feedback
• Clear pronunciation for every word and phrase
• Stars for each lesson and a daily streak to keep you going

NO ADS, NO ACCOUNT
Everything is inside the app and works offline. Only anonymous usage statistics are collected, with no advertising ID, and your progress stays on your device.

Want the alphabet first? Start with Learn Hebrew: Letters & Sounds, from the same family of apps.

name: Hibi - Habits & Calendar
description:
Hibi helps you check off the habits you want to keep, every day. Your ring for the day fills with the colors of the habits you finish, and habits linked to Health are checked off automatically when your data meets the goal.

HABIT CHECK-OFF
• Every day, specific days, or a number of times per week
• Current streak, longest streak, and completion for the last 30 days
• A monthly calendar where you can tap a date to check or uncheck it
• Start from suggestions such as waking up early, reading, or stretching

AUTOMATIC CHECK FROM HEALTH
Habits are checked off automatically on days your Health data meets the goal:
• Wake-up time (for example, up by 6:00 AM)
• Bedtime (for example, asleep by 11:00 PM)
• Time asleep
• Steps, Move, Exercise, and Stand
• Workouts (type, minimum duration, and start time)
Each habit shows a chart of the last 14 days. Hibi uses data that Apple Watch, iPhone, and other apps write to Health.

SLEEP PLAN
Set a bedtime and how long to sleep, and Hibi adds a repeating event to your calendar on the days you choose. When Health knows how you actually slept, that night’s event is updated to the actual times. The notes include time in bed, sleep stages, time awake, the difference from your plan, and the data source.

KEEP IT IN YOUR CALENDAR
Your checked habits, sleep, and workouts are added to calendars you’ve added to iPhone, such as Google Calendar or iCloud. You choose the event titles, like “Sleep {time asleep}”.

PRIVACY
Your data stays on your iPhone and is never sent to any server. Health data is only read. Events are added only to the calendar you choose.

name: Họ Trương
description:
Họ Trương là ứng dụng gia phả riêng tư của dòng họ Trương Đại Lộc, Đà Nẵng. Con cháu ở khắp nơi có thể cùng xem cây gia phả, giữ gìn những câu chuyện và nhớ những ngày quan trọng của gia đình.

CÂY GIA PHẢ
• Xem nhiều đời trên một cây: kéo, phóng to, thu nhỏ, xem toàn màn hình
• Chạm vào một người để xem năm sinh, nơi sinh, ngày giỗ, cha mẹ, vợ chồng, anh chị em và con cái
• Cây gia phả riêng của bạn: ông bà là rễ, con cháu là cành lá
• Tìm nhanh một người trong hàng nghìn thành viên

CÂU CHUYỆN DÒNG HỌ
• Những câu chuyện, kỷ niệm do con cháu ghi lại, có ảnh xen giữa các đoạn và video
• Album ảnh gia đình và ảnh của từng người

NGÀY GIỖ VÀ LỊCH
• Ngày giỗ tính theo âm lịch, đổi sang dương lịch mỗi năm
• Sinh nhật, họp mặt và các ngày lễ của gia đình

TIN NHẮN
• Trò chuyện với cả nhà, theo nhóm hoặc nhắn riêng
• Báo cáo và chặn tin nhắn không phù hợp

IN SÁCH GIA PHẢ
• In cả dòng họ hoặc một nhánh thành sách, có bìa, sơ đồ, lịch giỗ và danh sách tên (trên trang web)

RIÊNG TƯ
• Chỉ thành viên được quản trị viên duyệt mới xem được gia phả
• Mỗi người tự chọn chia sẻ số điện thoại, địa chỉ hay không
• Không quảng cáo, không theo dõi
• Có thể xóa tài khoản ngay trong ứng dụng

Ứng dụng dùng được bằng tiếng Việt, tiếng Anh và tiếng Trung. Cần tài khoản thành viên dòng họ Trương để sử dụng.

name: Holiday Train: Block Puzzle
description:
All aboard the Holiday Train!

Colorful pieces roll in on the conveyor belt. Drag them into the train's wagons, fit them together and pack every car to the roof. Blocks of one color wrap into shiny gift boxes, a full row packs into one big box - and when the car is loaded, the whistle blows: off to the next station!

A cozy block puzzle with a festive heart: easy to learn, satisfying to master and full of little holiday surprises.

LOAD THE TRAIN
Drag, turn and drop blocks into the wagons before the belt fills up. Plan your space, keep the belt moving and pack every car tight.

MERGE INTO GIFTS
Put blocks of one color side by side and watch them wrap into presents - from a tiny box to Santa's own gift. The bigger the present, the bigger the score!

CLEAR ROWS, CHAIN COMBOS
A full row or column packs into a single box. Clear two or three at once for a combo, keep the streak going and earn the golden crown.

RIDE THROUGH THE SEASONS
16 stations from snowy winter to spring rain, summer meadows and golden autumn, with rivers to cross by steamer - all the way to New Year's midnight at the grand depot. Every station brings its own cargo: ice cream, cakes, fruit, cocoa and wool.

HANDY BOOSTERS
Call Santa's sleigh to drop gifts into the trickiest holes, pull the brake to slow the belt, dump extra pieces into the shredder or slip in a gift block. Catch the special pieces too: the garland packs a row and a column at once, the magnet pulls stray blocks away, and the rocket shakes the whole load tight.

COLLECT TOYS
Every fully loaded car hides a toy. Collect tin engines, glass baubles and more, complete the sets for bonus coins, open chests on the journey map and pick up a daily gift.

PLAY WITH FRIENDS
Join a crew, invite friends with your code, send gifts to your crew and climb the leaderboards - or take on the endless Run and beat your own record.

COZY BY DESIGN
- Cozy illustrated festive worlds and gently falling snow
- Christmas carols and classic winter music
- A jolly grandpa cheers your best moves
- Play offline, anywhere - no Wi-Fi needed
- No ads

Hop on board, pack the presents and bring the Holiday Train home for the New Year!

name: Hollowkin Heroes: Action RPG
description:
Hollowkin Heroes is a single-player action RPG. You control the leader of a team of 5 heroes with 1 thumb.

Move with the joystick. Your hero attacks the nearest enemy automatically. The other 4 heroes follow you, fight and use their skills automatically.

FEATURES
- 10 regions and 100 stages on open isometric maps with lanes and forest areas
- Destroy mist towers, defeat enemy waves and break the mist core at the end of each stage
- Fight a boss in the last stage of each region
- Clear optional forest camps for a temporary power boost and materials
- Fill the power gauge and tap the epic attack to hit all enemies near your team
- Tap an enemy to make it the target of your team
- Collect gold and upgrade material, level up your heroes and equip gear that you see on the model
- Unlock a new hero when you complete a region
- Unlock an extra look for each hero

The game needs no network connection and no account. The game has no ads. Optional in-game purchases are available.

name: HOTIPARTS
description:
HOTIPARTS réunit en un seul endroit les pièces détachées qui dorment dans les stocks des entreprises et des particuliers : agricole, chantier, poids lourds, automobile, moto, industrie et bien plus.

TROUVER UNE PIÈCE
• Cherchez par référence, par mots-clés ou par secteur, marque et modèle.
• Prenez la pièce en photo : l'application lit la référence et vous dit à quoi sert la pièce.
• Voyez dans quels pays la pièce est disponible.
• Demandez le prix en une touche, à tous les vendeurs qui l'ont.
• Pièce introuvable ? Envoyez votre recherche avec une photo : elle est montrée aux vendeurs.

DISCUTER EN TOUTE SIMPLICITÉ
• Comparez les propositions reçues.
• Posez vos questions, faites une contre-offre, acceptez ou refusez.
• Les noms restent cachés jusqu'à la mise en relation. Vous choisissez ensuite les coordonnées que vous partagez.

VENDRE VOTRE STOCK DORMANT
• Créez une annonce en 3 étapes : photos, vérification, publication.
• À partir de la photo, l'application propose la référence, la marque et la désignation.
• Gérez vos annonces : quantité, pause, vendu, mode vacances.
• Répondez vite aux demandes des acheteurs : « Je l'ai » ou « Je ne l'ai pas ».
• Voyez les pièces que des acheteurs recherchent dans vos marques.

TOUJOURS AU COURANT
• Notifications quand une proposition, une question ou une demande arrive.
• Le même compte sur l'application et sur hotiparts.com.
• Disponible en français, allemand, anglais, italien, espagnol et portugais.

HOTIPARTS met en relation acheteurs et vendeurs. La vente se conclut directement entre eux : HOTIPARTS ne vend pas de pièces et n'encaisse aucun paiement.

L'utilisation de HOTIPARTS est gratuite.

name: Hour Hand
description: Hour Hand is for the moment before a call. Write the other person's name, then flick the hour tile up or down. The phone adds that whole-hour offset to its own hour and shows what hour it is there. Fold the call and open it later from the list. Nothing is dialed, no contacts are read, and no time zone is looked up.

name: How it works · Machines
description:
See inside the machines that shaped the modern world, and the one that powers life itself. How it works puts five working exhibits in your space: take them apart, set them running and watch every part move.

FORD MODEL T
Start the engine and watch the pistons, valves and crankshaft turn in order. Press the pedals and follow the power through the planetary transmission as it shifts between low, neutral, high and reverse. View the car as a tabletop miniature or at life size.

NUCLEAR POWER PLANT
Follow the heat from the reactor core to the cooling tower: reactor, steam generator, pressurizer, turbine, generator and condenser on one model. Open the reactor vessel and move the control rods yourself. Keep it on the table or stand it on your floor.

JET ENGINE
A two-spool, high-bypass turbofan in quarter cutaway. Press Start and watch the air starter spin up the core, fuel and ignition light, and the engine settle to idle. Move the thrust lever, deploy reverse thrust, and follow the air as it splits into bypass and core flow through the compressor, combustor and turbines.

PHOTOSYNTHESIS
Zoom from a leaf to its cells, into a chloroplast, and down to a single thylakoid membrane, magnified 20 million times. Watch water split, electrons flow through the photosystems and ATP synthase spin. Switch off the sunlight or close the stomata and see what stops.

SPACE STATION
Float inside four modules of the International Space Station: Unity, Destiny, Tranquility and the Cupola. Earth turns beneath the windows once every 93-minute orbit, with day and night where they really are, city lights on the night side and 9,000 real stars after sunset. Move between modules at your own pace with comfortable, step-by-step movement.

HOW ACCESS WORKS
Choose any two exhibits to keep free for good. A single one-time purchase opens all five exhibits. No subscription, no ads.

Built for Apple Vision Pro. Motion speeds, colours and some proportions are adjusted so you can follow what's happening.

name: Impossibly Hard Sudoku
description:
Impossibly Hard Sudoku is for players who finished the easy levels years ago. Every one of its 4,500 puzzles is rated 4.0 or harder, and every one has a single solution you can reach with logic alone.

THREE TIERS
• Hard (4.0 to 4.4): X-Wings, XY-Wings, W-Wings and unique rectangles.
• Expert (4.5 to 4.9): Swordfish, jellyfish and single-digit chains.
• Nightmare (5.0 and up): XY-chains and puzzles that go beyond them.
A solver that uses human techniques rated each puzzle by the hardest step it needs.

ARCADE RUNS
• Every correct digit scores points, scaled by the puzzle's rating.
• Place your next digit within 20 seconds to grow your combo, up to x5.
• A wrong digit costs a heart and 250 points. Lose all three and the run ends.
• Beat par for a time bonus. Solve with no mistakes to win a heart back, and skip hints too for a clean bonus.
• Personal bests for each tier: best run, fastest solve, puzzles solved and best combo.

NOTES THAT KEEP UP
• Select several cells at once and add, cross out or restore a candidate in all of them with one tap.
• Crossed out notes stay visible with a red slash, so you can see what you ruled out.
• Pick a digit to light up every place it sits and every cell where it is still a candidate.
• Auto notes fills in every candidate when you want to skip the bookkeeping.

HINTS THAT TEACH
Stuck? A hint names the technique for the next step and outlines the pattern on the board, so you learn the move instead of just getting the answer. Reveal the digit only if you need to.

BUILT FOR EVERY SCREEN
• iPhone, iPad and iPhone Duo, including the inner screen upright, sideways and partly open.
• Light and dark mode, haptics, VoiceOver labels and hardware keyboard shortcuts.

No ads, no accounts, no tracking. Your progress stays on your device.

name: InspectUs
description:
InspectUs is the app for inspection and engineering companies that use InspectUs. Choose your company, sign in with the email address it invited, and your jobs, customers and equipment are with you on site.

ON SITE, EVEN WITH NO SIGNAL
• Your jobs for today with customers, sites and equipment
• Inspection forms for lifting equipment (LOLER), PAT testing and more, with required questions so nothing is missed
• Photos, defects with a "put right by" date, and signatures
• Scan an asset's QR code to open it
• Everything is saved on the phone and sent when you're back online

CERTIFICATES AND DEFECTS
• Certificates made from the inspection, ready for the office to approve and send
• Dangerous defects flagged straight away
• Defects can become quotes for the office

JOB PACKS AND SAFETY
• Job packs with the work to do, site details and documents
• RAMS (method statements and risk assessments) with sign-on
• Timesheets and visit times

FOR THE OFFICE AND CUSTOMERS
• Schedules, customers, assets, quotes and invoices from a phone or tablet
• Customers can sign in to see their own equipment and certificates

You need an account with a company that uses InspectUs to sign in. Can't see your company in the list? Ask them about InspectUs.

Your company is in charge of its data. No adverts and no tracking. See our privacy notice for details.

name: Islamic Quiz: Muslim Trivia
description:
Love testing your Islamic knowledge? Sual wa Bayan is an Islamic quiz game that mixes fun and learning, and it works offline.

Every answer with evidence
After each question you see the explanation and its source from the Holy Qur'an or the authentic Sunnah, with the verse or hadith reference. Play and learn at the same time.

Following Ahl al-Sunnah wal-Jama'ah
Questions on aqeedah and fiqh built on agreed-upon principles, away from disputed issues.

9 sections, 450 questions
• Qur'an: surahs, verses and Qur'an stories
• Stories of the Prophets
• Seerah of the Prophet
• Aqeedah and the pillars of faith
• Fiqh and worship
• The Companions
• Hadith
• Adhkar and duas
• Islamic manners and character

A fun challenge
• Daily challenge: 5 new questions every day with a daily streak
• Lifelines: remove two answers, extra time, skip
• Stars, points and a speed bonus
• Review your mistakes until you master them

For the whole family
Islamic questions for kids and adults, from easy to hard, with an elegant design, dark and light mode and adjustable text size.

Offline, in 14 languages
Play anytime, anywhere. Available in English, Arabic, French, Urdu, Turkish, Indonesian, Hindi, Bengali, Spanish and more.

Download Sual wa Bayan now and test yourself with Islamic questions and answers!

name: IzoKonya – Isometric Konya
description:
All of Konya in a single isometric map, hand-drawn like a game world. From the Mevlana Museum to the Seljuk Tower, from Kültürpark to Konya Metropolitan Stadium: thousands of buildings, parks and streets in a living city that reveals more detail the closer you zoom.

A LIVING MAP
• Whirling dervishes at the Mevlana Museum, swans and fountains in Kültürpark, butterflies in Butterfly Valley, koi in the Japanese Park
• Trams on their rails, high-speed trains between stations, buses at the coach station
• A stadium that lights up on match days, a concert stage, evening lights and many more living scenes

LIVE TRAMS
• See where every tram is right now, on the real rails of the map
• Trams approaching a stop and their arrival times, in both directions
• Tap a tram to follow its journey

LANDMARKS, VIRTUAL TOURS, AUDIO GUIDE
• Information cards for historic buildings, museums, parks and modern landmarks
• 360° virtual tours across the city
• Audio narration in Turkish, English, German and Arabic

FLIGHT MODE AND POSTCARDS
• Glide over the city and tour Konya from end to end
• Save and share the view as a high-resolution postcard

CITY SHORTCUTS
• Pharmacies on duty today
• Hospitals and the emergency number
• Taxi ranks and car parks
• Prayer times and the nearest mosque
• Address search by street and house number
• and many more shortcuts for everyday city life

NOTIFICATIONS (OPTIONAL)
• News about events in the city and what's new on the map
• Prayer time reminders shortly before the times you choose, with the nearest mosque
• Both can be turned off with one tap, in the app or in your phone settings

ALWAYS NEW
• New places, new living scenes and new features are added to the map regularly; you see them without updating the app

PRIVACY
• No account needed
• Your location is used only on your phone and is not shared with us

Four languages: Türkçe, English, Deutsch, العربية

Suggestions and partnerships: desk@izokonya.com

name: Jaddidha: Iqama Reminder
description:
Jaddidha reminds you of every important deadline in Saudi Arabia: iqama renewal, exit re-entry visas, work permits, vehicle istimara and business licenses. Enter your dates once, and it calculates everything and alerts you at the right time.

Your data stays on your phone. We never ask for your iqama number or any ID number, only dates and names.

Iqama and travel
• Alerts before your iqama expires, plus a special alert 5 days before, when services stop
• Single and multiple exit re-entry visas: 45, 60, 90, 100, 120, 200 or 360 days, a custom duration, or "return before"
• Shows your "leave the Kingdom before" date and your last day to return
• "I left today" and "I'm back today" buttons update your deadlines automatically
• Work permits, dependents, domestic workers and employees

Vehicles and businesses
• Istimara, insurance, periodic inspection and driving license for cars, motorcycles and trucks (free)
• Business licenses: municipality, civil defense, CR annual confirmation and any document you add

Simple and clear
• Hijri or Gregorian calendar
• Arabic or English
• Reminders arrive even when the app is closed, with no internet needed

Plans
• Free: one iqama + all vehicles
• Family Plan: unlimited iqamas + backup
• Business Plan: everything in Family + business licenses, with a 7-day free trial on the yearly plan
• Monthly, yearly or lifetime

Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage them in your App Store settings.

Jaddidha is an independent app and is not affiliated with any government entity. Calculations are for guidance only and are based on published rules, so always confirm on the official platforms before taking action.

Terms of Use: https://glowwebstudio.com/jaddidha-terms
Privacy Policy: https://glowwebstudio.com/jaddidha-privacy

name: Jalin Kata: Edisi Jawi
description:
Jalin Kata Jawi is a free word-tile game for practising reading and spelling Malay in Jawi script.

Place letter tiles on a 15x15 board, link your word to the ones already there, and score on the premium squares. Play against the computer at three levels, or take turns with a friend on one device.

Made for Jawi:
- Every tile is one Jawi letter, and words read right to left.
- A joined-word preview shows how your word really looks when the letters connect.
- Small markers show the letters that never join to the next one.
- Over 35,000 Malay words, each with a short meaning in Bahasa Malaysia.
- Optional Arabic-Indic numerals on the board.

Learn more about Jawi:
- Three illustrated history books: the history of the Jawi script, the history of Bahasa Malaysia, and the story of Malay word games.
- A short tutorial that explains the board and the rules.

Free for community use and not for profit: no ads, no in-app purchases and no accounts. Music and sounds were made for this app.

About the word list: spellings come from Wiktionary (CC BY-SA 4.0) and the rumi-jawi list by Mohd Zamri Murah, Michael Wayne Goodman and Faizah Binte Zakaria. Some affixed words are spelled by rules the app learned from the others and are marked as derived. Meanings were written with an AI model and have not been checked word by word, so please report any mistake you find.

name: JANKeN PoN World
description:
世界の掛け声で、勝負。

JANKeN PoN は、19か国のかけ声で遊ぶじゃんけんゲームです。
グーは3pt、チョキは2pt、パーは5pt。勝った手のポイントだけが入るので、5回戦の25ptをめぐって、出す手がそのまま作戦になります。

■ 3つの遊び方
・CPU練習 — 初級・中級・上級、そして最強。ひとりで、好きなときに。
・通信対戦 — 1手5秒固定の真剣勝負。国内のクイックマッチか、合言葉の部屋で友だちと。
・パーティー — 2〜4人で、全員がいっせいに手を出す5回戦。

■ 世界の掛け声
「じゃんけんぽん！」「Rock Paper Scissors Shoot!」「Jo ken pô!」——
19か国語の掛け声を、その国の声で再生します。自分の国と相手の国は、プレイ中にいつでも切り替えられます。
プレイ画面のサウンドボタンで、かけ声と効果音をワンタップでON/OFFできます。設定のサウンドとも同じスイッチです。

■ 勝負の中身
・タップは「選択中」。締切まで何度でも選び直せます。
・「これで決定」を押すと、カウントを待たずに「ぽん！」。通信対戦では、全員が押した瞬間に開きます。
・「ぽん！」の最後の拍で、自分と相手の手が同時に開く。後出しはできません。
・PK戦のように、R1〜R5の勝敗がプレイ中から見えます。

■ 記録とランキング
・5回戦・3回戦の部門別に、総合・月別・週間・勝率のランキング。
・相手の手の傾向、勝った手の勝率。数字で自分の癖がわかります。
・国は初回に登録すると変わりません（ニックネームは後から変えられます）。

■ 安心して遊べる
・自由入力のチャットはありません。定型スタンプ6種・4秒あき・ミュート可。
・文字サイズは標準／大／特大。表示は12言語に対応。
・練習データは端末の中だけ。「練習データをリセット」でいつでも消せます。

■ PRO（買い切り ¥300）
強さは売りません。世界への入口と、数字の手応えを売ります。
・世界の通信対戦と世界ランキング
・世界パーティーバトル（2〜4人・5回戦）
・最強CPU「MASTER」（2秒）
・相手の手の率（グー・チョキ・パー%）の詳細
・ゴールド称号フレーム
ポイントや勝率が有利になることはありません。

T-maks Games

name: JDM Car Lot Tycoon
description:
Vladivostok, April 1992. Your uncle meets you at the port, shows you how the trade works, then leaves you a patch of dirt on the hills above the city, five tired Japanese cars and a wire fence. Around you a whole market is growing on the slopes: the Green Corner.

Buy cars in Japan through sailors you trust. Read the auction sheet and guess what the inspector left out. Get them through the port, wash them, fix what is worth fixing, set a price and haggle face to face with buyers who came a thousand kilometers for a right-hand-drive sedan.

• A living lot. Buyers walk the rows, kick tires, argue, leave and come back. Your men wipe the dust off hoods, smoke by the office and talk shop on quiet weekdays.
• Every car is its own story. More than a hundred models from nine makers, each with its own faults, mileage that may or may not be true, and a manual in the glovebox worth collecting.
• Haggling you can read. Hold your price, give a little, or let him walk. A looker can be won over.
• The port. Ships come in every weekday. Cars roll down the ramp, go through customs and leave by the gate. Order through sailors you trust, pay the storage fees and hope the typhoon misses your ship.
• The front row sells. Cars by the road get twice the looks. Fill a row with Toyotas or with vans and buyers start coming for them. Keep it up and the market knows your lot for it.
• A place of your own. Spend your money on yourself: a room in an old house on the Amur Bay shore, then the whole apartment, a garage, a boat at the jetty and a house by the sea. It fills up over the years.
• Seventeen years. From dirt and a kiosk in 1992 to a big lot by the main road in 2008, through the 1998 crash and every change of the rules.
• Show off your lot. One tap makes a picture of your lot, your place and your best deals, with a rank from The Uncle's Nephew up to Right-Hand-Drive Legend.
• Hand-drawn pixel art with whole hills of parked cars behind your fence, in every season.

The whole first lot is free to play, for as long as you like. The full game is one purchase: no ads, no coins, nothing to buy twice.

The game is in active development. We build it in the open and we read every comment: tell us what felt wrong and what you want more of.

Languages: English, Russian.

name: Jelly Belly: Feel Good Buddy
description:
Jelly Belly is a soft, colorful skills buddy for the moments when a feeling is a lot. Every color gets its space, and so does every feeling.

Check in with five quick questions, then try a short skill picked for how you feel. The skills are drawn from DBT (dialectical behavior therapy), such as paced breathing, STOP and TIPP, and each one comes with a timer so you always know how long it takes.

‚Ä¢ Check-in: five yes/no questions, with "Not sure" always allowed
‚Ä¢ Skills: breathing, STOP, TIPP, and your own skills that you add
‚Ä¢ Feeling rings: a calm core and rings around it, shown with a number, a shape and a word, never color alone
‚Ä¢ Your safety plan: warning signs, things that help, your reasons and your safe people, with a ready-to-send text ("Can you call me?"). Call or text 988 is at the top, one tap
‚Ä¢ Safe people: pick up to three from your contacts, or choose "No one right now"
‚Ä¢ Calm mode: no bear, flat colors, the same skills
‚Ä¢ Reduce Motion, Dynamic Type and VoiceOver supported
‚Ä¢ Gentle reminders that you control

Private by design: no account, no sign-in, no ads, no tracking, no analytics. What you write stays on your iPhone. Erase everything any time in Me.

Jelly Belly is not therapy and not a medical device. It does not diagnose, treat or prevent any condition, and it cannot call for help for you. If you are in crisis or thinking about hurting yourself, call or text 988 (US) or call your local emergency number.

name: JoinFolio
description:
Find the relationship between two CSV tables without losing where each row came from.

JoinFolio is a local CSV key-audit and hash-join workspace. Import two real files, map composite keys, inspect exceptions, then freeze an Inner, Left or Anti join with the original inputs and row provenance still attached. It is not a SQL server, spreadsheet formula engine or online data-sync service.

READ REAL CSV
Paste UTF-8 CSV or choose it in Files. The parser handles quoted commas, doubled quotes and multiline fields, with a unique nonempty header and rectangular records. Every data row keeps its logical source-record number and physical starting line. Inspect the original source fingerprint, complete column names and an explicitly labelled preview before joining.

AUDIT COMPOSITE KEYS
Pair1–4 different columns on each side in a defined order. Choose whether to trim key whitespace or ignore case without rewriting the original cells. Empty key components never match. Review empty keys, duplicate groups and their real source rows, unmatched left foreign keys and right rows that were never referenced. Compound keys remain separate components, avoiding delimiter-concatenation collisions.

JOIN WITH STABLE LINEAGE
Inner returns all matched pairs; Left retains every left row; Anti returns unmatched left rows including empty keys. Duplicate keys produce the complete many-to-many result in stable left order, then right source order. Browse real output in50-row pages. Above20000 output rows, the operation is rejected as a whole—never presented as a truncated success. A genuine zero-row result can still be frozen and exported with its header.

FREEZE AND SHARE
Reports deep-copy both CSV inputs, key options, audits and the complete joined rows. Later source deletion cannot change that evidence. Export Exact CSV, explicitly transformed Spreadsheet-safe CSV, full JSON or paginated PDF, then preview/share the real file. Exact CSV preserves source cells; the safe variant prefixes formula-like nonnumeric text, while JSON retains original values. Logical and physical provenance from both sides is included.

SUPPORTED SCOPE
Each input≤2 MiB,5000 data rows,32 columns and4096 characters per field; UTF-8 with optional BOM and RFC4180 quoting using LF/CRLF. No bare CR, malformed quotes, duplicate/blank trimmed headers or nonrectangular rows. Up to20 datasets,50 reports and32 MiB of library payload; each export≤16 MiB, PDF content≤2 MiB/500 pages. Core work is local with no App account, advertising, IAP or third-party analytics SDK.

name: Junkyard Simulator: Car Tycoon
description:
Junkyard simulator and car mechanic game: buy wrecked cars, take them apart with the right tools, wash and repair the parts, then sell them at your counter. Grow a small scrap yard into a busy car junkyard business and become a junkyard tycoon.

Junkyard Simulator: Car Tycoon combines the hands-on work of a car mechanic with running a used auto parts shop. Every car is a decision: what it costs, which parts it can give you and who will pay for them.

BUY AND DISMANTLE CARS
Pick a damaged car from the market, bid at an auction or take a chance on a sealed crate. Check the condition and price before you buy, because a car can lose money. At your lift, remove each part with a tool that fits it, from hand tools and ratchets to the impact wrench. Removed parts go to your shelves.

SELL USED PARTS
Customers walk in asking for a specific part. Find it in your stock, name a price and haggle at the counter, turn by turn. Bargain hunters, mechanics, collectors and buyers in a hurry all negotiate differently, and any of them can walk away. Compare each offer with what the part is worth before you accept.

CLEAN, REPAIR, CRUSH
Once the equipment is unlocked, wash dirty parts and repair dented body panels to raise their price. Weigh the cost against the added value. Send empty shells to the crusher.

GROW YOUR WORKSHOP
Buy tools and upgrade the shop through five tiers. Finish daily jobs, weekly goals, timed orders and contracts. Later your helper sells shelved parts while you are away, regular customers return, and the weekend market, the workshop pass and the classic restoration journal give you more to work toward. Choose the look of your sign, shutter and floor. Balance car purchases, shelf space and daily expenses.

FAIR AND AT YOUR OWN PACE
There is no paywall and nothing to buy: this version has no in-app purchases. Your money comes from the parts you sell. Short ad breaks come only at natural pauses, such as the end of a day, never in the middle of your work. Dismantling uses your mechanic's energy: when it runs out, take a short rest or watch an optional rewarded ad to refill. Rewarded ads also give bonuses or shortcuts. Daily reminders stay off unless you allow them.

Single-player. Progress is saved on your device and, with Game Center, follows you to another iPhone. Earn Game Center achievements as your yard grows. Available in English, Turkish, German, Spanish, Portuguese, Russian or Indonesian.

name: Kaelir
description: Kaelir is a quiet, entirely offline notebook for a record collection. It keeps your shelf in order, remembers what you played and how it sounded, suggests what to put on next, and offers practical notes on looking after the records themselves — without an account, an internet connection or a single advertisement.

name: Kalix Graphing Calculator
description:
Kalix is a scientific graphing calculator with a computer algebra system, made for iPhone, iPad and Mac, with an Apple Watch app. It gives exact answers, solves and simplifies, draws fast graphs in 2D and 3D, and keeps all your work on your device.

EXACT ANSWERS
- Real 2D math entry: stacked fractions, radicals, exponents, matrices, and templates for derivatives, integrals, sums, products, limits and log base
- Handwriting on iPhone and iPad: write a calculation with Apple Pencil or your finger, end it with =, and the result appears right after it
- Exact results, such as 1/3 + 1/6 = 1/2 or sqrt(72) = 6√2, with the decimal value underneath
- More or fewer decimals on any result, as on a spreadsheet cell
- Variables (a := 5) and your own functions (f(x) := x^2 + 1)
- Complex numbers, matrices and lists

COMPUTER ALGEBRA
- Simplify, expand and factor
- Solve equations, systems of equations and inequalities
- Derivatives, definite and indefinite integrals, limits and closed-form sums
- Taylor polynomials and differential equations

GRAPHS
- Functions, inverse functions, parametric and polar curves
- Implicit relations and shaded inequalities, drawn pixel by pixel on the GPU
- Sequences, scatter plots from lists and slope fields
- Sliders for free parameters: drag a number in the editor and the curve redraws as you move
- Trace, zeros, minimums, maximums, intersections and a table of values

3D GRAPHS
- Surfaces z = f(x, y) and parametric surfaces, rendered with Metal
- Rotate, contour lines and wireframe

MORE APPLICATIONS
- Lists & Spreadsheet: named columns, cell and column formulas, statistics and regressions
- Notes with live math boxes
- Finance: loans and savings with amortization, cash flows (NPV, IRR, XIRR, payback), bonds, depreciation, interest conversion and breakeven
- Convert: 24 categories of units, from length and energy to number bases, and currencies at the European Central Bank's daily rates

FUNCTION CATALOG
- Probability distributions: normal, t, chi-square, F, binomial, Poisson and geometric
- Random numbers
- Regressions: linear to quartic, exponential, logarithmic, power, logistic, sinusoidal and median-median
- Statistical tests and confidence intervals
- Matrices: determinant, inverse, rref, eigenvalues, eigenvectors, LU and QR
- Units of measure and conversions; angle, polar and number base conversions

MADE FOR APPLE DEVICES
- Native on iPhone, iPad and Mac, with a math keypad sized for each screen
- Apple Watch: the exact calculator on your wrist, with history, even without your iPhone
- A Kalix button for Control Center on iPhone, iPad and Mac, and on iPhone for the Lock Screen and the Action button
- History of past calculations, saved automatically
- Calculates and graphs without an internet connection

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
- No account, no ads, no analytics, no tracking
- Your calculations, handwriting, graphs and notes stay on your device, and handwriting is read on the device
- Export everything at any time as a text file or as JSON

FREE TRIAL AND ONE-TIME UNLOCK
- Kalix is free to download. Start a 7-day free trial to use every feature. Nothing is charged for the trial.
- After 7 days, calculating, graphing and editing stop until you unlock Kalix with a one-time purchase. The price is shown in the app before the trial starts. There is no subscription.
- Your data stays yours: after the trial you can still view and export your calculations, variables and graphs.
- One purchase covers iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple Watch with the same Apple Account.
- Restore Purchases is on the purchase screens and in Settings.

REQUIREMENTS
- iPhone with iOS 27 or later
- iPad with iPadOS 27 or later
- Mac with Apple silicon and macOS 27 or later
- Apple Watch with watchOS 26 or later

Kalix is made by Artiros. Questions or feedback: support.artiros@icloud.com

name: Keep'em: Photo Gallery Cleaner
description:
Your photo library is full of screenshots, duplicates, blurry shots and old media from chats. Keep'em makes cleaning it up quick, even fun: swipe right to keep, swipe left to trash.

SWIPE TO SORT
• One photo or video at a time, right to keep, left to trash
• Newest first, oldest first, or largest first to free space fast
• Camera, screenshots, social media, videos and the largest files, each in its own group
• Pick up exactly where you left off

A RECYCLE BIN YOU CAN TRUST
• Nothing is deleted while you swipe. Trashed items wait in the recycle bin
• Restore anything with one tap

SEE YOUR PROGRESS
• How many photos you sorted and how much space you freed
• Optional reminders to keep your library tidy

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no sign-up
• No server, no ads, no analytics
• Your photos never leave your iPhone

KEEP'EM PRO
Sorting, the recycle bin and restoring are free. Pro unlocks permanent deletion from the recycle bin, as a monthly subscription or a one-time lifetime purchase. The price is shown in the App Store before you buy. Subscriptions renew automatically until cancelled; manage or cancel them in Settings > your name > Subscriptions.
