name: Keşke: Budget & Savings
description:
How much can you comfortably spend today? Keşke answers with one big, friendly number: your daily number. No spreadsheets, no guilt trips. Just that number, a cheerful little coin pouch named Akche, and one question in the evening: "Worth it?"

YOUR DAILY NUMBER
Keşke takes your income, recurring bills and envelopes, then spreads what's left across the rest of your pay period. The whole screen tells you how the day is going: comfortable, careful, or a little over. No red, no scolding. Spend less today and tomorrow gets roomier; spend more and nothing explodes. Tomorrow is a fresh page.

TWO TAPS TO LOG
Tap "+", tap a token, done. Tokens line up by what you log most, the time of day and the day of the week, so your usual coffee is waiting as "Coffee · ₺95". Right under the amount, a tiny reality check: "8% of today's allowance". All worked out on your iPhone.

WORTH IT?
In the evening, give the day's spending ten seconds: swipe right for "Worth it", left for "Wish I hadn't". Your answers build a regret map, Akche points out where the "wish I hadn'ts" pile up, and can suggest a small challenge for next week. No banned lists. The ideas come from your own answers.

WAITING ROOM AND PIGGY BANK
Want something? Don't buy it yet. Put it in the waiting room for 1, 3 or 7 days and ask yourself again when the time is up. Everything you let go, plus what's left at the end of a period, flows into your piggy bank. Cappadocia or a new phone, you pick the goal. "Let this go and your goal is complete!" is Akche's favorite line.

WEEKLY CHALLENGE AND STREAKS
A small challenge for the week, like "no coffee out for 3 days". Watch the ring fill up. Log every day and your streak grows; no-spend days earn a star. On Monday, a short story of your last week is waiting.

MONTH
Your pay period as a colorful calendar: which days were comfortable and which went a little over, at a glance. Below it, what's left in each envelope (category limit), upcoming bills and card payments. Cards, statements and installments live here too, and installments split across the months by themselves.

WITHOUT OPENING THE APP
Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets show your daily number and the day's color. Log a pinned token from the Lock Screen, Control Center or Siri ("add coffee") in a single step.

YOUR DATA STAYS ON THIS IPHONE
No account, no sign-up, no servers, no ads, no analytics. Keşke collects none of your data. It stays on your iPhone and only leaves if you back it up to a folder you choose. Lock it with Face ID if you like, and hide amounts with a single tap.

YOUR BACKUPS, YOUR FOLDER
Automatic backups are encrypted and saved to a folder you pick, such as Files › On My iPhone. Delete the app and your backups stay right where you put them.

Completely free: no in-app purchases, no subscriptions.

In English and Turkish. For iPhone, iOS 26 or later.

name: Kettlebell Strength Plan
description:
Kettlebell workouts at home with one bell. Build full-body strength in short sessions: learn the deadlift, swing, squat, press and row step by step, then follow a program.

Kettlebell Strength Plan is home strength training for anyone who owns a kettlebell, or just got one. Every exercise has a demonstration, four plain steps, a suggested bell weight and the most common mistake to avoid.

BUILT FOR ONE KETTLEBELL
• Everything works with a single bell. A lighter bell for pressing helps, but you don't need one.
• The basics come first: the hip hinge and the deadlift before the swing, and swings in short sets.
• Six levels: each level adds reps or time, so the same program grows with you. The app explains when to move up to a heavier bell.
• Note the bell you use for each exercise, change it mid-workout, and see where every lift stands, in kg or lb.
• "How are you feeling?": select low back pain, shoulder pain, wrist pain, knee pain, hip pain or osteoporosis, and the app skips the exercises that most often aggravate it. It doesn't treat any condition.
• Sessions of about 10 to 20 minutes. Besides the bell you need at most a chair, a mat and a wall or doorway.

10 FREE KETTLEBELL WORKOUTS
Start with the free beginner path: Learn the Hip Hinge, Your First Kettlebell Swings and Your First Full-Body Kettlebell Workout. Then a 15-minute full-body kettlebell workout, 10-minute swings and carries, upper body, legs and glutes, core and carries, a warm-up before you lift and a cool-down stretch.

11 KETTLEBELL TRAINING PROGRAMS
• Start With One Kettlebell (30 days)
• Learn the Kettlebell Swing (30 days)
• Full-Body Strength With One Bell (30 days)
• Stronger Legs and Glutes (28 days)
• Stronger Grip and Upper Back (28 days)
• A Stronger Core With One Bell (28 days)
• Upper Body: Press and Row (28 days)
• Kettlebell Conditioning (28 days)
• Ten Minutes With a Kettlebell (30 days)
• Step Up to One-Arm Swings and Cleans (28 days, intermediate)
• Next-Level Full-Body Strength (28 days, intermediate)

Every program follows one sequence of exercises, with a rest day after every two sessions: a 30-day program is 21 sessions, a 28-day program 19. Effort stays moderate: you end each set with two or three reps left in reserve.

SAFETY FIRST
The exercises, bell weights and safety guidance follow published research and guidelines, and every source is listed in the app. The World Health Organization recommends muscle-strengthening activity on two or more days a week. Check with your doctor before you start if you have a heart condition or high blood pressure, chest pain, dizziness, a bone or joint problem, or if you are pregnant. Clear a space of about 2 × 2 m (7 × 7 ft) and keep children and pets away from the swing.

SIMPLE PRICING
All workouts and exercises are free. Programs are one-time purchases, so there is no subscription. Buying a program removes ads from that program's sessions. The complete bundle unlocks every program and custom workouts and programs, and removes all ads.

Available in 12 languages.

This app is for information only and is not medical advice. It does not diagnose or treat any condition. Check with a doctor in addition to using the app and before making medical decisions. Calorie and time figures are estimates.

name: KeyPro: Master Keying
description:
KeyPro is master keying software built by a working locksmith.

BUILD MASTER KEY SYSTEMS
• Standard pin tumbler systems with grand master, masters and change keys
• Correct progression with MACS, deepest first cut and step rules
• Specs for 15 major lock manufacturers built in

SFIC / IC CORES
• A2, A3 and A4 systems with the control key worked in
• Bottom, master, control (build-up) and top pins for every chamber
• Control key decoder: enter the top pins, get the control bitting

PINNING CALCULATOR
• Already have the keys? Enter the bittings and get the pin chart
• Save any job as a project

PAPERWORK, DONE
• Key schedule (door chart) with key holders and quantities
• Customer copy without bittings, and a bitting list with a checkbox per key
• Pin kit totals: how many of each pin to load before you leave the shop
• Print, or share as text or CSV

BUILT FOR THE JOB
• Works offline — basements and mechanical rooms included
• Projects sync between your phone and computer
• Imports project files from older Windows master keying programs

Free tools work without an account. Pro features require a KeyPro Pro account.

name: KFanRoute
description:
KFanRoute is a Korea trip planner for K-pop and esports fans.

Find what's on, then turn it into a great day:

• Events in one place — concerts, fan meetings, pop-up stores, music show recordings and esports matches, updated every day from official announcements and public sources
• One-day route planner — pick a date and what you love, and we place that day's events and fill the gaps with nearby food, cafés and sights. Start from your hotel, a subway station or where you are now
• Ready-made day routes for popular neighborhoods
• Concert venue guides — nearest station and exit, walking time and tips
• Goods shops and official stores for albums, photocards and merch
• Food, stays and sights near every event, with prices in Korean won and your own currency
• Open any route in Google Maps or Naver Map
• Save favorite artists, teams, places and routes — sign in to keep them on every device and see your favorites' new schedules in one place
• 8 languages: English, 한국어, 日本語, 繁體中文, 简体中文, ภาษาไทย, Bahasa Indonesia, Tiếng Việt

KFanRoute is an independent fan guide. We don't sell tickets and we are not affiliated with any artist, agency or league. Always check the official announcement before you go.

name: Khalo Jan: The Fisherman
description:
Khalo Jan the Fisherman is a one-touch fishing game. Tap the water to drop your hook ahead of a shark, hold to reel it in, and let go while it thrashes or your line snaps. Bigger sharks fight harder, and the red-tagged ones can pull Khalo Jan clean overboard.

Land sharks to earn sunset coins, spend them in the gym mini-game to build his strength, and work your way up to the catch that matters: the Megalodon, waiting at strength 8.

No accounts, no ads, no data collected. Progress saves on your device.

name: Kiln Path: Mahjong Connect
description:
Match glazed ceramic tiles using paths that turn at most twice. Open the next panel by clearing every pair, or try the daily firing. Tap a tile and then its twin. The route can follow the outside edge of the board.

Tap Open the kiln for ad-free play. Adult studio adds optional rewarded hints and a one-time Studio Pass that removes studio banners and includes unlimited hints.

name: Kinapod Golf
description:
Turn an AirPod into a golf stroke analyzer.

Tuck one AirPod into the end of your club's grip and Kinapod Golf measures every stroke you hit, for putting and full swings. No extra sensor to buy.

AFTER EVERY STROKE
- Tempo: backswing time against downswing time
- Stroke length: how far you took the club back, and how far through
- Face rotation on putts: how much the face turned between address and impact
- Estimated club speed for full swings
- A 3D replay of the stroke in slow motion

HOW IT WORKS
- Hold still at address until the app shows ARMED, then play your shot
- The sensor feels the ball contact, so practice swings do not count
- A consistency score shows how repeatable your strokes are

FREE
- Every club and every number
- 10 strokes a day, 15 on your first day
- Your latest session stays open

KINAPOD GOLF PRO
- Unlimited practice: every stroke measured, not only 10 a day
- Every past session in the Sessions tab, with its stats and a replay of any stroke

Club speed is an estimate from the grip, not a launch monitor reading. Face rotation is always the change from your address position.

Your sessions stay on your iPhone. Nothing is uploaded.

Requires AirPods Pro or AirPods (3rd generation or later). The AirPod sits in the end of the grip: soft grips hold it as it is, and a free printable mount is available at kinapod.com/golf.

Privacy Policy: https://kinapod.com/golf/privacy/
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: KinderConnect – Kindergarten
description:
KinderConnect connects kindergartens, teachers and parents. Attendance, messaging, photos, invoices and forms – everything a daycare needs to run the day and keep families in the loop.

FOR TEACHERS AND STAFF
• Today view – check children in and out, log meals, naps and activities, and record who picked each child up
• Announcements for the whole kindergarten or a single group, with read receipts
• Photos and videos – share moments from the day with the right families
• Daily reports, health log and incident reports, exportable as PDF
• Polls, calendar events with RSVPs and document sharing

FOR PARENTS
• Your child's day: attendance, meals, naps, photos and notes
• Chat with your child's teachers
• Calendar with events and reminders
• Invoices, with online payment where your kindergarten offers it
• Consents and permission forms you sign on your phone
• Report an absence in a few taps

FOR OWNERS AND ADMINISTRATORS
• Children, guardians, groups and staff in one place
• One join link and QR code to invite families
• Role-based permissions and an audit log
• Invoices, payment tracking, reports and CSV exports

Available in English, Polish, Ukrainian, German, Russian, French, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Arabic, Hindi, Japanese, Korean and Chinese.

KinderConnect is built for childcare providers. Owners set up their kindergarten, and parents and teachers join with an invitation, a join code or a QR code. Your data is stored in the EU and is never sold or used for advertising.

name: Kiwi Pop: Match 3 Puzzle
description:
Match, pop and bring the forest back to life.

Kiwi Pop is a cosy match-3 puzzle game set in Aotearoa New Zealand. Swap colourful New Zealand forest treasures, such as kawakawa leaves and boysenberries, to reach each level's goal before your moves run out. A cute kiwi chick cheers you on all the way.

• 30 levels across three regions: the coast, the forest and the Southern Alps
• Make special blocks with bigger matches, then set them off for big moments
• Earn 1 to 3 stars on every level
• Your stars restore a native forest step by step and hatch kiwi chicks
• Tricky levels give a coin bonus on your first win
• Boosters such as Kiwi Peck and Dasher Starter, plus +5 moves, are bought with coins you earn by playing
• Original music, with sound and music switches in Settings
• Plays offline, with no ads and no account needed

Free to play. Optional in-app purchases for coins.

Take a breather, tap the next level and see what the forest has waiting for you.

name: Kopdes - Mini Market Empire
description:
Start small, dream big, and build your own retail empire in Kopdes – Mini Market Empire!

Experience the excitement of running your own supermarket in a charming business management simulation game. Turn a small neighborhood shop into a thriving retail business, manage daily operations, and become a successful supermarket entrepreneur.

BUILD YOUR DREAM SUPERMARKET

Start with a small shop and gradually transform it into a bustling supermarket. Expand your store, upgrade facilities, organize shelves, and create a welcoming shopping experience for your customers.

MANAGE PRODUCTS AND INVENTORY

Purchase products from suppliers, restock shelves, monitor inventory, and keep up with customer demand. Manage a wide variety of products, including food, beverages, daily necessities, and fresh goods.

SERVE CUSTOMERS AND GROW YOUR BUSINESS

Welcome customers, fulfill their shopping needs, and keep your checkout counters running smoothly. Improve customer satisfaction, build your store's reputation, and increase your profits.

HIRE AND MANAGE EMPLOYEES

Build your own team of cashiers, restockers, and warehouse staff. Delegate daily tasks, improve operational efficiency, and focus on growing your business instead of handling everything yourself.

MANAGE YOUR WAREHOUSE

Organize stock in your own warehouse, receive supplier deliveries, and maintain a healthy inventory. Plan your purchases carefully to keep your shelves full and your business running efficiently.

EXPLORE NEW BUSINESS OPPORTUNITIES

Expand beyond traditional retail with bakery products, fresh goods, and additional store facilities. Discover new opportunities to increase revenue and attract more customers.

OPEN MULTIPLE STORE BRANCHES

Grow beyond a single supermarket. Open new branches, manage inventory across different locations, monitor business performance, and build a successful retail network.

BECOME A RETAIL TYCOON

Make strategic business decisions, reinvest your profits, upgrade your facilities, and transform your humble shop into an impressive mini market empire.

GAME FEATURES

- Supermarket and retail business simulation
- Store customization and expansion
- Product purchasing and inventory management
- Customer shopping and checkout systems

- Warehouse and supplier delivery systems
- Bakery and fresh goods
- Multiple store branches

- Relaxing yet strategic gameplay

Whether you enjoy supermarket simulators, business tycoon games, shop management, or relaxing simulation games, Kopdes offers an engaging experience where every decision matters.

Start your entrepreneurial journey today. Build your store, grow your business, and create your own mini market empire!

name: Korean Maker: Raise a Korean
description:
Raise a Korean. Live one whole life born in 1960s–1990s South Korea, from a baby to the very end.

※ The game is in Korean only for now.

■ Live on top of that year's Korea
Real yearly figures — prices, minimum wage, unemployment, economic growth, exchange rates — flow straight into your life. Play a few lives and modern Korean economic history sticks with you.

■ Pick three slots
Each school term as a kid, every half year as a young adult, every year as a grown-up — pick three activities. Study, play or work. Your choices add up to a person.

■ Absurd, exaggerated life events
Events from each era shake up your life. Based on real statistics, exaggerated for laughs.

■ 310 endings
Five rarity tiers from Normal to Legend. Fill the collection and chase Legend endings with the guide's conditions.

■ 2x speed
Skip through a life faster with 2x speed.

Free to play. The only ads are rewarded ads shown when you tap "Watch an ad".
Lifetime, Choose Your Birth, Ending Guide and Birth Era Pack are one-time purchases; 10 Previews is used up as you use it.

name: Lahu Qalb
description:
Lahu Qalb (له قلب) is a set of animated picture books for children, in English and in Arabic. A narrator reads each page, and the words light up one by one with the voice. The EN | عربي switch on the bookshelf changes the language at any time.
The lessons come from the chapter on companionship and brotherhood in Ibn Qudamah's Mukhtasar Minhaj al-Qasidin.

Two stories:

• The Three Keys
Three keys that open hearts: saying salam, making space, and a favorite name. At the Qur'an circle, Zayd tries them with a new boy.

• The Three Steps
Three steps to help a friend: if he asks, before he asks, before yourself. Zayd climbs them with his friend Idris on kite day.

Two ways to read:
• Read to me: the narrator reads and the pages turn by themselves.
• I'll read it: the child reads at their own pace and taps any word to hear it.

After each story:
• "What would you do if…?" moments from a child's day: think first, then turn the page for the answer. They also open straight from each book's cover.
• Pages for parents: what the story teaches, the hadith and their sources, and tips for talking it over.

No ads, no accounts, and the app collects no data. Everything works offline.

© 2026 Signals Kernels AI LLC

name: Landlord Inspection
description:
Landlord Inspection helps landlords who manage a few rental homes record the condition of each property, simply and consistently, on their iPhone.

WALK THROUGH ROOM BY ROOM
• Start a move-in, move-out, routine or maintenance inspection in seconds; rooms are suggested from the property's bedrooms and bathrooms.
• Rate every item with one tap: Excellent, Good, Fair, Poor or N/A.
• Add comments, flag items that need attention, and add or remove rooms and items as you go.
• No Save button: everything is kept as you go, even if you leave the app mid-inspection.

PHOTOS AND METER READINGS
• Take photos for any item or room, or choose them from your library.
• Record electricity, gas and water readings with a photo of the meter.
• Location data is removed from inspection photos.

COMPARE MOVE-IN AND MOVE-OUT
• See which items were recorded lower, higher or unchanged between two inspections, room by room, with photos side by side.
• Comparisons show what was recorded. They don't decide the cause of a change or who is responsible.

CLEAR PDF REPORTS
• Create inspection, comparison and property condition reports with photos, meter readings and optional signature lines.
• Preview before sharing, then send by Mail, Messages, AirDrop or save to Files.
• Reports are records of the observations made by the person who carried out the inspection.

KEEP TRACK OF EACH PROPERTY
• A maintenance history with costs, contractors and dates.
• Every inspection and report of a property in one place.
• Reminders to finish a draft inspection.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account and no sign-in.
• Your properties, tenants, photos and reports stay on your iPhone. There is no tracking, analytics or advertising.

FREE AND PRO
Free includes one active property, up to 50 photos per inspection and 2 new reports a month.
Landlord Inspection Pro adds unlimited properties, photos and reports, full move-in / move-out comparisons and comparison reports. Pro is available monthly or yearly; the yearly plan includes a free trial for new subscribers. Prices are shown in the app.

Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel them in your Apple Account settings.

Privacy Policy: https://sites.google.com/view/landlordinspection/privacy-policy

name: LapSkip
description:
Lap Skip is a spoiler-free companion for watching motorsport race replays.

Every lap of the race is scored for entertainment: overtakes, close battles, pit-stop strategy, incidents. When a boring stretch is coming, you get a push: “Boring — skip 4m 30s”. When the action is back: “Come back — it’s getting good”.

• Spoiler-free: you only ever see what you have already watched
• Pushes and a Live Activity tell you exactly how far to fast-forward
• Tap “I skipped”, pause or re-sync the lap right from the Lock Screen

LAP SKIP PRO

name: Last Call Courier
description:
Last Call Courier — Every Second Counts!
The city never stops. The clock is ticking. And every delivery matters!
Step into the shoes of a fearless courier racing across city rooftops, dodging dangerous obstacles, collecting packages, and completing deliveries before time runs out.
With 99 action-packed levels, every second counts. Run, jump, dodge, and deliver your way through increasingly challenging routes as you race to become the ultimate courier.
GAME FEATURES
•	99 Challenging Levels: Conquer increasingly difficult delivery missions.
•	Fast-Paced Rooftop Action: Run, jump, and dodge obstacles while racing against the clock.

CAN YOU COMPLETE THE FINAL DELIVERY?
Every rooftop presents a new challenge. Every package brings you closer to victory. And every second could make the difference between success and failure.
Do you have what it takes to conquer all 99 levels?
Download Last Call Courier today and make every second count!

name: Lectio Reader's Bible
description:
Lectio is a reader's Bible for iPhone and iPad. It sets Scripture in a single column of paragraphed text, so you can read a book of the Bible the way you would read a book.

Verse numbers are not set in the reading line. When the menu is open, chapter and verse numerals appear in the margins, in the same Garamond figures as the text.

Two public-domain translations are included: the Berean Standard Bible and the King James Version. The type is EB Garamond. You can change the body size, follow the system appearance, or choose Light, Dark, or Faux Dark. A thin-paper show-through suggests the next page; Plain mode turns that off.

Search looks up words, topics, and meaning on this device. You can save passages and return to them later. Nothing is uploaded, and no account is required.

Lectio is built for quiet reading, not for study notes, commentary, or social features.

name: Leonida Maps Atlas
description:
This is an unofficial fan app. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Rockstar Games or Take-Two Interactive.

Leonida Maps is a map and notebook for players of Grand Theft Auto VI. Find a place, save your own pins, keep a collectibles checklist and read guides, even without internet.

MAP OF LEONIDA
• full-screen map with place search and category filters
• a place card with details when you tap a pin
• your own pins with a title and a note, stored on your device

COLLECTIBLES
• a checklist with counters and a progress bar
• check off what you already have
• locations appear only once they are verified in the game, so today the list holds names and counts

DAILY PUZZLE
• a new "find the place" challenge every day
• an optional reminder that you switch on yourself

GUIDES
• 37 guides you can read offline

PROGRESS IMPORT
• bring your progress from the website mapaleonidy.com into the app

FREE AND PRO
• free: 25 check-offs, 3 pins of your own and one banner ad on two list screens
• Pro forever, a one-time purchase (not a subscription): unlimited check-offs and pins, the detailed map offline (about 10 MB download) and no ads

name: Lexico Écoute à la maison Pro
description:
Lexico Écoute à la maison Pro est la version de Lexico Écoute pour s’entraîner chez soi : un matériel complet pour entraîner la perception auditive et le traitement auditif du langage, sur quatre niveaux : bruits, sons, syllabes et mots.

À la maison :
Un seul profil, tout le matériel sur iPhone au format portrait, et les devoirs donnés par l’orthophoniste ou le logopédiste s’ouvrent directement dans l’app, par lien ou par code. On s’entraîne ainsi aussi entre les séances, plus souvent et plus près du quotidien, et les résultats sont transmis automatiquement au cabinet. Un entraînement plus fréquent favorise des progrès plus rapides.

L’app a été conçue avec la collaboration active de nombreux orthophonistes et logopédistes. Les contenus se choisissent par son cible, position du son ou thème, et la difficulté s’adapte à chaque personne. Ce sont les mêmes exercices que dans les cabinets d’orthophonie et de logopédie, l’enseignement spécialisé et les hôpitaux. Le journal enregistre chaque exercice.

Exemples d’utilisation selon l’objectif thérapeutique :

• Discrimination auditive : distinguer des bruits, des sons, des syllabes et des mots proches avec « Pareil ou différent ? » et « Lequel des deux ? », par exemple à partir de paires minimales.

• Conscience phonologique : repérer un son avec « Le son est-il dans le mot ? » et « Quel son est dans le mot ? », déterminer sa place avec « Position du son », compter les syllabes et les sons, trouver des rimes, assembler syllabes et mots avec « Fusion de syllabes » et « Fusion de mots ».

• Troubles des sons de la parole : entraîner l’écoute du son cible en appui à la rééducation articulatoire et phonologique, avec des paires minimales et des mots inventés classés par processus phonologiques. « Vrai ou faux ? » permet de juger si ce que l’on entend correspond à l’image ou si un mot existe vraiment.

• Lecture et dyslexie : les exercices sur les syllabes, les sons, les rimes et la position du son soutiennent l’apprentissage de la lecture et la prise en charge de la dyslexie.

• Traitement auditif et attention auditive : « Écoute dichotique » (un contenu différent sur chaque oreille) et bruit de fond réglable pour apprendre à filtrer l’information utile ; « Séquence » et « Memory » pour entraîner la mémoire auditive.

• Découverte : « Écouter » pour découvrir bruits, sons, syllabes et mots, « Trouver » pour les identifier, « Contre la montre » pour en retrouver le plus possible en une minute.

Autres indications : trouble développemental du langage, dysarthrie, apraxie de la parole, aphasie, français langue étrangère ou seconde.

Un matériel très complet : Lexico Écoute à la maison Pro contient plus de 1 250 mots et plus de 1 100 images, plus de 300 mots inventés classés par processus phonologiques, plus de 500 paires minimales, 60 paires de rimes, plus de 750 syllabes, les sons du français et plus de 200 bruits. Tous les contenus sont enregistrés et rangés en plus de 450 listes prêtes à l’emploi, sans abonnement.

Politique de confidentialité : https://lexico.ch/fr/politique-de-confidentialite-et-conditions-dutilisation/

name: Libéralo: Corre a la Corte
description:
¡Libéralo! es un juego divertido y fácil: corre por la ciudad, junta los papeles y llega a la corte para que tu personaje salga ¡LIBRE!

• Toca la pantalla para saltar, y dos veces para saltar más alto.

Un juego de Libertad Legal Group. Es solo entretenimiento, no es asesoría legal.

name: Liftathlon
description:
Liftathlon builds a training plan around your goals and your week, then helps you follow it session by session.

TELL IT WHAT YOU WANT
Pick one goal or several: build muscle, lose weight, get fitter, run 5 km to a marathon, or finish a triathlon from sprint to full distance. Choose your training days, your fitness level and the equipment you have. Liftathlon lays out the weeks, with phases that build up and a taper before your event.

TRAIN WITH IT
- See today's sessions and how long they take
- Log sets, reps and weight with last time's numbers beside each set
- A rest timer on your lock screen and in the Dynamic Island
- An animated demonstration for every exercise
- Log runs, rides and swims with pace worked out for you

WHEN LIFE GETS IN THE WAY
- Move or skip a session, or catch up on one you missed
- Make it an easy week

SEE YOUR PROGRESS
- Personal records and a chart for every exercise
- Weekly volume and training streak
- Planned against completed hours, and your longest sessions
- Body weight, measurements and progress photos

WORKS WITH APPLE HEALTH
Workouts recorded by your watch or other apps appear automatically and tick off the matching session. Your gym sessions are saved back to Health.

Your data stays on your iPhone and in your own iCloud. No adverts, no tracking, and your plan is built on your phone.

name: Limpiz
description:
Limpiz est l'application collaborative des entreprises de nettoyage. Gérants, superviseurs, agents et clients travaillent dans la même app, et chacun voit ce qui le concerne.

POUR LES AGENTS
• Missions du jour et calendrier
• Pointage par QR code sur le chantier
• Photos avant / après et signature du client

• Historique des passages et heures réalisées

• Chantiers ponctuels ou récurrents : les interventions sont générées automatiquement

• Demande de prestation ponctuelle ou récurrente
• Suivi de chaque demande étape par étape

Notifications en temps réel et 8 langues : français, anglais, espagnol, italien, allemand, grec, portugais et roumain.

name: Listo
description:
Listo organizes your shopping list by store and aisle. Add items to more than one store, then check them off once when you find them.

Add stores by name, set quantities, and share your list when you need to. Listo supports English, French, and Arabic, with light and dark appearance options.

name: Live Pulse: Nearby Market
description:
Live Pulse connects you with the people selling around you, right now: shops, home kitchens, street carts and helpers.

NEED SOMETHING NOW?
• Post what you need, with a photo if you like: a birthday cake for tonight, a dozen eggs, a plumber, a hot meal.
• Sellers who are online near you see it for 30 minutes and answer with their price.
• Take the answer you like. A deal opens and you chat inside the app, then meet or get it delivered.

SEE WHO IS SELLING AROUND YOU
• Sellers who are online right now, with real photos of what they have today.
• Search by what they sell, choose 1, 3 or 5 km, or look at the map.
• Ask a seller about an offer directly.

SELLING TODAY?
• Make a seller profile and add your offers with photos taken with your camera.
• Go online in one tap. Buyers near you find you, wherever you set up today.
• Street sellers can let buyers see where they are as they move while online.
• Answer the requests of buyers around you with your price.

PRIVATE AND SAFE

• Your phone number stays hidden. Share it in a deal only if you want to.
• Chat messages leave our server as soon as they reach the other phone.
• Block and report anyone, from any screen.
• No ads, and we never sell your data.

ALL YOUR DEALS IN ONE PLACE
Open, done or closed, every deal and its chat is easy to find again.

IN YOUR LANGUAGE
Bangla, English, Arabic, Hindi, Urdu, French, Spanish, German, Turkish, Indonesian, Malay and Vietnamese, in light or dark.

PRICES
Free for buyers. Free for sellers during launch.

description:
Lon Ton Miền Tây – con đường đến trường đầy bất ngờ của cô bé miền Tây!

Mỗi sáng, cô bé đội nón lá, đeo cặp, lon ton đi học qua xóm nhỏ. Nhưng con đường làng chẳng hề yên bình: chó nhà ai lao ra sủa, gà mẹ xù lông bảo vệ đàn con, đàn ngỗng hùng hổ đuổi theo, cầu khỉ chông chênh lắc lư…

name: Lost & Honk
description:
A Canada goose honks twice by the dock. She’s found a basket of lost things, and Winston needs your help returning them. Start with three beach balls at a pixel-art lakeside stop inspired by Canada, then find out who comes back for the rest.

Pick an item you can reach, then gather three of a kind to clear space in your tray. Tip the basket to slide a stack aside and reveal what’s underneath. At the dock, raise or lower the divider to decide what can slide through.

• Help Winston make his first return, then solve 50 story puzzles across the lakeside and the dock.
• Meet the people who come back for their things and revisit their receipts in the Lost & found log. When Maya’s dock drawing appears at the booth, tap it to open the matching entry.
• Chase your personal best in Endless mode. Come back to the same basket after closing the app.

name: Lumesh
description:
Lumesh is a messaging app and a toolkit for MeshCore radios. Pair your own MeshCore LoRa radio and message people on your local mesh with no cell service, no internet and no account. Everyday messaging is free. If you look after repeaters, a one-time Operator unlock adds the tools that keep a mesh running.

FREE: CHATS
- One Chats inbox: every channel and direct conversation together, newest first, with filters and search.
- Room servers are chats too. A room password you choose to remember stays in this device's Keychain.
- Direct messages show their status. They retry by themselves and, if the stored route fails, try the whole mesh. Messages typed while your radio is away go when it's back.
- Reply and react like other MeshCore apps, share a map pin or a contact, and split long messages into parts.
- MECP emergency codes show as readable cards.
- Strangers wait in Requests. Block, filter words, fold fast posters, show only trusted posters, or hide open channels.
- Keep conversations on your phone, or delete them after 7 to 90 days.

FREE: SAFETY
SOS lives in Control > Safety, away from everyday screens: hold, then confirm. It goes to your private Family channel, with your location if you choose. Going somewhere remote? Trip mode keeps SOS and an "I'm safe" check-in at the top of Chats until the trip ends. An SOS is a text message: it needs your radio and someone on the mesh in range to receive it. Lumesh is not an emergency service and is not a substitute for emergency services.

FREE: RADIO AND MESH
- Connect over Bluetooth, or over Wi-Fi by address for radios on MeshCore's Wi-Fi companion firmware.
- Setup compares your radio with the community presets for your region, each with its source.
- Reconnects by itself, matches your radio's time zone to your phone's, and helps fix a radio clock that runs ahead.
- Keep contacts on your phone beyond what your radio holds. Sort people into circles, choose who can learn where your radio is, and verify someone in person by QR code.
- Map: your mesh drawn on the phone, live traffic, and optional Apple Maps or USGS Topo imagery.
- No radio yet? Coverage near me shows repeaters a public map heard near you this week. It asks before going online.
- Repeaters: read health and owner, log in as admin, set location remotely, trace and find a route in Path Lab, noise floor, discover nearby and radio settings.

OPERATOR: ONE-TIME IN-APP PURCHASE
Bought once and shared through Family Sharing. No subscription, no wait timers. It includes:
- Autopilot: checks the repeaters you mark as yours on a schedule, sets a clock that reset or fell behind (with a saved admin password), re-checks to prove it, and alerts you when one needs a person.
- Health history: 90 days of battery, noise and airtime charts on your device, CSV export, scheduled reads, and a falling-battery alert.
- Path Lab pro: Ping 20x with round trip and jitter, compare routes, write the better route to your radio, and the route map.
- Line of sight: whether the ground between two radios blocks the signal, from terrain stored on your device. Download an area once from Apple, then check offline, anywhere in the world (on a Mac, macOS 26.4 or later).
- Reach circles: how far each repeater has been heard, and an estimate, on the map.
Try every Operator feature on sample data first.

WHAT YOU NEED
A MeshCore companion radio and others on the same mesh. Without a radio, Lumesh shows labeled sample data so you can look around. The app is in English.

PRIVACY
Lumesh collects no data: no account, no analytics, no ads. Messages, contacts and settings stay on your device and radio. Control > About > Internet requests lists every request Lumesh itself sends and names the Apple map and terrain downloads it can't count. The internet is used only for map imagery, terrain and the optional CoreScope public map, when you turn them on, agree or tap.

Lumesh is independent and not affiliated with the MeshCore project or CoreScope.

name: Lumi — O meu ritmo
description:
Track your menstrual cycle at your own pace. Log flow, symptoms and how you feel, check your history, and see estimates for upcoming periods. Your diary is encrypted on your iPhone.

The free plan includes the diary, calendar, basic predictions and export of your records as JSON. Lumi Premium lets you compare symptoms across cycles, create PDF reports and customize reminders. You can also send selected dates to an iPhone calendar, including Google and iCloud.

Try Premium for 30 days by activating the trial in Lumi. Payment starts only if you confirm a monthly or yearly subscription in the App Store. Subscriptions renew automatically and can be managed in your Apple Account settings.

Predictions are estimates for personal tracking.

name: Lumi's AI Lab™
description:
Lumi's AI Lab™ is a puzzle game from Dew Brook, fun for all ages.

A storm knocked out the power and Lumi, the lab's little robot, can't fix it alone. Solve puzzles to bring each room back online, from the server closet all the way to the language core.

TEN ROOMS, TEN KINDS OF PUZZLES
• Tile routing: turn pipes so coolant, power and data reach their racks
• Cooling: place fans so every rack is just right
• Grid bridge: build cable trays across the gap
• Rack packing: fit the servers into their racks
• Load balancing: share the traffic so no server overheats
• Binary Bits: light bulbs worth 8, 4, 2 and 1 to make each number
• Logic Gates: flip switches through AND, OR, NOT and XOR
• Pixel Chip: use the numbers to light up a hidden picture
• Train the AI: teach Byte, the little AI, by showing examples
• Next Word: think like an AI and guess the word that comes next

EASY TO START, HARD TO MASTER
• 600 puzzles: Easy, Medium and Hard in every room
• Up to 3 stars a puzzle. Finish in fewer moves for more stars
• Stuck? Tap Lumi any time to see the rules, and a free hint shows up after a few tries
• No timers and no lives. Undo is always free
• Plays on iPhone and iPad, held either way up

EVERY DAY
• Daily Rack: 3 new puzzles every day
• Weekly Mix: one puzzle from each room, new every week

EARN, NEVER BUY
• Stars, Daily wins and Weekly badges unlock outfits for Lumi and parts for your own data center
• Outfits and room parts are never sold

WHAT'S FREE AND WHAT ISN'T
• Free: 200 puzzles (every Easy puzzle, plus Medium 1 to 5 and Hard 1 to 5 in every room), the Daily Rack, the Weekly Mix, all stars, outfits and room parts
• Paid: a one-time in-app purchase that opens the other 400 puzzles. Family Sharing is on, so one purchase covers your family
• Ads are optional and only play when you choose: watch one to unlock a single puzzle, get 3 more Daily puzzles, or catch up a missed day
• No subscriptions and no coin packs
• Restore Purchases is on the unlock screen and in Settings

Made by Dew Brook, a small game studio. Lumi's AI Lab™ is a trademark of Dew Brook LLC. © 2026 Dew Brook LLC.
Questions? support@dewbrook.com

name: Lumitwirl
description: Lumitwirl is a fruit-themed spin and merge puzzle game. Twirl the luminous fruit wheel, place juicy harvests on the board, and connect matching fruits to craft higher tiers. Play Classic Orbit levels, chase Endless Twirl high scores, take on Daily Orbit challenges, and unlock fruit lore in the Codex. Clear goals, build combos, and enjoy bright casual gameplay made for quick sessions.

name: Lyfstyle: Fonts Keyboard
description:
Make every word stand out.

Lyfstyle turns your words into cursive, bold, bubble, gothic and sparkly text for bios, captions, names and chats. Type once, see every look, then copy and paste anywhere. Or switch to the Lyfstyle keyboard and type in style in any app.

WHAT'S INSIDE
• 100+ text styles in easy groups: cursive & cute, bold & clean, bubbles, gothic, glitch effects, emoji frames and kaomoji
• A keyboard that shows your chosen font right on the keys
• 100+ keyboard themes: colours, textures and pictures – K-pop, pride, movies, music, art, nature and more
• Your own photo as the keyboard background
• Mix your own colours on a colour wheel
• Translate your message right in the keyboard
• 112 ready-made bios and captions
• Tools: story cards, emoji letters, username ideas, text repeater and symbols
• Translating in the keyboard needs iOS 26 or later

PAY ONCE, KEEP FOREVER
Script, Sans Bold and Sparkles are free. Lifetime Pro unlocks everything with one payment: no weekly subscription and no trial that renews by itself.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No ads. No account. No tracking. Lyfstyle doesn't collect what you type. Password, email and number fields always get plain text.

Styled letters are Unicode characters, so they work in Instagram, TikTok, WhatsApp, Snapchat, Discord and lots more. Some symbols can look a little different in some apps.

name: Madares Parents
description:
Madares is the official parent app for schools that use the Madares platform. Everything about your children's school life is in one place, so you can follow their day and reach the school easily.

What you can do:
• Student overview: a daily summary with today's periods, the next exam and the latest updates.
• Timetable: each day's periods with subjects, teachers and times.
• Attendance: a clear attendance record for each child.
• Homework: what's due, late and done, with details and attachments.
• Exams: upcoming exam dates and details.
• Grades and performance: results per subject so you can follow progress.
• Behaviour: behaviour notes recorded by the school.
• Class activities: what's happening in class.
• Reports and evaluations: published teacher reports, notes and ratings.
• Fees and payments: total fees, amount paid and remaining balance, an alert for overdue installments, and a list of recorded payments.
• School announcements: trips, meetings and important dates as soon as they're posted.
• Messages: talk to the school directly and get replies in the app, with photo or voice message attachments.
• Surveys: share your feedback in school surveys.
• School bus: notifications when your child boards, arrives at school and is dropped off, plus route status.
• School pickup: send a pickup request and manage who is allowed to collect your child.
• Instant notifications so you never miss an update.
• Several children, even at different schools, in one account.
• Full Arabic interface with English support.

Note: Madares works with schools subscribed to the Madares platform. Available features depend on what your school has turned on.

name: MAEK PT
description:
LET OP: JE HEBT EEN MAEK PT ACCOUNT NODIG OM IN TE LOGGEN IN DEZE APP. 

Sporten is nog leuker met onze MAEK PT Fitness app. Gratis te gebruiken voor al onze leden! De ideale App voor een fit én gezond leven. Bereik je doelen en blijf gemotiveerd met de nieuwe MAEK PT app. Houd je workouts en vooruitgang bij en laat ons je op weg helpen.

Met de MAEK PT app kun je:
• De lesroosters en de openingstijden van jouw club bekijken
• Je dagelijkse fitnessactiviteiten bijhouden
• Je gewicht en andere statistieken invoeren en je voortgang bijhouden
• Duidelijke 3D demonstraties bekijken (er staan meer dan 2000 oefeningen in!)
• Vele kant-en-klare workouts gebruiken
• Zelf workouts samenstellen
• Meer dan 150 achievements verdienen

Kies de workout die bij jou past en start met jouw ideale training: in de sportschool of thuis. Houd je fitnessprestaties bij van conditie tot kracht, van afvallen tot groepsles: deze App is jouw eigen Personal Trainer en geeft je de motivatie die je nodig hebt! Upgrade naar de PRO-versie en je krijgt nog meer extra’s!

Je kunt deze app syncen met de Apple Gezondheid App. Wanneer je deze connectie activeert, worden je workouts in de Gezondheid app automatisch toegevoegd aan je activiteitenkalender.

name: Maelai
description:
Maelai is a private archive for the hour between a dream and a morning. It gives you one quiet place to keep the image before the day takes it away: choose a form, mark what stayed, and write the fragment in your own words.

There is no account, no feed, no cloud and no audience. The archive lives on this iPhone.

name: Mahjong Critters
description:
Mahjong Critters is a calm, cozy mahjong solitaire game. Instead of traditional symbols, the tiles show cute animals and big, colorful numbers, so they are easy to recognize at a glance.

HOW TO PLAY
Tap two matching tiles to remove them. A tile is free when nothing is on top of it and its left or right side is open. Clear the whole board to win!

FEATURES
- 12 hand-made layouts, from a quick warm-up to the 164-tile Master board
- A new daily challenge every day, with a streak counter
- Large, clear tiles designed for comfortable play
- Every board can always be solved
- Unlimited hints, undo and shuffle
- Highlight free tiles to make it easier to see your moves
- Best time saved for every level
- Gentle sounds and haptics (can be turned off)
- Works offline

Remove the banner ad with a monthly subscription or a one-time purchase.

The game interface is currently in Portuguese.

Privacy Policy and Terms of Use: see the links on this page.

name: Mahjong Family: Tile Solitaire
description:
Mahjong Family is the relaxing mahjong solitaire with no ads. Not one. Ever.

Find matching pairs of free tiles and clear the board. It is easy to learn and a pleasure to play every day, at your own pace.

WHAT YOU GET
• 600 levels and a new chapter every week
• Daily challenge
• 3 free hints and 3 free shuffles every day
• Shuffling is always free when you get stuck
• Big, easy-to-see tiles, with themes for day or night play
• A postcard album to collect as you progress
• Themed collections: Deep Sea, Little Farm, Tropical Fruits, Flower Garden and many more

PLAY WITH YOUR FAMILY PHOTOS
Turn photos of the people you love into game tiles. Grandkids, children, trips, the family dog: every game becomes a memory.

BAY PASS (OPTIONAL)
Paying is optional: it speeds things up and adds style, it never locks you out. Pass members get:
• A new collection every month, unlocked right away
• Every collection released so far and every tile set
• Tiles with your own photos
• Unlimited hints and auto-help
• Streak protection: missing 1 day does not reset it

The Pass is an auto-renewing subscription charged to your Apple Account. Plans: monthly, annual (with a 7-day free trial) and family (up to 6 people with Family Sharing). It renews automatically unless turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the period. You can cancel anytime in Settings > your name > Subscriptions, and you keep access until the end of the period you already paid for.

name: Maid of Orléans
description:
France, 1429. The English hold half the kingdom and Orléans is about to fall. Lead Joan of Arc and her captains through eight battles, from breaking the siege of Orléans to the road to Reims and the crowning of the king.

Fight in real time with sword, bow and shield, then switch to Jean de Metz, La Hire and the other generals whenever you need them. Send squads, captains and cannons across the battlefield from the tactics map, hire soldiers, storm gates and towers, free prisoners and guard your king. Every victory brings experience: raise your heroes' attributes, learn new skills and equip the swords, armour and charms you find along the way.

• Eight story missions across 1429, each with its own map, bosses and side objectives
• Four playable generals and the armies that follow them
• Four difficulty levels, from Easy to Very Hard
• Play Missions 1–2 free, and unlock the Full Campaign (Missions 3–8) with a single one-time purchase

name: Mantar: Mushroom Forager
description:
One wrong bite and you are the snack.

Mantar is a free multiplayer forest game about real mushrooms. Eat mushrooms to grow, swallow smaller foragers, and dash away from bigger ones. But you only know the red Fly Agaric when you start, and it's poisonous. Every other mushroom is a gamble until you learn it.

LEARN BY FORAGING
• 100 real species, from Chanterelles and Penny Buns to the deadly Destroying Angel
• Stand still to examine a mushroom up close: its gills, stem, smell and flesh
• Lookalikes are the danger: learn the tells that separate the tasty from the toxic
• Your field notes remember everything you've learned, life after life

PLAY TOGETHER
• Real players and friendly bots on shared islands
• Golden mushroom races, leader bounties and multi-chomps
• Play-with-friends parties: friends spawn together and can't eat each other
• Badges, unlockable hats and a weekly Hall of Fame

Beware the psychedelic ones: the forest warps, and the gnomes come for you.

No ads. No accounts. No in-app purchases.

Mantar teaches mushroom identification as a game. Never eat a wild mushroom unless an expert has identified it in person.

name: Mapita: Calm Trip Guide
description:
Mapita is a calm trip guide for people who feel a little anxious about trips and dislike planning.

For each destination, Mapita draws one simple, hand-made map that shows only what matters: the towns and areas, the things to do, and how long it takes to drive between them. No clutter, no endless lists.

ONE CALM MAP
See where everything is at a glance. Towns and neighbourhoods have clear outlines, and the drive times stand on the roads. Tap a place for a short card, or an area's name for what it is like to stay there.

GETTING AROUND
The usual trips, such as the airport to your hotel, with every sensible way to make them, side by side: time, cost, and the easiest choice. What each way works like here, from buses to ride apps.

GOOD TO KNOW
Money, plugs, time, tap water, tipping, entry papers and the rules that catch visitors out, in short, plain sentences. The US travel advisory level is read live where it applies.

EVERY PLACE, CHECKED BY HAND
Every fact comes from official and dated sources and is checked a second time. Beaches say whether they are safe to swim. Closures that end on a known day disappear from the app on their own.

SEARCH
Find everything the guide says about a word, or about one area, in one place.

CALM BY DESIGN
The maps and guides work without a connection. Directions open in Apple Maps or Google Maps. No account, no ads, no tracking.

Destinations: Los Cabos, Austin and New York, with more on the way.

Maps are made from OpenStreetMap data, © OpenStreetMap contributors. Photos come from Wikimedia Commons, each with its author and licence.

name: Marblino: Marble Run Builder
description:
With Marblino, children build their own marble run: drag a piece from the tray, attach it, let the marble go. The app works without any text, so children who cannot read yet can simply start building.

BUILD
• 48 track pieces: straights, curves and ramps, plus a loop, cannon, hoop, funnel, trampoline, seesaw, carousel, water wheel, xylophone and many more
• Chain reactions with dominoes and a pendulum
• Pieces snap together by themselves. If you like, a line shows in advance where the marble will roll
• Example tracks to watch and build on, plus random tracks at the roll of a dice
• Your own tracks are kept in the album

WATCH
• The camera rides along: behind the marble, from the marble's view or from the side
• Ten marbles from glass to rainbow. New marbles are earned with stars

CHALLENGES
• Every level has a gap in the track. Which pieces get the marble to the goal?
• Up to three stars per level

FOR PARENTS
• No ads, no subscription, no data collection
• Works without internet, also in the car
• Purchases and links are behind a parental gate
• One-time purchases with Family Sharing

FREE
• Free building in the garden with all 48 track pieces
• The ten levels in the garden

STARTER PACK (one-time purchase)
• Four more worlds: the moon with low gravity, mini golf, city and winter
• 40 more levels
• Random levels with new challenges every time
• Races against your own best time

DINO PACK (one-time purchase, also without the starter pack)
• The dino island with ten levels, random levels and races
• Seven dino pieces for every world: the marble rolls down the Brachiosaurus's neck, disappears into the T-Rex's mouth and flies off with the pterosaur. Plus Triceratops, volcano, dino egg and nest

name: Marceline Robotics
description:
صديقك جاهز. مع Marceline Robotics، سمِّ مداليتك وخصّص شاشتها حسب مزاجك.

اختر من 37 تعبيراً متحركاً، أو اكتب رسالة بالعربية أو الإنكليزية. جهّز صورك ومقاطعك القصيرة لعرضها بالأبيض والأسود، واحفظ تصاميمك المفضلة على الهاتف.

اعرض كلمات الأغاني بتوقيتها أو فوق صورة تختارها. العرض صامت، ويمكن استيراد كلماتك من ملف أو البحث عنها عند توفرها.

تقدر تجهّز التصميم وتعاينه على الهاتف. الإرسال إلى الشاشة يحتاج مدالية Marceline أصلية ومعتمدة ومتوافقة مع هذا الإصدار، واتصال بلوتوث. استخدام التطبيق لا يتطلب حساباً، وبريد التواصل اختياري.

name: Maré de Lume
description:
A tiny glowing seed is crossing a water garden. Watch the next flower as it drifts, then tap when it crosses the line to send the seed into the air. Land near the center to earn more points.

Chain perfect landings to multiply your score. The opening blooms move to different rhythms, and the timing window narrows as you travel farther. Every landing leaves ripples and little lights across the water.

Play a quick round or chase the personal best saved on your device. Pause whenever you need to, and switch on the sound to hear each leap.

A banner may appear when you open the game. A full-screen ad may appear at the end of a round.

name: Marid Owner
description:
MARID Owner is the all-in-one management app for restaurant and store owners on the MARID delivery platform.

Manage your business, handle incoming orders, and stay connected with your customers wherever you are.

Key Features:

• Instant Order Notifications: Receive new orders in real time so you never miss an order.

• Order Management: Accept incoming orders, manage preparation, and mark orders as ready for handover.

• Menu Management: Easily add, edit, and manage products, categories, prices, options, and special offers.

• Cashier Accounts: Create and manage cashier accounts for your employees with convenient access to store operations.

• Wallet & Earnings: Track your wallet balance and monitor your earnings.

• Multi-Language Support: Use MARID Owner in Arabic or English.

MARID Owner gives you the tools to manage your daily operations and grow your business efficiently.

Download MARID Owner and manage your business anytime, anywhere.

name: Math: Adding & Subtracting
description:
Adding and subtracting in seven small levels – from number bonds to story problems.

The app guides children from about 6 years old step by step through the math of the first two school years:
1. Numbers to 10: number bonds
2. Adding and subtracting to 20 without crossing ten
3. Crossing ten up to 20
4. Numbers to 100: tens, ones, neighbours
5. Adding and subtracting to 100 without crossing a ten
6. Adding and subtracting to 100 crossing a ten
7. Word problems and missing numbers

HOW CHILDREN PRACTICE
• Work it out: type the answer on a big number pad
• Ten frames and bars of ten: see numbers and understand them
• Missing numbers: 8 + ? = 13 – which number is missing?
• Comparing: greater than, less than or equal?
• Neighbouring numbers and tens
• Story problems: 12 children are on the bus, 5 get off …

Every round has 10 questions. A wrong answer gets a hint and a second try. The hints show the way across the ten (8 + 2 = 10, then 3 more) instead of just saying “wrong”. Facts that haven’t stuck yet come back in later rounds. Finish a round with three stars to earn a badge and a certificate.

HUNDRED SQUARE
Every number from 1 to 100 to tap – with bars of ten, ones and neighbouring numbers, read aloud if you like.

READ ALOUD
The app reads questions and story problems aloud with the device’s own English voice, even offline.

FOR PARENTS
• Up to 4 children with their own progress on one device
• The parents’ area shows which facts are currently being practiced again
• No ads, no tracking, no account, no data collection
• Works completely offline
• Large text (Dynamic Type), high contrast, Dark Mode, Reduce Motion
• Parents’ area with a parental gate for purchases, settings and links

FREE AND FULL VERSION
Levels 1 and 2 (number bonds to 10 and sums to 20 without crossing ten), the introduction and the hundred square are free to use without limits. Levels 3 to 7 are unlocked with a one-time in-app purchase (“Full version”, no subscription). With Family Sharing the purchase covers the whole family.

ALSO FROM CLAW LABS
“Times Tables: Learn & Practice” and “Telling Time: Clock Trainer”, each in seven levels.

Questions or ideas? Write to hello@clawlabs.cc.

name: MCLDeluvra
description:
How much of your next contribution can you allocate and still keep the cash you want on hand? MCLDeluvra lets you work through that question using your own holdings, prices and targets.

See where you stand
Record your cash, stocks and ETFs in one currency. Enter quantities and reference prices, then set your target percentages. The allocation map shows your actual and target weights side by side, with each gap measured in percentage points.

Try a funding plan
In Add Only, enter your new cash, the minimum you want to keep and the amount you want to allocate. See how much can go toward holdings below target and how much cash would remain. Switch to Target Comparison to see the theoretical change for each holding at your chosen mix.

Compare your options
Save up to three scenarios and compare ending cash, projected weights and the largest share of the portfolio. Adopt a plan when you’re ready. Your recorded balances change only when you record a new snapshot.

Review what changed
Compare a later snapshot with your plan. See what the quantity change was worth at the original reference price, then see the effect of the updated price separately. Add a note to explain any change in cash.

Export snapshots as a CSV, or save a full backup with your plans and optional photo attachments.

name: Megohm Soak
description: Megohm Soak is a logbook for the 10-minute insulation resistance test on a motor winding, done with your own megohmmeter and the motor isolated. Add a motor with its rated voltage, random-wound or form-wound winding, insulation class and insulation system, and the app suggests the test voltage. Start the timer and record a reading at each stop from 0.5 to 10 minutes: dial it in on the megohm ladder or type it. Set the winding temperature and the 1-minute reading is corrected to 40 °C. The app works out the polarization index, PI = 10-minute over 1-minute reading, and compares the corrected reading and PI with the minimums for that winding and class, following the practice of IEEE 43. Above 5,000 MΩ PI is not a criterion. On the curve, drag a point up or down to correct a reading and see PI change. A reading lower than the one before it is marked, and a test that is down by more than half since the last test at the same voltage is flagged. Each motor keeps its own history. Find a motor by name, share a test as text, and remember to discharge the winding after the test. There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: Memory Picks: Gallery Cleaner
description:
Twenty shots of the same sunset. Forty of the same picture. Memory Picks finds these photo sessions in your gallery, so you can keep the ones you love and clear out the rest.

Three ways to tidy up

Keep the masterpieces. Memory Picks puts photos of the same moment together in sessions. Go through them one by one and tap the trash or the tick. Anything you don't mark stays.

Random memories. A random pack of 20 photos from your whole gallery. Look back at old moments and let go of what you no longer need.

Replay your videos. Your videos one by one, each with its size. Speed them up to 2× or 4×, or start with the largest.

Safe by design
• Once you decide on a photo, it never comes back in any mode.
• Nothing goes until you confirm it in the iOS dialog, and deleted photos wait up to 30 days in Recently Deleted.
• Your favorites come first in a session.
• See how much space you got back.

Private
Memory Picks never uploads your photos. It looks at them on your iPhone, and what it learns about them stays only there. No account, no AI, no ads and no tracking.

Pricing
Looking through your gallery is free and unlimited. You can delete 100 photos and 10 videos for free. Memory Picks Pro removes the limit with a single one-time purchase. No subscription.

Privacy Policy: https://kiermates.dev/memorypicks/privacy/

name: MemoryPal
description:
MemoryPal helps you remember what you learn. Make flashcards in seconds, review a few each day, and MemoryPal brings each one back just before you'd forget it.

MAKE CARDS FAST • Type one card, paste a whole list, or turn your notes into cards. • Keep your notes with each set, with bold, italics and highlighting. Highlighted words become the blanks in your questions. • Build a set step by step: name it, add cards, and start studying. • Group them into decks for each subject, exam or language. • Ready-made everyday cards for names, routines and where things are kept.

REVIEW THAT FITS YOUR DAY • Start today's review with one tap. Easy cards come back later, hard ones sooner. • Type your answer and Smart Check tells you how close you were, or just think of it and reveal. • Quick 10, Deep study, Exam cram and weak cards first. • Quizzes that mix it up: multiple choice, fill the gap, true or false, match, put in order, and answer the other way round. • Talk-back: hear the question and answer out loud, hands-free. • Live AI tutor: a spoken conversation about your own cards. Answer in your own words, interrupt, ask for a hint or why, and it marks each card for you. • Make a study plan: say how much time you have and what's coming up, and get steps to tick off each day.

MAKE WITH AI • Turn your notes, a PDF or a photo of a page into clear study notes or practice questions. • Tell it how the cards should look, or give it questions your teacher has asked, and it follows that style. • Questions can point back to the page or sentence they came from. • Everything AI makes is labelled so you can check it, edit it, or report it. • Needs a free MemoryPal account and internet. You can turn AI off in Settings at any time.

TRAIN YOUR MEMORY • Memory techniques: turn any list or set into an acronym, a mini-story, a peg list, a memory palace, a chunk map or a link chain. • Puzzles for sequences, words and pairs.

SEE YOUR PROGRESS • Daily goal, streaks, levels and badges. • Daily reminders on your phone, if you want them. • See your last two weeks and what's coming up.

MADE FOR EVERYONE • Larger text options, a simpler-language mode and extra time in puzzles. • Read aloud on every card uses your device's own voice and works offline. • A mode for helping someone else, such as a family member. • Light and dark appearance, and full screen-reader support.

PRIVATE BY DEFAULT • Everything except AI and sync works offline. • Sync keeps your cards in step across your phone, tablet and computer through a private MemoryPal folder in your own Google Drive. Your cards never go to MemoryPal's servers. • AI requests, and your voice during a live tutor conversation, go to Google's Gemini service only when you use an AI feature. • No ads, no tracking.

MemoryPal is a study tool, not a medical device.

name: MENUpeño – Read any menu
description:
Sitting in a restaurant and can't read the menu? Take a photo. MENUpeño reads every dish, translates it into your language and lets you filter what you can eat.

How it works:

1. Pick the menu language (or "automatic") and your own language: English, German, Chinese, Japanese, Korean or about 30 more.
2. Photograph the menu, several pages are fine, or choose photos and screenshots.
3. The app finds dishes, descriptions, headings and prices, even in two columns.
4. You get a clean list with translation, original text and romanization (pinyin, romaji).

What you can do:
• Filter: meat, fish, peanuts, gluten, spicy, vegetarian, vegan and more. Tap once for "with", twice for "without".
• Your allergens: matching dishes are flagged or hidden.
• Prices in your currency at the current rate.
• Photo view: the translation sits right on top of the original photo.
• Order list: collect dishes and show the waiter in the menu's original language, plus phrases like "I am allergic to peanuts" in that language.
• Read aloud: the app pronounces the dish name.
• For iPhone Duo: in laptop posture the chosen dish appears large in the original on top for showing, you choose below. In book posture you see the menu on the left and the list on the right.

Good to know:
• Recognition and translation run on your device with Apple's text recognition and translation. Your photos are not uploaded, there is no account. iOS downloads language packs the first time and asks first.
• Ingredients are guessed automatically from the name and description and can be wrong. With allergies, always ask the staff. MENUpeño accepts no liability.
• An internet connection is only needed for exchange rates.

For iPhone, German, English and Chinese, light and dark.
