name: MeshSpace Messenger
description:
MeshSpace — chat without internet or mobile network.

Pair your MeshCore LoRa radio over Bluetooth and talk to people around you through the MeshCore mesh: radios and repeaters that pass messages on, miles at a time. When the mobile network is down, on a mountain, at sea or at a festival, your messages still get through.

SIMPLE MODE — EASY FOR EVERYONE
• Chats, Channels and Map — nothing else
• "Where are you?" sets your radio correctly in one tap
• "heard by 2" shows that the network passed your message on
• Big SOS button: sends your position to a channel you choose

ADVANCED MODE — FOR MESH ENTHUSIASTS
• Your own repeater dashboard: add any number, log in, advert, zero-hop advert, sync clock
• Routes, hops, path hash size, regions, radio settings and tools
• Repeater signal at a glance, live from every relayed packet

LOCATIONS AND SOS
• Coordinates shown right in the message
• Open in Google Maps or Apple Maps
• Share by SMS, e-mail or any app to someone with phone signal

MAP
• Every node your radio has heard; tap for details
• Walking and driving directions to any node
• Live mesh view with signals moving between repeaters

QUIET WHEN YOU WANT
• Mute everything, single channels or people
• Quiet hours, for example 22:00–07:00
• Spam and sender filter

MESHSPACE PRO (IN-APP PURCHASE)
Repeater management is MeshSpace Pro: try it for 3 days, then unlock it with a one-time purchase, or wait 20 seconds each time. Chats, channels, map and SOS never need a purchase.

WORKS WITH EVERY MESHCORE APP
Messages, locations and SOS are plain MeshCore text that every MeshCore app can read.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. Messages stay on your phone and your radio.

Requires a MeshCore companion radio (for example RAK WisMesh, Heltec or LilyGO with MeshCore companion firmware). SOS is not an emergency service; call 112 whenever you can.

name: MGSHP
description: markets, reviewing activity, , evaluating sector performance, and examining movements.Access interactive charts, updates, and brief research summaries while keeping relevant information organized in one convenient workspace.

name: Midnight Bakery: Tray Puzzles
description:
Run a late-night bakery, one pastry order at a time. Slide trays left and right and let gravity carry croissants, berry pies, and chocolate éclairs into the matching boxes.

Learn shelves, switches, linked trays, mixed boxes, and ribbon orders in the opening chapter. Replay each puzzle to earn three stars, or try the daily special for a new layout. The puzzles and original jazz soundtrack work offline.

The opening chapter, daily special, and expert preview are included. A one-time in-app purchase unlocks the full expert campaign.

name: Mile 27 Mileage Tracker
description:
Keep a mileage log without rebuilding your workweek from memory. Mile 27 helps contractors, self-employed professionals, and anyone who drives for work record trips, separate business from personal miles, and create reports for reimbursement or tax preparation.

TRACK YOUR DRIVES
Turn on Drive Detection and grant the location access it needs to record trips automatically. You can end a drive in progress or add a missed drive manually.

SORT BUSINESS FROM PERSONAL
Swipe right for Business or left for Personal. Add an optional purpose, such as Client visit or Job site, when you need more detail. Undo a classification if you change your mind.

BRING YOUR DRIVE HISTORY WITH YOU
Import past drives from a CSV or Excel file, then review the entries before saving.

SEE WHERE THE MILES WENT
Review routes and distances, save names for places you visit often, and organize drives by vehicle. View mileage estimates using your configured rate.

MAKE REPORTING EASIER
View mileage by month or year. Export PDF or Excel reports to share with your accountant or submit for reimbursement.

Automatic tracking requires appropriate iOS location permissions and does not continue after you force-quit the app. Mileage amounts are estimates and are not tax advice.

name: Mindphant
description:
Mindphant is a reminder app for the small, repetitive things at home.

Say it once
"Change the sheets every two weeks." "Rent is due on the 24th." No categories to pick, no dates to fill in. Mindphant prints a small ticket with what it understood: which thing, what to do, and when it comes up next.

Or share a screenshot
A parcel pickup message, a return page, a water or gas bill. Take a screenshot wherever you see it and share it to Mindphant. Pickup codes are printed large and copy with one tap. A photo of a paper bill, an insurance policy, or a medicine box works too.

On the day, the ticket shows up
What needs doing today hangs on the ticket rail. Tap Done and the next date is set for you.

At most one notification a day
You can mark things done right from the notification. On days when nothing is due, your phone stays quiet.

Things to look up are kept too
When the car insurance ends, the inspection date, the plate number, the policy number. They sit under Car and copy with one tap.

A record of what got done
How many times each thing was done and how much was paid. At the end of the year you can print one long ticket.

Stays on your phone
No account. Speech, photos, and screenshots are recognized on the device when possible. Export any time.

What you can keep track of
Bedroom, fridge, air conditioner, washer, water filter, car, pets, family birthdays, documents, medicine, household bills, parcels and returns. You can add your own.

name: MinuteQuarry
description:
Make focused time visible. Choose a session duration, name your work and start the timer. Pause, resume and recover the active timer after relaunch. Save elapsed time to your journal, add earlier sessions manually and edit dates, durations or notes. Review daily bars and total focused minutes over the last seven days. The timer uses elapsed time; it does not send background alarms or notifications.

Your records stay on this device. Sharing is initiated by you. No account, advertising or purchases are required.

name: Mirrors & Stars
description:
Mirrors & Stars is a calm, clever puzzle about arrows and mirrors.

Tap an arrow and it slides out along its path. Flip a mirror and the path bends. A dotted line always shows where each arrow will go, so you can think before you tap. Guide the arrows through the stars and collect all four in every level.

WHY YOU WILL LIKE IT
- 500 levels, and every one has a way to all four stars
- Flip mirrors between taps: plan the perfect order
- Smart hints set the mirrors for you and light up the next arrow
- Five hearts in every level, so you can learn without stress
- A daily gift, a season with rewards, and arrow colors to collect
- Bright, joyful look in light and dark mode
- Plays offline. No account needed
- 17 languages, including Arabic, English, Spanish, French, German, Hindi, Japanese, Korean and Chinese

Mirrors & Stars is free to play. It shows ads and offers optional in-app purchases (coin packs, remove ads, season pass). Colors are for looks only and never give an advantage.

name: Miseleaf
description:
Miseleaf is a focused, offline-first culinary companion created for calm and organized cooking in your kitchen. Designed with care for iPhone, Miseleaf brings clarity to meal preparation, recipe scaling, and ingredient planning.

KEY KITCHEN FEATURES:

• INGREDIENT PREP & MEAL TABLE
Organize your cooking station before turning on the stove. Consolidate required items, balance compatible units, and track collected ingredients at a glance.

• DYNAMIC RECIPE WORKSPACE
Seamlessly switch between Preparation, Cooking, and Tasting notes. View scaled ingredient measurements in real time without losing original proportions.

• INTUITIVE STEP TIMERS
Independent step timers keep you on track throughout complex courses. Timers run cleanly within your active session and update reliably.

• RECIPE VERSIONING & NOTEBOOK
Edit steps, cues, seasonings, and tags with complete peace of mind. Persistent version histories preserve your adjustments and variations across up to 30 revisions per dish.

• COMPLETE PRIVACY & OFFLINE INTEGRITY
Your recipe notes, modifications, and cooking journals remain entirely on your personal device. No accounts, no subscriptions, and no compulsory internet connection required.

Experience thoughtful cooking with Miseleaf — crafted for small, good moments in the kitchen.

name: Mizu Farm: Pig Escape!
description:
Mizu Farm: Pig Escape! is a tap-to-run escape puzzle: send every pig on the farm back to its own pen.

The rules are simple. Tap a pig whose way is clear, and it dashes straight ahead — in the direction its snout points — into the pen of its own color. A pig with another pig in front of it can't move. The puzzle is in reading the order: which pig has to leave first so the rest can follow?

A pig with nowhere to go can wait in one of the holding slots in the yard. There are five slots; two of them are locked (30 coins, or watch an ad, to open one for that stage). Every one of the 150 stages is designed to be solvable using only the three free slots. Stuck? You can restart the stage — a heart (up to 5) is spent when you enter a stage, and one more when you confirm a restart after making moves (restarting before any move costs nothing).

There are 150 stages in all, from a friendly 10 pigs to herds of more than 50, including 14 HARD stages. Your star rating depends on how few stuck taps you make — never on your time. Coins are earned only the first time you clear each stage.

There is also a daily bonus on a 7-day cycle, and Piggy Darts, a daily throw that can win coins and key tickets. Hearts refill one every 10 minutes (a gauge shows how long is left), and can also be restored with 30 coins, the daily bonus, or rewarded ads.

About ads: a banner ad appears at the bottom of the map screen, and a short ad may appear when you leave a stage you have cleared. Ads that unlock a holding slot or restore a heart are always your choice to watch. There are no in-app purchases.

- 150 stages (including 14 HARD), with herds of up to 56 pigs
- One-tap controls; the puzzle is in the leaving order
- Yard holding slots (locked slots open with coins or an ad)
- A 7-day daily bonus and Piggy Darts
- Hearts, coins and key tickets to manage as you go
- Progress is stored only on your device (ads appear only when online)

Made by MA DAYS.

name: Monster Legion RPG
description:
From a tiny slime to your own monster legion.

Summon allies and merge matching pairs to discover secret new forms. Arrange your frontline and backline, combining melee, magic and healing against waves of enemies and powerful bosses.

Battles play automatically. Choose three-way battle boosts and build lasting strength through summon upgrades and army expansion. Offline gold helps your legion grow when you return.

Free to play, with optional reward videos, occasional forced ads and optional in-app purchases. Progress and gold are saved on this device. Consumable gold cannot be restored. Restore ad removal using the same Apple Account.

name: Moonroom: Moon & Birth Chart
description:
Follow the Moon and explore the sky with a clear, detailed astrological chart.

MOONROOM FREE
• See the Moon’s zodiac sign, phase, illumination and lunar age.
• Check void-of-course periods and their start and end times.
• Explore the current chart with planetary positions, lunar nodes, major aspects and zodiac symbols.
• With location permission, see the twelve whole-sign houses and precise ASC, DSC, MC and IC positions for where you are.
• The current chart updates every minute while the app is open.

MOONROOM PREMIUM
• Enter a birth date, time and city to create a natal chart, or explore other moments from 1900 to 2100.
• Search cities with their local time zone selected automatically.
• Read an aspect list with precise orbs and explanations of the five major aspect types.
• Explore an interactive aspect matrix and the balance of elements and modalities.
• Swipe the wheel to move through time with the chart’s reference houses held fixed.
• Enjoy a white chart background and import or export chart data as CSV.
• Recall your last custom search or return to the present with NOW.

English, Italian, French, Spanish and German are supported. Chart calculations run on your device. City search requires an internet connection. No Moonroom account is needed.

OUR METHOD
Moonroom uses the tropical zodiac, geocentric positions, whole-sign houses and mean lunar nodes. The five major aspects use a maximum orb of 6°. Void of course runs from the Moon’s last exact major aspect to the traditional planets, Sun through Saturn, until the next sign ingress. Other astrological conventions may give different results. Interpretations are symbolic, not scientific predictions. The Moon’s surface and star background are illustrative; its phase is calculated.

SUBSCRIPTION
Premium is an optional monthly auto-renewing subscription. The price in your local currency is shown before purchase. Payment is charged to your Apple Account upon confirmation. The subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Manage or cancel it in your Apple Account subscription settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: MoreYou Fitness & Yoga Stüdyo
description:
MoreYou Fitness & Yoga Stüdyo ile stüdyo deneyimin artık tamamen cebinde.

Derslerini yönetmek, gelişimini takip etmek ve MoreYou Fitness & Yoga Stüdyo ile bağlantıda kalmak hiç bu kadar kolay olmamıştı. Üyeliğinden ders rezervasyonuna, performans takibinden etkinliklere kadar ihtiyacın olan her şey tek bir uygulamada.

Neler yapabilirsin?

QR ile hızlı giriş — MoreYou Fitness & Yoga Stüdyo’daki QR kodu okut, derse saniyeler içinde katıl.

Ders rezervasyonu — Eğitmeninle bireysel seans planla, grup derslerine katıl ve takvimini kolayca yönet.

Programını takip et — Planlanan, tamamlanan ve iptal edilen tüm derslerini tek ekranda görüntüle.

Paket yönetimi — Kalan ders hakkını, iptal haklarını ve paket detaylarını anlık olarak takip et.

Gelişimini izle — Kilo, vücut ölçüleri ve analizlerini grafiklerle görüntüleyerek ilerlemeni yakından takip et.

Su takibi — Günlük su hedefini belirle ve tüketimini kolayca kaydet.

Yarışmalar & sıralama — Adım ve katılım yarışmalarına katıl, diğer üyelerle yarışarak sıralamada yüksel.

Eğitmen profilleri — Eğitmenlerini yakından tanı, uzmanlık alanlarını ve sertifikalarını incele, değerlendirme bırak.

Etkinlikler & duyurular — MoreYou Fitness & Yoga Stüdyo’daki etkinliklerden ve önemli duyurulardan anında haberdar ol.

Akıllı bildirimler — Ders hatırlatmalarını ve önemli güncellemeleri kaçırma.

Hedeflerine giden yolda MoreYou Fitness & Yoga Stüdyo her zaman yanında. Hemen indir, antrenman deneyimini bir üst seviyeye taşı!

name: Motivationsdings: Tagesspruch
description:
Genug von Motivationssprüchen, die dich um sieben Uhr morgens anbrüllen, alles zu geben? Motivationsdings schickt dir einen Spruch am Tag. Mit Humor, mit Augenzwinkern und ohne Übertreibung.

„Glaub an dich selbst. Irgendjemand muss es ja tun.“
„Jeder Tag ist ein Neuanfang. Leider mit denselben Kollegen.“

SO FUNKTIONIERT'S
• Jeden Tag ein neuer Spruch als Mitteilung.
• Du bestimmst die Uhrzeit.
• Widget für den Home-Bildschirm.
• Teile jeden Spruch als Bild per WhatsApp, Instagram oder wo du willst.
• Speichere deine Favoriten und schau dir die Sprüche der letzten Tage an.
• Auf Deutsch und Spanisch. Die Sprüche sind nicht übersetzt, sondern für jede Sprache geschrieben.

THEMEN
• Montag (gratis)
• Arbeit
• Fitness & Diät
• Liebe
• Selbstständige
• Guru-Modus

GRATIS
Täglicher Spruch mit Mitteilung, Widget, Teilen, das Thema Montag, Archiv der letzten 3 Tage und bis zu 5 Favoriten.

VOLLVERSION: 10 €, EINMALIG
Alle Themen, auch alle, die noch kommen, komplettes Archiv, unbegrenzt Favoriten und keine Eigenwerbung. Kein Abo: Du zahlst einmal und sie gehört dir für immer.

DEINE PRIVATSPHÄRE
Keine Konten, keine fremde Werbung, kein Tracking. Deine Einstellungen und Favoriten bleiben auf deinem iPhone. Funktioniert ohne Internet.

Mehr Infos: motivationsdings.com

name: moveYak
description:
Know where every truck is, for free.

MoveYak Driver turns your drivers' phones into GPS trackers for your moving company. Your dispatchers see every truck on one live map in Fleet Tracker by MoveYak, so you can answer "Where's my truck?" without a phone call.

FREE FOR YOUR WHOLE TEAM
• No cost for dispatchers or drivers.
• No GPS hardware to buy or install. Drivers use the iPhone or Android phone they already carry.

SET UP IN MINUTES
1. Create your free dispatcher account at moveyak.com.
2. Enter a driver's phone number. You get an invite code to send them.
3. The driver installs MoveYak Driver, signs in with that number, and enters your code.
4. The driver turns tracking on, and their truck appears on your map.

BUILT FOR MOVING DAYS
• Tracking keeps running in the background and when the phone is locked.
• If a truck loses cell service, the app saves updates and sends them when the signal returns.
• Add details to each driver, such as truck and job numbers. Drivers see them in the app.
• Every driver adds a profile photo, so your team knows who is behind the wheel.
• Connect your own software with the Fleet Tracker API.

TRACKING YOUR CREWS CAN TRUST
• Drivers choose which companies can see their location.
• Drivers can turn tracking off at any time.
• MoveYak keeps only each driver's latest location. There is no route history.
• Drivers can delete their account in the app.

MoveYak Driver is the app your drivers install. Dispatchers sign up and use the live map at moveyak.com.

Sign-in texts go to US phone numbers only.

Privacy Policy: https://moveyak.com/privacy
Terms of Service: https://moveyak.com/terms
Support: https://moveyak.com/support

name: MwSt-Rechner: Brutto & Netto
description:
Der MwSt-Rechner rechnet Bruttobeträge in Nettobeträge um und umgekehrt – schnell, cent-genau und ohne Ablenkung. Ideal für Selbstständige, Handwerker, Händler, Buchhaltung und alle, die Rechnungen schreiben oder prüfen.

SO EINFACH GEHT'S
• Betrag eingeben – Netto, Mehrwertsteuer und Brutto stehen sofort da
• Mit einem Tipp zwischen Brutto → Netto und Netto → Brutto wechseln
• Steuersatz wählen, fertig

STEUERSÄTZE
• Deutschland: 19 % und 7 %
• Österreich: 20 %, 13 % und 10 %
• Schweiz: 8,1 %, 3,8 % und 2,6 % (in CHF)
• Eigener Steuersatz für alle anderen Fälle

CENT-GENAU
Der Rechner arbeitet intern in Cent und rundet kaufmännisch. Netto plus Steuer ergibt immer exakt den Bruttobetrag – genau wie auf einer Rechnung.

PRAKTISCH IM ALLTAG
• Eingabe so, wie du es gewohnt bist: „1.234,56“, „1234,56“ oder „1234.56“
• Tippe auf einen Betrag, um ihn zu kopieren
• Ergebnis teilen, z. B. per Nachrichten oder Mail
• Verlauf: Berechnungen mit „Merken“ speichern
• Ergebnis mit einem Tipp in die Gegenrichtung übernehmen
• Dunkelmodus und Unterstützung für VoiceOver
• Für iPhone und iPad

PRIVAT
Keine Werbung, kein Konto, kein Tracking. Die App sammelt keine Daten – alles bleibt auf deinem Gerät.

Alle Angaben ohne Gewähr; die App ersetzt keine Steuerberatung.

Fragen oder Ideen? Schreib uns an mail@altiros.com.

name: My AI Flashcards
description:
Study your own notes with cards created by artificial intelligence, right on your iPhone or iPad.

Import a PDF — a textbook chapter, a law, your class notes or a manual — and My AI Flashcards splits it into sections that follow its structure: titles, chapters, articles or subsections. Choose which sections to turn into cards, and your device's AI writes the questions in the document's language.

FOUR CARD TYPES
• Question-and-answer flashcards.
• Multiple choice with an explanation.
• Fill in the blank.
• True or false.
After answering, you can see the exact passage from the PDF each question comes from.

SPACED REPETITION
The app decides when each card should come back based on how well you know it: Again, Hard, Good or Easy. You spend your time on what you find hard and review what you know right before you'd forget it.

YOUR OWN QUESTION BANK
• Mark questions with the heart and study them together.
• Fix any card or create your own.
• Exclude sections you don't need, like cover pages or publication details.

COMPLETE PRIVACY
Everything is processed on your device. Your PDFs and cards are never sent to any server: they only sync across your devices with your own iCloud account. No sign-up, no ads, no tracking.

FREE TO START
The free version includes 2 topics and 3 generated sections a day. Studying is always unlimited. A single payment, no subscription, unlocks unlimited topics and generation on all your devices.

REQUIREMENTS
Generating cards requires a device with Apple's on-device AI turned on: iPhone 15 Pro or later, or iPad with M1 or A17 Pro chip or later. On other devices you can study cards synced through iCloud.

name: My Zoe
description:
My Zoe charges your Renault ZOE to the level you choose and stops there.

Drag the limit to 80 % and plug in. The app works out when the battery will get there and sends the car a charging schedule that ends at that moment, so the car stops on its own. Your phone does not have to stay awake all night.

CHARGE THE WAY YOU WANT
• Set a charge limit from 50 to 100 %
• Start now, in your cheap-rate hours, or be ready by a departure time
• Pause and resume from the app
• Charging history with energy and cost

A WARM CAR IN THE MORNING
• Start climate control from your phone or watch
• Schedule it for a time, so the cabin is ready when you are
• See when the car has actually confirmed it is running

ALWAYS KNOW WHAT IS HAPPENING
The app follows every command from your phone to Renault to the car and tells you plainly where it is: sent, picked up by the car, or refused. If the car is asleep, the app says so and checks again when it wakes.

• Battery level, range and charging power
• Tyre pressures, with a warning when one is low
• Battery health and mileage
• Where the car is parked, on a map
• The weather where the car is: rain, snow and fog fall on the car in the app too

EVERYWHERE YOU LOOK
• Live Activity on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island while charging
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets
• Apple Watch app
• Siri and Shortcuts: "Charge to limit" when you arrive home

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
There is no account with us and no server of ours. The app talks directly to Renault using your My Renault sign-in, and to Apple for maps and weather. No ads, no tracking, no analytics.

TRY IT FIRST
Tap "Try without an account" on the sign-in screen to explore the app with a simulated car.

REQUIREMENTS
A Renault ZOE with connected services and a My Renault account. Built and tested on the ZOE R135 (2019 and later). Earlier ZOE models are supported with fewer features, because the car reports less.

My Zoe is an independent app. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by Renault. Renault, ZOE and My Renault are trademarks of their respective owners.

name: MyAsistans by Ece Soft
description:
MyAsistans, Ece Soft ekibinin ve müşterilerinin günlük işlerini tek yerden yönetmesi için hazırlanmış kişisel bir asistandır.

Bugün
• Günün, geciken ve acil işlerinin özeti
• Gecikmiş, bugün ve bu hafta yapılacaklar tek listede
• Tek dokunuşla işi tamamlandı olarak işaretleme
• İstediğin saatte sabah hatırlatması: "Bugün 5 işin var"

Yönetim
• Görevler: tarih, saat, öncelik, ilgili kişi ve proje
• Kişiler: arama, WhatsApp ve e-posta tek dokunuşla
• Telefon rehberinden kişi aktarma, yeni kişiyi rehbere kaydetme
• Projeler: durum, teslim tarihi, fiyat ve notlar
• Proje raporunu PDF olarak paylaşma

Uygulama, Ece Soft yönetim paneli hesabı olan kullanıcılar içindir.

name: MYCitySim
description:
MYCitySim is a city builder set in Malaysia. Start with a few houses beside a river and grow them into a busy city with highways, LRT lines, mosques, temples, schools and night markets.

- Zone homes, shops and industry, and watch your town find its own character
- Lay roads, roundabouts, interchanges, bus routes and LRT lines
- Keep residents happy with clinics, schools, fire and ambulance cover, sewers and burial grounds
- Plant padi, palm oil, getah and durian on the farmland around your town
- Read what your residents post about your town in the Feed
- Floods and tornadoes test your planning: build flood walls along the river
- Save to the cloud and keep playing on another device

Politikal Disaster expansion, included:
- Turn on politics, make promises to voter groups and win the Term Vote every two years
- New buildings and radio spots

No ads. No in-app purchases.

name: MySherPa - 여행 일정 플래너
description:
Travel info scattered across notes, screenshots, emails and map apps?
MySherPa keeps your plans, map and documents together in one trip.

■ Day-by-day plans
· Set your trip dates and organize places by day
· Add a time to sort by time, or keep places in "Unscheduled"
· Drag to reorder or move to another day

■ See your route on the map
· View each day's route on the map
· Filter by day or tag; visited places fade out
· Start directions in Apple Maps or Google Maps

■ Documents
· Attach booking PDFs, tickets, photos, locations and notes to a trip or place
· Tap web links and phone numbers in notes to open them

■ "Up next" while you travel
· Home shows today's plan, your next stop and a D-day countdown
· Check off places with "Mark visited" and track progress

■ Organize with tags
· Create your own tags and colors — food, shopping, hotel and more

■ Stored only on your iPhone
· No sign-in, no server. All trip data stays on your device
· Plans and documents open even without a stable connection abroad
  (maps and place search need internet)

Supports light & dark mode, Korean and English.

name: Naelex
description:
Naelex is a small, offline word-completion trainer. It turns a definition into a puzzle: part of the word is missing, and you fill in the letters. No account, no connection, no advertising — just a focused few minutes of vocabulary practice.
A five-question round built from the current date. The same day always gives the same set, so you can replay it fairly. Choose Easy, Medium or Hard before you start: Easy removes two letters, Medium three, Hard four.
Six topic packs — Animals, Food & Drink, Nature, Science, Travel and Everyday — hold ten original entries each, sixty words in total. Search the whole library by word or definition, open any entry for its definition, hint, example and fact, and start a single-word drill straight from the detail page.

name: Nameoff - Baby Naming
description:
Choosing a baby name is hard. Lists of thousands of names are overwhelming, and it's tough to know which ones you really love. Nameoff makes it simple: two names at a time, tap the one you like more. A few minutes later, your favorites rise to the top.

HOW IT WORKS
• See two names side by side and tap the one you prefer
• Every pick sharpens your personal ranking
• Dislike a name and it won't come back
• Heart the ones you love to save them to your list

DECIDE TOGETHER
• Invite your partner with a link. Each of you picks on your own phone
• The Together ranking shows the names you both love, and flags any name one of you vetoed
• Your shared list stays in sync through iCloud

THOUSANDS OF NAMES
• Boy, girl and unisex names from U.S. Social Security records, with how popular each one is today and when it peaked
• Duel popular names, every name, or just your own list
• Slide between popular and rare to discover something unexpected
• Different spellings are grouped together, so you can pick the spelling you like

YOUR OWN LIST
• Add any name, even one that isn't in the database
• Import a list you already have by pasting it or choosing a file

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No accounts, no ads and no tracking. Your picks are stored on your phone and in your own iCloud, and a shared group is visible only to the people you invite.

Nameoff is free. Optional tips help support its development.

Requires iOS 18 or later.

name: Naval Battle: Tactical Ops
description:
Naval Battle: Tactical Ops is a cinematic naval strategy game for one or two players. Hide your fleet, read the enemy's movements and sink their ships before they sink yours.

TWO WAYS TO PLAY
• Classic: the timeless 10x10 duel. Five ships, one shot per turn, pure deduction.
• Tactical Operations: a deeper 12x12 battlefield with islands, six specialised ships and 2 action points per turn. Move your ships, scan with radar and sonar, send reconnaissance, deploy decoys, and unleash heavy artillery, torpedoes, air strikes and a missile. Every match lasts 18 rounds and is scored, so every action counts.

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Single player against a computer admiral that hunts, scans and dodges.
• Online multiplayer (beta): create a game, share the six-character room code and play a friend anywhere. No account, no sign-up.
• Local multiplayer over Wi-Fi: find games on your network automatically, or join by address.

CINEMATIC BATTLES
• Animated ocean, shells in flight, explosions, fires and sinking ships.
• Original music that intensifies as the battle heats up, plus radio calls from your crew.
• Made for touch, with quality and reduced-motion settings for every device.

FAIR PLAY BY DESIGN
In multiplayer, each device keeps its own fleet secret. Positions are sealed with a cryptographic commitment and checked when the match ends, so nobody can peek or cheat.

NO ADS. NO IN-APP PURCHASES. NO ACCOUNTS.
Available in English and Spanish.

name: NCLC Coach: TCF Canada Prep
description:
Build the French skills you need for TCF Canada and Canadian immigration — all four exam sections in one focused study workspace.

NCLC Coach combines realistic timed mock tests, targeted level practice, structured AI feedback for writing and speaking, spaced repetition, and an NCLC score converter tailored to your target level.

COMPLETE COVERAGE OF ALL FOUR TCF CANADA SKILLS

Reading Comprehension (Compréhension écrite)
• 6 full timed mock tests (39 questions each, 60 minutes, ordered from A1 to C2)
• 370 reading questions and original passages with clear explanations and source references
• Practise by CEFR level (A1 to C2) to strengthen weak bands
• Estimated score out of 699 and corresponding NCLC level after every mock

Listening Comprehension (Compréhension orale)
• 6 full timed mock tests (39 questions each, 35 minutes) with single-play exam audio
• 274 listening questions with 274 French audio recordings featuring Quebec (fr-CA) and European French (fr-FR) voices
• Unlimited audio replay in level practice mode

Writing Expression (Expression écrite)
• 30 structured writing prompts covering Tasks 1, 2, and 3 with realistic word-count targets and timers
• Detailed AI feedback: estimated score out of 20, estimated NCLC level, 4-criterion breakdown, specific corrections with explanations, and an improved model rewrite
• Saved local history so you can track progress across attempts

Speaking Expression (Expression orale)
• 30 speaking prompts covering Parts 1, 2, and 3 with preparation and speaking timers
• Record your answer and transcribe it on your device in Canadian French — your voice recording never leaves your device
• Submit your edited transcript for structured AI grading (/20, NCLC estimate, criterion notes, fixes, and model phrasing)

VOCABULARY, SPACED REPETITION & STUDY PLAN
• 1,500 French vocabulary entries across 30 everyday and exam themes with French audio pronunciation and Leitner spaced-repetition flashcards
• Wrong-answer SRS queue automatically brings back missed reading and listening questions until you master them
• Interactive NCLC Score Converter (NCLC 4 to 10) based on IRCC equivalency thresholds to check your lowest skill across all four tests
• Personalized weekly study plan paced to your target NCLC (5, 7, or 9) and exam date, plus optional daily study reminders
• Bilingual interface: choose English or French instructions while keeping exam questions in French
• Study offline for reading, listening, and vocabulary; sync progress across your devices with no account required

ACCESS & PRIVACY
Unlock all features with a one-time purchase — no subscription and no ads. An internet connection is required for AI writing and speaking feedback (up to 20 gradings per day); submitted text is used only to generate your feedback and is not stored.

NCLC Coach is an independent study app. Not affiliated with France Éducation international (FEI), Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship Canada (IRCC), or the Government of Canada.

name: Needle Trail
description:
Draw one unbroken thread through every square of the grid. Stop at each number in order. When the last square is filled, your grid turns into a small stitched pattern.

A calm puzzle with no timers, no lives and no ads. Some levels are cross-stitch, some are knitting; the thread is matte cotton or soft wool.

HOW TO PLAY
- Put your finger on the first knot and drag. The thread fills one square at a time.
- Move up, down, left or right. Fill every open square once.
- Visit the numbered stops in order: 1, 2, 3 and on.
- Stuck? Drag back along your thread, or tap Undo.

WHAT IS INSIDE
- 60 levels, from small 4x4 grids to larger boards with blocked squares.
- Undo and Reset on every level.
- One hint per level when you need a nudge.
- No move limit, no time limit and no lives.
- Play offline: no internet needed to play. No account.

NOT IN THE GAME
No ads, no in-app purchases, no timers.

PRIVACY
Needle Trail sends gameplay data, such as which levels you play and finish, to help us fix bugs and balance levels. It is tied to a random install code, not to your name. Where the law requires it, the game asks first. Your progress is saved on your iPhone.

name: Neon Station
description:
2087. When construction of the orbital elevator stopped, a giant station became a vertical city: Neon Station.
Corporations took the upper floors, gangs took the lower ones, and the station AI, ECHO, watches every floor.

You wake up on Platform 0 with a wiped ID chip — the one person ECHO never accounted for.
From the sewers to the Data Core, take down the gangs of 10 districts and reach the truth behind the Upbound Line.

■ It fights while you're away — an idle auto-battle RPG
· Your character battles the gangs on its own, and coins keep piling up even while you're offline
· 10 districts, from the Rust Sewers, Neon Market and Holo Pleasure District to the Data Core, each with its own gang and boss
· Defeat the final boss and the city starts over, tougher than before

■ Trade for gear across 11 grades
· Pay coins to Barrel, the Arms Dealer, to trade for gear
· 11 grades from Scrap to Origin, across 5 slots: head, body, legs, feet and weapon
· As the Arms Dealer levels up, higher grades turn up more often and his hidden stockrooms open one by one
· Odds for every grade and pity (guaranteed drop) rules are fully disclosed in-game

■ Your gear is your look
· Your pixel character changes with every piece you equip
· Collect 264 gear looks and repaint them in the Palette Builder to create the look you want
· Gather clue fragments to uncover 20 hidden signature sets

■ Adopt abandoned machines — Pets
· 16 kinds of robot pets and drones, repaired by Poppy the Pet Breeder
· Team up ground and air pets for a combo bonus

■ Rebuild your body — Implants
· Get neural, skeletal and cognitive implants from White the Ripper Medic
· Every implant has a skill that triggers automatically in battle
· Work out the best combination within your neural load limit

■ The lower-level merchants open as you grow
· As you level up, the Ripper Medic, the Pet Breeder and the Palette Builder open their doors one by one
· The first time you enter each menu, a guide drone quickly shows you around

■ New special jobs every day, plus PVP
· Gang Vault Raid, Fixer Job, Cyborg Scrapyard, Supply Truck Heist, Relay Server Hack — 5 special jobs to take on every day
· PVP that pits your combat power against other players, with weekly rankings
· Challenge other players to a duel from chat and share the results

■ Perfect for players who
· Want a game that grows even when you just leave it running on a busy day
· Love collecting and matching gear in RPGs
· Love cyberpunk worlds and pixel art

※ Some in-game items are randomized. The odds for each grade can be checked in the game's odds information.

name: NEXVOMX
description: NEXVOMX Ideal for those who want to track exactly where every bit of their income goes. By recording your income and starting balances—along with transfers, bills, and refunds—you can see exactly how your money is spent and what remains in each of your accounts. When processing an entry, you can allocate funds based on the order in which they were received, or manually distribute them across multiple income sources. Even if a refund lands in a different account, it can be traced back to the original source of the expense. When backdating entries or modifying dates, be sure to review the existing allocations to understand how those changes might affect related transfers, expenses, and account balances. A dedicated "pending" page aggregates unmatched refunds, gaps in manual allocations, and overdrafts, making it easy to revisit your original transaction history and reconcile each item.

name: Noise Remover: Video & Audio
description:
Noise Remover cleans the sound of a video or a voice recording so the voice comes through.

Pick a video from Photos or a recording from Files, and the app removes background noise such as wind, traffic, hum and crowd noise. Listen to the original and the cleaned version side by side, choose how much noise to remove, then save a new copy. Your original is never changed.

• Works fully offline. Your videos and recordings never leave your iPhone.
• The picture is not re-encoded: only the sound is replaced.
• Works in any language.
• Before / after preview is free.

Good to know
• The app keeps voices and removes other sounds, including background music. It is made for speech, not for songs.
• The cleaned sound is mono.
• Very loud noise that covers the voice completely cannot be undone.
• Files up to 60 minutes.

Free with ads. An optional monthly subscription removes all ads.

Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy policy: https://luxuriant-front-a88.notion.site/Noise-Remover-Privacy-Policy-Support-4210f7d779d880c9bae8c0d007a90a12

name: NovaStream IPTV
description:
Your playlists, beautifully organised. NovaStream is a fast, elegant player for the IPTV playlists you already have.

NovaStream does not include any channels, movies or series. Add a playlist from your own provider, an M3U link or an Xtream Codes login, and NovaStream turns it into a clean TV and media library.

LIVE TV WITH A REAL GUIDE
Browse channels by category, see what is on now and next with the EPG, and jump straight in. Mark favourites so the channels you watch most are always one tap away.

MOVIES AND SERIES
Your provider's movies and series appear as a poster library with seasons, episodes and plots. Pick up where you left off with Continue Watching, and move to the next episode automatically.

A PLAYER THAT FEELS NATIVE
Native iOS playback controls with AirPlay and Picture in Picture, so you can keep watching while you do something else.

MULTIPLE PLAYLISTS
Keep several playlists side by side and switch between them in a moment. Lock chosen categories with a 4-digit PIN.

NETWORK TOOLS
A built-in speed test and DNS diagnostics help you understand slow or failing streams.

Available in English, Italian, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Romanian and Turkish.

Try every feature free for 7 days. After that, NovaStream Pro is an auto-renewable yearly subscription. Payment is charged to your Apple Account, and the subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings.

NovaStream is a media player only. Use it only with content you have the right to access.

Terms of Use: https://www.novastreamapp.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://www.novastreamapp.com/privacy

name: Nubeox
description:
Nubeox es un servicio de almacenamiento en la nube pensado para tus vídeos. Guarda tus archivos de forma segura, reprodúcelos al instante desde cualquier dispositivo y compártelos con un simple enlace.

Almacenamiento en la nube
Sube vídeos, fotos, música, documentos y archivos comprimidos desde la galería, la cámara o la app Archivos. Empieza con 5 GB gratuitos al crear tu cuenta.

Reproducción en streaming
Reproduce tus vídeos sin descargarlos, directamente desde la nube.

Organización sencilla
Encuentra cualquier archivo en segundos gracias a las miniaturas de vídeo, las carpetas, los favoritos y la clasificación automática por categorías. La papelera te permite recuperar lo que elimines por error.

Compartir con enlaces
Genera un enlace para cualquier archivo o carpeta y envíalo por la app que prefieras. Solo se comparte lo que tú eliges. Puedes denunciar contenido y bloquear a quien te lo comparte.

Nubeox Pro
La suscripción opcional Nubeox Pro incluye:
• 1 TB de almacenamiento
• Experiencia sin anuncios
• Reproducción y descarga de archivos de más de 5 GB en HD y 4K
• Apertura de archivos ZIP en la nube sin descargarlos
• Subidas y descargas a mayor velocidad

Planes: mensual y anual. El pago se carga a tu cuenta de Apple al confirmar la compra. La suscripción se renueva automáticamente salvo que la canceles al menos 24 horas antes del final del periodo en curso. Puedes gestionarla y cancelarla en Ajustes > [tu nombre] > Suscripciones.

Privacidad y seguridad
Tus archivos son privados. Las conexiones están cifradas y puedes eliminar tu cuenta y todos tus datos directamente desde la app.

Términos de uso: https://nubeox.app/terms
Política de privacidad: https://nubeox.app/privacy

Soporte
¿Tienes alguna pregunta o sugerencia? Escríbenos desde Perfil > Ayuda y comentarios o a support@nubeox.app.

name: Nuri Memo
description:
Memos disappear in chat. Nuri Memo keeps them.

Write or speak a memo once, and it stays: on your phone, on your computer, on a screen by the door, and in your notes archive — searchable by date and keyword, including everything that was transcribed from voice.

SPEAK, DON'T TYPE
Record a voice memo and it is transcribed automatically. Dates and times in a memo are recognized and added to your calendar with a reminder.

SEND TO PEOPLE AND GROUPS
Send memos to friends and groups. Invitations are accepted before anyone is connected — nobody is added without agreeing.

A SCREEN BY THE DOOR
Pair any screen with a 6-digit code and your memos appear on it in real time — a family board at home, a notice screen at the shop. Choose per screen what shows: your memos, a group's, a friend's.

NOTES THAT KEEP THEMSELVES
Every memo you send or receive is kept in the Notes archive, organized by date. Nothing scrolls away.

CALENDAR, AUTOMATICALLY
Connect Google Calendar and dated memos become events on the right calendar — yours, and the people you send to.

Your contacts stay on your device. Nuri Memo reads your iPhone contacts only so you can pick people to invite; the list is never uploaded.

name: NURVIA: Prayer, Quran & Dhikr
description:
NURVIA is a quiet, private, offline-first Islamic companion crafted around one central idea: the five daily prayers organize the rhythm of your day.

Designed with generous space, refined typography, and calm astronomical geometry, NURVIA brings together everything you need for daily worship without clutter, advertisements, or tracking.

THE PRAYER HORIZON
• Visualize your entire day along an elegant astronomical horizon arc adapted to your exact calculated prayer times.
• Live countdown to the next prayer with previous and upcoming context.
• Six daily milestones: Fajr, Sunrise (informational), Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib, and Isha.
• Discreet, optional daily prayer completion progress—no guilt-tripping streaks.
• 100% offline astronomical calculations with multiple methods (MWL, Moroccan Regional Approximation, Umm al-Qura, ISNA, Egyptian, Karachi, Singapore, Dubai, Moonsighting Committee), Standard & Hanafi Asr, high-latitude rules, and manual minute adjustments.
• Individual per-prayer notification preferences respecting Apple's 30-second notification guidelines, plus an in-app Athan player.

THE NOBLE QURAN — OFFLINE
• Browse all 114 Surahs and 30 Juz offline.
• Authentic Uthmani Arabic script with English and French translations.
• Resume instantly from your last-read verse, bookmark favorite verses, and search across Surahs.
• Adjustable Arabic and translation font sizes, language toggles, and a calm OLED dark reading mode.
• Optional audio recitation streaming with renowned reciters (Mishary Rashid Alafasy, Abdul Basit), playback speed, and repeat controls.

IMMERSIVE QIBLA COMPASS
• Precise great-circle bearing and distance to the Kaaba in kilometers.
• Smooth live compass rotation with gold alignment indicator and gentle haptic confirmation.
• Clear accuracy and calibration guidance—never misleading when magnetic interference occurs.

OFFLINE ISLAMIC LIBRARY & DIGITAL TASBIH
• Curated authentic Hadith from Sahih al-Bukhari, Sahih Muslim, and Forty Hadith Nawawi with verified references and Arabic + English + French text.
• Morning Adhkar, Evening Adhkar, Post-Prayer remembrance, and categorized Daily Duas.
• Distraction-free digital Tasbih with customizable Dhikr, 33/99/100 targets, milestone haptic feedback, session history, and optional screen wake lock.

PRIVACY FIRST
• No ads. No tracking SDKs. No forced account creation.
• Works completely offline with 60+ built-in cities—location permission is optional and never tracked continuously.

name: Nuvori-Pet Journal & Care
description:
Make room for the little moments—and the details that make pet care easier.

Nuvori brings your pet profiles, familiar contacts, private journal and care plans into one warm, easy-to-use journal.

KEEP PET DETAILS TOGETHER
Record pet names, personality tags, care tips, photos and voice notes. Keep contact profiles and their pets close at hand, without creating an online social connection.

GIVE EACH DAY A PAGE
Save a photo, a few words, or both. Add a note later and revisit the moments you want to remember. Your entries are not publicly posted or sent to contacts.

PLAN THE NEXT CARE DAY
Choose whether you are arranging care for your pet or providing care for a contact’s pet. Record the time, handover details and task checklist. Nuvori checks overlapping plans and helps you keep track of care started, results to review, completed plans and issues that need attention.

RECORD WHAT REALLY HAPPENED
Add written handover notes, care photos and voice recordings. Plan updates are your own records: they do not notify a contact or confirm a commitment on someone else’s behalf. Check arrangements with the person yourself.

COINS FOR NEW CARE PLANS
Creating each new care plan costs 30 coins. Review the fee and remaining balance before confirming. Editing and updating an existing plan are free; pet profiles, contacts and journaling are free to use. Cancelling or deleting a created plan does not return the creation fee. Consumable coin packs are available through the App Store, whose confirmation shows the price and currency before you pay. Coins pay for the planning feature, not real-world pet care.

Start with a visitor profile—no password is required. You can skip the community field and fill it in later. Hide records, show them again in Settings, or clear your visitor data when you choose.

Nuvori does not provide pet-care matchmaking, professional care, medical advice or emergency assistance. Always confirm arrangements and your pet’s safety yourself.

name: One Button Translate
description:
One Button Translate is a realtime voice translator with exactly one button. Pick two languages at the top, hold the big button while you speak, let go, and the translation is spoken aloud about a second later. Speak in either of the two languages: the app works out who is talking and translates the other way, so there is no direction switch.

Made for
• Travelers asking directions, ordering food, haggling at a market
• Shop, hotel, clinic and front-desk staff who serve visitors from abroad
• Anyone who has short daily conversations with a colleague, friend or family member in another language

How it works
• Choose your two languages at the top (once is enough)
• Hold the button and talk
• Let go. The translation plays right away. That is all

What makes it different
• Fast. Translation starts while you are still talking, and you hear it about a second after you release
• No subtitles. Nothing to read on the screen, so you keep looking at the person you are talking to
• No settings, no account. Install and use it. We never ask for your name, email or phone number
• No direction switch. Whoever speaks, the app translates into the other language
• Press again while it is speaking to cut it off and start the next sentence

Languages (13)
English, Korean, Japanese, Chinese, Russian, Spanish, Portuguese, French, German, Italian, Hindi, Indonesian, Vietnamese

Pricing
• Your first install comes with 5 free minutes of translation
• After that, buy minutes inside the app: 30, 100 or 300 minute packs that never expire
• One Button Translate Plus subscription: 60 minutes every month, billed monthly or yearly. Unused minutes roll over
• Only the time you hold the button is counted, by the second. Your remaining time is always shown at the bottom of the screen

Subscription terms
• Payment will be charged to your Apple Account (Apple ID) at confirmation of purchase. The subscription automatically renews unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage and cancel your subscription in your App Store account settings after purchase
• Terms of Use: https://yonghostra.github.io/one-button-translate-site/terms.html
• Privacy Policy: https://yonghostra.github.io/one-button-translate-site/privacy.html

Privacy
• Audio from the microphone is streamed only to produce the translation and is not stored
• There is no account. We keep only an anonymous ID and purchase records to manage your minute balance
• No ads, no tracking

Requires a microphone and an internet connection. Support: support@stra.ai

name: Onnal - 5 Year Diary & Journal
description:
Onnal is a five-year diary that brings together entries written on the same date across different years. Capture your day with words, photos, weather, and moods, then rediscover what life felt like a year ago. A few lines each day become a personal journal you can return to.

What were you thinking on this day last year?
Everyday moments are worth remembering, too. Keep five years of your life, one day at a time.

YOUR DAY, YEAR AFTER YEAR
See entries from the same month and day together. Choose a date or swipe between days to revisit past moments and notice how your life has changed.

WORDS, PHOTOS, AND MOODS
Start writing without having to think of a title. Add the weather, choose your mood, and attach a photo to remember the moment. Writing prompts offer a little inspiration when you open your diary.

A CALENDAR OF YOUR MEMORIES
See the days you have written on the calendar. Search by words or a date range to find the entries you want to revisit.

GET TO KNOW YOURSELF
Look back at your writing streak, recent activity, and mood patterns. Small daily entries can help you see changes over time.

BUILD A DAILY JOURNALING HABIT
Choose a reminder time that works for you. The default is 8 PM. When you have an entry from the same date in a previous year, reminders can invite you to look back.

AUTOMATIC ACCOUNT BACKUP
Both free and Premium users can keep diary entries and photos on their device first, with automatic server backup. Sign in to the same account to restore backed-up records.

ONNAL PREMIUM
• Write without ads
• Enjoy unlimited diary text
• Attach up to 10 photos per entry
• Turn entries from a selected period into a diary PDF

The free version supports up to 200 characters and one photo per entry. Ads may appear starting with your third saved entry.

Premium is an auto-renewing monthly subscription. Pricing is KRW 2,900 per month in South Korea and US$1.99 per month in the United States. The price shown in your store applies. You can cancel automatic renewal in your subscription settings at any time. Existing entries and photos remain available after your subscription expires.

Start your five-year diary with a few words today.

Support: In the app, go to My Page → Settings → Contact Us.

Privacy Policy: https://13.209.255.5/legal/privacy
Terms of Use: https://13.209.255.5/legal/terms

name: Open Mind: Safer Use
description:
Open Mind ist eine App für Safer Use. Sie richtet sich an Erwachsene, die psychoaktive Substanzen konsumieren und die Risiken kennen wollen. Die App informiert sachlich, warnt vor gefährlichen Kombinationen und hilft dir, Pausen einzuhalten.

LEXIKON
• Über 250 Substanzen, von Koffein und Alkohol bis zu Partydrogen und neuen psychoaktiven Stoffen
• Wirkung, Risiken und Safer-Use-Regeln
• Dosisbereiche und Wirkdauer als Richtwerte
• Aufklärungsvideos von Open Mind zu vielen Substanzen

MISCHCHECK
• Zwei oder mehr Substanzen auswählen und sofort sehen, welche Kombination gefährlich ist
• Kurze Begründung zu jeder riskanten Mischung

TAGEBUCH
• Konsum eintragen und sehen, wie lange es voraussichtlich wirkt: Wirkkurve mit Uhrzeiten und laufender Uhr
• Warnungen schon beim Eintragen: bei starker Dosis, beim Nachlegen und bei riskanten Mischungen mit dem, was noch wirkt
• Kalender mit Hinweisen, wenn etwas zu oft vorkommt oder eine Pause sinnvoll ist

NOTFALL
• Erste Schritte bei Bewusstlosigkeit, Atemproblemen, Überhitzung, Krampfanfall und Horrortrip
• Notruf 112 und Beratungsstellen, von jedem Bildschirm aus erreichbar

DEINE DATEN
• Kein Konto, keine Werbung, kein Tracking
• Dein Tagebuch bleibt auf deinem Gerät. Du kannst es als Datei sichern.

Open Mind ruft nicht zum Konsum auf und verharmlost nichts. Jeder Konsum ist mit Risiken verbunden, am sichersten ist der Verzicht. Alle Angaben sind Richtwerte und ersetzen keine ärztliche Beratung. Im Notfall: 112.

Quellen: Dosis- und Dauerangaben von PsychonautWiki (CC BY-SA 4.0), Mischtabelle auf Grundlage der Kombinationstabelle von TripSit.

name: Orbital Stained Glass
description:
A star shines at the center of the board. Turn the glass tiles to find a path for its light to reach every piece. When the last tile glows, the paths fade away to reveal a stained-glass illustration.

Explore 500 levels across 20 chapters of the Celestial Atlas. Start with a few turns, then work your way up to puzzles that span several panels. Revisit an unlocked level, try to beat your best turn count, and resume your current puzzle whenever you like. Your progress is saved on your device.

Each board comes with one free hint. If you want another and a video is available, you can choose to watch a rewarded ad. Undo lets you try a different path. Sound is optional, and you can start playing as soon as you open the app.

A banner may appear when you open the game. A full-screen ad may appear after you complete a level.

name: Orofoglio
description:
Il tuo oro, sempre sotto controllo.

OROFOGLIO è l’app gratuita che ti aiuta a conoscere il valore del tuo oro fisico. Aggiungi le tue monete e i tuoi lingotti e consulta una stima in euro basata sul loro contenuto di oro fino e sulla quotazione di riferimento.

IL TUO PORTAFOGLIO ORO
Raccogli in un unico posto le informazioni su monete e lingotti. Sterline, marenghi, krugerrand e altri formati: tieni traccia delle quantità che inserisci e del loro valore stimato.

LA QUOTAZIONE, OGNI GIORNO
Consulta la quotazione dell’oro in euro e segui l’andamento del valore del tuo portafoglio.

UN CONTATTO PER IL TUO ORO
Vuoi acquistare o vendere? Indica la città e descrivi la tua richiesta. Ti aiutiamo a cercare un professionista iscritto all’Elenco degli Operatori Professionali in Oro, che potrà contattarti nei giorni lavorativi per approfondire le tue esigenze e formulare un eventuale preventivo.

SEMPLICE, SENZA REGISTRAZIONE
Puoi utilizzare il portafoglio senza creare un account. Per inviare una richiesta di contatto sono necessari i recapiti indicati nel modulo.

TOTALMENTE GRATUITA
Tutte le funzioni di OROFOGLIO sono gratuite.

Le valutazioni sono indicative e si riferiscono al contenuto di oro fino. Il prezzo effettivo di acquisto o vendita può variare in base al prodotto, alle sue condizioni, all’eventuale valore numismatico e alle condizioni applicate dall’operatore.

Per informazioni e assistenza: supporto@orofoglio.it

name: Over to You: AI Coding Agents
description:
Your coding agent stopped on a step only you can do. Over to You puts that step on your iPhone. Finish it there and the agent carries on.

Over to You is the phone half of a Mac setup. An agent running on your Mac asks for you through a small tool, and the step arrives on your iPhone as a notification.

WHAT YOU CAN DO FROM YOUR PHONE
• Finish a browser step: a sign-in, a password, a 2FA code or a CAPTCHA in Chrome on your Mac
• Press a Mac permission window from a live view of that window
• Save a secret to a .env file on your Mac, typed on your phone
• Answer a question the agent asks, with a choice or a few words
• Allow or deny Claude Code permission requests from the lock screen
• See which agents are running and what they changed
• Open your Mac's windows, files and running apps, once you switch that on

HOW IT WORKS
1. Install the Over to You Mac app and pair it by scanning a QR code with this app.
2. The Mac app sets up the agent tool for Claude Code, Codex and Cursor.
3. When an agent needs a person, you get a notification. Open it, finish the step, tap done.
4. The agent receives the outcome and continues.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account. Your Mac holds your pairing, files and settings.
• Traffic between your iPhone and your Mac is encrypted.
• For sign-ins and secrets, the agent gets only the outcome (finished, saved or declined), not what you typed. Answers to its questions are sent back as you write them.
• Face ID before a file or a step, on by default.
• The Mac view stays off for each phone until you turn it on at the Mac.

REQUIREMENTS
• A Mac with macOS 14 or later, running the Over to You Mac app (a separate download from overtoyou.dev)
• For the live Mac view, macOS Screen Recording and Accessibility permissions
• For browser steps, the Over to You Chrome extension
• iOS 17 or later
• The app is in English only for now

Over to You is independent and is not affiliated with Anthropic, OpenAI or Anysphere. Claude and Claude Code are trademarks of Anthropic. Codex is a trademark of OpenAI. Cursor is a trademark of Anysphere.

name: Özel Güvenlik Bilgi Kartları
description:
ÖGG Kartları ile özel güvenlik sınavına sade ve düzenli bir şekilde hazırlan.

Bilgi kartıyla temel konuları öğren, açıklamalı doğru–yanlış sorusuyla bilgini pekiştir. İstediğin kategoride çalış, önemli kartları kaydet ve zorlandığın konuları tekrar et.

Günlük hedefini ve ilerlemeni takip et. Kartlarını yeniden açtığında kaldığın yerden devam et. Tüm çalışma içeriklerini internet bağlantısı olmadan kullan.

Uygulama bağımsız bir hazırlık aracıdır; EGM ile resmî bağlantısı bulunmaz.

name: P Hotel
description:
Med P Hotel-appen har du oppholdet ditt samlet på ett sted.

Logg inn med e-postadressen du brukte da du bestilte. Vi sender deg en kode på e-post, så du trenger ikke passord.

I appen kan du:
• se kommende og tidligere opphold
• finne adresse og tider for innsjekk og utsjekk
• se romnummer og dørkoder fra innsjekkdagen
• bestille nye opphold og betale med kort eller Vipps
• endre kontaktinformasjon og språk

P Apartments leier ut leiligheter og hotellrom for korte og lange opphold. Appen finnes på norsk og engelsk.

Du kan slette kontoen din når du vil, under Profil i appen.

name: PalabrejasApp
description:
Palabrejas es un juego de palabras diseñado para estimular el aprendizaje y el dominio del idioma español mediante anagramas y crucigramas generados al azar.

¿CÓMO SE JUEGA?
• Al comenzar cada partida, la aplicación elige una palabra base según el número de letras (de 3 a 9) y el nivel de dificultad que tú configures.
• Combina las letras disponibles para formar anagramas de 2 o más letras y completa el crucigrama.
• Además de las palabras del tablero, puedes descubrir anagramas adicionales que suman puntos extra a tu marcador.
• ¿No conoces el significado de una palabra? Toca su letra inicial en el crucigrama o selecciónala en la ventana de estadísticas para consultarla directamente en el diccionario oficial de la RAE.

CARACTERÍSTICAS PRINCIPALES
• Basada en el Corpus de Referencia del Español Actual (CREA) de la Real Academia Española, clasificado por frecuencia real de uso.
• Dificultad personalizable por longitud de palabra (3 a 9 letras) y nivel dentro del diccionario CREA.
• Sistema de puntuación, pistas y estadísticas detalladas por partida.
• Funciona 100% sin conexión a internet (solo necesitas conexión al abrir definiciones externas en la RAE).
• Gratis, sin publicidad, sin compras integradas y sin recopilar datos personales.
• Diseñada para iPhone y iPad.

name: Panelboard: Dashboards on TV
description:
Panelboard puts your dashboards on the big screen. Connect your own Grafana server, pick a dashboard, and it shows on your Apple TV with live charts, stats and gauges — drawn natively, sharp at 4K, and readable from across the room.

MADE FOR THE OFFICE TV
• Time series, stat, gauge, bar gauge and text panels drawn natively with the same layout, colours, thresholds, units and value mappings as on your server.
• Other panel types are shown as images from your server's Image Renderer plugin, if you have it.
• Collapsed rows are opened, template variables and per-panel time ranges are respected.
• Open any panel full screen with one click.

ALWAYS UP TO DATE
• Dashboards refresh on their own. If the server goes away, the last data stays on screen with a clear note of when it was updated.
• Errors from your server are shown on the panel, so you know why a chart is empty.
• Pick a time range from the last 15 minutes to 30 days.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Panelboard connects straight from your Apple TV to your server. No account with us, no cloud relay, no analytics, no ads.
• Sign in with a read-only Viewer service account token, kept in the Apple TV Keychain.
• Works with servers on your local network, behind a sub-path, or on the internet.

TRY IT FIRST
No server at hand? Browse the public demo dashboards right away.

WALLBOARD MODE
Free: every dashboard, refreshed every 5 minutes.
Wallboard Mode (one-time purchase): each dashboard refreshes at its own interval, down to 10 seconds, and Apple TV stays awake instead of switching to the screensaver — so the board is live all day.

Grafana is a trademark of Grafana Labs. Panelboard is an independent app and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Grafana Labs.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: PANEPRINT
description:
A stained-glass window lights up on your workbench. You have a few seconds to notice the outline, the angles, and the spaces between the panes. Then it fades. What can you rebuild from memory?

In PANEPRINT, choose squares, triangles, and bars, then drag and turn them into place on a grid. Submit your work to see the original overlaid on your reconstruction. Your match score rises as you fill the silhouette and falls when glass extends beyond it.

When a detail slips your mind, use Afterimage. It brings the reference back briefly once per attempt at the cost of six seconds from the build timer. Decide whether a second look is worth the time, or trust the shapes you remember.

Rebuild different windows across multiple levels and test your eye for symmetry, edges, and negative space. Play in landscape on iPhone or iPad, with sound on or off. The game works entirely offline and saves your progress and sound preference on your device.

name: Paper Flapper: Fold to Fly
description:
Fold your phone to fly.

Paper Flapper is a retro pixel arcade game made for foldable iPhones. Close the phone a little and open it again to flap your paper crane's wings. Hold it half-folded to spread its wings and glide. Thread the gaps between the pillars and see how far you can go.

No foldable? No problem. On any other iPhone, tap the screen to flap.

FEATURES
• Controls built around the hinge of a foldable iPhone
• Hand-drawn pixel art with a dusky retro sunset
• Hats to earn by setting new high scores
• Worlds to fly through: cherry blossoms, snowy nights, volcanoes, synthwave, the deep sea and more
• Paper colors, trails and crash effects to style your crane
• Game Center leaderboard for your best score
• Haptics and sound

ONE PURCHASE, EVERYTHING UNLOCKED
Paper Flapper is free to play with occasional ads between games. A single purchase, Unlock Everything, unlocks every hat, paper, trail, crash and world, and removes ads for good. No subscriptions.

Fold gently. We are not responsible for broken hinges, cracked screens or wounded pride.

name: PARS CASp Strike 3D
description:
Study for the California CASp exam by playing it. PARS CASp Strike 3D turns Chapter 11B of the California Building Code and the 2010 ADA Standards into a fast 3D inspection game.

WALK THE SITE, CALL THE VIOLATIONS
Raid real places, from the bar and the restroom to the parking lot, the pool and the clinic. Every card shows a real measurement: counter heights, door clearances, grab bars, ramp slopes, parking stalls, signs and more. Shoot VIOLATION or COMPLIES before time runs out. When a card says MEASURE IT, pull the tape measure yourself and read it.

LEARN FROM LINA, YOUR CASp COACH
Miss one and Lina explains the rule, the reading and the code section, out loud. Every lesson is built in and works offline.

EVERY PLACE THE EXAM COVERS
The bar, the restroom, a parking lot, a restaurant, a hotel room, a pool, a playground, a theater, a clinic, an apartment and the entrance: 11 locations with hundreds of real Chapter 11B and ADA measurements.

EXAM PREP AND A FULL MOCK EXAM (PRO)
- EXAM PREP drills exam questions, your weakest domains first.
- MOCK EXAM: a timed two-part practice exam. Part 1 has 60 questions and Part 2 has 40 code-book questions, with the CODE BOOK at hand.
- A readiness report for every exam domain, then review every mistake with Lina.
- Ask Lina your own questions about Chapter 11B, the ADA, scoping and the exam.

KEEP COMING BACK
Levels from Easy to Expert, ranks from Trainee to Certified CASp, a daily challenge and a streak.

PARS CASp STRIKE 3D PRO
THE BAR and the RESTROOM are free. Pro unlocks all 11 locations, the daily challenge, EXAM PREP, the MOCK EXAM and asking Lina your own questions. One subscription works on iPhone, iPad and Mac.
- Monthly: $19.99/month
- Yearly: $191.99/year (save 20%)
- 3 days free for new subscribers. Cancel anytime.
Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm. The subscription renews automatically unless you turn it off at least 24 hours before the period ends. Manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://amirpakshir.com/caspstrike3d-privacy

A study game by Amir Pakshir. Codes from the PARS CASp handbook. Always confirm with the code text. Not affiliated with the Division of the State Architect.

name: Pawdunit
description:
Last night something walked across the snow. Who was it, and where did it go?

Pawdunit is a logic puzzle about footprints. Each animal moves in its own way – the cat walks one step at a time, the hedgehog has to turn at every step, the rabbit hops, the frog leaps, the penguin slides, the squirrel climbs and the owl flies over the trees. Follow the prints, work out which animal left them, and draw the path from each den to each meal.

NO GUESSING, EVER
Every stage has exactly one answer, and every answer can be reached by reasoning alone. If you are stuck, it is never because the puzzle is unfair.

WHAT YOU GET
• 149 hand-checked stages across 12 worlds, from a gentle tutorial to an 8×8 night under the aurora
• Seven animals with their own rules, plus foggy tiles that hide part of the trail
• A new "Today's puzzle" generated on your device every day – easier on Mondays, harder at the weekend
• A short replay of how the night really went after every solve
• Share your result for today's puzzle with friends
• Works offline. No account, no sign-up

HOW IT HELPS
Hints point you to the next safe step. Lives refill over time, and you can undo a few steps per world. Watch an optional ad to refill lives, get a hint or earn extra undos – or buy a hint pack.

ADS AND PURCHASES
Short ads appear between stages. "Remove Ads" (one-time purchase or monthly subscription) turns them off; rewarded ads stay optional. Hint packs are available as in-app purchases. The monthly subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period; manage it in your Apple Account settings.

name: PawzeApp
description:
Pawze is for everyday life with your dog: know what's out there before you leave, track the walk, keep their health in order and meet up with their friends.

MAP OF YOUR AREA
Neighbours flag what matters to a dog: caterpillars, hazards, water fountains, mess, access and dog-friendly places. Each alert expires on its own once it stops being useful.

WALKS
Start and finish a walk with one tap. Pawze tracks distance, moving time, pace and estimated calories based on your dog's weight. Forgot to start it? Pawze lets you know when it looks like you're out walking.

FRIENDS AND PARKS
Make dog friends with a QR code. Join your park, see who's walking nearby and chat with other owners. Chat is end-to-end encrypted: not even Pawze can read it.

HEALTH AND APPOINTMENTS
Weight, body condition, vaccination record, documents and appointments with reminders. All in one place, visible only to you.

YOUR PRIVACY FIRST
- By default nobody sees your walk. You choose whether friends can, and only while you walk.
- The position friends see is approximate and disappears when you finish.
- Your route is only saved if you turn it on, and you can delete it.
- You can delete your account and all your data from the app.

Pawze is free.

name: PE Electrical Exam Prep: Joulz
description:
PE Electrical Exam Prep: Joulz is an independent practice app for adults preparing for the NCEES PE Electrical and Computer: Power exam. It covers every subtopic NCEES publishes in its Power exam specification (nine knowledge areas, 39 subtopics) and shows your progress on each one. It is study material, not the exam.

WHAT YOU GET
- 19 study units, each with a short applied story, something to try, something to build and a check question
- 960+ original questions with a worked solution that names the common slip; numeric answers are recomputed by a second method before release
- Eight full-length 80-question practice mocks in a computer-based style: question navigator, flag for review, strike-through, on-screen scientific calculator with phasor conversion, exam clock, optional break and a score-by-area report; plus half-day, 20 and 40 question timed sets, area tests and subtopic quizzes (scaled practice estimates, never an NCEES score)
- 11 labs you can move: phasors, three-phase power, transformer, per-unit, fault currents, motors, power-factor correction, protection coordination, power flow, stability and voltage regulation
- 10 interactive 3D simulations: three-phase fields, transformer, induction motor, synchronous machine, one-line power flow, transmission line, faults and relays, grounding grid, lightning protection and a solar-battery microgrid
- Typeset equations with tappable symbols, 85 verified relations
- A coverage screen with your mastery on every NCEES subtopic, quick checks after each lesson, and a report that links what you missed back to the right material; learn in NCEES order or by building real projects
- A state guide for licensure: your board, education, experience, FE and exam steps with a source link and verified date on every fact; where a fact could not be confirmed it says check with the board
- Works offline, with no account; text size from 50 to 300 percent

CODES AND REFERENCES
Questions cite, and never reproduce, the editions the exam scores against: NEC (NFPA 70) 2020, NFPA 70E 2021, NFPA 497 and 499 2021, NFPA 30B 2023 and NESC (ANSI C2) 2017. Candidates also receive the NCEES PE Electrical and Computer: Power Reference Handbook through MyNCEES; learn to use it, it is not included here.

FREE WITH ADS, UNLOCK WITH A SHORT VIDEO
Free with ads. Watch a short video to unlock premium features for 24 hours, or remove ads and unlock everything with a monthly subscription. Premium features include the advanced labs, the longer mocks and the extra 3D scenes; the core study units, the diagnostic, drills, the 20-question mock, the coverage screen and the state guide are free. Ads appear only at natural breaks, never inside a timed mock. The monthly subscription renews monthly until cancelled. Cancel any time in your App Store or Google Play account settings. If you cancel, you keep ad-free until the end of the period you already paid for, and you will not be charged again. Restore purchase is on the Me tab.

ADULTS ONLY
This app is for adults aged 18 and over.

NOT AFFILIATED WITH NCEES
NCEES and PE are marks of their owners and are used only to identify the exam. This app is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by NCEES. All questions, text and figures are original. Licensure rules vary by state: always confirm with your board. Study material only, not a design reference for real projects.
