name: PharmKora
description:
PharmKora is a simple map for finding pharmacies near you.

• See pharmacies around your current location, or explore cities across Ghana
• Search for a pharmacy by name
• See each pharmacy's address and how far away it is
• Get directions in your maps app with one tap
• Call a pharmacy directly when a phone number is listed

Sharing your location is optional. PharmKora uses it only while you search, to show nearby pharmacies, and does not store it. You can also search by name or browse by city without sharing your location.

Pharmacy locations come from pharmacies listed with PharmKora and from public map data, including OpenStreetMap and Mapbox. Opening hours and services vary, so contact the pharmacy to confirm before you visit.

PharmKora does not sell medicines and does not give medical advice.

name: Pilot: VFR Preflight & Logbook
description:
Pilot is a preflight companion for VFR pilots flying under Part 91 in the United States. It answers the questions you ask before every flight, and it tells you plainly when it cannot answer one.

CONDITIONS
- The current report and the terminal forecast, judged against the VFR minimums for the airspace you are in and against your own limits
- Density altitude, and the wind split along and across each runway
- A report too old to act on is never shown as a green light

A FLIGHT FROM ONE FIELD TO ANOTHER
- The forecast for the hour you will be there, at both ends
- SIGMETs, G-AIRMETs, pilot reports and temporary flight restrictions along the route, and the controlled and special-use airspace the line crosses
- Runways, frequencies and what nearby fields are reporting
- Share the whole briefing as plain text

YOUR AIRCRAFT
- Weight and balance at takeoff and on landing, from the figures in your own aircraft's papers
- Fuel against 14 CFR 91.151 and against your own reserve
- Handbook takeoff and landing distance set against each runway

YOUR PAPERS
- Medical, flight review, annual, transponder and ELT dates, counted by the rule each falls under, with reminders before they run out

LOGBOOK
- Flights, aircraft and 14 CFR 61.57 currency, kept in your own iCloud

WHAT IT IS NOT
Pilot is a planning aid. It is not an official weather briefing, not a navigation source and not for IFR. It does not show NOTAMs. The decision to fly is yours.

Data: FAA and NOAA, public domain. No account, no tracking, no ads.

FREE AND PRO
Free, always: current conditions, airspace, restrictions and raw reports.
Pilot Pro adds the flight briefing, weight and balance, fuel and runway margins, papers and reminders, the extended outlook, unlimited logbook and export, local traffic and widgets.

Pilot Pro is offered as a monthly or yearly auto-renewing subscription, or as a one-time lifetime purchase.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://pilot-backend.pilotproject.workers.dev/privacy

name: Ping: Network Latency Tester
description:
Ping is a fast, no-nonsense network tool: type a domain or IP address, tap once, and watch live output from a real ICMP ping — response times, TTL, packet loss and min/avg/max latency, as the classic command-line tool reports them.

Whether a website seems down, your WiFi keeps dropping, or you just want to know if a server, router or printer is reachable, a quick ping test shows you in seconds what is going on.

What you can do
• Ping any domain name or IP address (or localhost)
• Watch replies arrive live, line by line — response time in ms, TTL and sequence for every packet
• Read the summary at a glance: packets sent and received, packet loss, min/avg/max round-trip time
• Stop a ping at any time and keep the replies and timing collected so far
• Check your ping before gaming — measure latency to any game server address
• Check whether a host is up: websites, servers, your router or any device on your network

Fast to use
• See your connection type, local IP address and subnet before you ping
• Address history — re-run recent pings in two taps
• Your last address is remembered between sessions
• Instant input validation catches typos in IPs and domain names
• Copy the full output to the clipboard to share with your ISP or network admin
• Choose how many pings to send (1–30) from the home screen

Troubleshoot your connection
• Slow internet? Compare latency to your router's address and to a public host to see where the lag is
• Website down? Ping it to tell whether it is the site or your connection
• WiFi problems? Run a longer ping and watch for dropped replies as you move around

What Ping does, and what it does not
Ping measures latency, packet loss and the quality of a connection. It cannot make your connection faster: it changes no network settings and adds no bandwidth. It shows delay, not download speed. A run in progress ends when you leave the app.

Design and privacy
• Made for iPhone, in light and dark appearance
• Available in 40+ languages
• No account, no location, no contacts — pings run right on your device

name: Pipe Gather
description: Pipe Gather keeps one gather on this iPhone. A blow adds a ring only when the pipe points down, the glass is hot, and the neck is thin. That blow also cools the glass. Blow while the pipe points up and the ring count stays, but the neck becomes thick. A thick neck blocks the next blow until you reheat. Reheating warms the glass and thins the neck. It does not add a ring. At four rings the gather is a vessel: blow, reheat, and aim no longer change it. Name a gather, open it from the list, and share the sentence. There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: Pit Window
description:
Now, or one more lap?

Pit Window is open-wheel racing seen from above, where the tires wear out and every race needs a pit stop. Drive hard, watch the rubber, and pick your moment. The stop takes two seconds if your thumb is good.

Free. No ads. No account. Nothing tracked.

HOW IT WORKS
Hold Gas to go. The car steers itself.
Brake for the sharp corners. Brake late and you run wide onto the grass.
Tap Pit and the car turns into the pit lane next time by.
Tap Go the moment the crew finishes. Then race to the flag.

IT WEARS
Every lap takes a little grip. For a while you barely notice. Then, around 60 percent worn, the tires fall off a cliff and the corners get wide. Stop too early and you give time away. Stop too late and you give away more.

TWO KINDS OF TIRE
Sprint · Endurance

Sprint tires are faster and fade sooner. Endurance tires are steadier and last longer. Pick a set for the start and another for the stop. Both plans can win.

THE STOP IS YOURS
The crew needs two seconds. Tap Go as they finish and you are away with a perfect stop. Tap late and you sit there. Tap early and the stop is fumbled: four seconds, and everyone you passed comes back by.

Every car must stop once. Skip it and 15 seconds go on your time.

IT RACES BACK
One to five rivals at Easy, Normal or Hard. Each one plans a stop, chooses tires and looks for a way past. Catch a slower car and yours pulls out and goes by. Tuck in behind one on the straight and the slipstream pulls you along.

THREE CIRCUITS
Marlow Bay · Sable Ridge · Lindenmere

Marlow Bay is fast and flowing. Sable Ridge is long straights into slow corners. Lindenmere is tight, twisty and hard on tires. A race takes about four minutes.

TWO PEDALS AND A PIT BUTTON
One half of the screen is Gas and the other is Brake, so your thumbs never hunt for a button. Gas sits under whichever thumb you choose and turns into Go in the pit box. A ring round the Brake button shows when to brake, and you can switch it off once you know the circuits. A tire gauge, a map of the circuit and your position are always on screen.

NOTHING LEAVES THE PIT LANE
No account. No sign-up. No ads. No purchases. No analytics. No servers. No connection needed. Your settings live on your phone and nowhere else. Our App Store privacy label reads "Data Not Collected", the strictest label Apple has.

Four minutes, start lights to trophy. One more race is hard to refuse.

name: Pixel Trips
description:
Keep your next trip together with Pixel Trips. Save places you want to visit, organise your days and keep your flights and accommodation alongside your plans.

BUILD YOUR TRIP
Create a day-by-day itinerary, add places and activities, and organise your timeline. Keep extra ideas in Extras until you are ready to add them to a day.

SAVE YOUR FAVOURITES
Keep destinations, places and accommodation together so your favourite finds are easy to return to. Add your flight details and keep outbound and return journeys separate.

SEE YOUR PLANS ON A MAP
Explore saved places and view your itinerary on a map to understand where each day takes you.

PLAN TOGETHER
Share an itinerary with your travel companions and use polls to decide where to go or stay.

GET INSPIRED
Browse published community itineraries, follow creators and save ideas for your own adventures.

Designed with a calm sage-green style, Pixel Trips keeps the focus on your plans. Sign in to save your content and return to it across your devices.

Pixel Trips is a trip-planning app. Saving a flight or accommodation does not make a booking.

name: Plantweek
description: Plantweek is a houseplant watering notebook. Give each plant a room, an optional pot, and the number of days you want between waterings. The plant grid shows whether the next date is still ahead or already due. The week board is a row of seven days per plant: tap a day to log a watering or to clear that morning. A due list lets you mark watered today in one tap. Pots record size and material, and a pot is held by one plant. Water logs keep an amount note. All of it stays on the phone.

name: Plately: AI Calorie Counter
description:
Snap your plate. Know what you eat.

Plately turns a single photo into calories and macros in seconds — no weighing, no searching databases, no typing.

HOW IT WORKS
• Take a photo of your meal — AI splits it into ingredients with grams, calories, protein, carbs and fat
• Not quite right? Just say it: “it was fried in butter” or “half the rice” — the AI fixes the numbers
• Scan barcodes of packaged food or simply describe your meal in words

YOUR PERSONAL PLAN
• Daily calorie and macro targets built for your body, goal and pace
• See when you'll reach your goal weight
• Smart Coach: one practical tip for the rest of your day

KNOWS REAL FOOD
• Recognises home cooking and dishes from around the world — not just burgers and salads
• Accounts for hidden oils, sauces and dressings

STAY ON TRACK
• Calorie ring, macro bars, water tracker and streaks
• Weight log and progress charts
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets
• Save favourite meals and log them again in one tap

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Your data lives on your iPhone and in your own iCloud — synced across your devices
• No ads, no tracking

PLATELY PRO
Free users get 3 AI scans per day. Plately Pro unlocks unlimited AI photo scans, smart corrections and text descriptions.
• Yearly with a 3-day free trial, or Monthly
Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://aelixapps.github.io/plately/privacy.html

Plately provides AI estimates for general wellness and is not medical advice.

name: Playflex
description:
Don't limit yourself to one app or one instructor. Playflex pulls together workouts from all kinds of instructors on YouTube, connects them automatically to Apple Fitness so you can track your progress, and gives you preset workouts designed by you — your own Stacks and Random Workout mixes. Set and track targets.

YOUR LIBRARY
• Make a category for each kind of workout, such as Yoga or HIIT
• Search YouTube or paste a link
• Sign in with Google to bring in your YouTube likes and playlists. Playflex never changes anything on your YouTube account

PRESET WORKOUTS DESIGNED BY YOU
• A stack plays several videos back to back as one session
• See the mix as an equation of minutes, such as Yoga 20 + HIIT 21 + Core 25
• Random Workout: choose up to four categories and Playflex picks one video from each

PROGRESS IN APPLE FITNESS
• Every workout, including each part of a stack, saves automatically to the Apple Fitness app
• Workouts also save automatically to Apple Health and appear in the Fitness app
• Today’s Activity rings sit at the top of the library (today only)
• A rolling 7-day total sits beside a weekly minutes target you set, and counts workouts from Playflex and other apps in Apple Fitness
• Per-category 7-day totals are coloured by how close you are to each target
• Streaks and how this week compares with your usual week are worked out on your iPhone

APPLE TV AND APPLE WATCH
• Use Screen Mirroring from Control Center to put the video full screen on your Apple TV, while playback, workout stats and your stack stay on your iPhone
• Install Playflex on Apple Watch to see heart rate and active calories on the player

PLAYFLEX PLUS
Playflex is free to download. The free plan includes 1 workout stack, 2 categories and 4 workouts per category, and may show one launch ad a day (never the first time you open the app, and never during a workout). Ads are not personalised, and Playflex never asks for tracking permission.

Playflex Plus is a one-time purchase, not a subscription. The intended price in Canada is C$4.99; the app shows Apple’s localised price. Plus removes the launch ad, unlocks unlimited stacks and categories, and raises the per-category limit to 100 workouts. If your library is already over a free limit, everything you have is kept. Plus can be shared with up to five family members through Apple Family Sharing.

Dark Mode follows your iPhone setting.

Playflex is made by Finjamco, a small Ottawa company. Your Health data stays on your devices.

Requires iPhone with iOS 18 or later. Apple Watch is optional (watchOS 11 or later).

name: Pocket Puzzle Club Games
description:
Pocket Puzzle Club is a small shelf of pocket puzzles: four Daily Games, Last Square Detective, and three Picture Puzzles.

DAILY GAMES
A new puzzle every day at midnight Eastern Time.

• Pocket Word: find the hidden five-letter word in six tries. Colors show which letters are in the right spot, in the word but in the wrong spot, or not in the word. Play the Daily puzzle, or Practice as much as you like.
• Pocket Digits: remember the number across five rounds.
• Pocket Pop: guess the word before the balloons pop.
• Pocket Find: find eight hidden words and beat the clock. If you are signed in, your Daily times can appear on the Pocket Find leaderboard.

LAST SQUARE DETECTIVE
Work out exactly where everyone is standing. Each board is a hand-painted map split into a grid of squares, with a list of people and clues. Use the clues to place each person, take notes, undo, and confirm when you're sure. The person you are looking for has no clues — they stand in the last open square.

• 48 logic boards: 5 Detective Training boards, then four stories
• Visit Maple Grove School, Tidewater Harbor, The Larkspur Grand, and the Halverston Museum after dark

PICTURE PUZZLES
Clear each board to uncover a hidden picture, one square at a time.

• Arrow Trails: clear arrow paths. 5 hand-painted pictures, 100 boards each — 500 boards in all. Enchanted Stream, Moonlit Waterfall Pool, Glowcap Lagoon, Lantern Lake, and Crystal Spring Cave. Every picture is open from the start.
• Pipe Flow: turn the pipes so water reaches every flower. 7 pictures, 25 boards each — 175 boards in all.
• Vine Knots: untangle the vines to show the picture.

Hearts are shared across the Picture Puzzles. You have 4 hearts. A mistake costs one heart, and a new heart returns every 10 minutes. If you run out, you can watch an ad for one heart, or refill all 4 as an in-app purchase.

HINTS
Sign in to get 2 free hints each day, shared across the games that use them. Free hints reset to 2 at midnight Eastern Time and do not carry over. A pack of 5 extra hints is available as an in-app purchase.

YOUR CLUB
• Progress is saved on your phone. Signing in with Apple, Google, or an email account is optional: it keeps your progress and hints if you change phones, and it lets you appear on the leaderboard.
• The leaderboard ranks signed-in players by total puzzles solved. Your public player card can include a nickname, an optional country, and an optional quote. Your real name and email are never shown. You can report or hide a card.
• Soft music plays on boards, and you can mute it.
• The app shows ads: a small banner on menu screens, an occasional ad after you leave a solved case, and a rewarded ad only if you choose to watch one for a heart. Ads do not interrupt a board you are solving.

Free to play. No account required.

name: Pocket Relay for Antigravity
description:
Pocket Relay lets you follow and steer Google Antigravity on your own computer from your iPhone or iPad.

Start a task at your desk, then walk away. Pocket Relay shows what your agent is doing, asks you before it runs commands or changes files, and lets you answer its questions or send the next instruction from wherever you are.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• See what the agent is working on, with a simple status that updates as it goes
• Approve or deny actions before they run
• Answer the agent's questions and send new prompts, by typing or by voice
• Attach photos and files to a prompt
• Switch between projects and conversations
• Pair more than one computer

HOW IT CONNECTS
Pocket Relay talks directly to a small free companion, Pocket Relay Bridge, that you install on your Mac, Windows PC or Linux computer. There is no Pocket Relay account and no cloud service in between: your phone connects to your computer over your own Wi-Fi or a private network you run. Pair by scanning a QR code.

PRIVACY
The developer collects no data. The app has no advertising, analytics or tracking.

WHAT YOU NEED
• Google Antigravity installed and signed in on your computer
• Pocket Relay Bridge, free from pocketrelay.app
• Your phone and computer on the same Wi-Fi or private network

No computer handy? Try the built-in demo with a sample session.

Pocket Relay is an independent app. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by Google. Google and Antigravity are trademarks of Google LLC.

name: Pour Rescue: Color Sort Puzzle
description:
Every stage is a rescue.

Goldie the fish needs water, a shark is getting closer and Milo the kitten is running out of energy. Tap a bottle, pour the color, fill it up: every finished bottle gives your friend new energy. Pour fast, think smart and save them before the bar runs out!

HOW TO PLAY
• Tap a bottle, then tap another one to pour
• Pour only onto the same color or into an empty bottle
• Fill every bottle with one color

OVER 100 DIFFERENT RESCUES
More than 50 friends to save, from fish and kittens to robots, fairies and snowmen, and almost 30 dangers, from sharks and storms to witches, yetis and meteors. Every rescue is a new little scene, and every win ends with a big "Thank you!"

SIX KINDS OF STAGES
• Sort every bottle into one color
• Fill a big tank to the very top
• Pour the colors in the right order
• Fill every tank with its own color
• Bring each guest a full bottle
• Pour before it is too late

NEW SURPRISES ALONG THE WAY
Hidden layers, collar bottles that take only one color, locked bottles, frozen bottles, small glasses and magic bottles that turn one color into another. Expert stages add a move limit. Each idea is explained the first time you meet it.

300 STAGES, SIX WORLDS, AND MORE
Travel one long river map through Sunny Beach, Flower Garden, Happy Town, Night Carnival, Snowy Peaks and the Royal Castle. Easy, Medium, Hard and Expert stages take turns, and after stage 300 new stages keep coming.

SOMETHING NEW EVERY DAY
• Daily Challenge with three special stages
• Beat the Clock, one timed puzzle a day
• A 7-day reward calendar and daily missions
• A reward chest every 10 stages and a coin bank that fills as you play

STUCK? NO PROBLEM
Use a hint, undo a move, restart, or add an extra bottle. Coins and gems are earned by playing; there are no coin or gem packs for sale.

YOUR STYLE
Unlock Royal and Crystal bottles and new backgrounds with the coins and gems you win.

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Portrait play on iPhone and iPad
• No account and no sign-in
• Stages work without an internet connection
• Free to play with ads; some optional bonuses are given for watching a video

RESCUE VIP (OPTIONAL)
One monthly subscription for players who want more:
• No ads at all: every video reward comes at once
• Play any locked stage with one tap
• Every bottle and background is yours while you are a member
• A daily gift of 3 hints, 1 bottle and 20 gems

Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase. The subscription renews automatically every month unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://pourrescue.xxcut.com/privacy.html

Pour, match and save them all!

name: Povești de la tata
description:
What does the letter A feel like under your fingertips? Read about Louis Braille, then tap the dots on the screen to form the letter yourself. Or discover why Ada Lovelace saw a connection between maths and music.

Choose from 90 true stories and 10 fables and parables to read together. Each one has an illustration, questions to talk about and an activity to try as a family. Search by title or person, bookmark a favourite and come back to it another evening.

The first three stories are free. One purchase in “For parents” unlocks the whole book in every available reading language. Romanian, English, Spanish, Russian and Ukrainian editions are included for offline reading. On compatible iPhones running iOS 18 or later, the language menu also offers on-device machine translations in languages supported by Apple. A language download may be needed the first time.

By A Dad and AI

name: Prep Rush: Storm Shopper
description:
A big storm is on the way and everyone in town had the same idea. Grab a cart, read your list and sprint through the aisles before the other shoppers clear the shelves.

HOW IT WORKS
Every round gives you a list of supplies: water, batteries, flashlights, canned food, paper goods and first aid. The sections you still need glow green with an arrow on top, so you always know where to go. Swipe anywhere to steer your cart. Rival shoppers want the same stock, and when a shelf is empty it's gone. Fill your list, reach checkout before the store closes, and you win the day.

RACE, CHAIN, SCORE
Pick up items and floor coins back to back to build a chain worth up to five times the points. Grab the bonus clock when it drops for five extra seconds. Every round ends with a score and up to three stars, so there is always a better run to chase.

A NEW STORE EVERY DAY
The daily challenge is the same store for everyone on the same day. Win it on back to back days to build your streak and earn bonus coins, then replay it to beat your own score.

MISSIONS AND SHOPPERS
Complete missions like "Hit a x5 chain" or "Win with 30 seconds left" to earn coins. Spend them to unlock new shoppers, from Turbo Granny to Roller Rosie. Shoppers change your look, not your speed, so every round stays fair.

MADE FOR QUICK BREAKS
Rounds last about a minute. Play one handed in portrait. The game pauses itself when a call comes in or you switch apps, follows your silent switch, and works offline, so it's ready on a plane, in a waiting room or in bed.

FEATURES
- Fast arcade rounds of about a minute
- Simple one finger swipe controls
- Rival shoppers that race you for the same stock
- Clear green highlights on what you still need
- Chains, floor coins and bonus clocks
- Daily challenge with streaks
- Missions with coin rewards
- Six unlockable shoppers
- Plays offline, progress saved on your phone

Prep Rush is published by Pudgefinds LLC. Every shopper, store and product in the game is fictional.

Questions or ideas? Email hi@pudgefinds.com

name: PrepWeave: Meal Planner
description:
Cook once. Make three different dinners. PrepWeave shows what to cook tonight, exactly what to set aside, and how to turn it into something different tomorrow.

Pick a three-dinner menu, choose your prep night and set servings for your household. Start with lemon roast chicken, smoky chickpeas or ginger-sesame tofu. Each plan shows which ingredients to buy, when to cook them and what to reserve.

SHOP ONCE
Every dinner feeds one checklist grouped by aisle. Quantities scale with servings and matching ingredients combine. Add a missing item, check groceries off at the store or share a copy from your iPhone or iPad.

COOK THROUGH THE WEEK
Follow step-by-step recipes and see which dinners use the food you already prepped. Save your favorite recipes and add them to the week.

TRY YOUR FIRST PLAN FREE
Plan, shop and cook through your first week. PrepWeave Household is an annual subscription for unlimited weeks and sending groceries to a list you already share in Apple Reminders. Apple Family Sharing is supported.

Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Presto Duo
description:
Presto Duo throws tiny games at you, one after another. Each one lasts a few seconds and comes with a single word: POP! POUR! PINCH! DON'T! Work out what it wants, do it, and the next one is already here.

FAST, THEN FASTER
• Four lives. Miss a game and you lose one.
• Every five rounds the whole thing speeds up.
• Every fifteen, a longer finale. Win it and a life comes back.
• Every game uses a different gesture: tap, swipe, drag, hold, pinch, twist, rub, or keep your hands off.

EASY ON THE EYES
Cream paper, black ink and one colour per game. Big type, small jokes, no clutter. Music made of snaps, claps and marimba that speeds up with you.

TWO PLAYERS, ONE PHONE
DUEL puts a player on each half of the screen with the same tiny game at the same time. First to five wins.

MADE FOR FOLDABLES, GOOD EVERYWHERE
Open a foldable iPhone flat and TWO HANDS appears: two different games at once, one for each hand, and you have to win both. A few gentle games use the fold itself and reward a slow, steady hand. On every other iPhone and on iPad the game plays the same, in any orientation.

• WORLD RANKING — longest run, free for everyone (Game Center).

No ads. No sign-up. We collect no data.

name: Pricey? The Party Price Game
description:
Pricey? is a party game about guessing what things really cost. Get a group together, take turns, and find out who has the best feel for money.

There are more than 150 real prices to guess. They range from the everyday to the strange:
• Everyday prices in the past: a pint of milk in 1990, a Ford Cortina in 1970, a Party Seven in 1975
• Today's prices: a Tube fare, a PS5 Pro, the average UK wedding
• Strange auction sales: a 285-year-old lemon, coal from the Titanic, John Lennon's tooth
• Famous film props: the Cowardly Lion costume, the Maltese Falcon, Dorothy's ruby slippers

THREE WAYS TO PLAY
• Sharp Guess: everyone names a price. The closest guess wins, and there's a bonus for landing within 5%.
• Fake It: everyone writes a fake price to fool the others, and then you all try to find the real one.
• Cheap to Steep: put four items in order from cheapest to most expensive.

PLAY YOUR WAY
• One phone: pass it round the room. A hand-over screen keeps your guess hidden.
• Everyone's phone: each player joins on their own iPhone over a local connection and answers in secret. No account or internet connection is needed.

Each reveal comes with a story behind the price. It's great for parties, family gatherings, pub nights and long car journeys.

The game works for 2 to 12 players. There are no ads, no accounts and no tracking.

name: PRISM BLEND
description:
PRISM BLEND is a physics-based optical puzzle game built around real light behavior.

Reflect beams with mirrors, focus or diverge light with convex and concave lenses, split white light into a spectrum with dispersion prisms, diffract rays through gratings, and combine RGB beams via additive color mixing to illuminate every target crystal.

KEY FEATURES:
- 74 Handcrafted Levels across 7 Chapters: Progress smoothly from basic reflections to focal-length tuning, spectral dispersion, diffraction orders, and multi-beam color synthesis.
- Precision Controls: Drag elements directly or fine-tune angles down to 0.1°, adjust lens focal lengths, and toggle grid snapping.
- Sandbox Mode: Place light sources, prisms, lenses, gratings, and crystals freely on an open optical bench to experiment and simulate your own setups.
- Offline Play & Built-in Hints: Play anywhere offline, with optional hints whenever you need a nudge.

name: Prism Spatial Video Player
description:
Watch web videos, direct video links, and local movies on Apple Vision Pro. Open a compatible video from a web page, paste a video link, or choose a movie from Files. Explore 180° and 360° video and compatible side-by-side 3D footage in Prism’s immersive player.

Turn on Green Screen Passthrough to make a clip’s green backdrop transparent so the subject appears in your surroundings. Adjust key strength, green spill, and room lighting. For compatible 180° footage, resize the subject with Fit. Stream the original 8K stereo Orbit demo from the Start Page.

Watch Orbit on the big screen in Palace, or open a website in the Palace or Jungle viewing environment. Keep favorite sites close and use Private Browsing for temporary sessions. Prism supports compatible MP4, MOV, and HLS sources. Playback options depend on the website, video format, and device software.

name: PROFEX-A Escola Executiva
description:
Você sabe exatamente o que precisa fazer. Mesmo assim, a tarefa fica para amanhã, o dia passa rápido demais e aquele projeto importante continua parado. Isso não é falta de vontade. Organizar, planejar, começar e manter o foco são competências — e competências se aprendem.

A PROFEX-A Escola Executiva é um programa educativo de um ano para treinar essas competências no seu ritmo, com poucos minutos por dia.

COMO FUNCIONA
• 10 aulas práticas, uma por semana, curtas e diretas.
• 5 minutos de prática por dia, com exercícios aplicados à sua vida real.
• Ferramentas que ficam com você para usar sempre que precisar.
• Um acompanhamento do seu progresso, para ver o que está mudando.

O QUE VOCÊ VAI APRENDER
• Mapear o seu perfil executivo: onde as coisas travam e onde você já vai bem.
• P.A.R.A.R.: perceber quando entrou no piloto automático e voltar ao objetivo.
• Árvore de Tarefas: transformar uma tarefa enorme em passos que se começam em 10 minutos.
• Calibração do tempo: estimar melhor quanto as coisas realmente demoram.
• Foco e distrações: estacionar pensamentos e voltar mais depressa à tarefa.
• Da intenção ao primeiro gesto: começar, mesmo sem vontade.
• STOP-3R: criar uma pausa entre o impulso e a ação.
• QUANDO-ENTÃO: lembrar do que importa no momento certo.
• Resolver problemas passo a passo e decidir com mais clareza.
• O seu Manual Executivo Pessoal, com o que funciona para você.

DEPOIS DAS 10 AULAS
O programa continua durante o ano: trilhas de aplicação para trabalho, estudos, casa, finanças e comunicação, desafios mensais e revisões ao 1.º, 3.º, 6.º e 12.º mês para consolidar o que aprendeu.

FEITO PARA VOCÊ
• Disponível em português do Brasil, português de Portugal, inglês e espanhol.
• Voz que lê as instruções em voz alta (voz gerada por IA), com velocidade ajustável.
• Os seus dados ficam no seu aparelho. Sem cadastro, sem anúncios.
• Relatório do seu progresso em PDF, para guardar ou compartilhar.

QUEM CRIOU
O programa foi desenvolvido por uma psicóloga e neuropsicóloga com mais de 30 anos de experiência, a partir do protocolo PROFEX-A™.

Programa educativo. Não substitui avaliação nem acompanhamento profissional.

EXPERIMENTE SEM COMPROMISSO
A Aula 1 e o Diário executivo são gratuitos. Para continuar, faça a matrícula trimestral: a assinatura é renovada automaticamente a cada 3 meses, até que você cancele. Você pode cancelar quando quiser nos Ajustes do seu Apple ID, até 24 horas antes da renovação.

Empresas: a PROFEX-A também está disponível por códigos de acesso para equipes. Fale conosco: apoio.menteetech@gmail.com

Política de privacidade: https://profex-escola-a.netlify.app/privacidade.html

name: Psicotécnico CNH do Brasil
seller_name: DIRIGIR AGORA INTERMEDIACAO E TECNOLOGIA LTDA
description:
Sistema de Avaliação e Simulação para o Exame Psicotécnico da CNH. Aplicativo desenvolvido em estrita conformidade com os parâmetros técnicos e metodológicos da avaliação psicológica exigida pela SENATRAN para o processo de habilitação.

Treine sob o padrão rigoroso exigido pelas normativas federais de trânsito. Reduza margens de erro, desenvolva técnicas de controle emocional e gerenciamento do tempo com base em dados precisos e compareça ao exame psicotécnico com total respaldo técnico e analítico.

O app é privado e independente. Não representa nem é mantido por nenhuma entidade governamental ou órgão de trânsito. As fontes de informações baseiam-se nos portais oficiais do governo federal.

FONTES

Resoluções e Normas do Conselho Nacional de Trânsito (CONTRAN) sobre aptidão física e mental:
https://www.gov.br/transportes/pt-br/assuntos/transito/conteudo-contran/resolucoes

Normas e Diretrizes de Avaliação Psicológica no Trânsito (Conselho Federal de Psicologia - CFP):

name: Publio: Community Manager IA
description:
¿Sabes que tu negocio debería publicar más en Instagram, pero no tienes tiempo ni ganas? Publio es tu community manager con inteligencia artificial: prepara las publicaciones de todo el mes con tus propias fotos y tú solo das el OK desde el móvil.

Cómo funciona:
• Escribe tu Instagram y en un minuto analizamos tu perfil: tu nota, cuánto publicas, qué te funciona y qué no.
• Te preparamos el mes: reels, publicaciones y carruseles con su idea, su texto, sus hashtags y el mejor día para publicarlos.
• Haz la foto, nosotros el reel: una foto de tu trabajo con el móvil (unas uñas, un plato, un vestido, una pieza) y la convertimos en un reel con gancho, texto y movimiento.
• Tú solo das el OK: cada publicación te llega a la app. Un toque para aprobarla o para pedir un cambio (otra foto, otro texto u otra idea). Nada se publica sin tu permiso.
• Avisos en el móvil cuando hay algo listo para aprobar.
• Mira cómo creces: tus seguidores, tu interacción y tu nota, semana a semana.
• Vigila a tu competencia: añade negocios de tu zona y te decimos en qué te sacan ventaja.

Pensada para peluquerías, centros de uñas y estética, bares, restaurantes y cafeterías, tiendas de moda, artesanos, clínicas y cualquier negocio local que quiera más clientes desde Instagram sin pagar una agencia.

Puedes probarla gratis con tu Instagram o ver primero una demo con un negocio de ejemplo. El servicio completo (publicamos por ti todo el mes) se contrata en publio.pro.

Puedes borrar tu cuenta y todos tus datos cuando quieras desde la propia app (Cuenta → Borrar mi cuenta).

name: PulseQuill Morse
description:
Build a Morse signal you can inspect, hear and keep.

PulseQuill Morse turns supported text or written Morse symbols into a deterministic integer-unit timing plan and an actual PCM WAV file. It is a local composition and inspection utility—not a microphone decoder, radio transmitter or a claim of real-world reception.

COMPOSE IN EITHER DIRECTION
Enter supported letters, digits and punctuation, or decode dots and hyphens separated into letters and words. Text is normalized to uppercase ASCII; unsupported input is rejected rather than silently transliterated. Save a named draft, reopen it and keep the exact input mode, speed and tone. The searchable Codebook lists every supported character and its canonical Morse pattern.

FOLLOW EACH TIMING ELEMENT
Choose a whole-number speed from5–60 WPM and tone from200–1200 Hz. Inspect every dot, dash, element gap, letter gap and word gap, including its unit position, start frame and frame count. One dot is one unit, a dash three; gaps use1/3/7 units. Cumulative sample boundaries prevent a separate rounding error from accumulating at each element. The plan ends at the last tone with no artificial leading or trailing gap.

GENERATE REAL SOUND AND FILES
Create a48 kHz mono16-bit PCM RIFF WAV with a short tone-edge envelope, play or stop it, and share the actual file through system sharing. Export the whole element timeline as CSV. The public SOS practice input at20 WPM and600 Hz is27 units,1.62 seconds and77760 frames, producing a155564-byte WAV—not a canned audio clip.

KEEP A FROZEN SIGNAL
Freeze the inputs, canonical symbols, integer timing and real WAV/CSV files into an immutable saved signal. Search and reopen it later; draft edits do not rewrite frozen files. Saved-file fingerprints are checked before sharing. Delete only the drafts or signals you choose, or use About to clear the App’s local library.

BOUNDARIES
Up to200 normalized supported ASCII characters or2000 input bytes, at most120 seconds of output and500 combined drafts/signals. No Farnsworth spacing, prosigns, audio recognition, transliteration, live radio or microphone recording. The core workflow requires no App account, advertising or in-app purchase. System backups and the destinations you choose for shared files remain under their own controls.

name: PusulaSudoku
description:
Pusula Sudoku, sevdiğin klasik sudokuya üç özgün ipucu türü ekler. Kurallar aynı: her satır, sütun ve 3×3 kutuda 1'den 9'a kadar her rakam bir kez yer alır. Farkı ipuçlarında.

PUSULA
Kırmızı bir iğne, bulunduğu hücrenin en büyük komşusunu gösterir. İğnenin gösterdiği rakam, üstündeki, altındaki ve yanlarındaki rakamların hepsinden büyüktür.

TOPLAM
Kesik çizgili kafesteki rakamların toplamı, köşedeki küçük sayıya eşittir. Bir kafeste aynı rakam iki kez kullanılmaz.

FARK
Dört hücrenin birleştiği köşedeki rozet, o dört rakamın en büyüğü ile en küçüğü arasındaki farkı söyler.

ÖZELLİKLER
• Kolay, Orta, Zor, Uzman ve Çok zor: 5 zorluk seviyesi
• Sınırsız bulmaca, her seferinde yeni bir tane
• Her bulmacanın tek bir çözümü vardır
• Notlar, geri alma, silme ve ipucu
• Hataları gösterme, rakam ve satır vurgulama ayarları
• Açık, koyu ya da cihaza uyan görünüm
• Seviyelere göre rekorlar, ortalama süreler ve seriler
• Kaldığın yerden devam et: oyunun otomatik kaydedilir

ÇEVRİMDIŞI VE GİZLİ
İnternet gerekmez. Reklam yok, hesap yok, veri toplama yok. Tüm ilerlemen yalnızca cihazında kalır.

Menüde küçük bir sürpriz de var. Bulabilecek misin?

Sevgili Funda'm için ABD'de aşk ile yapıldı.

name: PvoollHeam
description: PvoollHeam is an garden companion built around beds and the plantings “on the vine”—not another generic checklist. Each plot gets a plot fingerprint (sun microclimate plus what is growing there). Every planting shows vine progress toward maturity with growth rings and phases from taking root to ready to pick.

name: QuatroChat - Website Chat
description:
QuatroChat is the app for your team: answer your website visitors wherever you are.

The AI assistant answers questions around the clock from your own content – website, FAQ, documents and product catalog. When a visitor asks for a person, you get a push notification right away and take over the conversation in the app.

MADE FOR ON THE GO
• Inbox with every conversation: waiting, open, closed
• Push notification when a visitor asks for a person – one tap opens the conversation
• Take a conversation, reply, write internal notes, hand it back to the bot or close it
• Visitor card: current page, source, device and earlier conversations
• "Available" status with one switch – the widget shows visitors whether someone is there
• Today at a glance: conversations, AI answers, your team's answers

FOR TEAMS
• Several team members with roles
• Notification settings per person
• Signing out in the app stops notifications on that phone
• Sign in with email, Google or Apple

PLEASE NOTE
The app is for team members of businesses that use QuatroChat on their website. Sign in with your existing account.

Hosted in the EU. No ads, no tracking.

name: Quiet Glass
description: Quiet Glass keeps the name of a room and the sitting you choose: 20, 40, or 60. The number is written down. It does not count time. Drag the glass up and it turns face-down, marking the room covered. Open Covered from the pages at the side to read the room and the minutes. The pages can be read in English, Arabic, Chinese, French, Russian, Spanish, German, or Japanese. The sitting stays on this iPhone.

name: QuietNews.ai
description:
Quiet News gives you a short, AI-powered summary of the previous New York day. Each story links to the original reporting so you can check the details. Some days are quiet.

Open Archive to read a past edition. Quiet News saves the days you open so you can read them offline. Free to read, with no ads or account required.

name: Quran Kamil – القرآن الكريم
description:
Quran Kamil brings the complete Holy Quran to your iPhone: a beautiful mushaf to read, tajweed colours to recite correctly, and renowned reciters to listen to, in a calm design without ads.

• Complete Quran: all 114 surahs in the Uthmani script, as mushaf pages or verse by verse.
• Tajweed colours: letters coloured by tajweed rule (madd, ghunnah, ikhfa, idgham, iqlab, qalqalah…) with a colour guide.
• 15+ renowned reciters, including Mishary Alafasy, Abdul Basit, Al-Husary, Al-Minshawi, As-Sudais, Saad Al-Ghamdi and Maher Al-Muaiqly. The verse being recited is highlighted and followed.
• Listening tools: verse repeat, pause between verses, playback speed, sleep timer, automatic next surah, and playback that continues when the screen is locked.
• Translation under each verse in the app language.
• Navigate by surah, juz or hizb. Bookmark surahs and verses, and continue exactly where you stopped reading or listening.
• Auto-scroll reading at your own speed, pinch to zoom the text, Uthmani or standard font.
• Virtuous Verses: 12 verses with their virtues, explanations and authentic sources.
• Qibla compass, light, dark and sepia themes, and your reading and listening statistics.
• Share a verse with its reference in one tap.

No ads. No account. No personal data collected.
Quran text, translations and recitations are provided by the Quran Foundation.

App languages: English, العربية, Français, Español, Deutsch, Türkçe, اردو, فارسی, Bahasa Indonesia, Bahasa Melayu, বাংলা, Русский.

name: Raelor
description:
Raelor is a small, offline atelier for handmade scent. It keeps six complete formulas, twelve materials, a ratio bench, a thirty-minute dry-down timer and a private journal in one quiet place. There is no account, no shop, no feed, no sync and no advertising. Everything you need for the next blend is already inside the app.
First Light, Velvet Iris, Resin No. 9, Green Hour, Quiet Musk and Evening Tonka. Each formula has a top, a heart and a base; a ratio in parts; a concentration; a bottle size; a rest period; a short rationale; numbered build steps; three quiet notes; and a caution where one is needed. First Light, Green Hour and the others are starting points, not products to buy.

name: Rakyat Life
description:
Rahman pulang ke Kampung Sungai Rambai untuk membuka lagi kedai kopi almarhum Bapak. Kedainya kecil, utang Bapak masih Rp4.000.000, dan titian kampung mulai lapuk. Dari balik meja kopi inilah perjalanannya dimulai: dari warga biasa menjadi Ketua RT.

KEDAI & WARUNG RAHMAN
- Racik kopi dengan tanganmu sendiri: tuang, tunggu, aduk, lalu sajikan sebelum pembeli kehilangan sabar.
- Jaga warung sembako: timbang barang curah, catat kasbon tetangga, dan antar pesanan ke rumah warga.
- Belanja stok, atur harga, dan pegang buku kas. Saat Rahman pergi, Ibu yang menjaga kedai.

KAMPUNG YANG HIDUP
- Jelajahi kampung tepi sungai: gang, titian, dan dermaga. Tempat yang belum pernah didatangi masih gelap di peta.
- Perahu lewat, warga lalu-lalang, hujan dan petir datang tiba-tiba, siang berganti malam.
- Kabar warga, pesanan antar, dan obrolan kampung datang lewat HP Rahman.

DARI KEDAI KE MUSYAWARAH RT
- Dengarkan keluhan warga di Buku Aspirasi, bantu urusan surat pengantar, dan ikut musyawarah RT.
- Kebaikan berbalas: warga yang kamu tolong akan menolong balik.
- Pilihanmu dalam cerita meninggalkan jejak.

HIDUP SULIT, TAPI SELALU ADA JALAN
- Amplop belanja mingguan keluarga, tugas harian, dan tantangan mingguan.
- Banyak cara mencari uang: memancing, mengangkut barang, memetik buah, dan kerja lain di kampung.
- Mini-game yang mudah dimainkan: meracik kopi, menimbang barang, memancing, mendayung sampan, memperbaiki titian, dan lainnya.

BERSAING DENGAN ADIL
- Papan peringkat mingguan, bulanan, dan sepanjang masa, dengan liga mingguan.
- Peringkat hanya dari kegiatanmu sendiri.
- Kumpulkan lencana dan pakaian baru untuk Rahman di Lemari.

MAIN KAPAN SAJA
- Bisa dimainkan tanpa internet dan tanpa masuk akun. Saat tersambung, progres dicadangkan ke awan; Masuk dengan Apple atau kode pemulihan memindahkan progresmu ke iPhone baru.
- Cerita terbuka bab demi bab mengikuti hari, jadi hidup di kampung terasa berjalan dari hari ke hari.

PERLU DIKETAHUI
- Versi ini berisi Musim 1 "Kedai Bapak" (Bab 1 sampai 6, dari warga biasa sampai Ketua RT).
- Game ini berbahasa Indonesia dan menampilkan iklan.
- Semua tokoh, lembaga, merek, dan peristiwa dalam game ini fiktif. Tidak ada partai atau tokoh politik nyata.

name: Re_Notation
description:
Re_Notation labels your astrophotos. Open a picture of the night sky, taken through a telescope, a camera lens or a phone, and the app works out which part of the sky it shows, then names what is in it: nebulae, galaxies, star clusters, bright stars and planets. Everything runs on the device, with no account and no network.

PLATE SOLVING, OFFLINE
• A built-in star index finds the field blindly: no hint, no focal length needed
• Telescope fields from about half a degree, camera lenses up to about 120°
• Lens distortion is measured and corrected on wide-angle shots
• Stitched Milky Way panoramas are solved too
• Pictures that already carry a plate solution (FITS, XISF) are labelled straight away

LABELS THAT MAKE SENSE
• Over 150,000 catalogue objects, one name per object
• On wide fields the big named sights come first: the Galactic Center, Andromeda, the Orion Nebula, the Pleiades
• Objects behind the landscape are left out
• Planets placed from the time the picture was taken
• Turn labels on and off by type, rename them, export the annotated picture

MOON AND PLANETS
• Moon photos: seas, craters, mountains, valleys and landing sites, matched to the disc
• Explore your Moon photo in 3-D: turn it, zoom in, tap a name to fly there
• Jupiter and Saturn close-ups: belts, zones, rings and their moons

FORMATS
JPEG, PNG, HEIC, TIFF, camera RAW, FITS and XISF.

DEEP CATALOGUE
Point Re_Notation to a PixInsight Gaia star database on your device to label faint stars and solve very narrow fields.

Star data: USNO UCAC4, HYG Database (CC BY-SA 4.0). Deep-sky data: OpenNGC (CC BY-SA 4.0) and catalogues from CDS/VizieR. Moon feature names: IAU.

name: ReadingPace Page Planner
description: Plan your reading for one book. Enter its page count and the number of days left. Log pages in Progress, and Plan updates the daily target based on the remaining pages. Your plan and progress are saved on this device.

name: ReadWay: Read-Aloud Coach
description:
ReadWay is a read-aloud reading coach. I built it for my son, who found reading hard. You read a story aloud, and ReadWay follows along word by word. Words you get stuck on go into a notebook for practice. A reading voice can read each sentence first, so you listen and then read it yourself. The app comes with 2,500 English stories with comprehension questions, 13 short games, a daily plan and a progress report. You can also add your own books as Word, PDF, EPUB, RTF or TXT files.

Speech recognition and the reading voices run on the device. No audio is sent to a server. There are no ads, no accounts and no third-party tracking or analytics. Optional iCloud backup: profiles and history are backed up to your own iCloud account, and it can be turned off in the parent area. ReadWay is free for the first 3 days from first use: 1 story and 2 games a day, with 1 reader profile. After that, reading and games need ReadWay Pro. ReadWay Pro comes as a monthly subscription, a yearly subscription or a one-time lifetime purchase that does not renew. Only the yearly subscription has a free trial: 7 days, for eligible users. ReadWay Pro can be shared with your family through Family Sharing. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings. Privacy Policy: https://readway.gekaret.com/privacy Terms of Use: https://readway.gekaret.com/terms Contact: admin@gekaret.com

name: Ream Tray
description:
Ream Tray is for the person who keeps paper in the office printer. The tray is already out, and the paper is not in it yet.

Name this tray. Drag the low-line mark up or down until the bottom is where you want it, from 1 to 6. Drag a ream into the box, up to 8. When the reams sit below that line, pull the restock tag down and the tag is written on this iPhone.

The next time you open the tray, you can see how many reams are still in the box and which restock tags have already been pulled. Nothing is ordered, and no file is made. The trays and tags stay on this iPhone.

name: Recto – E-Invoice
description:
Recto makes e-invoices readable. XRechnung, ZUGFeRD, Factur-X and Peppol appear as a clear invoice sheet: who gets paid, how much, by when, to which account. Everything stays on your device, with no account and no upload. Recto has no internet access.

READ AND CHECK (FREE)
• Open from Mail, Files, Finder or by drag and drop: XML (UBL and CII) and PDFs with an embedded invoice
• Payment card with amount, due date, IBAN and payment reference, each copied with one tap
• Checks required fields and totals according to EN 16931, in plain words. Invalid IBANs stand out.
• View the invoice’s attachments and the original XML
• Storage: every invoice is filed as its original file in a “Recto” folder by year, on your device or in your iCloud Drive
• Reminder two days before an invoice is due, optionally as a calendar event

RECTO PRO
• Write invoices (for businesses under German law): enter your details once, pick a customer, add items. Recto issues a ZUGFeRD PDF (PDF/A-3, EN 16931 profile), plus XRechnung for German authorities with a Leitweg-ID. Sequential numbers, small business rule (§ 19 UStG).
• Issued invoices stay unchanged; corrections go through a cancellation invoice
• Recurring invoices, payment reminders when overdue, sending straight from Mail
• Payment QR code (GiroCode/EPC): pay with your banking app without typing
• Save or print any e-invoice as a readable PDF
• List for your accountant: month, quarter or year as CSV, with all invoices if you like
• Shortcuts: “Convert E-Invoice to PDF” and “Read Invoice Data”

Test mode lets you try issuing for free: test invoices are marked as such and can be deleted again.

For iPhone, iPad and Mac. One subscription covers all your devices.

Recto Pro costs €4.99 a month or €39.99 a year, and the first week is free. The subscription renews automatically unless cancelled in Settings at least 24 hours before the end of the period.

The checks in Recto are not an official validation (KoSIT). You are responsible for the content of your invoices.

Terms of Use: https://0xdeploy.studio/recto/terms#en
Privacy: https://0xdeploy.studio/recto/privacy

name: ReinShots: Screenshot Mockup
description:
Turn plain app screenshots into store-ready images, right on your iPhone or iPad.

ReinShots is a screenshot studio for app makers. Add a screenshot, pick a design, write your caption and export at the exact size your listing needs. No watermarks, no account, no subscription.

START FROM A TEMPLATE
• 72 designer templates with layered backgrounds and sample screens
• Free starter layouts for a clean, simple look
• Open any template and make it yours: your screenshots, your words, your colours

DESIGN EVERY DETAIL
• Device frames for phones, foldables and tablets, or your own SVG frames
• Solid, gradient, pattern and image backgrounds
• As many text blocks as you like, with fonts, highlights, pills, outlines and rating stars
• Shapes, stickers, extra devices and close-ups of a screen
• Panorama mode: one background flowing across all your screens
• Smart layouts that arrange text and device in a tap

EVERY LANGUAGE, EVERY SIZE
• Translate your captions and switch language in a tap
• Bulk export: every language and every size as one ZIP, in folders fastlane can upload
• Phone, tablet, desktop and smartwatch sizes
• A check before export finds cut-off text, missing translations and missing screenshots

STUDIO TOOLS
• Quick Framer: wrap any screenshot in a device frame and save a transparent PNG
• Asset Resizer: crop icons and graphics to exact store dimensions

YOURS, ON YOUR DEVICE
• Your projects stay on your device. No account needed.
• Save a project as a file to back it up or move it to another device.

FREE AND PRO
Free: one project of your own, one export a day, solid and gradient backgrounds, phone frames and phone sizes, and every template to try.

Pro, a one-time purchase: unlimited projects and exports, exporting the designer templates, image and pattern backgrounds, premium shapes, stickers, extra devices, close-ups, text styles, tablet, desktop and smartwatch sizes, custom frames, panorama mode and bulk export.

Pay once. No subscription.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Rep Clan
description:
Train with a structured 4-week workout plan built around your goals, experience, space and kit — whether you train at home with no equipment, with dumbbells, or in the gym.

WHAT YOU GET WITH REP CLAN PRO
• Personalised 4-week plans: built from a short quiz covering your goals, level, schedule (2 to 5 days a week) and session length (15, 25 or 40 minutes), with weekly progression and fresh exercise variations every 2 weeks.
• Guided workout player: 3-2-1 countdown, circular work and rest timers, animated character demos for all 46 exercises, form cues, optional audio beeps that mix with your music, and warm-up & cool-down built in.
• 5 targeted challenges: 7 to 28-day daily routines for core, abs, hips & lower back, posture and grip.
• Simple daily eating guide: adult daily calorie & protein estimates, 24 quick recipes with one-tap Swap, nutritional breakdown per serving, and a 7-day shopping list.
• Workout reminders & weight log: optional local training reminders and private on-device weight tracking. No account or login required.

SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION
Rep Clan requires an active Rep Clan Pro auto-renewing subscription to access plans, challenges, the workout player and meal guides:
• 1 Month — billed monthly
• 3 Months — billed every 3 months
• 1 Year — billed yearly

Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically for the same length and price unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your Apple Account settings.

Rep Clan provides general fitness guidance for ages 16 and up and is not medical advice.

Privacy Policy: https://repclan.com/app-privacy
Terms of Use: https://repclan.com/app-terms

name: Rewind: Nightly Diary
description:
Each night, before you sleep, tell Rewind your day backwards: from getting into bed, back to this morning. Talk or type, the way you'd tell a friend.

Rewind finds the moments in it, the people you were with and the places you went, and keeps them as a diary on your phone. Day by day it becomes a picture of your life: who you see most, where you spend your time, and how your weeks feel.

TELL IT BACKWARDS
Starting from the end makes remembering easy. One thing leads to the one before it, and the whole day comes back in a couple of minutes.

A DIARY THAT ORGANIZES ITSELF
- Every night is split into moments, with the people and places tagged for you
- Browse your days in the archive, or open a person or a place to see every moment together
- A weekly recap of what your week was made of
- Insights about who and where fill your days

SHARE ONLY WHAT YOU CHOOSE
- Send a night, a week, a person or a place as a card to the few people you pick
- Choose exactly which lines go on the card, and pick from 20 card themes
- Share lines with a small circle of your closest people
- Replies and moons stay between the people involved

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
- Your diary lives on your phone, not on our server
- Optional backup is locked with a recovery key only you hold, so we can't read it
- No ads, no selling your data, no tracking across apps
- Report and block anyone; reports are reviewed within 24 hours

One gentle nudge each night, never on nights you've already kept.

name: Rewindle: Reverse Audio
description:
Rewindle plays sound backwards. Record with the microphone or import audio, even the sound from a video, and hear it in reverse straight away.

RECORD OR IMPORT
• Record up to 5 minutes, with a live level meter and waveform
• Import audio files from Files, or take the soundtrack from a video in Files or Photos
• Every clip is reversed on your iPhone in seconds

PLAY IT BACKWARDS
• Switch between forwards and backwards at any time
• Scrub on the waveform and watch the playhead move
• Change the speed from 0.5× to 2×, and keep the pitch or let it slide like a tape
• Shift the pitch up or down by up to 12 semitones
• Loop playback

REVERSE CHALLENGE
1. Record a phrase
2. Hear it backwards
3. Record yourself copying the backwards sound
4. Rewindle flips your copy back so you hear how close it sounds
Play the original and your flipped-back attempt side by side. An optional rough match score compares the tone and loudness of the two clips. It's an estimate and can't judge words or singing, so trust your ears too.

TWO-PLAYER MATCH
Pass the phone back and forth. One player records a secret phrase and the other copies it backwards. You score points for the match, plus a bonus if the phrase's owner can recognise it. Rewindle keeps track of turns, totals and the winner.

TRIM, FADE & EXPORT
• Trim with handles on the waveform, add fade-in and fade-out, and normalise the loudness
• Export M4A or WAV, forwards or backwards, with or without your speed and pitch changes
• Make a short square video with a spinning cassette and the waveform, ready to share

YOUR LIBRARY
Name, rename, favourite and delete your clips. Search them, and filter to favourites.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Recordings stay on your iPhone. The microphone is used only while you record. No account, no ads, no tracking, and the app is completely free.

name: Rising-star
description:
Get exclusive special offers on the mobile app!

Use the mobile app to enjoy features optimized for mobile devices and access exclusive special offers.



Main features:

Enjoy exclusive coupons and discounts

Use automatic login

Check and track your orders

Manage your shopping cart and shipping info

Receive store notifications

Access social media channels

Contact Customer Service

name: Ritter
description:
Build a reading list from news sites, blogs, and other publishers with RSS or Atom feeds. Find sources in the built-in directory or add a website or feed yourself. New articles appear in chronological order in your timeline.

Choose how your timeline looks. Filter by source, category, language, or reading status, and search for articles by keyword. Save articles to Favorites to revisit them later. Open the original web page from any article.

Ritter uses iCloud to sync your followed sources, favorites, and reading status across your iPhone, iPad, and Mac.

name: Rochester Assembly Church
description:
The official app of Rochester Assembly in Rochester, Minnesota.

Whether you are visiting for the first time or have called this church home for years, the app keeps you close to what is happening.

PLAN YOUR VISIT
Service times, the address, directions, and what to expect when you walk in.

WATCH SERMONS
Catch up on recent messages and sermon series.

SERMON NOTES
Follow the message on Sunday with the day's notes at the top of Home. Read them in 13 languages and tap any reference to read the verse.

EVENTS
See what is coming up this week and this month, and sign up for events that need registration.

MINISTRIES
Kids, youth, adults, worship and more. Find the group that fits and see how to get involved.

GIVE AND CONNECT
Giving, member sign-in, event sign-ups and check-in open securely in Church Center.

No account is needed. No ads and no tracking.

name: Rovex pro
description: Rovex is a small, offline notebook for walking. It holds a fixed catalogue of twenty-four kinds of walking ground, a private record of every walk you make, and five short notes on reading the ground and choosing a season. There is no account, no feed, no map, no sync and no advertising. Everything you need for the next ramble is already inside the app.

name: Royal Block: Relic Escape
description:
The way out is on the right. Slide each stone along its groove, clear a path for the glowing block, then send it through the gate. Watch the rest of the board split into carved fragments.

Work through 3,000 puzzles, from short opening boards to tightly packed challenges. Plan around the move counter and the clock, or revisit a cleared level to improve your best move count.

Build a cabinet of 54 playable blocks across Crown Horses, Court Beasts and Sky Seals. Each new clear advances your collection. Equip a favorite to carry its engraving onto the next board, and earn silver and gold finishes as you progress.

Free lives refill over time. Optional one-time purchases add reserve lives or extra moves. You can spend five extra moves to continue a board when its move counter reaches zero.

name: RYNO Temps
description:
RYNO Temps monitors the temperature of your fridges and freezers, with no manual logs.

• A probe in each unit continuously measures the temperature; a gateway sends the data to the cloud.
• If the temperature goes out of range or the signal drops, you receive an instant alert.
• Temperature reports in PDF or Excel, ready for an inspection.
• Every incident is documented: cause, corrective action and person responsible.
• No technician needed: attach the probe and plug in the gateway.

A food safety self-monitoring (HACCP) tool for restaurants, hotels and food shops.

name: Sabres & Rails: Civil War
description:
Sabres & Rails puts the Civil War at your fingertips on iPhone and iPad. Plan the campaign on a map of the United States, and when your armies meet the enemy, charge onto the battlefield and fight it out yourself, by touch and in real time.

THE CAMPAIGN
Begin in 1861 with everything still to play for, or step into the war in 1862, 1863, or 1864. Then fight your way across a 25-territory map of the United States, one territory at a time.

THE BATTLES
In Arcade mode, every clash on the map becomes a battle you fight with your own fingers, and the result is yours to win or lose. Commanders who'd rather stay at the map table can choose Strategy mode, which plays the war without the real-time battlefield.

TRAINS AND FORTS
Some moments are too good to leave to the map. Rob a train and storm a fort in action scenes of their own, or set them to Automatic at setup and let them be decided for you.

TWO PLAYERS, ONE SCREEN
Hand a friend the other half of the screen. You take turns on the map, and when your armies meet, you both fight the same battle at once on a split screen. Playing solo, you face the computer at one of three difficulty ranks. Pick the one that matches your nerve.

LEARN AS YOU PLAY
If you've never commanded an army, the guided tutorial game teaches you the rules while you play, and it's free from start to finish.

YOUR WAR, ANYWHERE
Sabres & Rails plays fully offline, which turns a long flight into a campaign. Your war is saved automatically, so you can put it down mid-campaign and pick it up right where you left off. There's no account to create, and the game collects no data.

FOR EVERY PLAYER
VoiceOver reads the map, the menus, and the battle controls. The real-time battlefield is the one part it can't read, and Strategy mode plays the whole war without it.

EVERY WAR BEGINS FREE
Download Sabres & Rails and start any war you like. Every start year and both modes are free for the first three months of game time, against the computer or a friend. When April comes, your war saves and waits for you. Buy The Whole War once, and that same war marches on to its end, along with every war after it. It works with Family Sharing, and you'll never see an ad.

Pick your start year and take the field.

name: Sallama: Tahmin & Bilgi Oyunu
description:
Titanic kaç Oscar kazandı? Bir koala günde kaç saat uyur? Kimse tam bilmiyor, ama herkes bir sayı sallıyor! Sallama'da doğru cevaba en yakın tahmin kazanır. Arkadaşlarını topla, telefonları çıkar, kahkaha başlasın.

NASIL OYNANIR?
• Herkese aynı soru gelir.
• Herkes kendi tahminini girer ve kilitler.
• Doğru cevap açılır, tüm tahminler sayı doğrusunda yan yana dizilir.
• En yakın olan 5, ikinci 3, üçüncü 2 puan alır. Tam isabet yapana +3 bonus!
• Oyun sonunda podyum seni bekler.

Kesin bilmek zorunda değilsin. Tahmin etmek, sallamak ve birbirinize gülmek oyunun ta kendisi.

Parti modu: Biri oda kurar, diğerleri 6 haneli kodla ya da QR'ı okutarak katılır. 2'den 20 kişiye kadar herkes kendi telefonundan oynar, kimin kilitlediğini canlı görürsün.

name: Salt Society
description:
Salt Society brings selected content creators together with venues in Tunis. The venue offers the experience. You post or deliver the content agreed. Creators pay nothing.

APPLY
Send your application from the app: your name, your birth date, three photos and your Instagram or TikTok account. A person on the Salt team reads it and answers, aiming for 48 hours. Salt Society is for people aged 18 or over.

BOOK
Restaurants, cafes, brunch, beaches, hotels, wellness, fitness and nightlife. Each offer says what you get, what you post and the house rules. Book at once, apply, or answer a venue's invite.

GO
Confirm your booking in one tap when the app asks. At the door, show your pass: a QR code that changes every 30 seconds and works even without signal. Running late? Tell the venue in one tap.

DELIVER
After the visit, paste the link to your post, add your story screenshots or send your files. The Salt team checks the proof, then the venue approves. A countdown always shows the time left.

GROW
Four levels: Grain, Flake, Crystal and Fleur de sel. The more reliable you are, the more you can book, with early access to new offers. Your score and your strikes are clear, with an appeal if you disagree.

YOUR IDENTITY IS PROTECTED
Venues browse an anonymous directory. They see your name and accounts only when you apply, accept an invite or book with them. Never your phone number. Contact details typed in chat are hidden.

IN THREE LANGUAGES
English, French and Arabic, with Arabic right to left.

Run a venue? Sign up at saltsociety.app/business.

Questions: hello@saltsociety.app

name: Santo Domingo Taxi
description:
Santo Domingo Taxi ahora tiene su aplicación. Pide tu taxi en Santo Domingo desde tu celular, las 24 horas, sin llamar y sin esperar.

• Pide en segundos: fija tu punto de recogida, escribe a dónde vas y ve el precio estimado antes de confirmar.
• Sigue a tu conductor: ve en el mapa cuándo llega, con su nombre, vehículo y placa.
• Escríbele o llámale desde la app, sin compartir tu número.
• Agrega paradas o programa tu viaje para más tarde.
• Paga como prefieras: en efectivo o con tarjeta.
• Comparte tu viaje con alguien de confianza y ten a mano el botón de ayuda durante el recorrido.
• Revisa tus viajes y tus recibos cuando quieras.

¿Eres conductor de Santo Domingo Taxi? Entra con tu cuenta y recibe tus viajes en la misma app.

¿Dudas? Llámanos o escríbenos por WhatsApp al 809-544-4444, o a sto.dgo.taxi@gmail.com.

name: Scrambluff
description:
Spell it. Sell it.

Scrambluff is a crossword-tile word game for 2 to 8 players where any word can be a bluff. Play a real word, or invent one and give it a straight-faced definition. Your opponents can call the bluff. If they are wrong, it costs them.

HOW IT PLAYS
- Place tiles on the board to make words and score points, with double and triple letter and word squares.
- In Scrambluff mode, play a word that is not in the dictionary and pick a real word whose definition will be shown for yours. Every play looks the same to everyone else, so nobody knows who is bluffing.
- Call bluff on any word. Catch a fake and you win its points. Challenge a real word and you lose them.
- Prefer a classic game? Switch to Classic mode, where every word must be real.

PLAY YOUR WAY
- Deal friends in with an invite link or QR code. Games are turn based, so play a quick round or take your time over a few days.
- Daily Scramble: one new puzzle a day, the same for everyone. Make one play, climb the daily leaderboard and share your score.
- House rules: scrambles that shuffle everyone's tiles, letter trades between players, a turn timer, and optional acronyms and slang.
- Leaderboards for overall score and bluff score, among friends or everyone.
- Profiles with stats, streaks and avatars that unlock as you play.
- Fire off emoji and letter reactions during a game.

MADE FOR FRIENDLY TABLES
- Sign in with just your email and a code. No passwords.
- Add friends with a friend code or QR link.
- Block or report any player in the app. We review every report within 24 hours.
- There are no ads and no in-app purchases.

Make it your own with nine colourful themes, from warm Paper and late-night Midnight to neon Arcade, plus sound and haptics you can switch off.

Spell it. Sell it. Straight face on.

name: Scroll Quran: Read & Listen
description:
Read the Quran the way you already scroll: one verse at a time, swiping up. Arabic, meaning and tafsir together on every screen.

The average person spends over two hours a day scrolling. Scroll Quran turns a few of those minutes into time with the Quran. Each verse fills the screen in beautiful Uthmani script with its translation beneath it, so you can read a little or a lot and always pick up where you left off.

READ, ONE VERSE AT A TIME
• Full Quran, all 114 surahs, in clear Uthmani Arabic script
• Swipe vertically through verses, distraction free
• Translation under every verse in 16 languages, including English (Saheeh International)
• Quran text and translations stored on your phone: read offline, anywhere

UNDERSTAND WHAT YOU READ
• Tafsir for each verse: Ibn Kathir (abridged) in English, plus tafsir in many other languages
• A short introduction to every surah
• Search across the Quran to find any verse

LISTEN TO RECITATION
• Verse-by-verse audio by Mishary Alafasy
• Auto-continue to the next verse while you follow along

BUILD A DAILY HABIT
• Verse of the Day with an optional gentle reminder
• Reading plans: A Page a Day, Juz Amma, Khatm in 30 Days (perfect for Ramadan), Khatm in 60 Days, Khatm in a Year
• Favorites, bookmarks and personal notes on any verse

FREE
The full Quran with Arabic and translation in 16 languages, scrolling reader, Verse of the Day, search, favorites, notes, Alafasy recitation and two reading plans.

SCROLL QURAN PREMIUM
• Full tafsir for every verse
• All reciters: Mahmoud Khalil Al-Husary, Mohamed Siddiq Al-Minshawi, Abdul Rahman Al-Sudais
• All reading plans

Premium is available as a monthly or yearly subscription. The yearly plan starts with a 1-week free trial. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your App Store account settings.

name: SeaRoad: Pirate Seas
description:
In SeaRoad you are the captain. Pick your ship, set sail and fight, trade and hunt pirates in real time on the same sea as other captains.

Choose your flag
• Adventurer: complete quests, sink pirates and collect loot.
• Trader: buy spices cheap and sell them for more in another port.
• Thief: rob traders and caravans, then sell the spices.

Upgrade your ship
• Sloop, Brig, Galleon, Merchant and Cutter: every ship has its own specialty.
• Raise its firepower, speed, health and cargo hold.
• As your ship score grows, you meet stronger captains at sea.

What waits for you at sea
• Four ports, spice prices that change from port to port, and teleports between them.
• Passenger, fisher protection, wreck search and escort quests.
• Attacking pirates, caravans full of spices and loot barrels left by sunken ships.

Arena and duels
• Face captains with a ship score close to yours in the arena and earn points.
• Climb the daily, weekly and monthly leaderboards.
• Invite your friends to a duel.

Rewards
• Daily quests and Captain's Pass rewards.
• Chests, the Lucky Wheel and weekly login rewards.

Community
• Add friends, join the global chat and send private messages.
• Swearing and harassment are not allowed; reporting and blocking are always at hand.
• Sign in with Game Center to keep your captain on all your devices.

Play in 10 languages: Türkçe, English, Español, Português, Deutsch, Français, Italiano, Русский, Bahasa Indonesia, Polski.

An internet connection is needed to sail. The game contains optional in-app purchases and ads.

name: Seating Chart Maker Guest List
description:
Who sits where? Seating Chart turns the hardest list of a wedding, a dinner or a class into a floor plan you can see and change with a finger.

DRAW THE ROOM
Add round, square and long tables or classroom desks, give each its number of seats, and drag it to where it stands. Pinch to zoom.

YOUR GUEST LIST
Type names, paste a whole list, and give every guest a group such as "Bride's family" or "Work". Note who is coming, who has not answered and who cannot come. Search finds anyone in a moment.

SEAT BY HAND
Tap a table, tap a seat, pick a guest. Every group has its own colour, so one look at the floor shows whether a family sits together.

SMART SEATING (PRO)
One tap seats everyone who has no seat yet. Groups stay together at a table they fit at, the couples and friends you name sit at the same table, and the people you name are kept apart. The guests you seated yourself keep their seats.

SHARE AND PRINT
Send the floor plan as a picture to your partner, planner or venue. With Pro, make a PDF with the plan, a list for every table and everyone from A to Z, ready to print for the door.

FOR TEACHERS TOO
Choose "Classroom" and tables become desks. Shuffle the seats for a new term, or seat the class with rules about who should not sit together.

FREE
One event with up to 24 guests, seating by hand, and the floor plan as a picture.

SEATING CHART PRO
Smart Seating with its rules, as many events and guests as you need, the PDF, and guests imported from Contacts or a CSV file.

PRIVATE
No account. Your guest list stays on your iPhone; the app sends nothing to us.

Seating Chart Pro is optional. It is offered as a monthly subscription that renews automatically until cancelled, or as a one-time purchase. The subscription renews unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; manage or cancel it in your Apple Account's subscriptions.
