name: Seatsy Table Planner
description:
Seating arrangements for an event aren't just about dividing guests into tables. Sometimes, you also need to remember who wants to sit with whom, which families need to be together, and which guests should be seated separately. Seatsy makes it easier and more manageable.

Create an event, add a guest list, and arrange tables according to the available space. You can import guests from a spreadsheet, keep groups of friends or family together, note their preferences for seating together or separately, and let Seatsy automatically suggest seating arrangements.

Once you have an initial layout, you can drag and drop individuals between tables, fix preferred positions, or move entire groups to a different table. Supporting both round and long tables, Seatsy makes it easy to adjust the layout until everything fits perfectly.

Before finalizing, the plan check feature will help detect overcrowded tables and unfulfilled seating requests. You can also view the total number of meals served for each option to send to the catering service.

Once the seating chart is ready, export it as a PDF for printing, share the seating list with guests, download the guest list as a CSV, or send meal statistics to your supplier.

Whether it's a wedding, birthday, family dinner, or corporate event, Seatsy helps you organize everything more clearly and proactively.

Supports multiple events, imports guests from spreadsheets, and works even offline.

name: SecureBarns
description:
SecureBarns is the mobile app for horse boarding barns that run on SecureBarns. Barn staff sign off the day's care from the aisle, horse owners see exactly how their horse was looked after, and the vet and farrier see their visits.

FOR BARN STAFF

• Today's boards. Feed, turnout, medications and blankets for your location, one tap to sign each one off. The time is recorded and so is who did it. • Blanket advice from the forecast, for the parts of the day still ahead. • The day's task list. Sign tasks off as you go, or skip one with a reason. A task that mentions a board opens it. • Works with no signal. Anything you log in a dead spot waits on the phone and sends on its own when you're back in range. Today's boards stay readable offline. • Every horse's care log. What was fed, given and done, and by whom. A mistake is corrected with a new entry, never erased. • Report an incident with photos. Describe what happened, add photos from the camera or the library, and add follow-ups until it's resolved. • The schedule. Vet and farrier days and every booking for the next two weeks. Book the vet or farrier, sign a horse up for a vet or farrier day, cancel, or mark a visit done.

FOR HORSE OWNERS

• Proof of care. Your own horse's care log, entry by entry: fed, turned out, blanketed, medicated, and when. • Incident reports about your horse, with the barn's photos and every follow-up. • Your horse's schedule, and booking the vet or farrier for your own horses. • Notifications from your barn the moment something is reported.

FOR VETS AND FARRIERS

• Your visits at each barn that invited you, and what each booked horse needs.

BUILT FOR A BARN AISLE

• Fully in English and Spanish. Each person picks their language. • Unlock with Face ID. • Two-step sign-in for barn staff, vets and farriers. • Works on iPhone and iPad, in light and dark mode. • Belong to more than one barn? Switch between them in the app. • Photos are stripped of location data before they leave the phone, and the app never asks for your location. • Your barn's data is never sold.

A SecureBarns barn account is required. The barn owner adds staff, horse owners, vets and farriers on securehorsebarns.com, and you sign in with the same email and password.

Questions? We're here to help at securehorsebarns.com/support.

name: Shikiori: Science Calculator
description:
Shikiori is a scientific calculator that shows your math the way a textbook does and keeps answers exact. √12+3÷√3 gives 3√3, sin 30° gives 1/2, and S⇔D switches to decimals.

No ads, no account, no network. Open it and calculate.

TEXTBOOK DISPLAY
- Type fractions, roots, nth roots, powers, log with base, absolute value, ∫, d/dx and Σ in their real shape
- Tap anywhere in the expression to move the cursor
- Exact answers with fractions, roots and π; S⇔D for decimals
- Prime factors and degrees, minutes, seconds in one tap
- Syntax errors put the cursor at the problem and tell you how to fix it

HISTORY AND FORMULA NOTES
- Every answer is saved; search it, swipe to delete, undo
- Tap a line to bring the expression back and edit it
- Formula notes: save a formula with variables and see the answer change as you type (3 notes free)
- Ans and memory variables A to F

CONSTANTS AND SETTINGS
- 20 physical constants (CODATA 2022), searchable
- DEG / RAD, Norm1 / Norm2, Fix, Sci, Eng

HOME SCREEN WIDGETS
- A widget keypad for quick arithmetic without opening the app
- A small widget with your last answer

IPAD AND KEYBOARD
- Calculator and history side by side on iPad
- Hardware keyboard: digits, operators, Return, Delete, arrows

SHIKIORI PRO (ONE-TIME PURCHASE)
- Complex numbers: a+bi and r∠θ, arg, conjugate, real and imaginary parts
- Matrices up to 4×4: add, subtract, multiply, determinant, inverse, transpose, exact
- Equations: 2 to 4 unknowns, quadratic to quartic (exact roots for quadratics)
- Statistics: one variable with quartiles and box plot, regression y=a+bx with r
- Function table: f(x) up to 45 rows
- Base-N: BIN, OCT, DEC, HEX with AND, OR, XOR, NOT
- Unlimited formula notes
Every mode shows a worked example for free. Pro is needed to enter your own numbers.

Support: support@sanghuynhxuan.com

name: Shoebox from Capy & Paste
description:
Remember that shoebox of old letters under the bed? Shoebox is one you can fill today.

Shoebox guides you, one gentle question at a time, through the stories of your life: your earliest memory, who taught you to cook, how the two of you met, the advice you wish you'd had at twenty. No blank pages, no instructions needed.

WRITE IT, OR JUST TALK
Not a typer? Tap the microphone and tell it like you would at the kitchen table. Shoebox turns your words into a story you can read, change and keep.

A BOX FOR EVERY PART OF LIFE
Start with nine boxes: Beginnings, Food, Family, Love, Work, Vacations, Regrets, "I was there when…" and Advice. Each comes with starter questions. Not feeling a question? Swipe for another, or ask your own. Add your own boxes any time.

A STORY OF US
Invite your partner into your Shoebox. One of you starts a story, the other adds their side (and corrects the bits you got "slightly wrong"), so your family hears it the way it really happened.

FOR THE PEOPLE YOU LOVE
Add photos to your stories, and share them with family through private links that only the people you choose can open. Turn a link off whenever you like.

A LITTLE NUDGE
Pick how often you'd like a question (daily, every other day or weekly) and Shoebox will remind you.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
These are your family's most personal memories, and we treat them that way.
• We never sell your data, and there are no ads.
• Only you, your partner and the people you share a link with can read your stories.
• Ask for a copy of your data, or delete your account, right from Settings.

Shoebox is in early access. We'd love to hear what you think: help@shoeboxapp.live

Made with love in Canada by Capy & Paste.

name: Shopfoxie
description:
Shopfoxie is your online shop and every place you sell, for businesses that run on EFFICIENT. This app puts today's sales, the orders to ship, your products and your selling channels in your pocket.

Sign in with the account your workspace gave you.

TODAY
Sales across every channel, orders and visitors, the orders waiting to ship, and what needs you: failed listings, buyer messages and reviews to approve.

ORDERS
Every order from your shop, eBay and Amazon in one list, by where it stands and where it came from. Mark an order shipped with its tracking number, scanned from the label; the customer gets the tracking email, and a marketplace gets the number too.

PRODUCTS
Your catalogue with prices, sizes and stock, low stock flagged. Choose where each product sells: your shop, eBay, Amazon, Google Shopping.

CHANNELS
Your shop and each marketplace: what is listed, when orders last came in, fees and payouts, and the listings that need fixing.

STATS
Sales by day, the steps from visit to order, and your best sellers.

Shopfoxie needs a workspace on EFFICIENT. Pages, payments, delivery and domains are set up on the web.

name: Short Commit
description:
Saved it? Now do it.

Short Commit turns saved how-to reels into step-by-step plans you can actually follow. Share a reel, get a plan, and tick off each step while the video plays.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Share a reel. Tap Share on any how-to video and pick Short Commit.
2. Get a plan. Steps, ingredients, sets, chords or materials, pulled from the video.
3. Follow along. Jump to any step while the reel plays.
4. Tick it off. See what's done and what's next.

BUILT FOR EVERY KIND OF HOW-TO
• Recipes: ingredients, cook mode, servings, calories and macros
• Workouts: sets, reps, a work–rest timer and the muscles each move works
• DIY: steps and cut lists
• Makeup: steps and the products used
• Music: chords and practice tempos
• Languages: phrases to practise, with quick review
• Plus dance, tech, cleaning, gaming, skills, explainers and products

NO GUESSING
Every value shows where it came from: said in the video, shown as on-screen text, or calculated. If the video never says it, the plan marks it "not shown" instead of making it up.

CREATORS GET CREDIT
Every plan names the creator who made the video.

YOUR SAVES, FINALLY USED
Stop scrolling past the same saved videos. Turn them into plans and finish them.

Nutrition values are estimates. Workout plans are not medical advice; check with a professional before starting a new routine.

name: Signature Maker: Sign PDF Docs
description:
Make your signature once, then sign anything without a printer or a scanner.

THREE WAYS TO A SIGNATURE
- Draw it with your finger. The pen is wider where your hand is slow and finer where it is fast, like a real pen.
- Type your name and choose from eight handwriting styles.
- Scan the signature you wrote on paper (Pro): take a photo and the app keeps only the ink.

Choose black, navy, blue, red or green ink. Share any signature as a picture, see-through or on white, to drop into an e-mail, a letter or a form.

SIGN DOCUMENTS
Add a PDF or a picture from Files, a photo, or pages scanned with the camera. Tap Sign, drag the signature to its line and pull its corner to size it. Add text, today's date, check marks and stamps such as APPROVED, PAID or RECEIVED. Zoom in for the small boxes. A sample agreement is included to try it.

SEND IT (PRO)
Send makes the finished PDF and opens the share sheet: Mail, Messages, Files, print. The text of the original PDF stays text, and the page looks exactly as it did on screen.

FREE
Two saved signatures, drawn or typed, shared as pictures. Add documents and place everything on them.

SIGNATURE MAKER PRO
Send the signed PDF, scan your pen signature, and keep as many signatures and sets of initials as you like.

PRIVATE
No account. Your signatures and documents stay on your iPhone; the app sends nothing to us.

A signature placed with this app is a picture of your signature on the page. Whether that is enough for a given contract depends on the law that applies to it.

name: Sillage: Habit Tracker RPG
description:
Sillage turns your habits and goals into a quest you actually want to keep playing.

Sillage requires a subscription to unlock the app: weekly (with a 7-day trial for eligible new subscribers) or yearly. You can see the app and set up your first quest before choosing a plan.

PICK THE AREAS OF YOUR LIFE
Sport, sleep, mind, family, work, money, reading, music: choose what matters and give each area its own color and goals.

COMPLETE QUESTS, EARN XP
Every quest you finish adds experience to its area and to your overall level. Your skill map shows where you are growing and where to push next.

HABITS THAT STICK
Track daily habits, get a gentle reminder at the hour you choose, and write a short note in your habit journal.

PLAN YOUR WEEK
Place quests and programs on your calendar, follow your reading and workout programs, and see your last 7 days of progress.

WEEKLY CHALLENGES
New challenges every week unlock badges and bonus XP.

MAKE IT YOURS
Seven themes, alternative app icons, your own lists and a notebook for ideas.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your quests and notes stay on your iPhone.

SUBSCRIPTION DETAILS
Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. name: Skyport Tycoon
description:
Build a harbor in the clouds.

Skyport Tycoon is a cozy tycoon game about running a harbor that floats on cloud islands. Airships moor at your docks, passengers stroll your boardwalks, and every tea stall, noodle house and lantern post you place makes their walk a little nicer. It all sits on a little toy diorama, made for one-handed portrait play.

BUILD YOUR HARBOR
• Lay boardwalks: passengers only walk where you build them
• Build moorings, piers and docks on the island's edge for skiffs, clippers, liners and royal zeppelins
• Turn each shop's door onto a busy boardwalk and watch the customers come in
• Move, rotate, undo and sell in build mode, so a new layout is easy to try

SERVE YOUR PASSENGERS
Travelers, merchants and nobles each bring their own needs and budgets: food, drink, rest, shopping and fun. Start with tea stalls, dumpling carts, bench nooks and map kiosks, then grow into the Cloud Café, Noodle House, Sky Lounge, Curio Bazaar, Balloon Tours, Cloud Spa and Star Theater.

MAKE THE WALK NICER
Lantern posts, flower tubs, wind chime arches and cloud fountains brighten the boardwalks around them. Happy passengers tip better and lift your harbor's star rating, and a higher rating brings ships in more often.

HIRE A CREW
Dockhands unload ships faster, vendors keep the shops serving at full speed and sweepers keep the boardwalks clean.

RESEARCH WITH SKY CHARTS
Ships bring sky charts. Spend them on 32 upgrades across docks, shops, harbor and crew: new berths and shops, ships that arrive more often, better prices and longer earnings while you're away.

THREE ISLANDS
Start on Driftwood Dock, then open Brass Terrace and Gilded Spire, where bigger ships bring richer passengers.

EARNS WHILE YOU'RE AWAY
Your harbor keeps earning for a few hours after you put your phone down, and the coins are waiting when you come back. Research makes that time longer.

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Plays offline, no account needed
• Cozy toy-diorama look with gentle sounds and haptics

OPTIONAL PURCHASES

name: Sleigh Jam: Christmas Puzzle

Once the sleigh is full, it jingles off and a new one pulls up. There's just one rule: don't let the crates fill up, so think one tap ahead.

WHY YOU'LL LOVE IT
- So easy to pick up: one tap and you're playing

- Every world has its own sky: sunrise, sunset, moonlit nights and northern lights
- Surprise gifts to keep you on your toes: frozen, mystery, golden and magic boxes

name: SOME Scuba Diving
description:
Not all of scuba diving. Just some.

SOME Scuba Diving is the front door for people who have never dived — plain English, honest prices, real photography, and one rule printed on the door: orientation only — not training, not certification. This app will not teach you to dive. It will make you the most informed beginner your instructor has ever met.

WHAT IT IS
What SCUBA stands for, what a dive actually feels like, where people dive — reefs, wrecks, kelp forests, and the quarry closer to home than you think — and a dive day, minute by minute.

HOW TO START
The Open Water path in order: pick a school, do the book learning, pool sessions, four open-water dives, the card. The medical questions, answered honestly and explained. And both cost columns, always — the People's Path (local school, rented gear, ≈ $450–$700 all-in) next to the Mythology Path (resort course, bought gear, a trip — $2,500 and up). Same card at the end of both. Plus the six questions to ask any dive school before you pay a dollar.

WHAT YOU NEED
Buy first: the mask, fins, and snorkel — fit is personal. Rent first: the BCD, regulator, and tank. The dive computer explained in plain words, a wetsuit-by-temperature table, and what can honestly wait a year.

PRESSURE, MADE PLAIN
The one science idea all of diving stands on. Barometric pressure, the extra atmosphere every 10 metres adds, the squeeze and equalizing, the bends in plain words — and the one rule above all rules. Includes the interactive Pressure Lab: drag the depth from 0 to 40 metres and watch pressure, your air use, and a balloon obey Boyle's law.

THE HISTORY
Breath-hold divers and diving bells, Siebe's brass-helmet standard dress, Fleuss's 1878 rebreather, and the 1943 breakthrough — Cousteau and Gagnan's Aqua-Lung — through The Silent World, PADI, SSI, dive computers, and nitrox.

THE PEOPLE & THE BUSINESS
Cousteau and Gagnan, Sylvia Earle, Eugenie Clark, and the two Illinois men who founded PADI. Who runs this industry, where the money flows, and how this app makes money — printed in the open.

Free. No account. No data collected. Real photographs throughout (NOAA, U.S. Navy, National Park Service), every one credited in the app.

name: SOME Weave
description:
SOME Weave is the illustrated school of the hair trade — wigs, bundles, braids, extensions, and units — explained before you spend.

THE DECODER
Paste any hair listing and the decoder strips it word by word, from a closed library of the trade's vocabulary. A word the library doesn't know is named as unknown — never guessed. Start with the sixty-second demo, then open the full word library and save the words you decode.

FOLLOW ONE BUNDLE
Trace a single bundle through six stops of the sourcing chain — where hair comes from, whose hands it passes through, and what that means for the price on the listing.

METHODS, COMPARED
Sew-ins, hand-tied wefts, wigs, braids, clip-ins — how each method works and how they compare. Method first, brand never.

THE COST OF A YEAR
A calculator that adds up what a year of a method really costs — hair, installs, and maintenance visits — from your own numbers. Where no verified annual range is published, the app says so beside your number instead of inventing one.

SCALP LITERACY
Plain-language education about the scalp under the style. Literacy, never diagnosis — every card ends at the same door: see a dermatologist.

THE CHAIRS
Who does the hair — the people and the chairs behind the trade.

Free for learners, always. No account, no sign-in, and the app collects no data at all: what you save lives only on your device, and erasing it is one button in the app.

AFFILIATE DISCLOSURE: Some product links in the curriculum may be affiliate links that earn Reginal Polk Technologies a commission. The curriculum picks products first, never for commissions, and any link that could earn a commission is labeled on its card, in the app.

name: SowCast: Garden Planner
description:
SowCast times every job in your garden from the frost history of the weather station closest to you: Environment and Climate Change Canada's 1991–2020 normals in Canada, NOAA's in the US.

Most planners give you one "last frost date". SowCast shows the odds. In Minneapolis, there's a 1 in 2 chance of frost after April 23 and a 1 in 10 chance after May 7. You choose how much risk you'll take, and your start-indoors, transplant and sowing dates move with it.

FREE
• Your frost odds and the station they come from, with distance and elevation
• Search by Canadian town or US ZIP code, or use your location once
• A calendar and reminders for up to 6 crops: when to start seeds indoors, harden off, transplant, sow outdoors and expect a harvest
• This week's garden jobs, with a tick to mark them done
• One raised bed or plot, laid out in 30 cm (1 ft) squares
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets: days to your last frost, and this week's jobs
• Journal notes, and "a year ago this week" bringing last year's notes back
• Back up your whole garden to one file

UNLOCK — ONE PURCHASE, NO SUBSCRIPTION
• Every crop and as many beds as you like
• Plan around a safer frost date: a 1 in 10 or 1 in 4 chance of frost after it
• Repeat sowings for a steady harvest, and fall sowings timed to your first frost
• A seed box: track your packets and their packing year, and scan a packet to fill it in
• Journal photos and harvest weights, with season totals
• A frost-tonight check from Apple Weather, once a day in spring and fall

PRIVATE
No account, no ads and no tracking. Your garden is stored on your iPhone and nothing you enter is sent to me. If you turn on the frost-tonight check, your garden's approximate location goes to Apple Weather to get the forecast.

WHERE THE DATES COME FROM
Frost odds: Environment and Climate Change Canada, Canadian Climate Normals 1991–2020, and NOAA's U.S. Climate Normals 1991–2020. Hardiness zones and place names: Natural Resources Canada. Planting times: my own summary of guidance from provincial agriculture ministries and university extension services. Each crop lists its sources. Planting dates are a guide from long-term averages, not a forecast.

I'm Colin Robey, and I make SowCast on my own as CR Studios. If something doesn't work the way you expect, email me at crstudiosdev@gmail.com.

name: SpineHaven
description:
See how an EPUB3 package is assembled before you hand it over.

SpineHaven reads the actual archive, package manifest, original reading order and local XHTML references. It is a bounded structural audit tool for ebook preparation—not an ebook reader or a promise of complete EPUB conformance.

INSPECT THE PACKAGE
Import a supported EPUB file from Files or load the editable practice package. Check the source byte count and SHA256 fingerprint, title, creator, package location, manifest count and spine sequence. Follow each reading-order entry to its exact resource instead of assuming filename order.

TRACE RESOURCES AND REFERENCES
Search archive paths or media types. Inspect each member’s expanded and compressed sizes, compression method, CRC and content fingerprint. Read plain UTF-8 resource text without executing HTML or scripts; previews above32 KiB are clearly marked. Check local XHTML href/src paths and fragment identifiers. Findings identify their source, target and reason, including missing files, missing fragments, duplicate IDs and ambiguous manifest references. External addresses are classified but never fetched by the audit.

KEEP EVIDENCE THAT DOES NOT CHANGE
Freeze a named audit report with its source fingerprint, original reading order, complete resource list and all inspected references/findings. Rename or search saved audits and reports. Deleting a source book does not rewrite its frozen reports. Share a real UTF-8 CSV, JSON snapshot or paginated PDF. Export and validate a JSON library backup that includes saved EPUB source copies, or erase your local library explicitly.

SUPPORTED SCOPE
Single-package EPUB3.0 using ZIP32 stored or DEFLATE members and UTF-8 XML. Inputs up to8 MiB, expanded content up to32 MiB,300 archive entries,1 MiB per XML/XHTML,20000 XML nodes and4000 inspected references. Up to20 saved books,50 reports and40 MiB of source files. ZIP64, split/encrypted/DRM/font-obfuscated packages, EPUB2, visual rendering, CSS URLs, generated JavaScript links and full EPUBCheck certification are outside this version’s scope. Unsupported or unsafe inputs are rejected rather than labelled as checked.

The core audit works with local files. No App account, advertising or in-app purchase is required. Shared exports and system backups remain under the services you choose.

name: SPORTS:IT: Buddies & Meetups

Looking for more than a one-time game? See what people play and how good they are, then tap "Team up." If they accept, a 1:1 chat opens. There are no dating features.

▪ Coaches

Find coaches in 11 sports, from golf, tennis and gym to swimming, taekwondo, pilates, yoga, boxing and jiu-jitsu. Check their lesson photos, intro, experience, rates and where they teach, then ask about lessons right in chat. Reviews from members who took a lesson are there too. Coaches are listed after our team reviews their sign-up.

▪ Never miss a thing

Get notified about new messages, buddy and chat requests, people joining your meetup, accepted requests, canceled meetups and replies to your questions. Mute any group chat, or turn notifications off anytime in Settings.

· 18+ only

Meetups, buddies and questions to coaches are all free right now.


▪ Where meetups happen

Host a meetup anywhere in Korea, the US or Canada. Meetups show up wherever members post them, so if there's nothing near you yet, be the first to host one.


Sports are better together.
Find someone to play with today on SPORTS:IT.

STREAKS AND MEDALS WORTH KEEPING

WIDGETS FOR HOME SCREEN AND LOCK SCREEN
• 12 Home Screen widgets: ring, streak, gauge, weekly chart, hourly heatmap, your own photo and more
• 8 Lock Screen widgets, including steps to go and distance
• Light, Dark and Tinted styles

SEE YOUR PROGRESS
• Day, week, month and year views
• Compare with last week and spot your best days
• A calendar of every day you hit your goal

MAKE IT YOURS
• 9 themes, each in light or dark
• Set your own daily goal, from a gentle start to 10,000 steps and beyond
• Friendly reminders that skip the days you've already hit your goal

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No sign-up, no email, no password
• No ads, no analytics, no tracking
• Steps are read from Apple Health and never leave your iPhone

WORKS WITH APPLE HEALTH
Step Tracker reads your steps, walking distance, active energy, exercise minutes and flights climbed from Apple Health. No Apple Watch needed: your iPhone counts your steps on its own, and Apple Watch steps come in through Health too.

Step Tracker is free, with no subscription and no in-app purchases.

Questions or ideas? We'd love to hear from you: mkunal065@gmail.com

Privacy Policy: https://kunalvmore.github.io/StepTracker/privacy.html
Terms of Use: https://kunalvmore.github.io/StepTracker/terms.html

Step Tracker is a general fitness app and isn't intended to provide medical advice.

name: StepTrack: Offline Pedometer
description:
StepTrack has no server and no networking code of its own. No account, no sign-in, no ads, no analytics, no tracking. Your steps are written to your iPhone and stay there.

It reads only the phone's built-in motion sensor, never GPS or location, so it barely touches the battery and uses no data. The sensor keeps counting while the app is closed, so nothing is lost if you forget to open it: StepTrack backfills up to the last 7 days.

WHAT YOU GET

- Today's steps, progress toward your goal, steps left, and roughly how long they'll take
- Walking time, distance (km), estimated calories, average speed (km/h)
- Automatic sessions: stop for 60 seconds and the session ends there, so breaks stay out of your time and pace
- History and graphs by day, week, month and year, each against the period before
- A Home Screen widget: today's steps, large, plus the month's total
- A morning badge on the icon: 7 if you hit yesterday's goal, 8 if you didn't. Open the app and a stamp card shows how yesterday went. Plus a nudge at noon if you haven't taken a step yet
- Optional export to Apple Health: StepTrack writes the steps and distance it records, and never reads from Health
- CSV export, and six languages

Most step counters ask you to take a privacy policy on faith. Here you don't have to: there is no server for your steps to go to. They sit in the app's own storage, which iOS keeps encrypted while your iPhone is locked. The one exception is the App Store itself, which handles the subscription.

Recording is free for 30 days, counted from your first logged step, not from install. After that, recording continues with StepTrack Pro, an auto-renewing subscription at US$0.99 per month. It renews unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the period ends, and you can manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings. Without it, recording stops and the history view narrows to the last 7 days. Nothing is deleted: older records stay on your iPhone, hidden until you subscribe.

Built by one developer. Requires iOS 16 or later. No iPad or Apple Watch version.

Terms of Use: https://steptrack-legal.pages.dev/terms
Privacy Policy: https://steptrack-legal.pages.dev/privacy

name: Stočarko
description:
Stočarko is a digital assistant for livestock farmers. It keeps records of your animals, production and health in one place and turns them into official reports for the breeding service.

ANIMAL RECORDS
• Cattle, sheep, goats, pigs, horses and poultry in one app
• Registry sheet, parentage and pedigree, ear tags and photos for every animal
• Each animal's card shows its registry data, parentage, lactations and health on one screen

PRODUCTION AND MILK RECORDING
• Lactations, milk recording, fertility and offspring
• Calculations are updated automatically from the data you enter
• New births, inseminations or milk recordings take just a few taps in the field

HEALTH AND REMINDERS
• Treatments, vaccinations and blood sampling
• Reminders for births, shows, mating and breeding readiness

OFFICIAL REPORTS
• Registry and production sheets, forms for breeding organizations, commission records and extracts
• Ready to print or download as PDF and send to the service yourself

FASTER DATA ENTRY
• Enter records by hand, from a photo of a paper document, or from an image or PDF file
• The assistant lets you describe an entry in your own words, for example "cow 5694 was treated on 3 April for mastitis", and fills in the right animal's record
• Data recognized from photos and text is always shown for your review first; nothing is saved without your confirmation
• Import of calvings, inseminations, lambings, kiddings and milk recordings from UniSoft

WORKS WITHOUT INTERNET
• Records are saved on your phone and synced when you are back online
• Reports can be created offline

FOR FARMS AND BREEDING SERVICES
• Farms and farmers: enter data from a phone or tablet, without paper and retyping
• Basic and regional breeding organizations: overview of farms, shows, linear scoring, forms and documentation, with access only to what belongs to the service

YOUR DATA STAYS YOURS
• Each farm sees only its own data, and a service sees only what belongs to it
• Data is transferred encrypted and we do not sell it or use it for profiling
• You can export a backup or delete your account from the app settings

Available in Serbian, Croatian, English, Hungarian, Romanian and other languages.

name: Stoneridge School (SIMS)
description:
The official app of The Stoneridge School. 

The Stoneridge School app keeps parents and teachers connected to the school day. Sign in with your username or phone number and see everything that matters to you on one screen.

FOR PARENTS
One account for all your children. Switch between your children or see them all together.
• Fees and finances: see fees charged, payments made and the balance for each child, so you always know what is paid and what is due.
• Attendance: see whether your child was present at school each day and follow their attendance through the term.
• Results: view your child's marks, grades and report results as soon as the school releases them.
• Announcements and notifications: get school news, reminders and messages straight to your phone.
• Enrolment: start your child's enrolment straight from the app.

FOR TEACHERS
• Roll call: take daily attendance for your class in a few taps and see at a glance whether today's register has been taken.
• My class today: see your class, the number of children and whose birthday it is today.
• Term at a glance: see the current term and how many days are left.
• Announcements and notifications: never miss a message from the school, with unread counts on your home screen.

EASY TO REACH THE SCHOOL
Need help signing in? Call or email the school directly from the sign-in screen.

SECURE ACCESS
Each user signs in with their own account, so parents only see their own children's fees, attendance and results, and staff only see the information meant for them. Forgot your password? Reset it from the app.

The Stoneridge School app is for pupils' families and staff of The Stoneridge School. Contact the school office for your login details.

name: Stoxx Workspace
description:
Stoxx Workspace é o espaço de trabalho da sua equipe: tarefas do dia, agenda, reuniões e conversas em um só lugar, sincronizados com a plataforma web Stoxx.

MEU DIA
• Veja e organize suas tarefas por período (manhã, tarde, noite) com a próxima ação sempre em destaque.
• Traga pendências anteriores para hoje com um toque, reagende, transfira, duplique ou reordene tarefas.
• Aplique modelos de rotina, gere o PDF do dia e envie suas tarefas pelo chat ao seu gestor.

CRIE TAREFAS PELA VOZ OU PELO TEXTO
• Segure o microfone, fale normalmente e veja as tarefas surgirem ao vivo: "ligar para o cliente amanhã de manhã e depois enviar o contrato".
• Revise antes de salvar: data, período, prioridade e canal são reconhecidos automaticamente.

TAREFAS DA EQUIPE
• Gestores acompanham a equipe em lista, por dia ou em quadro, com filtros por setor, situação, prioridade e período.
• Atribua tarefas para hoje, amanhã ou a próxima semana, edite e consulte o histórico de cada tarefa.

AGENDA E REUNIÕES
• Agende reuniões com participantes, horário e link do Google Meet.
• Acompanhe compromissos e tarefas na agenda.

CHAT DA EMPRESA
• Converse com colaboradores e canais de setor, com confirmação de leitura.
• Compartilhe tarefas diretamente na conversa.

EQUIPE E ADMINISTRAÇÃO
• Convide e cadastre funcionários, organize setores e gestores e ajuste o perfil da empresa.
• Configure categorias, modelos e recorrências para padronizar a rotina.

Stoxx Workspace é destinado a empresas que usam a plataforma Stoxx. É necessário ter uma conta da sua empresa para entrar; novos cadastros são confirmados por um código enviado por e-mail.

name: STRATO SURGE
description:
STRATO SURGE is a 3D arcade dogfight shooter seen from behind your jet.
Keep enemies inside the targeting circle to lock on, then fire missiles to take them down together. Use the gun on enemies up close, and roll to dodge incoming fire and missiles.

■ 12 STAGES, 2 ROUTE SPLITS, 4 BOSSES
Dawn ocean, coral shelf, cloud cathedral, basalt gorge, aurora fjord, ember dunes, storm wall, neon harbor...
At two route splits, fly through the upper ring for a high-altitude stage or the lower ring for a low, obstacle-filled one. Each run flies 8 stages.
A giant flying boat, five weather towers and a fortress on the sea wait for you. Meet the conditions and a hidden ninth stage opens.

■ SURGE DRIVE
When the gauge is ready, time slows down, the targeting circle widens and you can lock up to 24 targets at once. The more you take down in one volley, the bigger the bonus.

■ 3 FIGHTERS, 12 LIVERIES
The balanced ARCLIGHT, the nimble WINDSHEAR and the heavily armed IRONGALE.
Unlock new liveries and EX settings that change the challenge.

■ WAYS TO PLAY
- ARCADE: the full campaign, on EASY, NORMAL or HARD
- PRACTICE: replay any stage you have reached
- RECORDS: top 10 scores for each difficulty
- GUIDE: controls and a route map of every stage
- First-time pilots get in-flight hints

■ MADE FOR TOUCH
Drag on the left side to fly (the stick appears where you touch). Fight with the MISSILE, SURGE, ROLL, BOOST and BRAKE buttons on the right. The gun fires automatically.
Swap the stick side, choose the button size (S / M / L), vibration and graphics quality (AUTO / HIGH / MID / LOW).

■ 6 ORIGINAL TRACKS
The music follows the stage, and the sound reacts when you boost or trigger the Surge Drive.

■ ALSO
- English / Japanese
- Adjustable screen shake, flash intensity, inverted vertical controls and auto missiles
- No ads, no in-app purchases, no network. Plays offline
- Collects no data

name: Streakpad
description: Streakpad is a habit check-in notebook. Name a habit, set how many days a week you want it marked Done, then tap Done or Skip on the today board. A streak counts consecutive Done days and stays intact until today is closed if you have not marked it yet. The month grid colors each day by how many habits were Done. Week score, skips, a 30-day history, and an under-target list are included. Marks stay on the phone. There are no reminders and no account.

name: Sturmdeck: Steampunk Shooter
description:
The cloud shipyard is lost, but the freighter with its crew is still falling. You are the drone launcher on the deck. Save them.

Slide the launcher sideways along the brass rail with one finger. It fires automatically. Your drones fly through two moving brass rings: the first doubles them, the second triples them. Hit both and you release an x6 swarm. That is the heart of the game: timing, aiming, bundling.

WHAT AWAITS YOU
• Rings and x6 swarms: Thread the drifting rings and multiply every drone.
• 24 missions in 3 chapters: the cloud heights, the icy Frost Belt with freezing rings, and the glowing Ember Forge where your launcher overheats.
• 8 bosses with their own tricks: from the Cloud Raider to the Storm Mother and the four-stage Forge Colossus.
• Dodge enemy fire: Red markers on the deck show where it lands.
• Storm Shot: Fill the charge ring, lift your finger and unleash a massive shot that pierces shields.
• Loot and gear: Five rarities from scrap to storm-forged, 26 legendary items and 6 gear sets with powerful bonuses. Salvage, reroll, upgrade and build your set.
• Three launchers to unlock: Hornet (rapid fire), Hammer (heavy) and Peacock (fan).
• Shipwright talents: firepower, evasion and loot, for progress beyond the top rank.
• Storm tiers and weather: up to ten tiers with fog, thunderstorms, headwinds and more, for better loot.
• Storm Wall: an endless mode with ever harder waves and mutators.
• Boss Rush: every boss back to back against the clock.
• Daily Storm: one mission per day for everyone, with a Game Center leaderboard.
• Achievements and leaderboards through Game Center.
• Flight school: Learn rings, Storm Shot, dodging and bosses in short lessons.

TRY FREE, UNLOCK ONCE
The flight school, the first four missions, the hangar, loot and the Daily Storm (from mission 3) are free. The full version unlocks everything else with a single in-app purchase: all chapters, storm tiers, Storm Wall, Boss Rush, sets and talents. No subscription, no ads, no further purchases. Family Sharing supported.

Your progress stays on your device. The game collects no data. It uses Game Center for leaderboards and achievements when you are signed in.

Bundle your drones. Dodge the storm. Save the crew.

name: SubliMock 3D: Mockup Maker
description:
Selling sublimated products? Show your customer how their order will look before you print.

Import the design you already made in Canva, Photoshop or Corel, see it in 3D on the product and share it on WhatsApp or Instagram as a photo or a spinning video. In seconds, from your iPhone.

YOUR DESIGN ON THE REAL PRODUCT
• Mugs: 11 oz, 15 oz, conical, enamel and frosted glass beer mug
• Magic mug with a heat animation that reveals the design
• 600 ml aluminum bottle and skinny tumblers (20 and 30 oz) with black, white or clear lid
• 20 cm plate, trucker cap, 58 mm pin button and pen
• T-shirt on a hanger, with center or chest print
• Aluminum panels, mousepads, MDF keychains and coasters
• Cushion, puzzle and ceramic planter with different plants

REAL SUBLIMATION SIZES
• Each product shows its standard print area, for example 21.1 × 9.5 cm on the 11 oz mug.
• If your design has a different ratio, the app adapts it for you: fit, fill or blurred background.
• Is your file already mirrored for printing? Un-mirror it with one tap.
• Change the color of the mug's inside and handle, and add a design on the handle.

SPIN, ZOOM AND SET THE SCENE
• Rotate the product with your finger and zoom in to see the details.
• Show it in a room, kitchen, office, café, studio or on a pure white background.

SHARE IN ONE TAP
• A square photo of the product, ready for WhatsApp, Instagram or Facebook.
• A short video of the product spinning, perfect for statuses and stories.
• Promote: create a post or a story with a title, a description and your product in 3D.

YOUR DESIGNS STAY YOURS
Everything is processed on your iPhone: we never upload your images and you don't need an account.

SUBLIMOCK PRO
The app is free and supported by ads. SubliMock Pro is an optional subscription (monthly or annual, with a free trial on the annual plan) that:
• Unlocks exporting every Pro product.
• Removes the watermark from photos and videos.
• Adds the vertical video for TikTok and Reels, with music.
• Removes all ads.

Payment is charged to your Apple Account. The subscription renews automatically unless you cancel it at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it in your Apple Account settings.

Terms of Use: https://sites.google.com/view/terminos-del-servicio-sublimoc/inicio
Privacy Policy: https://sites.google.com/view/sublimock3d/inicio

MADE FOR
• Sublimation businesses.
• Custom gift shops.
• Printers and designers who want to close sales faster.

name: Sudoku doc – Sudoku Coach
description:
Sudoku doc is a calm, honest sudoku for beginners and for players who already know every technique.

A COACH THAT EXPLAINS
Stuck? Ask for a hint. The coach doesn't just give away the answer. It helps in three steps:
• where to look
• which technique you need, from hidden single to X-Wing, Swordfish and XYZ-Wing
• and only then the answer
If there's a wrong digit somewhere, the coach tells you that first. You really get better.

1800 PUZZLES ACROSS 6 LEVELS
Every puzzle has exactly one solution and can be solved with logic, no guessing. The level comes from the hardest technique required, so 'hard' really means hard.

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Notes, with auto-fill and auto-remove
• Highlight matching digits
• Unlimited undo and back to the last mistake-free position
• Choose: digit first or cell first
• Calm mode with no timer and no mistake counter
• Pause button
• Light, dark and high contrast

A NEW PUZZLE EVERY DAY
Play the daily puzzle and build a streak. One missed day is forgiven.

STATISTICS
Puzzles played and solved, your best time per level, and a message when you set a new record.

PRIVATE AND OFFLINE
No account, no internet needed, no data collected.

ONE PURCHASE, EVERYTHING INCLUDED
Every puzzle and unlimited coach hints. No ads, no subscription and no in-app purchases.

In Dutch, French, English, German, Spanish and Italian.

name: Sudoku Owl: Puzzle Variants
description:
Sudoku Owl is a calm, carefully made sudoku app with classic boards, popular variants and a new daily puzzle. A friendly owl keeps you company, and every hint explains the logic instead of just filling a cell.

CLASSIC SUDOKU, YOUR SIZE
• Grids 6×6, 9×9, 12×12, 15×15 and 16×16.
• Six difficulty levels, from Easy to Extreme.
• Every puzzle has exactly one solution.
• Pencil notes, auto-notes, eraser and undo.
• Optional timer and an optional 3-mistake mode — or play without either.

VARIANTS
• Diagonal (X), Jigsaw, Killer, Thermo and Kropki on 9×9 boards.
• Each variant has short, clear rules in the game.
• Variants unlock one by one as you win classic boards.

DAILY SUDOKU AND WEEKLY SAMURAI
• One daily sudoku, the same for every player, with a different type and size through the week.
• Keep your streak going and see your days in the calendar.
• A weekly Samurai challenge: five overlapping 9×9 grids in one big board.
• Share your daily result as an emoji grid that doesn't give away the solution.

LEARN AS YOU PLAY
• Hints name the technique and highlight the cells that matter.
• The Academy teaches 8 techniques with short practice boards.
• After a board, the trainer points out techniques worth practising.

MORE WAYS TO PLAY
• Story: 8 chapters, each with its own place and variant.
• Time Master: six boards from 6×6 to Master on one timer.
• Shape of the week, a puzzle with a twist each day, and a board editor with share codes.
• Daily missions, an album of cards, a garden that grows with your streak, and a weekly league against computer-controlled players.
• Game Center leaderboards and achievements.

COMFORTABLE AND ACCESSIBLE
• Light and dark themes, Paper, Night and Forest, and four visual styles.
• Zen mode and a warm Bedtime mode with no timer and no mistake limit.
• Large digits, a colour-blind palette and a left-handed keypad.
• 30 languages, including right-to-left layouts.
• Play offline. An account is optional: sign in with Apple or Google to keep progress in the cloud, and delete the account at any time in Settings.

FAIR ADS
• Sudoku Owl is free and supported by ads.
• A banner appears only on menu screens, never over the board.
• A full-screen ad can appear only after a finished board — never in the middle of a game.
• Reward ads play only when you choose them, for example for an extra hint.
• "Remove ads" removes the banner and the ads between boards. Hints come from your hint balance: earn them, watch an optional reward ad or buy a hint pack.
• Coins are earned by playing and are used only for themes, digit styles and hints.

Questions or ideas? Visit the support page — we read every message.

name: Sunflip
description:
The sky decides which way is wrong.

Sunflip is a fast swipe game that takes a second to learn and a long time to master. An arrow appears. Look at the sky behind it:

MOON: swipe the WRONG way.
SUN: swipe the SAME way.

Easy, until the sky flips without warning.

IT KEEPS GETTING HARDER
• The sky flips more often the longer you last.
• Ghost arrows appear. Hands off: let them fade.
• At 40 the timer disappears, but the clock keeps running.
• At 60 the Eclipse hides the sky. Remember the rule, or lose it.

THREE WAYS TO PLAY
• Sunflip: how long can you last?
• Duel: two players, one iPhone or iPad. Hold it between you, one at each end, and get the same arrows. Whoever misses first loses.
• Echo: answer the arrow before the one on screen. Unlocks at a streak of 25.

SHARE YOUR SCORE
Every game ends with a card that shows what got you. Share it and dare your friends to beat it.

Free to play, with an occasional ad between games. Sunflip Plus is a one-time purchase that removes ads and unlocks Echo right away. No accounts, and your scores stay on your device.

name: SWMY — Swamy, your pujari
description:
SWMY (spoken "Swamy") is a pujari you can talk to. Ask him for a puja and he guides you through it by voice, one step at a time, in your language, while your hands stay free for the lamp and the flowers.

WHAT SWAMY DOES
• Guided pujas: Swamy explains each step, says what to offer and when, and waits for you before he moves on.
• Mantras with you: each mantra appears on a card in your script while it is recited, slowly enough to follow.
• Today's panchangam: tithi, nakshatra, rahu kalam and other times of the day for where you are.
• Festivals and vratams: what is coming, what it means, and a reminder the day before if you ask for one.
• Samagri list: what you need for a puja, ticked off as you gather it.
• Your family: names, gotram and the days that matter, including birthdays and remembrance days by tithi, so the sankalpam is said correctly.
• Japa counter: Swamy keeps count while you chant.

TALK, DON'T TAP
Everything starts with your voice. Say "Satyanarayana vratam cheddam" or "What is today's tithi?" and Swamy answers. Telugu, Hindi, English, Tamil, Kannada, Malayalam, Marathi, Gujarati, Bengali and Odia.

SUBSCRIPTIONS
Every new account gets one short free trial of talking to Swamy (a few minutes, once). To keep talking, choose a plan:
• Pro: monthly or yearly
• Ultra: monthly or yearly, double the monthly talking time (offered to Pro members)
Prices are shown in the app before you buy. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the period ends. Manage or cancel anytime in your Apple Account settings. The panchangam and festival calendar stay free.

YOUR DATA
Sign in with your phone number. To answer you, your voice, your words and the details needed for the answer (such as your name, gotram and town) are sent to Google's AI service (Gemini). By signing in you agree to this, as described in our Privacy Policy. Recordings of your conversations are not kept. You can see, export or delete everything from Settings, or at swmy.in/delete.html.

Swamy is an AI voice, not a person. If something in a puja looks wrong, tell him or send a report from the app.

Privacy Policy: https://swmy.in/privacy
Terms of Use: https://swmy.in/terms
Apple's standard EULA: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Sword of the Word
description:
Sword of the Word helps you take up "the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God" (Ephesians 6:17) and keep it sharp for life's daily battles.

Pick a verse or a whole passage, choose your start date and your pace, and the app builds your training plan. Each new verse is repeated 25, 20, 15, then 10 times over its first four days. After that you review it once a day for 45 days, once a week for 7 weeks, and then once a month, so the Word stays with you for life.

• Your pace: a new verse every day, every few days, weekly, or on the weekdays you choose
• Your calendar: see every day's verses at a glance
• Reminders at the times you pick for each day of the week, with a snooze you set yourself. Tap a reminder to jump straight to today's practice
• Hide the words to test yourself
• Grace mode: fell behind? Pick up where you left off, no guilt. Need a break? Take a rest day
• Groups: start a group with your church, Bible study or family, share a 6-letter code, and see who has finished today's verses
• American Standard Version (1901) built in and the default, with the King James Version and the Spanish Reina-Valera 1909 also available, or paste verses from your own Bible for personal use
• Works without internet: the Bibles are built into the app, so you can train anywhere, even on a retreat in the mountains
• English and Spanish, in large, easy-to-read print
• Free. No ads. No sign-up.

"For the word of God is quick, and powerful, and sharper than any twoedged sword." Hebrews 4:12

The Word of God is your Sword. Stay armed and faithful.

name: Tajo Construction Time Clock
description:
Clock in with one button, close the day with your task report and keep your hours, absences and documents in your pocket, even with no signal. Less paper, fewer phone calls and no lost clock-ins. Tajo is used every day by Grupo Edma, a construction company in Spain.

IMPORTANT: Tajo is a business tool. To sign in you need the invitation code your company gives you (HR or your site manager) and your Google or Apple account. If your company does not use Tajo yet, it can request it at tajo.enunplisplas.com.

WHAT YOU GET
• Clocking in takes a second: one big button, designed to be used with gloves.
• No clock-in is ever lost: with no signal it is saved on the phone and sent automatically when coverage returns.
• You know what to do each day: your supervisor assigns your task and you accept it when you start.
• You close the day in a minute: confirm the result of your task and add a photo or a video.
• Your hours always clear: day, breaks, trips and monthly total at a glance.
• No arguments about hours: clock-ins cannot be edited or deleted and every correction keeps its reason.

FOR WORKERS
• Clock in, take breaks and clock out. The time is set by the server, not by the phone's clock.
• Several sites in one day: you pick the site when you start and each stretch counts on its own site.
• Location only at the moment you clock in, to check that you are on site. If you are outside or there is no GPS, the clock-in is still recorded and flagged for your company to review: Tajo never stops you from clocking in.
• Task of the day: you accept it when you start and confirm the result when you finish (done, pending, blocked or not started). Unplanned work is logged separately.
• Report with photos and short videos and, if your company turns it on, voice dictation that you review before sending.
• Travel between sites in your own vehicle or a company vehicle. Travel time counts as working time and the route is only recorded while the trip you start lasts.
• Corrections with their reason, holidays and leave with your balance, and payslips, contracts and notices with read confirmation.
• Site purchases with their receipt, assigned company vehicle, health and safety and licences or certificates with their expiry dates.
• In-app notices with what you need to do or review.

FOR SITE MANAGERS AND FOREMEN
• Who is in, who is missing and who has not clocked in.
• Create and assign tasks to your crew; see blocked tasks and unplanned work.
• Review the exceptions on your site and approve purchases from the phone.

FOR HR AND ADMINISTRATION (WEB PANEL)
• Browser panel: team, sites, planning, daily exception review, absences, corrections, documents, purchases, vehicles and monthly reports with export.
• Working-time register built for the time-recording obligation under Spanish law.

LANGUAGES
Spanish, English, French and Romanian.

PRIVACY
No ads, no data selling and no continuous tracking: your location is only taken when you clock in and while a trip you start is in progress. The data belongs to your company, which is the data controller. You can delete your account from within the app (More, Settings and account) or at tajo.enunplisplas.com/borrar-cuenta; working-time records are kept without your personal data for the period required by law.

CONTACT
info@enunplisplas.com · tajo.enunplisplas.com
Tajo is designed and maintained by PlisPlas.

name: Talebright
description:
Talebright reads your books, PDFs, EPUBs and notes aloud in natural voices, and every voice runs on your own device. Nothing you read is uploaded anywhere.

NATURAL VOICES, OFFLINE
• 28 Kokoro voices and 37 Phonon narrator and character voices, bundled with the app
• Follow along: the sentence being read is highlighted and the page scrolls with it
• Narrators: save a voice, speed and pitch together and switch with one tap

YOUR OWN VOICES
• Clone a voice from a ten-second recording, a voice note or a video. Talebright separates the voice from music and background noise and finds each person speaking
• Add RVC voice models (.pth and .index)
• Cloning needs the speaker's permission; Talebright asks you to confirm it

PODCASTS AND SPEECHES
• Turn any document into a two-host podcast or a one-speaker talk, written by Apple Intelligence on your device and read in the voices you pick

READS WHAT YOU HAVE
• PDF (with text recognition for scanned pages), EPUB and plain text, or paste anything
• Lock-screen and Control Center controls, background playback, adjustable speed

FREE TRIAL AND FULL ACCESS
Talebright is free to download. Every voice and feature is free for 7 days. After the trial, Kokoro, Phonon, cloned and RVC voices and podcasts need Full Access, a one-time purchase with no subscription. Your library and reading with Apple's built-in voices stay free. One purchase works on your Mac, iPhone and iPad.

name: TandemParent
description:
Tandem Parent gives separated parents one calm, shared place to organise life across two homes.

WHO HAS THE KIDS, AT A GLANCE
See who has the kids right now, how long this stay lasts and how much is left, the next handover and a two-week view the moment you open the app. Choose week on week off, 2-2-3, 2-2-5-5, 3-4-4-3, every other weekend, or tap out your own pattern, starting on any day.

EXACT HANDOVER TIMES
Give every handover its own time, such as Sunday 8 am one week and Saturday 3 pm the next. Tandem shows each stay to the minute ("3 days 12 hrs") and totals the time and nights with each parent for the fortnight, month and year.

SET UP FROM YOUR PARENTING PLAN
Upload a PDF, take a photo of a paper plan, or type or paste the arrangements from an email. Tandem reads it on your iPhone and suggests the regular schedule, handover times, school holidays, Christmas, birthdays and Mother's and Father's Day. Nothing changes until you check it and tap Apply. Works for both southern and northern hemisphere school years. Reading documents needs an iPhone with Apple Intelligence; on other iPhones, documents are still stored and shared.

SWAP DAYS WITHOUT THE BACK-AND-FORTH
Ask to swap a day or a holiday block. The schedule only changes when the other parent accepts, so there are no surprises.

HANDOVERS THAT GO SMOOTHLY
A shared handover checklist (school bag, medication, uniform, the favourite toy) that both of you can tick off, plus one-off items and a note for the other home.

MESSAGES THAT STAY ON TOPIC
Message by topic: school, health, schedule, money. Before you send, Tone Check uses Apple's on-device intelligence to suggest calmer wording. Your drafts never leave your phone.

SHARED COSTS, SORTED
Log an expense with a receipt photo, choose how it's split, and the other parent agrees or asks a question. Record costs you both paid part of, and Tandem works out who owes whom. Add upcoming bills like school fees, each tick off your share, and get a reminder before they're due. Keep a shared kids' fund you both top up, with every spend visible to both of you. Tandem keeps a running balance so you always know where things stand.

NOTES ABOUT EACH CHILD
Keep shared notes on health, school, feelings and appointments, with key information like routines and medication that both homes can rely on.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your family's information, including uploaded documents, is stored in your own iCloud and shared only with the co-parent you invite. Only one co-parent can join. No ads, no tracking and no account to create.

Tandem Parent works on iPhone. Sharing requires both parents to have an iPhone signed in to iCloud.

name: Taquería
description:
Start with one taco and a stand on the corner.

Tap to make tacos. Hire taqueros, light the griddle, set the pastor spit turning. Your stand keeps working while the game is closed: a full box is waiting when you come back.

- Eight things to build, with four salsas for each
- Rush orders: serve them in time to start rush hour
- Eight customers who become regulars, each with a story
- Six places across Guadalajara, each with its own rule and its own taco
- Four cities to travel to, with a different tortilla in each
- Decorate your stand: awning, lights, sign and paint
- 50 stamps to earn
- A tour that never ends

No account needed and no rush. The game is whole without paying: ads are optional and only appear when you ask for one.

name: TaskAX
description:
# TaskAX – Smart Project & Task Management

TaskAX is a simple and efficient project and task management app designed to help teams organise work, assign responsibilities, track progress, and manage daily activities in one place.

Whether you are a project manager or an employee, TaskAX helps you stay organised and focused on completing your work.

## Key Features

**1. Project Management**
- Create and manage projects.
- Organise project-related activities.
- Keep project work structured.

**2. Task Assignment**
- Managers can assign tasks to team members.
- Assign responsibilities based on team requirements.
- Set task details, priorities and deadlines.

**3. Employee Self-Assignment**
- Employees can create and self-assign tasks where permitted.
- Manage their own work and responsibilities.
- Keep track of personal tasks.

**4. Task Status Tracking**

- Keep managers and team members informed.

**5. Team Collaboration**

- Better task organisation.

- Easy project and task tracking.
- Manage work efficiently from one application.

- Project managers

## Manage Your Work Smarter with TaskAX!

Organise projects, assign tasks, track progress and keep your entire team connected with TaskAX.

**Developed by AnaxisTech**

name: Taxi Meter – Cab Fare Tracker
description:
Just hopped in a yellow cab after a late dinner in Midtown? Heading home from the Loop on a Friday night? Know what the ride should cost before you reach for your card.

Taxi Meter is your own taxi meter for passengers. Tap Start when the ride begins and Arrived when it ends. Your phone's GPS measures the distance and the fare is calculated live with the local taxi rates: the flag drop, the distance rate and waiting time in slow traffic.

CITY TAXI RATES BUILT IN
• New York City – NYC TLC yellow cab (medallion taxi) rates
• Chicago – City of Chicago (BACP) taxi rates, including the July 2026 increase
• Los Angeles – LADOT taxicab rates
• Washington, DC – DFHV taxicab fares
• Philadelphia – Philadelphia Parking Authority (PPA) rates, with the monthly fuel surcharge
• San Francisco – SFMTA taxi fares
• Boston – Boston Police Hackney Carriage Unit rates
• Las Vegas – Nevada Taxicab Authority rates
• Seattle and King County – regional taxi rates
• San Diego – MTS maximum taxi rates
• Dallas, Houston, Atlanta, Miami-Dade, Charlotte, Baltimore and San Antonio – city or county taxi rates
• Phoenix – Sky Harbor taxi maximum rates, used as a fair reference price (taxis elsewhere in the city set their own fares)

ALSO BUILT IN
• Puerto Rico – island-wide meter rates (NTSP), the same in San Juan and across the island
• U.S. Virgin Islands – Taxicab Commission fares for St. Thomas, converted to a distance rate
• Guam – meter rates set by Guam law
• Manila – LTFRB rates for regular white taxis, in pesos (the cab's meter may read a little higher)

The city is picked automatically from your location, so there is nothing to set up. Fares are shown in the local currency, with distance in miles in the US.

SURCHARGES APPLIED AUTOMATICALLY
• NYC overnight surcharge (8 pm–6 am) and rush-hour surcharge (4–8 pm)
• NYC trips past the city line: double rate in Westchester and Nassau, Newark surcharge
• Chicago trips into the suburbs: 1.5x the meter from the city line
• Nevada's 3% excise tax on every Las Vegas ride
• Night rates in cities that have them

FEATURES
• Big, easy-to-read meter screen you can check at a glance
• Keeps measuring with the screen off
• Receipt after every ride, shareable as an image
• Works offline: fares are stored in the app and updated regularly
• No sign-up, no account

PRIVACY
Your location is used only on your phone to measure the ride. It is never sent anywhere.

PLEASE NOTE
Tips, tolls, airport fees and flat airport fares (such as JFK) are not included. Taxi Meter is a reference for passengers, not a legal meter, and the cab's own meter can differ slightly.

Traveling abroad? The meter switches to the local taxi fare there too.

And it's not just for taxis. Out for a drive with friends or on a date? Run the meter for laughs, then show off the fare when you pull up: “Look what that ride came to. Dinner's on you!”

name: TEBHOS
description:
TEBHOS is a chat app where you talk with your friends and communities by voice, video and text.

VOICE AND VIDEO
• Join a voice channel with one tap and leave whenever you like.
• Turn on your camera or share your screen.
• Call your friends directly.

SERVERS AND CHANNELS
• Create your own server and organize it with text and voice channels.
• Decide who can do what with roles and permissions.
• Find communities that match your interests in Discover.

MESSAGING
• Direct and group messages.
• Send photos, videos, GIFs, emoji and stickers.
• React to, reply to and pin messages.

YOUR PROFILE
• Set your avatar, banner and bio.
• Tune notifications per server and per channel.

SAFETY
• Block people you do not want to hear from; report messages, users and servers from inside the app.

TEBHOS PRO
TEBHOS is free to use. TEBHOS Pro is an optional subscription that adds extras such as a higher upload limit, animated avatar and banner, and longer messages.
• Monthly and yearly subscriptions are available.
• Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase.

Privacy Policy: https://tebhos.com/privacy

name: Tellvi
description:
Tellvi is where your people gather: posts, short videos, private chats, focused Channels and live streams, in one place you control.

HOME
A feed of text, photo and video posts from the people you follow.

PULSE
Short vertical videos with comments and replies.

CHATS
Private messages with photos, voice notes and calls. People you do not know yet can send three messages until you reply.

CHANNELS
One voice, many listeners. Only the Channel owner posts, so a Channel stays focused.

LIVE
Go live, let viewers join the moment, chat along and send gifts.

VERIFIED
Verification badges are reviewed by our team, and you are told the result and the reason.

PRIVACY AND SAFETY
You choose who can see your profile and who can message or comment. Report and block on every post, comment, message and live stream. Delete your account any time from Settings. Tellvi is for people 18 and over.

COINS
Coins are optional in-app purchases used only to send gifts in Tellvi. They have no cash value and cannot be transferred or exchanged for money.

name: Telly Tamer
description:
Telly Tamer is one remote for your TV and the streaming apps on it. Find your TV on your home Wi-Fi, pair it once, and control it from your iPhone.

WHAT IT DOES
- Finds Samsung smart TVs and Amazon Fire TV devices on your Wi-Fi
- Direction pad and volume from your phone
- Opens your streaming apps with one tap
- Searches shows and films, then opens them in the service that has them
- Keeps your favourite shows in a list

SUBSCRIPTION
Telly Tamer is a monthly subscription with a free first week. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when the trial ends and each month after, unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel in Settings, your name, Subscriptions.

Your iPhone and your TV must be on the same Wi-Fi network. Telly Tamer is not affiliated with Samsung, Amazon or any streaming service.

Privacy: https://weave-tellytamer.web.app/privacy/

name: The Agent Office
description:
The Agent Office runs AI coding agents, your workers, on your computer. This app is its remote control, so your work keeps moving when you step away from your desk.

• See every worker at a glance: who is working, who is done, and who needs you.
• Answer questions and approve or deny actions with one tap.
• Chat with a worker in its thread, send files, and watch replies arrive live.
• Hire a worker for a ticket, or talk a hire through first.
• Get a notification the moment a worker needs you or finishes.

Private by design: your phone and computer talk end-to-end encrypted. The relay in between cannot read your messages, and notifications say what happened, never what was said.

Requires The Agent Office on your Mac (free at theagentoffice.app), signed in with the same account.

name: The Full Puck
description:
Arcade hockey the way you remember it, inside a whole TV broadcast.

Skate, deke and rip a one-timer past the goalie, then finish your checks and win the faceoff that matters. Underneath the show is a proper arcade hockey game: easy to pick up, fast, and loud.

A WHOLE BROADCAST
Randy Mayfair and Duke Kruz, the booth from The Full Snap, now call hockey full time. They would like you to know they still do not get hockey. Cheryl Vance, between the benches, does, and keeps correcting them. The referee announces penalties on the arena mic, the PA is a very loud man, players chirp at each other, and every game comes with a pregame show, replays, intermissions and commercial breaks for things nobody should buy.

PLAY IT ON THE COUCH
• Apple TV: the Siri Remote plays the game. Your thumb skates, a click shoots, Play/Pause passes.
• Pair an Xbox, PlayStation or other controller for every move: dekes, turbo, slappers, poke checks and stick lifts.
• Couch 2-player: a second controller takes the other club.
• Play a friend online through a Game Center invite or on the same Wi-Fi. A friend's iPhone or iPad works as a controller.

PLAY IT ANYWHERE
On iPhone and iPad, a touch stick appears under your thumb and the buttons sit on the right. Your season follows you between iPhone, iPad and Apple TV through iCloud.

FIVE MINUTES OR A SEASON
• A single game with any two clubs.
• Quick game: we skip to the third period.
• A full season with standings and a trophy.
• Scenarios with gold, silver and bronze medals.
• Training camp: learn the moves in five minutes.
• Watch the computer play while the booth keeps talking.

THE DETAILS
• 5 on 5 plus goalies, line changes, and 3 on 3 sudden-death overtime.
• Wristers, slappers, one-timers, tips, wraparounds, fake shots, body checks and fights.
• Offside, icing, penalties, power plays and penalty shots, each one yours to turn off.
• Eight referee crews with their own habits.
• Outdoor games in snow, fog, heat and storms.
• 24 clubs in real cities, each with its own rink, crowd, coach and mascot.
• 28 Game Center achievements and leaderboards.

FAMILY-FRIENDLY
No swearing and no crude jokes. Good, silly fun for the whole couch.

NO ADS. NO IN-APP PURCHASES. Pay once, play on every Apple device you own.

The league, teams, players, officials and sponsors are made up. The Full Puck is not affiliated with any real league, team or broadcaster.

name: The Mishkat Quran
description:
The Mishkat Quran is a quiet place to read the Qur'an, to listen to it, and to learn to read it and to pray. Its name comes from the niche in Sūrat an-Nūr where a lamp shines, light upon light, and the whole app is built around that one lamp.

Read the complete Qur'an in Uthmani Arabic, with the English translation of Marmaduke Pickthall and the Urdu translation of Fateh Muhammad Jalandhari. The text and both translations live on your iPhone, so you can read and search anywhere, with or without a connection. Every verse is checked against its published source each time the app opens.

Listen to the whole Qur'an from cover to cover, or verse by verse, in the voices of four renowned reciters, streamed the moment you choose them. Repeat a verse as many times as you need, set a sleep timer that waits for the end of a verse, and hear the English or Urdu translation after each verse if you wish.

Learn to read the Qur'an with the Noorani Qaida. Ten lessons take you from the 29 letters, through their joined forms, the short and long vowels, tanwīn, sukūn and shaddah, to reading whole words. Tap any letter to hear it, see where in the mouth it is sounded, and practise with a listening quiz until each lesson is yours.

Learn to pray one step at a time, from wuḍū to a complete prayer. Each posture is drawn clearly for a man or a woman, with the Arabic, its transliteration and its meaning. When you are ready, Pray Along guides a whole prayer while your phone rests on the mat: a gentle voice and a vibration lead each movement, a large counter shows your rakah, and a tasbīḥ counter follows the salām. The lessons follow the Ḥanafī school.

In Ramadan, the app becomes a companion for the month. Follow your progress around a ring of thirty juz, resume exactly where you stopped, see the times of suḥūr and ifṭār for where you are, and share one khatm with your family. Tonight's juz can follow you onto the Lock Screen, the Dynamic Island and StandBy.

Keep the verses that speak to you as bookmarks and private notes, search in Arabic, English or Urdu, turn to any sūrah on a dial, and lift a veil word by word as you memorise. Choose from four reading themes and set the Arabic and translation sizes separately.

On iPhone Duo, the Qur'an opens as a two-page mushaf, and every part of the app uses both pages: a lesson on one page with its letter on the other, a prayer figure facing its words, and your settings beside a live page of the mushaf.

On devices with Apple Intelligence, optional study tools can explain vocabulary, summarise themes, suggest questions for reflection and help with memorisation. They run entirely on your iPhone, they are a reading aid rather than a scholar, and they never write or change the Arabic of the Qur'an.

name: The Space HI: Room Rentals
description:
The Space is a multi-room rental venue in Salt Lake, Honolulu: two training rooms, a podcast studio, a control room and three meeting rooms, rented by the hour.

The app is for people who rent with us.

MY BOOKINGS
See every upcoming booking with the room, time and what you paid. Add a booking to your iPhone calendar in one tap, or share the details with your group.

SEATING
Plan your room before you arrive. Every room is drawn to scale from laser measurements. Start from rows of chairs, a classroom or a boardroom layout, then drag chairs and 6-ft tables where you want them. Save the layout to your booking and our staff set the room up that way.

REQUEST A TIME
Pick a room, date and length and see the estimate right away. We reply with a secure payment link, usually within a couple of hours.

SCHEDULE AND GUIDES
Check which rooms are open, read the house rules and see the floor plan.

Sign in with the email you booked with. We send a one-time link, no password needed.

The Space, 4510 Salt Lake Blvd, Unit D8, Honolulu, HI 96818. (808) 630-1345

name: Thrum: Silent Vibration Alarm
description:
Thrum is a silent alarm that wakes you with strong vibration and won't let you switch it off half asleep.

HOW IT WORKS
• Your alarm rings through iOS: on the lock screen, in Silent mode and through Focus.
• Open Thrum and it vibrates at full strength, in patterns that change every few seconds, so you never get used to them.
• Take a selfie with flash. Thrum checks for a face on your iPhone and deletes the photo right away.
• Only then can you slide to snooze or slide to stop.

NO HIDING FROM IT
• Press the side button or ignore the alert, and it rings again a minute later, for up to half an hour.
• Wait too long after the selfie and the vibration starts again.

THE BASICS, DONE WELL
• Alarms with labels and repeat days.
• Snooze from 1 to 30 minutes.
• A test alarm in one minute, so you can see how it feels.

QUIET BY DESIGN
iOS alarms must play a sound, so Thrum plays a silent one on the lock screen. You can switch to the standard alarm sound in Settings at any time.

PRIVATE
No account, no analytics, no network access. Selfies never leave your iPhone and are never saved.

One purchase. No subscription. No in-app purchases.

name: Thunee Gully
description:
Thunee the way it's played in Durban, now on your iPhone.

Thunee Gully is the classic 24-card game played with a partner. Call for trump, count your points, keep score with two 6s, and don't get caught not following suit, or it's 4 balls to the other team.

PICK YOUR PARTNER
Play with one of six characters, each with their own style and plenty to say at the table:
• Fowl Auntie: sells fresh fowl to the whole neighbourhood and plays it safe
• BushKnife Bobby: a gambler who loves a big call
• Nine Boy: solid, but slips up now and then
• Temple Uncle: careful, calls only on strong hands, and blesses the table first
• Sweetie: her sugar is high, and she takes the odd chance call for trump
• Baboo's Lytie: half careful, half gambler, with his father telling everyone how well he's doing at school

PLAY ONLINE
• See who's online right now and challenge them
• Or start a table and invite friends with a code or a link
• Play against friends on iPhone or Android

ALL THE CALLS
• Calling for trump in 10s, and Last card when your first four cards are all different suits
• The trump card, shown after the first card is dropped
• Jodhi: 20, 30, 40 and 50
• Double, Khunuk and Thunee
• Claim 4 ball when an opponent doesn't follow suit. But get it wrong and it's 4 balls against you

AND MORE
• Score kept with two 6s on the table, just like the real thing
• Leave a game against the computer and carry on later
• Your stats: games played, win %, hands won and winning streaks
• Settings for sound and game speed

House rules vary from table to table. Thunee Gully uses a common Durban set.

name: THXO Maintenance

THXO Maintenance คือแอปงานซ่อมบำรุงสำหรับช่างและผู้ใช้เครื่องจักร ในบริษัทที่ใช้ระบบ THXO ทำงานหน้าเครื่องได้เลย ทุกอย่างเข้าระบบเอง ไม่ต้องกลับมาคีย์ที่คอมพิวเตอร์

name: TickBill - เตือนจ่ายบิล
description:
TickBill คือเช็กลิสต์รายจ่ายประจำเดือนที่ช่วยให้คุณไม่ลืมจ่ายบิลอีกต่อไป

ค่าเช่า ค่าไฟ ค่าน้ำ ค่าเน็ต ค่าโทรศัพท์ ค่าสตรีมมิง หรือค่างวด ใส่ไว้ครั้งเดียว แล้ว TickBill จะแสดงให้ทุกเดือนอัตโนมัติ พร้อมเตือนก่อนถึงวันครบกำหนด

ยอดรวม จ่ายแล้ว และคงเหลือ อัปเดตทันทีที่ติ๊ก

แตะครั้งเดียวก็บันทึกว่าจ่ายแล้ว และหยุดเตือนรอบนั้นทันที

• รู้ทันทีว่าบิลไหนใกล้ครบหรือเลยกำหนด
ทุกรายการแสดงสถานะ ยังไม่ถึงกำหนด ครบกำหนดวันนี้ หรือเลยกำหนดกี่วัน

• ยอดไม่เท่ากันทุกเดือนก็ได้
ปรับยอดเฉพาะเดือน เช่น ค่าไฟเดือนนี้สูงกว่าปกติ โดยไม่กระทบเดือนอื่น

• ย้อนดูเดือนก่อนและวางแผนเดือนหน้า
เลื่อนดูได้ทุกเดือน ประวัติการจ่ายยังอยู่ครบ

• เตือนก่อนครบกำหนด
ตั้งการแจ้งเตือนแยกรายบิล เปิดหรือปิดได้ตามต้องการ

• เป็นส่วนตัว ไม่ต้องสมัครสมาชิก
