name: 단어로 배우는 한자
description:
한자를 한 자씩 외우는 대신, 우리가 늘 쓰는 단어 속에서 만나요. 經營, 運動, 家族처럼 이미 아는 단어를 보면 글자마다 훈과 음이 함께 보이고, 모르는 글자만 누르면 돼요. 그 글자는 며칠 간격을 두고 다른 단어의 빈칸으로 다시 나와요.

■ 무엇을 배우나요
• 한문 교육용 기초 한자 1,800자 (중학교용 900자, 고등학교용 900자)
• 생활에서 자주 만나는 상용한자 579자: 간판, 메뉴, 지명, 신문, 교회와 절, 병원, 경조사에서 보는 글자
• 단어와 사자성어 4,992개: 교과서, 종교, 음식, 지명, 영화 제목, 의학, 절기와 경조사, 신문과 서류의 말까지

■ 이렇게 공부해요
• 단어 카드: 글자마다 훈음이 보이고, 모르는 글자를 누르면 표시돼요.
• 빈칸 복습: 모른다고 한 글자는 1·2·4·8일 간격으로, 이미 본 단어의 빈칸에 알맞은 글자를 넷 중에서 고르는 문제로 다시 나와요.
• 방금 몰랐던 글자는 몇 장 뒤에 한 번, 공부를 마칠 때 한 번 더 물어봐요.
• 글자 카드와 글자 퀴즈로 글자만 따로 볼 수도 있어요.

■ 글자에서 글자로
• 글자를 길게 누르면 그 글자가 든 다른 단어들과, 소리가 비슷한 글자, 뜻이 비슷한 글자, 모양이 닮은 글자가 나와요. 단어를 열고 그 안의 글자로 계속 건너갈 수 있어요.
• 뜻을 알기 어려운 훈과, 모양에서 뜻이 나온 글자 가운데 일부에는 짧은 설명이 붙어 있어요.
• 소리를 나타내는 부분이 있는 글자는 카드 뒷면에 그 부분을 보여 줘요.

■ 중국과 일본에서도
• 단어 대부분에 중국과 일본에서 쓰는 글자 모양과 병음·가나 읽기를 함께 보여 줘요. 여행 중에 간판과 메뉴를 읽을 때 도움이 돼요.

■ 한눈에 보는 진도
• 글자 하나에 점 하나. 아는 글자는 초록, 모르는 글자는 빨강으로, 내가 아는 한자가 한 화면에 보여요.
• 중학교용, 고등학교용, 상용한자마다 아는 글자가 10%씩 늘 때 작은 축하가 있어요.
• 며칠째 이어서 공부했는지, 오늘 몇 장 봤는지 보여 줘요.

■ 편하게
• 회원가입, 광고, 결제가 없어요.
• 인터넷 없이도 공부할 수 있어요.
• 글자 크기를 100%부터 175%까지 고를 수 있어요.
• iPhone과 iPad에서 쓸 수 있어요.
• 진도는 이 기기에만 저장되고, 파일로 백업하고 복원할 수 있어요.
• 뜻이나 읽기가 틀린 것 같으면 카드에서 바로 의견을 보낼 수 있어요.

익명 사용 통계를 보내며, 설정에서 끌 수 있어요. 자세한 내용은 개인정보처리방침(hanja.ixoy.net/privacy)에 있어요.

name: 루틴영어 - 엄마표 영어 & 원서 읽기 플래너
description:
매일 원서 진도 고민 끝! 
루틴만 짜두면 오늘 할 집중듣기·원서읽기 분량을 자동으로 배정해 주는 엄마표 영어 & 원서 읽기 스케줄러

■ 오늘 할 일 (설정 기반 자동 스케줄링)
· 내가 만든 루틴 규칙에 맞춰 오늘 읽을 책과 분량이 자동으로 배정돼요
· 할 일을 끝냈다면 체크 한 번으로 완료, 아이의 이해도까지 간편하게 체크해요
· 못 한 날은 '미루기', 집에 없는 책은 '빼기'로 스케줄이 꼬이지 않게 유연하게 조정해요

■ 나만의 영어 노출 루틴 설계
· 읽힐 원서 세트나 시리즈(그림책, 리더스북, 챕터북 등)를 담아두면 다음 책이 순서대로 이어져요
· 요일별 스케줄, 하루 학습량, 목표 회독 수를 원하는 대로 직접 설계할 수 있어요
· 챕터·유닛·페이지 단위로 쪼개 읽는 원서도 설정한 분량에 맞춰 매일 정확히 배분해요

■ 한눈에 보는 루틴 달성 리포트
· 집중듣기, 흘려듣기 등 활동별 스케줄 달성률과 누적 완료 권수, 회독 현황을 확인해요
· 기간별 이해도 변화 추이로 아이의 영어 리딩 성장을 점검해요

■ AR·렉사일 맞춤 원서 추천
· 엄마표 영어 단계와 독서 레벨 지수로 루틴에 담을 원서와 세트를 쉽게 찾아요
· 현재 아이 레벨에 맞는 추천 도서와 다음 단계 도전 원서를 탐색할 수 있어요
· 나만의 보관함, 직접 만든 원서 세트와 등록한 책도 깔끔하게 정리해요

■ 형제자매 개별 스케줄 & 리마인드 알림
· 자녀가 여럿이어도 형제자매 프로필별로 각자의 루틴과 할 일 목록을 따로 관리해요
· 매일 정해진 시간에 울리는 할 일 알림으로 영어 루틴을 놓치지 않아요

■ 여러 기기에서 안전하게 이어 쓰기
· 회원가입과 로그인 없이도 설치 즉시 바로 루틴을 시작할 수 있어요
· Google 또는 Apple 계정으로 연동하면 설정한 루틴과 데이터가 안전하게 백업되고 다른 기기에서도 이어서 쓸 수 있어요

번거로운 진도 계산과 할 일 관리는 루틴영어에 맡기세요.
오늘부터 가장 스마트한 엄마표 영어 루틴을 시작해 보세요!

name: 마리아고 스토쿠
description:
스토쿠는 스도쿠 퍼즐과 AI 기능을 결합한 두뇌 게임입니다. 간단한 조작과 깔끔한 화면으로 언제 어디서나 편안하게 스도쿠를 즐길 수 있습니다.

초보자부터 숙련자까지 자신의 실력에 맞는 난이도를 선택하고, 매번 새롭게 생성되는 퍼즐에 도전해 보세요. 문제를 풀다가 막히면 AI에게 질문하거나 ‘AI 한 수’ 기능을 통해 다음 수에 대한 도움을 받을 수 있습니다.

주요 기능

• 5단계 난이도
쉬움, 보통, 어려움, 극악, 지옥까지 실력에 맞춰 선택할 수 있습니다.

• 새로운 스도쿠 퍼즐
새 게임을 시작할 때마다 새로운 퍼즐이 생성됩니다.

• AI 한 수
어려운 순간에는 AI의 도움을 받아 다음 수를 확인할 수 있습니다.

• AI 질문 기능
퍼즐을 풀며 궁금한 내용을 AI에게 질문하고 힌트를 받을 수 있습니다.

• 메모 기능
정답 후보 숫자를 셀에 메모하여 체계적으로 추론할 수 있습니다.

• 실행 취소 및 다시 실행
입력 실수를 간편하게 되돌리거나 다시 적용할 수 있습니다.

• 편리한 게임 진행
진행 중인 퍼즐을 저장하고 다음 실행 시 이어서 플레이할 수 있습니다.

• 플레이 기록 확인
게임 진행 시간과 현재 난이도를 한눈에 확인할 수 있습니다.

• 직관적인 화면 구성
스마트폰과 태블릿 화면에 최적화된 인터페이스로 쾌적하게 플레이할 수 있습니다.

스토쿠는 단순히 정답을 맞히는 게임을 넘어 논리적으로 생각하고 문제를 해결하는 즐거움을 제공합니다. 매일 새로운 퍼즐에 도전하며 집중력과 추론 능력을 키워보세요.

지금 스토쿠에서 AI와 함께 스도쿠를 시작해 보세요!

name: 벽 대국
description:
7×7 판에서 말을 옮기고, 도착한 칸에 벽을 하나 놓으세요. 벽으로 내 말만 남은 영역을 만들어 점수를 얻습니다. 사각 말은 직선으로 움직이고, 원형 말은 한 번 꺾어 움직일 수 있어요.

오프라인에서는 AI와 1대1 또는 3인전을 하거나, 한 기기에서 둘이나 셋이 번갈아 둘 수 있습니다. 온라인에서는 공개 대국에서 상대를 찾거나 초대 코드로 친구와 대국할 수 있어요. 공개 대국의 전적과 레이팅은 계정 화면에서 확인할 수 있습니다.

name: 삑 - 바코드 찍으면 포인트
description:
삑은 바코드를 찍으면 포인트가 쌓이는 앱이에요.

택배를 뜯었다면 안에 든 제품 바코드를 삑 찍어 보세요. 장 본 물건, 집에 있는 물건도 돼요. 찍을 때마다 꽝 없는 복권이 한 장 나오고, 긁으면 포인트가 바로 쌓여요.

이렇게 모아요
- 바코드 찍기: 하루 4번, 한 번에 최대 40P
- 만보기: 1,000걸음마다 복권 한 장
- 보너스 타임: 오전 9시, 오후 1시, 오후 6시, 오후 10시에 찍으면 더 받아요
- 친구 초대: 친구가 첫 바코드를 찍으면 둘 다 100P
- 오늘의 미션: 출석하고 퀴즈 풀고 포인트 받기

이렇게 써요
- 1P는 1원이에요
- 1,000P부터 기프티콘으로 바꿔요
- 편의점, 카페에서 바로 쓸 수 있어요

안내
- 제품 사진은 실제 물건인지 확인하는 데만 써요. 송장의 이름, 주소, 전화번호는 가려서 보관해요
- 복권은 무료이고 구매나 결제가 필요 없어요. Apple은 이 이벤트의 후원사가 아니며 어떤 방식으로도 관여하지 않아요
- 만 14세 이상만 쓸 수 있어요
- 문의: hello@bbik.kr

name: 쓱가림 - AI 사진 모자이크 블러
description:
소중한 내 사진, SNS나 메신저에 공유할 땐 민감한 개인정보를 '쓱가림'으로 안전하게 가리세요!

중고거래 택배 송장 사진, 결제 영수증 인증, 신분증 인증, 단체 사진 속 타인의 얼굴...
사진을 올릴 때마다 개인정보가 노출될까 봐 일일이 브러시로 칠하기 번거로우셨나요?

'쓱가림(BlurTap)'은 온디바이스 AI가 사진 속 얼굴과 민감한 텍스트를 자동으로 찾아내고, 터치 한 번으로 손쉽게 블러, 모자이크 처리할 수 있는 개인정보 보호 유틸리티입니다.

외부 서버로 사진을 절대 전송하지 않는 100% 온디바이스 AI로 데이터 유출 걱정 없이 안심하고 사용하세요!

[ 쓱가림의 핵심 기능 ]

1초 만에 끝나는 똑똑한 AI 자동 감지
- 얼굴 (Face): 단체 사진 속 지나가는 행인이나 주변 사람의 얼굴 자동 감지
- 신분증 및 면허번호: 주민등록번호, 운전면허번호 등 핵심 민감정보 정밀 탐지
- 카드번호: 결제 영수증 및 국내/해외 신용, 체크카드 번호 감지
- 연락처 및 이메일: 텍스트 속 전화번호와 이메일 주소 감지
- 차량 번호판: 한국 및 글로벌 자동차 번호판 자동 인식
- 바코드 및 QR코드: 모바일 쿠폰, 티켓, 송장 속 바코드 정보 탐지

탭 한 번으로 가리고, 드래그로 자유롭게 추가
- 자동 감지된 영역을 가볍게 탭(Tap)하면 즉시 모자이크 적용!
- 감지되지 않은 부분도 손가락으로 드래그하면 나만의 마스킹 박스 즉시 생성

클립보드 복사본 즉시 가리기
- 스크린샷 캡처 후 [복사]를 누르고 쓱가림을 열면 갤러리에 저장할 필요 없이 1초 만에 바로 가리고 공유할 수 있습니다.

취향에 맞는 다양한 가림 스타일
- 부드럽고 자연스러운 [블러 (Blur)]
- 깔끔하고 클래식한 [모자이크 (Mosaic)]
- 완벽하게 내용을 가리는 [블랙박스 (Blackout)]

100% 온디바이스 AI (보안 및 오프라인 보장)
- 회원가입이나 로그인이 일체 필요 없습니다.
- 여러분의 사진과 개인정보는 외부 서버로 절대 전송되지 않습니다.
- 모든 AI 분석과 모자이크 처리는 스마트폰 기기 내부에서만 안전하게 실행되며, 비행기 탑승 모드나 오프라인에서도 완벽하게 작동합니다.

[ 이런 분들께 강력 추천합니다! ]

- 중고거래(당근마켓, 중고나라 등) 시 택배 송장 주소, 연락처 가릴 때
- 인스타그램, 블로그에 일상 사진 올릴 때 주변 사람 얼굴 가릴 때
- 맛집, 쇼핑 영수증이나 결제 내역 인증할 때 (카드번호 마스킹)
- 신분증 확인용 사진 제출 시 필수 정보만 남기고 가릴 때
- 모바일 기프티콘, 탑승권, 티켓 인증 사진 올릴 때 (바코드/QR 가림)

[ 문의 및 고객 지원 ]

- 고객 지원 이메일: support@craftr.win

name: 이퍼르 - 내 말로 배우는 영어 말하기
description:
오늘 내가 한 말, 내일은 영어로 나와요.

단어도 알고 문법도 배웠는데, 막상 말하려면 입이 안 떨어지나요?
이퍼르(eforut)는 ‘아는 영어’를 ‘입에서 나오는 영어’로 바꾸는 영어 말하기 앱이에요.

■ 내가 실제로 하는 말이 교재가 돼요
“이따 다시 전화할게”, “확인해 보고 말씀드릴게요”처럼 내가 매일 하는 한국어 문장을 등록하세요. AI가 말하는 의도와 상황을 함께 살펴 자연스러운 미국 영어로 바꿔 드려요.

■ 입으로 말해야 통과예요
문장 7개가 미션 하나예요. 보기에서 고르는 문제가 아니라 직접 말해야 통과해요. 말한 내용을 음성 인식으로 확인하고, 표현이 조금 달라도 뜻이 맞는지 AI가 한 번 더 살펴요. 대답은 5초 안에 시작해야 하고, 반응 속도도 기록돼요. 검증은 하루에 한 번이에요.

■ 잊지 않게 다시 확인해요
통과한 미션은 1주 뒤, 1개월 뒤 다시 검증해요. 그 뒤에도 불시에 유지 점검이 찾아와요. 재검증 전에는 연습이 잠겨서 벼락치기가 안 되고, 재검증에서 틀리면 연습을 처음부터 다시 해요. 그래서 통과한 문장은 진짜 내 것이 돼요.

■ 코스 1,870문장
여행 · 일상 · 직장 · 명언 · 명장면 4개 테마, 19개 카테고리, 카테고리마다 10단계로 준비했어요. 남성 · 여성 AI 음성이 감정을 살려 읽어 주고, 0.75배속으로 천천히 들을 수도 있어요. 베트남어 팩(9,900원)으로 베트남어도 같은 방식으로 배울 수 있어요.

■ 놀이 · 교실 · 단어장으로 매일 조금씩
문장 퍼즐, 빈칸 채우기, 듣고 고르기, 스피드 퀴즈로 가볍게 복습하고, 기초 영어 교실 12단계로 기본기를 다져요. 모르는 단어는 단어장에 모아 다시 볼 수 있어요.

■ 검증 날을 알려 드려요
검증할 미션이 생기면 앱 알림으로 알려 드려요. 알림은 앱 › 나 › 알림에서 언제든 끌 수 있어요.

■ 광고 없이, 구독 없이
영어 학습은 무료예요. 광고도 정기 구독도 없어요. 도움이 됐다면 앱 안에서 1,000원부터 ‘응원’으로 마음을 전할 수 있어요. 응원 안내는 4,900원 상품으로 영구히 숨길 수 있어요.

■ 가입 없이 바로 시작
게스트로 바로 시작하고, 원할 때 회원가입하면 다른 기기에서도 기록을 이어 갈 수 있어요.

이런 분께 추천해요
· 여행 가서 주문 · 체크인할 때 영어가 안 나오는 분
· 회의나 메신저에서 매일 하는 말을 영어로 바로 하고 싶은 분
· 영어 앱을 여러 번 시작했다가 그만둔 분
· 사람 앞에서 말하기 전에 혼자 충분히 연습하고 싶은 분

안내
· AI 번역과 판정은 틀릴 수 있어요. 어색한 결과는 알려 주시면 개선할게요.
· 음성 인식을 위해 마이크 권한이 필요해요. 학습 알림을 받으려면 알림 권한이 필요해요(선택).

name: お釣りミニマム
description:
レジで言われた金額に、財布のお金をどう出せばお釣りが一番少なくなる？
お釣りの枚数を最小にする「お釣りミニマム」を狙う、60秒の計算ゲームです。

■ 遊び方
・お客さんの金額を見て、財布のお札と小銭をトレーに出します（タップかドラッグ）
・「支払う」でお会計。お釣りの枚数が最小なら「ミニマム！」
・ミニマムを出すと持ち時間が増え、続けるとコンボ
・お釣りは財布に戻ってきます。財布の中身は次のお会計に持ち越し
・もたもたしていると、うしろの人のイライラがたまります
・60秒で何円分お買い物できるか挑戦しよう

■ 結果
お買い物の合計・ミニマムの回数で称号がもらえます。結果は画像つきで LINE や X に共有できます。

■ こんな人に
・すきま時間に頭を使いたい
・暗算や計算が好き
・レジで小銭を上手に出せるようになりたい

※ 広告が表示されます。「広告を消す」（買い切り）を買うと、広告がずっと出なくなります。

name: クレイジー剣道
description:
『クレイジー剣道』は、昭和のアーケードゲームを思わせるドット絵の剣道対戦アクションゲームです。

竹刀を手に、個性豊かな強敵たちと真剣勝負！

【主なゲームモード】
■ 全国大会
全国制覇を目指して強敵と対決！

■ 昇段試験
初段から八段まで、勝利を重ねて段位を獲得！

■ 伝説の剣豪
歴史上の剣豪や個性的な剣士たちとの特別な対決！

■ 異種格闘技戦
空手、日本拳法、ムエタイ、グレイシー柔術など、さまざまな格闘技の使い手と激突！

【ゲームの特徴】
・昭和レトロなドット絵グラフィック
・シンプルな操作で楽しめる剣道アクション
・多彩な対戦相手とゲームモード
・迫力のある必殺技と対戦演出

剣道の常識を超えた、クレイジーな戦いが始まる！

※本作品は娯楽を目的としたフィクションのアクションゲームです。

name: コツコツさんすう【１００マス計算】
description:
「コツコツさんすう」は、100マス計算と筆算を、画面に数字を書いて練習できる算数アプリです。
かかった時間と正解率を記録するので、続けた分だけ伸びがグラフで見えます。

■ 100マス計算でタイムに挑戦
・たし算、ひき算、かけ算から選べます
・マスの数は 9マス、25マス、100マスの3つ。はじめての子は少ないマスから
・終わるとタイムと正解率を表示。自己ベストも残ります

■ 筆算を、紙と同じ手順で
・たし算、ひき算、かけ算、わり算の筆算に対応
・「5×6」なら 30 と書くと、0 が答えに、3 がくり上がりの欄に入ります
・いま何を計算する番かを、画面の上に一言で出します
・レベルは各3段階（2けた×2けたのかけ算、3けた÷1けたのわり算まで）

■ 指で書いて答える
・画面の枠に数字を書くと、書き終わったところで読み取ります
・数字のキーで入力する方法にも切り替えられます

■ 伸びがグラフで見える
・1回目で正解できた割合を、日ごとにグラフで表示
・100マス計算のタイムを、回ごとにグラフで表示
・はじめのころと最近を比べた数字も出ます

■ よくまちがえる問題を集めて復習
・「7×8」のように、まちがいの多い問題を自動で集めます
・「にがてとっくん」で、その問題を 10問出題。まちがえた問題はあとでもう一度出ます

■ 毎日つづけたくなる
・毎日3つのミッション
・解くたびにスターがたまり、レベルが上がります
・続けた日数やミスなしのクリアでバッジがもらえます

■ ご利用について
・無料で使えます。広告は出ません
・アカウントの登録はいりません
・学習の記録は iPhone の中に保存します
・手書きの読み取りに使うデータを、はじめに1回だけ取りこみます（インターネット接続が必要です）

name: ことりのすづくり - シマエナガとスズメ
description:
小さな鳥になって、巣をつくって、ヒナを育てよう！
お庭を飛びまわって巣の材料を集め、卵をあたため、ヒナにごはんをあげて、巣立ちを見送るまでを遊べる、子ども向けの3Dゲームです。

■ あそびかた
・さがす … 画面をなぞると、その方向へ飛んでいきます。光っている材料にさわると、くちばしでくわえます
・つくる … 巣に運ぶと、巣が少しずつ形になっていきます
・かざる … できた巣を、お花や見つけた宝物でかざれます
・あたためる … 卵の上を長押しすると、トクントクンと動いて、ヒナが生まれます
・そだてる … 口を大きくあけたヒナに、虫を運んであげよう
・すだつ … 大きくなったヒナが、一羽ずつ飛び立ちます

■ 2しゅるいの ことり
・スズメ（無料）… 屋根のすき間に、草や羽をつめこんで巣をつくります
・シマエナガ（追加購入「ぜんぶの とり」）… コケをクモの糸でつないだ、まるい巣をつくります。巣立ったヒナは枝にぎゅっと並ぶ「エナガ団子」に
本物の鳥の習性をもとにしているので、遊びながら鳥のくらしにふれられます。

■ 宝さがしとシール帳
お庭のあちこちに、どんぐり・ビー玉・リボンなどの宝物がかくれています。見つけた宝物はシール帳に集まり、巣のかざりにも使えます。

■ 字が読めなくても遊べます
失敗やゲームオーバー、時間制限はありません。光と音で次にやることを案内します。

■ おうちのかたへ
・登録やログインは不要です
・広告は子ども向けの設定で表示し、章の合間（巣立ちを見送ったあと）だけに出ます。広告の前には「こうこく」の札が出ます
・シマエナガの章は、買い切りの「ぜんぶの とり」（追加購入）で遊べます。これから増える鳥も遊べるようになり、広告も出なくなります
・買い物の画面は、かけ算の問題に答えないと開きません

name: ネコ忍者 漢字4-5-6年 お受験対策 テスト・漢検対策
description:
ネコ忍者といっしょに、小学4〜6年生で習う漢字を しゅぎょうしよう！

小学校4・5・6年生で習う漢字586字を、ぜんぶ収録した漢字練習アプリです。読み・書き・意味・書き順の問題に、タップだけで答えられるので、えんぴつもノートもいりません。すき間時間に、毎日ちょっとずつ続けられます。

■ このアプリが生まれたわけ
小学生の子どもが、学校の「漢字チャレンジテスト」のために、ノートに同じ漢字を何回も書いて練習していました。がんばる姿を見ながら、「ふだんから、ちょっとずつ楽しく練習できるアプリがあったらいいのに」と思って、作りはじめたのがこのアプリです。

■ 4〜6年生の漢字を、ぜんぶ収録
・4年生 202字、5年生 193字、6年生 191字の、あわせて586字（2020年度からの学年別漢字配当表どおり。都道府県名の漢字もふくみます）
・学年はいくつでも組み合わせて えらべます（例：5年生と6年生だけ）
・どの漢字にも、音読み・訓読みそれぞれの例文つき

■ タップだけで、サクサク進む
答えをタップすると、その場で正解・不正解がわかります。正解すると花火や流れ星があがり、れんぞくで正解するほど演出が はでになるので、ついつい次の問題に進みたくなります。

■ 4つの問題で、しっかり身につく
・よみ：漢字の読みを えらぶ（音読み・訓読み）
・かき：読みに あう漢字を えらぶ
・いみ：例文の □ に入る漢字を えらぶ
・かきじゅん：書きはじめの場所を えらぶ
例文には絵文字のヒントがつくので、文の場面がイメージしやすくなっています。

■ 書き順は、アニメーションで
書き順の問題に答えると、正しい書きはじめの場所から、1画ずつ書き順どおりに漢字が書かれていきます。まちがえたときも、正しい書き順を目で見て確かめられます。

■ 毎日10問の「しゅぎょう」と、50問の「本番チャレンジテスト」
・しゅぎょう：1回10問。まだ出ていない漢字から出題されるので、毎日ちがう漢字に出会えます
・本番チャレンジテスト：50問で、いまの力をためせます
・ホームには、さいきんの「せいかいりつ」を表示します

■ まちがえた漢字は「ふくしゅう」
まちがえた漢字や、ヒントを使った漢字は、自動で「ふくしゅう」に入ります。苦手な漢字を くりかえし練習できます。

■ こべつれんしゅう
読みだけ、書き順だけなど、問題の種類をしぼって練習できます。

■ かんじパズル
同じ漢字を3つ そろえて消す、ごほうびのパズルゲームです。しゅぎょうで手に入れた手裏剣を1こ使って遊べます。れんさで ばくだんやロケットが手に入り、制限時間内にクリアすると「れんぞく巻物」がもらえます。

■ かんじじてん
学年ごとに、音読み順・訓読み順で「あかさたな」の見出しつきで ならんでいます。読み・例文の読み上げ・書き順も確認できます。

■ 読み上げつき
答えの読みや例文を、音声で読み上げます。読み上げは設定でオフにできます。

■ 毎日つづけたくなるしかけ
・れんぞく日数で、がんばった日が ひと目でわかる
・しゅぎょうを終えると手裏剣がもらえて、5こ集めると「れんぞく巻物」に
・れんぞく巻物があれば、お休みした日も れんぞく記録を守ってくれる
・おぼえた漢字が、ホームでパタパタ めくれて登場

■ 安心・安全に使えます
・広告はありません
・アプリ内課金の手続きのとき以外、外部との通信は一切ありません
・名前やメールアドレスなどの個人情報を集めません
・学習の記録は、お使いの端末の中だけに保存します
※ 記録は端末の中にだけあるため、機種変更をしたときや、アプリを削除したときは、学習の記録が消えてしまいます（購入は「購入を復元する」で元に戻せます）

■ 料金について
はじめて起動してから24時間は、すべての機能を無料でお試しいただけます。そのあとも使い続けるには、アプリ内で1回だけ購入（買い切り・500円）が必要です。毎月の支払いはありません。

■ クレジット
書き順のデータには KanjiVG（© Ulrich Apel、CC BY-SA 3.0）を使用しています。

name: マイクロブタカフェ
description:
歩くほど、ブタが集まる。

「マイクロブタカフェ」は、あなたの歩数と連動してマイクロブタたちが寄ってくる、ゆるい育成アプリです。

歩いた日は、ブタたちが膝のまわりに集まってきて、カフェがにぎやかに。歩いたぶんだけ、うちの子もすくすく育ちます。あまり歩かなかった日は、店内は静かで、ブタたちはのんびり過ごしています。どちらも責めたりしません。次の日に歩けば、またすぐ集まってきます。

■ あそびかた
・歩くとコインが貯まり、アイテムで居場所やブタを飾れます
・ブタはあなたの歩数で少しずつ育ちます。体重の節目には記念の記録が残ります
・ブタは1匹ごとに観察記録つき。名前、お迎え日、体重、毛色、チャームポイント、「組」（きょうだい）まで記録されます
・繁盛度は直近7日の歩数で変わります。賑わいはブタの集まり具合で表現されます

■ おともだちのカフェへ
・招待コードを交換すると、友達のカフェをのぞきに行けます
・シェアカードと招待コードで、今日のカフェの様子を友達と共有できます

■ データについて
・歩数は Apple ヘルスケアや端末の歩数センサーから読み取りますが、処理はすべて端末の中で完結し、外部に送信することはありません
・アカウント登録は不要です

今日のお散歩のお供に、膝の上の小さなカフェをどうぞ。

name: むぎゅねこパズル
description:
同じ色のねこを指でなぞってつなげるだけ！
かんたん操作で、ねこたちが敵にむぎゅっと攻撃する、かわいいパズルRPGです。

■ なぞって消すだけのかんたんパズル
同じ色のねこを3匹以上つなげると攻撃！ななめもOK。
5匹以上で「金魚ボム」、7匹以上で「レインボー肉球ボム」ができて、一気に大ダメージ。
10匹以上つなげると「FEVER!!」で攻撃アップ！

■ 22匹のねこ、それぞれに必殺技
おひるね好きの「しらたま」、えびフライの着ぐるみ「えび天にゃん」、雲に乗った「かみなりさまにゃん」、満月の夜の「怪盗ムーンにゃん」など、個性ゆたかなねこたちが登場。
ねこごとに担当の色・必殺技・リーダー特性があるので、チームの組み合わせで戦い方が変わります。

■ 全60ステージ＋やりこみ要素
・6つのワールド（リビング、お風呂場、ガーデン、お城、お菓子のキッチン、宇宙）と、ワールドごとのお話
・草やあわ、じかんばくだんなどの仕掛けや、ターン制限などの特別ルール
・どの面にも「チャレンジ」があって、達成するとダイヤがもらえる
・クリアした面は「ハード」でもう一度挑戦できる
・どこまでのぼれるか挑戦する「むぎゅタワー」と、10階ごとに待ちかまえる「塔の番人」
・毎日かわる「今日のデイリー」、ログインボーナス、ミッション、おるすばん
・集めたねこのプロフィールが読める「ねこ図鑑」

■ はじめてでも安心
最初のステージでは、指の動きでやり方を教えてくれるチュートリアルつき。
1回のバトルは数分なので、すきま時間にぴったりです。
iPhone と iPad の両方で遊べて、iCloud でデータを引き継げます。

※ 基本プレイ無料（一部、アプリ内課金があります）
※ ガチャの提供割合はゲーム内のガチャ画面で確認できます

name: 危険物乙4 合格ドリル - 乙種第4類
description:
危険物取扱者 乙種第4類（乙4）の試験に向けた学習アプリです。「危険物に関する法令」「基礎的な物理学及び基礎的な化学」「危険物の性質並びにその火災予防及び消火の方法」の3科目、あわせて155問のオリジナル問題を収録しています。本番と同じ五肢択一で、スキマ時間に1問ずつ解けます。

■ 科目別演習
科目を選んで10問ずつ出題。まだ解いていない問題と、前に間違えた問題から先に出します。答えるとすぐに正誤と解説が出て、選択肢ごとに「なぜ違うのか」も分かります。

■ 模擬試験
本番と同じ35問（法令15・物理化学10・性質消火10）・2時間の形式で、タイマー付きで解けます。途中でやめても続きから再開できます。採点後は科目ごとの得点と合否（各科目60%以上で合格）を表示します。

■ 今日の復習
間違えた問題と「自信なし」にした問題を、忘れかけたころにもう一度出します（間隔反復）。

■ 成績・用語集

name: 声慧 - AI 录音、日程与提醒
description:
Voxwise remembers what was said: quick reminders, plans you made, the English you're learning, and your conversations with the people around you. Transcription and analysis need a subscription (free trial).

SAY IT, AND IT'S IN REMINDERS
• Turn on Voice commands and say "Remind me to bring my laptop at 1pm" while recording; it goes into Reminders. No "Hey Siri", no talking into your watch.
• Only your own voice counts; undo any of them in Settings.
• Added once the recording is transcribed (later if the watch uses Standard delivery). Requires an iPhone with Apple Intelligence.

WHAT YOU TALK ABOUT LANDS ON YOUR SCHEDULE
• Times you agree on, promises and follow-ups go into Schedule, next to upcoming calendar events; tap one to jump to the exact line.

YOUR LIFE IS THE BEST ENGLISH TEXTBOOK
• Voxwise finds mistakes in the English you speak, suggests more natural phrasing, and collects slang and new words you hear.
• Each entry keeps the original line; quiz yourself and review a few days later.

UNDERSTAND YOURSELF AND THE PEOPLE AROUND YOU
• See your day with context and health data: Memory puts conversations next to heart rate, sleep and steps. Tap a moment to ask about it.
• Analyses surface recurring patterns, habits you're practicing and replies you're waiting on. Private portraits help you understand who you talk with most.
• Turn on Include places so analysis knows if you were at home, at work or out.

IT REMEMBERS EVERY DETAIL, SO JUST ASK
• Ask about any past conversation in Chat; answers cite the exact words, and you can tap to listen.
• Meeting minutes in one sentence, exported as PDF, Word or PowerPoint; weekly, monthly and yearly reviews.

RECORDING STARTS WITH YOU
• Record on iPhone or Apple Watch, or import audio and video from Files and Photos.
• Recording always starts with you and stays visible, even on the Lock Screen and Dynamic Island.
• Enroll your voice and transcripts mark what you said; others can enroll themselves by reading a few lines.

YOUR PRIVACY
• We don't keep recordings or transcripts: audio is held encrypted until transcription ends (1 day max); results are encrypted so only your phone can open them; deleted within an hour.
• Audio, trimmed of silence on your phone, goes via Voxwise's server to Qwen on Alibaba Cloud (Singapore) for transcription; not used for training, kept until delivered, up to 30 days.
• Text goes to OpenAI (US) for analysis, or to Qwen (Alibaba Cloud, Singapore) if you choose it in Settings. OpenAI doesn't train on it by default and keeps abuse logs up to 30 days.
• You agree before any cloud processing. Places go to AI only if you allow it; health data only when you tap Ask Voxwise. Voiceprints and contacts never go to us or AI providers.
• Exclude any recording from AI, delete anything anytime; lock the app with Face ID.

PLANS
• Free to download, record and play back. Transcription, analysis, Schedule and Chat need Pro or Max.
• New Pro subscribers get a 2-week free trial with a small cloud allowance; whichever runs out first ends cloud use until the trial converts.
• Pro: $9.99/month or $99.90/year, with a monthly cloud allowance shown as a percentage. Max: $19.99/month or $199.99/year, about twice the allowance, plus Thinking in Chat (Max only).
• Credit packs add 20%, 50% or 100% of a Pro month, never expire and need no subscription.
• Invite a friend; once they pay, you each get 5 hours of transcription.
• Own keys? The BYOK service ($3.99/month) uses your OpenAI or Qwen key for analysis and AssemblyAI (US) key for transcription; providers bill you directly.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Voxwise is for recording and reflection. It doesn't diagnose, provide therapy or detect lies.
• Get consent before recording others, and follow local laws.
• Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the period ends; manage or cancel anytime in your App Store account settings.

name: 工程リンク
description:

name: 差不多了
description:
生活里有很多事没有严格的时间表，但隔一阵子就“差不多该做了”：
给猫驱虫、冲洗前置净水器、换牙刷头、清洗洗衣机、给绿植施肥、换床单、清理空调滤网……

「差不多了」不设死板的闹钟，也不催你打卡，而是把时间变成直观的水位——水位越高，颜色从浅绿过渡到暖黄、珊瑚红，一眼就知道哪件事差不多该做了。

【核心功能】
• 水位看进度：用柔和的水位与颜色呈现每件事的时间进度，告别红点焦虑。
• 弹性周期，越用越懂你：支持“准时一点 / 差不多 / 随缘”三档弹性区间，也可以不设周期先记着，记录两次后自动为你估算合理间隔。
• 一键记下，轻松补记：支持首页与桌面小组件一键完成，5 秒内随时撤销；忘记当天记也能随时补记昨天、上周或任意过去日期，忙的时候还可以“再等一周”。
• 季节与暂停：换季用品可按生效月份自动休眠，出差或暂时不做可以随时暂停，恢复后接着之前的天数继续算。
• 家庭共享（会员）：一个人开通会员，全家最多 6 人一起记；谁刚做过一目了然，3 天内重复记录自动提醒，避免家人重复折腾。
• 桌面小组件 & 深浅外观：提供 2×2 单件与 4×2 概览小组件，支持桌面直接打卡；完整适配浅色与深色模式。

name: 数で押す勇者 ハクスラRPG
description:
勇者がずらりと並んでボスに挑む。
『数で押す勇者』は、ゲートをくぐって仲間を増やしながら戦う縦画面のハクスラRPGです。
冒険の楽しみは城下町に戻ってからも続きます。
宝箱から出た剣を手に取ると、今の愛剣より少しだけボスに強い。
そんな一本が見つかったら、さっき負けた相手にもう一度挑んでみよう。

【指一本で勇者の軍勢を指揮】
勇者たちは自動で前進し、目の前の敵と戦います。
道中にゲートが見えたら画面を左右にドラッグ。
通るゲートによって仲間が増えたり、攻撃力や防御力が上がったりします。

ボスを前にして左は増援、右は回復。
まだ余裕があるなら人数を増やして一気に攻めよう。
連戦で消耗していたら回復が頼りになります。
同じステージでも出撃するたびにゲートの組み合わせが変わるので、前回とは違った攻略を楽しめます。

【剣士・弓兵・魔法使いを使い分けよう】
最初に選べる剣士は攻守のバランスに優れた職業です。
1面クリアで集団戦が得意な弓兵、2面クリアでボスに強い魔法使いが仲間入り。
道中で押し切られるなら弓兵を、ボスのHPを削り切れないなら魔法使いを試してみよう。

戦闘でゲージが満ちたらタップで必殺技を発動！
剣士は「虹光連斬」で斬り込み、弓兵は「虹光連射」で矢を放ちます。
魔法使いの切り札は「虹星魔弾」。
ここぞという場面は自分の一撃で決められます。

【全50種の武器から愛用の一本を探そう】
敵のドロップや宝箱から手に入る武器は剣20種、弓15種、杖15種。
同じ剣でも「砂漠のシミター」は手数で攻めたいときに、「東雲の刀」はボスに挑むときに役立ちます。
武器のほかにも守りを固める鎧や攻撃速度を上げる指輪が登場。
大軍で出発したいときは初期人数が増える軍旗の出番です。

装備のレアリティはコモンからレジェンドまでの4段階。
エピックには1つ、レジェンドには2つの追加効果が付きます。
同じ名前の武器を拾っても片方はボス特効付き、もう片方はコイン稼ぎ向きということも。
次の冒険で何をしたいか考えながら装備を厳選できます。

【鍛冶屋と訓練場で次の冒険に備えよう】
城下町の鍛冶屋では装備を最大＋99まで強化できます。
気に入った装備は保護しておけば安心。
使わない装備はまとめて分解し、素材とコインを愛用品の強化に回せます。
拾った装備が多くて迷ったときは「おすすめ」で選ぶこともできます。

訓練場で鍛えられるのは全8項目。
最初から大勢で出発したいなら「初期勇者数」
道中でどんどん仲間を増やしたいなら「加算ゲート性能」を伸ばそう。
ほかにも
・攻撃力
・攻撃速度
・勇者数
・HP
・被ダメージ軽減
＿ボス特効
・コイン獲得量
を鍛えられます。

大型ボスからまれに「覚醒石」が手に入ったら城下町の祭壇へ
覚醒を重ねるたびに攻撃力と勇者HPが上がり、次の冒険で獲得できるコインも増えていきます。

【全30ステージを越えてエンドレスモードへ】
旅の始まりは王都領の「草原の砦」。
北方雪原を抜けた先には火山地帯の「火口の黒城」が待っています。
各ステージは300m。道中で仲間を増やし、最後に待ち構える大型ボスを倒せば次の面が開きます。

全30ステージをクリアするとエンドレス連戦が解放されます。
育て上げた軍勢と選び抜いた装備で、前回たどり着けなかった距離を目指そう。

【王都図書館で冒険の図鑑を完成させよう】
図鑑に記録できるのは通常の敵100種、大型ボス30種、武器50種。
倒した魔物や手に入れた武器を王都図書館で振り返れます。
まだ名前が「？？？」のボスを探しに行くか、武器図鑑に足りない最後の一本を狙うか。
ステージを踏破したあとも収集の楽しみが残っています。

name: 普通免許 学科ドリル 仮免・本免
description:
普通自動車免許の学科試験に向けた、○×式の問題演習アプリです。仮免許（50問）と本免許（文章問題90問）をボタンひとつで切り替えられます。

■ 分野別演習
信号・標識・標示／通行方法・速度／交差点・歩行者・踏切／駐停車・合図・灯火／運転者の心得・免許／高速道路・危険な場面 の6分野。答えるとすぐに正誤と解説が出ます。×の問題は「どこが誤りで、正しくはどうか」まで解説します。

■ 模擬試験
仮免は50問・30分、本免は文章問題90問・50分のタイマー付き。途中でやめても続きから再開でき、採点後は分野ごとの得点と合否の目安（90%以上）を表示します。

■ 今日の復習
間違えた問題と「自信なし」にした問題を、忘れかけたころにもう一度出します（間隔反復）。

■ 成績・用語集
分野ごとの正答率と模試の記録を確認できます。解説の中の用語（徐行・路側帯など）をタップすると、用語集の説明に飛べます。

■ 広告について
画面下に小さなバナー広告が出ます。設定から短い動画広告を見ると、24時間広告を消せます。

■ ご注意
・問題と解説はすべてオリジナルです。過去問や市販の問題集の問題は収録していません。根拠にした法令（e-Gov 法令検索の道路交通法・同施行令など）を各問題の解説の下に表示しています。
・本番の本免学科試験にあるイラスト問題（危険予測）は収録していません。
・法令の改正に合わせて問題を見直していますが、最新の情報は都道府県警察・運転免許試験場の案内で確かめてください。
・本アプリは警察庁・都道府県警察・運転免許試験場・自動車教習所とは関係のない非公式アプリです。

name: 有机农业app
description: 这是一款苹果及相关农产品提供在线选购服务的应用。用户可在商城浏览品牌店铺、商品活动和优惠信息，通过分类页按红富士、嘎啦果、秦冠、黄元帅、冰糖心、苹果礼盒等类型快速查找商品，并将心仪商品加入购物车结算。应用还支持个人中心管理订单、收藏、关注、足迹、优惠券、地址、发票和客服等事项，方便用户完成从浏览、选购到订单管理的日常使用流程。

name: 栗栗送到啦
description:
别急，好心情正在飘过来。

栗栗是一只戴着邮差帽的小刺猬，它正带着礼物出发。轻点屏幕发射小刺，扎破气球，让包裹落进邮车，把一份份心意送给森林里的朋友。

【一根手指，掌握投递时机】
观察气球、邮车和风向，再轻轻出手。邮车会移动，风会改变包裹的落点；瞄准时机，才能稳稳送达。

【八站邮路，各有小挑战】
从风铃小径到森林庆典，沿途遇见泡泡罩、探头的虫虫、路过的蜜蜂和爱打盹的猫头鹰。先看清提示，学会等待，再继续配送。

【收集属于栗栗的小纪念】
完成关卡获得星星，通过打卡和成就解锁不同形象。选择喜欢的装扮，生成纪念卡，自愿保存到相册，或通过系统分享给朋友。

【按自己的节奏游玩】
不设倒计时，可以随时暂停，失败后也能重新出发。无需注册账号，核心游戏可离线游玩，当前版本不含广告和内购。

游戏进度与设置保存在本机，不提供云端存档。仅在主动保存纪念卡时申请添加照片权限，不读取已有照片；拒绝权限不影响正常游玩。

戴好邮差帽，陪栗栗出发，送好心情。

name: 榫卯缝
description:
榫卯缝给做家具的人：沿榫肩拖出这一条缝有多宽，当场对照本榫的目标缝，看出偏紧还是偏松，并标出是否可胶合。松手写入；下次打开同一根榫，先见到上次那条缝。

样本：柜门中挺目标缝 0.20 mm，当前拖出 0.35 mm，偏松 0.15 mm，未可胶合。抽屉侧板 0.12 mm 对照 0.15 mm，落在可胶合范围。

缝宽、目标和写入记录只保存在这台设备上。不代替师傅判断结构是否牢靠。

name: 殲滅防衛線 ― HORDE BREAKER
description:
押し寄せる数千の大群を、砲台・技・仲間でまとめて吹き飛ばせ。

光るマスに砲台を建て、強化して覚醒させる。メテオで密集した敵をいっきに殲滅。建てるほど砦は進化し、新しい兵器が火を噴く。

【あそびかた】
・マスをタップして砲台を建てる
・砲台をタップで強化（Lv5で覚醒）
・技（メテオなど）で大群を吹き飛ばす
・ゴールドで基礎強化・技・仲間をそろえる
・10ステージのあとは「無限殲滅モード」

【アプリ版だけ】
・通信なしで遊べます
・戦いのあと、動画でゴールド2倍

家族で作っている「OKA games」のゲームです。

name: 水深之處福音網
description:
「把船開到水深之處，下網打魚。」（路加福音 5:4）

水深之處是 luke54.org 的官方 App，把網站上的福音文章、見證、靈修與 Podcast 帶到你的 iPhone 與 iPad，讓你在通勤、睡前或任何安靜的片刻，都能停下來讀一段文字、聽一集節目、默想一節經文。

【每日經文】
首頁每天一節經文，也可以把「今日經文」小工具放在主畫面。

【好讀的文章】
‧ 依分類瀏覽最新文章：信仰生活、親子家庭、婚姻、見證、靈修……
‧ 專為閱讀設計的排版，可調整字級與深淺色主題
‧ 經文引用、圖片與影片清楚呈現
‧ 文章結尾推薦相關文章

【Podcast】
‧ 收聽水深之處的 Podcast 節目
‧ 背景播放、鎖定畫面與控制中心操作、動態島與即時動態
‧ 0.75～2 倍速、睡眠計時器、記住上次聽到的位置

【離線閱讀與書籤】
‧ 下載文章，沒有網路也能讀
‧ 登入後書籤會在不同裝置間同步

【搜尋】
用關鍵字快速找到文章與節目。

【帳號】
不登入也能閱讀與收聽。需要同步書籤時，可使用「透過 Apple 登入」、Google、LINE 或電子郵件登入；也可以隨時在 App 內刪除帳號。

有任何建議或問題，歡迎到 https://www.luke54.org/support 與我們聯絡。

name: 漆膜道
description: 给喷漆房用的干膜道数估算。拨湿膜目标、喷枪流量和这一道走速，当场看到这一道预估干膜、还要几道、本件已喷几道。点「这道完成」后道数加一，膜厚累加到本件。样本从目标干膜 80 微米、已喷 1 道约 35 微米开始。数字留在这台设备上，不需要账号。车间估算，不是涂层合格证明。

name: 漢字ドリル - 級別4択で毎日練習
description:
漢字の読み・書き取り・部首と画数・四字熟語や対義語・送りがなを、4択でサクサク練習できる漢字ドリルです。

■ 3つのレベル
・5級レベル（小学校で習う漢字）
・4級・3級レベル（中学校で習う漢字）
・準2級・2級レベル（常用漢字すべて）
級は漢字検定の級を目安にした区分です。レベルはいつでも切り替えられます。

■ 分野別演習
5つの分野から選んで出題。まだ解いていない問題と、前に間違えた問題から先に出します。答えるとすぐに正誤と解説が出て、選択肢ごとに「なぜ違うのか」も分かります。

■ 模擬テスト
5分野から30問・20分のテスト。7割（21問）正解で合格の目安です。途中でやめても続きから再開できます。

■ 今日の復習
間違えた問題と「自信なし」にした問題を、忘れかけたころにもう一度出します（間隔反復）。

■ 成績・用語集
分野ごとの正答率、テストの記録、連続学習日数を確認できます。解説の「音読み」「へん」「つくり」などの用語をタップすると、用語集の説明に飛べます。

■ 広告について
画面下に広告が出ます。短い動画広告を最後まで見ると、24時間広告が出なくなります。

■ ご注意
・問題と例文はすべてオリジナルです。漢字の範囲は文部科学省「学年別漢字配当表」と文化庁「常用漢字表」によります。
・本アプリは漢字検定の実施団体とは関係のない非公式アプリです。実際の検定の出題範囲・形式とは異なります。
・「おすすめ教材」には Amazon アソシエイトのリンクを含みます。

name: 计算小助手 - 自行车传动齿轮计算
description: 这是一款有关自行车齿轮计算的工具，其中包括六项独立计算、动态齿比矩阵和参数对比。通过清晰的单位、公式与边界说明，让每个结果都可复核。

name: 語彙力チェッカー
description:
知っている言葉と、言葉の意味の25問で、あなたの推定語彙量を出すアプリです。所要時間は約3分です。

▶ 診断の流れ

ステップ1「知っている言葉をタップ」
画面に並んだ40語から、意味を説明できる言葉だけをタップします。この結果から、あなたにちょうどいい難しさを決めます。

ステップ2「意味を選ぶ」
言葉の意味として正しいものを、4つの中から選びます。全25問。その場で正解は出ないので、最後まで落ち着いて答えられます。前の問題に戻って選び直すこともできます。

結果
「およそ35,840語」のように推定語彙量を出し、「中3〜高2レベル」のように学年の目安を表示します。間違えた言葉は、読みと正しい意味を一覧で確認できます。

▶ 主な機能
・小学生レベルから「博識」まで、12段階・384語の問題
・問題ごとに「みんなの正解率」を表示（回答が30件集まった言葉から）
・結果をシェアカード画像で共有
・これまでの結果を履歴で見返せる
・アカウント登録・ログイン不要

▶ 安心して使える設計
・回答の正誤は、みんなの正解率を出すためだけに匿名で送ります。名前やメールアドレスは送りません
・送った回答の記録は、設定からいつでも消せます
・匿名の利用統計は設定でオフにできます
・無料で使えます（画面下部に広告を表示します）。アプリ内課金はありません

推定語彙量は、このアプリの問題から出した目安です。友達や家族と結果を見せ合って、ことばの力を確かめてみてください。

name: 轻松点击益智游戏 - 节奏方格匹配游戏
description:
1.选碎片, 点击下方队列，选择你想放入的碎片。先数格子，再找拐角与长边。
    2.找位置, 点击网格中形状相同的空缺。区域高亮后，确认轮廓和朝向一致。
    3.踩拍锁定, 光点进入两端的绿色区域时，点击「踩点锁定」。全部正确碎片拼入即可通关。

name: 量盛研-Max
description:
This is a tool designed for recording and analyzing repeated measurements. When you measure the same object multiple times, the app organizes your data, calculates variations, determines pass/fail status based on your specified reference values ​​and tolerances, and generates shareable local reports.

Key Features:

1. Project Management: Organize measurement objects by project, including details like units, tools used, operators, and locations. Features include search, filtering (in-progress/completed), as well as options to duplicate, archive, or delete projects.

2. Flexible Data Entry: Supports decimals and negative numbers for individual entries; you can also batch-import multiple values ​​by pasting them at once. Past records can be edited or deleted, with statistics updating automatically upon any changes.

3. Statistics & Analysis: Automatically calculates sample size, mean, minimum/maximum values, range, median, sample standard deviation, and variance. By setting a reference value (T), the app displays mean deviation and relative error; by defining specification limits, it tracks pass/fail counts and the overall pass rate. Includes trend line charts and distribution histograms.

4. Report Export: Generate PDF reports or CSV spreadsheets directly on your device. Use the system’s sharing function to save files locally or send them to colleagues. Reports are based exclusively on the calculation results derived from your input data.

Ideal for:
* Student Experiments: Recording multiple readings to analyze the mean, range, and standard deviation.
* Factory Quality Control: Creating projects by part number and verifying compliance against specification limits.
* Machining & Craftsmanship: Repeatedly checking dimensions (such as shaft diameters), temperatures, or weights, with the ability to add or correct entries at any time.

name: 墨痕录
description:
墨痕录是一本以素描为核心的离线材料图鉴。它用来查阅绘画材料、工具、纸张和技法，也用来比较它们的差别、记下自己的研究。

图鉴收录 21 种材料、14 种工具、13 种纸张和 20 种技法，另有 20 篇材料研究。石墨铅笔、石墨棒、木炭、彩铅、色粉、墨水和常见绘画媒介都有单独档案，内容包括材料特点、视觉表现、适用场景、保存方式和参考来源。

你可以顺着材料、工具、纸张和技法之间的关系继续看，也可以查看材料与纸张的适用说明。这些说明是使用判断，不是实验室评分。比较只在同一类别中进行，并标出相同与不同。

收藏、笔记和自定义专题都保存在这台设备上。笔记可以分类，专题可以调整条目顺序。个人数据可以导出为 JSON，也能合并导入或完整恢复。应用不需要注册，不联网，也不会上传笔记。

图中的硬度与步骤样本是示意图，用来说明方向，不是某个品牌的实测

name: 16 Types: Personality Test
description:
What kind of person am I? Know yourself in 3 minutes.

This personality test keeps every question, the scoring and all the type descriptions inside the app. Your answers are scored on your phone with a fixed formula, so the same answers always give the same result. No account, no sign-in: just start.

■ Pick a length that fits your time
• Quick: 24 questions, about 3 min (a rough look)
• Standard: 48 questions, about 6 min (a closer look)
• In depth: 96 questions, about 12 min (with detailed traits)
One question per screen, five answers to choose from. Leave whenever you like: your answers are saved and you can pick up where you left off. Every question was written for this app, and each of the four scales has the same number of statements pointing each way, so a habit of always agreeing doesn't tilt your result.

■ Results you can read in numbers
See your four letters, a nickname written for this app, and a bar for each scale with the numbers on both sides. When a scale is nearly even, the app tells you: "These two are close." You also get a three-line summary, the types you get along with, and how many people in 100 share your type (a reference figure). Finish the 96-question test to see three detailed traits on every scale.

■ All 16 types, explained
Strengths, things to watch out for, work that fits and how each type is with people, written from scratch for every type. Browse all 16 whenever you like.

■ Matches and friend links
Each of the 136 type pairs has its own one-line description and score, plus what works well and where you may clash. Send a friend a match link: once they finish the test, they'll see how you two match. Types from links you receive are collected in My people.

■ Share cards
Share your result as a classic card, a story card or a card with the numbers hidden, or save it to Photos.

■ Today's note and paw stamps
Every day, a little white cat brings a one-line note for your type, from 60 notes per type. Opening it leaves a paw stamp, and every 7 stamps unlock a new cat pose (9 in all). If you like, get a daily reminder at a time you choose.

■ More to try
• Two mini tests: How I love and How I work (8 questions each)
• Quote cards: 12 things your type often says

■ My history
Take the test more than once and see patterns like "INFP 2 of 3 times". Tests of different lengths count together.

■ Easy on the eyes
Dark theme, an option to keep the cat still, and 11 languages.

[Privacy]
Your results and history stay on your device. To help improve the test, answers and results can be sent without your name. You can turn this off before you start or in Settings.

[Please note]
This test is for fun and self-reflection. It is not a medical or psychological diagnosis. The "in 100 people" figures are reference values. Contains ads.

name: 2 Player Games: Offline Travel
description:
Two people, one phone, and a game to share. Pass the phone across the table, tap to move, and play the classics you grew up with, with no ads, no tracking and no account. Everything works offline.

PICK A GAME, PLAY
Board games, card games, dice games, pencil and paper games and quick duels where each of you has your own half of the screen. Every game has a short how-to-play with a small board you can try, in plain words.

ONE PHONE, TWO PLAYERS
Player 2 gets their own bar on the far side of the table, so nobody has to turn the phone around. Games with hidden cards and secret choices hide them behind a pass screen. Undo a move when you both agree.

OR PLAY THE COMPUTER
No one to play with? Pick Easy, Medium or Hard and play against the computer in almost every game.

PLAY A CUP

name: Aervelle
description:

Aervelle is a professional flute inspection and maintenance workspace designed for flute technicians, music educators, and instrument enthusiasts.

From mapping key mechanisms and recording pad seal conditions to inspecting mechanical linkages and tracking repairs, Aervelle brings essential flute maintenance tools together in one intuitive iOS app.

### Interactive Key & Pad Mapping

Explore flute key mechanisms through an interactive instrument diagram. Organize key positions, manage pad specifications, and maintain detailed component records.

### Pad Seal Inspection

Record pad seal observations for individual keys, document contact issues, and track inspection results. Compare previous checks and identify areas that need further attention.

### Mechanical Linkage Analysis

Visualize relationships between connected keys and record their expected and observed responses. Identify mechanical inconsistencies and organize follow-up inspections.

### Repair & Adjustment Tracking

Create repair tasks, document adjustments, record replacement parts, and track maintenance progress. Connect repair activities with specific keys and inspection findings.

### Inspection History & Reports

Keep a searchable history of inspections, mechanical issues, repairs, and retests. Compare before-and-after conditions and export detailed maintenance reports.

### Key Features

- Interactive flute key and pad diagrams
- Key identification and component records
- Pad seal inspection tracking
- Pad contact area annotations
- Mechanical linkage visualization
- Key response comparison
- Repair and adjustment records
- Replacement part tracking
- Post-repair inspection comparisons
- Maintenance history and PDF export
- Offline functionality and local data storage

### Built for Flute Care

Aervelle combines detailed instrument mapping, practical inspection tools, and organized maintenance records in one focused workspace.

Whether you're documenting routine inspections, reviewing key mechanisms, or tracking adjustments, Aervelle helps keep every detail organized and traceable.

Inspection results are based on user-recorded observations. Aervelle does not automatically detect leaks or diagnose mechanical faults.

**Map the mechanism. Track the details. Preserve every adjustment.**

name: Aquilens
description:
Aquilens is a calm, lab-styled water log for your home. Type in what you measured, estimate from shower minutes or loads of laundry, or copy the number off your water meter — Aquilens turns it into a clear picture of where your water goes and helps you use a little less.

Styled like a clean lab instrument — frosted glass over graph paper, a liquid-fill gauge, thin chart axes — Aquilens keeps water use honest. It never connects to a water meter or smart device: every figure comes from what you enter, and estimates are always marked "≈".

THREE WAYS TO RECORD WATER
• Volume: litres or US gallons, with an optional category.
• Estimate: pick a category, enter minutes or a number of uses, and see a live "≈ 72 L" preview from the category's flow rate. The rate is stored with the entry, so editing a category later never rewrites history.
• Meter reading: type the register value in m³, litres, US gallons or ft³. Aquilens shows the previous reading and the use worked out between them, and catches readings that are lower than an earlier one.

TODAY AT A GLANCE
• A large liquid-fill gauge with a gentle wave shows today's use against your daily goal, and turns coral when you go over.
• Litres left today, your 7-day average and use per person in your household.
• Quick-add tiles, today's entries, a breakdown by category and your latest meter reading.
• When meter readings cover a day, the meter figure is used as that day's total and spread evenly between readings; any gap shows as "Not itemised".

TRENDS
• Weekly and monthly views: the last 7 or 30 full days against the period before, compared per recorded day.
• Daily bars with a dashed goal line; days based on estimates are drawn pale and dashed.
• A 90-day trend line, weekly totals or monthly averages, and "Where it goes" category shares.

GOALS
• Daily, weekly and per-category limits, each with a graduated progress bar, "left" or "over by" text and a 7-day record of days kept.
• A suggestion card works out a 10% cut from your 30-day average.

CONSERVATION CHALLENGES
• Six ready-made challenges — 4-minute showers, Tap off while brushing, Full loads only, Watering can garden, Rinse in a bowl, Drip patrol — or create your own.
• Check in each day with one button, see your streak, progress and an estimated saving, and correct past days if you forget.

CATEGORIES & HISTORY
• Categories with their own drawn symbols and colours, estimating by minutes × flow, uses × litres or plain volume, with typical rates as a guide.
• A full history grouped by day, filtered by volume, estimate or meter entries; tap any entry to edit or delete it.

REPORTS
• Share an A4 PDF report (summary, daily chart with goal line, comparisons, categories, goals, challenges and daily totals) or a CSV of every entry, for the last 7, 30 or 90 days or all time.
• Reports are created on your iPhone and only leave it when you share them.
• Litres or US gallons, switchable at any time without changing your data.

WORKS OFFLINE, BACKED UP PRIVATELY
• No account, no sign-in — Aquilens opens straight onto Today.
• Everything is saved on your iPhone first and works without a connection.
• Your records are backed up automatically to a private cloud space that belongs only to this install of the app; changes made offline are sent when you're back online. A small sample vial in the header shows the backup status.
• Settings → "Delete all my data" removes everything from your iPhone and from the cloud backup.
• Want to look around first? Settings → "Load sample data" adds five weeks of readings from a fictional two-person flat that you can remove again in one tap.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No ads, no analytics and no tracking.
• No permissions needed — no camera, photos, location or notifications.

Aquilens is a personal record-keeping tool. Estimates and challenge savings are approximate, and Aquilens does not read, verify or replace your water meter or your utility bill.

relationships — how you reach for closeness, where your boundaries hold, what

• Attachment Style — how you reach for closeness, or protect yourself from it

WITH FULL ACCESS

• A conversation guide for comparing maps with a partner
One-time purchase. No subscription.

browser, then send a reply link back. The answers travel inside the link you
choose to share — never through a server.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN

you are struggling, please reach out to a professional or a local crisis line.

Know the pattern underneath.

An hourly timeline of the last 48 hours and the days ahead, with larger rises and falls shaded. Pressure values come from Apple Weather.

ONE-TAP LOGGING
Tap once when an episode starts and again when it ends. Add the symptom and the severity if you like. Episodes can last several days. Log from the app or from the widget.

HEADS-UPS THAT EXPLAIN THEMSELVES (BAROMIND PRO)
Get a notification about 12 hours before a larger change. Each one says what is expected and why, and how many of your records it is based on. At most two a day.

A PATTERN THAT IS YOURS (BAROMIND PRO)
After three weeks and eight episodes, Baromind can use the change your episodes follow most often for shading and notifications, instead of the standard thresholds. The full report shows every combination it compared. Forecast Accuracy shows how past heads-ups turned out.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account. No server. Your episodes stay on your iPhone. Only a location rounded to about 6 miles is sent to Apple Weather to look up the pressure. Encrypted export and import move your data to a new iPhone.

For migraine, headache, joint pain, sinus pressure and dizziness.

Baromind helps you track patterns. It is not medical advice. Talk to a doctor about your symptoms.

Baromind Pro is available as a yearly subscription with a 7-day free trial, or as a monthly subscription. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel in your Apple Account settings.

name: BeaconSIP
description:
BeaconSIP is a work phone for disaster response, emergency preparedness and volunteer teams, and for anyone who needs a SIP softphone. Put your team's phone extension on your iPhone: make and receive calls on your work number, check voicemail, and see at a glance whether your extension is online.

Features:
• Calls on your team extension over Wi-Fi or mobile data
• Incoming calls ring like regular phone calls, even when BeaconSIP is closed (CallKit and VoIP push)
• Voicemail: listen, change playback speed, read transcripts, call back, delete, and record your own greeting
• Phonebook: your organization's directory, grouped by team and location
• Sign in with a link from your administrator or with your work email; no passwords to type
• Add your own SIP accounts from other providers
• Your extension and its status at the top of every screen
• Phone health: check the microphone, notifications and connection, and place a test call
• Emergency numbers (such as 911) always open your iPhone's own dialer, so emergency calls use your mobile carrier and location services
• Audio only; dark design built for quick use in the field

Calls to hand-added SIP accounts ring only while BeaconSIP is open; only an organization line set up for BeaconSIP can wake the app for incoming calls.

BeaconSIP is made by Beacon Mid-Atlantic. Organization features (sign-in, phonebook, voicemail) need an account from an organization that uses Beacon Mid-Atlantic phone service. Support: info@beaconma.org

name: Beat Crew
description:
キャラクターに音をわたすだけで、みんなが歌い出す！
ビート・ベース・メロディ・和音・効果音を重ねて、自分だけの曲をつくれる、家族みんなで楽しめる音楽アプリです。

【あそぶ】
・ドラッグするだけのかんたん操作。7 体のキャラに、好きな音をのせよう
・ポップ・ロボット・森の 3 つの音のパターン
・テンポ・キー・コード進行を変えて、曲の雰囲気が変わるのを聴き比べられます
・「おまかせメロディ」が、コードに合うメロディを自動でつくります
・ちょっと怖い「ホラーモード」では、曲が短調に変わり、見た目も不気味に変身（自分で選んだときだけ）

【まなぶ】
・リズム・パートのやくわり・キー・和音・コード進行のしくみを、案内と読み上げで、遊びながら学べます（ひらがな中心で、小さな子でも読めます）

【ご案内】
・広告つきの無料アプリです。一部の機能（ロボット・森・ホラーモード・一部のコード進行・おまかせメロディ）は、広告を見ると使えます。
・個人情報は集めません。広告は、個人に合わせないものだけを表示します。

name: Beep Beep Hills
description:
Beep Beep Hills is a gentle driving game made for little hands.

Press GAS to go and STOP to slow down. Drive over rolling hills, collect sparkly diamonds, smash crates, bounce balls and stop to pick up friendly animals waiting along the road. Bring everyone to the picnic at the end for a party with balloons and hearts!

• Big, simple GAS and STOP pedals, easy for small children
• No losing, no timers, nothing scary
• 10 cars, each with its own world, horn and engine sound
• Real kids' voices, happy music and lots of cheering
• No ads, no tracking, no accounts

Three cars are free to play. A one-time purchase, behind a grown-ups-only check, unlocks all ten.

name: beTool MyApp
description:
beTool CRM sur votre iPhone et votre iPad : retrouvez vos clients, vos dossiers et vos tâches où que vous soyez, et mettez-les à jour sur le terrain.

L'application est réservée aux utilisateurs des organisations clientes de beTool : connectez-vous avec le compte professionnel que vous a donné l'administrateur de votre organisation.

VOS FICHES, PARTOUT
• Vos vues beTool CRM telles que votre organisation les a configurées : clients, interventions, factures, projets…
• Recherche instantanée par nom, e-mail ou téléphone, filtres et tris en un geste
• Affichage en liste, tableau, colonnes (kanban), calendrier, galerie ou carte
• Tableaux de bord : chiffres clés, répartitions et croisements
• Sur iPad : la liste et la fiche côte à côte

SUR LE TERRAIN
• Appelez, écrivez un e-mail ou ouvrez une adresse directement depuis la fiche
• Créez et modifiez des fiches, avec enregistrement automatique
• Joignez des photos prises sur place et des documents
• Dictée vocale pour remplir un champ sans taper
• Mode hors connexion : vos données restent consultables et vos modifications partent dès le retour du réseau

TOUJOURS INFORMÉ
• Notifications des événements de votre compte : affectations, relances, changements de statut…
• Historique complet de chaque fiche : qui a changé quoi, et quand

SÉCURITÉ
• Connexion par votre identité beTool, sans mot de passe enregistré dans l'application
• Données locales chiffrées et effacées à la déconnexion
• Verrouillage par Face ID ou Touch ID
• Aucune publicité, aucun traceur

POUR LES ADMINISTRATEURS
• Gérez les membres, groupes, rôles et accès de votre organisation depuis votre iPhone ou votre iPad

Une question ? contact@betool.fr

name: BezierDock
description:
Build a path from cubic Bezier segments and inspect its geometry before exporting a reproducible vector and sampled-coordinate record.

• Edit explicit cubic control points and keep multiple ordered segments in a saved path.
• Preview the curve and control geometry with a fitted canvas.
• Inspect positions, derivatives, tangent availability and exact axis-aligned bounds.
• Sample a chosen interval count, close a path with an explicit straight segment, or create a translated and uniformly scaled copy.
• Generate real SVG, sampled CSV and PDF outputs as a frozen export asset.

BezierDock works with explicit bounded cubic geometry. It is not a general CAD editor or automatic image tracing service. A sampled polyline length is an approximation; PDF diagrams fit the page and are not a physical scale drawing.

Your saved work stays in this app’s local library. Use the system sharing controls when you choose to export a file. System backups may include app data.

name: Bibéo : Suivi Bébé & Tétées
description:
Bibéo est le carnet de votre bébé, pensé pour la nuit : tétées, biberons, sommeil et couches se notent d'une main, en deux gestes. Sans compte, sans publicité, et le journal reste sur votre iPhone.

DEUX GESTES, MÊME À 3 H DU MATIN
De gros boutons sur l'accueil : Tétée, Biberon, Tire-lait, Sommeil, Couche. Un geste ouvre la feuille, un geste enregistre. Un mode sombre automatique s'active de 22 h à 6 h.

LE CHRONO DE LA TÉTÉE
Touchez gauche ou droit : le chrono démarre. Changez de côté, mettez en pause, terminez. Chaque côté est compté à part, et Bibéo se souvient du côté suivant, à tour de rôle. Le chrono continue même si l'app est fermée.

BIBERON ET TIRE-LAIT
« Comme le dernier » en un geste, ou la quantité au millilitre près. Lait maternel ou lait infantile.

SOMMEIL ET COUCHES
Un chrono de sommeil avec pause, ou un dodo passé noté après coup. Pour une couche : pipi, selles ou les deux, un geste enregistre.

UN OUBLI ? L'HEURE SE CORRIGE
« −10 min », « −20 min », « −1 h » ou l'heure exacte : la saisie de la nuit se rattrape au réveil. Tout se modifie et se supprime.

« DEPUIS QUAND ? »
L'accueil affiche le dernier repas, le dernier change et le sommeil en cours, avec le total de la journée.

JOURNAL ET RÉSUMÉ
Tout l'historique, jour par jour, sans limite. Le résumé donne la journée et la moyenne des sept derniers jours, calculées à partir de vos seules saisies.

RAPPEL DU PROCHAIN REPAS
Un rappel compté depuis le dernier repas noté, au délai que vous choisissez.

MESURES
Poids, taille et périmètre crânien, listés par date, comme dans le carnet de santé.

PRIVÉ PAR NATURE
Pas de compte à créer, aucune publicité. Ce que vous notez sur votre enfant ne quitte pas votre iPhone : ni prénom, ni heure, ni quantité, ni mesure, ni note. L'app envoie seulement des compteurs anonymes de fonctionnement (nombre de saisies, écrans ouverts), que vous pouvez désactiver dans les Réglages. Le journal n'est pas synchronisé avec un autre appareil : si vous supprimez l'app, il est effacé.

GRATUIT, POUR DE BON
Toutes les saisies sont gratuites, sans limite de nombre ni de durée, avec tout l'historique. Aucune saisie n'ouvre l'écran d'abonnement.

—

Bibéo Premium ajoute : le rapport PDF à montrer au pédiatre (7 ou 30 jours, un jour par ligne), plusieurs enfants (jumeaux, fratrie), un rappel quotidien à votre façon et tous les thèmes de couleur.

Abonnement : 3,99 € par mois ou 24,99 € par an (tarifs indicatifs France, le prix exact s'affiche dans l'app). L'abonnement annuel commence par 7 jours d'essai gratuit pour les nouveaux abonnés, puis se renouvelle automatiquement au tarif indiqué, sauf résiliation au moins 24 h avant la fin de la période en cours. Le paiement est prélevé sur votre compte Apple. Vous gérez ou résiliez l'abonnement dans les réglages de votre compte App Store. Le partage familial est activé.

Conditions d'utilisation : https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Confidentialité : https://bibeo.babapp.fr/privacy/

Bibéo est un carnet de suivi. Ce n'est pas un dispositif médical et il ne remplace pas l'avis d'un professionnel de santé.

name: BipeChat: chat e campainha
description:
BipeChat é um aplicativo brasileiro de mensagens. Você entra com o número do celular e um código que chega por SMS, sem senha para lembrar.

CONVERSAS
• Mensagens com pessoas e com grupos
• Fotos, áudios e arquivos
• Ligações de voz e de vídeo
• Canais para avisar muita gente de uma vez

CAMPAINHA POR QR CODE
Cole o adesivo com QR Code na porta, no portão ou no interfone. Quem chega aponta a câmera do celular para o QR e toca a campainha, sem instalar nada. O BipeChat te avisa, você vê a foto de quem está na porta e só então escolhe: atender com vídeo, atender só com voz ou responder com uma mensagem rápida, como "Já vou!" ou "Deixe na portaria".
• Casa ou condomínio: no condomínio, um QR só na entrada, com a lista dos apartamentos
• Botões para chamar a portaria e para entregador
• Todos da casa podem atender
• Quem tocou fica no histórico, com foto
• Se ninguém atender, a pessoa deixa um recado
• O adesivo estragou ou sumiu? Desative pelo app e ative outro

PARA QUEM ATENDE CLIENTES
• Etiquetas para organizar as conversas
• Respostas rápidas para o que você escreve todo dia
• Pix na conversa: mande a sua chave ou o código copia e cola

SEGURANÇA
• Entrada pelo código do SMS, sem senha
• Bloqueie e denuncie quem incomoda
• Apague a sua conta pelo próprio app, quando quiser

Feito no Brasil.

name: Black Hole Run: Tap Fast
description:
A tapping game where you run around a black hole and try not to get pulled in.

■ Tap to hold on
Tap anywhere on the screen and your astronaut pushes outward. Stop tapping and you slowly slide in. The pull keeps getting stronger, so you have to tap faster and faster. The outer edge is a wall, so you can't fly off.

■ The closer, the more points
Points = distance run × how close you are. The red ring next to the black hole is ×3, orange is ×2, blue is ×1. Get closer for more points, but it is easier to get pulled in. How close dare you go?

■ Pulled in...
Your body stretches long and slips into the dark. A ring of light bursts, and the run is over. Very rarely, something comes back out...

■ Moments to breathe
Rocks, tiny satellites and pieces of spaceships drift past you and fall in. When the black hole pulses with a pale blue glow, the pull gets weaker for 2 seconds. If a golden asteroid falls in, you get 10 coins.

■ Unlock with coins
Earn coins by playing. You can also get them by watching ads.
- Characters: red suit, space dog, robot, alien, captain in a gold suit, and at the top: penguin, chicken, little dino, running toilet
- Stages: ice, neon, gold

■ Leaderboards and achievements
Compare your best score and your total taps on Game Center. 12 achievements. Share your results and rare moments.

name: Blufield Ops
description:
Blufield Ops is the field-operations app from Outbox for supervisors and field teams.

LIVE TEAM MAP
• See every field agent on one map, with live status: active, idle or offline
• Tap an agent to see their recent activity and contact them
• Filter by project, workflow, region and time window

TASKS
• Browse all task submissions with status, region and timestamps
• Open any task to see its full details and location
• Navigate straight to a task with your maps app

QUALITY AUDITS
• Run QC checklists against completed tasks
• Attach photos as evidence
• Review audit results across your team

BUILT FOR THE FIELD
• Light and dark mode
• Works on iPhone and iPad
• Location is used only while the app is open

GETTING ACCESS
Blufield Ops is used by Outbox and its partner organisations. New teams can request access from the Sign up link on the login screen, and our team will contact you to set up your account.

name: Bootstrap Finnish Grammar
description:
Why do koulussa, koulusta and kouluun all start with the word for school? The ending tells you whether someone is at school, coming from school or going to school. Bootstrap Finnish Grammar helps you hear and practise changes like these, one short lesson at a time.

Start with minä olen (“I am”) and sinä olet (“you are”). Learn to ask questions, talk about places and time, and say what you want or need. As you progress, you’ll meet the partitive, consonant gradation, past tenses and polite requests. You’ll also hear how familiar phrases sound in everyday speech, from minä olen to mä oon.

• Work through 271 topics with explanations in English and the Finnish forms highlighted.
• Listen to 2,904 worked examples with English meanings. Replay the audio at normal or slower speed.
• Build Finnish sentences with word tiles. In 145 topics, type the form that fits the sentence using a keyboard with ä and ö.
• Open “Why?” when it’s offered to see the rule behind a correction.
• Save phrases to your Study List and revisit what you’ve practised with spaced repetition.

The first 10 topics are free, including their explanations, exercises and audio. A single lifetime purchase unlocks the remaining 261 topics. Learn on iPhone or iPad.

Support URL
https://www.declansoftware.com/contact.html

Privacy Policy URL
https://www.declansoftware.com/privacy-policy.html

Copyright
2026 Declan Software Ltd

name: Borderfall
description: Borderfall is a free strategy game inspired by classic territory conquest. Command armies across historical world maps and regional theaters, research technologies, play ranked matches, daily challenges, and async games with friends. No real-money purchases: gold and cosmetics are earned through play.

name: Borna
description:
Borna es la app de trabajo para empresas instaladoras: electricistas, telecomunicaciones, antenas, redes WiFi, cámaras y alarmas. Todo lo que haces en una obra, en el móvil y sin papeles.

PRESUPUESTOS EN LA OBRA
• Presupuestos con tu propia tarifa, el IVA calculado y numeración automática.
• Presupuesto con IA: haz una foto o dicta el trabajo y Borna lo convierte en partidas. Lo que no está en tu tarifa sale marcado para que revises el precio.
• Envíalo por WhatsApp: el cliente lo abre en su móvil y lo acepta firmando en la pantalla. Te llega un aviso al momento.
• PDF listo para enviar o imprimir.

PLANOS ELÉCTRICOS
• Dibuja el plano desde cero o encima de la foto de un plano real.
• Paredes, habitaciones, enchufes, puntos de luz, mecanismos, cuadro, telecomunicaciones y circuitos.
• Genera el presupuesto a partir del plano.

CLIENTES Y PARTES DE TRABAJO
• Ficha de cada cliente con teléfono, dirección, notas, accesos y contratos de mantenimiento.
• Partes de trabajo con horas, material, fotos y firma del cliente.
• Llama o escribe por WhatsApp con un toque.

TU EQUIPO
• Invita a tus técnicos: cada uno ve sus clientes, presupuestos y partes; tú ves los de todos.
• Material de cada furgoneta con stock, mínimos e inventario mensual.
• Formulario de contacto para tu web o tus redes, con aviso al móvil.
• Estadísticas: lo facturado mes a mes y tus mejores clientes.

FUNCIONA SIN COBERTURA
En un sótano o en una nave sin señal sigues trabajando; se guarda en cuanto vuelve la conexión.

SUSCRIPCIÓN
Prueba gratis 7 días. Después, suscripción mensual o anual por empresa, con todos tus técnicos incluidos. El pago se carga en tu cuenta de Apple y se renueva automáticamente salvo que la canceles al menos 24 horas antes del final del periodo, en Ajustes → tu nombre → Suscripciones.

Privacidad: https://borna-web.vercel.app/privacidad/

name: Bottino
description:
Bottino — магазины мужской одежды. В приложении:

• Каталог с фото и ценами: куртки, свитеры, рубашки, брюки, двойки и трикотаж.
• Наличие по магазинам и городам — сразу видно, где есть нужная вещь.
• Заказ в пару касаний: «Купить», корзина, «Оформить заказ». Продавец позвонит, уточнит размер и доставку.
• Доставка курьером в ваш город или самовывоз из магазина. Оплата при получении.
• Статус заказа в профиле: принят, собирается, отправлен, готов к самовывозу.
• Бронь вещи в магазине на 24 часа и запись к стилисту.
• Избранное и корзина хранятся на вашем телефоне.

Русский, казахский и английский языки.

Для сотрудников Bottino — рабочий портал: продажи, склад, накладные, заказы покупателей и расчётный листок. Вход — с логином, который выдала компания.

name: Boxbert: Crate Puzzle
description:
Boxbert is a forklift with brains. Together with warehouse boss Hilde he tidies up: push every crate onto its marker – but careful, Boxbert can't pull.

LOTS OF PUZZLES, ALL SOLVABLE
• 120 levels at launch in the Warehouse, Harbor, Cold Store, Freight Yard and Air Cargo
• 10 new levels every 14 days – up to 270 levels in 11 halls
• Every level is verified solvable, with a best path to compare against

SPECIAL RULES AND BONUS ROUNDS
• Black ice: crates slide to the next wall
• Fog: you only see the squares around Boxbert
• Quota: a fixed number of moves
• Daily puzzle, time races and a vault with secret levels

HELP WHEN YOU'RE STUCK
• Unlimited undo
• Shake takes you back to the last solvable position
• Hint shows the next sensible push

LEVEL EDITOR
Build your own levels. The built-in solver checks whether they can be solved. Share them with friends as a code.

FOR EVERYONE
• Control by swiping, tapping or D-pad
• Color aid, reduced motion, announcements for screen readers
• Portrait and landscape, works without internet
• In English, Spanish and German

FAIR
• 36 levels free: the whole Warehouse, 5 levels of every other hall, trial levels of the special rules – plus three free levels every week and the daily puzzle
• No ads, no subscription, no data collection
• More halls individually or in the complete bundle – bundle owners get all future levels at no extra cost

name: Breathe: Box Breathing & 4-7-8
description:
Breathe better, sleep deeper, and take back your calm.

Breathe brings breathwork, meditation and sleep together in one quiet app. Whether you are winding down after a long day, struggling to fall asleep, or need a moment of focus, a calmer few minutes is one tap away.

BREATHING EXERCISES WITH A VISUAL PACER
Follow the pacer (inhale, hold, exhale) with a gentle voice guiding each breath:
• 4-7-8 Breathing, a favourite before sleep
• Box Breathing for focus and steadiness
• Coherent, Triangle, Relaxing and Energizing breaths

MEDITATION, YOUR WAY
• Sessions from 3 to 60 minutes
• Full guidance, light guidance, or silence
• Choose your guide's voice: Jonah or Mia
• Nature sounds, calm music, instrumental or white noise underneath
• A singing bowl marks the start and the end

GUIDED PROGRAMS
Short daily sessions that build a habit: 7 Days of Calm, Better Sleep, Stress Reset, Focus at Work and Easing Anxiety.

QUICK HELP FOR THE MOMENT YOU'RE IN
Overwhelmed, before a stressful moment, between meetings, awake at 3 am: pick what's going on and start right away.

SLEEP
Build your night: a wind-down, a sleep story, and a soundscape (rain, ocean, brown noise and more) that fades out on its own.

KEEP GOING
Daily streaks and an optional daily reminder at the time you choose.

BREATHE PRO
Breathe is free to use: the meditation and breathing timers, 4-7-8 and box breathing, and the first two days of every program. Pro unlocks every exercise, voice, sound, program and sleep story.
• Yearly with a 7-day free trial, or monthly
• Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase (after the free trial, if you take one)
• Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period
• Manage or cancel any time in Settings > [your name] > Subscriptions

Privacy Policy: https://www.termsfeed.com/live/24531415-a8db-46a4-9c65-aaf397150276

Take a deep breath, and find your calm today.

name: Brush Reality Capture
description:
Brush turns the space around you into a 3D model you can actually work with.

Walk a room with your iPhone's LiDAR scanner and Brush builds a clean surface mesh from it in the cloud. Then sculpt it, build on it, paint it and hand it to your coding agent, all from your phone. The same models open on brush-reality-capture.com and in Blender.

START RIGHT AWAY, NO ACCOUNT
Open the app and you're on the canvas: a 3D scene of your own, saved on your iPhone as you go. Place walls, floors, ramps, cubes, cylinders, cones and spheres on a grid, sculpt them, paint them and drop in models from the public gallery. When you like what you made, log in and publish it to Brush.

CAPTURE REAL SPACES WITH LIDAR
• A full-screen AR view shows the live point cloud as you scan
• Coaching keeps you at the right distance and speed: sweep the walls, the floor and the ceiling
• Depth and photos stream straight to your scan; nothing piles up on your phone
• Brush builds the surface on a GPU and the scan page follows every step

EDIT IN A REAL 3D ENGINE
• Sculpt with draw, inflate, smooth, flatten, pinch and paint brushes. Apple Pencil pressure works
• Build with pieces that snap to a grid, face the camera and stand on whatever you aim at
• Place any Brush model as a linked object. Improve the original and every scene it's in updates
• Fill holes, simplify and smooth the whole model in one tap
• Undo, redo and a saved history of every revision
• Export GLB, OBJ or PLY to Files, AirDrop or anywhere else

HAND IT TO YOUR AI AGENT
Send a scan to Claude Code, Codex or Cursor with one tap. Brush writes the prompt and makes a key, and you watch the model change as your agent edits it.

YOUR LIBRARY, EVERYWHERE
• Dashboard of your scans, the ones shared with you, and their status
• Gallery of public scans, searchable by what's in them ("oak chair", "kitchen island")
• Star models to keep them in your building library, here and on the web
• Choose a pipeline for each build: classic reconstruction, generative completion or your own recipe
• Share links, make scans public or private, rename, describe and delete

ON-DEVICE INTELLIGENCE
On iPhones with Apple Intelligence, Brush suggests titles and answers questions about your scans right on the device. Siri and Shortcuts can start a scan, open your latest one or send it to your agent.

LiDAR capture needs an iPhone Pro or iPad Pro with a LiDAR scanner. The canvas, the editor and your library work on any supported iPhone and iPad.

name: Cachet: Stamp & Signature
description:
Your company stamp and your signature on a quote or an invoice, in 30 seconds, from your phone. No account, no subscription: your documents never leave your iPhone.

HOW IT WORKS
• Design your stamp: text (company name, registration number, address, phone), round, oval or rectangular shape, ink colour, live preview.
• Draw your signature with your finger, once. It is saved for all your documents, along with your initials.
• Import a PDF, a photo or a scan: quote, invoice, purchase order, certificate.
• Place the stamp and the signature wherever you want, adjust size and angle, on any page.
• Export as a PDF and send it by mail, WhatsApp or Files.

WHO IT'S FOR
Tradespeople, freelancers, small businesses and self-employed professionals who sign and stamp quotes and invoices on the go and don't want a subscription-based business tool.

100% LOCAL
No account to create, no document uploaded to a server. Your stamp, signature and PDFs stay on your phone. Cachet works offline.

FREE TO TRY, HONEST ABOUT THE REST
You can stamp and sign 3 documents for free, with a small banner ad at the bottom of the screen. After that, a one-time purchase unlocks unlimited documents and removes the ads. Never a subscription. The price is shown in the app before any purchase, and you can restore your purchase at any time.

WHAT CACHET DOESN'T DO
Cachet places a visual signature, like an ink stamp: it does not have the value of a qualified electronic signature (eIDAS). No multiple signers, no certificate.

Questions? Legal notices and contact are in Settings.

TERMS OF USE (EULA)

name: Carblet: Carb Counter
description:
Carblet is a calm, honest carb counter for keto and low-carb eating. Open it, see how many net carbs you have left today, log your meal in seconds.

NET CARBS YOU CAN CHECK
Every food shows the math: total carbs minus fiber minus sugar alcohols equals net carbs. Choose your rules: subtract sugar alcohols fully or partly, subtract allulose, or count total carbs instead. Your day total adds up each food on its own, so nothing goes below zero by mistake.

A DAY AT A GLANCE
- Net carbs left against your daily limit, with protein, fat and calories
- Your meals on a simple timeline: breakfast, lunch, dinner, snacks
- Repeat yesterday's breakfast in one tap
- Water with a quick add button
- A streak of days under your limit, with clear rules

FAST LOGGING
- 12,879 foods from USDA FoodData Central built into the app, search works offline
- Scan a barcode (Open Food Facts) or take a photo of a US Nutrition Facts label, read on your phone, then check the numbers before saving
- Quick add your own carbs, fiber, protein and fat
- Decimal amounts in grams, ounces or servings
- Your recent, favorite and own foods first

RECIPES AND PROGRESS
- Build a recipe once, log a serving any day
- 7-day net carb chart with your limit line
- Weight log and a weekly summary
- Export everything to CSV

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no sign in, no ads. Your log stays on your iPhone.

CARBLET PRO, ONE PAYMENT
Unlimited recipes, 30-day charts, What fits (the largest portion of your usual foods that still fits today), a Lock Screen widget and saving to Apple Health. Pay once, no subscription.

Goals are general estimates (Mifflin-St Jeor), not medical advice. If you have diabetes, kidney disease, are pregnant or take medication, talk to your doctor before starting a low-carb diet. Food database in English. Food data: USDA FoodData Central; product data © Open Food Facts contributors, ODbL.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: CatPaw Keyboard
description:
CatPaw Keyboard is an English keyboard with photoreal cat-paw keys. Each tap brings a lifelike paw onto the keyboard. Choose from 14 cat breeds, starting with British Shorthair.

Suggestions appear in the bar above the keys:
• Word completions while you type
• Conservative autocorrect when you press space — press backspace once to restore the original word
• Next-word suggestions after a space

Dictionaries and suggestions run on your iPhone and work without a network. A short key sound can be turned off, and it follows the hardware silent switch.

How to add the keyboard
1. Open Settings
2. Go to General → Keyboard → Keyboards
3. Tap Add New Keyboard… and choose English under CatPaw Keyboard
4. Open any text field and switch to CatPaw Keyboard
5. Tap the pawprint key for paw styles, key sound, and typing options

Full Access is optional. You only need it if you want the app and the keyboard to share paw and typing settings. Typing and suggestions work without it. Preferences stay on your device.

CatPaw Keyboard has no ads and does not require an account. Suggestions come from compact on-device language data. They are helpful for everyday English, but they are not the same as Apple’s built-in QuickType suggestions, and uncommon phrases may be missing or ranked lower.

Password, verification-code, and credit-card fields stay without suggestions.

name: CertGrove
description:
Inspect the public information inside an X.509 certificate and keep a dated record of the fields you reviewed.

• Import public DER certificates or a supported PEM certificate bundle.
• Inspect subject, issuer, serial number, validity dates and available certificate extensions.
• Compare SHA-256 certificate and public-key fingerprints.
• Choose a reference date for validity inspection and compare two saved certificates.
• Freeze an inspection report and share its JSON or PDF representation.

CertGrove does not establish certificate-chain trust, verify signatures, check hostname ownership or query revocation services. A date or fingerprint comparison is not a security or authenticity verdict. Private keys are not an input format.

Your saved work stays in this app’s local library. Use the system sharing controls when you choose to export a file. System backups may include app data.

name: ciLager
description:
ciLager is the mobile warehouse and stocktaking app for ciPOS customers. It runs on handheld scanners and smartphones and records stock movements right at the shelf – even without a network connection. As soon as the device is online again, all postings are synchronised automatically with your ciPOS client.

Please note: ciLager is an add-on to an existing ciPOS account. Sign-in uses a device PIN generated by your administrator in the ciPOS back office. The app cannot be used without a ciPOS client.

FEATURES

• Stocktaking: full or partial counts by warehouse, storage location or article group. Expected stock stays hidden while counting (blind count). On completion, differences are shown, justified and released.
• Goods receipt: scan the article, enter the quantity, choose warehouse and storage location, optionally batch, serial number and delivery note.
• Goods issue: availability per storage location is checked, optionally with an order or document reference.
• Transfers: scan source location, article and target location – done.
• Returns: customer and supplier returns with reason, condition and follow-up action (restock, scrap, return to supplier).
• Article lookup: by scan or search, with stock per warehouse and storage location.
• Labels: article and storage-location labels using templates from the ciPOS label designer, with preview and printing to network label printers on your own LAN.
• Movement journal: all local postings with time, employee and sync status.

SCANNING

• USB and Bluetooth scanners (keyboard mode)
• Camera scanner for EAN, UPC, Code 128, QR code and DataMatrix – decoded on the device, no Google services required
• Optional: Google code scanner (ML Kit)

OFFLINE FIRST

All postings are stored locally first and synchronised afterwards. Stock is never edited directly; every change is a traceable stock movement.

FOR EVERY CLIENT TYPE

Postings are forwarded through the ciPOS interface to the client's own system (ciPOS inventory, SelectLine, Proffix or Shopify). The app itself talks to ciPOS only.

PRIVACY

The app contains no advertising and no trackers. The camera is used for scanning only; images are neither stored nor transmitted.

Support: support@itsieber.ch

name: City Odd Jobs
description:
City Odd Jobs connects people who need a hand with neighbors who want to work. Mow a lawn, assemble furniture, haul a couch, walk a dog, paint a garage door: post it, set your hourly rate, and choose who you want.

NEED WORK DONE?
- Post a job with details, a location, an hourly rate and a time.
- Workers see a general area on the map until you pick someone. Your exact address is shared only with the worker you choose.
- Browse workers on the map by state, see their photo, skills and rating, and chat inside the app.
- Arranging help for a family member in another state? Post a job anywhere in the U.S.
- Rate your worker when the job is done.

LOOKING FOR WORK?
- Add your skills and show a pin for the area you work from.
- Browse open jobs on the map in any state, accept the rate you like, and chat with the poster in the app.
- Build a public rating from the people you work for.
- Far from a job? Ask for travel or fuel cost.

BUILT FOR SAFETY
- Every worker adds a real profile photo and a government ID, stored encrypted and never shown to anyone.
- Report and block people, and delete your account any time.
- All messages stay in the app.

PAYMENT
City Odd Jobs does not process payments. Every job is paid in person, in cash, when the work is finished.

name: ClaimBridge
description:
ClaimBridge guides commercial fleet drivers—dry van, reefer, flatbed, tanker, and hazmat—through roadside incident intake in plain, stress-free language. Capture scene photos, tractor and trailer IDs, witness details, and GPS coordinates in minutes, then generate a structured, insurer-ready claim packet for your safety team.Key Features:
- Step-by-step driver intake built for high-stress roadside situations
- Smart branching for cargo leaks, fuel spills, and hazmat containment checklists
- Works offline in cellular dead zones and syncs automatically once signal returns
- Verified GPS coordinates, timestamps, and photo evidence packaging

name: ClearCast: IPTV & Media Player
description:
Your playlists. More possibilities.

ClearCast brings your live TV, movies and series together in an IPTV and media player for iPhone and iPad. Connect your own M3U playlist, Xtream Codes account or operator-provided server code. Then make your library your own.

DISCOVER MORE ABOUT WHAT YOU WATCH
Explore title descriptions, cast and character information, biographies and film credits when available. Search by actor or actress, follow matching credits straight to movies and shows in your playlists, and find related titles to watch next. Open IMDb and TMDb links for more information, or watch a linked trailer when supplied.

DOWNLOAD A MOVIE. SAVE A SEASON.
Take supported movies and episodes offline. Download individual episodes or an entire season, see progress and time remaining, and pause or resume transfers. Background downloads can continue while you use another app or lock your screen, subject to iOS and source support. Optional Turbo uses parallel file parts for compatible sources; speed depends on your provider and connection.

LIVE TV WITH A PROPER GUIDE
Browse channels alongside programme listings, preview a channel and expand into full-screen playback. Turn your phone sideways for a larger guide and preview. Follow current and upcoming programmes, save favourite channels and set programme reminders. Restart or replay programmes on channels that provide catch-up.

RECORD THE MOMENT
Record live TV with a name you choose. Where guide data is available, use programme times and up to five minutes of padding before and after. Background recording depends on supported iOS capabilities. Future recordings require the app to be open at the start time.

MAKE EVERY PLAYLIST YOURS
Give each playlist a clear name, switch between saved sources, show or hide category groups, and keep favourites close. Search channels, movies, shows and cast. Your saved catalogue is available again when you return to the app.

A PLAYER THAT FITS YOU
Watch in portrait with title details below the picture, or expand into landscape. Cycle through Fit, Auto, crop-to-fill and aspect ratios while watching. Adjust audio and brightness, select available subtitle and audio tracks, change playback speed, set a sleep timer or lock the controls. Choose 10-, 15- or 30-second skips. Use Picture in Picture or AirPlay where supported by the device, stream and playback engine.

PICK UP WHERE YOU LEFT OFF
Return to favourites and continue watching. Clear your viewing history or use Private viewing. Credentials are stored in the iOS Keychain, and saved catalogue data is encrypted on your device.

BRING YOUR OWN CONTENT
ClearCast is a player, not a TV subscription or content provider. It does not include a library of channels, movies or series. You must provide sources you are authorized to access and have permission to download or record. Metadata, trailers, guide listings, catch-up, downloads and other features depend on your source and device. IMDb and TMDb links open external services; ClearCast is not affiliated with them.

Support: support@clearcastplayer.com
Privacy: https://clearcastplayer.com/privacy-policy/
Terms: https://clearcastplayer.com/legal/#terms

name: Closetwise: Wardrobe & Outfits
description:
Closetwise helps you get dressed from the clothes you already own, and shop with intent when you do buy.

YOUR WARDROBE IN A FEW PHOTOS
Photograph your clothes, several at once if you like. Each piece is recognised on your phone, with its colour, pattern and kind, and you can correct anything before saving. Want to look around first? Try the sample wardrobe.

TODAY'S LOOK
Every day, a complete outfit that goes together: top and bottom or a dress, finished with shoes and a layer when you have them. Choose work, casual or evening. Colours, patterns and dress code are matched with clear rules, and each look tells you why it works. Mark what you wear and Closetwise avoids repeating it, plans the week ahead, and shows pieces that have been resting too long.

SHOP SMARTER
Before you buy, see which single piece would make the most new outfits with what you own, ranked by the number of new looks. Tap one to search for it in a shop you already use, such as Amazon, Trendyol in Türkiye, or Google Shopping. Closetwise does not sell anything: the shop handles payment, delivery and returns.

YOUR STYLE AND YOUR LINES
Your palette and style are read from your wardrobe. Mark colours, patterns or pieces you never wear and they are never suggested; mark the ones you love and they come up more.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no server, no ads, no tracking. Photos and your wardrobe stay on your phone. Export or erase everything at any time.

FREE AND PRO
Free: up to 25 pieces, today's look and a few fresh ideas a day, and your best shopping idea.
Closetwise Pro: unlimited pieces, unlimited outfit ideas with every outfit at a glance, a week planned ahead without repeats, and the full ranked list of shopping ideas.

Closetwise Pro is an auto-renewable subscription, yearly with a one-week free trial for eligible new subscribers, or monthly. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel in your Apple Account settings.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Cloud Identifier: Sky Atlas
description:
Point your phone at the sky and find out what you're looking at. Cloud Identifier names the clouds in your photo in seconds, tells you what they usually mean for the weather, and keeps every new cloud you find in your own collection.

SNAP THE SKY
Take a photo or pick one from your library. The AI spots one or more clouds in the same sky and shows how sure it is about each one. Photos that don't show the sky aren't guessed at.

KNOW EVERY CLOUD
Each result shows the common and Latin name, altitude band, typical height, rarity and how the cloud forms.

READ THE WEATHER
Learn what each cloud usually signals for the next few hours, from fair-weather cumulus to storm-building cumulonimbus.

SKY ATLAS
Browse 30 cloud types and sky phenomena with photos: the 10 main cloud genera, patterns like undulatus and lacunosus, features like mammatus, asperitas, shelf clouds and virga, and optical effects like halos, sun dogs, rainbows and crepuscular rays. Every entry explains the Latin name, altitude, formation, weather meaning and rarity.

COLLECT THEM ALL
Save your sightings with photo and date. Every new cloud type you find fills your atlas, and your history keeps every sky you've seen.

SHARE YOUR SKY
Turn any sighting into a share card for friends and family.

AD-FREE AND PRIVATE
No ads and no account. Your saved sightings stay on your device.

SUBSCRIPTION
Cloud Identifier requires a subscription. Choose a weekly or a yearly plan; the yearly plan starts with a free trial. Payment is charged to your Apple ID when you confirm the purchase or when the trial ends. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your App Store account settings.

Weather meanings are general information, not a forecast. Always follow official weather warnings.
