Privacy Policy: https://asugan.github.io/petopia-legal/privacy-cloud-identifier.html

name: Coatl: Serpent Marbles
description:
A carved stone track winds through your own room. A chain of gemstone marbles rolls along it toward a serpent gate. Shoot, match and shatter the chain before it gets there.

Coatl is a marble-chain shooter made only for Apple Vision Pro. The track is not on a screen. It stands in your space at room scale, with your walls, floor and furniture still in view around it.

HOW IT PLAYS
• Two ways to shoot. Look at a spot on the chain and pinch: your marble flies there. Or pinch, pull your hand back like a slingshot, and let go: a longer pull is a stronger shot.
• Three or more of one color shatter.
• When a gap closes and matching colors meet, they shatter too. That is a Coil, and every step of it scores more.
• Wrong color? Pinch Swap, or the loaded marble itself, to trade it for the next one.
• Clear the whole chain before it reaches the serpent gate. If the chain gets in, the level is lost and you can try again at once.

MADE FOR LOOK AND PINCH
You aim with your eyes and shoot with a pinch. A shot that lands just beside a marble is pulled onto it. There is no controller. Coatl does not use hand tracking and asks for no permissions.

THIRTEEN LEVELS IN THREE WORLDS
• A saga map takes you through Jade Court, Feathered Stair and Sun Gate: the jade temple at morning, the cenote, and the sun pyramid at dusk. Each world has its own stone, light and glow.
• The first level is short, so you are into the game quickly. Levels then grow from three colors to six.
• Every track has its own shape, from a single sweep to a figure-eight, a stepped coil, a spiraling bowl, twin coils and three nested arches. Lighter levels come after the hard ones.
• Clear a level to open the next, or replay any level you have cleared.
• Earn Jade, Gold and Sun seals on every level, and a feather mark for clearing it before the gate wakes.
• A short guided start teaches the game inside the first level. You can skip it.

UNLOCK NEW MARBLES
Clear the last level of each world to earn a new marble finish: Jade Polish, Cenote Glass and Sun Gold. Pick the one you like in Settings. Earn every Sun seal in a world to gild it.

TWO POWER MARBLES
A marble with a gold sign carries a power. Match it to set it off.
• Sun Burst clears every marble near it, even on a neighboring pass of the track.
• Quetzal Wind rolls the whole chain backward for a few seconds.

COMFORT
• Play standing or seated. The track sets itself to your eye height when a level starts, and a Track height setting fine-tunes it.
• Compact room shrinks the track for a smaller space.
• One level can wrap the serpent all the way around you, with a switch in Settings.
• Put the launcher on your left or right side.
• Pause at any time, and recenter the track in front of you from the pause panel.
• Reduce effects calms the shards and flashes, and follows the Reduce Motion setting of your device.
• No timers, no lives, no energy meters. Your progress is saved after every level.

STONE, GEMS AND SOUND
Weathered carved stone, gemstone marbles with gold inlay, a sun-stone that pours out the chain and a feathered-serpent gate that wakes as the chain gets close. Spatial sound follows every shot, match and Coil, over a calm music loop, with separate volume settings for music and effects.

FAIR AND PRIVATE
• One price for the whole game. No ads, no in-app purchases, no subscription.
• No account and no sign-in.
• No permissions requested.
• No data is collected. Progress and settings are saved on your device only.

Coatl is made only for Apple Vision Pro.

name: Color Lock: Screw Puzzle
description:
Small move. Big satisfaction.

Color Lock is a relaxing puzzle where you unscrew colorful screws and take apart pictures built from plates: an owl, a butterfly, a cat, a rocket, a watermelon and many more.

How to play
- Tap a screw that nothing covers.
- It flies into the box of its colour. Three screws close the box.
- Other colours wait in the tray. If the tray fills up, you lose, so plan ahead!
- Unscrew every screw and the plates drop away.

Features
- Over 1000 levels across 15 worlds, from the Workshop to Rainbow Land, from calm to truly challenging.
- Hidden screws and padlocks that change your strategy.
- A collection of 75 pictures (animals, fruit, vehicles, space…) with rewards for completing it.
- Daily challenge, daily gift streak and a weekly Screw Race.
- Boosters: Undo, +1 Slot and Hint.
- Colour themes and a colourblind mode.
- Plays offline, anytime.

Free to play with ads and optional in-app purchases, including a one-time "No ads".

name: Colorline Tycoon: Idle Factory
description:
Start with a single ball generator and grow it into a six-zone color factory!

Colorline Tycoon is a relaxing idle factory game. Balls roll along your conveyor belts while your machines paint, sort, mix, duplicate, polish and pack them. Every sale earns cash, every upgrade makes the line faster, and your factory keeps working even when the game is closed.

BUILD YOUR LINE
• Buy machines, connect them with belts and watch the balls flow
• Upgrade every machine through tiers; each tier changes how it looks
• Open six zones, each with new machines and more valuable colors
• Discover 13 colors and complete color sets for permanent sale bonuses

RUN THE BUSINESS
• Deliver customer orders before the timer runs out
• Win multi-stage tenders for big rewards
• Follow the color market and produce the color whose price is rising
• Tap machines to fill the TURBO meter and double the factory speed

GROW STRONGER
• Collect foreman cards and assign them to machines for speed, value and offline bonuses
• Unlock permanent upgrades in the research tree
• Prestige to restart with lasting bonuses and reach new zones
• Earn while you are away and collect your offline income when you return

SOMETHING NEW ALL THE TIME
• Weekend events with exclusive conveyor belts
• A new Season Pass every month with free and premium rewards
• Daily login rewards, daily quests, achievements and the Lucky Wheel
• Game Center leaderboards and cloud save

MAKE IT YOURS
• Neon, Winter, Summer, Football, Diamond and Gold factory themes
• Preview every theme before you buy it
• 20 floor designs to unlock with in-game cash

Plays offline. Six languages: English, Türkçe, Deutsch, Русский, 中文 and Azərbaycanca.

The game is free to play. It contains optional rewarded ads and optional in-app purchases.

name: CommHub Schools
description:
CommHub Schools keeps parents and their school connected — simply.

Schools send a notice once, and every parent gets it on their phone as a notification. Parents can ask the school's friendly assistant a question any time and get an answer straight away, drawn from the school's own information.

FOR PARENTS
• Get school notices as push notifications — never miss an important message
• One place for every notice from your school, newest first
• Ask the assistant about fees, uniform, term dates, events and more — it answers from your school's own information, and passes you to the school office when a person is needed
• Stay signed in on your phone — no passwords to remember

FOR SCHOOLS
• Send a notice to the whole school or a single class in seconds
• Upload your school information once (a photo, PDF, Word or Excel file, or just paste it) and the assistant answers parents' questions from it automatically
• A simple desk to handle anything the assistant passes on
• Make it yours — add your school's logo and colour

Sign-in is passwordless: enter your email, get a one-time code, and you're in. CommHub does not collect any student or child information — parents just join their school to receive notices.

CommHub Schools is a BTECH company.

name: Connect Navi
description: Device Connect Navi 是一款为兼容设备提供蓝牙配网和连接设置的工具。通过清晰的操作步骤，帮助您完成设备连接、Wi-Fi 设置和服务器配置。

name: Conseil de Geek
description:
Conseil de Geek repère chaque jour les offres qui valent vraiment le coup sur Amazon, et vous dit pourquoi.

Les bons plans qui valent le coup
Chaque offre est sélectionnée et commentée : un titre clair, une courte description, les points forts du produit, le prix et la remise. Un coup d'œil suffit pour savoir si c'est le bon moment d'acheter.

Plus c'est chaud, meilleur c'est
Chaque bon plan a sa température, en degrés. Les meilleures affaires montent en haut : triez par température, par prix, par remise ou par nouveauté.

Vos univers, vos bons plans
High-tech, maison et cuisine, bricolage et jardin, jeux vidéo, jouets, mode et beauté, sport, musique, auto et moto : cochez ce qui vous intéresse et votre onglet se crée tout seul.

Des onglets à votre façon
Créez autant d'onglets que vous voulez, avec leurs filtres : catégorie, température minimale, prix, marques, mots-clés. Chaque onglet indique combien de nouveaux bons plans sont arrivés depuis votre dernière visite.

Ne ratez plus rien
Activez une alerte sur un onglet ou une recherche et recevez une notification dès qu'un bon plan arrive. Suivez un produit précis pour être prévenu quand il repasse en bon plan.

Les bons plans à la une
Retrouvez chaque jour la sélection des offres à ne pas manquer, et les grands événements comme le Black Friday dans un onglet dédié.

En clair ou en sombre
Thème clair, sombre ou celui de votre iPhone, trois densités d'affichage, et la possibilité de n'afficher que les nouveautés.

Sans compte, ou avec
L'app fonctionne tout de suite, sans inscription. Avec un compte gratuit (e-mail, Apple ou Google), vos onglets vous suivent sur l'iPhone et sur conseil-de-geek.com.

Un bon plan à partager ? Proposez-le directement depuis l'app.

Conseil de Geek est gratuit et sans publicité. En tant que Partenaire Amazon, Conseil de Geek réalise un bénéfice sur les achats remplissant les conditions requises.

name: Corner Work: Boxing Coach
description:
Corner Work is a boxing coach that calls out your combos, so you can train like you have someone in your corner.
Pick a workout, press start and box. The coach calls every combo out loud in a real voice ("jab, cross, left hook"), counts you down with the bell, and pushes you through the last seconds of each round.
BUILD YOUR OWN SESSION
• Choose your rounds, round length and rest
• Pick the exact combos you want, or let the coach mix them up at random
• Different combos for each round, called randomly or in order
• Save your sessions and run them again any time
WORKOUTS FOR EVERY KIT
• Heavy bag, freestanding bag, double-end bag, speed bag, slip bag and wall bag
• Shadow boxing, pad work with a partner, footwork, skipping and conditioning
• Non-stop and power-punch finishers at the end of each round
• Beginner to advanced levels and four paces
LEARN TO BOX
• Short lessons on stance, guard, footwork, every punch and defence
• Animated demos you can slow down
• Fix common bad habits
TRAINING PLANS
• Learn to Box in 4 Weeks, Fight Fit, Fight Camp and more
• Guided warm-ups and cool-downs
RECORD AND REVIEW
• Film yourself and watch it back in slow motion to check your form
MORE
• Realistic coach voices in 35 languages
• Works with Spotify, Apple Music and other music apps, so your music keeps playing under the calls
• Free round timer with bell, 10-second clapper and rest countdown
• Points, streaks, badges and a weekly leaderboard with friends
• Saves workouts to Apple Health
CORNER WORK PRO
The round timer is always free. Pro unlocks the combo caller, every workout, all lessons, training plans, build-your-own sessions and video review.
• Yearly: 7-day free trial, then £39.99 a year
• Monthly: £7.99 a month
Payment is charged to your Apple ID. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel in your Apple ID settings.
Terms of Use: https://famous-cendol-6b792a.netlify.app/terms.html
Privacy Policy: https://famous-cendol-6b792a.netlify.app/privacy.html

name: CraftLedger
description:
CraftLedger is an offline woodworking planner for iPhone and iPad. Use frame and spacing calculators to plan your build, then record each part’s dimensions, joinery, and grain direction.

Lay out parts on sheet stock with your chosen saw kerf, save cut lists, and compare layouts before you cut. As the build progresses, track materials, tools, costs, and workshop notes in one place.

Export cut lists and project reports as PDFs, or back up your workshop for later restoration.

name: CreaWars
description:
Tartarus trembles – Kronos is free!

Kronos, lord of time, has broken his chains. His Titan spawn is storming Olympus, and the gods need a commander: you. Send hoplites, archers, the Minotaur and Pegasus into battle across three lanes, defend your temple and destroy the Titan gate.

THE GODS FIGHT WITH YOU
• 8 gods with their own powers: Zeus hurls lightning, Poseidon sends the flood, Hades summons the shades of the fallen
• Every time, the god steps onto the battlefield, attacks and descends again
• Divine wrath: your gods attack together – 12 different combos such as meteor shower, earthquake, whirlwind, deluge or “Sun and Moon”

TITANS AS BOSSES
• Polyphemus, the Kraken, Cerberus, Atlas, Hyperion and Kronos – with abilities from mythology
• When their gate falls, they descend onto the battlefield as giants and keep fighting

50 LEVELS AND A STORY
• 5 chapters from Olympus through the Aegean and the underworld to the throne of time
• A told story with gods and Titans, always available in the chronicle
• 12 special rules such as air raid, shield wall or race against time

GROW STRONGER
• Upgrade troops and gods on Olympus
• Troops evolve at levels 4 and 8: new armor, new abilities such as fire arrows or a healing wave
• Codex with every troop, god, enemy and Titan

ALWAYS SOMETHING NEW
• Daily trial with new rules
• Tartarus: endless mode with high score
• The 12 labors of Heracles
• Titan storm: all six Titans in a row

FAIR
• Guided tutorial with Athena
• Playable offline, no ads, no data collection
• Everything can be earned by playing; optional packs in the shop
• German and English, for iPhone and the foldable iPhone

name: DashRunner
description: DashRunner is a fast-paced endless running game. Tap the screen to jump and swipe down to slide under obstacles. Collect coins, unlock new outfits and power-ups, and beat your best score. The speed increases the longer you survive. The Pro version unlocks all outfits and doubles your coins with a one-time payment, no subscription.

name: Deckora: DJ Mixer & Music
description:
Deckora — DJ Mixer & Music

Turn your phone or tablet into a portable DJ mixing station.

Deckora makes mixing music simple. Load your own songs, play two tracks together, blend between decks, shape your sound, and use your microphone to talk over the music in real time.

Whether you're learning to DJ, mixing music for friends, hosting a small party, or experimenting with transitions, Deckora gives you the essential tools without the complexity of professional DJ equipment.

TWO VIRTUAL DJ DECKS

BUILT FOR TOUCH

A clean, landscape DJ interface with accessible controls, clear waveforms and a mixer layout designed for touchscreens.

No complicated setup. Just your music and the freedom to mix.

Download Deckora and start mixing.

Your tracks. Your voice. Your mix.

name: Delta Aces
description:
Own the sky.

Delta Aces is a neo-retro arcade air combat game. Take the controls of a delta-wing fighter and fly through landscapes that keep moving beneath your aircraft.

7 MISSIONS. DIFFERENT THREATS.
Intercept oncoming fighters, watch your six, tackle squadrons, strike aircraft carriers and engage armed gunships. Choose any mission from the operations map.

TWO WEAPONS. INDEPENDENT SIGHTS.
Aim the gun precisely while a separate missile seeker acquires its own target. When the frame turns red, you decide when to fire. Missiles are limited; the gun stays available.

A WORLD IN MOTION
Open sea, cliffs, snowy peaks, canyons and night ports: four environments evolve as you fly. Switch between cockpit and chase views, and track threats on the radar.

Evade hostile gunfire and missiles, protect your hull, then review your takedowns, accuracy and score in the debrief. An original soundtrack follows the screens and landscapes.

• Free to play, with no ads or in-app purchases.
• Works offline. No account required.
• English and French interface and missions.
• Landscape gameplay, with layouts adapted to both iPhone Duo displays.
• Progress and sound preference stored on your device.

Ready for launch?

name: DigitGrove
description:
Check an identifier checksum, follow every digit and weight, and review a batch without changing the original numbers.

• Explicitly choose GTIN-8, GTIN-12, GTIN-13, GTIN-14, ISBN-10, ISBN-13 or ISSN.
• Check a full number or calculate a final check digit from a correctly sized payload.
• Inspect the weighted trace while preserving leading zeroes and the original input.
• Classify up to 1,000 nonempty batch lines, keeping original physical line numbers.
• Preview check-digit-only suggestions and export independent CSV and PDF reports.

A valid checksum does not verify registration, issuance, ownership, authenticity or the existence of a product or publication. Generating a check digit does not allocate a real identifier. Suggestions are limited to a mismatched check digit in an otherwise valid format.

Your saved work stays in this app’s local library. Use the system sharing controls when you choose to export a file. System backups may include app data.

name: Dino Knights: Pixel Run & Gun
description:
Four dinosaurs who flunked knight school are off to rescue a blonde T-rex princess.

Dino Knights is a pixel run-and-gun action game: run, shoot, ride and smash. The Chicken Empire claims that birds descend from dinosaurs, so they are the "original" dinosaurs, and it has invaded the Jura Kingdom and carried off the princess. The only knights left are four dropouts.

Hear a tiny clip of a real song. Name it. Then date it.

name: EdgeChronicle
description:
EdgeChronicle turns a digital VCD record into an inspectable timing notebook. Import a trace, choose signals, set exact tick windows and save the result with the source context.

IMPORT THE ACTUAL DIGITAL RECORD
Choose a UTF-8 Value Change Dump file from Files or paste its source text. The parser keeps scopes, digital declarations, signal widths and explicit timescale. Unsupported data is rejected rather than silently omitted. Load synthetic practice trace explicitly adds an ordinary example so you can explore the workflow without hardware or a private file.

INSPECT FOUR-STATE WAVEFORMS
Select one through eight signals by complete name. Inspect stepped 0/1 values, unknown X and high-impedance Z states, buses and aliases. Set the window using integer ticks and use A/B cursors for exact state values and absolute time difference. Converted labels are rounded for display while the tick record remains exact. Dense drawings are identified; calculations still use recorded events.

MEASURE ONLY WHAT THE RECORD SUPPORTS
Choose one signal and bit, with bit 0 as the least significant bit. Count known rising/falling edges and inspect complete high/low pulses and periods. X/Z intervals break continuity rather than being guessed as a level. Boundary-clipped pulses do not become complete pulses. Coverage separates known and unknown duration; duty is calculated over the known portion and becomes Unavailable when nothing is known.

FREEZE A TIMING SESSION
Save the source identity, selected signal/bit, window, cursors and report with a title. Search and reopen saved sessions. Inspect saved scope restores a working configuration for a new measurement without rewriting the original frozen result. A trace referenced by a session is protected from deletion.

SHARE A REAL CSV REPORT
Generate an actual quoted UTF-8 CSV with source/signal metadata, timescale, exact tick intervals, edge and pulse details, periods, coverage, duty and interpretation rules. Use the system share sheet, or reopen a saved session and share its frozen CSV again. Text cells are protected against spreadsheet formula interpretation.

DEFINED FORMAT AND LIMITS
Up to 4 MiB per VCD, 128 declarations, 64 bits per declaration and 100,000 assignments. Timestamps must be nondecreasing integers from 0 to 9,007,199,254,740,991. The library supports 20 traces, 50 sessions and 32 MiB of source text. One explicit timescale is required. Real/string/unknown extensions and unsupported recording gaps are rejected; dump-off/on requires complete explicit snapshots. Same-code same-tick final value wins, so delta-cycle glitches are not preserved.

THIS IS DIGITAL RECORD ANALYSIS
No hardware capture, analog voltage measurement, protocol decoder, circuit simulation or electrical certification. Keep important original VCD files and exported reports. Sessions and traces have separate delete controls; external CSV copies are unaffected. This version has no bulk-clear or complete-library backup/restore feature.

For iPhone with iOS 15 or later. No app login, in-app purchase or advertising SDK.

• Guided Syllable Rhythm Pacer (Zero Microphone Needed)
Follow highlighted syllable beat chips across short phrases, natural sentences, and rhythm twisters, then log local self-checks (Clear Placement or Practice Again) with zero audio recording or microphone permissions.

• Printable Practice Sheets & Local Progress Export

PRIVACY & OFFLINE INTEGRITY

• Zero Sensitive Permissions: Requires no microphone, camera, or location permissions—working identically across iPhone, iPad, and Mac.
• Data Not Collected: All study progress remains strictly on your device.

EDUCATIONAL USE NOTICE

Educational pronunciation, phonetics, and articulation placement practice studio for self-guided learners, educators, and speakers. Not a medical device, clinical speech-language pathology diagnosis, or substitute for a licensed Speech-Language Pathologist.

• Switch coloring modes between Nucleotide Base Pairs (A–T vs G–C), Hydrogen Bond Strength (2 vs 3 H-bonds), and Antiparallel Sugar-Phosphate Backbones (5'→3' and 3'→5').

PUBLISHED REFERENCE GENE & VARIANT ATLAS (8 CLASSIC GENES)

name: Fettled
description:
If you own appliances like water purifiers, robot vacuums, or air purifiers, you’ve likely faced the same dilemma: "How long has this filter actually been in use?"
Forgetting the answer usually leads to one of two outcomes: either you keep using a filter six months past its expiration, or you end up buying a replacement right after you’ve just installed one. Calendar reminders don’t help much—they can’t track how many consumables each device has or the specific replacement schedule for each.
Fettled does just one thing: it turns the question "When does this specific consumable need replacing?" into a simple, maintenance-free checklist.
No need to calculate dates yourself
For each consumable, you only need to enter two details: the date it was last replaced and the replacement interval (in months). The app calculates the due date for you—you don’t have to input it manually. Whether you’re adjusting the interval, logging a replacement, or restoring from a backup, you never have to go back and manually edit any dates.
Know exactly what needs attention this month
The home screen doesn’t list every single device; instead, it answers one key question: "What needs to be taken care of this month?" You can log a replacement directly from the to-do list without needing to navigate to the device’s details page.
No need to figure out which consumables a device requires
Simply select the model, and the app automatically populates the necessary consumables and their replacement intervals—whether it’s three filters for a water purifier or two for a robot vacuum, it’s all in the database. You can also add items manually if you prefer.
Snap a photo of the nameplate to auto-fill the model
Take a picture of the device’s nameplate, and the app will automatically identify and fill in the model and serial number—saving you the trouble of squinting at tiny text to copy it down.
Notifications only when action is actually required
You’ll only get a reminder when a consumable is nearing its expiration date—no daily, repetitive alerts. You can customize the notification timing or turn them off entirely.
Your data stays on your device
The app doesn’t require an internet connection, an account, or third-party analytics SDKs. With no cloud dependency, you’ll never have to worry about "sync failures" or sudden changes to a privacy policy.
Take your data with you, anytime
Export your list as a PDF, a CSV file, or a long image. You can also back up your data to the "Files" app, making it easy to restore when you switch to a new phone. Perfect for those who have three or more household devices that require regular replacement of consumables—and who want to completely erase this minor chore from their mental to-do list.

name: FieldFerry
description:
FieldFerry helps you complete an existing PDF form while keeping the original intact. Import a real AcroForm, inspect its fields, save your work and freeze a visible copy with a machine-readable field snapshot.

START WITH THE ORIGINAL DOCUMENT
Choose an unencrypted AcroForm PDF from Files. FieldFerry copies it into its own local library and audits its real field names, types, required/read-only settings, choices and page locations. The external original is not overwritten. Import practice form explicitly loads a synthetic form through the same workflow; nothing is inserted automatically.

FILL THE FIELDS ALREADY THERE
Edit supported text and multiline fields, checkboxes, mutually exclusive radio groups and single-choice fields. Source maximum lengths and permitted values remain in effect. Same-name compatible widgets share a value, so repeated Name locations agree. Use View on page or View PDF to inspect values in their original layout. Read-only fields stay read-only.

SAVE AND CHECK A DRAFT
Save draft stores your current fill. Search, reopen, copy or delete fills in their own tab. Leaving unsaved changes gives you a choice to save, discard or continue editing. Validate identifies missing required values, overlong text and invalid choices, and takes you back to the affected field. A failed check does not discard the draft or produce a successful export.

FREEZE REAL PDF AND JSON FILES
Freeze PDF + JSON creates an independent output from the valid values. The visible original pages and current field values are drawn into a new, noninteractive PDF. A separate UTF-8 JSON preserves field names, types, values, page locations, source fingerprint and fill revision. Later draft changes do not alter an older export. Preview the actual PDF, read the JSON, inspect byte counts and fingerprints, or share either file with the system sheet.

KEEP CONTROL OF LOCAL COPIES
Templates, fills and exports live in separate searchable lists. Referenced templates cannot be deleted until their fills and exports are removed. About > Clear local library uses two confirmations. External originals and previously shared files remain unchanged. Keep your own important exports; this version does not include a full-library backup/restore feature. System device backup may include app files according to your settings.

SUPPORTED INPUT AND LIMITS
Up to 20,000,000 bytes, 1–30 pages and 200 field locations. Supports ordinary unencrypted AcroForm text, checkbox, radio and single-choice fields. Encrypted/locked files, XFA, JavaScript/automatic calculations, signature fields, push buttons, password fields, multiselect choices and ambiguous field definitions are rejected. Flat PDFs and scans without AcroForm fields are not made fillable.

Validation checks field structure, not institutional rules or signature legality. Flattened output has no editable widgets and does not guarantee searchable text or retain digital signatures. This is not an OCR, scanning, signing, redaction or form-design service.

For iPhone with iOS 15 or later. No app login, in-app purchase or advertising SDK.

一問一答の正誤と模擬試験の採点結果を単元ごとに集め、正答率の低い単元を弱点として出します。復習の期限が来た問題（忘却曲線: 1 → 3 → 7 → 14 → 30 日）、弱点の単元、まだ解いていない問題を 20 問に組んだ「今日の学習」をホームに用意します。合格予測は学科の配点（6 分野 × 10 点、36 点で合格）で出します。

■ テキスト（36 本）
全 36 単元に、要点・表（6 つの係数の使い分け、健康保険・雇用保険の給付、保険金の課税関係、所得の計算、所得控除の要件と金額、用途地域と建蔽率・容積率、小規模宅地等の特例など）・「ここが出る」を短くまとめました。2025 年分からの基礎控除・給与所得控除・扶養の要件の見直しや、2026 年 4 月施行の区分所有法の改正も反映しています。

■ 一問一答（377 問）
本番と同じ ○× と三答択一で。6 分野を単元ごとに解けます。

■ 模擬試験（本番形式・5 回分）
学科（○× 30 問・三答択一 30 問、90 分、60 点満点）と、日本 FP 協会の実技「資産設計提案業務」（設例を読んで答える 20 問、60 分、100 点満点）。学科だけ・実技だけでも解けます。自動で採点して学科・実技それぞれの合否と分野ごとの点を示し、全問の正解と解説で見直せます。実技はキャッシュフロー表・係数・バランスシート・債券利回り・外貨預金・建蔽率と容積率・法定相続分・贈与税・損益通算・保険の給付金などの計算を、設例の数字で練習できます。
問題冊子・答案用紙（マークシート）・採点表を印刷して紙で解き、答えを入れて採点することもできます。

■ 通知
毎日のリマインダー（時刻を選べます）は、その日の復習の数と弱点の単元を本文にします。受検日を入れると、ホームに残り日数が出て、1 週間前・3 日前・前日・当日にも知らせます。

■ 記録
合格予測、弱点の単元、分野ごとの正答率、模擬試験の点の推移、日ごとの学習量を残します。

■ 料金
無料: 各分野の最初の 20 問と最初の単元のテキスト、模擬試験の第1回（印刷・紙の採点を含む）。弱点の分析・合格予測・通知は無料で使えます。
すべての問題（買い切り ¥980、1 回払い）: すべての一問一答・テキスト・模擬試験。今後の版で増える問題も追加料金なしで使えます。
・サブスクリプションではありません。自動更新はなく、お支払いは 1 回だけです。
・機種を変えたときは、同じ Apple ID で「購入を復元」を押すと引き継げます。

■ 安心してお使いいただくために
通信は一切しません。アカウントも広告もありません。記録はこの iPhone の中だけに残り、通知もこの iPhone の中で組みます。

■ 問題について
問題と解説はすべて当社の書き下ろしで、実際の試験の過去問ではありません。2026 年 4 月 1 日時点の法令・税制にもとづいています。毎年度改定される年金額・保険料などの金額は、問題文で与えるか扱っていません。改正があれば更新します。本アプリは試験の学習のためのもので、個別の投資・税務・法律の助言を行うものではありません。誤りに気づかれた場合は、サポートページからお知らせください。

3 級ファイナンシャル・プランニング技能検定は、日本 FP 協会と金融財政事情研究会（きんざい）が実施する国家検定です。本アプリはこれらの団体の公式アプリではなく、承認や推奨を受けたものではありません。

利用規約（EULA）: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Geçer Not: AÖF Sınav Hazırlık
description:
Geçer Not, açıköğretim sınavlarına hazırlanan öğrenciler için özgün sorularla hazırlanmış bir sınav hazırlık uygulamasıdır. Okulunu ve programını seç, derslerinin sınavlarını sırayla çöz, sonucunu hemen gör.

NASIL ÇALIŞIR?
1. Okulunu seç: Anadolu AÖF, İstanbul AUZEF ya da Atatürk AÖF
2. Lisans ya da önlisans, ardından programını seç
3. Dersini seç ve numaralı sınavları sırayla çöz
4. Sonucunu gör: doğru, yanlış, net ve 100 üzerinden puan
5. Aynı sınavı tekrarla ya da sıradaki sınava geç

ÖZELLİKLER
• 89 derste 12.000'den fazla özgün soru
• Her soru yazıldıktan sonra iki ayrı denetimden geçer
• Güz dönemi dersleri, ünite ünite
• Ünite testleri: istediğin üniteden ayrıca çalış
• Sınav sonunda zayıf olduğun üniteler ve o ünitelerden tekrar
• "Finalde kaç almalıyım?" hesaplayıcısı
• Yanlışlarım: yanlış yaptığın soruları yeniden çöz
• İnternet olmadan çalışır
• Üyelik yok, reklam yok, şimdilik ücretsiz

BİLMENİZ GEREKENLER
• Sorular özgündür; konulara göre yeniden yazılmıştır.
• Geçer Not hiçbir üniversiteyle bağlantılı değildir.
• İçerik sürekli genişliyor: bazı programlarda henüz hazır olmayan dersler "Sorular hazırlanıyor" olarak görünür ve güncellemelerle eklenir.

GİZLİLİK
Hesap açman gerekmez. Seçimlerin, sınavların ve sonuçların yalnız telefonunda saklanır. Ayrıntı: https://www.karneyn.com/gecer-not/gizlilik

Karneyn Yazılım · info@karneyn.com

name: Ginger Photo Dedupe
description:
A little room for more memories.

Ginger Photo Dedupe helps you find duplicate and similar photos, compare the copies, and decide what stays. All photo analysis happens on your device.

CHOOSE WHAT TO CHECK
Scan your whole photo library or focus on selected albums, smart albums, and date ranges. Save your scope as a preset for next time.

UNDERSTAND EVERY MATCH
Results are grouped as Exact, Same image, or Similar. See the evidence behind each group and adjust matching sensitivity for the cleanup you want.

KEEP YOUR BEST SHOT
Compare photos and review suggested keepers based on your preferences, including Favorites, edits, sharpness, face quality, and image size. Your own choices always come first.

STAY IN CONTROL
Review copies before removing them. Bulk cleanup is reserved for verified Exact copies; visual matches are reviewed one group at a time. Every removal requires your confirmation and Apple's Photos confirmation. Removed photos go to Recently Deleted in Photos.

PROTECT YOUR ALBUMS
With full Photos access, the app can carry album memberships and Favorite status to the photo you keep. Review the planned changes before confirming.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Photos are analyzed on your device. This app never sends your photos, or anything computed from them, to its own servers or to anyone else. No account or analytics.

KNOW WHAT CHANGED
Review cleanup activity, estimated space recovered, and recovery instructions. Clear cached analysis and activity history in Settings.

Requires iOS 17 or iPadOS 17 or later. Photo library access is required. With Limited Access, only your selected photos are checked. The app works with photos, including Live Photos; video cleanup is not included. If you use iCloud Photos, removals and album changes sync through your existing iCloud Photos setup. Optional iCloud downloads use Apple's Photos framework.

name: Glaze Unity
description:
Glaze Unity puts a glaze recipe on the Stull chart.

Each recipe is a few materials and parts by weight. The app turns the parts into oxides, sets the fluxes to 1 and reads the silica and alumina. The point lands in Matte, Satin, Gloss or Underfired, with the Si:Al ratio next to it. Alkali above 0.30 adds a crazing note.

Drag a material bar on the home screen. The parts follow your finger, the point moves, and the zone name changes the moment it crosses a line. Let go to keep it. A recipe with no flux is not saved.

Read the unity formula in three columns and share it. Drag the batch ruler from 500 to 20000 g and get the grams of each material; the grams add up to the bucket. Add a photo of the fired tile and mark how it came out. When the tile and the chart disagree, the recipe card says so.

Zone lines follow the published Stull chart and are an approximation. Recipes stay on this iPhone. There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: GradientPier
description:
Build an opaque colour gradient from explicit stops, compare its appearance, and export useful files for your design work.

• Edit a gradient with 2 to 16 colour stops and explicit positions.
• Choose linear or radial geometry and compare sRGB with linear-light interpolation.
• Preview the current saved colours and geometry before export.
• Generate an actual opaque PNG, SVG and CSS output from the same gradient.
• Keep frozen export assets independently from later edits to the source gradient.

Exports use opaque RGB colours. GradientPier is not a photo editor or a colour-managed print proofing application. Export dimensions and pixel budgets are bounded, and all required files must succeed before an asset is saved.

Your saved work stays in this app’s local library. Use the system sharing controls when you choose to export a file. System backups may include app data.

name: Gymprov
description:
Any room. Real workout.

Take one photo of the space you are in. Gymprov looks at what is actually there (a rug, a wall, a chair, a set of stairs, a full gym) and builds a timed workout around it in seconds.

HOW IT WORKS
- Snap your space, or pick a photo from your library
- Choose 5, 10, 20 or 30 minutes and how hard you want to go
- Get a workout fitted to your level, your goal and the areas you want to protect (knees, back, shoulders, wrists)
- Press start and follow the timer

BUILT FOR REAL LIFE
- Room mode for bedrooms, living rooms, hotel rooms, offices and garages
- Gym mode for when you have equipment in front of you
- A "Watch how" link on every move opens a how-to search on YouTube
- Three voice coaches: Sarge, the Comedian and the Machine
- A day streak, a history of every workout, and a card to share your plan

SMART TIMERS
- AMRAP, For Time, EMOM, Tabata and custom mixes
- Save your favourites as presets
- Lock screen alerts when a round changes, so you can put the phone down

Gymprov is free to try: your first 2 workouts are on us, and the timers are free.

GYMPROV UNLIMITED
A new workout from any room or gym, whenever you want one.
- Yearly: $39.99 per year
- Monthly: $6.99 per month
Prices are in US dollars and may vary by country. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel any time in your iPhone's Settings under your Apple ID, then Subscriptions.

Workouts are written by an AI model from your photo and are general fitness information, not medical advice. Check with a doctor before starting a new exercise programme.

Terms of Use: https://gymprov-api.onrender.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://gymprov-api.onrender.com/privacy

name: Hai, Moldova: Travel Guide
description:
Go green. Go Moldova.

Hai, Moldova is a free travel companion for Moldova, made by a local team that guides visitors every week. Ask Hai a question, get a real answer, and spend your time on the trip instead of on research.

ASK HAI, IN YOUR LANGUAGE
• Ask anything in English, Romanian or Russian. Hai understands typos and asks back when a question is unclear.
• Answers come with photo cards of the places, opening hours and how to get there.
• Places, guides and the bus planner work offline too.

A DAY PLAN BUILT AROUND THE WEATHER
• Tell Hai how many days you have and what you love: wine, monasteries, nature, food, fortresses or nightlife.
• Every day out is built around a day tour with a local guide: underground wine cellars when it rains, cliffs and countryside when the sun is out.
• Evenings back in Chișinău, with dinner, a show and a walk nearby.

DAY TOURS WITH LOCAL GUIDES
• Day tours by Moldovatovisit & Tours to Old Orhei, Cricova, Mileștii Mici, Brănești and more.
• See real photos from our trips, then book on Tripadvisor or plan your trip with us on WhatsApp.

DISCOVER 70 PLACES
• Wineries, castles and fortresses, monasteries, nature, rural stays, restaurants and city sights.
• Most photos are taken by our own team. Like places, mark where you’ve been, and Hai learns what you enjoy.

WHAT’S ON
• Concerts, theatre, festivals and wine events, updated through the day.
• Filter by type and by language, and see the important days of the year.

THE PRACTICAL BITS
• Buses and trolleybuses in Chișinău, step by step, from the airport to your street.
• Exchange offices, ATMs, banks and pharmacies by area.
• Visa notes, today’s exchange rates and the weather.
• Clubs and bars are 18+: Hai asks your age once before showing nightlife.

MADE WITH CARE FOR YOUR PRIVACY
• No account needed. If you want one, sign in with Apple, Google or email; your account stays on your phone.
• Anonymous statistics only, and you can switch them off.
• Optional notifications: a daily tour idea and news.

Free to use. Some places in the app are sponsored and clearly marked.

Hai means “let’s go”. Hai, Moldova!

name: Hanger Span
description:
Hanger Span names the pipe run whose span passes the mark for that size.

Drag the span. DN15 allows 1.5 m, DN25 allows 2.1 m, DN40 allows 2.7 m, DN50 allows 3.0 m, DN80 allows 3.6 m, and DN100 allows 4.2 m. The run that overruns the most is named. A span under 0.6 m is not stored. Changing the size does not rewrite the stored span. The last run stays.

A photo stays on the iPhone and is not part of the span. Share an English run list when you choose to. There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: Hangul by Name: Learn Korean
description:
Put the names you love on a shelf in Hangul, and learn to read Korean letters in the order they appear in those names. Instead of the textbook order, you start with the letters you will actually see again and again, so every new letter shows up in a name right away.

NAME SHELF
- Type or paste a name in Hangul
- Watch each syllable split into its initial, vowel and final letters as you type
- See which letters are new, being learned or learned

TODAY'S LETTERS (1-2 a day)
- The most frequent letters in your names come first; letters you missed come back
- Shape, sound (romanization), a memory tip and examples for each letter
- Hear it in Korean

QUIZZES
- See a syllable and pick its sound
- Listen and pick the syllable
- Build syllables and whole names from letter tiles

"I CAN READ IT!" CARDS
- Learn every letter in a name to earn its card
- Share it as an image or text

LETTER TABLE
- All 40 letters in four groups, tap for details

DAILY REMINDER (optional)

FREE
- Up to 2 names
- The 14 basic consonants and 10 basic vowels

PRO (monthly or yearly)
- Unlimited names
- The 5 tense consonants and 11 compound vowels
- Final consonant (batchim) lessons: 27 spellings, 7 sounds
- Spaced-repetition review
- 30 words fans use every day, with real pronunciation

Pro is an auto-renewable subscription (US$0.99 per month or US$6.99 per year; prices vary by region). Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it in the Settings app under your Apple ID > Subscriptions.

SPEECH
Pronunciation uses the Korean voice built into iPhone.

PRIVACY
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your names and progress stay on your device and are never sent anywhere.

The app contains no names of real people; you enter names yourself. It is not affiliated with any artist, group, agency, show or streaming service.

Terms of Use (Apple standard EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://ookura-privacy.web.app/hangulname/en/

name: Heddle by madeforth
description:
Heddle for iPhone is a companion to Heddle on your Mac. Pair the two, then follow your projects when you step away from your desk.

See which sessions are running or waiting for you. Read project conversations, respond to an agent's question and send a new prompt to your Mac. Add a photo to explain a change, or dictate your message. Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets show a compact view of your work.

Requires Heddle on a Mac with an internet connection. Your Mac runs the coding agents and must remain online for new work and updates. The iPhone app does not run coding agents locally. Agent subscriptions and API usage use your own provider accounts.

Heddle is free during alpha.

name: Hey Morn
description:
Hey Morn is an alarm you cannot end from your bed.

A normal alarm stops when you tap one button. Then you sleep again. Hey Morn asks for proof that you are up.

HOW IT WORKS
• The alarm rings at your wake time, also in Silent mode and in a Focus.
• The Stop button ends one ring only. A backup alarm rings 2 minutes later. Each alarm has 5 backups.
• Only a finished mission cancels the backups.
• After the mission, you have 5 minutes to walk 30 steps. If you stay in bed, one more alarm rings.

MISSIONS
• Leave the bed: walk 30 steps.
• Barcode: scan a barcode that you saved in another room (Pro).
• Math: solve 3 problems.
• Shake: shake the phone 30 times.

TASK SETS
After the alarm, start a short task set for your morning. Choose a ready set, such as 5 AM Club, Gym morning, or Calm start. Or make your own set from 46 tasks in 5 categories. You can also add your own tasks and categories. Many tasks have a proof, for example a step count or a timer.

READY CHECK AND WAKE REPORT
• The Ready Check at bedtime tells you if your alarm is ready for the morning.
• The Wake Report shows your wake time, the backups that you used, your mission time, and your streak.

PRIVATE
Hey Morn has no account. The app sends no data to us. Your alarms and your history stay on your iPhone.

FREE PLAN
1 alarm, 3 missions (leave the bed, math, shake), 1 task set with 4 tasks, and 7 days of Wake Report history.

HEY MORN PRO
Unlimited alarms and task sets, the barcode mission, up to 8 tasks in a set, and the full Wake Report history.
• Yearly: $29.99 a year, with a 3-day free trial.
• Monthly: $4.99 a month.
Prices can be different in your country. Apple charges the payment to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage and cancel the subscription in the settings of your App Store account.

GOOD TO KNOW
The alarm cannot ring if the iPhone is off, the battery is empty, or you delete the app. Hey Morn needs iOS 26 or later.

Terms of use: https://heymorn.app/terms
Privacy policy: https://heymorn.app/privacy

name: Hingemeter: Duo Fold Counter
description:
Hingemeter counts every open and close of your iPhone Duo and turns it into stats worth looking at.

TODAY
A live hinge dial follows the fold from closed to flat. See folds today, opens, time spent open and your streak.

STATS
Daily, monthly and all-time charts, plus a heatmap of the hours and weekdays you fold most.

HINGE
A lifetime odometer, how much of the reference lifetime you've used, and how long it lasts at your pace. Share a hinge report when you sell or trade in.

CREASE CHECK
Full-screen test patterns make the crease easy to see. Log how it changes as the count climbs.

WIDGETS
Today's count on your Home Screen and Lock Screen.

COUNTS IN THE BACKGROUND
Two quick Shortcuts automations keep counting while the app is closed. The app walks you through it.

PRIVATE
Everything stays on your iPhone. No account, no ads.

Apple has not published a hinge rating. The reference lifetime comes from public stress tests and can be changed in Settings.

HINGEMETER PRO
Pro unlocks full history, the heatmap, the hinge projection and report, the crease journal, all widgets and accent themes.
• Pro Yearly: auto-renewing yearly subscription
• Pro Lifetime: one-time purchase, no subscription

Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription anytime in Settings.

Terms of Use: https://marcusthuvesen.github.io/appstackstudio-legal/hingemeter/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://marcusthuvesen.github.io/appstackstudio-legal/hingemeter/privacy/

name: Hold Day
description:
Hold Day names the batch you open before its hold ends.

Tap the day on the November calendar. If that day is before the hold ends, the earliest batch is named. A hold under 1 day is not stored. Changing the hold does not rewrite the opened day. The last batch stays.

A photo stays on the iPhone and is not part of the opened day. There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: IAG Zürich
description:
Die offizielle App der Islamischen Albanischen Gemeinschaft Zürich (IAG), zweisprachig auf Deutsch und Albanisch.

• Gebetszeiten für Zürich mit Countdown zum nächsten Gebet und Monatsübersicht
• Erinnerungen an die Gebetszeiten, pro Gebet wählbar und auch ohne Internet
• Kibla-Kompass mit Richtung und Entfernung zur Kaaba
• Mitteilungen der Moschee: Neuigkeiten, Veranstaltungen, Live-Ders
• Live-Ders: Vorträge des Imams live mitverfolgen, mit Bild oder nur Ton
• Islamische Feiertage mit Datum
• Mitgliedschaft online beantragen; «Mein Bereich» für Mitglieder (Beiträge, Mitteilungen)
• Kontakt und Vorstand

Der Standort für Kibla und Gebetszeiten bleibt auf deinem Gerät.

name: ibidauto
description:
ibidauto is the official customer portal of Sangar Ahmed Abdulla Company (Sangar Group) in Kurdistan Region, Iraq.

Authorised dealership customers can:
- Search over 140,000 US auction vehicles with detailed specifications, HD photos, damage reports, and scheduled sale times.
- Estimate total landed cost to Iraq, Turkey, or Dubai with the built-in towing & freight calculator.
- Track active bids, won vehicles, USD invoices, payment statements, and container shipping stages in Kurdish Sorani, Arabic, and English.

Note: An active customer access code issued by our dealership office is required to sign in.

name: Infrasis
description:
Infrasis keeps a commercial build's progress in one place: every trade, on every level and zone, updated from site.

FOR SUBCONTRACTORS
• See the work released to your company, level by level
• Update progress with a slider, a note and photos
• Call an inspection when an area is ready
• See defects raised against your work, fix them and mark them fixed with a photo

FOR HEAD CONTRACTORS
• Release areas to trades
• Pass inspections, or fail them with a list of defects, each with its room and photos
• Check fixed defects and close them
• See what's waiting on you across the job

BUILT FOR SITE
• Works without signal: updates are saved on your phone and sent in order when you're back in range
• Notifications when work is released, inspections are called, passed or failed, and defects are raised or fixed
• A dated record of who did what, where and when

Infrasis is for head contractors and subcontractors on commercial jobs. Your head contractor invites your company to the job, or set up your company at infrasis.com.

name: Inkome for Amazon KDP
description:
See what your books earn on KDP, beautifully displayed on your iPhone.

Sign in to KDP Reports once, right in the app. From then on, Inkome reads your figures the way the Reports page does and lays them out in one calm overview: royalties, orders and Kindle Unlimited pages - today, this month and since your first sale.

• Every period KDP offers - today, yesterday, the last 7, 30 or 90 days, this month, last month, year to date, the last 12 months, lifetime - and any range you pick
• A chart you can scrub, by day or by month
• Your titles ranked by royalties, with their covers
• A page for each book: orders by format, KU pages, month by month
• Your markets, with each one's share of orders
• Amounts in your own currency - KDP converts all royalties for you
• Light and dark appearance, in 8 languages

Private by design
Your KDP session and your figures stay on your iPhone. There is no server and no Inkome account. Inkome collects nothing and shows no ads.

Free. No subscription, no in-app purchases.

Want to look around first? Tap "See it with sample data".

Sign in with your Amazon password. Amazon passkeys work only in web browsers and Amazon's own apps.

Made by Vilusion, an independent studio. Not affiliated with Amazon. KDP and Kindle Unlimited are trademarks of Amazon.com, Inc. or its affiliates.

name: Intrateji
description:
Yazılım projenizi birkaç soruyla başlatın, teklifinizi 30 dakika içinde alın; teklifinizi, sözleşmenizi ve projenizin gidişini tek uygulamadan yönetin.

Intrateji, 2016'dan beri web ve mobil uygulamalar, özel yazılımlar ve yapay zekâ çözümleri geliştiren bir yazılım ve teknoloji danışmanlığı firmasıdır. İstanbul, Londra ve Palo Alto'daki ofislerimizden çalışıyoruz.

PROJENİZİ BAŞLATIN
• Neye ihtiyacınız olduğunu birkaç kısa adımda anlatın: ihtiyaç, kapsam, bütçe, zamanlama ve birkaç cümlelik anlatım.
• Kapsamı madde madde gösteren teklifiniz 30 dakika içinde hazırlanır. Toplantı beklemeden, e-posta trafiği olmadan.
• Hesabınız son adımda açılır; ayrı bir kayıt formu doldurmazsınız.

TEKLİFİNİZE KARAR VERİN
• Tutarı, teslim süresini ve kapsamı okuyun; teklifi kabul edin, revizyon isteyin ya da vazgeçin.
• Revize edilen teklifte neyin değiştiğini bir bakışta görün: tutar, süre, eklenen ve çıkarılan maddeler.
• Teklif belgesini PDF olarak açın, paylaşın ya da yazdırın.

PROJENİZİ TAKİP EDİN
• Sözleşmenizi ve ödeme planınızı görün.
• Üretimin hangi durakta olduğunu izleyin: keşif, projelendirme, tasarım, geliştirme, yayın.
• Akışa not bırakın; mesai saatlerinde aynı gün döneriz.
• Proje yöneticinizi tek dokunuşla arayın ya da ona e-posta yazın.
• İsterseniz teklifiniz ya da sözleşmeniz hazır olduğunda ve üretim başladığında bildirimle haber veririz.

BİZİ TANIYIN
• Kim olduğumuzu, nasıl çalıştığımızı ve neler yaptığımızı okuyun: hizmetlerimiz, sürecimiz, kendi ürünlerimiz ve birlikte çalıştığımız markalar.
• Ofislerimizin adresi, telefonu ve haritası bir dokunuş uzağınızda; mesajınızı birkaç seçimle hazırlayıp kendi e-postanızdan gönderin.

NELER YAPARIZ?
Web geliştirme, mobil uygulamalar, backend, API ve bulut, yazılım danışmanlığı, dijital pazarlama ve yapay zekâ otomasyonları: fikrinizi projelendirir, tasarlar, geliştirir ve büyütürüz.

HESABINIZ VE VERİLERİNİZ
Hesabınız intra.intrateji.co'daki müşteri portalıyla ortaktır; aynı projeleri tarayıcıdan da açabilirsiniz. Uygulamada reklam ve izleme yoktur. Hesabınızı dilediğiniz zaman Profil'den silebilirsiniz.

Sorularınız için: bilgi@intrateji.co

name: iScamChecker
description:
Got a strange text, WhatsApp, email or link? Before you click, pay or reply, ask iScamChecker.

Paste the message, add a screenshot, or simply tap Share in WhatsApp, Messages, Mail or Safari and choose iScamChecker. In a few seconds you get a clear answer - Looks safe, Suspicious or Scam! - with the warning signs explained in plain words and exactly what to do next.

WHAT IT CHECKS
• Text messages and WhatsApp messages ("Hi Mum, this is my new number…")
• Emails and fake invoices
• Links and websites
• Screenshots of messages, social-media offers and QR codes
• Fake bank, tax-office, parcel-delivery and police messages
• Romance, job, investment and crypto offers that are too good to be true

WHY PEOPLE LOVE IT
• Clear verdict with a risk score - no technical words
• The reasons we found, so you learn to spot scams yourself
• Concrete next steps: don't click, block the sender, call your bank on the official number
• Answers in your own language
• Share the warning with family or friends in one tap
• Works for every age - ideal to install on your parents' phone

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. We don't keep the messages you check - only the result is counted.

SIMPLE PRICING
Your first 3 checks are free. After that, buy a pack of 25 checks whenever you need it. No subscription.

iScamChecker gives an automatic assessment, not a guarantee. When money, passwords or personal details are involved, always contact the company yourself using contact details you already trust.

name: IsoLock - Offline Local Vault
description:
IsoLock is an encrypted vault with no servers, no sign-up, no ads, no analytics, and no third-party SDKs. Your private notes, photos, videos, and files stay encrypted on your iPhone and are never sent to the developer.

■ Key Features

• Encrypted on your device Notes, photos, and files are encrypted with AES-256 and stored on your device. The device-only secret used for encryption is kept in the iOS Keychain (Secure Enclave) and never leaves the device. If you use iOS device backups, vault files are included only in encrypted form, and on a new or reset device they open only with your Recovery PIN.

• Pattern lock and Recovery PIN Unlock with a pattern on a 5×5 grid. If you forget your pattern or move to a new device, open the app with your Recovery PIN and set a new pattern. The app locks as soon as you leave it, and its content is hidden in the app switcher.

• Three kinds of vaults Create as many Text (notes), Files (documents, PDFs, videos, and more), and Photos vaults as you need. Videos go into a Files vault and play right in the app. You can also add a separate 6-digit PIN to any vault.

• Add from other apps In Photos or Files, tap Share > IsoLock. Items are stored encrypted right away, even before you open the app, and you choose a vault for them the next time you unlock.

• As easy as the Photos app Slide your finger across photos to select many at once, then export, move, or delete them. Deleted items stay in "Recently Deleted" for 3 days, so you can recover them.

• Hidden while recording Vault content is hidden automatically while the screen is being recorded or mirrored, and you are notified when a screenshot is taken.

• Minimal permissions Photos and files come only from the iOS pickers, so the app receives just what you choose. It never asks to read your whole photo library and requests add-only access only when you use "Save to Photos".

• No tracking, no ads Start right away without an account or sign-in. There are no ads and no third-party analytics.

■ Free and Premium Free use includes up to 3 vaults, 10 MB per text vault, 300 MB per file vault, and 100 photos per photo vault. Premium (monthly or yearly auto-renewing subscription, or a one-time lifetime purchase) removes these limits. If a subscription ends, you can still view and export everything you already saved.

■ Important If you forget both your pattern and your Recovery PIN, no one, including the developer, can open your vaults. Write your Recovery PIN down somewhere safe.

■ Subscriptions and Payment • Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. • Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. • Renewal is charged within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. • Manage or cancel subscriptions in the Settings app under Apple Account > Subscriptions, or in IsoLock under Settings > Support & Info > Manage Subscription. Restore Purchases is in the same place.

■ Terms and Support • Privacy Policy & Terms: https://saber-wave-c00.notion.site/IsoLock-Privacy-Policy-Terms-41f77b123d6a80c3a812e097986ab555 • Apple Standard EULA: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/ • Support: strongman1158@naver.com

name: Jet Swarm
description:
Lead a squadron of jets through a sky full of trouble.

Jet Swarm is a fast 3D action game you play with one thumb. Drag to steer, fly through ring gates to add jets to your squadron, and let every jet open fire. The bigger your swarm, the harder you hit.

GROW YOUR SQUADRON
Blue gates add jets. Red gates take them away. Shoot a gate before you reach it to raise its number, and keep firing at a red gate to turn it blue.

THE SKY SHOOTS BACK
Enemy fighters weave across your path. Heavy bombers soak up fire. Aces shoot back, darts hunt you down, mines chain together and laser lanes burn after a short warning. New threats arrive as you climb the levels.

BREAK THE BOSS
Each level ends with an armoured warship. Fight through its three phases, expose the reactor core and bring it down. Then line up on the runway and land your survivors.

BUILD YOUR AIR FORCE
Spend the coins you win on your airbase: more starting jets, stronger cannons, faster fire, missile pods and armour. Unlock new aircraft and recruit pilots, each with a special strike.

MORE TO CHASE
Keep your combo alive to trigger fever mode. Skim past danger for close-call bonuses. Grab power-ups for rapid fire and shields. Stuck on a level? Reinforcements join your next attempt.

No account is needed. Your progress is saved on your device.

Jet Swarm is free to play. It offers optional in-app purchases of coins, gems and item packs, and optional rewarded video ads that you choose to watch for a bonus.

Help: jetswarm.neu.so/support
Privacy: jetswarm.neu.so/privacy
Terms: jetswarm.neu.so/terms

name: Joshi Astrologer: Vedic Kundli
description:
Your Vedic birth chart, calculated exactly, and books generated from it.
Enter your date, time and place of birth once. Joshi Astrologer calculates your kundli, navamsa and Vimshottari dasha, then generates personal Codex books from those exact positions: typeset like a printed volume, readable offline, in English, Hindi or Gujarati.

FREE IN THE APP
• Birth chart in the North Indian style: lagna, moon rashi, nakshatra and pada, and all nine grahas with sign, degree and house
• Navamsa (D9) chart when your birth time is known
• Vimshottari dasha timeline with start and end dates, the running period marked
• Birth panchang: the tithi, paksha and vaar of the day you were born
• Numerology: life path, destiny, soul urge, personality, birthday and personal year, your Chaldean name number, Lo Shu grid and personal months, with the working shown
• The 12 rashis: element, ruling planet and character of each
• Naming syllables (namkaran akshar) for all 27 nakshatras and their padas, plus yours from your chart

Numerology, rashis and naming syllables work on your device. The birth chart is calculated on our server and needs an internet connection.

THE CODEX BOOKS (IN-APP PURCHASE)
Ten books, each generated for one person from their own chart. Buy one, or the Complete Codex: all ten bound as one 250–350 page volume with a page-numbered table of contents.
• Janmakshar: Naming & Birth Chart
• The Numerology Codex
• The Vedic Chart Codex
• The Dasha Timeline Codex
• The Transits Codex: the year's transits over your natal chart
• The Tarot Codex
• The Career & Wealth Codex
• The Love & Marriage Codex
• The Health & Remedies Codex: remedies, mantras and gemstones
• The Daily Almanac 365: every day of the year with its tithi and paksha

HOW DELIVERY WORKS
After you buy, your book is generated on our servers from your birth details. A single book usually takes 20 to 45 minutes; the Complete Codex can take around three hours. You can close the app. The finished PDF downloads into your Library and is also emailed to you. Once downloaded it reads offline, and the reader remembers your page.

WHAT MAKES IT DIFFERENT
• Calculated, not generic: every chart value comes from your own date, time and place of birth. No sun-sign columns.
• No birth time? The app tells you which values become approximate and which stay exact.
• If your birthplace can't be found on the map, your book is paused rather than printed with the wrong chart.
• Planet, sign and nakshatra names and every number appear exactly as calculated, in all three languages. Only the prose is translated.
• The calculations are exact. The reading text in each book is composed from them with AI assistance and typeset as a book.

THREE LANGUAGES
English, हिन्दी and ગુજરાતી, for both the app and the books.

YOUR DATA
Your birth details are kept on your device. They are sent to our server to calculate your chart and, when you buy, to generate and deliver your book. No ads, no third-party tracking, no account to create.

Each purchase buys one personal book for the birth details entered, and can be bought again for another person. Books stay in the Library on your device and are also emailed to you.

Astrology and numerology readings are for guidance and self-reflection. They are not medical, legal or financial advice, and no outcome is guaranteed.

name: JRCMax
description:
Welcome! We hope this app helps you work more efficiently, and we look forward to your suggestions.

We are dedicated to ongoing upgrades that make Joy Stage clearer and more useful, and if the stage bar, spends, Quiet Fills, or insights ever misbehave, tell us quickly so we can make it right.

Spark, People, Make, Body, and Quiet blur together until a rest day feels spent without a plan. JRCMax gives you a Joy stage home with a local max bar, then lets you log spends, tune Cap, park Quiet Fills, browse Fuel atlas, and read day or week lines. It is a personal on-device lifestyle utility only—no cloud vault.

Log spends, watch Cap, add Quiet Fills, open Fuel atlas and Insights. Optional photos stay on this iPhone. Settings let you export a backup or clear local data whenever you want a clean start.

Private by design: no account, no ads, no tracking, and no upload of your vault. Spends, quiet blocks, preferences, and notices stay on this iPhone. JRCMax only helps you see the joy stage—it never sells your data and never requires a login to begin.

name: Juju Alley: Teppan Puzzle
description:
Juju Alley is a fresh chain puzzle played on a sizzling teppan griddle.

Your little teppan stall has opened in a sleepy, retro Japanese alley. Serve delicious food, make your customers happy, and bring the closed shops back to life one by one.

[EASY TO PLAY]
- Drag through 3 or more of the same food
- Sparkly "ready" food is served to customers
- Raw food cooks one step every time you chain it
- Serve now, or cook first? That choice is what makes Juju Alley special

[BUILD POWER TOOLS]
- 5+ chain: Spatula clears a whole line
- 7+ chain: Sauce splashes the area
- 9+ chain: Big Flame serves every food of one kind
- Combine tools for a huge "Big Order" blast!

[REVIVE THE ALLEY]
- Earn stars by clearing levels and restore shops
- Shopkeepers return as cute residents
- Restored shops earn coins in your register
- Complete the resident book

[1000+ LEVELS]
- Burnt crust, grease, steamers, frozen food, deliveries, high heat and snack cats
- New griddle shapes and surprises every level

[DAILY FUN]
- A free fortune draw every day
- Daily bonus and missions
- Lucky Cat Bank and Festival Pass

Juju Alley is free to play. Some items can be purchased with real money. The game shows ads; the "No Ads" purchase removes interstitial and banner ads.

name: Kawumm!
description:
Kawumm! is the bomb maze for your phone. Place bombs, blow up crates, grab power-ups and be the last robot standing.

100 LEVELS IN 10 WORLDS
• Factory, Ice World, Desert, Lava Cave, Jungle, Neon City, Deep Sea, Scrapyard, Outer Space and Bomb Castle
• Every world adds something new: ice blocks, fire jets, teleporters
• Three stars in every level – for winning, for speed and for winning before the Bomb Hail

BOSSES AND BONUS ROUNDS
A boss with a crown waits at the end of every world and takes several hits. After every fifth level there is a bonus round: coin rain or treasure hunt.

POWER-UPS FROM CRATES
More bombs, bigger blasts, more speed, bomb kicking, remote detonator and piercing blast. But watch out for the oil slick!

FREE PLAY
Take on three robots at three difficulty levels. The first to win three rounds is the champion. From 1:30 bombs rain from the sky.

SOMETHING NEW EVERY DAY
• Daily bonus with a growing streak
• Three new tasks every day
• Achievements and stats

ROBOTS AND ARENAS
Use coins to unlock new robot colours and arenas. Defeated bosses unlock their world as an arena.

FAIR AND OFFLINE
• All 100 levels are free
• Ads only when you start a video for coins yourself – no forced ads
• Coin doubler is a one-time purchase, no subscription
• Works without an internet connection
• Music, effects and voice lines can be set separately
• Works in portrait and landscape
• Languages: English, German, Spanish

Have fun blowing things up!

name: Kiesel: Selbstfürsorge
description:
Kiesel ist ein kleiner Otter, der dich durch deinen Tag begleitet. Jeden Tag gibt es einen Plan mit fünf kleinen Schritten, ruhige Atemübungen und Klänge zum Einschlafen. Für jeden Schritt, den du für dich tust, sammelst du Steine am Flussufer.

DEIN PLAN FÜR HEUTE
Fünf kleine Schritte pro Tag, zusammengestellt aus deinen Antworten beim Start. Ein Glas Wasser, eine Minute Atmen, ein kurzer Blick auf deine Stimmung. Nichts davon dauert lange, und jeder Schritt zählt.

ATMEN UND ZUR RUHE KOMMEN
Atemübungen mit einem Kreis, der mit dir ein- und ausatmet: 4-7-8, Box-Atmung und lange Ausatmung. Dazu kurze geführte Übungen für Momente, in denen dir alles zu viel wird, zum Beispiel «5 Dinge sehen» oder «Mein Kopf rast». Kiesel hilft dir, kurz innezuhalten und zur Ruhe zu kommen.

KLÄNGE MIT SCHLAF-TIMER
Ruhige Klänge wie Regen am Flussufer, die sich endlos wiederholen. Mit dem Schlaf-Timer hören sie von selbst auf, wenn du eingeschlafen bist.

STIMMUNG, SCHLAF UND SERIE
Trag ein, wie es dir geht und wie lange du geschlafen hast. Der Verlauf zeigt dir die letzten 14 Tage, deine Serie und wie sich deine Woche im Vergleich zur Vorwoche anfühlt.

SCHREIB MIT KIESEL
Erzähl Kiesel, was dich beschäftigt. Kiesel antwortet mit kurzen, freundlichen Sätzen und schlägt dir eine passende Übung vor. Der Chat läuft direkt auf deinem iPhone, ohne Server.

TÄGLICHE ERINNERUNG
Wenn du willst, erinnert dich Kiesel einmal am Tag an einen kleinen Schritt. Die Uhrzeit wählst du selbst.

DEINE DATEN BLEIBEN BEI DIR
Kein Konto, keine Werbung. Deine Einträge bleiben auf deinem iPhone. In den Einstellungen kannst du jederzeit alle Daten löschen.

WICHTIG
Kiesel ersetzt keine ärztliche oder therapeutische Behandlung. Wenn es dir sehr schlecht geht, hol dir bitte Hilfe: Telefonseelsorge Deutschland 116 123, Österreich 142, Schweiz 143, im Notfall 112.

name: Kiln Ring
description:
Kiln Ring listens to one knock and tells you how the piece cooled.

After you unload, hold Listen and tap the rim once with a knuckle. The phone keeps the sound for a second and a half, draws the decay, and times how long the ring takes to fall 20 dB. At 0.35 s or longer it is Rings. From 0.15 s it is a Short ring. Under 0.15 s it is Dull. Two peaks a few hertz apart are a Split tone.

Each piece sits on a shelf of the kiln map. Dull and split pieces that touch are drawn as a Cluster. Drag a piece to another cell and the cluster updates. The first three clear rings of a form set its pitch. A later ring more than 6 percent away is marked Off pitch, high or low.

Compare two firings shelf by shelf, and share a plain unload sheet. The recording is not kept. Pieces, forms and firings stay on this iPhone. There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: Krampus Heist
description:
Every winter, the town gets louder, brighter and more full of jingles. Krampus has had enough. Tonight he sneaks in, grabs the presents and slips out before anyone notices.

Krampus Heist is a turn-based stealth puzzle game. Every move counts: you step, then the guards step. Read their lines of sight, time your moves and find the cleverest route to the chimney.

SNEAK, DON'T RUSH
• Elves watch in straight lines — stay out of their light or hide in snowdrifts and sacks
• Patrols walk fixed routes: wait for the right moment and slip past
• Sneak up from the side and tie a guard up with a string of lights
• Parents in pajamas turn around every move
• The house dog follows its nose — distract it with a cookie
• Slide across the frozen town square and stop exactly where you need

60 HANDCRAFTED LEVELS
Three worlds — a snowy yard, a warm house and the night market square — each introducing new tricks one at a time.

KRAMPUS WORKSHOP: 1,000 MORE PUZZLES
Twenty packs of fresh puzzles that grow harder as you go, plus a free Level of the Day every day.

MADE FOR SHORT BREAKS
• Levels take 1–3 minutes
• Unlimited undo — experiment freely
• Hints show the next best move when you're stuck
• Earn up to three stars on every level
• Plays completely offline, no account, no ads, no tracking

FREE TO PLAY
The first two worlds and the first Workshop pack are free. The optional Full Pack unlocks World 3, all Workshop packs and infinite lives, plus 10 hints. Hint packs and a lives refill are also available.

Grab your sack. The town is asleep.

name: KURULI - Video Editor & Audio
description:
Roll through your footage and land on the moment you want. KURULI is a video editor for iPhone and iPad built around a white playhead.

Use coarse and fine jog controls to inspect your video, trim, split and place media. Timeline edges snap to the playhead with haptic feedback.

• Combine video clips and still images
• Trim audio by waveform, extract audio from video, and adjust BGM volume and fades
• Add text, timers, counters, shapes and title presets
• Picture-in-picture and split screen with position, size and rotation controls
• Mosaic, blur and blackout masks with a dedicated mode for manually recording their positions
• Choose aspect ratio, export resolution and quality, with file-size estimates
• Undo/Redo, autosave, saved versions and project sharing with media

Editing tools and project saving are free. One successful video export is included, up to 1080p at 60 fps. Failed or canceled exports do not use it. A one-time KURULI Pro purchase unlocks unlimited exports and 4K. No subscription or automatic renewal.

Editing and video processing happen on your device. No app account is required. With permission, finished videos are saved to Photos, and you can also share them with other apps.

name: La Última Calle
description:
La Última Calle es un juego de conducción y suspense con vista cenital.

Eres Álex, el repartidor de la última ruta de la noche en Puerto Bruma, una ciudad costera donde cada medianoche una calle desaparece del mapa. Las farolas se apagan, el GPS insiste en girar por donde ya no hay asfalto... y aun así, la dirección del paquete sigue ahí.

¿A quién se lo entregas ahora?

CARACTERÍSTICAS
• Conduce por un barrio portuario de noche, con calles que se apagan y desaparecen.
• Habla con los vecinos: Inés, la mecánica; Lola, del Bar El Ancla; Nico, el del quiosco; Salva, el guarda del puerto, y más. Todos con voces interpretadas.
• Decide qué calle se borra a medianoche y vive las consecuencias en el mapa.
• Encuentra atajos, sigue las luces del muelle y alcanza el último ferry.
• Dos fases completas: El barrio de Inés y El último ferry.
• Controles táctiles sencillos: mantén el dedo en la pantalla y arrástralo hacia donde quieras ir.
• Sin registro, sin anuncios y sin compras dentro de la app. Tu progreso se guarda en tu iPhone.

Ponte los auriculares, apaga la luz y conduce antes de que la ciudad se olvide de ti.

name: Lantriva
description:
**Design the stage. Plan every cue. Perfect every performance.**

Lantriva is a professional stage lighting planning and operations app designed for lighting designers, theatre technicians, stage managers, and performance production teams.

From arranging lighting fixtures and programming cue sequences to managing DMX addresses, tracking rehearsals, and documenting technical adjustments, Lantriva brings essential stage lighting tools together in one intuitive iOS workspace.

### Interactive Stage Lighting Plot

Create detailed stage layouts with an interactive lighting editor. Position fixtures, adjust beam directions, organize lighting groups, and manage stage dimensions with precise visual controls.

### Lighting Cue Programming

Build and organize lighting cue sequences with customizable fade times, hold durations, fixture groups, and timing settings. Edit cue timelines, arrange transitions, and save different versions of your lighting plans.

### DMX Patch Management

Manage lighting fixtures, DMX universes, channel assignments, and fixture modes. Detect overlapping addresses, review channel allocations, and keep your lighting configurations organized.

### Live Rehearsal Tracking

Run cue sequences through a dedicated rehearsal workspace. Use GO, HOLD, and BACK controls to record cue execution, track timing differences, and document rehearsal notes.

### Technical Logs & Maintenance

Keep detailed records of lighting adjustments, fixture inspections, maintenance tasks, and rehearsal history. Compare different runs and track technical issues over time.

### Key Features

- Interactive stage lighting plot editor
- Fixture positioning and beam visualization
- Lighting groups and focus settings
- Custom cue lists and timeline editing
- Fade and hold time configuration
- DMX universe and address management
- Channel conflict detection
- Rehearsal cue execution tracking
- GO, HOLD, and BACK recording controls
- Fixture inspection and maintenance logs
- Cue revision and rehearsal history
- PDF reports and data export
- Offline functionality and local data storage

### Built for Stage Lighting Professionals

Lantriva combines creative lighting design, technical planning, and practical rehearsal tools in one focused workspace.

Whether you're preparing a theatre production, organizing a live performance, or refining lighting cues during rehearsals, Lantriva helps keep every detail structured and accessible.

Lantriva is a planning and recording tool and does not directly control physical lighting equipment.

**Plan the lights. Refine the cues. Bring every scene to life.**

name: LassoMind: AI Notes & Planner
description:
Write it down. It's already planned.

LassoMind is the notebook that plans for you. Write naturally with Apple Pencil, and your notes turn into reminders, calendar events and meeting summaries, all gathered in one beautiful Planner next to your calendar.

YOUR NOTES BECOME YOUR PLAN
- Draw a box and write a task. LassoMind offers to make it a to-do, a reminder or a calendar event.
- Write a whole list and convert every task at once.
- Write a time, like "call Ana 3pm", and get a reminder at 3pm.
- Tick a box with your Pencil to complete it, anywhere: on the page, in a checklist, in today's agenda.

ONE PLANNER FOR EVERYTHING
- See your day, week or month: events and reminders together, with a "now" line.
- Every to-do, reminder and meeting from all your notes, in one place.
- Choose which calendars and reminder lists to show.
- Check things off right from the Planner, or tap to jump to the note.

NEVER MISS A MEETING NOTE
- When a meeting is about to start, LassoMind offers to record it and opens a note for it.
- Recordings are transcribed on your iPad. Audio is never sent to us or to any AI service.
- Get a summary, key takeaways and action items, then send tasks to Reminders or straight onto the page.

CIRCLE IT, UNDERSTAND IT
- Draw the AI Lasso around any handwriting, a page, a PDF or a whole notebook.
- Get a summary, takeaways and action items, or chat with your notes.
- Study mode turns class notes into key concepts, a practice quiz and flashcards.

A BEAUTIFUL PLACE TO WRITE
- Every Apple Pencil ink, the eraser, ruler and lasso, in a pen bar you can arrange.
- Lined, grid, dotted and dark paper, smooth zoom, and pages that turn like a real notebook.
- Section dividers with dates, meeting sections, collapsible sections.
- Typed text with headings, lists and checklists, tables, photos, scans and math with graphs.
- Pen gestures: scribble to delete, strike through text, double-underline to make a heading.

PDFs, REMINDERS AND CALENDAR, LIVE ON THE PAGE
- Import PDFs to annotate, or attach them to any page and snap sections into your notes.
- Add live reminder cards and checklists you can complete on the page.
- Drop today's agenda onto a page: events and reminders due today, with times.

ORGANIZED WITHOUT TRYING
- Folders and subfolders, pins, #tags, Smart Folders, links between notes and @mentions.
- Search typed text, handwriting and meeting transcripts.
- Siri, Spotlight, widgets and Control Center: start a quick note or a recording in one tap.
- Lock private notes with Face ID.
- Export to PDF, Word or Markdown, or print.
- Optional iCloud sync across your iPads, and daily backups to a folder you choose.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
- Handwriting recognition and transcription run on your iPad.
- Recordings stay on your iPad, and in your own iCloud only if you turn on sync.
- AI runs on your iPad with Apple Intelligence: your notes are never sent to an AI service.

PLANS
- Free: 3 notebooks, this week's planner pages, 3 recordings and 10 AI results.
- LassoMind Full: a one-time purchase that unlocks everything: unlimited notebooks, planner pages for any date, unlimited recordings, meeting minutes and on-device AI. No subscription.
