Privacy Policy: https://sites.google.com/view/lassomind-privacy

Recording laws differ by place: always let people know before you record a conversation.

name: LightRoll
description:
LightRoll helps you free up space in Photos. Sort your videos by size, select the ones you want, and tap Compress & Replace. LightRoll downloads iCloud originals as needed and processes your videos on your device.

Each conversion fits the picture within 1080p, preserves its orientation, and exports at 30 frames per second in an HEVC QuickTime movie. LightRoll checks that the result is smaller and verifies the video, audio, and HDR before requesting removal of the original. Photos manages its deletion confirmation and Recently Deleted.

Video Info shows file size, capture date, resolution, and available camera metadata. Capture dates, locations, favorites, captions, keywords, and editable album memberships are carried over where Photos permits. The compressed copy is a new Photos item. Spatial, Cinematic, and slow-motion videos are protected.

Select several videos at once and watch their progress in the queue. On the iPhone Duo inner display, the selection and compression controls appear beside the library, with separate regions around an active fold.

name: Lineset Pro
description:
Lineset Pro runs the day for HVAC and home service companies, from the first call to the paid invoice.

Leads: every new request in one place, sorted by what needs a call first. See who was contacted, who needs a follow-up, and what is quoted.

Quotes: build a quote from your price book, send it, and get it signed on the spot.

Schedule: drag jobs onto the calendar, see who is where, and keep crews from double booking.

Jobs: techs see their day, add photos and checklists from site, and close out the job so the invoice goes out on its own.

Invoices and payments: send invoices, take card payments, and see what is owed.

Inbox: texts and emails with each customer in one conversation, tagged by job type and the person on it.

Built by a heat pump and insulation contractor in Nova Scotia for how trades crews actually work. Accounts are set up by your company.

name: Linesmith: Tattoo Stencil
description:
Turn a photo of your design into a printable tattoo stencil. Take a photo or pick a JPG, PNG, or HEIC from Photos or Files, then crop it to the design.

• Outline uses AI to redraw your design with bold, clean outlines.
• Hatching uses AI to redraw the outlines and shade them with hatch lines.
• Exact Trace follows the lines in your photo without AI. Use it for portraits or when likeness matters. AI styles redraw faces and can change the likeness.

On your phone, adjust Darkness and Line weight. Use Flip to mirror the stencil for transfer. Set Size by the long side in 0.1 in or 0.1 cm steps. Hold Compare to see your photo under the stencil. Preview in black or transfer violet. Prints, PDFs, and PNGs stay black.

Print at true size on Letter or A4 with AirPrint. Each stencil prints on one sheet at a size that fits the paper. Each page includes a 1 in square and a 2 cm square to check with a ruler, plus a reminder to print at 100% with Fit to page turned off.

• Export a true-size PDF to send to a thermal or stencil printer app.
• Export a PNG with a white or transparent background to save to Photos or share.

Your last 50 stencils stay on your phone. Open one again to adjust it and reprint it. Delete one stencil or clear the whole history.

Get started without signing up or creating an account. You get 3 free AI stencils using Outline or Hatching, plus up to 50 Exact Trace stencils a day. You can also print and export PDFs and PNGs for free. Failed or refused AI requests don’t count.

Premium allows up to 30 AI stencils a day and 200 a month. Prices are shown in the app and in the store before you buy. There’s no free trial.

Linesmith is available in English and Korean. In Korean, the defaults are cm and A4.

Support https://linesmith.web.app/support/
linesmith@lifeengine.co.kr

Outline and Hatching send your photo to OpenAI to convert it. Our server doesn’t keep the photo or the stencil. Exact Trace runs on our server without AI.

Premium is a weekly, monthly, or yearly subscription. It renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Manage or cancel your subscription in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy https://linesmith.web.app/privacy/

name: Lithovellum Play
description:
Каждая находка начинается с продуманного хода.

Lithovellum Play — логическая игра о раскопках окаменелостей. Решайте, какие камни убрать, какие естественные опоры сохранить и куда поставить подпорку. Освободите путь и извлеките образец целым.

ИЗУЧАЙТЕ КАМЕННЫЙ ПЛАСТ
Выбирайте камень с буквенной меткой или гнездо для подпорки. Предварительный просмотр показывает, как изменится число опор. Отменяйте просмотр без изменения раскопа, возвращайте предыдущий ход или получайте подсказку для текущей позиции.

24 УРОВНЯ РУЧНОЙ РАБОТЫ
Исследуйте четыре пласта и находите шесть художественных типов образцов. Завершённая раскопка сохраняет результат, открывает следующий участок и пополняет коллекцию.

ПРОДОЛЖАЙТЕ ИССЛЕДОВАНИЕ
В бесконечном карьере доступны три сложности: Gentle, Standard и Expert. Созданные участки проверяются на решаемость и соответствие сложности. Сравнение недавних структур уменьшает повторы, но не гарантирует вечную уникальность каждого участка.

ДОПОЛНИТЕЛЬНЫЕ ЦЕЛИ
Шесть испытаний предлагают особые условия для выбранных уровней. Следуйте подсказкам с учётом цели или завершайте обычную раскопку, чтобы двигаться дальше. Следите за 12 локальными достижениями.

ИСТОРИЯ ВАШИХ НАХОДОК
Рассматривайте образцы, просматривайте сохранённый ход решения и делитесь изображением результата в формате PNG. Прогресс и настройки хранятся на устройстве. Фоновая музыка включается по желанию и изначально выключена. Учитывается системная настройка уменьшения движения.

Интерфейс самой игры сейчас доступен на английском языке.Разрешение на отслеживание необязательно.

Число опор — упрощённое игровое правило. Образцы являются художественными интерпретациями, а не научно подтверждёнными находками или инструкциями по настоящим раскопкам.

name: Little Months: Baby Photo Art
description:
Turn your own photos into beautiful milestone cards: baby months, pregnancy weeks, firsts, announcements and holidays. Keep them in a timeline for each child, and see your due date countdown or your baby's age right on your Lock Screen and Home Screen.

MONTHLY PHOTOS, DONE IN SECONDS
Pick a photo and choose a design. Little Months reads the day the photo was taken and fills in the age for you: "Day 10", "3 weeks", "4 months", "1 year, 2 months". Change any word you like.

132 CARD DESIGNS, ALL ORIGINAL
Badges, ribbons, arches, moon cradles, milestone blankets, letter boards, polaroids, film strips, calendar pages and hand-drawn doodle frames with hearts, stars, clouds, rainbows, flowers and balloons. Categories for Months & Weeks, Pregnancy, Firsts, Announcements, Birth Stats, Holidays (First Christmas included), Birthdays, Everyday & Funny, and Family.

MAKE IT YOURS
224 stickers, 27 fonts, text with outline or curved into an arch, 12 gentle filters made for baby skin, brightness and warmth, and four shapes for Instagram, stories and prints. Drag, pinch, rotate, undo. Save a style to "My designs" and use it every month so the series matches.

PREGNANCY, WEEK BY WEEK
Due date countdown, weeks and days, trimester and a progress ring. A size comparison for every week from 4 to 40. Weekly bump cards, a bump grid and a bump timelapse. Pregnancy announcements, gender reveal and baby shower cards. When baby arrives, your bump photos stay on the same timeline and the birth announcement card is ready.

BABY'S FIRST YEARS
Age today, total days, the next monthiversary and the first birthday countdown. Photo slots for months 1 to 24. Firsts like the first smile, first steps and first tooth, with a date, a note and a card. An optional growth log in lb/oz or kg.

STORY TOOLS
A First Year collage, Then & Now cards and a growth slideshow video, all made from your cards.

WIDGETS
16 designs for the Lock Screen, Home Screen and StandBy: countdown, size this week, baby's age, next monthiversary, your latest card, a first year grid and twins side by side.

TWINS AND SIBLINGS
Add every child, twins and triplets too. Cards can show both names.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account. Your photos never leave your iPhone, and backdrops are made on your iPhone too, with nothing uploaded. Move to a new phone with one backup file.

LITTLE MONTHS PLUS
Free: your first child, a set of designs, stickers and fonts, and two widgets. Plus unlocks every design, sticker, font, backdrop and widget, unlimited children, story tools and cards without the Little Months mark. Yearly with a 1-week free trial (we remind you 2 days before it ends), monthly, or lifetime: pay once, yours forever.

Pregnancy week information is general and not medical advice.

Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your Apple Account settings. Any unused part of a free trial is forfeited when you buy a subscription.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://littlemonths.brimapp.co/privacy

name: Locker Lock Practice: FirstTry
seller_name: Henan Zhentianlei Culture Media Co., Ltd
description:
Open your locker on the first day.

A combination lock looks simple until you are standing in a crowded hallway with two minutes before class. First Try lets you practice at home, on a dial that turns under your finger like the real thing, until the steps feel automatic.

LEARN THE STEPS
• Watch a short demo that opens the lock from start to finish.
• Then follow along. An arrow shows which way to turn, and one short line tells you where to stop.
• Right three full turns, stop on the first number. Left past the first number once, stop on the second. Right, straight to the third. Pull up.

SEE WHAT WENT WRONG
When the lock doesn't open, First Try tells you why in one sentence: you didn't clear it with three turns, you turned the wrong way, you stopped on the second number too early, you went past a number, or you made an extra turn at the end.

PRACTICE YOUR WAY
• A new random combination every time, or your own.
• Three sensitivity levels, so the dial is easy to stop on a number even on a small screen.
• A click and a tap for every mark. Both can be turned off.
• Works on iPhone and iPad, in English, Spanish and French.

YOUR COMBINATION STAYS WITH YOU
Your combination is saved only on your device. There are no accounts, no ads and no tracking, and the app collects no data.

UNLOCK EVERYTHING (one-time purchase)
Practicing, the demo, the hints and one saved lock are included. A single in-app purchase adds:
• More than one saved lock (hallway, gym, home)
• A timer and your best time for each lock
• 0–49 and 0–59 dials
• Dial colors
• A Home Screen widget that shows your combination when you forget it

No subscription. Family Sharing is supported.

First Try teaches the standard three-number dial padlock. It is a practice tool and is not affiliated with any lock maker.

name: Lucky Seven — Classic Slots
description:
Pull the lever on a classic three-reel mechanical slot machine.

Lucky Seven brings back the street-corner cabinet: three spinning reels, one or three paylines, and a 100× jackpot for three Lucky 7s. BARs, stars, cherries, and diamonds trigger extra line bonuses. Chasing cabinet bulbs, particle bursts, and synthesized arcade sound make every spin feel mechanical.

• Three reels that stop one after another
• One-line or three-line betting
• Lucky 7, BAR, star, cherry, and diamond symbols
• Smooth coin counter, win bursts, and paytable
• Optional sound with one-tap mute

All coins are virtual, have no cash value, and cannot be purchased or exchanged. No account, no ads, no in-app purchases, and no data collection.

name: Magnetic Field Detector - µT
description:
Open Magnetic Field Detector to see the total field, X/Y/Z and the last eight seconds of readings in microteslas. Tap Freeze to hold the display.

LOOK FOR CHANGES
Remove magnetic accessories, set a baseline and move at the same angle and distance. Look for changes near magnets or steel. For drywall, sweep back along the same path after a peak to see if the change repeats. Readings only give clues to shallow steel nails or screws. Use a suitable tool to check the wall before drilling.

COMPARE SPOTS
Capture multiple spots against one baseline, label the results and keep previous readings when you retake a spot. Share a field card, export a chart or CSV, or send a setup with a preset code or file.

One payment on the App Store includes all features. No subscriptions, accounts or ads. Measurements stay on your iPhone.

name: Makam – Makam Şoförü Hizmeti
description:
Makam, makam şoförü hizmeti alan yöneticiler ve asistanları için hazırlandı. Size atanmış şoför ve araç, gününüzü sizin programınıza göre yürütür.

• Günün programı tek ekranda: hangi saatte nereden alınacağınız, kim şoförünüz, hangi araç geliyor.
• Takvimden rota: toplantılarınızı işaretleyin, saat ve adresler rotaya dönüşsün.
• Kayıtlı adresler: ev, ofis, kulüp… Bir dokunuşla durak ekleyin.
• Misafirler: misafirlerinizi ve adreslerini kaydedin, kimin nereden alınacağını seçin. İzin verirseniz misafiriniz de kendi aracını takip eder.
• Canlı konum: şoförünüzün nerede olduğunu ve tahmini varış süresini görün.
• “10 dakikaya çıkıyoruz”: bekleyen şoförünüze tek dokunuşla haber verin.
• Asistan desteği: asistanınız programı sizin adınıza düzenleyebilir.
• Konumunuz varsayılan olarak kapalıdır; açarsanız yalnızca o günün şoförü görür.

Uygulama, hizmet aldığınız şoför şirketinin açtığı hesapla kullanılır.

name: Malssireum: Korean Word Chain
description:
This game is in Korean. It is a story-driven Korean word chain game (kkeutmal-itgi) for people who read and type Korean.

On the first full moon of the year, mischievous goblins (dokkaebi) carried off the words of a mountain village. Join Ieum and the little brush goblin Malkkori, and win the words back in word-chain duels.

■ Word-chain duels
· Each word must start with the last syllable of the previous one. Longer and faster words push harder; push the bar all the way to win.
· Every goblin knows different words and has its own habits. Bosses add special rules: no initial-sound rule, three syllables or more, killer words allowed, backward chaining, and best-of-three.

■ Fully voiced story
· 7 villages, 36 stages and 25 scenes, all voiced in Korean.

■ Daily Stepping Stones
· Three puzzles a day, the same for everyone: chain from a start word to a target word. Optional leaderboards.

■ More
· Free duels with your own rules, Endless mode with three lives, pass-and-play for 2–4 players, a word collection and dictionary lookup.
· Words and definitions are adapted from the Standard Korean Language Dictionary (National Institute of Korean Language, CC BY-SA 2.0 KR).

■ Good to know
· A banner ad sits at the bottom of the play screen, and free play needs the banner to show (internet required).
· With Remove Banner Ads you can play without internet for up to 7 days after the last check.

name: Mandragore
description:
Mandragore est une application de conception paysagère pensée pour aider à créer des jardins naturels, cohérents et adaptés au sol vivant.

L'application combine une vue de dessus, destinée à organiser vos futurs travaux de conception paysagère, et une vue de face, qui permet d'imaginer visuellement le rendu des massifs et des plantations.

Mandragore permet notamment de :
• créer des plans de jardin en vue de dessus
• concevoir et visualiser des massifs en vue de face
• organiser les plantations et les espaces extérieurs
• utiliser une bibliothèque de plantes pour composer un projet de jardin
• préparer facilement des listes de plantes pour un devis ou une pépinière

L'application adopte une approche centrée sur le vivant et l'observation du terrain. Elle intègre :
• une aide à l'analyse du type de sol
• des outils de présélection selon les caractéristiques du terrain
• des informations sur les plantes bioindicatrices
• une approche inspirée des pratiques paysagères et écologiques

Les végétaux proposés tiennent compte du contexte du sol renseigné, afin d'aider à construire des compositions plus adaptées et plus durables.

Vos photos sont analysées sur votre téléphone : aucune donnée personnelle n'est collectée.

Zones climatiques concernées : Mandragore est pensée pour les climats tempérés européens. Dans les régions aux hivers très rigoureux (en dessous d'environ -20 °C), le choix de végétaux proposés devient très limité.

GRATUIT ET PREMIUM
La version gratuite donne accès à tout le catalogue de plantes et à 10 plans proposés par mois. Mandragore Premium (abonnement mensuel ou annuel, renouvelé automatiquement) débloque les plans sans limite et l'export PDF. Le paiement est débité sur votre compte Apple ; l'abonnement se renouvelle sauf annulation au moins 24 heures avant la fin de la période, depuis les réglages de votre compte Apple.

Conditions d'utilisation (EULA) : https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Confidentialité : https://docs.google.com/document/d/1zJ8KCysxmH8kd79cXAyXpSSVB3vag3y7fIIsr5EAmmw/edit?usp=drivesdk

name: MatrixCove
description:
Work with small numeric matrices, inspect the calculation result, and follow the actual elimination steps behind supported operations.

• Save matrices up to 8 by 8, with strict grid text import and an editable cell grid.
• Calculate addition, subtraction, multiplication, transpose and determinant.
• Inspect an inverse or a supported square linear-system solution, with recorded elimination steps.
• Follow stored elimination snapshots and the tolerance used for the calculation.
• Freeze input, result and steps in a report, then share JSON, CSV or PDF.

MatrixCove uses bounded floating-point calculations and an explicit numerical tolerance. It is not a symbolic algebra or arbitrary-precision solver. Incompatible dimensions and unsupported singular solutions produce an error rather than a fabricated result.

Your saved work stays in this app’s local library. Use the system sharing controls when you choose to export a file. System backups may include app data.

name: Meadowmark: Farm & Raid
description:
Plant, harvest, cook and raid in Meadowmark, a cozy farming game with a daring side.

YOUR FARM IS A SANCTUARY
Plant crops in beds you place yourself, collect eggs and milk, fish at the pond and mill wheat into flour. Cook bread, cheese, fish stew and pies in the cottage kitchen, sell your surplus and upgrade every corner of your homestead. Nobody can ever attack your farm.

A DOG WHO LOVES YOU
Choose your dog and give it a name. Walk it, treat it and dress it up. It digs up finds, greets you with gifts and tells you how the last raid went.

THE FRONTIER
When you are ready for adventure, load the Supply Wagon and travel to your outpost. Lift the fog over five regions, discover wild crops you can grow at home, and clear bandits from mines and ancient ruins.

RAID AND DEFEND
Build defences and train Farmhands, Archers and Brutes. Drop your troops around a rival's outpost and watch them storm it for stars and loot. Pack lunchboxes from your kitchen to power up your army. Raided? Take your revenge straight from the farm. Troops are never lost, only wounded, and they come back to fight again.

FRIENDS AND VILLAGES
Visit friends and water their crops, send seed gifts, stamp guestbooks and trade at your roadside stall. Found or join a village, fill the weekly Village Cart together and climb six leagues on the Frontier.

SEASONS AND SURPRISES
Every week brings a new season with its own rules. Grow a giant pumpkin for the contest, find rare hybrid seeds, catch rain-only fish, and enjoy comet nights and the travelling circus.

Play as a guest straight away, or create a free PapaGames ID to keep your farm on any device.

name: Metronome-Pendulum
description:
Slide the brass weight to your tempo, draw out the accent bell, and release the pendulum. Follow its swing as the wooden tick and tock alternate. Choose from 39 classic settings between 40 and 208 BPM, or hold the weight and slide to adjust in steps of one BPM.

Practice offline with the free walnut instrument. Set the bell to mark every 2, 3, 4 or 6 beats, or turn it off for an even tick. With a one-time purchase of Pendulum Pro, the beat continues when you lock the screen or open a score in another app. Pro also includes the matte ebony instrument and its distinct tone, extra desk surfaces, a Midnight app icon and Pure mechanical mode. Wind the key and keep the instrument level as you play.

name: Mia's Secret Menu: Cafe Rush
description:
Psst… every restaurant has a secret menu. Can you find it?

Mia just got the keys to her grandma's little trattoria — and that's only the beginning. Seat guests, take orders, cook on the stove, the pizza oven and the grill, serve drinks and desserts, and keep every guest smiling before their patience runs out!

• 4 RESTAURANTS, 200 LEVELS – an Italian trattoria, an Istanbul café, an Indian palace and a Route 66 diner
• SECRET MENU OF THE DAY – one dish pays DOUBLE today, and guests can't stop ordering it
• 70+ DISHES – pizza, menemen, butter chicken, cheeseburgers, baklava, milkshakes and more
• A REAL KITCHEN – dishes go raw, half-done, done… and burn if you forget them!
• UPGRADE EVERYTHING – new tables, a garden terrace, a whole new floor, faster chefs, bigger trays
• DAILY GOALS – three fresh goals every day and a treasure chest for finishing them all
• DAILY REWARDS – come back every day; day 7 is a treasure chest
• COMBOS, FOOD CRITICS & FESTIVAL NIGHTS – chain quick actions for huge tips

Free to play with optional in-app purchases. Ads between levels can be removed with a one-time purchase.

name: Midnight Rail: Cozy Cafe
description:
The gentle rhythm of the tracks, raindrops tapping against the window, and the warmth of freshly brewed coffee... In Midnight Rail, you run the café car of a cross-continental night train, crafting the exact cup each sleepless passenger needs.

Depart from rainy London and watch the world drift past your window—from sunset over the Eiffel Tower in Paris and snow-dusted cabins in the Swiss Alps to the canals of Venice, Istanbul's Bosphorus skyline, Cairo, and Kyoto.

TACTILE BREWING MINI-GAMES
Every stop along the route brings new recipes and hands-on brewing rituals:
• Filter Coffee & English Tea: Keep fresh carafes ready for late-night travelers.
• French Press & Chemex: Time the coffee bloom and infuse aromatic spices like cardamom.
• Italian Espresso Bar: Pull rich shots with golden crema and steam silky milk to order.
• Turkish Coffee & Cup Reading: Watch the foam rise in the cezve and lift it at the exact second—then match hidden symbols in the coffee grounds to read your passenger's fortune.

STORIES ON THE NIGHT TRAIN
Everyone aboard a midnight train is carrying a story. Some are leaving a city behind; others are chasing a new beginning. Listen to their quiet reflections over a warm cup and collect memories in your journal.

UPGRADE YOUR CAFÉ CAR
• Unlock new brewing gear and espresso machines to expand your menu.
• Upgrade your lounge carriage and manage staff to keep service smooth.
• Play at your own unhurried pace with zero timers or stressful rush hours.

Put on your headphones, settle into the soothing ambiance of rain and rails, and brew your way across borders. Playable offline and completely ad-free.

name: MiniBook – Fold Laptop
description:
MiniBook turns your iPhone Duo into a pocket laptop.

Fold it to about 45° and MiniBook switches on automatically: the top half becomes a little desktop with windows and a dock, and the bottom half becomes a full keyboard with a trackpad. Unfold or close it and MiniBook steps aside.

WHAT'S INSIDE
• Notes — jot things down; everything is saved on your device
• Terminal — a playful command line (try “help” or “hinge”)
• Calculator — tap the keys, or type sums on the keyboard
• Sketch — draw with your finger or with the trackpad
• Clock — always at a glance
• Settings — trackpad speed, wallpapers, key sounds and haptics

11 MORE WAYS TO USE YOUR FOLD
Picture Frame and Four in a Row are free. The other nine come with MiniBook Pro — a one-time $2.99 in-app purchase, no subscription.
• Picture Frame — your photo in oak, walnut, ebony, white, aluminium or gold
• Nightstand — a big bedside clock with a sunrise alarm and a red night mode
• Teleprompter — your script scrolls at your pace, with mirror mode
• Arcade — a brick-breaking game with the bottom half as your controller
• Recipe Stand — one big step at a time, with kitchen timers
• Beat Maker — eight drum pads and a 16-step sequencer
• Status Sign — Do Not Disturb, On a Call, or your own message, facing the room
• Book — a page on each half; open any plain-text book
• Four in a Row — lay it flat between two players
• Focus Timer — an hourglass timer with rain, waves or brown noise
• Home Panel — your Home lights and scenes at a glance

DESK PICTURE FRAME
Turn MiniBook into a picture frame for your desk. Pick a photo and choose an oak, walnut, ebony, white, aluminium or gold frame, with or without a mat. Fold the Duo and the photo stands upright while you work — the screen stays on.

FEELS LIKE A REAL LAPTOP
• Open the lid and MiniBook starts up with a chime; close it and the screen dims and switches off
• Three keyboard sound packs: Soft, Clicky and Typewriter (with a bell on return)

TRACKPAD & KEYBOARD
• Trackpad: slide to move the pointer, tap to click, hold the bar to drag windows or draw
• Minimise, maximise and close windows; drag them by their title bars
• Number row and a symbols layer on the keyboard
• Works with Bluetooth keyboards too
• Haptic key clicks matched to each sound pack (can be turned off)

Laptop mode is completely free. No account, no ads, no tracking. Your photos, notes and books never leave your phone.

Not on a foldable? Tap “Open laptop mode anyway” to try it on any iPhone.

name: Miró Connect One
description:
O Miró Connect One é o app da plataforma de atendimento da Miró Soluções Tecnológicas. Com ele, sua equipe atende clientes, acompanha negociações e vê os resultados de onde estiver.

PRINCIPAIS RECURSOS
• Atendimento multicanal: responda as conversas dos seus canais de mensagens em uma única caixa de entrada.
• Copiloto com IA: receba sugestões de resposta prontas para usar durante o atendimento.
• Agentes de IA: configure assistentes que atendem e qualificam contatos automaticamente.
• Kanban e funil de vendas: acompanhe cada oportunidade por etapa.
• Painel de atendimentos e dashboards: veja volume, tempos médios e desempenho da equipe em tempo real.
• Cobranças: acompanhe as cobranças dos seus clientes.
• Envie fotos, vídeos, áudios e documentos nas conversas.
• Receba notificações de novas mensagens e atendimentos.

PARA QUEM É
Para empresas que usam a plataforma Miró Connect One. O acesso é feito com o usuário e a senha fornecidos pelo administrador da sua empresa.

PRIVACIDADE
Política de Privacidade: https://termos.mirosolucoes.com.br/privacidade

name: Moodki
description:
MOODKI es tu espacio visual personal para capturar, organizar y redescubrir todo lo que te inspira en internet sin perderlo entre miles de chats, capturas o pestañas abiertas.

Guarda publicaciones, Reels, videos, artículos web y fotografías desde cualquier aplicación y conviértelos automáticamente en un moodboard limpio, estético y 100% visual.

CAPTURA DESDE CUALQUIER APP
• Comparte directamente desde Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, X, Spotify, tu navegador o galería eligiendo MOODKI en el menú Compartir.
• O usa el botón "+" dentro de la app para pegar un enlace desde tu portapapeles, elegir una foto de tu librería o tomar una foto al instante.
• MOODKI extrae automáticamente la previsualización visual, el ícono de origen y la información del enlace.

CREA TUS PROPIOS MOODS
• Organiza tu contenido en colecciones y tableros personalizados llamados "Moods" (ideas de diseño, recetas, viajes, moda, referencias, compras o proyectos).
• Personaliza cada Mood con su propia imagen de portada desde tu galería.
• Reordena libremente tus tarjetas y colecciones manteniendo presionado y arrastrando a tu gusto.

 ENCUENTRA TODO AL INSTANTE
• Agrega etiquetas (#tags) y notas privadas a cada elemento para recordar exactamente por qué lo guardaste.
• Usa el buscador rápido para filtrar tu inspiración por palabras clave, etiquetas, notas o dominio web.

100% PRIVADO, LOCAL Y MULTIPLATAFORMA
• Todo tu contenido y sus imágenes de previsualización se guardan directamente en tu dispositivo: sin cuentas obligatorias, sin anuncios y con acceso rápido incluso sin conexión.
• Incluye sistema de respaldo completo (.modki) en Ajustes para exportar e importar todos tus elementos, fotos y Moods fácilmente entre dispositivos Android e iOS.

Diseñado por MediaLabs con una interfaz minimalista adaptable a modo claro y oscuro.

name: Morrowglass
description:
The lamps of Morrow went out long ago.

On the cliff above the town, the old sun-works stands cold and empty. You are the new foreman. Catch the sea mist, turn it to glass, and make little suns. Ship them down to the harbour and light Morrow again, one street at a time.

Morrowglass is a calm builder you can pick up and put down. Walk your foreman along the terraces, step on a pad to build, and come back later to collect what the works has earned.

WHAT'S INSIDE
• Three ages of machines: the brass Dawnworks, the green copper Tideworks and the lightning-fed Stormworks
• 15 machines, each with two bigger models to build
• 22 terraces carved down a sea cliff, with stairs, a lift and keepers who work beside you
• Ships that take commissions: fill one, and you light a district of the town yourself
• A town map that fills with light as you go
• A beacon to raise, buildings to add, and outfits for your foreman
• The works keeps earning while you are away

FAIR PLAY
No ads. No accounts. The whole first age, the Dawnworks, is free to play. One purchase opens the rest of the game for good. A second builder, a collector and hourglasses are there for anyone who wants to go faster; none of them is needed to finish. The game plays offline.

Made by Rubik Solutions.

name: Morselo - Calorie Tracker
description:
Morselo helps you log what you eat, calmly and quickly.

• Scan a barcode and see nutrition values (data from Open Food Facts)
• Search common foods or add your own
• See calories left and the day's protein, carbs and fat
• Progress by week, month and year
• A daily target estimated from your details, which you can change any time
• Your food log stays on your phone. No account needed.
• Export your history as CSV or delete everything, any time

FREE AND MORSELO PLUS
Free: unlimited manual logging and 10 barcode scans each month. Morselo Plus removes the scan limit.

Morselo Plus is an auto-renewing subscription, yearly or monthly. The price is shown in the app before you subscribe and varies by country. Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it in your Apple ID account settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://morselo.life/privacy.html

Morselo is not a medical device. The calculated target is an estimate, not medical advice. If food or weight is hard for you, talk to a doctor or dietitian.

Product data comes from Open Food Facts and can be incomplete or wrong.

name: MOT Minder: Car Tax Check
description:
Never miss an MOT, tax renewal, insurance or service date again. Enter your registration once and MOT Minder looks up your vehicle's MOT and tax dates, reminds you before they're due and shows its full MOT history.

ADD YOUR REG, WE DO THE REST
• MOT and tax due dates looked up for you from official DVLA and DVSA data
• Countdowns with clear colours: fine, due soon, overdue
• New vehicle? We work out the first MOT date
• Outstanding safety recall alerts
• Kept up to date automatically

REMINDERS THAT WORK FOR YOU
• Notifications 30 days, 7 days and the day before (choose your own days and time)
• Quick links to tax your vehicle or book an MOT

KNOW YOUR VEHICLE (PRO)
• Full MOT history: every pass, fail and defect
• Advisories in plain English, so you know what to keep an eye on
• Mileage chart from every MOT, with a warning if a reading ever goes down
• Clean air zone (ULEZ) estimate

EVERY DATE, EVERY VEHICLE (PRO)
• Unlimited vehicles: family cars, vans, motorbikes
• Your own reminders for insurance, servicing, breakdown cover, warranty and parking permits
• Home-screen widgets
• Apple Calendar sync

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account needed. Your garage stays on your phone. No ads, no tracking.

Pro is available monthly, yearly (with a 1-week free trial) or as a one-off lifetime purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel any time in the app (Settings › Manage subscription) or in your Apple Account settings.

Vehicle data from the DVLA Vehicle Enquiry Service and DVSA MOT History. Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0. MOT Minder is independent and not affiliated with or endorsed by DVLA, DVSA or GOV.UK. Always check official sources before relying on a date. Clean air zone results are estimates.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://bowyer-digital.github.io/mot-minder/privacy.html

name: Mud Ball Museum: Shine & Craft
description:
A game where you make shiny mud balls in a park sandbox at sunset.

■ Knead, sprinkle, polish
Pour water on the sand pile and knead it, and a mud ball pops out. Use the watering can, a bucket of dry sand, a sieve of fine dust, and your hand in any order you like to make it perfectly round.

■ Mud balls that look real
Wet mud turns darker, and sand only sticks where it's wet. Dust it with fine powder and polish it until the trees and sky around you reflect on it. Leave it alone and it dries out. Crack!

■ A shocking appraisal
Tap the sparkle button to get it appraised. Roundness, shine and smoothness earn it a ridiculous price. Then it might be declared a national treasure, get rolled away by a dung beetle, or become a bowling ball...

■ The Mud Ball Museum
Every mud ball you make is displayed in the museum, from the most expensive down. The top one sits in a glass case with a guard. Polish it again the next day and it shines even more.

■ Surprises happen
A dog grabs it and runs off, a frog jumps out of the mud, or you find a gem or a fossil inside.

■ Unlock with coins
Earn coins by playing. You can also get them by watching ads.
- Soils: red clay, black soil, white clay, soybean flour, chocolate, curry powder
- Powders: gold glitter, cherry blossom pink, rainbow glitter
- Places: beach, snowy park, the Moon

■ Leaderboards and achievements
Compare your highest appraisal and your total appraisal value on Game Center. 12 achievements. Share your results and surprising moments.

name: Music Hub: Mixes & Radio
description:
Music Hub brings everything you listen to into one calm, beautiful player.

MIXES FOR YOU
Every day Music Hub builds new mixes around the artists you play most: their songs from your library, mixed with similar artists from the Apple Music catalog. Each mix keeps to one style, never plays the same artist three times in a row, and keeps going when it reaches the end. Like a mix? Save it to Apple Music as a playlist and add more similar songs whenever you want.

FROM YOUR LIBRARY
Forgotten Favorites, Recently Added, On Repeat and the decade you love most, built only from your own songs.

LIVE RADIO
Swipe through Apple Music’s live stations right on Home.

PODCASTS
Search, follow and download shows, with playback positions remembered.

YOUR OWN FILES
Import FLAC, ALAC, MP3, OGG and more from Files, iCloud Drive or a Mac. They play offline, right next to your Apple Music.

PINS
Keep your favourite albums, playlists and artists at the top of Home. Apple Music pins follow you to your other devices through iCloud.

MADE TO LOOK GOOD
Records in sleeves, CDs in jewel cases or clean covers: choose how your shelf looks.

Mixes, live radio and the Apple Music catalog need an Apple Music subscription. Imported music and podcasts work without one.

No ads, no tracking, no account.

name: MusicFaculty
description:
MusicFaculty helps music teachers organize lessons, track student progress, and share lesson summaries.

Manage your weekly schedule, add student profiles, record lesson notes and assignments, and review assessment scores over time. Keep sheet music in your PDF library, and set reminders before lessons.

Import annual plans in PDF, Word (DOCX), or Excel (XLSX). Keep the original file or split it into weeks on your device when you need to. MusicFaculty supports Turkish and English.

Teacher accounts and lesson records are stored on the device. Password recovery uses a code sent to your registered email address.

name: MyMap Ireland Live Bus Tracker
description:
Where is my bus? Find your route, choose your stop and follow your bus with MyMap Ireland Live Bus Tracker.

FOLLOW REPORTING BUSES
See available vehicle positions on the map, with both route directions and stops. Live readings refresh while the app is active. Coverage depends on the operator and vehicle; older positions are hidden.

FIND YOUR STOP
Search by stop name or number, or use optional location to find stops nearby. Choose the exact stop to see its next departures. Live arrival predictions and scheduled timetable times are labelled separately.

PLAN YOUR JOURNEY
Choose your starting point, destination, date and time. Compare public transport options, walking links and travel times. View journey details and available live bus positions. Save journeys for offline access.

KEEP YOUR REGULARS CLOSE
Save your usual buses and stops on your phone. Colour-coded pills show operator names and route numbers to help you find them quickly.

LOCATION IS YOUR CHOICE
Search for routes and stops without granting location access. Nearby-stop distance checks happen on your phone. If you choose your location for route planning, the required journey coordinates are sent to MyMap's transport service.

No account is required. The app contains no advertising or analytics SDK.

COVERAGE AND TIMETABLES
The app covers Republic of Ireland bus services in the NTA timetable. Northern Ireland services are not included. Live positions and predictions are available only for supported services and reporting vehicles. Scheduled journeys remain labelled as timetable information. Always check the operator for service changes and cancellations.

Independently developed by ONOIR STUDIO LIMITED using MyMap's transport service and National Transport Authority data. This is not an official NTA or TFI app.

name: Neiro: Brain Training
description:
Train your mind five minutes a day.

Neiro gives you three short games each day. Every game you play grows your neuron, and every day you finish lights a star in your sky.

28 GAMES, 7 SKILLS
Each game is a short, playable version of a task scientists use to study the mind.

• Memory: repeat lights and sounds in order, remember where the stars light up, and spot when a light repeats one from a few steps back.
• Attention: steer a glider through rings while catching gold stars, follow fireflies as they fly around, and swipe the way the middle arrow points.
• Speed: find the one shape that's different, turn symbols into numbers, and take in more in a split second.
• Flexibility: find the hidden rule and notice when it changes, guide a bead when the controls are flipped, and tap the ink, not the word.
• Problem solving: plan your moves in Towers, complete the pattern, turn 3D shapes in your mind, and find your way home across the sea.
• Math: keep a running total in your head, pick the heavier side, and judge which fish there were more of.
• Words: unscramble letters, sort words into baskets, and spot the word that doesn't belong.

IT ADAPTS TO YOU
Every game gets harder when you're doing well and easier when you're not, so you always practice right at the edge of what you can do. Each one starts with a practice round, so you learn as you play.

WATCH YOUR NEURON GROW
Your neuron has seven branches, one for each skill. Every game grows its branch, so you can see what you train most and what could use more. Each skill scores from 0 to 1,000 and compares you only with yourself.

LIGHT UP YOUR SKY
Every day you finish your three games lights a star. Seven stars make a constellation, twelve in all. A day you miss never takes a star away.

A DAILY PUZZLE
A new puzzle every day, the same one for everyone. Gentle on Mondays, hardest on Sundays. Solve it in the fewest moves and see where you stand on today's Game Center board.

WHAT TO EXPECT
You will get better at these games, and research shows that gains in the skills you practice are real. Whether they carry over to everyday life is still debated, so Neiro doesn't promise to prevent, treat, or cure anything. Sleep, moving your body, time with people, and learning new things all matter for your brain too. Think of Neiro as a few focused minutes a day alongside them.

name: NEWS PICKER
description:
NEWS PICKER は、あなたの「好き」に関するニュースだけを集めて届けるニュースアプリです。

■ 好きなことを「#テーマ」で登録するだけ
入力すると、ニュースがあるものだけが「#名前＋ジャンル」の候補で出てきます。タップすれば登録完了。アイドル、ゲーム、乗り物、遊園地、カフェなど、どんなテーマでも登録できます。

■ 関係ないニュースが混ざりにくい
テーマごとにジャンルを選べるので、同じ名前の別の話題が混ざりにくくなっています。登録すると、公式サイトのお知らせや公式の動画も自動で集めます。

■ 大事なニュースは大きく
たくさんの媒体が報じている話題や大きな発表は、写真付きで大きく表示します。同じ話題がまとまり、いろいろな媒体のニュースをバランスよく読めます。

■ 国内・国際・ビジネス・テクノロジー・エンタメ・芸能・スポーツ・科学・健康
「ニュース」タブでは、分野ごとの主要なニュースもチェックできます。

■ 新着をすぐに通知
登録したテーマに新しいニュースが出ると通知でお知らせ。大きなニュースの速報や、夜は音を鳴らさない「おやすみ時間」にも対応しています。

■ あとで読む
気になる記事はしおりで保存。Apple でサインインすれば、機種変更しても登録したテーマや保存した記事を引き継げます。

■ NEWS PICKER Pro（定期購読）
・広告なし
・テーマを20件まで登録（無料は3件）
・新着通知を20テーマまで（無料は1テーマ）
・記事の保存が無制限（無料は50件）
初めての方は1週間無料でお試しいただけます。

【定期購読について】
・料金はご購入の確定時に Apple ID に請求されます。
・期間終了の24時間前までに解約しない限り、自動で更新されます。
・無料お試し期間中に解約すれば料金はかかりません。
・解約は iPhone の「設定」→ 自分の名前 →「サブスクリプション」から行えます。
利用規約：https://newspicker-collector.gvp2zcm79v.workers.dev/terms
プライバシーポリシー：https://newspicker-collector.gvp2zcm79v.workers.dev/privacy

※記事の見出し・画像は各報道機関・情報源のものです。本文は各サイトでお読みください。

name: Nida - Adhan & Prayer Times
description:
Nida is your daily companion for prayer: times calculated on your phone from your location, and the adhan delivered on time in the voice you choose, even when the app is closed and you are offline.

PRAYER TIMES & ADHAN
• Accurate times anywhere in the world with 13 calculation methods, and automatic selection of the method used in your country.
• 16 built-in adhan voices, including a dedicated Fajr adhan, and the option to add a voice from your own files.
• A spoken alert before the adhan, an iqama alert, and per-prayer minute adjustments to match your mosque.
• At prayer time you get a notification in the muezzin's voice; tap it to hear the full adhan followed by the supplication.
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets: next prayer with a live countdown, a rotating dhikr, and the Hijri date.

THE HOLY QURAN
• The full Mushaf in 604 pages that turn like a printed copy, in two views: the Madinah Mushaf pages as printed, or Uthmani-script text at the size you choose.
• Tap any ayah to read its tafsir (Al-Muyassar, in Arabic) and word meanings.
• Search the whole Quran, bookmarks, and continue where you left off.
• Khatma plans with a daily portion and a reminder.

AZKAR & TASBEEH
• Morning, evening, after-prayer, sleep and more azkar, each with its own counter.
• Listen to the morning and evening azkar.
• A digital tasbeeh with goals and a daily count.
• Dhikr reminders through the day, and "A message in its time": a dua or an ayah with a short reflection at a fitting moment.

EVERYDAY TOOLS
• Qibla compass with direction and distance to Makkah.
• Prayer tracker: log your prayers and follow your consistency.
• Hijri calendar, recommended fasting days and upcoming occasions.
• Full monthly timetable you can share.
• Prayer times in other cities: Makkah, Madinah and any city you add.
• The 99 Names of Allah with their meanings.
• Learn wudu, salah and umrah step by step.
• Holy Quran Radio from Cairo.
• Reminders for morning and evening azkar, sunnah prayers, Duha, Witr, night prayer, Ramadan, Arafah and Eid.

YOUR PRIVACY
• No ads and no account.
• Your location is used to calculate prayer times and the Qibla on your phone; we do not collect it or store it on our servers.
• Prayer times, adhan, Quran and azkar work offline.

The app interface is available in Arabic and English, with light and dark appearance. Quran, azkar, tafsir and daily messages are in Arabic.

name: Ninni: Bebek Takibi
description:
Ninni, yeni doğan ve bebeğinin her anını kolayca takip etmek isteyen anneler için bir bebek takip uygulamasıdır. Gece 3'te, tek elle, uykulu gözlerle bile kullanılabilsin diye tasarlandı.

BEBEK TAKİBİ
• Emzirme: sağ / sol göğüs ve süre
• Mama ve biberon: mama ya da anne sütü, kaç ml
• Uyku: bugün toplam ne kadar uyudu, haftalık grafik
• Bez: ıslak, kirli ya da ikisi
• Süt sağma ve banyo kayıtları
• Boy, kilo ve baş çevresi ölçümleri, büyüme grafiği
• Geçmiş: istediğin günü seç, o günün özetini gör

AY AY GELİŞİM
Her ay için bebeğin gelişimi, neler yapar, sen neler yapabilirsin, beslenme ve uyku düzeni.

ANNELER FORUMU
Uyku, emzirme, ek gıda, annelik... Soru sor, deneyimini paylaş. Cevap geldiğinde bildirim al; konu açtıkça puan topla, rozet kazan.

ARAÇLAR
• Ninniler ve beyaz gürültü (zamanlayıcılı)
• Ek gıda tarifleri, burçlar
• Notlar ve ajanda

NINNI PREMIUM
• Baba, bakıcı, anneanne ve babaanneyi davet koduyla aileye ekle
• Herkes aynı bebeğin kayıtlarını görür ve ekler; davet edilenler ücretsiz katılır
• Reklamsız kullanım
Aylık ya da yıllık abonelik olarak sunulur.

Sevimli amigurumi tasarım; kız bebeklere pembe, erkek bebeklere mavi tema. Türkçe ve İngilizce.

Ninni bir ebeveynlik günlüğüdür; tıbbi bir uygulama değildir ve tıbbi tavsiye vermez.

ABONELİK BİLGİSİ
Ninni Premium otomatik yenilenen bir aboneliktir. Ödeme, satın alma onaylandığında Apple Kimliği hesabınızdan alınır. Abonelik, dönem bitiminden en az 24 saat önce iptal edilmezse otomatik olarak yenilenir ve yenileme ücreti dönem bitiminden önceki 24 saat içinde hesabınızdan alınır. Aboneliğinizi Ayarlar > Apple Kimliği > Abonelikler bölümünden yönetebilir ve iptal edebilirsiniz.

Gizlilik Politikası: https://ninni.online/gizlilik.html

name: NIUN Pádel
description:
NIUN es la app de torneos de NI1 Padel Club, el club de pádel de la comunidad coreana de Buenos Aires.

Inscribite con tu pareja en un minuto, mandale el link a tu compañero por WhatsApp, pagá juntos o cada uno su parte y seguí todo el día del torneo: tu próximo partido con la cancha y la hora estimada, el ranking general en vivo y las llaves de la Copa Oro y la Copa Plata.

PARA LOS JUGADORES
• Entrá con Apple, con Google o con tu mail.
• Inscribí tu pareja y mandale el link a tu compañero: con NIUN, entra directo a la pareja.
• Elegí cómo pagan: uno por los dos o cada uno su parte.
• Mirá los datos para transferir y subí la foto del comprobante.
• El día del torneo: tu próximo partido, tus resultados y tu puesto.
• El ranking general, el fixture por grupos y las llaves de Oro y Plata.

PARA LA ORGANIZACIÓN
• Armá el torneo: fecha, sede, precio y datos para transferir.
• Confirmá los pagos, de la pareja o de cada jugador, y manejá la lista de espera.
• Check-in por jugador, fixture, resultados desde la cancha, imprevistos y correcciones.
• El corte Oro/Plata y las copas, que se completan con cada resultado.
• Las planillas del torneo, para abrir en Excel.

EL FORMATO
Torneo americano de 20 parejas: clasificación en 5 grupos de 4, un ranking general y dos copas por eliminación directa. Cada pareja juega por lo menos 3 partidos.

Podés borrar tu cuenta cuando quieras desde la app.

name: Noctilana: Count Sheep
description:
Noctilana is an incremental roguelite to play in bed, before you fall asleep. You count the sheep as they jump the fences, and each night takes you a little deeper into sleep.

ONE NIGHT
The herd moves forward on its own. Drag your finger to steer it through the fences that make it grow, away from alarm clocks and nightmares. Along the way you are offered dreams: pick one bonus for the current night among a few. Some of them work very well together.

WHEN YOU WAKE UP
The yarn you earned is spent in the Bedroom, the Constellations and on the Nightstand. The next night goes further.

EVER DEEPER
When your nights level off, you sink one stage of sleep deeper: light sleep, deep sleep, then REM sleep. Part of your progress resets, in exchange for a new currency (feathers, crescent moons, dream shards) and bonuses that stay. Then the cycle starts again, heavier.

MADE FOR BED
• Dark from start to finish: night background, ivory text, no bright white to dazzle you.
• One-handed: a single column, large buttons, the next thing to do always in view.
• A night lasts a few minutes. Play for five minutes or twenty, and pick it up again the next evening.
• Numbers for those who want them: every bonus is explained one tap away, and the Dream journal keeps your records.
• No account and no connection required: your progress stays on your device.

WHAT COSTS MONEY
The game is free and fully playable without buying anything. There is no premium currency, no banner and no forced ad: videos only play when you tap an "Ad" button to get a bonus.
• No Ads (one-time purchase): bonuses that ask for a video are granted directly, and yarn is doubled.
• The Nightlight (monthly or yearly subscription): everything in No Ads, plus even more yarn, more generous descents, a stronger bedtime rhyme, one more slot on the Nightstand and in the dream deck, and constellation layouts you can save.

Available in English, French, German, Spanish, Italian, Brazilian Portuguese, Japanese, Korean and Traditional Chinese.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://apps.epacus.fr/en/noctilana/privacy/

name: Notia - AI Notes & Voice Memo
description:
Notia is a clean everyday notes app enhanced with on-device voice transcription and AI summarization.

Features:
• Rich text formatting: Bold, underline, strikethrough, highlighter, interactive checklists, bullet & numbered lists, headings, and undo/redo.
• Voice memos with background recording: Keep recording even with the screen locked, then transcribe accurately on-device.
• On-device AI summarization: Turns spoken thoughts into structured bullet points with a fitting title. Save the summary alone or together with the original transcript.
• Ask your notes in Chat: Search past notes, summarize recent notes, pull all unchecked checklist items, ask by voice, and save answers as new notes in one tap.
• Folders, iCloud sync & 5 themes: Organize with custom folders, sync seamlessly across iPhone and Mac via iCloud, and choose from light and dark themes.
• Privacy first: Notes, audio, transcription, and AI processing stay on your device.

name: Nour Quran
description:
Nour is a calm, ad-free Quran companion designed for real-time recitation alignment, Hifz memorization, and live cooperative Subac circles.

Key Capabilities:
- Real-Time Recitation Tracking: Recite aloud at your natural pace while Nour follows word-by-word across the 15-line Uthmani Mushaf.
- Hifz Memorization & Al-Radd Prompts: Conceal verses while reciting from memory and receive gentle studio audio cues whenever you hesitate or miss a word.
- Cooperative Subac Circles: Create or join live turn-based Quran review circles with friends, family, or study groups using a simple 6-character code.
- Studio Audio Playback: Listen to clear verse-by-verse recitation with synchronized word highlighting.
- Cross-Device Progress Sync: Start immediately without an account, or optionally sign in with a one-time email code to keep your reading locus synchronized across devices.
- Free & Ad-Free: Zero advertisements, zero subscriptions, and zero paywalls.

name: Oasis for Business
description:
Oasis for Business is the counter app for partner venues on Oasis NZ, the local rewards app for Mount Maunganui and Tauranga.

Set it up once on your counter iPad or bar phone with your venue's Oasis login. After that, each staff member signs in with their own name and PIN.

- Send a promotion: pick up to 3 promo offers and push them to Oasis members to bring people in when it's quiet
- Repeats: run the same offer at the same time every week on your venue page
- Post photos to the Oasis feed as your venue
- Today: see scans and redeemed rewards as they happen
- Show your venue's Oasis QR code for customers to scan
- Promotion results: see who came in after each push

name: Ohr Pnimi
description:
Ohr Pnimi gathers shiurim on Pnimiyus HaTorah, Chassidus, Kabbalah and Inyanei Emunah from trusted mashpi'im into one unified place. New shiurim arrive daily.

Learn Chassidus, Kabbalah, Breslov, Tanya, emunah and the parsha with thousands of video and audio shiurim. New shiurim come straight from the mashpi'im's own channels and podcasts, so there is always something fresh to learn.

FIND THE RIGHT SHIUR
• Browse by mashpia, topic, series, length and language
• Search titles, sefarim and topics in English or Hebrew
• Series in order, from the first shiur to the last, with your place kept
• A "This week" shelf for the parsha, Yomim Tovim and special days

LEARN YOUR WAY
• Video or audio, as you prefer
• Audio keeps playing with the screen locked, with lock screen controls
• Pick up where you left off, on any device
• Save shiurim and follow mashpi'im to see their newest shiurim first

• Niggunim & Kumzitzim: niggunim, kumzitzim and musical Hallel, gathered by singer

CHOSEN WITH CARE
Every mashpia is approved by hand. Shiurim are included with the mashpi'im's permission and play from their own YouTube channels and podcast feeds. Shiurim by women have their own section, one tap away.

FREE, NO ACCOUNT NEEDED
Browse and listen without signing up. Sign in with Apple, Google or an email code to keep your saved shiurim, your progress and the mashpi'im you follow on all your devices.

Shiurim that play from YouTube may show adverts that Ohr Pnimi does not control.

name: Optical Multimeter
description:
Optical Multimeter combines a zero-hardware iPhone AC Magnetic & Motor Field Tracer with a 64-bit 48 kHz software lock-in polarimeter for optical bench and external USB-C sensor pods.

WHAT WORKS OUT OF THE BOX vs. OPTIONAL ACCESSORIES:
• Works Immediately on Your Bare iPhone (No Accessories Needed): Live Field & Motor Check mode uses your iPhone's built-in 100 Hz 3-axis magnetometer, 48 kHz microphone, and Macro camera right out of the box—plus a complete interactive 48 kHz Optical Bench Simulator.
• Optional Wall-Outlet Line-Splitter Adapter Tip: Standard off-the-shelf AC Line-Splitter wall outlet adapters (1x / 10x plug-in splitters available at hardware and electrical supply stores) safely separate Hot and Neutral conductors at any wall receptacle, boosting bare-iPhone magnetic load sensitivity up to 10x without stripping cable insulation.
• Optional USB-C Optical Clamp Hardware: Live calibrated Volts, Amps, and Watts polarimetry in Optical Clamp (Pod) mode requires connecting an external class-compliant USB-C audio interface with a dual-photodiode Faraday/Pockels optical head.

1. LIVE FIELD & MOTOR CHECK (BARE-IPHONE MODE):
• 100 Hz 3-Axis Magnetometer AC Lock-In: Rejects static Earth and internal MagSafe DC fields (>600 µT) plus wrist tilt via a 4th-order Butterworth high-pass filter, isolating alternating 50/60 Hz magnetic flux (µT rms) around energized cords, AC line splitters, motors, and transformers.
• Synchronous 60 & 120 Hz Motor Hum Analyzer: Uses passive 48 kHz narrowband microphone analysis to distinguish silent resistive loads (Yellow) from spinning motors and transformers with stator magnetostriction hum (Green).
• Macro Close-Up Camera HUD & Proximity Haptics: Targets cables down to 2 cm with single-active status lamps, Low/Standard/High sensitivity presets, Peak Hold, Room Zeroing, and Geiger-style tactile proximity feedback.

2. OPTICAL CLAMP POD & BENCH LOCK-IN MODE:
• Click-Free 1.0 s Snapshot & Auto-HOLD: Ramps a 4 kHz sinusoidal laser modulation carrier with a 20 ms Hann taper, acquires a 48,000-sample stereo photodiode frame, and locks readings cleanly with zero continuous drain.
• Balanced Polarimetry & True Power: Computes S = (A - B)/(A + B), exact θ = 0.5 arcsin(S), refined line frequency (±0.01 Hz), Volts RMS, Amps RMS/DC, Apparent VA, Phase Angle Δφ, Power Factor, and Real Power (Watts), plus Verdet 1/T temperature compensation and CSV export.

IMPORTANT SAFETY NOTICE:
Non-contact magnetic sensing detects active AC current flow (magnetic load) only. Zero magnetic load does NOT indicate zero voltage. Always verify de-energized circuits with a certified contact voltage tester before touching electrical conductors.

name: Outlanders Build for MHO
description:
Find armor for your hunter rank in Monster Hunter Outlanders (MHO) with this unofficial build planner. At HR45, for example, choose a weapon and the skills you want to compare five-piece sets available at that rank.

Rank up to 20 builds by base power, base defense or affinity. Adjust physical and elemental hitzones, compare two sets of stats and save builds with their conditions on your device. Base power models the effects listed in the app. Combat timing and motion values are outside its scope.

Search and calculations work offline in English and Japanese. Equipment data and calculation references come from AuCal.

A banner appears at the bottom of the screen. A full-screen ad may appear on the results screen after every third search that finds builds, at least five minutes after the previous ad. Where available, you can manage ad privacy choices in Settings.

name: Pakkeleg!
description:
Pakkeleg er terningespillet med pakker – på dit eget bord, til julefrokosten, fødselsdagen eller bare en fredag.

Ret telefonen mod dit eget bord, og pakkerne dukker op midt på bordet. Rundt om sidder gæsterne og slår med terninger. Slår du en sekser, skal du skynde dig at tage en pakke, inden terningen går videre.

TO RUNDER, SOM DU KENDER DEM
• Runde 1: Seksere giver pakker fra bunken.
• Runde 2: Nu stjæler I fra hinanden, og ingen ved, hvornår tiden løber ud.
• Husregler i runde 2: en etter giver en pakke til venstre, og en femmer bytter.

SPIL PÅ DIN MÅDE
• Hurtig start: Scan bordet, og tryk, hvor pakkerne skal stå.
• Markér bordet: Sæt hjørnerne, og spil på en træbordplade i præcis dit bords form.
• Spil uden kamera: Markér hjørnerne, og spil videre ved et virtuelt bord, du kan dreje og zoome. Eller tegn bordet med fingeren.
• 3 til 6 spillere ved bordet, dig selv medregnet.
• Tilfældige gæster som Tina, Onkel Jørn og Moster Sonja – eller skriv dine egne navne.
• Én eller to terninger i hånden.
• Tre niveauer: Let, Mellem og Svær.

SPIL SAMMEN
• Ved samme bord: Hver sin iPhone. Én starter spillet, de andre går med – uden konto eller internet.
• Over FaceTime: Ring op, og spil pakkeleg hver ved jeres eget bord, mens I kan høre hinanden.
• Tomme pladser fyldes med gæster.

PAKKERNE ER VÆRD NOGET
Hver farve papir giver point, og guldpakken er den bedste. Lær tavlen udenad. Går du helt tæt på en pakke, når det er din tur til at vælge, kan du se, hvad den er værd.

Skriv, hvad der er i jeres rigtige pakker, og pak gaverne i de samme farver. Så øver du præcis den pakkeleg, I skal spille.

EFTER SPILLET
Se hele forløbet igen som replay – oppefra eller i 3D på dit bord – og se, hvem der fik flest pakker og point.

Ingen konto, ingen reklamer, ingen køb i appen. Intet sendes til nogen server – fællesspil går direkte mellem telefonerne.

Virker på alle iPhones med iOS 18. Bruger kameraet til at finde dit bord – billederne gemmes ikke og sendes ingen steder hen.

name: Pawspot: Pet Health & Travel
description:
Pawspot keeps the everyday questions of life with a dog or cat in one calm place.

HEALTH CHECK FROM A PHOTO
Take a photo of your pet's poop. Pawspot looks at form and colour and tells you whether it looks like a normal day, something to watch, or time to call the vet. Results arrive in seconds and are tracked week by week, so changes stand out.

PET PLACES NEARBY
Dog parks, vets, pet stores, groomers and boarding on one map, sorted by distance, with walking and driving times, directions, phone numbers and websites.

TRAVEL RULES, THE SHORT VERSION
Flying with your pet? Pick where you're leaving from and get a few plain sentences on what the destination requires: microchip, rabies vaccination, antibody tests, permits and quarantine. Then follow the full checklist with deadlines and official sources. Covers 14 destinations including the EU, UK, US, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, Japan and Singapore.

A PHOTO FEED THAT'S ONLY PETS
See how other pets spend their days, follow the accounts you like, and keep a page for your own.

GOOD TO KNOW
• The health check is a screening aid, not a diagnosis, and does not replace a vet.
• Travel rules change. Always confirm with the official authority and your airline before you book.
• You can browse places and travel guides without an account. The health check and the community use Sign in with Apple.
• English and Chinese.

name: PH Driving Test: Exam Reviewer
description:
Unofficial app: it is not affiliated with and does not represent the Land Transportation Office (LTO) or any government agency. The questions are written by us based on the official Filipino Driver's Manual, Volume 1 (2nd edition, 2021) published by the LTO: https://lto.gov.ph/comprehensive-drivers-education-program/

Get ready for the written driver's license exam in the Philippines and pass on your first try.

WHAT'S INSIDE
• 290 questions on everything in the Driver's Manual: road signs, pavement markings, traffic lights, right of way, overtaking, parking, expressways, safe driving, vehicle checks, laws and penalties
• Light vehicles (B, B1, B2) and motorcycles (A, A1), non-professional and professional licences, plus the conductor's licence
• All 60 road signs from the manual: warning, prohibitive and information signs
• A short explanation for every answer, with the page of the Driver's Manual where the rule is

MOCK EXAM LIKE THE REAL ONE
• Non-professional: 40 questions, pass with 30 correct
• Professional: 60 questions, pass with 45 correct
• Skip a question and come back to it, see your mistakes at the end

STUDY YOUR WAY
• Topics: work through the rules one section at a time
• Marathon: all questions shuffled; the ones you miss come back until you know them
• My mistakes and Hard for you: focus on what you get wrong
• Search any question by a word or number
• Progress: what you know, what is shaky and what you have not seen yet

No account, no ads, works offline.

FREE AND FULL ACCESS
Free: 10 questions in every topic and one mock exam a day. Full access unlocks all questions and unlimited mock exams with a one-time purchase: 7 days, 30 days or lifetime. No subscription and no auto-renewal.

The app is for self-study only. It does not replace a driving school, the Comprehensive Driver's Education course or official LTO materials.

name: Photo Redact: PixelVeil
description:
Choose a photo from Photos or Files. PixelVeil finds faces, possible plates and text on your iPhone. Cover the suggestions in one tap, adjust any frame, or draw your own. Review anything the scan may have missed.

Use mosaic, blur, a solid cover or a sticker. Use a solid cover for private details. You can zoom in, move or resize a frame, remove it and undo changes.

Save a separate JPG or PNG at the original pixel size without location or capture metadata. You can keep the normal copy free of branding, or create a separate share version. Your original stays in place.

One payment at download includes all features: edit up to 50 photos per batch, copy frames across matching layouts and save multiple presets. No ads or subscriptions.

No account or analytics. Your photos and recognized text are processed on your device.

name: PianoApp
description:
PianoApp to nauka gry na pianinie, która wciąga jak gra.

POSŁUCHAJ I POWTÓRZ
Tryb Nauka gra krótką frazę i podświetla klawisze. Ty powtarzasz w swoim tempie, z podpowiedziami i numerami palców. Etap po etapie poznajesz cały utwór.

GRAJ W RYTM
W trybie Gra świecące nuty spadają na klawiaturę. Trafiaj w odpowiednim momencie, łap combo, zbieraj gwiazdki i bij rekordy. Wybierz „Czekaj na mnie”, żeby grać bez pośpiechu, albo „Płynnie”, żeby grać w tempie utworu.

KONCERT Z ORKIESTRĄ
Zdobądź 3 gwiazdki i zagraj cały utwór z podkładem orkiestry. Za udany koncert dostaniesz trofeum.

PONAD 100 UTWORÓW
Kołysanki i piosenki dla dzieci, piosenki ludowe z całego świata, kolędy i klasyka: Beethoven, Mozart, Bach, Haydn, Brahms, Grieg, Pachelbel i inni. Do tego ćwiczenia na początek. 51 kolęd: polskie, angielskie, niemieckie i francuskie. Nowe utwory dodajemy na bieżąco.

SWOBODNA KLAWIATURA
Fortepian z nagranych próbek i 6 innych instrumentów, metronom, sustain, podwójna klawiatura i gra wieloma palcami naraz.

MOTYWACJA KAŻDEGO DNIA
Misje dnia, wyzwania tygodnia, seria dni, poziomy i liga. Towarzyszą Ci postacie z baśni i legend: Słowik, Muzykanci z Bremy, Smok Wawelski i wiele innych.

PEŁNY DOSTĘP NA ZAWSZE
Dwa utwory i fortepian wypróbujesz za darmo. Wszystkie utwory, kolędy i instrumenty odblokujesz jednorazową płatnością, bez subskrypcji. Masz już konto? Zaloguj się e-mailem, a kupiony dostęp włączy się od razu.

Aplikacja uczy gry na klawiaturze ekranowej telefonu i tabletu. Najwygodniej gra się na tablecie.

name: Pickleball Arena 3D
description:
Play a full 3D pickleball match against a smart AI opponent.

Pickleball Arena supports over-the-shoulder, top-down, and side cameras, so you can play the angle you like. Balls bounce with real physics and air drag, serves stay underhand, and the non-volley kitchen is enforced. First to eleven, win by two.

• Three selectable camera angles
• Underhand serve and kitchen rules
• Physics-based bounce and air drag
• Smart AI opponent that covers the court
• Eleven-point, win-by-two scoring

No account, no ads, no in-app purchases, and no data collection.

name: Plant Identifier: Weed & Care
description:
Point your camera at a plant, flower, tree, weed or mushroom and find out what it is, how sure the app is, whether it is safe for cats, dogs and kids, and how to care for it or get rid of it. No ads, no account, and no free trial that turns into a charge.

A STRAIGHT ANSWER, NOT A GUESS
When the reader is certain, it says Identified. When it is the best match but a look-alike is possible, it says Likely match and shows how to tell the look-alikes apart. When the photo cannot settle it, it says Not sure. If it is only likely, the app asks for the one photo that decides it, and checking again never uses a scan.

SAFE FOR PETS AND KIDS?
Every plant gets a clear answer for cats, dogs and kids. Plants that irritate skin get a careful-touching warning, and plants with deadly look-alikes, like Queen Anne's lace and poison hemlock, get a warning with the one feature that tells them apart.

MUSHROOMS TOO, WITH DEADLY LOOK-ALIKES
The app names a mushroom's most likely species, lists its look-alikes with the deadly ones first, and shows the feature that tells them apart. Every wild mushroom is marked toxic for pets and kids, and the app never says a mushroom is safe to eat.

SICK PLANT? FIND OUT WHY, AND WHICH BUG
Photograph the problem and get the likely cause, what it probably is not, what to do today and over the next weeks, and whether it can spread. When bugs are the cause, it names the pest, how to spot it, where it hides, and whether it harms people or pets.

JUST ASK OUT LOUD
Tap and ask a question out loud, from the home screen or any plant's page, and hear the answer. It already knows your plants: their photos, care, watering and diary.

WEEDS, CARE AND REMINDERS
Find out if it is a weed, an invasive plant, or a native worth keeping, and how to remove it. Every saved plant gets a care guide, watering and feeding reminders that adjust for winter, a water calculator for your pot size, and a ZIP code check on whether it survives your winter outdoors.

GOING AWAY?
Pick how long you will be gone and the app writes a plain plant-sitter sheet: which plant to water on which days, how much, and which to keep away from pets. Send it by text or email.

FREE AND PRO
Free: 5 scans (answers of Not sure never use one), 3 spoken questions, care reminders, the water calculator, the sitter sheet, your plant list, diary and export.
Pro: up to 500 scans and health checks a month, questions out loud or typed. Monthly, yearly, or a one-time lifetime price. Subscriptions renew until you cancel in Settings.

Identifications come from photos and can be wrong. Never eat a wild plant or mushroom because an app named it. If a pet or child ate a plant, call your vet or Poison Control (1-800-222-1222).

name: Plant Squad
description:
Keep every plant in your home happy. Plant Squad knows who's thirsty, so you don't have to remember.

SNAP A PHOTO, KNOW YOUR PLANT
• Take a picture and Plant Squad suggests what it is, from 240+ houseplants, succulents, cacti, orchids, palms, herbs and balcony plants
• Recognition runs on your phone: your photos are never uploaded
• Not sure? Pick from the list or choose a general type

A RHYTHM FOR EVERY PLANT
• Each plant gets its own watering schedule from its kind, its light and the season
• Tap "Still wet" when the soil is damp and it learns how your plant really drinks
• Prefer your own schedule? Set it in days

• At most one notification a day, only when a plant needs you
• Mark them all as watered right from the notification
• "Check the soil first" for succulents and other plants that hate wet feet

CARE GUIDES FOR 250+ PLANTS
• Light, water and humidity at a glance
• Which plants are toxic to cats and dogs
• A tip for every plant

YOUR WHOLE SQUAD
• Your plants as a photo grid, room by room
• Water a whole room with one tap
• Give every plant its own name

PLANT SQUAD PRO
Free: up to 3 plants, with photo identification, reminders and care guides.
Pro adds unlimited plants and the home screen widget (water with one tap).
Try Pro free for 7 days, then US$9.99 per year (or the equivalent in your currency). Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm after the trial. The subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the trial or current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your Apple Account settings.

No ads. No account. Your plants stay on your phone.

name: Polizei Österreich Testtrainer
description:
Inoffizielle, unabhängige Lernhilfe: Diese App steht in keiner Verbindung zur Polizei, zum Bundesministerium für Inneres oder zu einer Landespolizeidirektion.

name: Prism Atoll
description:
Prism Atoll is a 3D color puzzle for Apple Vision Pro. Guide pairs of glassy orbs onto a board with three levels. Connect at least four orbs of the same color through shared faces to make them bloom. The orbs above them fall into place and can trigger another bloom. Plan a few moves ahead to build a cascade.

Look and pinch to choose a column. Pinch once while looking at the floating pair to turn it, or twice to drop it. Use both hands to turn or move the board and see how the colors connect across levels.

Play in your space or step into a Japanese-inspired island garden with an ocean horizon. An original ambient soundtrack accompanies both modes and can be muted in-game.

Take your time with the illustrated guide and play without a timer. Your game is saved on your device, ready to resume in either mode.

name: Proposal Studio
description:
Proposal Studio turns an in-home heat pump visit into a clean, visual presentation the homeowner can follow and sign on the spot.

Built by an HVAC company for its own sales team, it lets a rep:

• Walk the customer through their home, the recommended system and where each unit goes, using photos taken on site
• Choose equipment from the company price book, with line set and wiring runs priced automatically
• Show estimated savings and the rebates the customer qualifies for
• Check an electrical panel photo for a likely panel upgrade
• Look up the home's size from public property records
• Email a polished proposal straight to the customer and send the matching quote to the office

Every rep signs in with their own account and the office controls the price book. A company account is required; accounts are set up by your office.

name: Pulsebit
description:
Make a morning habit of checking in with your resting pulse. Pulsebit uses your iPhone’s rear camera and flash to estimate your pulse while you rest a fingertip lightly over the lens.

- Follow the on-screen guide to position your fingertip.
- Save the estimate to your journal and view your last seven mornings.
- Compare a new estimate with recent morning readings once you have enough entries.
- Set a morning reminder and switch between English, Japanese, German, and Spanish in Settings.

Saved readings stay on your iPhone. Pulsebit is designed for personal wellness tracking. Consult a healthcare professional before making medical decisions.

name: Pumpwell: Pump Parts Tracker
description:
Pumpwell keeps every part of your breast pump fresh and on schedule.

Valves, duckbills, membranes, backflow protectors, flanges and tubing all wear out at different speeds, and worn parts can quietly lower suction. Pumpwell knows the typical replacement time for each part, adjusts it to how often you pump, and reminds you before anything is due.

EVERY PART, PERFECTLY TIMED
• Pick your pump from popular models or a pump type, and Pumpwell sets up its parts for you
• A live countdown and health ring for every part
• Schedules adapt to occasional, regular or exclusive pumping
• Set your own interval for any part
• Mark parts replaced today or on an earlier date, with full history

NEVER RUN OUT OF SPARES
• Track the spares you have for every part
• Low-stock warnings you set yourself
• An automatic shopping list of what to buy next, ready to share in one tap
• Tap Bought to add new spares

INSURANCE REORDERS
• Track how often your plan covers replacement parts
• Get a reminder when your next covered reorder is due
• Keep your supplier's name and phone number at hand

A BEAUTIFUL CARE REPORT
• Create a polished PDF of your pumps, parts, due dates, spares and history

HELPFUL GUIDES
• Flange fit: a suggested flange size from one simple measurement
• Replacement guide: what to look for between changes
• Cleaning basics, plus a daily sanitize tracker with streaks

ON EVERY DEVICE
• iPhone, and iPad with a spacious layout
• Mac and Apple Vision Pro
• A standalone Apple Watch app with watch face complications. Mark parts replaced right from your wrist. When your iPhone is nearby, your watch stays in sync.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no ads, no tracking

Available in 30 languages, with dates and numbers in your region's format.

Pumpwell is an organizer and reminder tool, not a medical device. Replacement times are typical guidance; always follow your pump maker's instructions, and ask a lactation consultant or doctor about fit, pain or supply. name: PuzzleBento: Sudoku & Logic
description:
Two squares add up to seven. One holds a three. That little deduction is your way into Killer Sudoku. When you feel like solving something with your hands instead, pick Water Sort and pour until each color has a tube of its own.

Eight games share one shelf. Pencil in candidates in Classic Sudoku. In Kakuro, find the one digit that works in both a row and a column. Drag across a Nonogram to uncover a picture, one strip at a time.

Swipe matching tiles together in 2048, hold a square to plant a flag in Minesweeper, or use the single gap in the 15 Puzzle to slide the last tile home.

All eight games are free and work offline on iPhone and iPad. No ads, purchases, subscriptions, or account to set up. Your progress stays on your device, and the games you played most recently move to the front. Play with sound or in silence, in any of seven interface languages including Spanish and Korean.

name: Qiblane: Prayer Times, Quran
description:
Qiblane is a simple, beautiful companion for your daily worship. Completely free, with no ads, no accounts and no tracking.

PRAYER TIMES
• Accurate Fajr, Sunrise, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib and Isha times for your location
• Popular calculation methods (Muslim World League, ISNA, Umm al-Qura, Egyptian, Karachi, Diyanet and more)
• Hanafi or Shafi'i Asr, and your own minute adjustments to match your mosque
• Live countdown to the next prayer and a weekly and monthly timetable

PRAYER REMINDERS
• A notification at each prayer time, on or off for every prayer with one tap

WIDGETS
• Home Screen widgets with today's five prayers and a live countdown
• Lock Screen widgets for the next prayer at a glance
• The widget colours follow the time of day
• Small, medium and large sizes, including a list of all five times

SIRI AND SHORTCUTS
• Ask "Next prayer in Qiblane" or "Prayer times in Qiblane" without opening the app

THE HOLY QURAN
• All 114 surahs in Uthmani script, with colour-coded tajweed
• Saheeh International English translation and transliteration
• Turkish and Indonesian meanings
• Choose your Arabic font and text size, or read Arabic only

QIBLA
• Qibla compass, corrected for magnetic declination, with the distance to the Kaaba

DHIKR
• Tasbih counter for after-prayer adhkar (SubhanAllah 33, Alhamdulillah 33, Allahu Akbar 34) with gentle haptics
• Free count mode

HIJRI CALENDAR
• Today's Hijri date and upcoming Islamic events

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your location is used only on your iPhone to calculate times and the qibla. Your settings stay on your device. Qiblane does not collect, sell or share any personal data.

Works offline. Available in English, Turkish, Arabic and Indonesian.

name: QR出退勤管理
description: 2次元コードをかざすことで出勤時間と退勤時間を記録できるアプリです。アプリ内で2次元コードも作れますので、すぐにご使用いただけます。共有ボタンからCSVファイルにも書き出せます。このご時世ですので、記録は端末内に保存される仕様になっていますので、情報はネット上に出回りません。1年間使用を続けると、挙動が遅くなると思いますので、定期的に書き出して、履歴を削除されることをお勧めします。

name: QuoteCedar Estimates
description:
Build a prospective quote from your own line items, see how discount and tax affect each line, and keep an independent document of the estimate.

• Enter a quote title, optional issuer and customer text, and a three-letter currency label.
• Add manual lines or copy saved catalogue items into an independent quote.
• Use exact decimal quantity and rate input with explicit per-line rounding.
• Apply your chosen discount and tax rates and inspect the line-by-line totals.
• Create a revision, compare saved versions, and freeze actual PDF and CSV documents.
