QuoteCedar prepares draft estimates. It does not collect payments, email customers, submit tax filings or convert currencies. You provide the business details, units, currency and applicable rates; no jurisdiction-specific rate is supplied.

Your saved work stays in this app’s local library. Use the system sharing controls when you choose to export a file. System backups may include app data.

name: Ram Leela: Ramayana Adventure
description:
Explore Ayodhya as young Ram and leap across the sea as Hanuman in this six-chapter pixel-art adventure through the Ramayana.

Every choice changes your journey. Decide what Ram and his companions do, and the story follows you into different scenes and moments. Play again, choose differently, and find every path. The journey map counts the paths you have found.

Your first adventures are close to home. Wander through the market and practice archery alongside Ram’s brothers. By the time you reach Lanka, Hanuman is searching for Sita with Ram’s ring to give her.

• Fly as Jatayu and intercept Ravan’s chariot. Fit stones into a bridge before the next wave rolls in. Steer Hanuman through the clouds with a mountain in his hand.
• Ride home with Bharat or stay in the forest with Lakshman. See how different traditions tell a familiar tale, then revisit your discoveries in the Library of Ramayans.
• Collect Wisdom cards as you play. Three save slots let you and your family keep separate journeys on the same device.

Play the whole first chapter free. A single optional in-app purchase unlocks Chapters 2–6 for all three save slots. You can buy or restore the unlock from the title screen. The story plays offline, with no ads or account required.

Created by Sachin Agrawal, Ariel Agrawal and Ethan Agrawal.

name: RapidResponse Command Ops
description:
RapidResponse Command Ops is the companion app to the RapidResponse ICS Field Guide. It puts ten fillable Command and Command Staff worksheets and the Command Staff position checklists in your pocket, saved by incident and operational period and ready to share as a PDF.

SAVE EVERY INCIDENT AND OPERATIONAL PERIOD
• Everything you enter is saved automatically to the current incident and operational period. Closing the app never erases your work.
• Name the incident, add the incident number, set the operational period dates and times, and record who completed it.
• Tap "Next OP" to start the next operational period. The previous one stays on file.
• Saved incidents are grouped by incident. Reopen, edit or delete any record.
• Share a full incident package as one PDF: a cover sheet, every worksheet you filled in and every checklist in progress.

10 COMMAND OPERATIONS WORKSHEETS
• CW-A Command Worksheet: All Hazards
• CW-F Command Worksheet: Fire / Structural
• CW-H Command Worksheet: Hazardous Materials
• CW-L Command Worksheet: Law Enforcement / Active Assailant
• CW-M Command Worksheet: Mass Casualty Incident
• CS-P Public Information Officer Worksheet
• CS-L Liaison Officer Worksheet
• CS-S Safety Officer Worksheet
• CA-1 All Hazard Incident Complexity Analysis
• PAR Personnel Accountability Report

FILL THEM OUT ON THE WORKSHEET ITSELF
• Tap any box on the worksheet to type in it, or tap a check box to mark it. Previous and Next buttons move you from field to field.
• Draw the situation sketch, site plan or tactical worksheet with your finger or Apple Pencil.
• Pinch with two fingers to zoom in and move around the worksheet, or switch to the field list for fast typing. On iPad the worksheet fills the whole screen in landscape.
• Incident name, incident number and operational period fill in for you.
• Send the completed worksheet as a PDF by email or text, or share a blank worksheet to print.

COMMAND STAFF CHECKLISTS FROM THE ICS FIELD GUIDE
• Incident Commander, Public Information Officer, Liaison Officer and Safety Officer position checklists.
• Check off tasks in the list or right on the CrisisComms.org PDF form. Each check is time-stamped automatically.
• Share a completed checklist PDF or a plain-text activity log for your ICS 214.

BUILT FOR THE FIELD
• Works completely offline. No signal at the command post? Every worksheet and checklist is on your device.
• Search across all worksheets, checklists and tasks.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account. No sign-in. No ads. No analytics. No tracking.
• Everything you enter stays on your device unless you choose to share it.

Published by CrisisComms.org: crisis and strategic communications consulting, training, and crisis response. Bringing Order To The Chaos.

These worksheets and checklists are reference aids based on standard ICS guidance. They do not replace your agency's plans, SOPs, training, or the direction of the Incident Commander.

name: Retain AI Education
description:
Retain AI Education is the tool our tutors use to run their classes, and where learners find what to work on afterwards.

FOR TUTORS
• See your week at a glance: every class, who has booked, and how full you are
• Open class times for booking and share your booking link
• Run a class: mark attendance, upload the question paper, add notes or a recording
• Get an analysis for each learner that pinpoints the skills they lost marks on
• Review it, then send it to the learner with one tap

FOR LEARNERS AND PARENTS
• Book classes with your tutor
• After each class, get short sections to work on, each explained in two sentences
• Each section lists the exact textbook exercises to do, with the questions pinned at the top
• Do the work on paper, photograph it and hand it in from your phone
• Get feedback on your working within minutes

BUILT FOR SOUTH AFRICAN SCHOOLS
Exercises are matched to the CAPS curriculum and link to free, openly licensed textbooks.

PRIVACY
Learners under 18 need a parent or guardian's consent before any schoolwork is stored. Tutors see only their own learners. You can delete your account at any time in the app.

name: Retroland: Game Shop Sim
description:
Your aunt Dot was a legend. For thirty years her game shop kept Brightwater playing: midnight launches, queues round the block, her name on the evening news. Then a collector everyone calls the Curator started buying up every old cartridge in town and locking it in a vault.

Now Dot's gone, and the shop is yours. There's a box on the curb, five sealed envelopes on the counter, and a whole town of games about to disappear.

Retroland is a cozy retro game shop sim. Drive your van round town, buy what people are clearing out, sort every box in a quick puzzle, and turn a pile of junk into a shelf of treasure.

DIG
• Garage sales, thrift stores, flea markets, the beach Lost & Found, a pawn shop, an estate sale up on Old Money Hill and a storage auction
• A yard sale pops up on a different street every day, with a theme on the table
• Every lot is a gamble, and some hide a Find. Maybe the ultra-rare one.

SORT
• Every lot is a short sorting puzzle: get each game into a crate of its own
• 600 puzzles, with padlocked crates, busted crates and three stars for sorting fast
• Stuck? Tip Line magazines turn up in the bins, and each one shows you the next move
• Climb the ranks from Rookie to Legend

COLLECT
• 60 games for two consoles, the Moxie 8 and the Zephyr 16, each with its own box, manual and label art
• Loose, boxed or complete in box: chase a full set for each console
• Blow out dusty carts, fix them up, keep the best copy and sell the rest over the counter
• Test mystery carts with no label at all. A few are secrets Dot left behind.
• Seal a rare find for a collector, or plug it into the arcade and play it

RESTORE
• Ten projects, from scrubbing thirty years of grime off the windows to rewiring the neon
• Each one shows from the street and brings in business, all the way to a grand reopening
• Upgrade the van, and find five paint jobs hidden in the bins

PLAY
• Real playable arcade cabinets in the back of the shop, with Dot's high scores to beat
• Race rivals to the good stuff in head-to-head Showdowns
• Folks leave messages on the answering machine asking after one particular game. Bring it round and they'll tell you something about Dot.

THE STORY
Four chapters, two endings, and a town full of people who knew Dot. Funny on the surface, heartfelt underneath. And somewhere in Brightwater is a game nobody has ever played.

THE GOOD STUFF
• Free, with no ads and no in-app purchases
• No account, no data collected, and it plays offline
• An original 16-bit soundtrack, with a tune for every part of town
• Made for iPhone Duo too: open it up for the town on one side and the shop on the other

Every console, company and game in Retroland is fictional.

name: Ricochet: Neon Disc
description:
Ricochet is a neon arcade game about one flick at a time.

Touch below the red line and flick the energy disc upward. It bounces off the walls and smashes the targets it hits. Clear every target to finish the level. If the disc comes back across the line, the game is over.

- Bank shots off the walls for Ricochet bonuses. More walls before a hit means more points.
- Hit targets in a row for combos.
- Pick up shields and magnets, and take on timed challenges.
- Unlock 37 achievements, some of them secret.
- Put your best score on the High Scores board shared by every player.
- Choose your flick sensitivity and one of several animated backgrounds.

No ads. No in-app purchases. No account to create: High Scores use your iCloud account.

name: RideScreen
description:
RideScreen puts what matters on your motorcycle's screen: map, navigation, speed and engine data, even with your iPhone locked in your pocket.

BIKE DASH
• Its own Wi‑Fi projection: a map that follows your position, destination and next turn, speed and time.
• Five new designs (LED, analog, VFD, minimal and cockpit), plus map, clean, Pit, Classic and Focus.
• A photo background of your choice, automatic, day or night theme, and adjustable margins.
• It connects by itself when you reach the bike, and disconnects when you lock it.

ROUTES AND NAVIGATION
• Destination by search, saved places, Apple Maps or Google Maps links, Shortcuts and Siri.
• Route planner, GPX import and export, voice prompts, traffic lights and a lap timer.

RIDES
• Local GPS recording, heat map, records, trophies and weekly and yearly summaries.
• Ride video over your own clip, with route, speed and time.
• Engine data from an OBD adapter (ELM327 over Bluetooth or Wi‑Fi): revs, temperature and voltage.

YOUR BIKE
• Keyless key: lock, unlock, open the seat and the tank, also with Siri.
• Maintenance, fuel stations, parking with a photo, battery alert and optional fall detection.
• Passenger mode, live route sharing, widgets and backup.

PRIVACY
No accounts, no ads. Your rides and settings stay on your iPhone. Sending anonymous data is optional and never includes your location.

COMPATIBILITY
It needs a motorcycle with a TFT dash that connects to a phone with a QR code (EasyConnect / MotoPlay). The app tells you whether your bike is compatible. RideScreen is independent: it is not an official app of any motorcycle maker.

PRICE
The app is free. The full unlock is a single payment, no subscription, and works on all your devices with the same Apple ID.

name: RIGLI
description:
RIGLI est l’application des locataires, propriétaires, artisans et agents qui travaillent avec une agence de gestion locative utilisant RIGLI.

• Signaler un problème dans le logement en quelques gestes : description, photos, urgence.
• Suivre l’avancement : l’agence, l’artisan et vous voyez les mêmes informations.
• Valider un devis et consulter les factures et documents (PDF) directement dans l’application.
• État des lieux d’entrée et de sortie, avec signature.
• Notifications instantanées dès qu’il y a du nouveau, même application fermée.

Votre espace est personnel : il est ouvert par votre agence, puis protégé par votre mot de passe. Pour supprimer votre compte, ouvrez votre profil dans l’application.

name: Ripple Pond: Lotus Puzzle
description:
Ripple Pond is a calm puzzle about one gentle gesture: tap the water, and a ripple spreads two steps, flipping every lily pad it touches. Bloom them all in as few taps as you can.

• 56 hand-crafted story ponds across eight areas, from Little Pond to the Night Garden, each teaching one new idea: golden lotus chains, koi that swim with every ripple, choose-your-stone, moon reflections, twin roots, reeds and glass water, night lilies.
• Growing "sluice" ponds that open stage by stage.
• 1000+ extra ponds in 41 packs, unlocked as you learn.
• A daily pond in three tiers (the same for everyone), a forgiving streak, and spoiler-free sharing.
• Tide: an endless mode — every tap uses a drop, every bloom refills.
• Still Ponds with no counting, and a koi garden that grows as you play.
• Every par is the true minimum. Hints are always free and point to a move that can still win (or tell you to undo).
• Designed for everyone: no reading needed to start, colour-blind friendly shapes, reduced-motion support, English and Korean.
• Generative Korean-inspired music for gayageum, geomungo and flute, with a quiet stream underneath.
• Story ponds 1–14, the daily pond, Still Ponds, replays and hints are free. After that each new pond uses one lotus of energy (one regrows every 20 minutes, up to 5), or refill with coin packs, or remove the limit with Unlimited forever (a one-time purchase). No subscriptions.
• Fully offline. No ads, no accounts, no data collection.

name: Root Face
description:
Root Face names the prep whose land is under 1 mm.

Land is wall minus bevel. Drag the bevel on the section. If the land is under 1 mm, the thinnest prep is named. A bevel that meets the wall is not stored. Changing the wall does not rewrite the bevel. The last prep stays.

A photo stays on the iPhone and does not change the land. Share the call when you choose to. There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: RTM – Route to Market
description:
RTM is the field app for consumer-goods companies and their merchandisers and sales reps.

PLAN THE DAY
• Your shops and today's visits, with addresses and directions
• Tasks and checklists per shop, set by your company

PROVE THE VISIT
• GPS check-in at the shop
• Your route is recorded during company working hours, so managers see where the team was (a blue indicator shows while recording)
• Works offline – everything is sent when the connection returns

SHELF PHOTOS WITH AI
• Photograph the shelf; RTM counts your products and competitors' products
• Share of shelf, missing products and planogram checks, per shop and per category
• Prices read from shelf tags

ORDERS, RETURNS AND PAYMENTS
• Take orders and returns at the shop
• Record payments

FOR MANAGERS
• Live map of the team, visit reports and KPIs on rtm.ge

RTM accounts are created by your company. If you do not have a login, ask your company's RTM administrator.

name: Rudi Tools
description:
Rudi Tools puts a set of measuring instruments in one app, free and with no ads. There's no account to create, and the app doesn't send anything anywhere.

Every reading shows which sensor it comes from and how accurate it is. If your iPhone can't measure something, the app tells you plainly instead of showing a made-up number.

Tools:
• Level — bubble, edge mode, relative angle, slope in % and mm/m, 10-second calibration
• Camera level — a level line over the live camera view, a measure mode and angles from a photo
• Compass — warns when metal or a magnet is nearby, with true north
• Sound meter — approximate dB(A), can be tuned to a reference meter
• Tuner — chromatic and guitar
• Magnetometer — field strength in µT and a search mode for magnets and steel
• Barometer — pressure and height change
• GPS speedometer — speed, trip, coordinates
• Sun — sunrise, sunset, golden and blue hour, sun position, and a widget for today
• Ruler — calibrate it with a card, a tape measure or a coin
• Flashlight — torch, SOS, strobe, screen light and red night light
• Magnifier — zoom with light and freeze frame
• My phone — what your phone's sensors can do

Save any result with one tap, with the time and a note. Saved measurements stay on your phone.

Privacy: the app never connects to the internet. The microphone only measures loudness and pitch and never records. Camera and location are used only in the tools that need them, and photos are not saved.

Rudi, the little fox's dad from RudiKids, gives tips for more accurate measurements — and never covers your readings. When you calibrate, a picture shows how to turn the phone.

name: Runroute: Running Route Maker
description:
Runroute plans running routes for you. Choose where to start and how far you want to go, and it finds several loops on real paths that bring you back to where you started.

PICK A START
• Use your location, search for a town, place or postcode, or just tap the map
• Drag the pin to start from exactly the right spot

PICK A DISTANCE
• 1 mile, 5K, 10K, 10 miles, half marathon or marathon
• Or any distance you like, in kilometres or miles
• Loops, or out-and-back routes

GET ROUTES WORTH RUNNING
• Up to five different loops at a time, and "More routes" for a fresh set
• Routes favour footpaths, bridleways, tracks, parks and quiet streets, and keep off main roads wherever there's another way
• Every route shows what it's made of: how much is paths and tracks, pavements and quiet streets, and any main road, with a clear warning if it can't be avoided
• The real distance and how close it is to what you asked for
• Total climb and an elevation profile
• Your finish time, from your usual pace

TAKE IT WITH YOU
• Share any route as a GPX file to Garmin Connect, Strava, Komoot, Files or any app that opens GPX, with heights included
• Star the routes you like: saved routes stay on your phone and open even without signal

Routes come from OpenStreetMap, the free map made by millions of people, so they work across the UK, Europe and much of the world. Paths change and maps aren't perfect: always check a route is safe to run.

Free, with no account, no ads and no tracking.

name: SaveBox App
description:
SaveBox suit vos colis de la Chine jusqu'en Afrique, par avion ou par bateau.

POUR LES CLIENTS
• Trouvez votre agence de transit par son nom ou son @identifiant.
• Badge bleu : l'agence a été vérifiée par SaveBox (licence commerciale chinoise et code de crédit social).
• Copiez en un geste l'adresse de l'entrepôt en Chine, en chinois ou en anglais, avec le numéro du réceptionniste.
• Enregistrez votre colis avec son numéro de suivi, une photo et la ville de livraison.
• Suivez chaque étape : reçu en Chine, vérifié, parti, arrivé, prêt à récupérer. Une notification vous prévient.
• Confirmez la réception et notez l'agence pour aider les autres clients.

POUR LES AGENCES
• Inscription en 3 étapes, validation par SaveBox et badge bleu.
• Scannez les cartons qui arrivent : le client est retrouvé tout seul.
• Réceptionnez, refusez ou demandez une correction, changez le statut : le client est prévenu.
• Invitez votre équipe avec des rôles et des permissions précises.
• Répondez aux avis et voyez combien de clients veulent un transport que vous ne proposez pas encore.

SIMPLE ET SÛR
• Connexion par code WhatsApp, sans mot de passe.
• Vos documents restent privés. Vous pouvez supprimer votre compte à tout moment.

name: SchoolBusTrack Driver
description:
The app for school bus drivers and chaperones at schools that use SchoolBusTrack. Your school creates your account: sign in with the details they give you and today's trips are waiting.

BEFORE YOU DRIVE
• Today's trips at a glance, with the route, the stops and who is travelling
• A pre-trip safety checklist, so every bus leaves checked

ON THE ROAD
• Turn-by-turn directions, spoken aloud, from stop to stop
• The bus's position is shared live with the school and with families, only while a trip is running
• Built for patchy signal: boarding records are kept on the phone and sent when coverage returns

BOARDING
• Mark each child on and off the bus: tap their name, or scan their bus pass card (NFC)
• A rear-seat check at the end of every trip, so no child is left on board

STAYING IN TOUCH
• Message the school office, with photos and voice notes
• Voice and video calls with the office. The phone rings like a normal call, even when the app is closed
• SOS for real emergencies, and incident reports for everything else

YOUR RECORD
• Safety score and driving history
• Record fuel stops

SchoolBusTrack Driver works only with an account from a school that uses SchoolBusTrack.

name: SchoolBusTrack Parent
description:
Know where your child's school bus is, every school day.

SchoolBusTrack Parent connects you to your child's school bus in real time. Your school sets up your account: sign in with the email and password they give you, and your children, their bus and their route are already there.

LIVE TRACKING
• Watch the bus move on the map, with a live arrival time for your stop
• Morning runs: follow the bus to your stop, then all the way to school
• Afternoon runs: tracking starts once your child is on board and the bus leaves school
• More than one child? Switch between them with a tap, even if they ride different buses

ALERTS THAT MATTER
• Boarding confirmation the moment your child gets on the bus
• Bus nearby: a heads-up minutes before it reaches your stop
• Arrived at school, and dropped off at your stop
• Delay updates from the school
Choose which alerts you get in Settings.

YOUR CHILD AT A GLANCE
• A card for each child with their status, driver and route
• Trip history: check whether they boarded on any day this week
• Fine-tune your pickup point, within the distance your school allows

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• You only ever see your own stop, never other families'
• You can follow the bus only while your child's trip is running

REPORT AN ISSUE
Late pickup, a safety concern or a route problem? Report it from the app and it goes straight to your school.

SchoolBusTrack Parent is for families whose school uses SchoolBusTrack. If your school hasn't set you up yet, ask the school office.

name: Scorch: Golf Scorecard
description:
Scorch is the golf scorecard built for Finnish courses. Pull it up on the first tee, pick who's playing and start marking.

- Every Finnish course with pars and hole maps, from the OpenStreetMap catalog
- Score the whole group on one phone: stroke play, match play or scramble
- Distance to the green from where you stand, plus a rangefinder
- Works with no signal: scores stay on the phone and sync when you're back online
- Share a live scorecard link, or a recap image of the round
- Stats, head-to-head records against friends, badges and your Scorch Level
- Friends, friend board and public profiles
- Finnish and English

Scorch records strokes. It doesn't calculate handicaps or Stableford points, and it isn't connected to any handicap system. Your data is never sold.

Made in Finland by FHATAL.

name: Scrolloom
description:
Scrolloom turns scrolling pages into long screenshots. Start a capture using the system control, switch to a scrollable page, and scroll slowly. Scrolloom stitches the frames into one image. Some protected content cannot be captured.

Crop, annotate, or mask details. Text recognition can find and redact matching text. Export as PNG or PDF, copy to the clipboard, or share.

Capture, stitching, and text recognition happen on your iPhone. No account, ads, analytics, or media uploads to the developer. All features are free. Optional one-time tips under More → About → Support Scrolloom unlock no features.

name: scrt.ly
description:
scrt.ly (pronounced “secretly”) is a home for your gift ideas. Save things you’d love, share one list, and let friends and family coordinate gifts without giving away the surprise.

SAVE FROM THE SHOPS YOU LOVE
Paste a product link to look for its name, photo and price, or use Save to scrt.ly in the Safari share sheet. Choose a list, review the details and save. You can always edit a wish or add your own photo and notes. Import results depend on the shop.

A LIST FOR EVERY OCCASION
Keep birthday wishes, holiday ideas, housewarming gifts and everyday finds in separate lists. Add a cover, organize wishes into categories, and choose who can view each list. Create a shared list with someone you mutually follow.

SHARE THE LIST. KEEP THE SURPRISE.
Friends sign in to view your list and reserve gifts so others know what’s taken. Reservations and purchases stay hidden from list owners, and buyer identities stay anonymous. Purchases happen at the shop.

GOOD IDEAS FROM PEOPLE YOU FOLLOW
Follow friends to see their recent wishes, like ideas to keep privately, or rewish a find to one of your own lists. Private wishes only appear when you have access.

KEEP AN EYE ON PRICES
Get in-app updates when a tracked price drops. Price checks depend on the shop and may not be available for every product.

Sign in with Apple or create an account to save and share.

name: ServSafe Manager Test: EN & ES
description:
2027 Edition — FDA Food Code 2022 + 2026 updates. Every answer is linked to the official rule.

Prepare for the certified food protection manager (CFPM) exam and the food handler test in English and Spanish.

2027 EDITION
Manager exams follow the FDA Food Code 2022. The 2026 edition was released in September 2026 — its changes are marked so you know what is new.

WHAT'S INSIDE
• 480 manager questions in 9 sections: foodborne illness, time and temperature, cleaning, HACCP, pests and more
• 135 food handler questions — switch between manager and handler anytime
• Practice test in the real format: 90 questions, 2 hours, 80 scored
• A clear explanation for every answer, with the Food Code section it is based on
• Key temperatures and times on one page
• Every question in English and Spanish — the other language one tap away
• Mistakes review, readiness score and search
• Works offline, no account

Free: 10 questions in every topic and 1 practice test.

SUBSCRIPTION
Full access: weekly or monthly auto-renewable subscription, or a one-time lifetime purchase. Payment is charged to your Apple ID. Subscriptions renew automatically at the same price unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period; manage or cancel them in Settings → Apple ID → Subscriptions.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

ServSafe is a registered trademark of the National Restaurant Association. This app is not affiliated with or endorsed by the National Restaurant Association, ServSafe, Prometric, NRFSP, the FDA or any government agency. Questions and explanations are written by us from the FDA Food Code.

name: Shoalwater Bay Tribe
description:
The official app of the Shoalwater Bay Indian Tribe in Tokeland, Washington.

Find Tribal services, staff, events and emergency information in one place, made easy to read and easy to use on a phone.

• See at a glance whether Tribal offices are open, and call the main office with one tap
• Browse every department and program, with hours, phone numbers and directions
• Look up staff in the directory and call or email them
• Keep up with community events, office closures, news and notices
• Find jobs, Requests for Proposal, and Tribal codes and forms
• Emergency information and contacts from the Tribe's Emergency Management office, available even without a connection
• Tribal members can sign in to the Member Portal for member news, documents and requests
• Choose larger text, have pages read aloud, and save shortcuts to the pages and people you use most

Everything public works without signing in. Information comes straight from shoalwaterbaytribe.org, so the app stays current whenever the website is updated.

name: Silk Hop
description:
Mina swings at the end of her silk thread. Touch the screen to cast the thread, let go to fly, and cross the garden from leaf to flower.

• 12 handmade levels, from the vegetable patch to the great oak, plus a daily challenge every morning
• One finger, acrobat thrills: momentum, bounces, big leaps
• Grandpa holds out his net under the first levels to catch your first fall
• Collect Mina's hats: earned by playing or at a fixed price, nothing left to chance
• No energy, no subscription, no paid draws

Available in French and English.

name: Silly Hero Maker: Habit Game
description:
A habit game where every habit you tap makes your own goofy hero smash a monster.

■ Make any hero you want
Give your hero a goofy old-man face, a slice of toast, a puppy or a broccoli. Pick hats, capes, masks, chest marks and things to hold, in any color. Drag decorations anywhere on the body (up to 30) and spin your 3D hero around.

■ Tap a habit, BAM!
Choose up to 8 of 30 habits: brush teeth, drink water, wake up early, go for a walk and more. Each tap sends your hero to knock out a habit monster. Skip a habit, and its monster lazes around your home the next day.

■ Tap fast to beat giant monsters
Each habit gives you a ticket. Spend it on a 10-second tapping battle and chip away at a giant monster over days. Beat it and a silly hero like Chief Toast or Boss Frog joins your team (30 in all).

■ Unlock new parts with coins
Earn coins from habits and battles. Unlock 40 things: crowns, wings, a golden suit, a fart-beam special move, a moon stage and more.

■ Rankings and achievements
Compete on Game Center for your biggest hit and the number of monsters beaten, and earn achievements like a 7-day or 30-day streak.

Just tap your habits and watch the chaos unfold. Have fun building habits, a little every day!

name: Site Boss: Builder Tycoon
description:
Start with one van, one crew and a muddy lock-up. Finish with a construction empire.

Site Boss is a building firm tycoon. Win jobs, read the small print, and grow your yard from a lock-up into a head office.

YOUR YARD, YOUR EMPIRE
Your yard is your home screen, and you watch it grow. Put up a site office, welfare cabin, plant shed, material bays, training room and safety hut. Buy the land next door when you outgrow it. Vans come and go, the crane swings and the lads crack on.

READ THE JOB PACK
Every job comes with a price, a deadline and site notes, and the notes hide problems: bad ground, buried cables, asbestos, wrong drawings, clients who won't pay. Run a site survey, a credit check or a drawing review. Price the problems in, or turn the job down.

OVER 40 KINDS OF JOB
Garden walls, re-roofs, knock-throughs, loft conversions, underpinning, barn conversions, drainage, shop fit-outs, warehouses, schools, care homes, a bypass, a stadium, a skyscraper and a suspension bridge.

THINGS GO WRONG
A missing guard rail. A labourer with no CSCS card. A storm on pour day. An HSE inspector at the gate. You make the call, and every choice costs time, money or risk. Cut corners and it could end in a prohibition notice.

BUILDING MINI-GAMES
Lay bricks to the line, pour concrete to the mark, dig the trench without hitting the cable, and spot the hazards on site. Do them well and the job's quality goes up.

THE GAFFER SHOWS YOU ROUND
A quick tutorial walks you through your first jobs.

SELL UP AND GO BIGGER
Outgrown the yard? Sell the firm for Goodwill, pick a perk, and start again with every job paying more.

MAKE IT YOURS
Name your firm, paint your vans, kit out the crew, and pick your cabins and yard sign.

Free to play. Contains ads and optional in-app purchases. Remove Ads is a one-off purchase. No random loot boxes or gambling-style features.

BOSS PASS (OPTIONAL SUBSCRIPTION)
Boss Pass gives +50% speed on every site, 50 gems every day, no between-job ads and 4 more hours of away earnings, for £6.99 a month (or the local equivalent). Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm. It renews automatically each month unless you turn it off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and your account is charged for the renewal in the 24 hours before then. Manage or cancel it any time in Settings > your name > Subscriptions.

Privacy policy: https://wrenhaven.co.uk/privacy/games
Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

Made in Yorkshire by Wrenhaven.

name: Słowo – Biblia Gdańska
description:
Słowo to spokojna aplikacja do czytania Biblii po polsku. Cały tekst Biblii Gdańskiej jest w telefonie, więc czytasz także bez internetu. Nie trzeba zakładać konta, nie ma reklam.

CZYTANIE, KTÓRE NIE MĘCZY OCZU
• Duże litery od pierwszego uruchomienia. Przyciski A− i A+ są zawsze pod tekstem.
• Tryb jasny i tryb nocny, wygodny wieczorem.
• Czytanie kartami: jeden fragment na ekranie, przesuwasz dalej.

CODZIENNIE KILKA MINUT
• Werset dnia rano, o godzinie, o której zwykle otwierasz aplikację.
• Seria dni czytania. Jeśli opuścisz dzień, możesz ją odzyskać, czytając trzy rozdziały w ciągu 48 godzin. Co 7 dni dostajesz zamrożenie, które chroni serię. Niczego z tego się nie kupuje.
• Odkrywaj: przewijaj krótkie fragmenty z całej Biblii zamiast wiadomości.
• Plany czytania: Ewangelie w 30 dni i Psalmy w 30 dni za darmo.

TWOJE NOTATKI
• Zakreślenia w pięciu kolorach, notatki i zakładki.
• Wyszukiwanie w całej Biblii, także bez polskich znaków („swiatlosc” znajdzie „światłość”).
• Przejście do miejsca po skrócie, np. „J 3,16”.
• Udostępnianie wersetu jako obrazka.
• Widżet na ekranie początkowym i blokady.

TEKST, KTÓREMU MOŻNA UFAĆ
Używamy Biblii Gdańskiej w wydaniu z 1881 roku, która jest w domenie publicznej. Nie zmieniamy w niej ani słowa. Źródło i sumę kontrolną pliku znajdziesz w aplikacji, w Ustawieniach → Źródła tekstów.

PRYWATNIE
Aplikacja nie zbiera żadnych danych. Twoje zakreślenia i notatki zostają na Twoim urządzeniu.

SŁOWO PRO
Biblia w aplikacji jest i zawsze będzie za darmo. Pro odblokowuje dodatkowe plany czytania (Nowy Testament w 90 dni, Biblia w rok). Możesz zapłacić raz, na zawsze, albo co roku. Pieniądze idą na przygotowanie cyfrowego wydania Biblii Jakuba Wujka i na korektę tekstów.

Płatność obciąża konto Apple. Subskrypcja roczna odnawia się automatycznie, jeśli nie wyłączysz jej co najmniej 24 godziny przed końcem okresu. Zarządzasz nią w Ustawieniach konta Apple.
Polityka prywatności: https://ferpel.es/slowo/prywatnosc
Warunki użytkowania: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Snowfree - Ski Forever
description:
Point your skis downhill. Carve through fresh snow, catch air, land a flip, and keep moving when the yeti comes after you.

Ski through the signs to enter Slalom, Tree Slalom, or Freestyle. Take the open slope for Free Ride. The mountain keeps going past the finish line, with forests, deep snow, jumps, and lift towers along the way.

Switch between Front and Behind views, chase personal bests, and post eligible scores to the online leaderboard on supported devices.

Play on iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple TV. On Apple Watch, tap to steer and turn the Digital Crown to flip. On Apple Vision Pro, ski in a window, explore a miniature slope, or take on the mountain in an immersive space.

name: Sock Tumble: Match Puzzle
description:
Find the twin. Toss the pair. Sock Tumble is a cheerful matching game about the one chore everybody knows: pairing socks fresh from the dryer.

Socks tumble out onto the table in a messy pile, rotated and overlapping. Spot two with the same color and pattern, drag one onto the other or tap them both, and the pair flies into the laundry basket. Clear every pair to finish the level.

EASY TO PICK UP, TRICKIER THAN IT LOOKS
• Look-alike socks share a color but not a pattern, so look twice.
• Odd socks have no twin at all. Don't fall for them.
• Every so often the dryer kicks and the whole pile tumbles to new spots.
• Quick matches build a combo up to x8.

THREE WAYS TO PLAY
• Adventure: 100 levels along a map through two laundries, Sunny Suds and Midnight Spin. Every level adds one new thing, every fifth level is HARD, and each one earns 1 to 3 stars.
• Endless: beat the clock, level after level. Leftover seconds turn into points.
• Moves: no clock, just a set number of turns. Some socks land inside-out and you flip them to see the pattern. A memory game with socks.
Endless and Moves unlock as you play through Adventure.

POWER-UPS
• Freeze stops the clock.
• Magnet matches two pairs for you.
• Twin Glow lights up a sock's twin.
• Sweep clears the odd socks off the table.

MORE ON THE TABLE
Tap shirts to grab power-ups. Catch boxers, beanies, towels and rare golden boxers for bonus points. Collect coins and sewing buttons, then spend them in the shop on power-ups and room themes: Fresh Mint, Bubblegum and Night Shift.

MADE FOR SHORT BREAKS
• Play one-handed in portrait on iPhone and iPad.
• Short levels, and you can pause any time.
• Plays offline. No account, no sign-up.
• Your progress is saved on your device.

Sock Tumble is free to play and shows a small banner ad. A one-time Remove Ads purchase turns the ads off for good.

Questions or feedback? Write to hello@socktumble.app

name: Son Görülme: Dedektif
description:
Bir telefon bulundu. Sahibi kayıp. Gerisini telefon anlatacak.

Son Görülme, tamamen bir telefonun içinde geçen bir dedektiflik oyunu. Her dosyada kaybolan ya da bir olaya karışan birinin telefonunu incelersin: mesajlar, arama geçmişi, galeri, notlar, e-postalar, takvim ve sosyal medya. Doğru ipuçlarını birleştir, kilitli uygulamaların şifrelerini telefondaki izlerden bul ve dava raporunu yaz.

GERÇEK BİR TELEFON GİBİ
• Kilit ekranı, bildirimler, ana ekran ve uygulamalarıyla eksiksiz bir telefon
• Silinen fotoğraflar, arşivlenmiş sohbetler, gizli notlar
• Her karakterin kendi Fotogram, Klip ve Cıvıl hesapları: gönderiler, hikâyeler, özel mesajlar
• Kilitli uygulamalar: şifre her zaman telefonun bir köşesinde saklı

TELEFON CANLI
İnceleme sürerken telefona yeni aramalar ve mesajlar düşer. Arayan kişi telefonun sahibine ulaştığını sanır; sen sadece dinlersin. Bazı mesajlar birkaç saniye sonra silinir, gözünü dört aç.

DEDEKTİF PANOSU
Bir mesajı, fotoğrafı ya da gönderiyi basılı tut ve panoya iğnele. Kartları sürükle, aralarına kırmızı ip çek, kendi notlarını ekle. Davanın resmini kendin kur.

30 DOSYA, 3 SEZON
Kayıplar, dolandırıcılık, aile sırları, soygunlar ve daha fazlası. Kolay dosyalarla başla, zorlaştıkça daha derin sırlara in. Yıldız topla, bonus dosyaların kilidini aç.

GRUP SORUŞTURMASI
Arkadaşlarınla aynı vakayı çöz. Bir kişi oda kurar, herkes 4 haneli kodu kendi telefonuna girer. Deliller bölünür: her oyuncu farklı bir kişinin telefonunu inceler ve şifreler çoğu zaman başka birinin telefonundadır. Konuşun, tartışın, raporu birlikte tamamlayın. 2–5 oyuncu için 11 uzun ve zor vaka.

GİZLİLİK
Hesap yok, reklam yok, takip yok. Oyun internete bağlanmaz; ilerlemen yalnızca cihazında saklanır.

Oyundaki bütün kişiler, kurumlar ve olaylar kurgudur.

name: SonoScope
description:
Your ear adapts to a room in seconds, hears a brighter mix as a louder one, and cannot give you a number you can write down. SonoScope turns an impression into a figure you can act on, compare, and come back to tomorrow — and it is honest about how much to trust each one.
WHAT IS IN IT • Spectrum and spectrogram — which frequencies are there and how loud each one is, with held peaks, labelled notable frequencies and a scrolling history of everything just played. • Loudness — peak and RMS in dBFS, plus the LUFS, true peak and loudness range that streaming services actually use. • Sound level meter — dBA, dBC and dBZ with noise statistics, a timed measurement period and a hearing-exposure dose against the eight-hour limit. • Room measurement — a sine sweep works out reverb time, frequency response, early reflections and resonant modes. Play it through this device or through your own monitors. • Tempo and key — the BPM of whatever is playing, and a shortlist of the keys it might be in, with a way to hear each one against the music. • Two tuners — a pitch tuner with fourteen guitar, bass and ukulele tunings, an intonation check and a voice view that draws your pitch over time; and a drum tuner that evens a head out lug by lug. • Metronome — real time signatures, subdivisions, an editable beat pattern and a practice graph that shows your tempo drifting. • Recorder — uncompressed, and always holding the last thirty seconds, so you can save what just happened without having pressed record first. • Stereo width and phase — how wide the mix is at each frequency, with a correlation meter, so a phase problem is something you see rather than guess at. • Spectral balance — compare a track's tonal balance against a genre target or a reference record, and hear the difference applied. • Signal generator — tones, noise, clicks and a speaker-wiring check, plus a loopback that lets you prove any meter in the app rather than trust it. • Session log — save any reading with a note and export the lot as a spreadsheet.
FOUR TOOLBOXES, SO IT IS NOT OVERWHELMING Each is built around where the sound is coming from, and you can switch at any time. • Musician — an instrument or a room, through the microphone. • Producer — everything from a loaded track, measured in one pass. • Technician — an external microphone or interface, for room and system work. • Your own — tick the tools you want and leave the rest out.
IT SAYS WHEN IT CANNOT BE SURE Key detection shows three candidates rather than one. A reverb band with too little signal is left blank instead of guessed. The sound level meter says outright that it is uncalibrated. A tempo trace stops recording the moment the microphone does, rather than drawing a flat line that looks like a perfect performance. Each of those is doing you a favour.
RECORDINGS ARE THE REAL THING Uncompressed, exactly the samples the meters saw, exported as 24-bit WAV — never a re-encode. Takes are kept on the device until you delete them.
NOTHING LEAVES YOUR DEVICE No account, no servers, no analytics, no tracking. The audio is analysed on the device and never uploaded, which is why it works just as well with no signal at all.
WHAT YOU NEED The built-in microphone is enough to get started, and a loaded file needs no microphone at all. An audio interface or measurement microphone helps where the absolute numbers have to be right.
Apple gives an app the microphone but never the audio playing inside other apps, so a track from another app is measured by loading the file rather than by listening to it.

name: SoundEscape: Ambient Sounds
description:
SoundEscape is an ambient sound mixer where you place each sound around you. Put the rain behind you and a café to your right: closer is louder, and on headphones the sound on your left really is on your left.

How it works
You sit at the center of a listening chart, with rings every 6 dB out to the edge of earshot. Drag a sound in to hear it, nearer to make it louder, and out past the edge to send it away. The air on the chart moves with what's playing.

On headphones, each sound is rendered binaurally (HRTF), so a sound behind you sounds behind you. On speakers it pans in stereo. SoundEscape chooses between the two on its own.

Drift lets each sound wander a little, so the loops never line up the same way twice.

Start in seconds
The first time you open it, Rainy café is already on the chart. One tap plays it. There's no account to make and no sign-up.

Starting points are ready-made mixes, like Night train, Deep work, Summer night and Lights out. Random builds a new scene each time you tap it.

Keeps playing
• Plays with the screen locked and while you use other apps, with the mix on the Lock Screen and in Control Center.
• Sleep timer from 15 to 90 minutes, with a 60-second fade and a countdown on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island.
• Widgets for the Home Screen and Lock Screen, a Control Center control, and Shortcuts and Siri.
• Every sound is stored in the app, so it works offline.
• Share a mix as a link. It opens in the app, or in the free web version at soundescape.app.
• On iPad, the chart and the sound list sit side by side.
• With VoiceOver, every sound on the chart can be moved nearer, farther, left, right or behind you.

Where the sounds come from
Most sounds are made with AI and three plain noises are made in code; any real recording is marked Recorded. Tap the mark at the end of a sound's row in the list to read how it was made and what you'll hear.

Free
• 31 sounds: white, pink and brown noise, plus two from every other family
• 15 starting points, and Random over the free sounds
• Sleep timer, Drift, widgets, Live Activity and Shortcuts
• 1 saved mix
The free sounds don't run out and there are no ads.

SoundEscape Pro
• All 112 sounds and 69 starting points, and every sound added later
• AirPods head tracking: the scene stays put when you turn your head (supported AirPods and Beats)
• Unlimited saved mixes
• A sleep timer of any length up to 12 hours, with a fade from 10 seconds to 10 minutes

Pro costs $2.99 a month, or $19.99 a year with a 7-day free trial for new subscribers, or $39.99 once for lifetime access. Prices vary by country. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the period, and you can manage or cancel them in your Apple Account settings.

Privacy
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your mixes and listening time stay on your device.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://soundescape.app/privacy

name: Squatch Squat
description:
Meet the squatch: a big, friendly pixel sasquatch with eight little games to play and a cabin in the woods to call home.

EIGHT GAMES
• Classic: squat when the pad turns green and jump the forest critters. Pi sets the beat.
• Toilet Dash: squat as fast as you can, but don't sit when a bug pops out of the bowl!
• Ranger Escape: a park ranger is after you. Jump stumps, rocks and lakes, and double jump the tents.
• Pond Hop: hop logs, lily pads and stepping stones across the ponds.
• Road Crossing: hop the lanes between cars, trucks and the ranger's truck.
• Vine Swing: swing vine to vine through the canopy, out of the ranger's reach.
• Jetpack Squatch: fly the ranger's jetpack through drain pipes, past drones and geese.
• Ranger Run: race down a 3D forest trail. Swipe to change lanes, jump logs and slide under branches.

HOW STARS WORK
Classic is always free to play. The other seven games take a few stars a play: 5 for Toilet Dash, Pond Hop, Road Crossing and Vine Swing, 10 for Ranger Escape and Ranger Run, 15 for Jetpack Squatch. You start with 100 stars and win more in every game, from the daily bonus and missions, or by choosing to watch a short ad. Stars can also be bought in the star shop.

DRESS UP YOUR SQUATCH
Earn stars in every game and spend them in the star shop: hats, sunglasses and other face things, suits, rides, trails, wipeouts and whole new worlds to run through, from snowy woods to candy hills.

YOUR CABIN
Walk around your own cabin in 3D. Play the arcade, sit on the couch and watch the TV, and decorate with tickets you win in the games. Visit other players' cabins and leave a sticker in their guest book.

EVERY DAY
A daily bonus, three daily missions, achievements, and a leaderboard for every game. Share a GIF of your best run.

MADE FOR EVERYONE
Squatch Squat is for all ages. Usernames are checked for rude words, there is no chat, and every ad is rated G.
No Ads is a one-time purchase, and bought stars never expire.

name: Stillkin
description:
Lähellä on paljon hyvää. Stillkin auttaa pysähtymään sen äärelle.

Valitse lyhyt luontohetki, seuraa lempeitä ohjeita ja kirjoita muistiin se, minkä huomasit. Metsään ei tarvitse lähteä: ikkunan valo, huonekasvi tai tuttu äänimaisema riittää.

OMA PIENI LÖYTÖRETKI
24 ohjattua 2–5 minuutin hetkeä neljässä aiheessa: katso, kuuntele, tunne ja vaali. Löydä sopiva hetki hakemalla, tallenna suosikkeja tai anna sattuman valita.

MUISTOISTA KASVAVA PUUTARHA
Jokainen tallennettu havainto saa oman kukan. Palaa muistoihin kukkia koskettamalla, muokkaa merkintöjä tai jaa haluamasi hetki.

OMAAN TAHTIIN
Rauhallinen ajastin, taukomahdollisuus ja vapaaehtoinen päivittäinen muistutus. Ei suoritusputkia tai kilpailua. Voit kirjoittaa havaintosi milloin vain.

MUISTOSI OVAT SINUN
Ei tiliä, mainoksia tai seurantaa. Muistot tallennetaan laitteellesi, ja perustoiminnot toimivat ilman verkkoyhteyttä. Vie JSON-varmuuskopio, tuo aiemmat muistot tai poista tietosi sovelluksen asetuksista.

Stillkin on havaintopäiväkirja, ei terveydenhuollon palvelu. Sovella hetkiä omaan ympäristöösi ja liikkumiseesi sopiviksi.

name: StitchPause: Row Counter
description:
Pick up your crochet or knitting project where you left off. StitchPause keeps your completed counts, pattern position, and a short note together.

Count rows or stitches with a large tap surface, undo, and a lock. Give different sections their own counters, set repeat lengths and goals, and leave a cue for an upcoming row.

Open a PDF or pattern photo from your iPhone and mark your place manually. When it’s time to put your work down, use Pause & Save to record your place and what to do next.

Keep yarn and tool details, save project timer sessions, and export project summaries. Use a full backup to carry your projects and attachments to another iPhone.

Everything is included with the one-time purchase. Your projects work offline and stay on your device unless you choose to export them. Apple purchase sharing, where available, does not synchronize projects.

name: Suki: Who Fed the Cat?
description:
Your cat says nobody has fed her. Your cat is lying.

Suki is a tiny app for houses that share a pet. Feed the cat, tap FED. Scoop a truly upsetting litter tray, tap POOPED. Everyone else in the house gets a notification, and nobody feeds the cat twice. The cat is livid about this.

We made it for Suki, our grumpy house cat, because a house full of busy people could never remember who'd fed her, and she certainly wasn't going to tell us.

WHAT IT DOES
• Big buttons: FED, POOPED and PLAYED. Dogs get WALK as well. Tap one and the whole house knows who did it and when.
• Notifications with attitude. Every tap pings the house, in words written by people who have cleaned a lot of litter trays.
• Nudges when it matters. Nobody's fed the pet by 1pm, or played with it by 8pm? The house hears about it.
• Your pet, in pixels. Cats and dogs, 7 breeds, 28 coats, and a paint tool to get the patches exactly right.
• The wall. Snap the pet doing something stupid and pin it for the house to see.
• It has opinions. Your pet sits on the screen, judges you, licks a paw, naps, and now and then says something rude.
• Widgets for your Home Screen and Lock Screen (iOS 26), so you can check without opening the app.

ONE HOUSE. EVERYONE IN IT.
Make a house and share the six-letter code. That's it. No accounts, no email, no passwords. Partners, flatmates, housemates, the neighbour who feeds them while you're away: anyone with the code is in. Whoever made the house is the BOSS and can kick people out.

SUKI PLUS
One optional purchase, once, for the whole house: paint your pet's coat from a photo, and keep up to 4 pets in a house. Everything else is free.

WHAT IT DOESN'T DO
No ads. No tracking. No subscriptions. No sign-ups. It won't make your cat grateful. Nothing will.

Fair warning: the notifications swear a bit. So does anyone who's just scooped a litter tray.

Made for Suki, who has never once said thank you.

name: Sunplop: Daily Logic Puzzle
description:
Sunplop is a calm, clever logic puzzle about placing suns.

THE RULES FIT IN ONE BREATH
• Put exactly 2 suns in every row and every column.
• A numbered tile is never a sun. Its number tells you how many suns touch it, diagonals included.
• That's it. Tap once for a sun, twice for a dot, and let logic do the rest.

A NEW PUZZLE EVERY DAY
The Daily Sun is the same puzzle for every player, every day. Solve it to keep your streak alive, then share your result with friends without spoiling the solution.

2,400+ LEVELS THAT GROW WITH YOU
Start with quick 4×4 grids that teach you the basics, then climb through 100 chapters up to big 9×9 boards. New twists appear along the way:
• Clouds: tiles that are never suns and count nothing.
• Green numbers: they only count the 4 tiles directly beside them.
• Bigger grids that reward careful thinking.

FAIR, CHECKED PUZZLES
Every level and every daily puzzle has been checked by a solver to have exactly one solution, so you never get stuck on a broken puzzle.

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Earn up to 3 stars per level: solve without hints and beat the target time.
• Collect Rays as you play and spend them on hints, skipping a tough level, or a Streak Joker that saves a missed day.
• Undo, clear and hints whenever you need them.
• Sound effects and relaxing music, both easy to switch off.
• No account needed.
• Available in English, German, French, Spanish and Portuguese.

Sunplop is free to play. It contains ads and offers optional in-app purchases, including Ray packs and removing banner ads.

Good luck, and enjoy the sunshine!

name: SypDeck
description:
Track your daily cups across four distinct beverage categories with responsive, full-surface clickers, customize individual serving volumes, and monitor your cumulative fluid intake in real time.

KEY FEATURES

• 4 Dedicated Beverage Clickers:
Quickly log Tea, Coffee, Ice Tea, and Cold Soda with satisfying tap animations and haptic feedback. Each beverage features custom vector artwork rendered natively with smooth liquid indicators.

• Customizable Serving Sizes (ml):
Every drink comes with calibrated presets (Small, Medium, Large) and fine-tuning steppers (-25 ml / +25 ml). Adjust cup sizes freely between 50 ml and 1000 ml to match your exact glassware.

• Live Consumption Projections:
Instantly calculate your fluid intake benchmarks:
- Daily: Total cups and liters consumed today with a visual liquid progress bar.
- Weekly: 7-day volume estimate based on your current pace.
- Monthly: 30-day projection based on your daily tally.

• Quick Actions (Undo & Reset):
Made a mistake? Tap Undo to instantly roll back your last logged cup, or tap Reset to clear the deck for a fresh start.

• Dedicated Deck Tuning & Settings:
Calibrate your daily target goal (from 4 to 20 cups), inspect the serving size matrix for all beverages, and toggle haptic or animation feedback preferences.

name: sysmoni -超軽量システムモニターウィジェット
description:
ホーム画面に置くだけで、iPhone の状態がひと目でわかる。
sysmoni（シスモニ）は、CPU・メモリ・ストレージ・モバイル通信量・バッテリーを、Apple 純正のバッテリーウィジェットのようなリングで表示する、超軽量のシステムモニターです。

■ とことん軽く作りました
・常駐しません。バックグラウンドで動き続ける処理はありません
・通信しません。外部へのデータ送信、広告、解析ツール、追跡は一切ありません
・ウィジェットは iOS が決めたタイミングで一瞬だけ値を読むだけ。電池やメモリへの影響は最小限です
・アプリ本体は約1MB。外部のライブラリも使っていません

■ 純正のようなウィジェット
・中サイズは4つの配置から選べます（リング4つ／リング4つ＋1行／二重リング／リング5つ）
・小・大サイズ、ロック画面（丸・横長・1行）にも対応
・リングに表示する項目を5つの枠で自由に入れ替え
・更新間隔は15分／30分／1時間／手動から選択。ウィジェットをタップすればいつでも最新に
・使用率に合わせてリングの色が緑→黄→赤に変わります（目安は自分で設定できます）
・ライト／ダークモード、iPad にも対応

■ 表示できる項目
・CPU 使用率（アプリではコアごとの使用率も）
・メモリの使用率・空き、内訳（アプリ・固定・圧縮・キャッシュ）
・ストレージの使用率・空き容量
・モバイル通信量（今月・今日）と、月の容量に対する割合
・Wi-Fi の通信量（今月・今日）
・バッテリー残量・充電状態・低電力モード
・熱状態（4段階）と推定残容量（mAh）
・現在の通信速度、回線（5G／LTE）、IP アドレス
・機種・チップ・OS・画面・リフレッシュレート・起動してからの時間

■ ギガの使いすぎを防ぐ
月の容量と締め日を設定すると、今月のモバイル通信量がリングでわかります。通信会社の表示に合わせて、今月の使用量を補正することもできます。

■ アプリを開けばリアルタイム
アプリを開いている間は、すべての値を1〜5秒ごとに更新します。閉じると完全に止まります。

■ 料金
基本機能は無料です。中サイズのウィジェットで CPU・メモリ・ストレージ・バッテリーを表示できます。
sysmoni Pro（買い切り）で、すべての項目・すべてのウィジェット・配置と項目の変更が使えるようになります。サブスクリプションではありません。
はじめての方は、1か月間すべての機能を無料で試せます。自動で課金されることはありません。

■ ご注意
・iOS はアプリに電池の温度・電圧・実際の容量を公開していないため、熱状態は4段階、残容量は機種の設計容量から計算した推定値です。
・モバイル通信量は端末が数えている値を積み上げたもので、通信会社の請求とは一致しないことがあります。
・ウィジェットの更新回数は iOS が調整するため、設定した間隔より遅れることがあります。

サポート：https://asteroid-technology.com/sysmoni-support/

name: TabuTabi
description:
TabuTabi, arkadaşlarınla aynı odada oynadığın yasaklı kelime anlatma oyunu. Takımını kur, kartı çek, yasaklı kelimeleri kullanmadan anlat.

SESLİ HAKEM
Tilki hakem anlatan kişiyi canlı dinler. Yasaklı kelimeyi söylediğin an düdüğü çalar ve cezayı yazar. Türkçenin eklerini tanır: "kitap" yasaksa "kitaplar", "kitabı" da yakalanır.

YALNIZCA ANLATAN CEZALANDIRILIR
Tur başında anlatıcı sesini 5 saniyeliğine tanıtır. Tahmin eden takım arkadaşları aynı kelimeyi bağırsa bile ceza yazılmaz.

SENİN KURALLARIN
• 700'den fazla kart, beş zorluk seviyesi
• 30, 60, 90 ya da 120 saniyelik turlar
• Hedef skor ve pas hakkı seçimi
• Açık ve koyu görünüm

REKLAM YOK, HESAP YOK
Kaydolmadan aç ve oyna. Skorların, takım adların ve ses profilin telefonundan çıkmaz; ses profili tur bitince silinir. Sesli hakem Apple'ın konuşma tanımasını kullanır: cihazına göre telefonda ya da Apple'da işlenir ve internet gerektirebilir. Hakem kapalıyken oyun tamamen çevrimdışı oynanır.

name: Tang Polo
description:
Play a Tang dynasty polo match on the imperial spring field.

Ride a red horse, carry a crescent polo mallet, and face two rival riders. Build speed, line up the ball, and strike through the opposing goal. First to five goals wins the match. The 3D field, watchtowers, and upturned eaves are built for the period, with a chase camera that keeps the ball in view.

• 3D Tang-style spring polo field
• Ride, turn, sprint, and swing controls
• Two AI rival riders
• First to five goals
• Touch-friendly controls for iPhone and iPad

No account, no ads, no in-app purchases, and no data collection.

name: Tanglo: Mind & Focus Puzzle
description:
Every tangle is a tiny puzzle for your mind. Slow down, spot the pattern, and drag the knots until no two cables cross. A few calm minutes of Tanglo a day keeps your focus sharp.

HOW IT WORKS
• Drag the knots to uncross the cables
• Every cable you free pops off the board, and chains of pops earn big bonuses
• Finish with moves to spare for 3 stars

A JOURNEY THROUGH 7 WORLDS, 105 LEVELS
• The Pocket: tangled earphones and chargers
• The Bedroom: cables plugged into wall sockets
• The Terrace: sharp kite string that snaps if you rush
• The Balcony: festive lights wrapped in tape
• Behind the TV: sparking extension boards
• The Street: crows sitting on the wires
• Space: quantum twins that move as a pair

GOALS THAT KEEP IT FRESH
Untangle everything, free the glowing cables, pop a set number, plug knots into their sockets, or beat the clock in Speed Knots.

TOOLS AND REWARDS
Earn Scissors, Magnets and Combs from clever combos. Collect a gold badge every 10 levels, pick your avatar, and keep a Daily Mind Workout streak.

CALM BY DESIGN
No account, no sign-in, no ads, no tracking, and it works offline. Just you and the knots.

name: Tankō: Book & Audiobook Reader
description:
Tankō reads the manga, comics and books you already own, and plays your audiobooks. Drop in CBZ, CBR, PDF, EPUB, MOBI or AZW3 files, M4B or MP3 audiobooks, or whole folders of images or tracks, and they become a library you will want to look at.

READ YOUR WAY
• Single page, double page, vertical scroll for webtoons, or panel by panel
• Right to left for manga, remembered per series
• Double-page artwork is detected and kept whole, or split into halves on a portrait iPhone
• Novels as EPUB with your choice of font, size and spacing
• Real page curl, or a plain slide if you prefer
• On-device translation of speech bubbles
• True black for OLED, custom backgrounds, night warmth

AUDIOBOOKS
• Chapters read straight from the file, speed from 0.5× to 3.5×, sleep timer with shake to extend
• Bookmarks with notes, Lock Screen and headphone controls, AirPlay, mini player
• Covers found automatically when a file has none
• Pro: voice boost, smart speed, car mode, and read & listen to switch between the e-book and the audiobook

MADE FOR EVERY SCREEN
• iPhone, iPad and iPhone Duo. On Duo, two pages meet exactly at the fold
• Sidebar, multiple windows and keyboard shortcuts on iPad
• Apple Watch: your current book, today's goal, and play or pause the audiobook

YOUR OWN SERVER
• Browse and download from OPDS catalogues: Komga, Kavita, Calibre-Web and more
• Audiobookshelf libraries, with your listening position kept in step
• Komga and Kavita keep your reading position in step with the server

BOOKS, THE WAY YOU LIKE THEM
• Contents, bookmarks, highlights in five colours, notes and search
• Sepia, Paper, Calm, Quiet and Night themes; New York, Charter, Georgia and more
• Two pages side by side in landscape
• Share any passage as a beautiful quote card
• Collections, Want to Read and Finished
• iCloud sync of your place, highlights and notes between iPhone and iPad
• Widgets, Siri and Shortcuts: "Continue reading in Tankō"

ONLY IN TANKŌ (Pro)
• Bookshelf: your library as real spines, with missing volumes marked
• Scrapbook: clip favourite panels and passages, sorted by series
• Story so far: come back after a few days and see the pages you lingered on
• Translation of speech bubbles, on your device
• Read aloud in natural voices for English and 31 other languages, running on your iPhone
• Daily goal, streaks, reminders, statistics and your year in review
• Vocabulary list, Paper mode, panel-by-panel reading, app icons

PRIVATE
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your files stay on your device. Apart from two public-domain classics to try it out, Tankō provides no content of its own.

Pro is a single purchase. No subscription.

name: TapTalk Korean
description:
TapTalk Korean lets travelers talk with people in South Korea without speaking Korean, just by tapping.

Choose a question in English and show the screen. The other person sees the question in Korean with answer choices. The answer they tap appears in English, and you can go straight on to a follow-up question. No typing needed.

TWO-WAY CONVERSATION
• You pick a question in English
• The other person taps an answer in Korean
• The answer appears in English, with a one-tap follow-up question
• The screen shown to the other person is in Korean only

SHOPPING, RESTAURANTS, HOTELS, TRANSPORT
• Prices, payment, tax refunds, ordering, spiciness, check-in, stations, taxis, and more
• Korea-specific questions too: side-dish (banchan) refills, single servings, ordering kiosks, grilling the meat, buying and topping up a T-money card, subway exit numbers
• The other person can answer amounts and numbers on a number pad
• See an estimate in your own currency next to the amount in won, using a rate you enter yourself (works offline)
• Rotate the screen 180 degrees for the person across the table

AUDIO
• Play the question aloud in Korean
• The audio is AI-generated speech built into the app, so it plays offline

OFFLINE
• Questions and answers are built in, so it works in Airplane Mode
• No accounts, ads, or tracking

FREE AND FULL PACK
• Basic conversation and common shopping and restaurant questions (26) are free
• The Full Pack, a one-time purchase, unlocks all 110 questions including hotels and transport. Not a subscription.

PLEASE NOTE
• Answers and translations are not a guarantee of safety or accuracy. For allergies, dietary restrictions, health, medicine, or emergencies, do not rely on this app alone.
• The Korean text and audio have not yet been checked by native speakers.
• The app is available in English and Japanese.

name: Task Tracker: Cycles & Sprints
description: Task Tracker is a private, offline-first personal planner organized around Work Cycles → Sprints → Tasks. Plan your work in cycles, break them into sprints, and track tasks with custom workflow statuses and progress. Everything is stored locally on your device — no accounts, no cloud, no tracking. Export/import a versioned JSON backup to move your data between devices.

name: Tender: One Idea a Day
description:
Tender turns her cycle into four seasons and gives you one small, specific thing to do each day, so you are there before she has to ask.

WORKS WITH ANY PERIOD APP
She keeps using the tracker she already has. A photo or screenshot of her calendar is enough: point your camera at her phone, or choose a screenshot, and Tender reads it on your iPhone in a couple of seconds. Nothing is uploaded. No screenshot? Pick the day her last period started and you are done.

ONE IDEA A DAY
Not a list of tips. One idea, timed to where she is: a quiet night in when her energy is low, something new when it is rising, a heads-up before the tender days. Tap Done, ask for another, or skip it. Tender learns what lands.

HER SEASONS AT A GLANCE
Winter, spring, summer, autumn. A single orb shows today, and a ribbon of colour shows the next three weeks. No charts to study.

NEVER ONLY THEN
Big gestures are spread across her whole month, on purpose. Care that only shows up on certain days stops feeling like care.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account needed. Her dates stay on your phone. If you choose to back up with Apple, the backup is encrypted on your phone first, so we cannot read it either. Notifications say nothing revealing on a lock screen.

TRYING FOR A BABY
Switch it on and Tender shows her most likely fertile days, helps you keep those evenings free, and stays kind through the wait.

GOOD TO KNOW
- Tender estimates dates from her past periods. Every body varies, and estimates can be off by days.
- Tender is not a contraceptive and is not a medical device. Do not use it to prevent pregnancy, and talk to a doctor about any health concern.
- It works best when she is in on it: ask her for the screenshot.

name: Tessera Home Music
description:
Tessera plays the music you keep on your own server, at home or anywhere.

Connect Tessera to Navidrome or any other Subsonic-compatible music server and your whole library is in your pocket:

• Albums, artists, playlists and favourites, with big covers and a calm, dark design
• Now Playing with shuffle, repeat, a queue you can change, and lyrics when your server has them
• Autoplay that keeps the music going with similar songs when the queue ends
• Search across your whole library
• Save songs to your phone and listen offline
• Controls on the lock screen, in Control Center and on your headphones

Your music, your server, your data. Tessera has no account of its own, no ads and no tracking. It talks only to the servers you sign in to; nothing is sent to us.

Tessera does not come with music: you need your own music server, or one somebody shares with you.

name: The Ages of San Francisco
description:
San Francisco's history is written in its buildings. This storybook map colors all 177,000 of them by the year they were built, so you can see the city's story at a glance.

Four chapters of the city
The Victorian city that survived the 1906 earthquake and fire. The rebuilt city of Edwardian flats and the roaring twenties. The Sunset city of stucco homes and postwar suburbs. And the tall city that grew upward after 1970.

Near me
Tap "Near me" to see the buildings around you: how many there are within 200 meters, when most of them were built, and the oldest one nearby.

Watch the city grow
Press play and watch San Francisco fill in, year by year, from 1850 to today.

Tap any building
See when it was built, how tall it is, what it's used for, how many homes it holds, and share it with friends.

More ways to look
Color the city by height, floor area or use. Raise the city in 3D. Explore leaderboards of the tallest, biggest and oldest buildings.

On your phone
All 177,000 buildings are stored on your phone, so they appear instantly and still work with no signal (the street map underneath returns when you're back online). Share any building through the share sheet, and feel a gentle tap as you explore. Your location stays on your phone and is never collected.

Data from DataSF and SF Planning. Map data from OpenStreetMap contributors via OpenFreeMap. Years come from city land use records, which are kept per lot, so some buildings show an approximate year.

name: TileCanopy
description:
Plan a rectangular tile grid from your own dimensions, inspect visible cuts, and compare layout choices before saving a plan.

• Enter exact decimal surface, tile, grout and reserve measurements in millimetres.
• Compare corner-anchored and centred layouts in straight or 90-degree-rotated tile orientation.
• Inspect positive-area visible cells, full tiles, cuts and their clipped dimensions.
• Review covered area, grout area and a clearly stated suggested original-tile count.
• Freeze a plan with a fitted PDF diagram and complete cut-schedule CSV.

TileCanopy is a rectangular layout planner. It does not reuse offcuts, optimise boxes or promise a minimum-cost installation. Each visible cell consumes a separate original tile in the estimate. Diagrams fit the display or page and are not 1:1 physical templates.

Your saved work stays in this app’s local library. Use the system sharing controls when you choose to export a file. System backups may include app data.

name: TinkerTill: 3D Print Pricing
description:
TinkerTill helps kids and teens who 3D print work out what each print really costs to make, and what to charge for it. Price it. Sell it. Keep it.

PRICE IT (free, no account needed)
• Add each filament color, the grams, and how long the print takes.
• TinkerTill adds the filament, electricity, printer wear, color swaps, Oops prints (the ones that fail), your time, and add-ons like keyrings or magnets.
• Pick a price style: Friends price, Fair price or Shop price. You get an easy-to-say price, and how much you'll earn.
• Selling a lot at once? Get a wholesale price that still earns you money.
• Works in many currencies, including dollars, pounds, euros, and currencies from the Middle East and around the world.

SELL IT AND KEEP IT (with the Family plan)
• My prints: save prints and their prices, find them again, and copy them for a new color.
• My shop: keep track of orders, what's been made, handed over and paid, and how many you have in stock.
• My filament: keep your spools and their prices so you never type them again.
• Up to 3 kid profiles in one family, each with their own prints and shop.
• Use it on more than one iPhone or iPad, and with a second parent or guardian.

MADE FOR KIDS, RUN BY PARENTS
• Only a parent or guardian (18+) can make an account. Kids never give an email, phone number, birthday, photo or location.
• A parent PIN is needed before TinkerTill opens any website or makes a purchase.
• No ads, no tracking, and we never sell anyone's information.
• Parents can download or delete their family's information at any time, right in the app.
• Big buttons, plain words, and Undo instead of scary pop-ups. Built to work with VoiceOver and larger text.

THE FAMILY PLAN
Price it is free, with no account.
The Family plan is $2.99 a month or $29.99 a year (US prices; the App Store shows your local price), with a 1-month free trial for every new family.
• Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase, after the free trial ends.
• The plan renews automatically unless it's turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account is charged for the renewal within 24 hours before the end of the period.
• Manage or cancel any time in your Apple Account settings (Settings → your name → Subscriptions).
• If the plan ends, your saved prints and shop are kept safe, ready for when you come back.

Terms of use: https://sumr415.github.io/tinkertill-site/terms-of-use.html
Privacy policy: https://sumr415.github.io/tinkertill-site/privacy-policy.html

Questions or ideas? Email thetinkertill@gmail.com.

name: Tiny Bays
description:
Calm, small and a little bit magical: a toy parking school, set down right on your floor or table.

A glossy toy car sits on a toy-town lot of painted bays, ringed by pastel buildings. You are the nervous new driver. The instructor is patient. Nothing here shouts at you.

16 LESSONS IN 4 CHAPTERS
- Car Park: learn the bays at your own pace, from your first straight-in park to parallel and tight squeezes.
- Street: traffic, and a red light to wait at.
- Town: a crossroads, and a level crossing with a train.
- Lot Jam: a puzzle. Parked cars box in your bay, each with an exit arrow. Pinch one and it toots and drives off if its way is clear, or bonks if not. Clear the way, then park.

KNOW WHAT YOU'RE AIMING FOR
Before each drive, a big goal card shows three star goals:
1 star: stop inside the bay.
2 stars: neat, nearly square, with one scrape at most.
3 stars: perfect, square, centred and touch-free.
Live goal chips on the console strike through when a contact rules a star out.

DRIVE YOUR WAY
A 3D toy steering wheel and big BRAKE and GAS pedals float at your hands. Use gaze and pinch, or touch them directly. Grab the bars to move the wheel and pedals wherever feels comfortable, and they turn to face you as you drag. A game controller works too, and is optional. Brake rolls into reverse. Parking sensors show arcs and beep faster as you close in.

YOUR TABLE, YOUR LOT
Move and turn the whole toy lot with its MOVE and TURN handles. It remembers where you left it.

GENTLE FEEDBACK
Close calls pop a "Hairline!" with a sparkle chime. Bumps are a cartoon boop and a "bonk!", never a harsh fail. Restart with one tap, or rewind 3 seconds (a rewind caps you at 2 stars).

THE PERFECT PARK
The car eases square and settles on its springs. A shock ring rolls across the lot, a rubber stamp slams in, and paper confetti flutters down and stays on the lot. Perfect parks in a row build a streak.

SMALL TOWN DETAILS
- A duck family waddles beside your route, and scatters with a quack if you drive too close.
- Every lesson has an instructor "Show me" demo.
- Earn stars to unlock new paint jobs for your car in the Garage (six in all).
- Calm synthesised sound, chapter music and controller rumble.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No accounts, no ads, no tracking, no network.

Take your time. The ducks will wait.

name: ToDo Hero – Task List
description:
ToDo Hero is the simple task app for anyone who wants to stay calmly on top of their day. No learning curve, no cluttered menus: type a task, hit Return, done.

MY DAY
• Every morning, pull what matters today into My Day. Tomorrow, your day starts fresh.
• Important, Planned, and All automatically gather your tasks from every list.

QUICK ENTRY
• Type “Call the dentist tomorrow at 9” – ToDo Hero recognizes the date and time and reminds you right on time.
• An “!” at the end marks the task as important.

LISTS WITH CHARACTER
• Colors, emojis, and 20 backgrounds – from mountain lake to northern lights.
• Groups keep work and personal life apart.
• Simply drag tasks into another list or into the order you want.

EVERYTHING IN ONE PLACE
• Steps for bigger projects, notes, due dates, and reminders.
• Repeats: daily, weekdays, weekly, monthly, yearly, or every few weeks.
• Attachments: photos, PDFs, and documents right on the task.

THE SAME EVERYWHERE
• iCloud keeps your lists in sync across iPhone, iPad, and Mac automatically.
• On Mac with a menu bar and keyboard shortcuts, on iPad with a sidebar.

DONE FEELS GOOD
• A gentle sound, a checkmark – and when everything’s done, the hero cheers along with you.
• Completed tasks move out of sight but are still easy to find.

SAFE AND SOUND
• Back up everything to a single file, attachments included – to keep or to move to a new device.
• No ads, no tracking, no account: your data stays on your devices and in your own iCloud storage.

FREE – WITH A TIP JAR
ToDo Hero costs nothing and locks nothing behind a paywall. If you like, you can drop something in the hero’s tip jar: anything from a piece of candy to heroic recognition.

ToDo Hero is available in 12 languages. Questions and suggestions: todohero.huwi.ch

name: TohanNova 登録販売者 一問一答・模擬試験
description:
TohanNova（トウハンノバ）は、登録販売者試験の対策アプリです。医薬品に共通する特性と基本的な知識・人体の働きと医薬品・主な医薬品とその作用・薬事に関する法規と制度・医薬品の適正使用と安全対策の 5 項目を、テキスト・一問一答・模擬試験で一つのアプリで。項目ごとの合格予測と弱点の分析が、次に何をやるかを決めてくれます。厚生労働省「試験問題の作成に関する手引き（令和 8 年 4 月）」と 2026 年 5 月 1 日時点の法令にもとづいています。

■ 今日の学習（弱点の分析と合格予測）
一問一答の正誤と模擬試験の採点結果を単元ごとに集め、正答率の低い単元を弱点として出します。復習の期限が来た問題（忘却曲線: 1 → 3 → 7 → 14 → 30 日）、弱点の単元、まだ解いていない問題を 20 問に組んだ「今日の学習」をホームに用意します。登録販売者試験は合計 7 割と項目ごとの足切りがあるので、合格予測も項目ごとに出し、足りない項目を知らせます。

■ テキスト（42 本）
全 42 単元に、要点・表（かぜ薬の成分、漢方処方の「しばり」、リスク区分ごとの販売と情報提供、救済制度の給付と請求期限など）・「ここが出る」を短くまとめました。読んだらそのまま単元の問題へ進めます。

■ 一問一答（536 問）
・医薬品に共通する特性と基本的な知識: 医薬品の本質、副作用、相互作用、小児・高齢者・妊婦、プラセボと品質、セルフメディケーション、薬害の歴史
・人体の働きと医薬品: 消化器・呼吸器・循環器・泌尿器、目・鼻・耳、皮膚・骨・筋肉、脳と神経、薬の働く仕組みと剤形、全身・局所の副作用
・主な医薬品とその作用: かぜ薬、解熱鎮痛薬、眠気・乗物酔い、鎮咳去痰薬、胃腸薬、循環器・貧血、痔・婦人薬、アレルギー・鼻炎、眼科用薬、皮膚の薬、歯・口・禁煙補助、滋養強壮、漢方・生薬、消毒薬・殺虫剤・検査薬
・薬事に関する法規と制度: 登録販売者、医薬品の分類、表示、医薬部外品・化粧品・食品、販売業の許可、リスク区分ごとの販売と陳列、広告と監視指導
・医薬品の適正使用と安全対策: 添付文書の読み方（「してはいけないこと」「相談すること」）、安全性情報、副作用の報告、副作用被害救済制度、主な安全対策
本番と同じ 5 択（「a〜d の正誤の組合せ」「正しいものの組合せ」）と、要点を確かめる ○× で。

■ 模擬試験（本番形式・10 回分、各 120 問・計 1,200 問）
5 項目を手引きの章の順で、各項目 20 問 40 分（主な医薬品とその作用は 40 問 80 分）。全項目を通しで解くほか、項目を選んでその項目だけを本番の時間で解けます。自動で採点して合計 84 問と項目ごとの 3 割 5 分に届いたかを示し、全問の正解と解説で見直せます。添付文書を読んで答える事例問題も入れています。
問題冊子・答案用紙（マークシート）・採点表を印刷して紙で解き、答えを入れて採点することもできます。

■ 通知
毎日のリマインダー（時刻を選べます）は、その日の復習の数と弱点の単元を本文にします。本番の日を入れると、ホームに残り日数が出て、1 週間前・3 日前・前日・当日にも知らせます。

■ 記録
項目ごとの合格予測、弱点の単元、項目ごとの正答率、模擬試験の点の推移、日ごとの学習量を残します。

すべての問題（買い切り ¥980、1 回払い）: すべての一問一答・テキスト・模擬試験。今後の版で増える問題も追加料金なしで使えます。

・機種を変えたときは、同じ Apple ID で「購入を復元」を押すと引き継げます。

■ 安心してお使いいただくために
通信は一切しません。アカウントも広告もありません。記録はこの iPhone の中だけに残り、通知もこの iPhone の中で組みます。

■ 問題について
問題と解説はすべて当社の書き下ろしで、実際の試験の過去問ではありません。厚生労働省「試験問題の作成に関する手引き（令和 8 年 4 月）」と 2026 年 5 月 1 日時点の医薬品医療機器等法などにもとづいています（指定濫用防止医薬品の販売ルール、要指導医薬品の「対面等」による販売と特定要指導医薬品、拘禁刑への改正などを含みます）。改正や手引きの改訂があれば更新します。合格基準は多くの都道府県の例（合計 7 割以上かつ項目ごとに 3 割 5 分以上）で、県によって異なる場合があります。誤りに気づかれた場合は、サポートページからお知らせください。

登録販売者試験は、各都道府県が実施しています。本アプリは厚生労働省・都道府県の公式アプリではなく、承認や推奨を受けたものではありません。
